papers.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. We organize the pyramid around the tension between scalability and robot alignment, and further characterize each source in terms of data quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity. We then analyze recent embodied foundation models through the lens of their data recipes, examining how different sources are selected, aligned, and mixed during pretraining. For embodied brain models, vision-language-action models, and world-action models alike, we relate data composition to capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, action generation, and world prediction. We close by discussing six open challenges: building large-scale tactile datasets, collecting failure and recovery data, developing scalable data-collection pipelines, aligning actions across embodiments, leveraging egocentric data for dexterous manipulation, and designing principled data recipes for robot learning. We hope this work paves the foundation for the design of next-generation embodied systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统化组织具身操作的数据生态，提出一个“数据金字塔”框架，涵盖真实机器人数据、UMI风格数据、自我中心/异中心数据、仿真数据和通用视觉语言数据五类互补来源。围绕可扩展性与机器人对齐之间的张力，分析了各数据源的质量、多样性、可重用性和物理保真度，并考察近期具身基础模型的数据配方如何选择、对齐和混合不同来源。最后讨论了六个开放挑战，旨在为下一代具身系统设计奠定基础。
Motivation: 具身智能体无法像多模态基础模型那样直接利用互联网数据，因为需要耦合观测、物理状态和动作的数据。多种数据源能提供不同程度的信号，但缺乏系统化的组织与分析框架。
Method: 提出具身数据金字塔框架，将数据源分为五类，并从数据质量、多样性、可重用性和物理保真度四个维度刻画。在此基础上，分析近期具身基础模型（如具身脑模型、视觉-语言-动作模型、世界-动作模型）的数据配方，探讨数据组成与感知、推理、规划、动作生成、世界预测等能力的关系。
Result: 将具身数据生态系统组织为金字塔结构，揭示了不同数据源在可扩展性与机器人对齐之间的权衡，并归纳了数据配方对具身代理能力的影响。
Conclusion: 总结六个开放挑战：大规模触觉数据集、失败与恢复数据收集、可扩展数据收集流程、跨具身动作对齐、自我中心数据用于灵巧操作、数据配方的原理性设计。强调这些方向是构建下一代具身系统的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) hold immense potential to revolutionize clinical practice, yet deploying them in the medical domain is fundamentally a vision-centric challenge: models must absorb knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images, and evaluation protocols must align with radiologists' clinical practice and provide an accurate, fine-grained and factualness-driven assessment. In this paper, we introduce ClinFusion, a vision-centric MLLM designed for holistic medical understanding that systematically addresses these limitations. We propose a compositional and cascaded vision encoder architecture featuring a Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion operator that unifies diverse 2D and native 3D medical image understanding within a fused encoder. We further introduce a vision-grounded evaluation framework, including MedIF-Bench for instruction-following assessment and a region-of-interest-grounded method for clinically aligned and factualness-driven report generation evaluation. We show that ClinFusion sets a new state-of-the-art across a comprehensive suite of 2D and 3D multimodal medical benchmarks---spanning visual question answering, report generation, and instruction following---as well as textual medical tasks, outperforming leading open-source medical MLLMs (\textit{e.g.}, Hulu-Med, Lingshu) on 20 out of 24 benchmarks and demonstrating multimodal capabilities better than powerful proprietary models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3-Flash on 13 out of 16 benchmarks, and can be further augmented with agentic tool use for retrieval-augmented and tool-assisted clinical workflows. A blinded evaluation by board-certified radiologists confirms that ClinFusion produces the highest-ranked reports, and validates our RoI-grounded metric as achieving the strongest correlation with expert judgment among all automatic evaluation metrics examined.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClinFusion 是一个以视觉为中心的多模态大语言模型（MLLM），旨在实现整体医学理解。它提出了一种组合式级联视觉编码器架构，通过级联空间感知局部融合算子统一处理 2D 和 3D 医学图像，并引入基于视觉的评估框架（包括 MedIF-Bench 指令遵循评估和基于感兴趣区域的报告生成评估）。在 24 个医学基准测试中，ClinFusion 在 20 个上优于领先的开源医学 MLLM，在 16 个上优于 GPT-5.2 和 Gemini-3-Flash 等专有模型；放射科医生的盲审证实其报告质量最高，且所提 RoI 指标与专家判断的相关性最强。
Motivation: 将多模态大语言模型部署到医学领域面临视觉中心挑战：模型必须从异质 2D 和 3D 医学图像中吸收知识，且评估协议需要与放射科医生的临床实践对齐，提供准确、细粒度且基于事实的评估。现有方法和评估框架未系统解决这些问题。
Method: 提出 ClinFusion 系统，包含组合式级联视觉编码器（Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion 算子）以统一 2D 和原生 3D 医学图像理解，同时引入视觉驱动的评估框架，包括指令遵循基准 MedIF-Bench 和基于感兴趣区域（RoI）的临床对齐报告生成评估方法。
Result: 在 24 个 2D/3D 医学多模态基准（涵盖视觉问答、报告生成、指令遵循）和文本医学任务中，ClinFusion 在 20 个上优于领先开源医学 MLLM（如 Hulu-Med、Lingshu），在 13/16 个上优于 GPT-5.2 和 Gemini-3-Flash 等专有模型；盲审中放射科医生认为其报告质量最高，且 RoI 指标与专家判断的相关性优于所有其他自动评估指标。
Conclusion: ClinFusion 在整体医学理解上达到了新的最先进水平，可进一步通过智能体工具增强用于检索增强和工具辅助的临床工作流。盲审结果验证了其临床实用性和 RoI 评估方法的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Certified Parallel-in-Time Sinkhorn for Dynamic Entropic Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic applications, including optimal-transport Flow Matching, repeatedly solve related entropic optimal transport problems, yet conventional distributed Sinkhorn processes frames sequentially and synchronizes after every iteration. We present TemporalSinkhorn, a parallel-in-time executor that batches future candidates and their repairs without making output accuracy speculative. A centered, row-sharded certificate accepts only a deterministic safe prefix. The remaining candidates share packed Sinkhorn updates; an online projective forgetting rate places audit milestones, while a posteriori residual checks recover from every depth underestimate. Prediction can therefore change work placement but cannot authorize an inaccurate output. On 4 A100 GPUs, a 60-run, five-seed grid at n = 2048 shows that forgetting-guided milestones reduce wall time by 1.15x-1.47x relative to auditing every packed iteration in five statistically resolved regime cells. Against a sequential soft c-transform warm start, temporal execution is 1.42x-3.55x faster across six synthetic streams, with zero marginal-tolerance violations. On Flow Matching minibatch streams, temporal execution is 3.054x-3.632x faster than sequential carry at n = 2048, with no tolerance violations. A separate fixed-kernel test on an RTX 4060 Laptop GPU gives a 4.315x geometric-mean speedup. These are complementary deployment studies rather than a controlled hardware comparison. End-to-end Flow Matching integration, optimized-solver comparisons, and multi-node validation remain open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TemporalSinkhorn，一种用于动态熵最优传输的并行时间执行器。通过将未来候选批量处理并修复，同时利用中心化行分片证书保证输出确定性安全前缀，在 4 块 A100 GPU 上达到 1.42-3.55 倍加速（相对于顺序软 c-transform 热启动），并在 Flow Matching 小批量流上实现 3.05-3.63 倍加速，无容差违规。
Motivation: 动态应用（如最优传输流匹配）需要重复求解相关的熵最优传输问题，但传统分布式 Sinkhorn 顺序处理帧并在每次迭代后同步，效率低下。
Method: 提出 TemporalSinkhorn，一种并行时间执行器，批量化未来候选及其修复，通过中心化行分片证书仅接受确定性安全前缀，并采用在线投影遗忘率设置审计里程碑，配合后验残差检查从深度低估中恢复。
Result: 在 4 块 A100 GPU 上，60 次运行、5 种子网格（n=2048）下，遗忘引导的里程碑相比审计每次打包迭代减少 1.15-1.47 倍墙钟时间；相对于顺序软 c-transform 热启动，在六个合成流上实现 1.42-3.55 倍加速；在 Flow Matching 小批量流上，n=2048 时加速 3.054-3.632 倍；RTX 4060 笔记本 GPU 上几何平均加速 4.315 倍，均无容差违规。
Conclusion: 这些是互补的部署研究而非受控硬件比较。端到端 Flow Matching 集成、优化求解器比较和多节点验证仍待探索。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Learning Distributions from Multiple Data Providers
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by learning from heterogeneous and overlapping data providers, we study a stylized model of distribution learning from restricted conditional samples. The goal is to learn an unknown distribution $p$ on a finite domain $[n]$. The learner is given a fixed family of queryable sets $\mathscr{S} \subseteq 2^{[n]}$, and each query to $S \in \mathscr{S}$ returns an independent sample from the conditional distribution $p(\cdot \mid S)$. Learnability is governed by the co-occurrence graph associated with $\mathscr{S}$: two domain elements are adjacent if they appear together in some queryable set. Pointwise consistency is achievable when this graph is connected on the target support. PAC learning requires more: it is possible when the co-occurrence graph is complete. The optimal sample complexity of PAC learning ranges from nearly linear to quadratic. Every query family with complete co-occurrence graph admits sample complexity $\widetilde O(n^2/ε^2)$, and this bound is tight in the worst case. On the other hand, if $[n]$ is queryable then ordinary sampling improves the bound to $Θ(n/ε^2)$, and this cannot be improved further even if every set is queryable. More generally, we identify hierarchical comparabilityas a sufficient structural condition on $\mathscr S$ under which the optimal complexity is nearly linear, $\widetilde Θ(n/ε^2)$, with pairwise query families as a canonical example. Finally, the full range of polynomial rates between linear and quadratic is attainable: for every $α\in (1,2)$, there exists a query family with optimal PAC rate $\widetilde Θ(n^α/ε^2)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从多个异构且重叠的数据提供者学习分布的问题，提出基于条件样本的受限学习模型，并刻画了PAC学习的样本复杂度。作者证明当查询集合的共现图完全时，最优样本复杂度为~O(n^2/ε^2)，且该界是紧的；若可查询整个定义域，则复杂度降至Θ(n/ε^2)。此外，层次可比性等结构条件能进一步优化复杂度。
Motivation: 现有分布学习假设独立同分布样本，难以处理来自多个重叠数据提供者的异构数据。本文旨在建立该场景下的理论基础，理解可学习性与样本复杂度的决定因素。
Method: 提出基于条件样本的分布学习模型：未知分布p定义在[n]上，给定查询集合族S，每次查询返回p在S上的条件样本。通过共现图（两个元素若同时出现在某集合中则有边）研究可学习性，并分析PAC学习的样本复杂度。
Result: PAC学习在共现图完全时可达，样本复杂度从近线性到二次（~O(n^2/ε^2)紧界）。若可查询整个[n]，复杂度降至Θ(n/ε^2)。层次可比性条件下复杂度为Θ~(n/ε^2)。此外，对于任意α∈(1,2)，存在查询族使最优复杂度为Θ~(n^α/ε^2)。
Conclusion: 共现图的连通性决定了点态一致性，完全性决定了PAC可学习性。样本复杂度的完整范围从线性到二次均可实现，且依赖于查询集的结构性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. We show that this objective is under-identified at the branch level: positive- and negative-branch errors can compensate in the guided prediction. Through two contrasting cases, we find that naive matching remains effective under shared negative conditioning, where both branch errors decrease jointly. When the model's native CFG schema retains privileged information in the teacher's negative branch that is unavailable to the student, however, this joint reduction breaks down and the composed objective induces antagonistic branch-error dynamics, reducing the positive-branch error while increasing the negative-branch error. We term this failure mode Negative Branch Asymmetry (NBA). To address NBA, we introduce Positive--Direction Matching (PDM), a branch-aware OPD objective that separately constrains the positive prediction and the CFG conditional direction. We apply PDM to dense-to-sparse video control, where naive guided matching is highly sensitive to inference guidance scales, while branch-aware supervision enables more robust and effective knowledge transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在线策略扩散蒸馏（On-Policy Diffusion Distillation）中分类器自由引导（CFG）的行为，发现现有方法直接匹配引导速度会导致分支级欠识别问题，即正负分支误差可能相互补偿。作者识别出一种称为负分支不对称（NBA）的失败模式，并提出正方向匹配（PDM）方法，分别约束正预测和CFG条件方向，从而在稠密到稀疏视频控制中实现更鲁棒的知识迁移。
Motivation: 现有的在线策略蒸馏方法直接匹配教师和学生的CFG引导速度，但该目标在分支级别上欠识别，正负分支误差可能相互补偿，导致不稳定的知识迁移。
Method: 提出正方向匹配（PDM），一种分支感知的蒸馏目标，分别约束正分支预测和CFG条件方向，从而避免负分支不对称（NBA）问题。
Result: 在稠密到稀疏视频控制任务中，PDM方法相比朴素引导匹配对推理引导尺度更不敏感，实现了更稳健的知识迁移。
Conclusion: 作者指出分支感知的监督（如PDM）对于在线策略扩散蒸馏中CFG的有效使用至关重要，有助于消除NBA失败模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KANEx: Translating Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' Interpretability to Medical Explainability
papers.abstract_en: Computer vision models have become highly effective for medical applications, yet their black-box nature continues to undermine clinician trust. In clinical workflows, chest X-ray classifiers are increasingly paired with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate natural-language explanations. However, these systems add linguistic fluency without addressing the underlying opacity of the visual model. With the emergence of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), whose spline-based components provide inherently interpretable functional units, we investigate whether this architectural transparency can be leveraged to produce more trustworthy textual explanations. We introduce KANEx, the first ever framework that leverages the symbolic transparency of KANs to ground VLM reasoning. This interpretability also made it possible to design KAN-Map, a novel heatmap generation method derived directly from KAN models rather than gradient approximations. We feed these grounded contexts into downstream VLMs for enhanced explainability. Benchmarked on the MIMIC-CXR dataset, we demonstrate that KAN-based architectures with ResNet/ViT baselines demonstrate improved semantic similarity while producing significantly more faithful saliency maps. KAN architectures improve visual localization and downstream reasoning quality by 10%. Our findings suggest that grounding linguistic explanations and visual attributions in mathematically interpretable units is a necessary step toward trustworthy medical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KANEx框架，利用Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)的内在可解释性来增强医学影像（胸部X光片）的视觉语言模型（VLM）解释。通过KAN的符号透明度，KANEx生成更可信的文本解释和基于KAN的注意力热图（KAN-Map），在MIMIC-CXR数据集上展示了比ResNet/ViT基线更好的语义相似性和更忠实的显著性图。
Motivation: 医学影像分类器的黑箱特性削弱了临床医生的信任，现有的视觉语言模型增加了语言流畅性却未解决视觉模型的根本不可解释性。
Method: 提出KANEx框架，利用KAN的符号可解释性为VLM推理提供基础上下文；同时设计KAN-Map方法，直接从KAN模型生成热图，而非依赖梯度近似。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，基于KAN的架构与ResNet/ViT基线相比，提高了语义相似性，并生成了更忠实的显著性图；视觉定位和下游推理质量提升约10%。
Conclusion: 将语言解释和视觉归因建立在数学可解释单元上是迈向可信医学AI的必要步骤。

papers.title: MicroZoom: Structure-Preserving Detail Synthesis at Extreme Scale
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MicroZoom, a generative framework for gigapixel image synthesis at the microscopic scale. Given a standard photograph and a sparse set of consumer-grade microscope close-ups, MicroZoom synthesizes a seamless, gigapixel-resolution image grounded in the material character of the real references, enabling exploratory visualization of microscopic texture across the full spatial extent of an object. Our goal is plausible synthesis, not exact reconstruction. We focus on full-image, reference-based, extreme-scale super-resolution at magnification levels of up to 350x, a setting that introduces two major challenges: (1) recovering texture-specific detail from highly lossy inputs near ambiguous material boundaries, and (2) preserving correct large-scale pattern structure, such as the repeating geometry of a fabric weave, across millions of local predictions. We address these with a two-stage cascaded design, where the first stage recovers global pattern coherence and the second refines local texture detail, supplemented by a segmentation mask to guide synthesis at ambiguous boundaries. We verify our approach on a collection of self-captured everyday objects and demonstrate globally coherent, materially grounded gigapixel imagery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MicroZoom 是一个生成式框架，用于在微观尺度上合成千兆像素图像。给定一张标准照片和少量消费级显微镜特写，MicroZoom 能生成一幅无缝、千兆像素分辨率、基于真实参考材料特征的图像，实现跨越物体整个空间范围的微观纹理探索性可视化。该方法采用两阶段级联设计，第一阶段恢复全局模式一致性，第二阶段细化局部纹理细节，并通过分割掩膜指导模糊边界的合成。
Motivation: 在高达350倍的放大倍数下进行全图、基于参考的极端尺度超分辨率面临两大挑战：从高度丢失的输入中恢复纹理特定细节，以及在数百万局部预测中保持正确的大尺度模式结构。
Method: 提出两阶段级联设计：第一阶段恢复全局模式一致性，第二阶段细化局部纹理细节，并辅以分割掩膜来指导模糊边界的合成。
Result: 在自采集的日常物品数据集上验证了该方法，能够生成全局一致、基于材料特征的千兆像素图像。
Conclusion: MicroZoom 实现了在极端尺度下基于参考的图像合成，为探索微观纹理提供了可行的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Infrared Imaging Empowered by Artificial Intelligence for Pediatric Skeletal Triage: A Narrative Review and Future Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Background. Pediatric musculoskeletal trauma represents up to 18% of pediatric ED visits, yet diagnosis still depends on ionizing radiography. Cumulative low-dose radiation in early life raises lifetime leukemia and brain malignancy risk, motivating radiation-free triage alternatives. Objective. To synthesize evidence for a hybrid framework coupling broad-spectrum infrared (IR) imaging with deep-learning cross-modal translation to generate clinically interpretable synthetic-radiograph reconstructions from non-ionizing data. Approach. We review five IR spectral windows spanning 650 nm to 1 mm - NIR-I, NIR-II, SWIR, MIR/LWIR, and THz - and how dual-geometry (transmission/reflection) acquisition exploits wavelength-specific tissue depth and biochemical sensitivity. We summarize image-to-image translation networks (Pix2Pix, CycleGAN, Swin-Unet) and feature-matching algorithms (SuperPoint, SuperGlue, ALIKED, LightGlue) used to align and fuse IR data into radiograph-equivalent reconstructions. Implications. Pediatric anatomy - smaller cross-sections, thinner cortical bone - favors IR penetration, enabling compact, portable, non-ionizing triage hardware. Feasibility is grounded in fNIRS and transcranial photobiomodulation evidence: near-infrared light passes through skin, skull, and cortex with sufficient signal for hemodynamic monitoring - a longer, more attenuating path than through a pediatric forearm or distal leg. Key barriers: paired IR/X-ray dataset construction, AI-as-medical-device regulatory pathways, generalization across body habitus and skin pigmentation, and acquisition-protocol standardization. Conclusions. Integrated multi-spectral IR+AI imaging is a promising radiation-free complement to pediatric skeletal radiography. Progress requires multi-center paired datasets, externally validated models, and IR source safety qualification under IEC 60825-1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇叙述性综述探讨了将宽谱红外成像与深度学习跨模态翻译相结合，用于儿科骨骼创伤分诊，以替代有电离辐射的X光检查。文章回顾了五个红外光谱窗口（NIR-I、NIR-II、SWIR、MIR/LWIR、THz）和双几何采集方法，总结了图像翻译网络（Pix2Pix、CycleGAN、Swin-Unet）和特征匹配算法（SuperPoint、SuperGlue、ALIKED、LightGlue）用于对齐和融合红外数据。关键障碍包括配对数据集构建、AI医疗器械监管路径、体形和肤色泛化以及采集协议标准化。
Motivation: 儿科肌肉骨骼创伤诊断依赖电离辐射X光，累积低剂量辐射增加终身癌症风险，因此需要无辐射分诊替代方案。
Method: 提出混合框架：宽谱红外成像（650 nm-1 mm）结合深度学习跨模态翻译，从非电离数据生成可临床解释的合成X光重建。具体包括双几何（透射/反射）采集、图像翻译网络和特征匹配算法。
Result: 儿科解剖结构（较小截面、较薄皮质骨）有利于红外穿透，可实现紧凑、便携、无辐射的分诊硬件。可行性基于fNIRS和经颅光生物调节证据：近红外光能穿透皮肤、颅骨和皮层，其路径比通过小儿前臂或远端腿部更长、更衰减。
Conclusion: 集成多光谱红外+AI成像是一种有希望的无辐射儿科骨骼X光替代方案。进展需要多中心配对数据集、外部验证模型以及根据IEC 60825-1的红外源安全认证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
papers.abstract_en: The Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) and Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have become widely-used methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the rapidly growing field of scientific machine learning. In these methods, a neural network is trained to approximate the PDE solution by using (stochastic) gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual of the neural network. Due to the non-convexity of the PDE residual objective function, the trained neural network may, in principle, only converge to a local minimizer of the objective function (which would not be a solution of the PDE). Therefore, there is a longstanding question regarding the mathematical foundations of these algorithms, and it is highly valuable to establish that the trained neural network will converge to the PDE solution. For a class of semi-linear PDEs (nonlinear in the solution and its first derivative), we prove that neural networks trained with gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual objective function will converge to the PDE solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对半线性偏微分方程（PDE）类，证明了Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) 和物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 在梯度下降训练下最小化PDE残差目标函数时，会全局收敛到PDE解，而非仅局部极小值，从而为这些算法提供了严格的数学基础。
Motivation: DGM和PINN在科学机器学习中广泛用于求解PDE，但由于PDE残差目标函数的非凸性，训练可能仅收敛到局部极小值，而非PDE解，这一理论缺陷长期存在，需建立全局收敛性保证。
Method: 针对一类半线性PDE（解及其一阶导数为非线性），作者通过理论分析证明，使用梯度下降算法训练神经网络最小化PDE残差目标函数时，网络输出会收敛到真实PDE解。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值或实验，仅提供了理论收敛性证明。
Conclusion: 该工作为DGM和PINN算法的数学基础提供了关键进步，确保在特定PDE类上训练不会陷入非PDE解的局部极小值。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: DreamStyle3D: Efficient 3D Stylized Asset Generation via Dual-Attention Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: With the growth of gaming, animation, and virtual reality industries, the demand for efficient generation of stylized 3D assets is rapidly increasing. However, existing approaches still struggle to jointly preserve style fidelity, geometric consistency, and generation efficiency, as most of them still rely on indirect 2D-to-3D stylization pipelines. This motivates a native 3D stylization framework that can explicitly disentangle style from geometry while remaining efficient. To this end, we propose DreamStyle3D, an efficient framework for stylized 3D asset generation built on a Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention mechanism. Our method explicitly separates geometric and stylistic features to enable efficient style injection while preserving structural consistency, and further adopts a lightweight training strategy to enhance style consistency and model generalization. In addition, we build an automated data pipeline and construct a dataset of about 15K content-style-stylized triplets for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DreamStyle3D can generate high-fidelity, geometrically consistent stylized 3D assets within 10 seconds, substantially improving efficiency while maintaining superior style quality and offering a new solution for 3D content creation. The code and data are available at https://github.com/HVision-NKU/DreamStyle3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DreamStyle3D，一种基于解耦双交叉注意力机制的高效3D风格化资产生成框架。该方法显式分离几何与风格特征，通过轻量训练策略增强风格一致性，能在10秒内生成高保真、几何一致的风格化3D资产。实验表明其在效率与风格质量上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有3D风格化方法大多依赖间接的2D到3D流程，难以同时兼顾风格保真度、几何一致性和生成效率。亟需一种原生3D风格化框架来显式解耦风格与几何特征。
Method: 提出Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention机制，将几何和风格特征分离处理以实现高效风格注入；并采用轻量训练策略提升风格一致性与模型泛化能力。
Result: DreamStyle3D可在10秒内生成高保真、几何一致的风格化3D资产，大幅提升生成效率，同时保持优良的风格质量。
Conclusion: 为3D内容创作提供了一种高效的新方案，代码与数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning ability acquisition during pre-training. We study data format, distribution, and quality. Explicit world model construction through CoT state transition modeling yields stronger long-horizon generalization. Atomic skills alone are insufficient for compositional generalization, whereas a litte long-horizon data works. Moreover, suboptimal trajectories severely impair performance because errors amplify over long horizons. (2) Planning ability shaping via GRPO and OPD post-training. Through mutual information, we distinguish general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. For planning patterns, we identify three application regions of post-training: unnecessary, effective, and unsupported. OPD has a broader effective region than GRPO under low-quality and long-horizon settings, as it provides more consistent update directions. For planning knowledge, distilling unseen procedures from a teacher with different knowledge may impair student's prior world modeling without fully establishing new knowledge. (3) Planning ability integration through MOPD post-training. We show that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates capabilities by converging to shared planning-pattern across environments. Compatible patterns enable cross-environment generalization, partially shared patterns support continual learning, while completely conflicting patterns cause severe interference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个可控多轮环境，系统研究基础模型agent的多轮长程规划能力在预训练和后训练中的获取、塑造与整合。预训练阶段发现显式世界模型构建（CoT状态转移建模）比原子技能更能泛化，少量长程数据有效且次优轨迹因错误累积严重损害性能。后训练中，OPD在低质量和长程设置下比GRPO有效区域更广；多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）能整合能力，但模式冲突会导致干扰。
Motivation: 现有模型基于不可控的网络数据训练，难以明确规划能力的获取、塑造和整合机制，因此需要可控环境进行系统研究。
Method: 引入统一可控的多轮环境，分三阶段研究：(1) 预训练中规划能力获取——探究数据格式、分布和质量；(2) 后训练中能力塑造——通过GRPO和OPD，利用互信息区分通用规划模式与任务特定知识；(3) 能力整合——采用多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）融合多环境能力。
Result: 预训练中，显式世界模型构建增强长程泛化，原子技能不足以组合泛化，少量长程数据有效，次优轨迹严重损害性能。后训练中，OPD在低质量和长程设置下有效区域更广；MOPD在不同环境中收敛到共享规划模式，兼容模式支持跨环境泛化，部分共享支持持续学习，冲突模式导致干扰。
Conclusion: 该研究通过可控环境揭示了长程规划能力在不同阶段的特性，为提升agent规划能力提供了理解框架，但方法依赖特定环境设定，实际复杂场景中的适用性需进一步验证。

papers.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example. Given a chunk of pretraining data, an orchestrator decides whether to drop, untouch, or clean it. For a chunk to be cleaned, it selects one or more downstream operations, ranging from programmatic editing to different forms of LLM-based rewriting. For each rewriting step, it further generates a concrete instruction, which is executed by the corresponding downstream tool model. We pretrain models from 0.5B to 7B from scratch on web data processed by DataOrchestra and observe stable average gains over individual data-processing methods across 11 benchmarks. DataOrchestra is also effective for math continued pretraining and outperforms stronger processing baselines, while reducing processing compute by skipping unnecessary downstream operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DataOrchestra框架，为每个预训练数据样本动态定制处理流水线，包括丢弃、保留或清理，并选择具体操作和指令，在0.5B到7B的模型上展示了对多个基准的稳定提升。
Motivation: 现有数据预处理方法在语料或领域级别定义固定策略，无法适应每个样本的具体需求。
Method: 一个编排器（orchestrator）决定每个数据块的处理方式，对于需要清理的块，选择下游操作（程序编辑或LLM重写），并生成具体指令，由对应工具模型执行。
Result: 在0.5B-7B模型上从头预训练，DataOrchestra在11个基准上持续优于单一处理方法，并且在数学继续预训练中也超过更强的基线，同时通过跳过不必要的下游操作减少了计算成本。
Conclusion: 框架统一了不同处理操作，实现了逐样本的自适应数据策划，提升了预训练数据处理的灵活性和效率。

papers.title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Trapped-ion quantum computers rely on shuttling compilers, which cast an input algorithm into a sequence of ion-qubit movements within a given architecture. We present the first study in which a single frontier large language model (LLM), Claude Opus 4.7, generates and iteratively refines the full Python code of shuttling compilers from written specifications. We start with a compiler for (i) a linear segmented trap, extend it to (ii) a trap with junctions, and finally achieve efficient compilation for (iii) a broad class of connected trap graphs. The compilers for the more general cases are seeded with code from the previous ones. We benchmark the LLM-generated compilers against state-of-the-art hand-crafted ones using a common suite of quantum circuits. The number of shuttling timesteps is reduced by up to 76% for (i) and up to 39% for (ii). For the broad case (iii) of freely connected architectures, we find large variations in the required number of shuttling timesteps, depending on the connectivity. A densely connected, junction-rich architecture yields an order-of-magnitude reduction in shuttling timesteps compared to a corridor-like one. Repeating the complete generation and evaluation with a second frontier LLM, Claude Fable 5, reproduces these findings, with the Fable 5 compilers surpassing the hand-crafted ones more often on the largest circuits. Our results show that an unmodified frontier LLM can produce working, correct, and competitive shuttling compilers without additional manual algorithmic engineering, thus reducing the development time for new architectures from several months to a few days.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次使用单一前沿大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.7）从书面规范生成并迭代优化离子阱量子计算机的移位编译器（shuttling compiler）完整Python代码。编译器从线性分段陷阱逐步扩展到带结点陷阱和通用连接陷阱图。在常用量子电路基准测试上，LLM生成的编译器相比手工编译器在移位时间步上减少最多76%（线性）和39%（带结点），且通用架构中密集连接架构比走廊状架构减少一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有移位编译器的手工开发耗时数月，且不同离子阱架构需要不同编译器，缺乏自动化生成工具。本研究探索使用大语言模型自动生成高效的编译器，以大幅缩短开发周期。
Method: 使用未修改的前沿大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.7）从自然语言规范迭代生成和优化不同复杂度架构的移位编译器代码。采用渐进式扩展策略：先为简单线性陷阱生成编译器，再以此代码为种子，逐步生成带结点陷阱和通用连接陷阱图的编译器。
Result: LLM生成的编译器在常用量子电路基准上相比手工编译器显著减少移位时间步：线性段架构减少76%，带结点架构减少39%，通用架构中密集连接架构比走廊状架构减少一个数量级。使用第二个模型Claude Fable 5重复实验得到一致结果，且在最大电路上更常超越手工编译器。
Conclusion: 未修改的前沿大语言模型能产出工作正常、正确且具有竞争力的移位编译器，无需额外手工算法工程，从而将新架构的开发时间从数月缩短至数天。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs) are central to conceptual database design, yet they are typically available only as rendered images rather than machine-readable schemas, limiting AI-assisted database engineering. We introduce ERUnderstand, the first large-scale benchmark for structured understanding of ER diagrams, comprising 2,960 diagrams collected from curated educational sources, real-world schemas, and synthetically generated examples spanning diverse domains, notations, complexity levels, and Extended Entity-Relationship (EER) constructs. Each diagram is paired with a standardized machine-readable representation for fine-grained evaluation of schema elements. Evaluating state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs), we find that while common ERD elements are recovered reliably (F1 > 0.74), performance drops sharply on weak entities (as low as 0.28 F1), multivalued attributes (0.14 F1), and N-ary relationships (0.07 F1). Reasoning-augmented models improve overall performance by 15-25% but remain sensitive to linguistic priors and increasing diagram complexity. ERUnderstand provides a standardized benchmark for evaluating multimodal understanding of conceptual database schemas. The benchmark, dataset, evaluation toolkit, and generation code are publicly available at https://github.com/salinaria/ERUnderstand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERUnderstand，首个大规模结构化理解ER图（Entity-Relationship Diagrams）的基准测试，包含2960张来自教育、真实世界和合成数据的ER图，配有标准化机器可读表示。评估了多个视觉语言模型（VLMs），发现常见元素F1>0.74，但弱实体（0.28 F1）、多值属性（0.14 F1）和N元关系（0.07 F1）性能较差。推理增强模型整体提升15-25%，但仍受语言先验和复杂度影响。基准、数据、工具包和生成代码已公开。
Motivation: ER图是概念数据库设计的核心，但通常以图像形式存在，缺乏机器可读模式，限制了AI辅助数据库工程。现有基准缺乏对ER图结构化理解的细粒度评估。
Method: 构建包含2960张ER图的数据集，覆盖多种领域、符号、复杂度和扩展实体关系（EER）结构，每张图配有标准化机器可读表示。评估多个SOTA视觉语言模型（VLMs），包括推理增强模型。
Result: 常见ER元素F1>0.74，弱实体F1低至0.28，多值属性0.14，N元关系0.07；推理增强模型性能提升15-25%，但仍对语言先验和复杂度敏感。
Conclusion: ERUnderstand为概念数据库模式的多模态理解提供了标准化基准，揭示了现有VLM在复杂ER结构上的显著不足。

papers.title: SADe: Sparse-Atom Support Decontamination for Few-Shot Segmentation with Weak Support Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) commonly assumes clean pixel-level support masks, yet practical support supervision often uses boxes, scribbles, coarse masks, or pseudo-masks. These weak annotations may include texture-similar distractors and background context alongside the target, contaminating class prototypes or visual prompts before query prediction. We introduce SADe, a predictor-agnostic support decontamination layer that estimates the reliability of selected support patches without query information. Central to SADe is sparse autoencoder (SAE) atom evidence: dense similarity may respond to both target and texture-similar context, whereas contrasting atom activations inside and outside the weak-support region provides factor-level reliability cues. A lightweight router combines atom evidence with dense similarity and episode statistics to predict patch reliability and generate a cleaned support mask. Trained once on synthetic weak-support episodes from FSS-1000, the router is frozen for all target evaluations. The resulting mask supports standalone prediction or can be supplied to heterogeneous FSS models through native support interfaces without altering query-side inference. Under a matched weak-support protocol, SADe achieves the highest query mIoU in six of nine standalone prompt-shot combinations. With the same ProMi query head, it is within 0.03 mIoU of SAM3-derived masks under tight boxes and surpasses them by 11.17 and 19.49 points under box-r2 and box-r4, respectively. As a plug-in, SADe improves over raw support in 70 of 72 matched box-family comparisons across four frozen downstream models and two datasets. On point and scribble prompts, its average performance remains close to the corresponding raw-support baseline. Ablations and atom-removal controls show that atom evidence contributes reliability information beyond dense similarity.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures; includes a technical appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对少样本分割中弱支持标注（如框、涂鸦）含有纹理相似干扰物导致原型污染的问题，提出一种预测器无关的支持去污染层 SADe。其核心是利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）的原子证据，结合密集相似度与片段统计，预测支持补丁的可靠性并生成干净支持掩码。在匹配的弱支持协议下，SADe 在九种 prompt-shot 组合中六种达到最高查询 mIoU，作为插件在 70/72 个框族比较中提升性能。
Motivation: 弱支持标注（如框、涂鸦）常包含与目标纹理相似的干扰物和背景上下文，在查询预测前污染类原型或视觉提示，降低分割性能。现有方法缺乏不依赖查询信息就能估计支持补丁可靠性的机制。
Method: 提出 SADe，一个可插拔的支持去污染层，包含稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取原子证据，通过对比弱支持区域内外原子激活提供因子级可靠性线索，再由轻量路由器结合密集相似度和片段统计预测补丁可靠性，生成干净支持掩码。该层仅在 FSS-1000 的合成弱支持片段上训练一次后冻结。
Result: 在匹配的弱支持协议下，SADe 在九种独立 prompt-shot 组合中六种达到最高查询 mIoU；与 ProMi 查询头结合时，在紧凑框下接近 SAM3 衍生掩码（mIoU 差 0.03），在 box-r2 和 box-r4 设置下分别高出 11.17 和 19.49 点。作为插件，在四个冻结下游模型和两个数据集上的 72 个框族比较中改善 70 个。
Conclusion: 原子证据提供了超越密集相似度的可靠性信息，SADe 能有效弱化弱支持标注中的干扰，且与多种 FSS 模型兼容。

summary_sections.conclusion: 原子证据提供了超越密集相似度的可靠性信息，SADe 能有效弱化弱支持标注中的干扰，且与多种 FSS 模型兼容。

papers.title: Panda: Unsupervised Pelvic Anomaly Detection for Real-Time MR Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Female pelvic diseases remain an under researched area characterized by often delayed diagnosis. While pelvic MRI offers superior soft-tissue contrast for diagnosis and image-guided procedures, real-time anomaly detection remains challenging due to physiological motion, tissue deformation, and instrument artifacts. Existing supervised approaches are impractical, as adverse events are rare, heterogeneous, and difficult to annotate. We present a Dinomaly-based unsupervised anomaly detection framework adapted for pelvic MRI that learns normative representations from healthy cases and flags deviations without requiring labels. Our approach leverages a frozen DINOv3 Vision Transformer encoder combined with a noisy MLP bottleneck and Linear Attention decoder to prevent identity mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Anomalies are localized via per-token cosine distance between encoder and decoder representations, yielding spatial anomaly maps that provide immediate feedback at the scanner to support radiologist decision-making and adaptive protocol adjustment. Evaluated on a curated subset of the Uterine Myoma Dataset, the framework achieves a pixel-level AUROC of 88.06% and high specificity (95.45%) at frame level at 40.5 slices/s, meeting real-time clinical deployment requirements. The spatial anomaly maps and frame-level scores provide immediate, localized feedback at the scanner to support radiologist decision-making and adaptive protocol adjustment during active procedures.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Dinomaly 的无监督盆腔 MRI 异常检测框架，利用冻结的 DINOv3 Vision Transformer 编码器、噪声 MLP 瓶颈和线性注意力解码器，无需标注即可实时检测异常。在子宫肌瘤数据集子集上，像素级 AUROC 达 88.06%，帧级特异性 95.45%，速度 40.5 切片/秒，满足临床实时需求。

Conclusion: 该框架提供即时、局部的异常反馈，支持放射科医生决策和自适应协议调整，但在其他盆腔疾病或更大数据集上的泛化性有待验证。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Conditional Denoising Transformer for Modality-Missing RGBT Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Missing modalities in RGBT tracking often lead to incomplete and unstable multimodal feature representations that greatly degrade the performance. Existing methods typically attempt to recover missing modalities from available ones, but the quality of data generated in challenging scenarios might be unsatisfactory. In addition, current approaches exhibit limited flexibility in processing both missing and complete data. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Spatio-temporal Conditional Denoising Transformer (SCDT), which integrates the spatial cues and the temporal context to adaptively perform information reconstruction of missing modalities and feature enhancement of weak modalities in a unified framework, for robust modality-missing RGBT tracking. In particular, SCDT leverages the short-term temporal cues from recent historical frames to capture the fine-grained temporal correlations and the long-term temporal cues encoding modality evolution to capture the global context. By jointly exploiting long short-term temporal contexts as the conditions, SCDT progressively guides noisy features of available modalities to learn reliable and temporally consistent multimodal representations. Furthermore, SCDT introduces a noisemodulated adaptation mechanism that dynamically adjusts its behavior according to the modal availability, enabling a single framework to unify feature learning under both modality-missing and complete scenarios without changing the architecture or parameters. Extensive experiments on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is available here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时空条件去噪Transformer（SCDT），用于处理RGBT跟踪中的模态缺失问题。通过联合利用短时和长时时间上下文作为条件，逐步引导可用模态的噪声特征学习可靠且时间一致的多模态表示。引入噪声调制适应机制，使单一框架统一处理模态缺失和完整情况。在三个公开基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在RGBT跟踪中处理模态缺失时，生成的数据质量不佳，且对缺失和完整数据的处理灵活性有限。
Method: 提出SCDT，集成空间线索和时间上下文，在统一框架中自适应进行缺失模态信息重构和弱模态特征增强。利用短时时间上下文捕获细粒度时间相关性，长时时间上下文编码全局上下文。引入噪声调制适应机制，根据模态可用性动态调整行为。
Result: 在三个公开基准数据集上一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: SCDT通过联合时空条件和噪声调制适应机制，有效解决了RGBT跟踪中的模态缺失问题。

papers.title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Inference systems increasingly combine a fast path that returns predictions within the application's latency deadline together with a higher-accuracy slow path that runs higher-compute methods on stronger, remote hardware, so its results can be returned on time and combined with the fast path predictions. Across several application domains, we abstract this inference architecture as a fast path, a slow path, and a coordination layer with two functions: a router that invokes the slow path and a merger that decides whether to incorporate its returned predictions. In this work, we show that this new coordination layer exposes a new attack surface: shaped workload attacks, e.g., Yo-Yo bursts, can exploit contention at shared resources along the slow path to push benign users' slow-path predictions past their latency deadlines. The merger then discards those predictions, while the fast path continues to return timely outputs. We refer to the resulting loss of slow-path accuracy benefits as accuracy collapse. We demonstrate accuracy collapse in a two-tier edge-cloud multi-object tracking pipeline in autonomous driving. In simulation, approximately 4,000 burst-shaped requests increase benign p99 latency from 92ms to 2s, nearly eliminating the benefit of the slow path's cloud inference, reducing object tracking quality by 7.0 HOTA points on average. We further find that accuracy degradation can significantly vary (2.0-18.7 HOTA points), depending on the video intervals that are targeted in the attack, and that certain rare classes (e.g., stop signs) lose nearly half of their pre-attack prediction accuracy. These results show that workload attacks can degrade prediction quality without needing either access to model weights or victim data, and motivate research on attacks and defenses for routing, merging, scheduling, and resource isolation in these emerging inference pipeline architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了分布式推理管线中协调层（router和merger）新引入的攻击面——形状化工作负载攻击（如Yo-Yo突发）可通过抢占慢路径的共享资源，使合法用户的慢路径预测超时而被丢弃，导致快路径虽返回及时结果但丧失慢路径的高精度优势，即“精度崩溃”。在自动驾驶多目标追踪的两层边缘-云管线仿真中，约4000个突发请求使p99延迟从92ms升至2s，对象追踪质量平均下降7.0 HOTA点，某些稀有类别（如停止标志）的预测准确率近乎减半。攻击无需访问模型权重或用户数据，即可降级预测质量。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对分布式推理管线中协调层（router和merger）安全性的分析，而该层可能被工作负载攻击利用，导致精度崩溃。
Method: 抽象出快路径、慢路径和协调层（含router和merger）的通用架构，并设计形状化工作负载攻击（如Yo-Yo突发）以实证精度崩溃现象。
Result: 在自动驾驶多目标追踪仿真中，约4000个突发请求使p99延迟从92ms升至2s，对象追踪质量平均下降7.0 HOTA点，某些稀有类别（如停止标志）预测准确率下降近半。
Conclusion: 工作负载攻击能通过干扰慢路径的延迟而非篡改模型或数据来降级预测质量，呼吁对路由、合并、调度和资源隔离进行攻击与防御研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Scale and Generation: Understanding Language Model-based Entity Matching
papers.abstract_en: Entity matching identifies records that refer to the same real-world entity. Language models can be adapted to this task through bi-encoder, cross-encoder, and generative matcher architectures. However, prior studies often conflate matcher architecture with differences in model backbone, model variant(reflecting different pretraining objectives), and model size, making it difficult to isolate the sources of performance gains. We address this issue through a controlled factorial study spanning three matcher architectures, three model variants and three model sizes from the Qwen3 family, and nine datasets, totaling 1,215 fine-tuning runs. We also evaluate cross-dataset transferability and computational cost. Our results show that model variant is critical for bi-encoders: embedding-oriented variants provide stronger initialization and more favorable representation geometry predictive of downstream matching performance. Cross-encoders retain a consistent advantage over bi-encoders because they jointly encode record pairs rather than representing each record independently, although larger models partially narrow this gap. Generative matchers do not universally outperform cross-encoders. Instead, their advantages concentrate under distribution shift, including subtle unseen differences in record schemas and cross-dataset transfer. We further find that larger models rely more heavily on shortcut learning and therefore do not necessarily perform better. These findings clarify the factors underlying performance differences across matcher architectures and motivate future research and benchmark designs that better disentangle architectural choices from model-level factors while explicitly evaluating distribution shift and cross-dataset transferability. We release our experimental results, code, training scripts, and evaluation data at https://github.com/Jantory/llm-trained-matcher.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Preprint. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验设计（3种匹配器架构×3种模型变体×3种模型规模×9个数据集，共1215次微调），系统研究了语言模型在实体匹配任务中性能差异的来源。结果表明：模型变体对双编码器（bi-encoder）至关重要，嵌入导向变体提供更好的初始化与表示几何；交叉编码器（cross-encoder）因联合编码记录对而持续优于双编码器，但大模型可缩小差距；生成式匹配器（generative matcher）仅在分布偏移（如模式差异与跨数据集迁移）下优于交叉编码器；大模型更依赖捷径学习，不一定性能更好。
Motivation: 已有研究常将匹配器架构差异与模型骨干、变体、规模等因素混淆，难以隔离性能增益的真正来源。
Method: 采用析因控制实验，在Qwen3系列上变化三个因素（架构、变体、规模），在9个数据集上执行1215次微调，并评估跨数据集迁移性与计算成本。
Result: 模型变体对双编码器关键；交叉编码器普遍优于双编码器，大模型缩小差距但不消除；生成式匹配器仅分布偏移下超交叉编码器；大模型更多依赖捷径学习。
Conclusion: 未来研究需更清晰分离架构选择与模型层面因素，并明确评估分布偏移与跨数据集迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stacking the Deck: Tunable Trainability in Stacked LCUs
papers.abstract_en: Variational quantum circuits have been central to many proposed near-term applications of quantum computing, but a growing body of evidence suggests that trainability and quantum advantage are fundamentally at odds: ansätze expressive enough to resist efficient classical simulation tend to exhibit barren plateaus, while structures that provably rule out barren plateaus typically render them classically simulable. We propose a stacked linear combination of unitaries (S-LCU) as a variational ansatz which provides a tunable trade-off between barren plateaus and classical simulability. Using a diagrammatic analysis, we bound the loss-landscape variance of the Free Fermion S-LCU, whose elements are fermionic Gaussian unitaries. We prove a variance lower bound of $Ω(1/(n k^{3l}))$, with a simulation cost of $O(k^{2l} n^3)$ using the best known classical algorithm, compared to a quantum gate complexity of only $O(lkn^2)$. The number of layers $l$ serves as a single dial that trades computational complexity against the rate of cost concentration. This offers practitioners a systematic method for constructing ansätze with a complexity-trainability trade-off that best suits their application and hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出堆叠线性组合酉（S-LCU）作为变分量子电路的一种ansatz，可在贫瘠高原（barren plateaus）和经典可模拟性之间实现可调权衡。通过图分析，作者证明了自由费米子S-LCU的损失景观方差下界为Ω(1/(n k^{3l}))，其经典模拟成本为O(k^{2l} n^3)，而量子门复杂度仅为O(lkn^2)。层数l作为单一调节旋钮，允许实践者根据应用和硬件选择复杂度-可训练性权衡。
Motivation: 变分量子电路的可训练性与量子优势存在根本矛盾：表达能力强的ansätz易出现贫瘠高原，而避免贫瘠高原的结构通常可被经典模拟。现有工作缺乏系统的方法来权衡两者。
Method: 提出堆叠线性组合酉（Stacked Linear Combination of Unitaries, S-LCU）作为变分ansatz，并针对自由费米子S-LCU（元素为费米子高斯酉）进行图分析，推导损失景观方差的下界。
Result: 证明了自由费米子S-LCU的损失景观方差下界为Ω(1/(n k^{3l}))，对应的经典模拟成本为O(k^{2l} n^3)，量子门复杂度为O(lkn^2)。层数l可调节计算复杂度与成本集中速率。
Conclusion: 该工作为构造具有复杂度-可训练性权衡的ansätz提供了系统方法，使实践者能针对具体应用和硬件选择最佳折衷。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出堆叠线性组合酉（S-LCU）作为变分量子电路的一种ansatz，可在贫瘠高原（barren plateaus）和经典可模拟性之间实现可调权衡。通过图分析，作者证明了自由费米子S-LCU的损失景观方差下界为Ω(1/(n k^{3l}))，其经典模拟成本为O(k^{2l} n^3)，而量子门复杂度仅为O(lkn^2)。层数l作为单一调节旋钮，允许实践者根据应用和硬件选择复杂度-可训练性权衡。
summary_sections.motivation: 变分量子电路的可训练性与量子优势存在根本矛盾：表达能力强的ansätz易出现贫瘠高原，而避免贫瘠高原的结构通常可被经典模拟。现有工作缺乏系统的方法来权衡两者。
summary_sections.method: 提出堆叠线性组合酉（Stacked Linear Combination of Unitaries, S-LCU）作为变分ansatz，并针对自由费米子S-LCU（元素为费米子高斯酉）进行图分析，推导损失景观方差的下界。
summary_sections.result: 证明了自由费米子S-LCU的损失景观方差下界为Ω(1/(n k^{3l}))，对应的经典模拟成本为O(k^{2l} n^3)，量子门复杂度为O(lkn^2)。层数l可调节计算复杂度与成本集中速率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为构造具有复杂度-可训练性权衡的ansätz提供了系统方法，使实践者能针对具体应用和硬件选择最佳折衷。

papers.title: Co-Learning for Missing Arbitrary Modalities in Multi-modal Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal classification leverages complementary information across diverse data sources to enhance predictive performance. However, real-world scenarios subject to operational constraints, such as sensor failures or privacy restrictions, lead to inconsistent modality availability between training and inference times. To handle missing modalities, prior studies have mainly covered bimodal data setups and focused on designing robust fusion processes. Instead, we adopt a multi-modal co-learning framework that prioritizes inter-modal collaboration rather than multi-modal fusion. Specifically, we consider that any subset of modalities may be absent, without assuming predefined missing-modality patterns, an inference scenario we refer to as missing arbitrary modalities. To address this challenge, we introduce two alternative approaches that leverage information at both feature- and decision-level. Experiments on two multi-modal classification benchmarks demonstrate significant robustness gains in various missing modality conditions. The first method shows more robust behavior under minimal missing conditions, where a single modality is absent, whereas the second performs better under extreme missing conditions, where all-but-one modalities are missing. Our code is available at https://github.com/fmenat/Co4Miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态分类中任意模态缺失的问题，提出了一种基于协同学习（co-learning）的框架，强调模态间协作而非融合。两种方法分别在特征级和决策级利用信息，实验表明在缺失单模态时第一种方法更鲁棒，在缺失多模态时第二种方法更优。
Motivation: 现实场景中因传感器故障或隐私限制导致训练和推理时模态可用性不一致，现有研究多针对双模态设计，缺乏处理任意模态缺失的通用方法。
Method: 提出两种协同学习方法：第一种在特征层面进行模态交互，第二种在决策层面进行集成，两种方法均不依赖预设的缺失模式，可处理任意模态缺失。
Result: 在两个多模态分类基准上，第一种方法在仅缺失单个模态时鲁棒性更好，第二种方法在极端缺失（仅剩一个模态）时表现更优。
Conclusion: 协同学习框架能够有效应对多模态分类中的任意模态缺失挑战，两种方法互补，可根据缺失程度选择使用。

papers.title: Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in High-Dimensional and Nonstationary Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We describe Causal-TS, an open-source Python library for causal discovery in high-dimensional and nonstationary multivariate time series. Causal-TS provides four specialized algorithms-CDNOTS, CDNOTS+, CEDAR, and GRACE-along with wrappers for GES, Granger, LASSO-VAR, and LGES, all sharing a unified conditional independence (CI) test layer with GPU acceleration via PyTorch. A regime discovery pipeline detects structural breaks via pluggable changepoint detectors and runs discovery per regime with regime-specific parameters. A command-line interface, synthetic data generators, and optional DoWhy integration provide an end-to-end pipeline from raw time series to causal effect estimates. The library is pip-installable, tested on Python 3.10--3.12, and available at https://github.com/bloomberg/causal-ts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Causal-TS 是一个开源 Python 库，专门用于高维和非平稳多元时间序列的因果发现。它集成了四种专用算法（CDNOTS、CDNOTS+、CEDAR、GRACE）以及多种现有方法的包装器，并通过统一的 CI 测试层和 GPU 加速（PyTorch）提升效率。库还包含结构断点检测、命令行接口、合成数据生成器以及与 DoWhy 的集成，提供从原始序列到因果效应估计的完整流程。
Method: 提供四种专用因果发现算法（CDNOTS、CDNOTS+、CEDAR、GRACE）以及 GES、Granger、LASSO-VAR、LGES 的包装器；所有算法共享基于 PyTorch 的 GPU 加速条件独立性测试层；通过可插拔的变点检测器实现结构断点发现，并允许每个稳态区间使用特定参数进行因果发现。

papers.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning via Physics-Aware Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical sectors such as robotics and automotive engineering, the deployment of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is often hindered by the black-box nature of deep neural networks. This lack of transparency poses significant challenges for regulatory compliance and human-agent trust. This paper presents an experimental study aimed at making high-performance continuous control DRL systems interpretable. A policy distillation framework is implemented using the classic Inverted Pendulum benchmark. A high-performance Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3) agent serves as an opaque, continuous teacher model, whose policy is distilled into an interpretable student surrogate based on a shallow Decision Tree. By leveraging a custom physics-aware feature and "Noisy Oracle Rollouts" for dataset generation, the distillation process achieves performance equivalent to the expert teacher. Furthermore, comparative control theory analysis reveals a fundamental trade-off: transitioning from continuous to discrete rule-based control induces high-frequency Bang-Bang actuation and a stable bimodal limit cycle. Simulation results indicate that Bounded-Input Bounded-Output (BIBO) stability is maintained while providing both global and local interpretability for safe autonomous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理学感知的策略蒸馏框架，将高性能连续控制DRL（TD3）代理的策略蒸馏为可解释的浅层决策树，在倒立摆基准上实现了与专家教师相当的性能。通过定制的物理学感知特征和“噪声Oracle Rollouts”生成数据集，蒸馏过程保持了性能，同时提供了全局和局部可解释性。控制理论分析揭示了从连续控制到离散规则控制转换时产生高频Bang-Bang驱动和稳定的双模极限环的权衡。
Motivation: 深度强化学习在安全关键领域的部署受限于黑盒特性，缺乏可解释性影响法规遵从和人机信任。
Method: 使用TD3作为连续教师模型，通过决策树作为可解释学生代理进行策略蒸馏；采用定制物理学感知特征和“Noisy Oracle Rollouts”生成数据集。
Result: 在倒立摆基准上，蒸馏后的决策树策略达到了与教师TD3相当的性能；同时BIBO稳定性得以保持。
Conclusion: 本文证明了通过物理学感知的特征和噪声Oracle Rollouts可以将高性能DRL策略蒸馏为可解释的决策树，同时揭示了连续到离散控制转换的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Eviction as Estimation: A Fixed-Lag Smoothing View of Test-Time Memory, and When Measuring Beats Accumulating
papers.abstract_en: A language model with a bounded working memory must repeatedly decide which stored items to keep. Every deployed method decides the moment an item arrives, from the past (StreamingLLM, H2O) or from a guess about the future (SnapKV). We recast the choice as an estimation problem on a hidden signal, whether an item will be reused, placing existing methods on one axis, the commit lag $H$: online filters and learned predictors commit at $H=0$, while Belady's offline optimum sits where the whole future is known. The missing regime in between, fixed-lag smoothing, waits a bounded number of steps, observes which items a correct near-future prediction attended to, and only then commits. This measurement, demonstrated utility, turns Belady's unobservable future request into something we read off the model itself. We instantiate it as a training-free policy, RMM, a strict generalization of H2O that reduces to it exactly when the measurement is uniform. In controlled settings where reuse is endogenous and separated in time, demonstrated utility identifies used memory far better than accumulated attention, and a small bounded memory behaves like a much larger one. But on independent third-party benchmarks, run inside NVIDIA's KVPress harness against its own SnapKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM implementations, the advantage mostly disappears: RMM is on par with H2O for single-turn question answering and loses to both H2O and SnapKV in a streaming multi-turn setting. The cause is simple: on natural text the model is correct about most tokens, so weighting attention by correctness barely changes it, and demonstrated utility collapses onto accumulated attention unless reuse is sharp and endogenous, which standard benchmarks do not exercise. Our contribution is the framework and an honest map of when measuring beats accumulating, not a new state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将语言模型的有界工作记忆中的逐出选择重新表述为对隐藏信号（是否会被重用）的估计问题，并提出一个统一的框架，将现有方法置于不同的提交滞后轴线上。作者举例了一种无训练的策略RMM，作为H2O的严格泛化，通过测量近未来预测中实际被关注的效用（demonstrated utility）来决定逐出，而非基于累积注意力。实验表明，在复用是内生的且时间分离的控制设置中，RMM显著优于基线，但在标准第三方基准上（单轮问答、流式多轮设置）优势消失，与H2O性能相当或更差。作者将原因归结为自然文本中大多数token的预测正确，使得基于正确性的加权与累积注意力差异不大。
Motivation: 现有语言模型的工作记忆管理方法（如StreamingLLM、H2O、SnapKV）在项目到达时立即决定保留或逐出，依赖于过去或猜测未来的信息，缺乏对中间状态（固定滞后平滑）的利用。本文旨在将逐出问题重新形式化为对隐藏信号的估计，并探索“测量”效用（而不仅仅是累积）何时能带来收益。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，以提交滞后H为轴，将现有方法（在线过滤、学习预测器在H=0，Belady离线最优在H无穷大）置于其中。作者填补了中间缺失的固定滞后平滑机制，等待有限步后观察模型自身对近未来预测中实际关注到的token，然后基于此测量效用决定逐出。具体实例化为无训练策略RMM（Recency with Measurement of Memory），它是H2O的严格泛化，当测量均匀时退化为H2O。
Result: 在控制实验中（复用内生且时间分离），RMM比累积注意力方法更好地识别有用记忆，小容量记忆表现如同更大容量。但在NVIDIA KVPress框架下与SnapKV、H2O、StreamingLLM的比较中：单轮问答中RMM与H2O持平；流式多轮设置中RMM输给H2O和SnapKV。原因是自然文本大多数token预测正确，导致基于正确性的加权与累积注意力几乎无差异。
Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是提出了一个理论框架和对“测量何时优于累积”的诚实刻画，而不是新的最优方法。当复用模式尖锐且内生于长距离依赖时，测量有望击败累积，但标准基准并未测试这种场景。

papers.title: MMOE: Modernizing Diffusion Transformers with Efficient Expert Design
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models scale successfully by pairing capacity growth with efficiency, keeping per-token and deployment costs under control as capacity grows. AIGC Foundation Models (AFMs), especially diffusion-transformer backbones, have begun to adopt sparse experts, but recent efforts mostly enlarge total parameter counts and sparsity ratios without importing the efficiency mechanisms that made LLM scaling practical, so generation quality is seldom balanced against training and deployment cost. This raises a natural question: can the architectural principles behind efficient LLM scaling be adapted to AFMs in a more balanced way? We introduce ModernMOE (MMOE), a modernization of SiT-style diffusion transformers that systematically adapts routed experts, shared and lightweight experts, gate-residual routing, and attention-residual information reuse to AIGC generation. Rather than treating MoE as a single plug-in replacement, MMOE studies how different modern expert components affect convergence, efficiency, and generation quality when composed inside a diffusion transformer. Every experiment in this paper is trained on a single eight-GPU H100 node with batch size 256 for 400k steps, an accessible single-machine budget. Under matched training and sampling protocols and at this budget, MMOE reaches lower FID at every recorded checkpoint, that is, it converges faster per training step, than dense and intermediate sparse-expert baselines, and among the sparse variants it attains the best quality-cost balance. Routing analysis further shows stable expert specialization across depth, substantial use of lightweight routes, and modest step-to-step routing changes during denoising. These results suggest that AFMs can follow the balanced scaling path of LLMs by importing proven efficiency designs, rather than by simply increasing total parameters and sparsity ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMOE（ModernMOE），系统地将大型语言模型中的高效专家设计（路由专家、共享和轻量级专家、门控残差路由、注意力残差信息复用）适配到SiT风格的扩散变换器中。在单台八卡H100节点、batch size 256、400k步的训练预算下，MMOE在每个检查点都取得比稠密和稀疏基线更低的FID，收敛更快，且在稀疏变体中达到最佳质量-成本平衡。路由分析显示专家专门化稳定、轻量级路由使用充分、去噪过程中路由变化平缓。
Motivation: 现有AIGC基础模型（尤其是扩散变换器）虽然开始采用稀疏专家，但主要增加参数量和稀疏率，缺乏LLM中使缩放变得实用的效率机制，导致生成质量与训练/部署成本不平衡。本文旨在将高效LLM缩放中的架构原则以更平衡的方式适配到AIGC生成中。
Method: MMOE系统地将多种现代专家组件（路由专家、共享和轻量级专家、门控残差路由、注意力残差信息复用）组合到扩散变换器中，并在单台八卡H100节点上以batch size 256进行400k步训练，与稠密和稀疏基线进行公平比较。
Result: 在相同训练和采样协议下，MMOE在每个检查点都达到更低的FID，收敛速度更快；在稀疏变体中，MMOE实现了最佳质量-成本平衡。路由分析表明专家专门化稳定、轻量级路由被大量使用、去噪过程中路由变化适度。
Conclusion: AIGC基础模型可以通过借鉴LLM中经过验证的效率设计实现平衡缩放，而不是仅靠增加总参数量和稀疏率。MMOE验证了这一路径的可行性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出MMOE（ModernMOE），系统地将大型语言模型中的高效专家设计（路由专家、共享和轻量级专家、门控残差路由、注意力残差信息复用）适配到SiT风格的扩散变换器中。在单台八卡H100节点、batch size 256、400k步的训练预算下，MMOE在每个检查点都取得比稠密和稀疏基线更低的FID，收敛更快，且在稀疏变体中达到最佳质量-成本平衡。路由分析显示专家专门化稳定、轻量级路由使用充分、去噪过程中路由变化平缓。

papers.title: A corrective agentic hybrid RAG and an operations-grounded evaluation for a scientific facility
papers.abstract_en: Scientific user facilities accumulate decades of operational knowledge that no single search index covers: electronic logbooks, technical documents, internal wikis, operations chat messages, maintenance records, and live control-system data. We present APS-RAG, Advanced Photon Source Retrieval Augmented Generation, a deployed platform that makes the institutional knowledge at the Advanced Photon Source (APS) accessible to staff through natural-language queries, along with an operations-grounded evaluation. The retrieval engine fuses dense, sparse, and knowledge-graph (KG) channels with query-type-adaptive reciprocal-rank fusion, adds a corrective agentic loop, and runs a native-tool ReAct executor over a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling layer. We construct APS-Bench, a 50-question, question-answering (QA) dataset with auditable gold answers. Every retrieval-augmented variant numerically improves strict vital-nugget recall over a naive BM25 baseline (63.8%), with the full corrective Agentic GraphRAG scoring (70.3%). The cross-encoder reranker contributes significantly to answer quality: removing it and allowing the LLM to score relevance drastically reduces strict vital recall by 32.8%. The graph channel and corrective loop contribute positively as expected, but the performance gains are marginal. Additionally, we also compare the performance of open-source and closed-source LLMs in final answer synthesis. We release the APS-Bench construction methodology, the six-layer evaluation harness, and the underlying codebase, along with the '/aps-rag' retrieval agent skill framework, to support reproduction and adoption at other facilities. Together, the deployed platform and its operations-grounded evaluation present a promising workflow for trustworthy, statistically grounded AI assistance in facility operations, transferable to other large scientific instruments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍APS-RAG，一个为先进光子源（APS）部署的检索增强生成平台，通过自然语言查询访问分散的机构知识（电子日志、技术文档、聊天记录等）。检索引擎融合密集、稀疏和知识图谱（KG）通道，采用查询类型自适应的倒数秩融合，并加入修正代理循环（corrective agentic loop），基于模型上下文协议（MCP）工具层运行原生工具ReAct执行器。构建了50个问答对的APS-Bench数据集，带可审计标准答案。全变体修正Agentic GraphRAG在严格关键片段召回率上达70.3%，优于BM25基线的63.8%；交叉编码器重排序器对答案质量贡献显著，移除后严格关键召回率下降32.8%。开源了构建方法、评估框架和检索代理技能框架。
Motivation: 科学用户设施积累数十年的运行知识，但分散在电子日志、技术文档、内部维基、运维聊天、维护记录和实时控制系统数据中，单一搜索索引无法覆盖。需要一个统一平台让工作人员通过自然语言查询获取这些知识，并对其可靠性进行运维导向的评估。
Method: 提出APS-RAG平台，检索引擎融合密集、稀疏和知识图谱通道，通过查询类型自适应的倒数秩融合（query-type-adaptive reciprocal-rank fusion）结合修正代理循环（corrective agentic loop），并基于模型上下文协议（MCP）工具层运行原生工具ReAct执行器。构建APS-Bench基准（50个问答对，带可审计标准答案），设计六层评估框架。
Result: 全变体修正Agentic GraphRAG在严格关键片段召回率上达70.3%，超过BM25基线的63.8%。交叉编码器重排序器对答案质量至关重要：移除后由LLM直接打分导致严格关键召回率下降32.8%。图通道和修正代理循环增益边际。同时比较了开源和闭源LLM在最终答案合成上的性能。
Conclusion: 部署平台和运维导向评估为科学设施中可信、统计可靠的AI辅助工作流提供了有前景的方案，可迁移至其他大型科学仪器。作者认为修正代理循环和图通道贡献符合预期但增益有限，交叉编码器重排序器是关键组件。

papers.title: When Can You Correct Distribution Drift in Temporal Graph Generation? A Sharpening--Drift Tension and an Impossibility for Observation-Based Correction
papers.abstract_en: Generative models of temporal graphs are trained on one stretch of an evolving network and deployed on the next, and they degrade badly in the gap. We show this degradation is derivable, general, and not fixable from observations. The masked flow-matching loss decomposes exactly, with no independence assumption, into an irreducible entropy plus a divergence whose derivative along the training path is positive precisely for structures rare during training and common at deployment, diverging as their training probability goes to zero. Empirically the trade-off is a power law with exponent $-0.605$ ($R^2=0.9977$), and drift raises the sampler's error floor without changing how many steps reach it: across seven well-powered conditions the drift-period marginal error varies by at most $6\%$ over a $50\times$ range of sampling budgets, while the floor sits $2.2\times$ to $34.3\times$ above the in-period floor. Because the deployment period is observed, correction looks like a matter of measurement. It is not. We prove that any corrector measurable with respect to past observations leaves at least the conditional variance of the statistic it tracks, and that trend extrapolation beats trusting the last observation only when $μ^2>v(1-2ρ)$. Both premises are measurable and both go the wrong way: the drift is trendless and mean-reverting, with a one-step innovation as large as the drift itself. An oracle removes $60\%$ of the error, the best observation-based corrector recovers $5.7\%$ of that, and extrapolation is strictly worse than doing nothing clever.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间图生成模型在训练和部署时段之间的分布漂移问题，证明漂移可推导、普遍存在且无法通过观测数据修正。通过流匹配损失分解，误差主要由训练中罕见结构引起，并服从指数-0.605的幂律。实验表明漂移将采样器误差下限提高2.2至34.3倍，任何基于观测的校正器最多消除5.7%的误差。
Motivation: 时间图生成模型在部署时性能严重下降，作者旨在理论分析退化的根本原因并探究是否可通过观测数据修正。
Method: 将流匹配损失精确分解为熵与散度项，分析散度导数与罕见结构概率的关系，推导漂移误差的幂律形式，并证明任何基于过去观测的校正器均无法完全消除条件方差。
Result: 训练-部署漂移误差遵循指数-0.605的幂律（R²=0.9977）；漂移将误差下限提高至训练时段的2.2–34.3倍；最佳观测校正器仅恢复5.7%的误差，外推法甚至不如不做任何处理。
Conclusion: 分布漂移在时间图生成中本质不可通过观测数据修正，且给出了可检验的统计条件（μ² > v(1-2ρ)）用于判断是否值得外推。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. Post-training highlights reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains and multiple reasoning-effort levels, enabling compositional generalization and robust long-horizon execution. At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K3 achieves frontier-level performance across long-horizon coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, namely Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 consistently outperforms other open and proprietary models evaluated in our suite. We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 介绍Kimi K3，一个2.8T参数（104B激活参数）的MoE模型，具备原生视觉能力和百万token上下文窗口。模型基于Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals改进信息流，采用Stable LatentMoE每个token激活16/896个专家，整体缩放效率相比K2提升约2.5倍。后训练使用跨通用、智能体、编码领域的强化学习，实现组合泛化和长程执行。评估表明在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理、视觉任务上达到前沿水平，但仍落后于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol。作者开源全部权重。
Motivation: 旨在提升大规模MoE模型的缩放效率、长上下文能力和跨领域智能，特别是通过算法-系统协同设计实现高效训练和部署。
Method: 提出Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals改进信息流；Stable LatentMoE实现每token激活16/896专家；精细化训练和数据配方；后训练采用多领域强化学习和多推理努力级别。
Result: 缩放效率提升约2.5倍；在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理、视觉任务上达到前沿水平，优于其他开源和闭源模型（除Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol）。
Conclusion: 模型整体性能仍落后于最强大的专有模型，但开源权重以促进研究。

papers.title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
papers.abstract_en: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it. Recent benchmarks and systems express this step through a coordinate interface: the model outputs the coordinates of bounding boxes that mark the evidence regions in the document. Under this interface, vision-language models often fail to identify the right regions even when the answer is correct, a failure known as Attribution Hallucination. We present a study that investigates whether this failure is partially limited by what the model can express through coordinates. On a verified bilingual CiteVQA subset, we compare the coordinate interface with a language interface in which the model outputs only text, quoting its evidence verbatim, and a multimodal retriever returns the location of each quote as a page region proposed by a layout parser (tables and figures are quoted through their captions or notes); the comparison is repeated over six open vision-language models. Compared with the coordinate interface, evidence recall rises from at most 8 points to between 26 and 47 and the hallucination rate roughly halves, with little change in answer quality. Building on this comparison, we use the same quote-and-retrieve pipeline as a training scaffold: because region-level evidence labels are expensive to collect for long documents, we introduce a GRPO recipe whose reward is a judge's reading of the gold answer and crops of the retrieved regions, training the model to quote better evidence without any region labels and raising an 8B backbone's strict attributed accuracy from 22.4 to 33.8. These findings indicate a practical path to improve attribution"without a coordinate interface and without costly region-level supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉文档理解中模型将答案归因于证据区域的能力。现有方法通过坐标接口输出边界框，但模型常出现归因幻觉。作者提出用语言接口（模型引用文本证据，布局解析器定位）替代坐标接口，在CiteVQA子集上证据召回率从最多8点提升至26-47点，幻觉率减半。进一步，利用引用-检索流程作为训练框架，通过GRPO方法和奖励信号（基于答案和检索区域裁剪）训练模型，无需区域标签即可提升归因准确率。
Motivation: 现有视觉文档理解中，模型通过坐标接口输出证据区域边界框，但常出现归因幻觉（答案正确但区域错误）。作者假设该失败部分源于坐标接口的表达限制。
Method: 提出语言接口：模型输出纯文本引用证据内容，再由多模态检索器通过布局解析器定位引用文本、表格和图片的位置。进一步，将该流程作为训练框架，引入GRPO算法，以答案和检索区域裁剪输入给评判器的输出作为奖励信号，无需区域标签即可训练模型改进引用能力。
Result: 在CiteVQA子集上比较六种开源视觉-语言模型：语言接口的证据召回率从≤8点提升至26-47点，幻觉率减半，答案质量几乎不变。GRPO训练将8B骨干模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。
Conclusion: 研究表明，无需坐标接口和昂贵区域级监督，通过语言接口和引用-检索训练框架可显著改善视觉文档理解中的证据归因。

summary_sections.result: 在CiteVQA子集上比较六种开源视觉-语言模型：语言接口的证据召回率从≤8点提升至26-47点，幻觉率减半，答案质量几乎不变。GRPO训练将8B骨干模型的严格归因准确率从22.4提升至33.8。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究表明，无需坐标接口和昂贵区域级监督，通过语言接口和引用-检索训练框架可显著改善视觉文档理解中的证据归因。

papers.title: Reason-Mediated Behavioral Models for Auditing LLM Social Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as social simulators, including as synthetic survey respondents. Most evaluations ask whether simulated outcomes resemble human outcomes. We argue that this is necessary but too weak: a simulator can match the final answer while using the wrong rationale-derived reason pattern. We study this problem through a 94-person sunscreen concept test in which each respondent evaluated three product concepts and wrote open-ended rationales. We map those rationales into signed reason states $Z$, where positive signs support adoption and negative signs block it. This gives a practical audit: holding respondent descriptors $D$, category context $K$, and concept treatment $X$ fixed, do human rationale-derived reasons help predict behavior $Y$, and can an LLM simulate the same reason state without seeing the human rationale or outcome? Human rationale-derived reasons substantially improve held-out prediction of purchase intent. LLM-simulated reasons are more brittle: they often sound plausible, but frequently echo the concept board rather than recover the respondent's acceptance or rejection path. The paper contributes an evaluation framework for social simulators. Reason states do not identify natural causal effects by themselves, but they provide an interpretable test of whether a simulator's stated reasons align with human evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于理由中介的行为模型来审计LLM社会模拟器。通过94人防晒产品概念测试，将人类开放式理由映射为带符号的理由状态Z，发现人类理由能显著提升购买意向预测，而LLM模拟的理由虽表面合理但常重复概念板而非真实接受/拒绝路径。论文贡献了一个评估社会模拟器的框架。
Motivation: 现有LLM社会模拟器评估仅关注最终输出是否匹配人类结果，但忽略理由过程；模拟器可能用错误理由得出正确结果，这种虚假对齐需要被检测。
Method: 设计94人防晒产品概念测试，收集每个受访者的产品评价和开放式理由，并将理由映射为带符号的理由状态Z（正号支持采纳，负号阻止）。通过比较保留的人类理由与LLM模拟理由对购买意图的预测能力进行审计。
Result: 人类理由状态显著提升保留样本的购买意图预测；LLM模拟的理由更脆弱，常重复概念板内容而非恢复受访者的接受或拒绝路径。
Conclusion: 理由状态本身不能识别自然因果效应，但提供了一种可解释的测试来检查模拟器的理由是否与人类证据一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficiency Matters in Autonomous Research
papers.abstract_en: AI-driven autonomous research (AR) systems are becoming increasingly effective across a broad range of tasks. Their performance, however, is still evaluated primarily by the quality of the final outcome. In this paper, we argue that the efficiency of the solution-search process is an equally important but often overlooked dimension of performance. A strong AR system should not only produce high-quality results, but also reach them with as small a budget as possible. Search efficiency will become increasingly important as AR expands from domains with inexpensive verification, such as mathematics and coding, to real-world scientific settings in which solution evaluation may require costly physical experiments. To capture this dimension, we propose evaluating AR systems using the area under the curve (AUC) of the Pareto frontier, alongside final outcome quality. We compare several families of search algorithms, including hill climbing, beam search, tree search, and evolutionary search, across twelve systems-optimization tasks. We find that no single search structure is consistently the most efficient. We also show that search efficiency and final outcome quality are distinct performance dimensions: a method that eventually achieves the best result may nevertheless improve slowly and consume substantially more evaluation budget before reaching that result. Because the most effective search policy is generally unknown in advance, we introduce an adaptive procedure called fluid search, which uses a portfolio bandit to dynamically allocate a fixed evaluation budget across a forest of search processes. Across the evaluated tasks, fluid search achieves the highest overall search efficiency, closely matching the performance of a per-task oracle that is given the best search structure for each task in advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出AI驱动的自主研究（AR）系统的搜索效率与最终结果质量同等重要，但常被忽视。作者提出用Pareto前沿的AUC评估搜索效率，并在12个系统优化任务上比较了爬山法、束搜索、树搜索和进化搜索等算法。结果显示没有单一搜索结构普遍最有效，且搜索效率与结果质量是独立维度。为此，他们引入流体搜索（fluid search），通过portfolio bandit动态分配预算，在任务中达到了接近最优的搜索效率。
Motivation: 现有AR系统评估主要关注最终结果质量，忽略了搜索过程效率。随着AR扩展到需要昂贵物理实验的真实科学场景，搜索效率变得至关重要。
Method: 提出用Pareto前沿的AUC衡量搜索效率，在12个系统优化任务上比较多种搜索算法。进一步提出流体搜索（fluid search），使用portfolio bandit在森林搜索过程中动态分配固定评估预算。
Result: 未发现单一搜索结构始终最有效；搜索效率和最终结果质量是独立维度；流体搜索在所有任务中实现最高搜索效率，几乎匹配每个任务预先给定最佳结构的性能。
Conclusion: 搜索效率是AR评估的重要维度，流体搜索能自适应地接近最优策略。

papers.title: Sparse Autoencoders Encode Both Concepts and Functions: The Downstream Geometry of Feature Effects
papers.abstract_en: The wide-scale use of sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as interpretability tools is limited by inconsistent links between SAE features and model behavior. Features with clear activation descriptions may have weak or unexpected causal effects; steering can vary across prompts or oppose the intended direction; and activation-based feature selection can miss features that produce the desired output change. Prior work has studied feature geometry inside the model, where features are computed. We instead study the geometry of changes in model logits caused by feature interventions. We introduce Feature-Effect Geometry Analysis (FEGA), an unsupervised framework that removes the same active SAE feature across contexts and analyzes the resulting cloud of logit changes. Across SAE variants, consistent one-dimensional effects are rare: few features behave like reusable directions. To interpret this variation, we distinguish value-like features, tied to static information such as factual attributes, from pointer-like features, associated with context-dependent operations. Value-like features more often exhibit structured, low-dimensional effects, although these effects typically span several directions. Pointer-like features, by contrast, predominantly exhibit diffuse effects. Our results show that a feature can be interpretable and causally relevant without providing a stable direction for steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征与模型行为之间的不一致性，提出特征效应几何分析（FEGA）框架。通过分析特征干预引起的模型logits变化几何，发现一致的一维效应很少，大多数特征并非可复用的方向。特征可分为值型（value-like）和指针型（pointer-like），前者表现出结构化低维效应，后者效应分散。
Motivation: SAE作为可解释性工具的使用受限于特征与行为之间的不一致：特征激活描述清晰但因果效应弱或与预期相反，基于激活的特征选择可能遗漏重要特征。
Method: 提出FEGA，一种无监督框架：在不同上下文中移除相同的活跃SAE特征，分析logit变化云团的几何结构。
Result: 跨多种SAE变体，一致的一维效应罕见；值型特征更常表现出结构化低维效应（但仍需多个方向），指针型特征效应分散。
Conclusion: 特征的可解释性和因果相关性并不保证其提供稳定的操控方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra for Taint Confinement in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents processing mixed-confidentiality data face severe security risks from prompt injection attacks and reasoning errors. While dynamic Information Flow Control (IFC) provides structural security guarantees, traditional taint tracking permanently taints an agent's context upon reading unvetted data, severely restricting downstream utility. We present APPA (Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra), an IFC framework that resolves this usability bottleneck through engine-managed context branching and prospective acquisition enforcement. Before data acquisition occurs, APPA prospectively evaluates label descents and missing prerequisites, generating actionable remedy plans (Authorize, Accept). To inspect unvetted data without polluting the primary context, a label-seeded child trajectory is spawned, absorbing label descent locally and allowing a trusted sanitizer to return a bounded derivative to the unchanged parent. Governed by a two-monoid model over security labels and shared event logs, we formally prove parent label preservation and merge confinement. Finally, we evaluate APPA on a multi-turn tool-chaining benchmark across four models: it suppresses exfiltration (31%-50% down to 0%-7% attack success), and on three of the four, branching recovers a substantial share of the utility that taint tracking alone forfeits.
papers.comment: Preprint. Submitted to the 19th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISec '26). 10 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出APPA（Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra），一种用于LLM代理的污点隔离信息流控制框架。通过引擎管理的上下文分支和前瞻性获取执行，APPA解决了传统污点跟踪永久污染上下文导致可用性下降的问题。在多个工具链基准上的实验表明，APPA能将攻击成功率从31%-50%降至0%-7%，同时在三个模型上通过分支恢复了大部分因污点跟踪而损失的实用性。
Motivation: 自主LLM代理处理混合机密性数据时面临提示注入攻击和推理错误的严重安全风险，而传统动态信息流控制（IFC）在读取未验证数据后永久污染上下文，严重限制了下游实用性。
Method: APPA框架通过引擎管理的上下文分支和前瞻性获取执行实现污点隔离：在数据获取前前瞻性评估标签下降和缺失前提，生成可操作的补救计划（授权、接受）；为检查未验证数据而不污染主上下文，生成标签种子子轨迹，吸收本地标签下降，允许受信任的清理器向未改变的父上下文返回有界导数；基于安全标签和共享事件日志的双幺半群模型，形式化证明了父标签保持和合并隔离。
Result: 在多轮工具链基准上，APPA将攻击成功率从31%-50%降低至0%-7%；在四个模型中的三个上，分支恢复了大部分因污点跟踪而损失的实用性。
Conclusion: APPA通过上下文分支和前瞻性策略解决了传统IFC在LLM代理中的实用性瓶颈，提供了结构化的安全保证，同时保持了较高的任务效用。

papers.title: A Model for Imbalanced Label Aggregation: A Focus on Minority-Class Detection
papers.abstract_en: We study imbalanced crowdsourcing with a focus on class-dependent annotator accuracy, a setting that, to the best of our knowledge, remains relatively underexplored despite its importance in real-world inspection systems where the labels of greatest operational importance are also the rarest ones. In this setting, annotators may be reliable on both classes, unreliable on both classes, majority-class specialists, or minority-class specialists. Existing models only partially address this problem: they either capture class-dependent errors but ignore item difficulty, or they model item difficulty without capturing class-dependent errors. To fill this gap for imbalanced datasets in crowdsourcing, we introduce a generative aggregation model combining item difficulty with class-dependent annotator competence. The model allows both annotator abilities and item difficulties to vary across classes. We then revisit Condorcet's Jury Theorem in the class-imbalanced setting. We also show that majority voting asymptotically preserves the underlying class proportion. We evaluate our model on $33$ real-world crowdsourcing datasets, covering multiclass tasks such as images and text, as well as two large-scale regimes: large-scale annotation datasets, with many annotations per item, and large-scale item datasets, with a large number of annotated instances. Across these diverse settings, our model consistently achieves the highest minority recall while remaining competitive in balanced accuracy, making it particularly relevant when rare-label recovery is the primary objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对众包场景中少数类标签稀缺且标注者能力因类别而异的问题，提出一个结合项目难度和类别依赖标注者能力的生成式聚合模型。该模型在33个真实众包数据集上（涵盖图像、文本等多类别任务）取得了最高的少数类召回率，同时保持有竞争力的平衡准确率。
Motivation: 现实众包系统中，最重要的标签往往也是最稀有的，但现有模型要么捕捉类别依赖错误却忽略项目难度，要么建模项目难度但不考虑类别依赖错误，无法有效处理类别不均衡众包数据。
Method: 提出一个生成式聚合模型，同时建模项目难度和类别依赖的标注者能力，允许标注者能力和项目难度在不同类别间变化。
Result: 在33个真实众包数据集上，该方法在少数类召回率上一致最优，同时平衡准确率具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该模型在不均衡众包标签聚合中有效提升了少数类检测性能，特别适用于稀有标签恢复为主要目标的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation via Dual Distillation for Videos Under Severe Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in several computer vision tasks. However, they experience severe performance degradation when applied to real-world scenarios due to unanticipated distribution shifts. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) attempts to solve this problem by using unlabeled data from the target domain to dynamically adapt to the test distribution at inference time, without access to the source data. However, TTA remains a challenging problem when adapting to continuous, temporally correlated data, such as videos, and in scenarios where the target domain contains severe domain shifts. For this reason, few works in the literature explore TTA for videos under such extreme conditions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Test-time Adaptation via Dual Distillation (TADD), an online adaptation framework that relies on a lightweight projection adapter to bridge the domain gap. The adapter module is pre-trained on the source domain and then adapted to the target using our proposed complementary losses: (i) zero-shot distillation, which encourages alignment with the domain-agnostic features from a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM); and (ii) target distillation, which retains the source domain discriminative knowledge encoded in the pre-trained adapter. Built upon a frozen CLIP backbone, our method introduces this lightweight projection adapter as the sole updatable component during inference. We conducted extensive evaluations on three well-known video action recognition benchmarks: UCF-HMDB, Daily-DA, and Sports-DA. Our experiments in the closed-set scenario demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA baselines. Notably, our TTA approach improves upon previous methods by up to +3.81% on UCF-HMDB, +2.63% on Daily-DA, and +3.03% on Sports-DA.
