papers.title: Are Prompt Optimizers Blind? Cross-Modal Visual Feedback for Automatic Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has been widely adopted to adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks without weight updates, yielding promising results. However, on multimodal tasks, the effectiveness of APO is fundamentally bottlenecked by a blind feedback channel: the optimizer reads the question, the prediction, and the gold answer, but never the input image on which the model failed, and therefore cannot diagnose visually grounded errors. As a remedy, we introduce Cross-Modal Visual Feedback (CMVF). CMVF incorporates (1) a failure-conditioned visual diagnosis stage, in which a stronger optimizer VLM inspects each failed image without access to predictions or labels, and (2) an error-aware aggregation stage that compresses these observations into reusable, task-level visual blind-spot patterns that drive the prompt rewrite. Crucially, the image is consumed only during optimization; the deployed artifact is an ordinary text prompt that runs at the same inference cost as any text-only baseline. Extensive results across 12 VQA datasets and 4 target VLMs demonstrate that CMVF consistently ranks first, improving over the strongest baseline on every target by 2.4 points on average, with gains of up to 6.5 points on individual benchmarks. Moreover, the optimizer self-organizes into expert-style visual checklists that transfer across models without re-optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨模态视觉反馈（CMVF）用于自动提示优化（APO），解决多模态任务中优化器无法访问输入图像导致的盲区问题。CMVF包含故障条件视觉诊断和错误感知聚合两阶段，仅优化时使用图像，部署时的文本提示推理成本与纯文本基线相同。在12个VQA数据集和4个目标视觉语言模型上，CMVF平均提升2.4个点，最高提升6.5个点，并生成可跨模型迁移的专家式视觉检查清单。
Motivation: 现有自动提示优化在多模态任务中因优化器无法访问输入图像，导致无法诊断视觉相关错误，形成反馈盲区。
Method: 提出CMVF，包含故障条件视觉诊断（更强优化器VLM检查失败图像）和错误感知聚合（压缩观察为任务级视觉盲区模式以驱动提示重写）。图像仅在优化时使用，部署为普通文本提示。
Result: 在12个VQA数据集和4个目标VLM上，CMVF均排名第一，平均比最强基线高2.4个点，单个基准最高提升6.5个点。
Conclusion: CMVF通过跨模态视觉反馈显著提升APO在多模态任务中的效果，且生成的视觉检查清单可跨模型迁移。

papers.title: PRISM: Prompt Refinement via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation models can synthesize high-quality images from natural language descriptions, but their performance remains highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Existing prompt optimization methods mainly rely on text-side rewriting, prompt expansion, or external reward signals, offering limited image-grounded diagnosis and weak support for learning reusable optimisation policies. In this paper, we propose PRISM, a Prompt Refinement framework via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism. PRISM closes the prompt-image-feedback loop by interpreting generated images with structured visual diagnosis and scoring them along semantic consistency, aesthetic quality, and human preference alignment. It first initializes a unified VLM through multi-task supervised fine-tuning, and then improves the prompt policy via self-rewarding optimization with a hybrid ideal-point and Chebyshev reward. Extensive experiments show that PRISM improves holistic image quality and fine-grained semantic alignment, while providing interpretable feedback for targeted prompt refinement. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM-FF81.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM，一种通过图像引导的自奖励机制进行提示优化的框架，用于文本到图像生成。PRISM 利用视觉诊断和评分（语义一致性、美学质量、人类偏好对齐）来闭环提示-图像-反馈循环，并通过多任务监督微调初始化的统一 VLM 及自奖励优化（混合理想点和切比雪夫奖励）改进提示策略。实验表明 PRISM 提升了整体图像质量和细粒度语义对齐。
Motivation: 现有提示优化方法主要依赖文本侧重写、扩展或外部奖励信号，缺乏图像引导的诊断和对可重用优化策略的支持。
Method: PRISM 通过结构化的视觉诊断解释生成图像，并从语义一致性、美学质量和人类偏好对齐三方面评分；先通过多任务监督微调初始化统一 VLM，再使用混合理想点和切比雪夫奖励的自奖励优化改进提示策略。
Result: 实验表明 PRISM 提高了整体图像质量和细粒度语义对齐，同时提供了可解释的反馈用于针对性提示优化。
Conclusion: PRISM 通过图像引导的反馈循环和自奖励优化，有效改善了文本到图像生成中提示优化的效果。

papers.title: DeepFaith: Evidence-Grounded LLMs for Faithful Incident Reporting in Multi-Stage APT Defense
papers.abstract_en: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are difficult to detect and interpret due to their multi-stage and stealthy nature. While recent autonomous defense systems leverage provenance graphs and learning-based models for detection and mitigation, their outputs remain largely machine-oriented and difficult for analysts to interpret. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising interface for report generation, but often produce hallucinated or weakly grounded content. In this paper, we propose DeepFaith, an evidence-grounded framework for faithful incident reporting in multi-stage APT defense. DeepFaith transforms structured outputs from autonomous defense and explainability modules into natural-language reports that are explicitly aligned with underlying system evidence. The framework integrates a unified evidence representation, evidence-grounded prompting, faithfulness-aware generation, and post-generation verification to ensure that all generated statements are supported. Experiments in a realistic enterprise testbed demonstrate that DeepFaith improves faithfulness from 0.68 to 0.92, reduces unsupported claims from 0.32 to 0.08, and increases temporal consistency from 0.6 to 0.88, while maintaining concise reports and lower error rates than existing template-based and LLM-based solutions. These results show that evidence-grounded generation enables reliable, interpretable, and actionable reporting for security operations centers.
papers.comment: This paper has been submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Network and Service Management (CNSM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对APT攻击的多阶段防御中，现有自主防御系统输出机器导向、难以解释，且大语言模型（LLM）生成的报告常出现幻觉或弱证据支撑的问题，本文提出DeepFaith框架。该框架将自主防御与可解释性模块的结构化输出转换为自然语言报告，通过统一证据表示、证据引导提示、忠实性感知生成和生成后验证，确保所有陈述均有证据支持。在企业测试床上的实验显示，DeepFaith将忠实性从0.68提升至0.92，无支撑声明从0.32降至0.08，时间一致性从0.6提升至0.88，同时保持简洁报告和较低错误率。
Motivation: 现有自主防御系统输出机器导向、难以解释，而LLM生成的报告缺乏证据支撑，易产生幻觉或弱证据内容，分析师难以理解和信任。
Method: 提出DeepFaith框架，集成统一证据表示、证据引导提示、忠实性感知生成和生成后验证，将结构化输出转化为与系统证据明确对齐的自然语言报告。
Result: 在企业测试床上，忠实性从0.68提升至0.92，无支撑声明从0.32降至0.08，时间一致性从0.6提升至0.88，报告更简洁、错误率更低。
Conclusion: 证据引导生成能够为安全运营中心提供可靠、可解释且可操作的报告，提升LLM在APT防御中的实用性和可信度。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Perturbative-NeuSA: A Structured Spectral Framework for Time-Dependent PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Neural spectral PDE solvers often learn an entire unresolved vector field even when an inexpensive approximate model can already capture most of the trajectory. Here we introduce Perturbative-NeuSA, a residual formulation that decomposes the target solution into a low-fidelity background and a high-resolution perturbation, so that only the unresolved dynamics is learned. Starting from the exact perturbation equation, the method combines a fixed spectral operator, a background-dependent correction, the background defect in the target PDE, and an optional neural closure. This construction makes the roles of physical structure and neural closure separately measurable. Across 2D Burgers, Klein-Gordon, and heterogeneous 2D wave equations, the deterministic structured solver outperforms the trained NeuSA baseline while requiring no neural-network training. The largest gains occur on Burgers, where the deterministic correction reduces training and extrapolation errors by factors of 24 and 44, respectively. In addition, a Klein-Gordon sweep over seven background resolutions shows that the effect of the closure is conditional: it improves a poor background by 3.6 times, becomes neutral at intermediate resolutions, and degrades a well-resolved background. For the wave equation, however, the closure provides an additional 18% reduction when the remaining residual is interface-localized. Multi-initial-condition diagnostics further show that the useful closure regime depends on the initial-condition spectrum and can disappear in extrapolation when structured correction already captures the dominant Burgers dynamics. Perturbative-NeuSA therefore reframes neural closure as a conditional, diagnosable correction governed by background fidelity, residual organization, and compatibility with the closure model.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables; supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Perturbative-NeuSA，一种残差形式的神经谱PDE求解框架，将目标解分解为低保真背景和高分辨率微扰，仅学习未解析的动力学。在2D Burgers、Klein-Gordon和非均匀2D波动方程上，确定性结构化求解器无需神经网络训练即可超越已训练的NeuSA基线，且微扰项在特定条件下提供额外改进。
Motivation: 现有神经谱求解器常学习整个未解析向量场，而廉价近似模型已能捕获大部分轨迹，导致计算浪费。
Method: 从精确微扰方程出发，结合固定谱算子、背景依赖校正、目标PDE背景缺陷和可选神经闭合（neural closure），使物理结构与神经闭合的作用可分别度量。
Result: 在2D Burgers上，确定性校正将训练和泛化误差分别降低24倍和44倍；Klein-Gordon上，闭合在低分辨率背景改善3.6倍，中分辨率中性，高分辨率退化；波动方程上，闭合在界面局部残余上额外降低18%误差。
Conclusion: Perturbative-NeuSA将神经闭合重塑为条件性、可诊断的校正，其有效性取决于背景保真度、残余组织以及与闭合模型的兼容性。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.conclusion: Perturbative-NeuSA将神经闭合重塑为条件性、可诊断的校正，其有效性取决于背景保真度、残余组织以及与闭合模型的兼容性。

papers.title: Beyond Aggregate Risk: Role-Stratified Conformal Risk Control for LLM Tool Calls
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents act through structured tool calls whose arguments carry different risks. Untrusted content may safely influence an email body but should not determine a recipient, account, command, or credential. Existing statistical methods typically control risk over the entire action, allowing failures in rare, high-risk fields to be obscured by benign arguments. We introduce role-stratified per-field conformal risk control, a calibration layer that wraps any per-field detector and sets separate thresholds and risk budgets for semantic argument roles. For a role with prevalence $p_r$, aggregate-only certification must use an effective budget of $αp_r$ to guarantee role-specific risk $α$, whereas role-stratified calibration certifies each sufficiently sampled role directly with a finite-sample guarantee; rarer roles are handled by pooled certification. Across AgentDojo and InjecAgent with six language models, the empirical utility gap tracks this predicted price of coarseness, and our method achieves the most consistent role-specific budget compliance under model and attack transfer, detector noise, gradual drift, unseen tool suites, and adaptive attacks. It provides formal per-role guarantees under exchangeability or after recalibration, and empirical compliance under frozen distribution shift. These results suggest that structured tool calls should be certified at the semantic-role level, not the whole action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出角色分层逐字段共形风险控制方法，为LLM工具调用的每个语义角色设置独立的阈值和风险预算，解决聚合风险控制无法保护罕见高风险字段的问题。在AgentDojo和InjecAgent基准上，使用六种语言模型验证了该方法在模型转换、攻击迁移、检测器噪声、渐进漂移、未见工具套件和自适应攻击下的鲁棒性，并提供正式的角色级保证。
Motivation: 现有共形风险控制方法仅控制整个动作的聚合风险，导致罕见但高风险字段（如收件人、账户、命令、凭证）的失败被大量良性参数掩盖，缺乏针对不同语义角色的细粒度风险保证。
Method: 引入角色分层逐字段共形风险控制，包装任意逐字段检测器，为每个语义角色设置独立阈值和风险预算；对出现频率足够的角色直接校准并给出有限样本保证，对罕见角色采用池化校准。
Result: 在AgentDojo和InjecAgent上，六种语言模型的实验显示角色分层方法在角色级预算合规性上优于聚合方法，且对模型/攻击迁移、检测器噪声、分布漂移、未见工具和自适应攻击保持稳定。
Conclusion: 结构化工具调用应在语义角色层面而非整个动作层面进行风险认证，角色分层共形控制能够提供正式保证并在经验上保持合规。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simulating Tenant Responses to Energy Policy Interventions with Transaction-Cost-Aware LLM Age
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies use Large language models (LLMs) to simulate human opinions and decisions by prompting models with demographic, attitudinal, or persona-based descriptions. Yet such simulations rarely model the practical, cognitive, or social frictions that shape how people respond to policy interventions. Perceived transaction cost (PTC) provides a useful lens for modeling the practical frictions that shape policy responses, such as information burden, administrative effort, coordination demands, and perceived uncertainty. We use this lens to develop a friction-aware persona modeling approach for LLM-based simulation. In the context of energy-efficient renovation (EER), tenants are represented not only by who they are demographically, but by how they perceive the costs, benefits, barriers, and uncertainties associated with proposed renovation plans. Using survey data collected from 1,068 citizens in the Netherlands, comprising approximately 40,548 survey question and answer pairs, we compare prompt-only and fine-tuned settings across GPT-3.5-turbo, Ministral-8B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for local open-weight models. Results show that incorporating PTC-based personas and reasoning consistently improves model performance across both prompt-only and fine-tuned settings, suggesting that PTC-based persona design provides a useful bridge between institutional policy theory and interpretable LLM-based policy simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaweijie1996/socialagent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于感知交易成本（PTC）的人物建模方法，用于LLM模拟租户对能效改造政策的响应。通过调查荷兰1068名公民的数据，比较了GPT-3.5、LLaMA等模型在纯提示和微调设置下的表现，发现引入PTC基人物和推理持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有LLM模拟人类决策时忽略了实际摩擦（如信息负担、行政努力等），本文利用PTC概念建模这些摩擦，提高政策模拟的真实性。
Method: 开发一种PTC感知的人物建模方法，将租户表示为人口统计特征+对改造成本、收益、障碍和不确定性的感知。使用调查数据进行提示和微调（SFT和GRPO）实验。
Result: 在三种模型和两种设置下，PTC基人物和推理均提升性能，表明该方法能桥接制度政策理论和可解释的LLM政策模拟。
Conclusion: PTC基人物设计为LLM政策模拟提供了有效框架，代码开源。

papers.title: Gubernaut: A Deterministic Homeostatic Controller for Affect-Regulated LLM Agents, Validated Across Independent Model Families
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents inherit reactive failure modes: escalation under provocation, sycophantic drift under flattery, perseveration when stuck. These are failures of propensity, not capability; they concern what a model does under sustained pressure, which training-time alignment reduces but does not eliminate at runtime. This research led to the Gubernaut Cognitive Controller (GCC), a model-agnostic runtime control layer in a Nelson--Narens monitoring--control loop: an object level reads and writes text, while a deterministic meta level reads only the numeric telemetry {intensity, valence, repetition} and returns a regulating posture. Because the meta level ingests zero tokens, no injection channel to the controller exists by construction (an architectural property, not yet adversarially tested); the text-exposed arbiter's compliance is measured, not assumed. We evaluate the GCC with a pre-registered, generate-once/judge-many protocol across a 4x4 matrix of four frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4.3), each serving as both a generator and a judge. The regulated arm is calmer in 13 of 16 cells at p<.05 and 15 of 16 by sign; the three sub-threshold cells, including a -0.04 null, all fall on the single near-saturated host. The effect survives a lineage-independent fourth judge family (xAI), strong evidence that it is no artifact of shared judge style. The clearest mechanism is the recovery signature: arousal that integrates under attack and then decays, valence-gated, on de-escalation, replicating across all four families. Transcripts and panels ship with SHA-256 provenance and are re-judgeable; five failure modes are pre-registered. No consciousness claims are made.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Data, transcripts, and analysis scripts: https://github.com/thegubernaut/Gubernaut_Validation Project page: https://gubernaut.com (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21303518)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC），一种与模型无关的运行时控制层，采用Nelson-Narens监控-控制回路：对象层读写文本，元层仅读取数值遥测（强度、效价、重复性）并返回调节姿态。元层不摄入任何token，从而消除了对控制器的注入通道（架构特性，尚未经过对抗测试）。在4个前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Grok 4.3）的4×4矩阵上进行预注册、一次生成/多次评判的评估，受调节臂在13/16个单元格中显著较平静（p<0.05），15/16个单元格符号一致。效果在独立于谱系的第四评判家族（xAI）中依然存在，表明不是共享评判风格的假象。
Motivation: LLM代理存在反应性失败模式：挑衅下升级、奉承下趋炎附和、卡顿时持续固着。这些是倾向性而非能力性的失败，涉及模型在持续压力下的行为，运行时对齐无法完全消除。
Method: 提出Gubernaut认知控制器（GCC），一个模型无关的运行时控制层，采用Nelson-Narens监控-控制回路：对象层读写文本，确定性元层仅读取数值遥测（强度、效价、重复性）并返回调节姿态。元层不摄入任何token，因此没有注入通道（架构特性，尚未对抗测试）。
Result: 在4个前沿模型的4×4矩阵评估中，受调节臂在13/16个单元格中显著更平静（p<0.05），15/16个单元格符号一致；三个亚阈值单元格（包括一个-0.04的零效果）均落在单一近饱和宿主上。效果在独立谱系的第四评判家族（xAI）中依然存在。最清晰的机制是恢复特征：在攻击下整合的唤醒在降级后以效价门控方式衰减，在四个模型家族中复制。
Conclusion: GCC提供了一种确定性、模型无关的运行时情绪调节方法，其效果跨模型家族和评判家族稳健，但存在一个近饱和宿主上的亚阈值区域。作者声明未提出意识主张，且控制器的注入安全性尚未经对抗测试。

papers.title: Unsupervised Graph Representation Learning with Complementary View Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised graph representation learning aims to derive meaningful node embeddings by capturing both structural and attribute information without relying on labeled data. Existing methods, such as GAEs, have demonstrated effectiveness but typically rely on message-passing mechanisms that assume homophily, leading to performance degradation on heterophilous graphs, where connected nodes exhibit dissimilar features. This homophily bias results in the loss of critical high-frequency components that are essential for identifying heterophilous patterns. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{AlignGAE}, a novel extension of \textit{MaskGAE} that preserves the full frequency spectrum through complementary view alignment. Our framework introduces a dual-encoder architecture that separately processes structural and attribute information, incorporates node positional encoding to approximate Neighborhood Identity Distribution (NID), and employs dual reconstruction tasks for both edges and node attributes. We further propose theoretically grounded NID alignment strategies that ensure semantic consistency across views while preserving their distinct characteristics. Through comprehensive spectral analysis, we demonstrate that \textsc{AlignGAE} achieves optimal representation properties when the alignment loss converges. Extensive experiments across 12 benchmark datasets validate our approach, showing that \textsc{AlignGAE} outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 18.7\% on heterophilous graphs in node classification, while maintaining competitive performance on homophilous graphs. Our results establish a new paradigm for frequency-aware graph representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AlignGAE，一种无监督图表示学习方法，通过互补视图对齐保留全频谱信息，解决异质性图上同质性偏置导致的性能下降问题。具体包括双编码器结构、节点位置编码和双重建任务，并在理论分析表明对齐损失收敛时达到最优表示性质。在12个基准数据集上，节点分类任务在异质图上最高提升18.7%。
Motivation: 现有无监督图表示学习方法（如GAEs）基于消息传递假设同质性，在异质图上性能下降，丢失了识别异质模式所需的高频分量。
Method: 提出AlignGAE，扩展MaskGAE，引入双编码器结构分别处理结构和属性信息，结合节点位置编码近似邻居身份分布（NID），以及边和节点属性的双重建任务，并提出理论基础的NID对齐策略确保视图间语义一致性。
Result: 在12个基准数据集上，节点分类任务在异质图上最高提升18.7%，在同质图上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 建立了频率感知的图表示学习新范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unequal Trips, Unequal Places: Diagnosing and Mitigating Delay Inequity in Autonomous Vehicle Fleet Coordination
papers.abstract_en: City-scale autonomous vehicle fleet coordinators are typically optimized for aggregate travel time, yet fleet averages conceal how delay is distributed across trips and regions. We conduct a distributional audit on three real-city road-network and taxi-demand datasets from Manhattan, Chicago, and San Francisco. The audit reveals pervasive trip-length inequity whose direction depends on the city and coordinator. After accounting for trip length, spatial inequity becomes more pronounced as demand grows and is consistently stronger when trips are grouped by origin rather than destination. These findings motivate SPatially Aware RErouting (SPARE), a budgeted online coordination framework that assigns limited replanning capacity to delayed vehicles and redirects them using recently observed waiting pressure. SPARE provides a per-review decision guarantee and explicitly bounds online route updates. Experiments on all three datasets against six representative baselines show that SPARE delivers the strongest joint efficiency-fairness performance while retaining city-scale scalability. The results demonstrate that bounded congestion-responsive rerouting improves performance and equity without full-fleet replanning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对曼哈顿、芝加哥和旧金山三个真实城市的道路网络和出租车需求数据集进行分布审计，发现自动驾驶车队协调中普遍存在行程长度不公平性，且方向因城市和协调器而异。在考虑行程长度后，空间不公平性随着需求增长而加剧，且按起点分组时更显著。基于此，提出SPARE（空间感知重路由）框架，通过预算约束的在线协调，将有限的重新规划能力分配给延迟车辆，并利用最近观察到的等待压力引导它们。SPARE提供每决策保证并显式限制在线路由更新。实验表明，SPARE在三个数据集上相比六个基线实现了最佳的效率-公平联合性能，同时保持了城市级可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有城市级自动驾驶车队协调器通常优化总旅行时间，但车队平均值掩盖了延迟在不同行程和区域之间的分布差异，导致未诊断的延迟不公平问题。
Method: 提出SPARE（空间感知重路由）框架，是一种预算约束的在线协调方法，为延迟车辆分配有限的重新规划能力，并利用最近观察到的等待压力进行重路由，提供每决策保证并显式限制在线路由更新次数。
Result: 在曼哈顿、芝加哥和旧金山三个真实数据集上，SPARE相比六个代表性基线实现了最强的效率-公平联合性能，同时保持城市级可扩展性。
Conclusion: 实验表明，有界拥堵响应重路由可以在不进行全车队重新规划的情况下改善性能和公平性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文对曼哈顿、芝加哥和旧金山三个真实城市的道路网络和出租车需求数据集进行分布审计，发现自动驾驶车队协调中普遍存在行程长度不公平性，且方向因城市和协调器而异。在考虑行程长度后，空间不公平性随着需求增长而加剧，且按起点分组时更显著。基于此，提出SPARE（空间感知重路由）框架，通过预算约束的在线协调，将有限的重新规划能力分配给延迟车辆，并利用最近观察到的等待压力引导它们。SPARE提供每决策保证并显式限制在线路由更新。实验表明，SPARE在三个数据集上相比六个基线实现了最佳的效率-公平联合性能，同时保持了城市级可扩展性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有城市级自动驾驶车队协调器通常优化总旅行时间，但车队平均值掩盖了延迟在不同行程和区域之间的分布差异，导致未诊断的延迟不公平问题。

papers.title: Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication for Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
papers.abstract_en: Common chunking strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often create redundant chunks. These redundant chunks make the vector database bigger and slow down retrieval. A common fix is cosine-similarity thresholding. This method reduces each chunk to a single vector, then compares vectors using a similarity score. But a single vector can lose the fine-grained, token-level detail needed to tell a true duplicate apart from a chunk that just shares the same topic. We propose Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication (CACD). CACD checks each new chunk against an in-memory pool of chunks already kept, using a cross-encoder instead of a single pooled vector. This keeps token-level detail all the way to the final comparison. CACD combines three parts: the cross-encoder comparison itself, a New Information Score (NIS) that measures how much of a chunk is not explained by a candidate already kept, and a majority vote across several candidates rather than a single best match. NIS is calculated from the attention entropy of the cross-encoder. We tested CACD against five existing filtering methods, nine chunking strategies, and 18 configurations, all on the full SQuAD 1.1 validation set. In our experiments, CACD removes 9.75% of chunks on average. This drop rate is close to other semantic-level methods, and much higher than exact-match filters, which barely remove anything. In these experiments, CACD also processes each configuration in 51.0 seconds on average, about 27% faster than the strongest baseline, NERExact (69.6s), and about 7x faster than cosine-similarity filtering (356.7s). These results come from a single dataset, so we present them as an early comparison, not a general claim. Code for the baseline evaluation and for CACD is available at https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench and https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中冗余块问题，提出跨注意力校准去重（CACD）。CACD使用交叉编码器保留token级细节，结合新信息分数（NIS，基于注意力熵）和多数投票，替代余弦相似度阈值方法。在SQuAD 1.1验证集上，CACD平均移除9.75%的块，处理时间51.0秒，比最强基线NERExact快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤快约7倍。结果基于单一数据集，作者声明为早期比较。
Motivation: 现有RAG分块策略易产生冗余块，余弦相似度阈值法将块压缩为单个向量，丢失token级细节，无法区分真正重复与主题相似。
Method: 提出CACD，包含三部分：交叉编码器比较新块与内存池候选块、基于注意力熵的新信息分数（NIS）衡量块未被已有候选解释的程度、针对多个候选的多数投票而非单一最佳匹配。
Result: 在SQuAD 1.1验证集上，CACD平均移除9.75%的块，处理时间51.0秒，较NERExact（69.6秒）快约27%，较余弦相似度过滤（356.7秒）快约7倍。
Conclusion: 结果仅基于单数据集，属于早期比较，非一般性断言；代码已开源。

papers.title: DynaCalKV: Key-Value Cache Compression via Head Grouping and Adaptive Rank Allocation
papers.abstract_en: As the inference phase of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires handling long context windows, the Key-Value (KV) cache initially appears to address this challenge but eventually becomes a significant bottleneck as the context window continues to grow. Low-rank compression has recently been studied as an effective approach to reduce KV cache memory while maintaining model performance. However, only a few existing methods treat the Key and Value caches differently, despite their distinct roles. Moreover, these methods typically employ fixed attention-head grouping, which may not fully exploit the structural similarity among attention heads. In this paper, we propose an improved low-rank KV cache compression framework. For the Key cache, we dynamically group attention heads based on Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity and allocate the rank budget adaptively under a parameter budget. For the Value cache, we adopt the same approach as ReCalKV, refining the low-rank decomposition through offline calibration to improve reconstruction quality. Experimental results on three instruction-tuned LLMs show that our method reduces the number of Key cache parameters while maintaining competitive accuracy. We further observe that the proposed strategy is particularly effective for Multi-Head Attention (MHA) models, whereas it should be applied more conservatively to Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) models, especially in long-context settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的低秩 KV 缓存压缩框架，针对 Key 缓存基于 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 相似性动态分组注意力头并自适应分配秩预算，针对 Value 缓存采用 ReCalKV 的离线校准方法。实验表明该方法在三个指令微调 LLM 上减少了 Key 缓存参数数量并保持竞争精度，尤其适用于 Multi-Head Attention (MHA) 模型，而对 Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) 模型需更保守应用。
Motivation: 现有低秩 KV 缓存压缩方法未区分 Key 和 Value 的不同作用，且固定注意力头分组未充分利用结构相似性。
Method: 对 Key 缓存基于 CKA 相似性动态分组注意力头并自适应分配秩预算；对 Value 缓存采用 ReCalKV 的离线校准低秩分解。
Result: 在三个指令微调 LLM 上减少了 Key 缓存参数数并保持竞争精度；在 MHA 模型上特别有效，在 GQA 长上下文设置中需更保守应用。
Conclusion: 本文框架通过动态分组和自适应秩分配有效压缩 KV 缓存，但不同注意力架构需不同处理策略。

papers.title: MEGA-CL: A Molecular Foundation Model for Generalizable ADMET Prediction through Graph External Attention and Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion and toxicity (ADMET) properties of small molecules remains a major challenge in drug discovery. Here, we present MEGA-CL, a foundation graph neural network framework for universal molecular ADMET prediction. MEGA-CL integrates self-supervised contrastive learning with a multi-head external attention mechanism and an enhanced message-passing architecture, enabling simultaneous modeling of local chemical substructures and global inter-graph relationships while mitigating over-smoothing effects commonly observed in deep graph networks. Across 13 benchmark datasets and 21 downstream ADMET tasks, MEGA-CL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baseline models. In particular, the framework demonstrates robust performance on challenging regression tasks, including clearance (CL) and steady-state volume of distribution (VDss), while maintaining strong generalization ability in independent external validation. Clinically relevant predictive accuracy was achieved, with more than 75% of predictions falling within a 3-fold error range. In an external evaluation on 18 novel compounds derived from recently approved FDA drugs, over 50% of human liver microsome clearance (HLMC) predictions were within a 2-fold error range. To further assess its practical applicability, MEGA-CL was prospectively evaluated on three preclinical drug candidates using in vitro hepatic microsomal metabolism assays and CYP450 inhibition assays guided by model predictions. The predicted HLMC values for all candidates were within 2.5-fold of the experimentally measured values, and 73.3% of CYP450 inhibition endpoints (11/15) were correctly classified. These results demonstrate the potential of MEGA-CL as a generalizable framework for accelerating in silico ADMET evaluation and early-stage drug candidate optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEGA-CL是一个基于图神经网络（GNN）的分子基础模型，用于预测小分子的ADMET性质。该模型通过自监督对比学习、多头外部注意力机制和增强的消息传递架构，同时建模局部化学子结构和全局图间关系，并缓解过平滑问题。在13个基准数据集和21个下游ADMET任务中，MEGA-CL一致优于现有基线模型，在清除率（CL）和稳态分布容积（VDss）等回归任务上表现稳健，且在独立外部验证中具有良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 药物发现中预测小分子的ADMET性质仍面临挑战，现有方法在泛化性和准确性上存在不足，尤其是对于深层图网络中的过平滑问题。
Method: 提出MEGA-CL框架，整合自监督对比学习、多头外部注意力机制和增强的消息传递架构，以同时捕获局部化学子结构和全局图间关系，并利用外部注意力缓解过平滑。
Result: 在13个基准数据集和21个ADMET任务上优于现有基线；回归任务（CL、VDss）上表现稳健；外部验证中超过75%的预测在3倍误差范围内；在18个新型化合物上，超过50%的人肝微粒体清除率（HLMC）预测在2倍误差范围内；前瞻性评估中，三个候选药物的HLMC预测值在实验值的2.5倍以内，且73.3%的CYP450抑制终点正确分类。
Conclusion: MEGA-CL作为一种通用框架，有潜力加速电子ADMET评估和早期药物候选优化，但未提及具体限制。

papers.title: Energy Constrained Hierarchical Underwater Monitoring via Local Multi-Agent RAG
papers.abstract_en: Marine life monitoring is limited by strict energy constraints, poor underwater connectivity, and the high cost of transmitting raw multimodal data from remote deployments. This paper proposes a low-consumption underwater monitoring architecture that combines always-on edge sensing with selective high-performance local reasoning. The system follows a hierarchical master--satellite design in which ultra-low-power MAX78000/MAX78002 microcontrollers continuously monitor visual and acoustic signals, while an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX is activated only for scheduled processing, event-driven analysis, or researcher interaction. Once active, the Jetson executes a fully local multimodal pipeline for data ingestion, visual target extraction, embedding-based indexing, species identification, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and automated reporting. BioCLIP/OpenCLIP embeddings are used to organize mission data, marine taxonomic references, scientific documents, and operational metadata in local ChromaDB collections. A dedicated identification layer combines visual similarity search, centroid-based classification, and supervised classifiers to support adaptive species recognition. A LangChain-based multi-agent framework coordinates query routing, structured analysis, energy management, hardware reconfiguration, and report generation. The architecture is evaluated through visual and acoustic monitoring case studies. The proposed system bridges ultra-low-power continuous sensing with local multimodal intelligence, enabling underwater stations to produce structured, researcher-ready knowledge while compressing local data for flexible acoustic, optical, or satellite transmission, minimizing both energy use and communication overhead.
papers.comment: Contains 25 pages, 11 figures. To be submitted to Elsevier Ocean Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种层级式水下监测架构，结合始终在线的边缘感知（MAX78000/MAX78002微控制器）和低功耗现场推理（NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX），实现低能耗、本地化的多模态数据处理（视觉+声学）。系统使用BioCLIP/OpenCLIP嵌入进行数据索引和物种识别，通过LangChain多智能体框架协调查询路由、能量管理和报告生成。案例研究验证了视觉和声学监测的有效性。
Motivation: 海洋监测受限于严格的能量约束、水下通信质量差以及传输原始多模态数据的高成本，现有系统难以在低功耗下实现高效本地化分析。
Method: 提出主从式层级设计，低功耗微控制器持续监测，Jetson Orin在需要时激活。激活后执行完全本地的多模态流水线：数据摄入、视觉目标提取、基于嵌入的索引、物种识别、检索增强推理（RAG）和自动报告。使用BioCLIP/OpenCLIP嵌入组织任务数据、分类参考和科学文档，通过视觉相似性搜索、质心分类和监督分类器进行物种识别。LangChain多智能体框架协调各模块。
Result: 通过视觉和声学监测案例研究评估，系统能够生成结构化、研究者可直接使用的知识，同时压缩本地数据以便灵活传输，最小化能耗和通信开销。
Conclusion: 该架构将超低功耗连续感知与局部多模态智能结合，使水下站点能够产出有序知识，同时通过压缩和选择性传输减少能耗与通信负荷。

papers.title: Memory operator ensembles indicate proximity to criticality in simulated AMOC transitions
papers.abstract_en: Classical early-warning signals assume that recovery slows near a tipping point, but in a well-studied CESM simulation of AMOC collapse, autocorrelation and variance decrease instead. We develop a preregistered diagnostic that uses only past data to estimate the slowest mode of a memory operator fitted to the evolving overturning structure. The operator ensemble produces an exploratory alarm 77 years before collapse, compared with 29 years for a physics-based freshwater-transport indicator. A blind test on the recovery branch does not validate the same timing rule, supporting interpretation of the diagnostic as a proximity measure rather than a universal clock. In nine additional simulations, it warns before all four finite-rate forced transitions but not before three rapid noise-induced collapses available only as scalar AMOC records. Matched ablations show that the signal depends on long-timescale memory and vertical overturning structure rather than trend, forcing, or multivariate information alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AMOC（大西洋经向翻转环流）崩溃前的早期预警信号，发现在CESM模拟中传统指标（自相关、方差）反而下降。作者提出一种基于记忆算子（memory operator）的诊断方法，仅使用历史数据估计最慢模态，在模拟的AMOC崩溃前77年发出预警，优于基于物理的淡水输运指标（29年）。在盲测和额外模拟中，该方法在有限速率强迫转变前有效，但对噪声诱发的快速崩溃不敏感。
Motivation: 经典早期预警信号（如自相关增加）在AMOC崩溃模拟中失效（自相关、方差下降），需要开发替代诊断方法以提前预警AMOC临界点。
Method: 提出一种预注册诊断方法：利用历史时间序列数据拟合记忆算子（memory operator），从中提取最慢模态的演化，并构建算子集成（operator ensemble）作为预警指标。
Result: 在CESM模拟的AMOC崩溃中，该方法在崩溃前77年发出预警，而基于淡水输运的物理指标仅提前29年。在9个额外模拟中，该方法对所有4个有限速率强迫转变发出预警，但对3个噪声诱发的快速崩溃（仅有标量AMOC记录）无效。消融实验表明，信号依赖于长时间尺度记忆和垂直翻转结构，而非趋势、强迫或多变量信息。

papers.title: Teacher Knows It Best: Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking and Tipping Points in Networked Langevin Dynamics AI Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: We formulate a statistical physics framework to model a networked stochastic dynamical system exhibiting bistability, driven by additive noise and social conformity. We apply this model to understand and mitigate AI-induced delusional spiraling-a phenomenon where algorithmic sycophancy from Large Language Models continuously reinforces inaccurate beliefs within a socially interacting society. By partitioning the network into a majority of regular agents and a minority of "aware" nodes (Teachers) placed at topological hubs, we use a degree-weighted mean-field approximation to reduce high-dimensional coupled Langevin equations into a single macroscopic drift equation. We provide a closed-form analytical derivation for the deterministic critical tipping time through a saddle-node bifurcation. We validate this analytical boundary using finite-size scaling and demonstrate a universal data collapse across diverse network topologies. Finally, we optimize an intervention strategy under a strict budget constraint that balances the topological footprint against driving velocity. We prove mathematically that under certain conditions, a highly concentrated, rapid intervention targeting massive hubs strictly outperforms a distributed, slow approach to rescue the network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个统计物理框架，用于模拟由加性噪声和社会从众性驱动的双稳态网络随机动力系统。该模型专门用于理解和缓解AI导致的妄想螺旋现象，即大型语言模型（LLM）的算法奉承（algorithmic sycophancy）在社会互动中不断强化错误信念。通过将网络划分为多数普通代理和少数位于拓扑枢纽的“意识节点”（教师），并采用度加权平均场近似，将高维耦合Langevin方程简化为单个宏观漂移方程。论文给出了通过鞍结分岔（saddle-node bifurcation）的确定性临界倾倒时间的闭式解析推导，并通过有限规模标度验证了该解析边界，展示了跨不同网络拓扑的通用数据坍缩。最后，在严格预算约束下优化干预策略，证明了在某些条件下，高度集中、快速针对大型枢纽的干预严格优于分散、缓慢的方法。
Motivation: AI系统的算法奉承会导致社会范围内错误信念的持续强化和蔓延（妄想螺旋），现有模型缺乏对这一现象背后双稳态动力学机制和关键干预时机的定量理解。
Method: 使用度加权平均场近似将高维耦合Langevin方程降维为单变量宏观漂移方程，通过鞍结分岔理论解析推导临界倾倒时间，并利用有限规模标度和数据坍缩验证理论边界。在预算约束下，通过平衡拓扑影响与驱动速度来优化干预策略。
Result: 解析推导了确定性临界倾倒时间，并在不同网络拓扑上验证了理论边界的数据坍缩。证明了在预算约束下，高度集中、快速的枢纽干预策略优于分散、缓慢的方法。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过统计物理框架可以定量理解AI奉承导致的社会妄想螺旋，并证明集中干预枢纽节点是更优的救援策略。

papers.title: Multiview Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery Under Large Scenes with Occlusions
papers.abstract_en: Human mesh recovery (HMR) aims to recover 3D human meshes from images. Most existing HMR benchmarks and methods focus on either multi-person reconstruction from a single view or single-person reconstruction from multiple views, where the number of subjects and the scene scale are relatively limited. Such settings are insufficient for real-world applications with large scenes and severe inter-person occlusions. To address this limitation, we introduce a large-scale synthetic benchmark for multiview multi-person HMR, termed MVMP-HMR. The proposed dataset contains 15 complex scenes with up to 50 camera views and 30 interacting persons, featuring large spatial coverage and severe occlusions, which significantly increases the difficulty of human mesh recovery. Based on this benchmark, we further propose a multiview multi-person whole-body human mesh recovery model, referred to as MVMP-HMR model. The model first fuses multiview features into a scene-level 3D feature volume, and then leverages pelvis joints predicted by a 3D pose estimation network to extract person-specific queries from the 3D feature volume. These human queries are cross-attended with the 3D feature volume and integrated to decode each person's 3D mesh. Moreover, we introduce two novel losses--the orientation loss and the 3D joint density loss--to alleviate orientation and pose ambiguities under severe occlusions. Experiments demonstrate that existing state-of-the-art HMR methods struggle on the proposed MVMP-HMR benchmark, while our method consistently outperforms prior SOTAs in large-scale scenes with severe occlusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大场景多视角多人场景下的人体网格恢复（HMR）问题，提出了一个大规模合成基准MVMP-HMR（15个复杂场景，最多50个相机视角和30个交互人物），并提出了对应的模型MVMP-HMR，通过多视角特征融合到3D特征体，利用3D姿态估计网络预测的骨盆关节提取人物查询，然后交叉注意力解码每个人的3D网格。同时引入方向损失和3D关节密度损失来缓解遮挡下的歧义。实验表明现有方法在该基准上表现不佳，而所提方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有HMR基准和方法要么是单视角多人，要么是多视角单人，场景规模和人数有限，不足以应对大场景和严重人际遮挡的真实应用。
Method: 提出MVMP-HMR模型：首先将多视角特征融合为场景级3D特征体，然后利用3D姿态估计网络预测的骨盆关节从3D特征体中提取人物特定查询，这些查询与3D特征体交叉注意力并集成解码每个人的3D网格。还引入方向损失和3D关节密度损失。
Result: 在提出的MVMP-HMR基准上，现有SOTA方法表现不佳，而所提方法在大型场景和严重遮挡下持续优于先前SOTA。
Conclusion: 本文强调了多视角多人HMR在大场景中的挑战，并提供了基准和方法，展示了有效应对遮挡的新损失函数。

papers.title: UMI3D: Robust 3D Generation on Unconstrained Multi-Image Inputs via Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention Routing
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D foundation models can generate high-quality assets from a single image, but degrade markedly on unconstrained multi-image inputs, often producing distorted geometry, over-smoothed textures, and chaotic colors. We argue that this failure stems not from limited model capacity, but from a mismatch between single-image cross-attention and the multi-image setting: existing models lack a principled way to decide which image each 3D voxel should trust at each denoising step. Revisiting recent single-image 3D foundation models, we show that explicitly routing each voxel to its most informative image is sufficient to unlock strong performance on inconsistent multi-image inputs. Based on this observation, we propose UMI3D, a training-free and plug-and-play framework that restructures cross-attention for unconstrained multi-image 3D generation. Its core, Simultaneous Focus Cross-Attention (SFC-Attn), activates all conditioning images at each denoising step while allowing each voxel to focus on the single image that best explains it. To enable this routing, we derive the Voxel Reference Score (VRS), a model-intrinsic metric for voxel--image affinity that requires no external matching, segmentation, or correspondence models. Extensive experiments show that UMI3D unlocks the multi-image potential of single-image 3D generation frameworks across diverse tasks. Project Page: UMI3D-Project.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有单图像3D基础模型在处理无约束多图像输入时性能显著下降，原因是跨注意力机制与多图像设置不匹配。作者提出UMI3D，一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，其核心是同时聚焦交叉注意力（SFC-Attn），每个体素在去噪步骤中仅聚焦于最能解释它的单张图像。通过推导体素参考分数（VRS）作为体素-图像亲和力的内在度量，无需外部匹配或分割模型。实验表明UMI3D能解锁单图像3D生成框架的多图像潜力。
Motivation: 现有3D基础模型在单图像输入下表现良好，但在无约束多图像输入时产生几何扭曲、纹理过平滑和颜色混乱。作者认为失败并非模型容量不足，而是单图像交叉注意力与多图像设置不匹配，模型缺乏原则性方法决定每个体素在每一步去噪时应信任哪张图像。
Method: 提出UMI3D，一个训练免费、即插即用的框架，重构交叉注意力用于无约束多图像3D生成。核心为同时聚焦交叉注意力（SFC-Attn），在每一步去噪中激活所有条件图像，同时允许每个体素聚焦于最能解释它的单张图像。为了实现路由，推导了体素参考分数（VRS），一种模型内在的体素-图像亲和力度量，无需外部匹配、分割或对应模型。
Result: 大量实验表明UMI3D能在多种任务中解锁单图像3D生成框架的多图像潜力。
Conclusion: UMI3D作为无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过显式路由每个体素到最相关的图像，可有效处理不一致的多图像输入，提升3D生成质量。

papers.title: Superpixel-Based QUBO for Scalable Quantum-Enhanced Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) has emerged as a powerful framework for medical computing problems. Binary decision variables naturally represent clinical choices, making QUBO formulations well-suited for quantum annealing hardware. However, a fundamental scalability challenge limits practical deployment: problem size grows rapidly with input dimensionality, creating computational bottlenecks that restrict applications to simplified scenarios. This paper addresses this challenge through hierarchical problem reduction, as demonstrated in medical image segmentation, where pixel-level QUBO formulations create over 65,000 variables for a 256x256 image, forcing existing approaches to downsample to 42x42 resolution and discard 97% of pixel information. A superpixel-based QUBO framework is proposed using simple linear iterative clustering (SLIC) to group pixels into perceptually meaningful regions, then formulate segmentation as QUBO over a region adjacency graph (RAG) combining min-cut and smoothness objectives. Validation on INbreast mammography breast cancer images demonstrates a 4.2% improvement in segmentation quality (mean IoU 0.76 vs 0.73) with 33 computational speedup (0.67s vs 21.97s) and a 97.3% reduction in problem size (1764 to 48 variables), all achieved while processing full-resolution images rather than downsampled versions. The reduced problem size also fits well within current quantum annealer connectivity limits, removing the embedding overhead that has historically blocked direct deployment of pixel-level QUBO segmentation on quantum hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于超像素的QUBO框架，用于可扩展的量子增强医学图像分割。通过SLIC将像素分组为感知上有意义的区域，然后在区域邻接图（RAG）上构建QUBO，结合最小割和平滑目标。在INbreast乳腺X线图像上验证，分割质量提升4.2%（mIoU 0.76 vs 0.73），速度提升33倍（0.67s vs 21.97s），问题规模减小97.3%（从1764个变量降至48个），且能处理全分辨率图像。
Motivation: 像素级QUBO公式化导致问题规模随输入维度快速增长，256x256图像产生超过65000个变量，迫使现有方法将分辨率降低至42x42，丢弃97%的像素信息。需要一种可扩展的方法来克服这个计算瓶颈。
Method: 使用简单线性迭代聚类（SLIC）将像素分组为超像素，然后基于超像素构建区域邻接图（RAG），将分割问题公式化为RAG上的QUBO，目标函数包含最小割项和光滑项。
Result: 在INbreast乳腺X线癌图像上，平均IoU从0.73提升至0.76（+4.2%），运行时间从21.97s降至0.67s（加速33倍），问题规模从1764个变量降至48个（减少97.3%），并且可以处理全分辨率图像，无需下采样。
Conclusion: 所提出的超像素QUBO框架显著减小了问题规模，使其适合当前量子退火器的连接限制，消除了像素级QUBO分割在量子硬件上直接部署的嵌入开销，为量子增强医学图像分割提供了一条可行路径。

summary_sections.result: 在INbreast乳腺X线癌图像上，平均IoU从0.73提升至0.76（+4.2%），运行时间从21.97s降至0.67s（加速33倍），问题规模从1764个变量降至48个（减少97.3%），并且可以处理全分辨率图像，无需下采样。
summary_sections.conclusion: 所提出的超像素QUBO框架显著减小了问题规模，使其适合当前量子退火器的连接限制，消除了像素级QUBO分割在量子硬件上直接部署的嵌入开销，为量子增强医学图像分割提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: From Proprietary to Open-Source: Bridging the Distribution Gap via Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation in Agentic Search
papers.abstract_en: Agentic search enables large language models to solve knowledge-intensive tasks by interleaving multi-step reasoning with retrieval, yet optimizing this with outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides only sparse supervision. Knowledge distillation can supply denser guidance, and advanced proprietary models with their strong reasoning capabilities are promising teachers. While distilling from proprietary models can densify this supervisory signal, conventional logit-matching is precluded by hidden logits and mismatched tokenizers, whereas raw natural language trajectory imitation transfers superficial stylistic artifacts rather than core reasoning competence. To address the heterogeneous distillation problem and bridge the distribution gap, we propose Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation (MAPD), a joint distillation and RL framework uses a structured, style-normalized protocol as an intermediate representation. An offline multi-agent system (MAS) decomposes each query, retrieves supporting evidence, repairs failed searches, and converts the resulting exploration trace into a JSON protocol containing the task type, reasoning plan, and extractive grounding facts. During training, the protocol is provided only to a privileged branch of the student policy, whose token distributions furnish a dense distillation signal alongside the sparse RL objective. Extensive evaluations across seven QA benchmarks demonstrate that MAPD consistently outperforms competitive distillation and RL, achieving average success rates of 39.4\% on Qwen3-1.7B and 44.4\% on Qwen3-4B. Crucially, the framework generalizes robustly across diverse proprietary teachers while effectively mitigating the student policy from style drift and verbosity degeneration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多智能体协议蒸馏（MAPD）框架，通过将专有模型（proprietary model）的搜索轨迹转化为结构化的JSON协议，为开源学生模型提供密集的蒸馏信号，结合稀疏强化学习目标，弥合专有模型与开源模型在智能搜索任务上的分布差距。在七个QA基准上，MAPD显著优于对比方法，且有效防止学生模型风格漂移与冗长退化。
Motivation: 专有模型在智能搜索中表现优异，但传统蒸馏方法因隐藏logits、分词器不匹配和自然语言轨迹浅层模仿而效果不佳；现有强化学习信号稀疏，需更密集的监督。
Method: MAPD包含两步：离线多智能体系统将查询分解、检索、修复搜索失败并生成JSON协议（含任务类型、推理计划、事实依据）；训练时该协议仅提供给学生策略的特权分支，其token分布提供密集蒸馏损失，与稀疏RL目标联合优化。
Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B上，平均成功率分别达39.4%和44.4%，超越竞争性蒸馏和RL方法，且对不同专有教师模型鲁棒泛化。
Conclusion: MAPD利用结构化的协议作为中间表示，有效弥合了专有与开源模型在智能搜索任务上的分布差距，同时减轻了风格漂移和冗长问题。

papers.title: The Tokenizer Tax: Quantifying and Explaining the Cross-Lingual Cost of Subword Tokenization for Indian Languages
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) process text through subword tokenizers rather than directly reading characters or words. Because these tokenizers are trained predominantly on English-centric corpora, they introduce a systematic and often overlooked disadvantage for many non-English languages. In this work, we quantify this tokenizer tax for Indian languages using the FLORES-200 parallel corpus, measuring tokenization fertility across six widely used tokenizers and fourteen languages. Under cl100k_base (used by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4), Indian languages experience an average 8.0x tokenization tax relative to English, reaching 13.0x for Malayalam, reducing the effective context window to as little as 12% of that available to English users for equivalent semantic content. We identify the primary mechanism behind this disparity: failed byte-pair merges that leave text fragmented into single-byte tokens, with merge failure strongly correlating with tokenizer tax (Pearson r = 0.89). We further show that this phenomenon is not an inherent property of Indic scripts but a consequence of tokenizer design. Multilingual tokenizers such as XLM-R and OpenAI's o200k_base reduce the average Indic tokenizer tax by 73%, demonstrating that the disparity is largely remediable. Beyond token statistics, we quantify a practical consequence by showing that, under fixed context budgets, Indian-language documents preserve substantially less original content than equivalent English documents. Finally, we examine the relationship between tokenizer fertility and reading comprehension performance on the Belebele benchmark, finding that the apparent correlation is largely explained by language resource availability rather than tokenizer behavior alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了子词分词对印度语言造成的tokenization税（tokenizer tax），即相比英语需要更多token来表达相同语义。使用FLORES-200平行语料，测量了六种广泛使用的tokenizer在十四种印度语言上的tokenization fertility，发现cl100k_base（GPT-3.5/GPT-4所用）下印度语言平均承受8.0倍的tokenization税，马来亚拉姆语高达13.0倍，有效上下文窗口缩小至英语用户的12%。该差异主要源于字节对合并失败（byte-pair merge failure），合并失败率与tokenization税强相关（Pearson r=0.89）。多语言tokenizer（如XLM-R、o200k_base）可将平均税降低73%，表明此差距可弥补。此外，固定上下文预算下印度语言文档保留的原始内容远少于英语，且Belebele阅读理解性能与tokenizer fertility的表观关联主要由语言资源可用性解释，而非tokenizer行为本身。
Motivation: 大型语言模型的子词分词器主要基于英文语料训练，导致非英语语言（尤其是印度语言）在tokenization效率上系统性处于劣势，但该差异尚未被精确量化与解释。
Method: 利用FLORES-200平行语料，测量cl100k_base、o200k_base、XLM-R等六种tokenizer在十四种印度语言上的tokenization fertility，并通过分析字节对合并失败率揭示机制。
Result: cl100k_base下印度语言平均tokenization税为8.0倍，马来亚拉姆语达13.0倍；合并失败率与税高度相关（r=0.89）；多语言tokenizer可降低73%的税；固定上下文下印度语言文档内容保留量显著少于英语；Belebele性能差异主要归因于语言资源可用性。
Conclusion: 印度语言在tokenization上的低效并非语言脚本固有属性，而是tokenizer设计可修复的缺陷；多语言tokenizer能大幅缓解该问题。阅读理解性能的表观tokenizer效应实际上由语言资源驱动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Computational Ethical Framework for Financial Digital Phenotyping for Mental Health
papers.abstract_en: Ethical governance of AI-driven systems is often expressed through high-level principles and static documentation, creating a gap between regulatory requirements and system-level verification. This challenge is particularly acute in digital phenotyping, where continuous behavioural data raises concerns around consent, privacy, and fairness. In this paper, we propose a computational ethical framework for AI-driven digital phenotyping system in which ethical requirements are formalised as deontic temporal logic constraints, alongside a conceptual ethical agent that oversees the system and ensures that any supervised system satisfies the specified constraints. Using a case study involving financial data and mental health, we model key ethical properties and verify them using the Z3 Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver. Our evaluation shows that the framework is logically consistent and that violations of the specified ethical properties are ruled out within the formal model through counterexample-based verification. This presents early research enabling continuous, machine-verifiable ethical checking, moving beyond retrospective compliance based on static documentation. We discuss limitations, including the need for real-world verification with data, the challenge with subjectivity and contextual sensitivity, the need for human oversight, and outline how such approaches can support the development of digital phenotyping and AI systems with continuous and auditable ethical guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI驱动数字表型系统中的伦理治理问题，提出一个计算伦理框架，将伦理要求形式化为道义时序逻辑约束，并设计一个概念性伦理代理来监督系统。通过金融数据与心理健康的案例研究，使用Z3 SMT求解器验证关键伦理属性，结果表明框架在逻辑上一致，且能通过反例验证排除违例。该工作为实现持续、机器可验证的伦理检查提供了早期探索。
Motivation: 现有AI伦理治理多依赖高层原则和静态文档，导致监管要求与系统级验证之间存在差距。这在数字表型领域尤为突出，因为持续的行为数据引发了同意、隐私和公平等问题。
Method: 提出计算伦理框架：将伦理要求形式化为道义时序逻辑约束，并引入一个概念性伦理代理来监督系统，确保受监督系统满足约束。使用Z3 SMT求解器对金融数据与心理健康案例进行模型验证。
Result: 评估表明框架在逻辑上一致，通过反例验证排除了指定伦理属性的违例情况。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了持续、机器可验证的伦理检查的可行性，但需在真实数据中进行验证，并面临主观性、情境敏感性以及人工监督需求等挑战。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Generative AI for Property-Targeted 3D Porous Media Design
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design of three-dimensional porous media is central to applications in filtration, catalysis, energy storage, fuel cells, thermal management, and biomedical scaffolds, but remains challenging because many distinct pore geometries can share similar porosity or permeability while small structural changes can strongly affect transport behaviour. This paper proposes a physics-guided generative AI framework for property-targeted porous media design, combining a property-aware variational autoencoder, a conditional latent diffusion model, and an independently trained differentiable structure-to-property surrogate. The framework learns a compact, physically informative latent design space, generates porous structures conditioned on target porosity and directional permeability, and refines generated samples using property-level feedback during denoising and decoding. Experiments on procedurally generated structures and real micro-CT porous-media datasets show improved target-property matching, directional permeability control, and property correlation compared with representative property-aware variational-autoencoder and latent-diffusion baselines. The results demonstrate a scalable route towards controllable inverse design of complex porous geometries and establish a foundation for simulation-informed generative AI tools in engineering and advanced materials discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理引导的生成式AI框架，用于面向性质的三维多孔介质逆向设计。该框架结合性质感知变分自编码器、条件潜扩散模型和独立训练的微分结构-性质替代模型，学习紧凑的物理信息潜设计空间，生成满足目标孔隙度和定向渗透率的多孔结构，并在去噪和解码过程中利用性质级反馈进行细化。在程序生成结构和真实微CT多孔介质数据集上的实验表明，与代表性基线相比，该方法改善了目标性质匹配、定向渗透率控制和性质相关性。
Motivation: 三维多孔介质的逆向设计在过滤、催化、储能等领域至关重要，但由于不同孔几何形状可能具有相似的孔隙度或渗透率，而微小结构变化会强烈影响传输行为，因此设计面临挑战。现有方法难以精确控制目标性质。
Method: 提出一个物理引导的生成式AI框架，包含三个组件：性质感知变分自编码器、条件潜扩散模型，以及可微分的结构-性质替代模型。框架通过性质级反馈在去噪和解码过程中优化生成样本，实现目标孔隙度和定向渗透率的可控生成。
Result: 在程序生成结构和真实微CT数据集上，该方法在目标性质匹配、定向渗透率控制和性质相关性方面优于现有的性质感知变分自编码器和潜扩散基线。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了向复杂多孔几何可控逆向设计的可扩展路径，为工程和先进材料发现中基于模拟的生成式AI工具奠定了基础。

papers.title: Catalyst Diffusion Transformer: Generative Inverse Design of Heterogeneous Catalysts
papers.abstract_en: The vast chemical design space and complex, interdependent design variables make catalyst discovery for targeted properties highly labor- and resource-intensive. Although generative models have emerged as a promising solution, existing approaches are generally limited to single-property conditioning or narrow chemical spaces. Here, we present Catalyst Diffusion Transformer (CatDiT), a unified framework for inverse catalyst design that generates valid and novel structures ranging from intermetallic alloys to oxide surfaces. By learning compressed latent representations, CatDiT enables efficient training and rapid sampling while supporting simultaneous conditioning on adsorbate type, binding energy, and catalyst class. The model provides reliable control of discrete properties and directional control of continuous properties, enriching candidate pools for reaction-specific catalyst discovery. As a representative application, multi-conditional generation for the nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) yields 28 density functional theory (DFT)-relaxed alloy candidates that satisfy the target activity window and lie above the pure-metal *N-*H scaling line, corresponding to a ~1.5-fold enrichment over the source distribution. These results establish CatDiT as a practical and scalable approach for property-directed catalyst inverse design and targeted catalyst generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Catalyst Diffusion Transformer (CatDiT)，一种统一的逆向催化剂设计框架，能够生成从金属间化合物到氧化物表面等多种有效且新颖的催化剂结构。通过学习压缩潜在表示，CatDiT 支持高效训练和快速采样，同时可对吸附物类型、结合能和催化剂类别进行多条件控制。作为代表性应用，针对氮还原反应 (NRR) 的多条件生成得到了 28 个满足目标活性窗口且位于纯金属 *N-*H 标度线上方的 DFT 弛豫合金候选物，相比源分布富集约 1.5 倍。
Motivation: 催化剂的化学设计空间巨大且设计变量复杂、相互依赖，导致针对目标性质的催化剂发现费时费力。现有生成模型通常局限于单一性质条件或狭窄的化学空间。
Method: 提出 CatDiT 框架，采用扩散 Transformer 架构，通过压缩潜在表示进行训练和采样，支持对吸附物类型、结合能和催化剂类别的多条件联合控制。
Result: 在 NRR 任务中，多条件生成了 28 个 DFT 弛豫合金候选物，满足目标活性窗口并且优于纯金属 *N-*H 标度线，富集程度约为源分布的 1.5 倍。
Conclusion: CatDiT 为性质导向的催化剂逆向设计和目标催化剂生成提供了一种实用且可扩展的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KAP: Bridging the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption Gap in LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM systems increasingly rely on knowledge-selection processes that produce high-value structured priors, such as ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, and confidence signals. Yet LLM serving remains fundamentally oblivious to this rich structure: once such signals are serialized into a prompt, the backend observes only a flat token sequence, forcing dense and uniform consumption of the full key-value (KV) state during decoding. We term this architectural mismatch the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption (KSRC) gap: richer contexts enlarge the full-prompt KV footprint and decode-time memory traffic, increasing latency and degrading throughput even when reasoning depends on only a small fraction of the context. To bridge the gap, we propose Knowledge Access Planning (KAP), a paradigm-shifting execution abstraction that elevates structured knowledge priors from passive prompt-construction hints into first-class physical execution artifacts. KAP establishes a universal intermediate representation (IR)-the runtime access plan-which compiles structured knowledge signals to govern physical KV access without altering logical prompt semantics, model weights, or training procedures. Through this IR, KAP shifts LLM serving from token-aware context consumption to plan-driven, knowledge-aware runtime consumption. We instantiate KAP with GraphSpec, a compiler-executor realization connecting structured knowledge selection to an LLM serving backend. We derive a phase-boundary model for the positive-speedup regime of plan-guided execution. Across 4K-128K long-context QA workloads, GraphSpec maintains answer quality comparable to full-context decoding while decoupling physical KV consumption from prompt length, reducing proposal-time KV access to 5.5% of source KV state at 128K, and fundamentally shifting the scaling trajectory of long-context generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现代LLM系统依赖于知识选择过程产生结构化先验，但LLM服务端将其视为平坦token序列，导致密集且均匀的KV消耗，形成知识选择-运行时消耗（KSRC）差距。对此提出知识访问规划（KAP），一种将结构化知识先验提升为物理执行构件的范式，通过运行时访问计划中间表示（IR）控制物理KV访问。实例化GraphSpec，在4K-128K长上下文问答中，将提案时间KV访问降至源KV状态的5.5%（128K上下文），同时保持答案质量。
Motivation: 现有LLM服务端忽略了知识选择产生的结构化信号（如排序证据、图拓扑、多模态对齐等），导致全提示KV足迹增大和解码内存流量增加，造成延迟上升和吞吐量下降，即使推理只依赖少量上下文。
Method: 提出KAP，建立运行时访问计划（中间表示），编译结构化知识信号以控制物理KV访问，不改变逻辑语义、模型权重或训练过程。实例化为GraphSpec编译-执行器，连接结构化知识选择与LLM服务后端，并推导出计划引导执行的正加速区域的相边界模型。
Result: 在4K-128K长上下文问答负载上，GraphSpec保持与全上下文解码相当的答案质量，同时将提案时间KV访问降至源KV状态的5.5%（128K上下文），从根本上改变了长上下文生成的扩展轨迹。
Conclusion: KAP将LLM服务从基于token的上下文消耗转变为计划驱动的知识感知消耗，弥合了知识选择与运行时消耗之间的差距，实现了正加速区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) to convert images of queuing networks into verifiable simulation models: an open-weight LLM workflow approach
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has explored the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate simulation model building, typically by generating executable code directly from natural language descriptions. However, this raises challenges for verification and reproducibility particularly for users without programming expertise. We propose Sketch2DES, a sketch-to-simulation workflow that converts diagrammatic representations of queuing networks into verifiable discrete-event simulation models using open-weight LLMs. The workflow has three stages: (1) translation of a diagram into a semi-structured textual description using a multimodal LLM; (2) conversion into schema-validated structured data (JSON) via an LLM with a reflection-based verification loop; and (3) deterministic transformation into an executable simulation model using a software adapter. Intermediate artefacts can therefore be inspected and automatically validated before execution. We evaluate the approach on eight queuing-network diagrams of varying complexity. The workflow achieved high reliability for all stages, and results were statistically indistinguishable from human-coded and analytical benchmarks. Compared to direct code generation, the workflow improves reproducibility, transparency, and verifiability, while reducing the need for programming expertise. Limitations include restricted model scope and dependence on accurate visual interpretation. The results demonstrate the feasibility of structured, workflow-based model generation as a robust foundation for LLM-assisted simulation modelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sketch2DES 工作流，利用开放权重的大语言模型 (LLM) 将排队网络示意图自动转换为可验证的离散事件仿真模型，包含图像转文本、模式验证转换和确定性代码生成三个阶段。在八个排队网络图上验证，结果与人工编码和解析基准统计无显著差异，相比直接代码生成提高了可重复性和透明度。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 辅助仿真建模通常直接从自然语言生成代码，但缺乏可验证性和可重复性，尤其对非编程专家不友好。
Method: 提出三阶段工作流 Sketch2DES：(1) 多模态 LLM 将示意图转换为半结构化文本描述；(2) LLM 结合反射验证循环将文本转换为模式验证的 JSON 结构化数据；(3) 通过软件适配器确定性生成可执行仿真模型。中间产物可被检查和自动验证。
Result: 在八个不同复杂度的排队网络图上，各阶段均达到高可靠性，生成模型与人工编码及解析基准统计上不可区分。
Conclusion: 结构化的基于工作流的模型生成方法可作为 LLM 辅助仿真建模的鲁棒基础，提升可重复性、透明性和可验证性，但受限于模型范围和视觉解释准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ML-based Predictive Models for Power Consumption in Virtualised O-RANs
papers.abstract_en: As communication networks adopt virtualized and disaggregated architectures, achieving energy efficiency has become increasingly important for both economic and environmental reasons. Traditional methods for power modeling are inadequate in these dynamic software-defined environments due to their inability to model complex and nonlinear factors affecting energy use. We investigate the use of feature extraction and regressor-based machine learning methods for predicting power consumption in virtualized open radio access networks (O-RANs), utilizing datasets from a hardware-instrumented testbed. We test three variants of deep neural networks (DNNs), namely, a standard DNN, a regularized DNN, and a hybrid model combining DNN-based feature extraction with an XGBoost regressor. We evaluate the performance of these models for various system parameters such as transmission gain, modulation/coding schemes, and airtime. We show that the hybrid model consistently outperformed others, achieving a mean relative error below 0.5%. Results suggest hybrid models like DNN-XGBoost offer superior accuracy and could be integrated into O-RAN management tools to enable more energy-efficient network orchestration in future networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究虚拟化O-RAN中的功耗预测，使用机器学习方法，包括标准DNN、正则化DNN以及DNN-XGBoost混合模型。在硬件测试平台数据集上，混合模型表现最佳，平均相对误差低于0.5%，表明混合模型可用于未来网络的节能编排。
Motivation: 传统功耗建模方法无法适应动态软件定义网络环境（如虚拟化O-RAN），需要精确预测功耗以实现能效优化。
Method: 采用特征提取和基于回归器的机器学习方法，构建三种DNN变体：标准DNN、正则化DNN、以及DNN特征提取结合XGBoost回归器的混合模型。使用硬件测试平台数据，考虑传输增益、调制编码方案、空中时间等参数。
Result: 混合模型（DNN-XGBoost）始终优于其他模型，平均相对误差低于0.5%。
Conclusion: 混合模型如DNN-XGBoost在功耗预测上具有优越精度，可集成到O-RAN管理工具中，支持更节能的网络编排。

papers.title: Decision trees, Frobenius traces, and Weierstrass coefficients of elliptic curves
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the extent to which the reduced minimal Weierstrass coefficients of an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$ may be computed from it's Frobenius traces. Decision tree models reveal that the first two reduced minimal Weierstrass coefficients can be recovered with perfect accuracy from the Frobenius traces at the primes $2$ and $3$, and the third by supplementing these two traces with the conductor parity. We subsequently prove explicit formulae for these coefficients using the Frobenius traces and conductor parity. These formulae appear to be new. In particular, we deduce that the first three reduced minimal Weierstrass coefficients of an elliptic curve are determined by its isogeny class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究椭圆曲线约化最小Weierstrass系数是否可由其Frobenius迹计算。决策树模型表明，前两个系数可从2和3处的Frobenius迹完美恢复，第三个需补充导子奇偶性。随后证明了这些系数的显式公式，并推出前三个系数由同源类决定。
Motivation: 探究椭圆曲线的约化最小Weierstrass系数与Frobenius迹之间的可计算关系，揭示系数与同源类的关联。
Method: 利用决策树模型分析Frobenius迹与系数的关系，并基于分析结果推导显式数学公式。
Result: 前两个系数可从2和3处的Frobenius迹完美恢复；第三个系数需补充导子奇偶性；证明了显式公式并推出系数由同源类决定。
Conclusion: 椭圆曲线前三个约化最小Weierstrass系数由其同源类唯一确定，提供了新的计算途径。

papers.title: SILICA: Repurposing Diffusion Priors for Joint Glass Segmentation and Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Standard depth sensors systematically fail on transparent surfaces, creating corrupted 3D maps and severe navigation hazards. While specialized hardware sensors can detect glass, they lack modularity and have extensive hardware dependencies. Consequently, learning-based monocular depth estimation has emerged as a compelling alternative. However, domain-specific glass-aware monocular depth estimators struggle with unfamiliar indoor layouts; restricted by the severe scarcity of real-world glass depth annotations, they fail to generalize zero-shot to new settings. This motivates us to explore whether the extensive priors of text-to-image diffusion models can enable generalizable perception of transparent surfaces. We introduce SILICA, a unified pipeline leveraging these priors to jointly predict glass segmentation and glass-aware depth. This mutual information exchange establishes a robust spatial hierarchy, entirely eliminating the need for paired real-world glass depth annotations. Subsequently, we use the predicted segmentation mask to explicitly filter incorrect glass depth points from standard sensors, recovering accurate metric glass depth for downstream 3D mapping and autonomous collision avoidance. Supported by our novel Mirage 18k dataset, extensive experiments demonstrate that SILICA achieves remarkable zero-shot transfer across diverse, unseen environments, outperforming state-of-the-art models by almost 20% and setting a new benchmark for transparent surface perception.
papers.comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出SILICA，一种利用文本到图像扩散模型先验的联合玻璃分割与深度估计管线，无需真实玻璃深度标注，通过互信息交换建立空间层次，并在Mirage 18k数据集上实现零样本泛化，超越SOTA约20%。
Motivation: 透明表面导致标准深度传感器失效，现有的玻璃感知单目深度估计因缺乏真实标注难以泛化到新场景。本文探索利用扩散模型的先验实现透明表面的泛化感知。
Method: SILICA利用扩散模型的先验联合预测玻璃分割和玻璃感知深度，通过互信息交换建立空间层次，无需配对真实玻璃深度标注；随后用预测的分割掩码过滤标准传感器中的错误深度点。
Result: 在Mirage 18k数据集上，SILICA在多种未见环境上实现零样本迁移，性能超越现有最优模型近20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法消除了对真实玻璃深度标注的需求，并设置了透明表面感知的新基准。

papers.title: Epistemic Norms for AI Safety and Alignment Research
papers.abstract_en: Mainstream AI research emphasises capability growth and tolerates low failure rates when average-case performance is high. AI safety and alignment research has a different mission: to ensure that catastrophic failures never occur, under sparse evidence, adversarial dynamics, and fat-tailed risk. We argue that the two domains differ along two analytically independent axes---{\it capability profile}, demonstrating the absence of hazardous behaviours rather than the presence of positive capabilities, and {\it risk profile}, bounding worst-case outcomes under fat-tailed uncertainty rather than optimising average-case performance---and that mainstream epistemic practices are inadequate on both. Building on a structured synthesis grounded in a preregistered bibliometric baseline, we identify five cross-cutting gap dimensions in current alignment research, including the near-absence of institutionalised independent verification. To address these gaps, we propose {\sc ECAISA}, an Epistemic Code for AI Safety and Alignment comprising eight principles, a three-level scoring rubric, a four-level disclosure ladder that reconciles transparency with information-hazard and commercial-confidentiality constraints, a tiered applicability scheme, an information-hazard adjudication procedure, and seven anti-gaming mechanisms. {\sc ECAISA} does not certify that any AI system is safe; it constrains how safety-relevant research claims are documented, checked, and relied upon, with auditability rather than certification as its governance target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证AI安全和对齐研究在能力谱系和风险谱系上与传统AI不同，现有认识论实践不充分。提出ECASA规范，包含八项原则、三级评分、四级披露阶梯等，旨在约束安全相关研究声明的记录、核查和依赖，以可审计性为目标。
Motivation: 主流AI研究容忍低失败率，而安全对齐研究需要保证灾难性失败永不发生，面临稀疏证据、对抗动力学和肥尾风险。传统认识论实践在能力和风险两个轴线上均不适用。
Method: 基于预注册文献计量基线识别五个交叉缺口维度，提出ECASA（Epistemic Code for AI Safety and Alignment）框架，包括八项原则、三级评分、四级披露阶梯（协调透明性与信息危害/商业保密）、分层适用方案、信息危害裁决程序和七种反博弈机制。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但指出当前对齐研究存在如缺乏制度化独立验证等缺口。ECASA不认证任何AI系统安全性，而是约束安全相关研究声明的文档化、核查和依赖。
Conclusion: 可审计性而非认证是治理目标。ECASA通过规范认识论实践来提升AI安全研究的可信度。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Progress in video generation keeps narrowing the visual gap between AI-generated and professionally produced footage, yet most benchmarks still draw prompts from web sources or LLM templates and score them with untrained, generic multimodal models. More fundamentally, their evaluation taxonomies remain rudimentary (overall visual quality, coarse text alignment and temporal smoothness) rather than the professional Cinematic Language criteria by which films are actually made and judged, so they assess basic video plausibility rather than film-grade craft. We introduce FilmBench, a text-to-video (T2V) and reference-to-video (R2V) benchmark grounded in the professional Cinematic Language of the film- academy tradition and co-developed with directors and faculty from the Beijing Film Academy and the Hujing Digital Media & Entertainment Group film studio. It rests on three choices. First, prompts are reverse-engineered from clips of award-winning films spanning 20 cinematic genres and chosen by professional directors, so every prompt is anchored to a verified live-action reference; the prompts follow real shot lists, and most script multiple shots (1,056 of the 1,169 prompts are multi-shot), unlike prior single-clip benchmarks. Second, evaluation follows a three-level Cinematic taxonomy of 3 axes, 12 components and 35 (T2V) +3 (R2V-only) sub-metrics. Third, we develop an in-house expert-grade automatic evaluation agent and open-source its core suite of Cinematic Language operators (FilmOps). Benchmarking leading video generation models (9 for T2V, 7 for R2V), the evaluator reproduces the human model ranking at model-level Spearman \r{ho} = 0.95 (T2V) and 0.96 (R2V). Scores fall well below prior web-style benchmarks, with two consistent gaps in dynamic aesthetics and a marked single- to multi-shot performance drop that widens for weaker models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FilmBench是一个面向影视级视频生成的基准测试，由专业导演和电影学院教师共同开发，基于获奖电影片段逆向工程生成提示词，并采用专业电影语言的三级评估体系（3轴、12组件、35+3子指标）。评测发现现有顶尖模型在该基准上的得分远低于传统网络风格基准，且在动态美学和多镜头生成方面存在明显不足。
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准的提示词多来自网络或模板，评估标准粗糙（仅关注视觉质量、文本对齐和时序平滑度），未能反映专业电影制作中使用的电影语言标准，因此无法衡量影视级生成质量。
Method: FilmBench构建了包含1169个提示词（其中1056个为多镜头）的T2V和R2V基准，提示词源自20种电影类型的获奖影片片段；开发了基于电影语言操作符（FilmOps）的自动评估代理，采用三级电影语言分类体系评估。
Result: 在T2V和R2V任务上分别评测9个和7个模型，评估代理的人类模型排序斯皮尔曼相关系数达0.95和0.96。模型得分显著低于传统网络基准，且存在动态美学差距和单镜头到多镜头的性能下降。
Conclusion: FilmBench揭示了当前视频生成模型在影视级标准下的不足，尤其在多镜头和动态美学方面，为未来研究提供了更贴近专业电影制作的评估框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Why does Greedy Search produce Optimal Clustering Outcomes? A Fixed-Core Assignment Theory
papers.abstract_en: Many existing clustering methods are designed based on a set-oriented definition---a cluster is a set of similar points---relying a point-to-point similarity function to find similar points. This works well for compact clusters, but clustering performance can deteriorate badly when cluster shapes are irregular, and densities or sizes vary between clusters. Recent `Cluster-as-Distribution' (CaD) clustering has been shown to discover these generic types of clusters in practice by treating each cluster as a set of independent and identically distributed points generated from some unknown distribution via a greedy search, achieving a clustering objective equivalent to that of Spectral Clustering, but with better clustering outcomes without eigen-decomposition. However, a theoretical analysis of this phenomenon is still lacking. Our analyses are from two angles. First, we analyze the approximation error between the true and empirical distribution embeddings. Second, we show that the greedy search employed to achieve the CaD clustering objective can be mapped to a partition matroid---yielding greedy optimality. These yield a near-optimality guarantee for the CaD clustering objective, with regret controlled by the approximation error. This is the first analysis that explains why CaD clustering via greedy search can discover clusters of arbitrary shapes, densities and sizes (where all set-oriented clustering methods have failed to discover) when the estimated cluster embeddings faithfully approximate the underlying cluster distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了基于贪心搜索的“聚类即分布”（Cluster-as-Distribution, CaD）方法为何能发现任意形状、密度和大小的簇。通过分析真实分布与经验分布嵌入之间的近似误差，并将贪心搜索映射为划分拟阵（partition matroid），作者证明了CaD聚类目标具有近最优性保证，其遗憾由近似误差控制。这是首个解释CaD贪心搜索成功机制的理论工作。
Motivation: 现有基于点对点相似性的集导向聚类方法在处理不规则形状、密度或大小变化的簇时性能严重下降，而CaD方法在实践中表现出色，但缺乏理论解释。
Method: 从两个角度分析：一是真实分布与经验分布嵌入之间的近似误差；二是将CaD聚类目标中的贪心搜索映射为划分拟阵，从而利用贪心最优性理论。
Result: 给出了CaD聚类目标的近最优性保证，其中遗憾由近似误差控制，解释了贪心搜索为何能发现各类复杂簇。
Conclusion: 当估计的簇嵌入忠实逼近底层簇分布时，CaD贪心搜索可发现所有集导向方法无法发现的任意形状、密度和大小的簇。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimax Lower Bounds of Kernel Discrepancy Estimation: MMD, HSIC, KSD
papers.abstract_en: Over the past 20 years, kernel discrepancies have been leveraged as a highly powerful tool for quantifying the disagreement of distributions, with numerous successful applications in two-sample, goodness-of-fit, and independence testing, among others. Their fastest estimators are known to converge at a parametric rate---$n^{-1/2}$---under mild conditions. While this rate is known to be minimax optimal on $\mathbb R^d$ under strict assumptions with bounded kernels, little is known about its optimality beyond the finite-dimensional Euclidean setting with unbounded kernels. In this work, we prove that the minimax lower bound of estimation of the most popular kernel discrepancies (maximum mean discrepancy, Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion and kernel Stein discrepancy; MMD, HSIC, KSD) is $n^{-1/2}$ on general topological spaces, and under mild assumptions on the kernel; the same rates are shown (as corollaries) to hold for the estimation of the mean embedding and the centered cross-covariance operator. Our results settle the question of optimal estimation of these kernel discrepancies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了在一般拓扑空间和温和核假设下，最大均值差异（MMD）、希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）和核斯坦差异（KSD）的估计最小极大下界为n^{-1/2}，从而确定了这些核差异的最优估计率。
Motivation: 尽管已知在有限维欧几里得空间和有界核条件下MMD等估计的n^{-1/2}率是极小极大最优的，但在更一般的拓扑空间和无界核情形下的最优性尚不清楚。
Method: 通过建立一般拓扑空间上的极小极大下界理论，并利用核函数的温和假设，推导出MMD、HSIC和KSD的估计下界。
Result: 证明了MMD、HSIC和KSD的极小极大下界均为n^{-1/2}，相同速率也适用于均值嵌入和中心交叉协方差算子的估计。
Conclusion: 该工作解决了这些核差异估计的最优性问题，表明n^{-1/2}速率在一般条件下是最优的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MATS: A novel multi-modality multi-task learning framework for 3D perception in autonomous driving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modality data from different sensors provides rich complementary information for 3D perception, becoming an essential component in reliable autonomous driving systems. Current research typically designs intricate and complex fusion strategies to integrate information from multimodal data on a unified bird's-eye-view (BEV) feature map for the joint learning of multiple perception tasks. However, such a single feature map hardly carries sufficient information to simultaneously meet the requirements of various perception tasks, leading to a very limited perception performance. To mitigate this limitation, this paper proposes MATS, a novel multi-modality multi-task learning approach with modality-adaptive BEV fusion and task-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for 3D perception. Specifically, a simple modality-adaptive BEV fusion module is designed to adaptively recalibrate the BEV features by modeling the global cross-modality dependencies, generating diverse BEV feature maps for various perception tasks. For joint multi-task learning, this paper proposes a task-specific MoE module to decouple the tasks and enable the network to automatically choose the appropriate BEV feature candidates for each specific task. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, we conduct extensive experiments on the large-scale benchmark nuScenes. With the camera- and LiDAR-modality input data, the proposed approach outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by a significant margin. Furthermore, the experimental results on the single tasks show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms the baselines. The code and trained models will be available upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MATS，一种多模态多任务学习框架，用于自动驾驶3D感知。通过模态自适应BEV融合和任务特定的混合专家（MoE）模块，生成不同的BEV特征图以适应不同感知任务。在nuScenes数据集上超越SOTA。
Motivation: 现有方法使用单一BEV特征图同时处理多个感知任务，难以承载足够信息，导致感知性能受限。
Method: 提出模态自适应BEV融合模块，通过建模全局跨模态依赖自适应重新校准BEV特征；提出任务特定MoE模块，解耦任务并自动为每个任务选择合适的BEV特征候选。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，使用相机和LiDAR输入，显著超越SOTA。
Conclusion: 验证了所提方法的有效性，代码和模型将公开。

papers.title: Every Client Is an Environment: Federated De-confounding for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for spatio-temporal forecasting (STF), enabling collaborative model training without sharing raw observations. Existing federated STF methods primarily regard cross-client heterogeneity as an optimization challenge and mitigate it through personalized approaches. However, such heterogeneity fundamentally stems from diverse \emph{environmental conditions}, and these methods capture environment-specific forecasting patterns, hardly generalizing under environmental shifts. Our key insight is that the environmental diversity across federated clients should be exploited, as they provide \emph{complementary observations of the same underlying spatio-temporal system}. Based on this insight, we propose \method, a novel federated de-confounding framework that \textbf{treats clients as distinct causal environments}. \method leverages the client heterogeneity as distributed environmental evidence and learns a global prototype codebook to capture shared environmental regimes. We further derive a theoretical federated de-confounding bound that is linearly controlled by the averaged confounding strength. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \method consistently outperforms federated baselines, while providing transferable, interpretable, and communication-efficient environmental representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对联邦时空预测中客户端异质性带来的环境变化问题，提出将每个客户端视为独立因果环境，利用客户端多样性作为分布式环境证据，学习全局原型码本以捕获共享环境模式。理论上推导了联邦去混淆边界，实验表明该方法在多个联邦时空预测基准上优于基线，并提供可转移、可解释、通信高效的环境表示。
Motivation: 现有联邦时空预测方法将客户端异质性视为优化挑战，采用个性化方法缓解，但无法泛化到环境变化。作者认为客户端多样性应被利用，因为它们提供了对同一时空系统的互补观测。
Method: 提出FedDeconf框架，将客户端视为不同因果环境，利用客户端异质性作为分布式环境证据，学习全局原型码本（prototype codebook）捕获共享环境模式，并推导联邦去混淆理论边界。
Result: 摘要报告在多个联邦时空预测基准上，FedDeconf一致优于联邦基线，并提供可转移、可解释、通信高效的环境表示。
Conclusion: 论文强调利用客户端环境多样性作为去混淆手段，可以提升联邦时空预测的泛化性，理论边界显示平均混淆强度线性控制性能。
Relevance: 45

summary_sections.motivation: 现有联邦时空预测方法将客户端异质性视为优化挑战，采用个性化方法缓解，但无法泛化到环境变化。作者认为客户端多样性应被利用，因为它们提供了对同一时空系统的互补观测。
summary_sections.method: 提出FedDeconf框架，将客户端视为不同因果环境，利用客户端异质性作为分布式环境证据，学习全局原型码本（prototype codebook）捕获共享环境模式，并推导联邦去混淆理论边界。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在多个联邦时空预测基准上，FedDeconf一致优于联邦基线，并提供可转移、可解释、通信高效的环境表示。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调利用客户端环境多样性作为去混淆手段，可以提升联邦时空预测的泛化性，理论边界显示平均混淆强度线性控制性能。

papers.title: TreeAdapter: Hierarchical Taxonomy-Guided Adapter Composition for Fine-Grained Species Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Although general text-to-image models excel in open-domain generation, their performance degrades significantly in specialized downstream domains, particularly when generating images of rare biological species. Hindered by long-tailed distributions, general models struggle to capture subtle fine-grained details, while per-species fine-tuning methods over-isolate individual species and consequently ignore the shared visual features among closely related taxa. To address this, we propose TreeAdapter, a novel framework that explicitly leverages hierarchical taxonomic data. Rather than using a monolithic model or independent per-species modules, TreeAdapter attaches lightweight adapters to every node of the taxonomic tree. Specifically, leaf-node adapters capture species-specific visual traits, while internal-node adapters encapsulate shared semantics among descendant taxa. We introduce a two-stage training paradigm where ancestor adapters are optimized to model only the residual visual features unexplained by their descendants. This model architecture and training paradigm enable the model to fully leverage hierarchical information, ensuring the accurate generation of visual features for each species. Extensive experiments across three large-scale biodiversity benchmarks demonstrate that TreeAdapter achieves state-of-the-art fine-grained generation quality, outperforming both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TreeAdapter框架，利用层次分类学树在每节点附加轻量适配器，通过两阶段训练让叶节点捕获物种特异特征、内部节点捕获共享语义，以解决通用文本到图像模型在稀有生物物种生成中细节丢失的问题。实验表明，该方法在三个大规模生物多样性基准上取得了细粒度生成的最新最优结果。
Motivation: 通用文本到图像模型在长尾分布的稀有物种上难以捕捉细微细节，而逐物种的微调方法又孤立了物种间共享视觉特征，导致生成质量不佳。
Method: TreeAdapter在物种分类树的每个节点（叶节点和内部节点）上附加轻量适配器，并采用两阶段训练：先训练子节点适配器，再训练祖先适配器仅建模未被子节点解释的残差视觉特征。
Result: 在三个大规模生物多样性基准上，TreeAdapter在细粒度生成质量上超越通用模型和领域特定基线，达到最优性能。
Conclusion: 通过显式利用层次分类学结构，TreeAdapter能有效生成稀有物种的准确视觉特征，并克服了通用模型和独立微调方法的局限性。
