papers.title: Integrating Factual and Normative Industrial Knowledge via Constraint-Aware Graph Attention for Process Plan Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Integrating heterogeneous industrial knowledge, including factual relations and decision constraints, remains a core challenge in industrial information systems. Machining process planning exemplifies this problem because engineers must select operations by combining material properties, feature characteristics, and quality requirements. Existing methods rely mainly on similarity retrieval or classification, without a unified ranking objective or standardized evaluation. We propose PCA-GAT, which formulates machining process plan recommendation as a knowledge graph enhanced collaborative filtering problem. Bayesian Personalized Ranking provides the learning objective, while Recall@K and NDCG@K define evaluation. The knowledge graph supplies semantic structure when collaborative signals are sparse. Four domain constraints, material compatibility, precision requirements, feature applicability, and operation sequencing, are introduced as attention biases during graph propagation. Type-specific weights learn their importance, and an adaptive gate adjusts their influence using local context. On a real aerospace dataset with 115 parts and 507 plans, PCA-GAT achieves Recall@1 = 0.9087 and strong cold-start robustness, with about half the degradation of the strongest baseline under severe sparsity. Ablation studies show that knowledge graph enrichment is essential, constraints add value, and ungated constraint injection can hurt performance. The learned weights identify material-operation compatibility as the dominant factor, consistent with domain expertise. Results on three public benchmarks show no degradation when constraints are absent, supporting generalization beyond manufacturing. This study establishes a standardized recommendation protocol for engineering process planning and benchmarks seven methods across three categories, showing that knowledge representation is the main bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PCA-GAT方法，将工艺过程规划推荐建模为知识图谱增强的协同过滤问题，通过约束感知图注意力网络融合事实与规范工业知识。在包含115个零件和507个计划的航空数据集上，Recall@1达到0.9087，并在稀疏场景下展现出强冷启动鲁棒性，退化程度仅为最强基线的一半。
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖相似性检索或分类，缺乏统一的排序目标和标准化评估；异构工业知识（事实关系与决策约束）的集成是工业信息系统的核心挑战。
Method: 将工艺规划推荐视为知识图谱增强的协同过滤，采用Bayesian Personalized Ranking作为学习目标，Recall@K和NDCG@K作为评估指标。在图中引入材料兼容性、精度要求、特征适用性和操作排序四种领域约束作为注意力偏置，并通过自适应门控机制调整其影响，类型特定权重学习各约束的重要性。
Result: 在航空数据集上Recall@1=0.9087，严重稀疏下退化仅为最强基线的一半。消融实验表明知识图谱增强必不可少，约束有价值但无门控注入会降低性能，材料-操作兼容性是最重要因素。在三个公开基准上无降解。
Conclusion: 本研究为工程过程规划建立了标准化推荐协议，基准测试七种方法，表明知识表示是主要瓶颈。提出的方法可推广至制造业之外。

papers.title: Effect of User-Prompted Priors on Semi-Automated Cancer Lesion Segmentation in Whole-Body Computed Tomography
papers.abstract_en: In clinical oncology studies, metastatic cancer is commonly evaluated using "Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors" (RECIST), in which the diameter of up to five lesions is measured and followed over the course of treatment. However, RECIST shows limited correlation with overall survival. Total tumour volume (TTV) is a stronger predictor but typically relies on manual ground-truth segmentation of all lesions, which is time-consuming and requires expert domain knowledge. Semi-automated approaches leveraging user-prompted priors, such as bounding boxes and single-slice contours, as inputs to automated segmentation methods can facilitate the generation of ground-truth segmentations. This work investigates the impact of different user-prompted priors on semi-automated cancer lesion segmentation performance in whole-body computed tomography. Across 3-fold cross-validation and external testing, more complex spatial priors consistently improved performance, with contour priors from three orthogonal planes (axial, coronal and sagittal) achieving the best results. On the external test (n=3865 lesions), this approach achieved a mean Dice score of 0.882, compared to a mean Dice score of 0.671 for the baseline model with no spatial prior. These findings suggest that the use of multi-plane orthogonal user-prompted priors can improve semi-automated tumour lesion segmentation and support efficient generation of high-quality volumetric ground-truth data.
papers.comment: Accepted at MIUA (Medical Image Understanding and Analysis). To appear in Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS). 12 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不同用户提示先验（边界框、单切片轮廓、三正交平面轮廓）对半自动癌症病变分割性能的影响。在全身CT数据上，使用三正交平面轮廓先验在外部测试集（n=3865病变）上达到平均Dice 0.882，显著优于无先验基线（0.671）。结果表明多平面正交先验可提升分割质量并支持高效生成体素级真值数据。
Motivation: RECIST评估与总生存期相关性有限，而总肿瘤体积是更强预测因子但手动分割耗时，需半自动方法辅助生成高质量真值。
Method: 比较不同用户提示先验作为分割模型输入的效果，包括边界框、单切片轮廓和三正交平面（轴位、冠状位、矢状位）轮廓。
Result: 三正交平面轮廓先验在外部测试集上达到Dice 0.882，基线（无先验）为0.671，且更复杂先验一致提升性能。
Conclusion: 多平面正交用户提示先验可改善半自动肿瘤分割，为高效生成高质量体素真值数据提供有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Surgical Re-enactment for Operating Room Workflow Datasets
papers.abstract_en: The introduction of new technologies, such as surgical robots, is driving the vision of a connected, smart operating room (OR). However, realizing this vision requires a deep understanding of surgical workflows, which relies on realistic datasets capturing the actions of all OR personnel from both full room and surgical field perspectives. Acquiring such data in real ORs is prohibitively challenging due to factors such as ethics committee approvals, limited space for camera installation, and sterility regulations preventing the use of tracking markers. We present a step-by-step methodology for re-enacting complete surgical procedures in a reconstructed OR. This approach enables the creation of repeatable and annotatable workflow datasets for training activity recognition models, generating scene graphs, and formalizing surgical process models. Developed for robot-assisted ophthalmic surgery, our methodology combines expert consultation, structured workflow formalization, OR reconstruction, role-based training, real OR observation, and iterative recording with post-take debriefing. We provide concrete recommendations to allow other research groups to seamlessly adopt this methodology for their own surgical domains.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 4th "Robot-Assisted Medical Imaging" (RAMI) workshop as part of ICRA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在重建手术室中重演完整手术流程的方法，用于生成可重复和可标注的工作流数据集。该方法针对机器人辅助眼科手术开发，结合专家咨询、工作流形式化、OR重建、角色扮演训练和迭代录制，旨在为活动识别模型训练、场景图生成和手术过程模型形式化提供数据基础。作者还提供了具体建议以便其他研究组将其应用于自己的手术领域。
Motivation: 真实手术室中收集高质量工作流数据因伦理审批、空间限制和无菌规定极为困难，需要替代方案来获取可重复利用的数据集。
Method: 逐步重演方法：在重建手术室中模拟完整手术流程，包含专家咨询、结构化工作流形式化、OR重建、基于角色的训练、真实OR观察以及迭代录制与事后汇报。
Result: 该方法能够创建可重复和可标注的工作流数据集，用于训练活动识别模型、生成场景图以及形式化手术过程模型。摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的可迁移性，并提供了具体建议以便其他手术领域的研究组直接采用。

papers.title: Reasoning to Regulate: Chain-of-Thought for Traffic Rule Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and complying with traffic regulations is a safety-critical requirement for autonomous driving, yet remains challenging due to the diversity and context dependence of traffic signage. Importantly, regulation understanding is not a simple recognition task, but a reasoning problem: whether a rule applies depends on interpreting the sign in relation to the spatial layout of lanes and scene context. To support such reasoning, MapDR provide fine-grained annotations that link each traffic sign's regulatory rules to the specific lanes they govern. Existing methods, however, largely treat this as direct sequence prediction, ignoring the underlying reasoning that connects sign semantics and map structure. To address this limitation, we explicitly incorporate reasoning into this task and propose a framework that equips vision-language models (VLMs) with chain-of-thought (CoT) capabilities. We first design a scalable CoT curation pipeline that bootstraps rationales from a strong LLM through a two-round strategy and employs a VLM-based verifier to filter out incorrect cases, yielding a high-quality set of (CoT, answer) pairs. Building on this foundation, we adopt a two-stage training scheme: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to teach rationale-to-answer generation, followed by GRPO reinforcement learning with answer-grounded, fine-grained rewards to further improve final answer accuracy. Extensive experiments on MapDR show that our approach significantly improves both interpretability and accuracy, establishing the first reasoning-based framework for regulation-aware autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶中交通规则理解任务，提出将链式推理（CoT）融入视觉-语言模型（VLM）的框架。通过两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO）提升模型在MapDR数据集上的可解释性和准确性，首次建立基于推理的法规感知自动驾驶方法。
Motivation: 现有方法将交通规则理解视为直接序列预测，忽略了符号语义与地图结构之间的推理，导致识别效果有限，且缺乏可解释性。
Method: 设计CoT数据生成管线：利用LLM两轮生成推理过程，经VLM验证器筛选；采用SFT训练模型生成推理与答案，再通过GRPO强化学习以答案驱动的细粒度奖励优化最终答案。
Result: 在MapDR数据集上，该方法在准确率和可解释性上均显著优于现有序列预测方法。
Conclusion: 该框架证明将显式推理引入交通规则理解能够提升自动驾驶系统的安全性和可解释性，为法规感知提供新范式。

papers.title: Face Age Verification Vulnerabilities Under Simple Appearance Manipulations
papers.abstract_en: Online platforms increasingly rely on automated age estimation systems to enforce minimum-age policies. Focusing on vision-based models designed for this task, concerns arise regarding their robustness to simple appearance changes that underage individuals may use to bypass such systems, such as drawing a mustache or applying lipstick. In this work, we present a systematic study of age verification robustness by simulating visual alterations that can be easily achieved by underage individuals. We evaluate seven models, including vision, vision-language, and multimodal large language models, across three datasets and four manipulation types. Interestingly, under drawn beard stubble, up to 61% of True Negatives are flipped into False Positives. Furthermore, we investigate how different demographics are affected by such manipulations, finding that Indians are more affected by beard stubble manipulations, while females are more affected than males across all manipulations. Finally, we explore how these biases can be mitigated using bias mitigation methodologies in lightweight linear probe settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线平台年龄验证系统易受简单外观变化（如画胡子、涂口红）欺骗的问题，系统研究了7个模型（视觉、视觉-语言、多模态大语言模型）在3个数据集和4种操控类型下的鲁棒性。发现画胡子茬可使最多61%的真阴性样本变为假阳性，印度人和女性受影响更显著，并探索了轻量级线性探测下的偏差缓解方法。
Motivation: 现有年龄估计系统对未成年人通过简单化妆或画胡子等手段绕过年龄验证的鲁棒性缺乏系统研究。
Method: 模拟未成年人可轻松实现的视觉变化（如胡子茬、口红、胡须等），在多个年龄验证模型和数据集上进行评估，并尝试使用偏差缓解方法（如线性探测调整）来减少人口统计偏差。
Result: 画胡子茬操控下，最多61%的真阴性（正确分类为未成人）变为假阳性（错误分类为成年人）；印度人受胡子茬影响最大，女性在所有操控下受影响程度高于男性。
Conclusion: 简单外观操控对年龄验证模型构成严重威胁，且偏差存在人口群体差异，可通过偏差缓解方法部分缓解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-based Source Code Compression via Thresholded Symbol Ranking
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of lossless compression of source code, motivated by the storage demands of large-scale software archives, such as Software Heritage (https://www.softwareheritage.org/). General-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2) offer a good trade-off between compression ratio and speed, but fail to exploit all special regularities inherent in source code. Recent approaches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) within Shannon's symbol-ranking framework, relying on a scheme in which the predicted rank can grow arbitrarily. While effective at reducing space, this setting incurs significant throughput degradation, and leaves open the question whether it is necessary to explicitly encode all ranks. In this work, we introduce LLM-based compressors deploying two novel symbol-ranking variants that bound predictions to the top-$T$ ranks ($T=1$ or $63$), with out-of-threshold symbols stored as exceptions and compressed jointly with the rank stream via general-purpose compressors. We conduct the first large-scale evaluation of LLM-based source code compression across 30 LLMs, including general-domain, code-specialized, and quantized models. Our $T$-bounded approach outperforms prior LLM-based compressors both in compression ratio (up to 37% relative improvement) and compression throughput (40% faster). Compared to general-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2), we obtain up to 82% relative compression gain but at a lower speed, thus offering a new trade-off point in the compression-speed spectrum. We also show that these gains are stronger on source code than on natural language, suggesting an interesting indication, namely that source code exposes regularities captured by LLMs but missed by general-purpose exact-match-based compressors. We conclude by commenting on open problems that offer theoretical and practical avenues of research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的源代码无损压缩，提出阈值化符号排名（thresholded symbol ranking）方法，将预测限制在top-T排名（T=1或63），超出阈值的符号作为异常处理并与排名流联合压缩。在30个LLM上的大规模实验表明，该方法相比现有LLM压缩方法在压缩比（最高提升37%）和吞吐量（提升40%）上均有提升，相比通用压缩器（如zstd）压缩比提升最高达82%，但速度较慢。代码压缩的增益强于自然语言，表明源代码存在LLM可捕捉但通用压缩器忽略的规律性。
Motivation: 通用压缩器未能充分利用源代码的特殊规律性，而现有基于LLM的符号排名方法因预测排名无界导致吞吐量下降，且需对所有排显式编码。
Method: 提出两种阈值化符号排名变体，将LLM预测限制在top-T排名（T=1或63），超出阈值的符号作为异常存储，并与排名流一同使用通用压缩器（如zstd）进行联合压缩。
Result: 在30个LLM上的评估中，T-bounded方法相比先前LLM压缩方法实现了压缩比最高37%的相对提升和压缩吞吐量40%的提升；与通用压缩器（zstd, bzip2）相比，压缩比相对提升高达82%，但速度较慢。
Conclusion: 该方法在源代码上的压缩增益强于自然语言，表明源代码存在LLM可捕捉的规律性，但通用精确匹配压缩器无法利用。本文还指出了有待解决的理论与实践开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StanceFlip: A Comprehensive Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Conversational stance detection has shifted from static text analysis to dynamic multimodal modeling. However, existing benchmarks exhibit three key limitations: failure to capture the dynamic evolution of beliefs, particularly during stance reversals; difficulty in disentangling affective states from logical reasoning; and neglect of the critical role of multimodal cues in resolving pragmatic ambiguities such as sarcasm. To address these limitations, we propose StanceFlip, a benchmark designed for multimodal conversational stance flipping forecasting over multi-turn dialogues across five modalities and multi-scenarios, which includes two novel subtasks: 1) Multimodal Stance Sextuple Extraction, extracting holder, target, emotion, sentiment, stance, and rationale as static state snapshots of dialogue to capture fine-grained cognitive structures. 2) Dynamic Stance Flip Attribution, tracking stance reversals across the conversation and identifying their underlying triggers. Alongside the dataset, we propose a dedicated framework, named ConStaFF, for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting (MCSFF). Built upon a large language model, ConStaFF performs end-to-end stance reasoning, with a Thought-of-Stance (ToS) reasoning framework and a self-reflective verification mechanism integrated for structured stance modeling and faithful flip attribution. Specifically, ToS decomposes the reasoning process into specialized cognitive personas to formulate target propositions, resolve cross-modal conflicts, and infer historical stance trajectories. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both sextuple extraction and flip-trigger attribution, outperforming strong multimodal large language model baselines by substantial margins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StanceFlip基准，用于多模态对话立场翻转预测，包含两个子任务：多模态立场六元组提取和动态立场翻转归因。方法ConStaFF基于大语言模型，集成思维立场推理和自我反思验证机制，在多模态立场抽取和翻转归因上取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有对话立场检测基准存在三个局限：未能捕捉信念的动态演变（尤其是立场反转）；难以区分情感状态与逻辑推理；忽视多模态线索在解决语用歧义（如讽刺）中的关键作用。
Method: 构建StanceFlip基准，覆盖五种模态和多种场景，提出两个子任务：多模态立场六元组提取和动态立场翻转归因。提出ConStaFF框架，基于LLM进行端到端立场推理，包含思维立场推理和自我反思验证机制。
Result: 实验表明ConStaFF在六元组提取和翻转触发器归因上均达到最先进性能，显著超越强多模态大语言模型基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该基准和框架为多模态对话立场翻转预测提供了更全面的评估，有效利用了多模态线索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not Forgotten: Implementation and Evaluation of a Personalized Episodic Memory for the Humanoid Robot Head Kim
papers.abstract_en: Social robots that rely on large language models for conversation are unable to retain information across sessions. This absence of memory violates social expectations, potentially preventing the formation of persistent relationships. This paper presents a lightweight episodic memory module that integrates vector-based semantic retrieval with an LLM-controlled dialog system, deployed on the humanoid robot head Kim. The module employs a hybrid scoring function combining cosine similarity with a memory strength metric to retrieve contextually relevant past interactions and inject them into the generation prompt. The system was evaluated in a within-subjects video-based online study (N = 43) using the Human-Robot Interaction Evaluation Scale (HRIES). Results show that episodic memory significantly increased perceived sociability (d = 0.60, p < .001), with the strongest effects on perceived trustworthiness (d = 0.62) and warmth (d = 0.56). Perceived disturbance remained unchanged (d = 0.00), indicating that the implemented approach to personalized recall did not trigger privacy-related discomfort or uncanny valley effects. These findings suggest that episodic memory serves as a social lubricant in embodied Human-Robot Interaction, enhancing relational quality without eliciting negative affective responses.
papers.comment: Acceoted at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026) Kitakyushu, Japan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并实现了一个轻量级的情景记忆模块，集成到人形机器人头Kim中，通过向量语义检索和混合评分函数（余弦相似度+记忆强度指标）从对话中检索相关历史交互并注入生成提示。在43名受试者的视频在线研究中，使用HRIES量表评估，结果显示情景记忆显著提升了感知社交性（d=0.60, p<.001），尤其增强了可信赖感和温暖感，而未引起隐私不适或恐怖谷效应。
Motivation: 社会机器人依赖大型语言模型进行对话，但无法跨会话保留信息，这违背了社会期望，阻碍了持久关系的形成。
Method: 提出一个轻量级情景记忆模块，采用混合评分函数融合余弦相似度和记忆强度指标，检索与当前上下文相关的过去交互，并将其注入LLM的生成提示中。
Result: 在43名受试者的视频在线研究中，情景记忆显著提升了感知社交性（d=0.60, p<.001），对可信赖感（d=0.62）和温暖感（d=0.56）的影响最强，而感知干扰未变化（d=0.00）。
Conclusion: 情景记忆在具身人机交互中充当社交润滑剂，增强关系质量而不引发负面情感反应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Myopia Prevention and Control 3.0: Artificial Intelligence--Driven Risk Stratification, Proactive Monitoring, and Personalized Intervention
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI), digital sensing, and ubiquitous computing has created an unprecedented opportunity to transform myopia prevention from a reactive, population-based model into a proactive, precision-driven one. Despite evidence that half the world's population will be myopic by 2050, conventional approaches---school-based vision screening (Phase 1.0) and evidence-based risk factor management (Phase 2.0)---have proven insufficient. We review the emergence of Myopia Prevention and Control 3.0, defined by AI integration across three interconnected domains forming a closed-loop pipeline: (1) AI-driven risk stratification predicting individual-level risk through machine learning on multimodal data; (2) AI-enabled proactive monitoring via wearables, smartphones, and school screening networks; and (3) AI-powered personalized intervention with closed-loop feedback. We critically evaluate evidence across each stage, discuss challenges in data quality, model validation, ethics, and equity, and outline future directions including multimodal foundation models, digital twins, and causal machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了人工智能驱动的近视预防与控制3.0框架，该框架整合了AI在风险分层、主动监测和个性化干预三个领域的应用，形成一个闭环流程。文章评估了各阶段的证据，并讨论了数据质量、模型验证、伦理公平等挑战，同时展望了多模态基础模型、数字孪生和因果机器学习等未来方向。
Motivation: 传统近视防控方法（校园筛查和风险因素管理）已被证明不足以应对全球近视率持续上升的趋势，因此需要更精准、主动的AI驱动方法。
Method: 提出Myopia Prevention and Control 3.0框架，包括三个核心领域：1) 基于机器学习的多模态数据个体风险预测；2) 利用可穿戴设备、智能手机和校园筛查网络的主动监测；3) 具有闭环反馈的个性化干预。
Result: 综述了各阶段的证据，指出当前挑战包括数据质量、模型验证、伦理和公平性问题。
Conclusion: 未来方向包括多模态基础模型、数字孪生和因果机器学习，以进一步提升近视防控的精准性和主动性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LCMamNet: A Lightweight Cross-scale Mamba Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is important for low-altitude perception, unmanned-system warning, and security monitoring. However, weak targets in infrared imagery usually occupy only a few pixels and are easily submerged by cloud clutter, ground edges, and bright noise, making it difficult for lightweight segmentation-based methods to preserve local target structures while suppressing background interference. To address these challenges, we propose LCMamNet, a lightweight cross-scale Mamba network that progressively enhances local target structures, interacts cross-scale context in a latent space, and restores spatial details with background suppression. Specifically, a compact hierarchical encoder with cross-shaped directional bottleneck residual (CDBR) blocks strengthens direction-sensitive target structures under a small computation budget. A latent dense cross-scale fusion (LDCF) module then performs dense all-level interaction through bidirectional Mamba modeling and reorganizes the interacted features into stable hierarchical semantics. Finally, a progressive decoder selectively recovers shallow spatial details while suppressing irrelevant background textures. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1k, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST show that the proposed network achieves mIoU scores of 71.25\%, 79.60\%, and 95.58\%, respectively, with only 1.175M parameters and 6.91 GFLOPs. It also runs with a mean inference latency of 6.62 ms, and deployment results on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16G SUPER further demonstrate its practical potential for real-time edge inference. The code and checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/Haoyu096/LCMamNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LCMamNet，一种轻量级跨尺度Mamba网络，用于红外小目标检测。通过紧凑层次编码器、潜在密集跨尺度融合模块和渐进解码器，在低参数量（1.175M）和计算量（6.91 GFLOPs）下，在IRSTD-1k、NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST数据集上达到71.25%、79.60%、95.58%的mIoU，推理延迟6.62ms，并在Jetson Orin NX上验证了实时边缘部署能力。
Motivation: 红外弱小目标仅占少量像素，易被云杂波、地面边缘和亮噪声淹没，轻量级分割方法难以同时保留局部目标结构和抑制背景干扰。
Method: 提出LCMamNet，包含：1）紧凑层次编码器，使用十字形状方向瓶颈残差（CDBR）块增强方向敏感目标结构；2）潜在密集跨尺度融合（LDCF）模块，通过双向Mamba建模进行密集全层次交互并重组为稳定层次语义；3）渐进解码器，选择性恢复浅层空间细节并抑制无关背景纹理。

papers.title: Monitoring Post-Disaster Urban Recovery Using High-Resolution SAR Time Series and Unsupervised Learning: Evidence from the 2023 Türkiye-Syria Earthquake
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring post-disaster recovery is essential for understanding how urban systems rebuild and progressively return to functionality. However, tracking reconstruction remains difficult because reliable ground-truth information is often scarce and recovery processes evolve over time. This paper proposes an unsupervised framework for recovery monitoring based on multi-temporal synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations and deep-learning anomaly detection. COSMO-SkyMed time series are used to identify persistent temporal anomalies associated with reconstruction activities and to generate spatially explicit recovery maps. The framework is applied to four cities severely affected by the 2023 Turkiye-Syria earthquakes, revealing heterogeneous reconstruction dynamics across different urban contexts. The results show spatially structured patterns of persistent anomalies related to reconstruction over damaged and cleared areas, temporary container settlements, and new residential districts. Comparison with nighttime-light recovery indicators derived from SDGSAT-1 data highlights the complementary nature of the two modalities: nighttime lights reflect the restoration of electricity supply and nighttime socioeconomic activity, whereas SAR anomalies capture structural changes in the built environment and may reveal reconstruction at earlier stages. The results demonstrate that multi-temporal SAR data combined with unsupervised learning provide an effective and scalable approach for monitoring post-disaster reconstruction when labeled recovery datasets are unavailable.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing (JSTARS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多时相合成孔径雷达（SAR）影像和深度学习异常检测的无监督框架，用于监测灾后城市恢复。利用COSMO-SkyMed时序数据识别与重建活动相关的持续性时间异常，生成空间显式的恢复图。应用于2023年土耳其-叙利亚地震的四个城市，揭示了不同城市语境下的异质重建动态，并与SDGSAT-1夜间灯光恢复指标进行互补分析。
Motivation: 灾后恢复监测因地面真值稀缺且恢复过程随时间演变而困难，现有方法依赖标记数据，缺乏可扩展的无监督方案。
Method: 采用无监督学习框架，基于COSMO-SkyMed多时相SAR影像和深度学习异常检测，识别与重建活动相关的持久性时间异常，生成恢复图。
Result: 在2023年土耳其-叙利亚地震的四个城市中，该框架揭示了受损区域清理、临时集装箱安置区和新住宅区等重建相关的持久性时空异常模式；与SDGSAT-1夜间灯光数据比较显示，SAR异常更早捕获结构变化，夜间灯光反映电力和社会经济恢复，两者互补。
Conclusion: 多时相SAR数据结合无监督学习可在无标记恢复数据集时有效、可扩展地监测灾后重建。

papers.title: EXE-Bench: Ranking the Tradeoffs of AI-based Windows Malware Detectors for Real-World Usability
papers.abstract_en: Due to the lack of systematic evaluations, we are not yet able to determine which AI-based Windows malware detector to deploy in production, since existing evaluations (i) differ in terms of data used for both training and testing; (ii) do not consider temporal analysis to showcase whether models withstand the passage of time; (iii) avoid security evaluations with adversarial attacks that could highlight their brittleness against content-injection attacks; and (iv) neglect the computational requirements for deployment, risking slow inference on endpoints. For these reasons, we develop EXE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark of AI-based Windows malware detectors. EXE-Bench assesses performance, temporal and adversarial robustness, and computational overhead, aggregating them into a single score for direct and fair model comparison. Through EXE-Bench, we highlight how evaluations conducted only after deployment are suboptimal and unable to provide a complete picture of their performance. In particular, through our analysis, we remark how much domain knowledge instilled through feature engineering is still extremely useful in this domain, resisting both time and adversarial attacks, in stark contrast with most of the deep networks that only excel right after deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EXE-Bench，一个综合基准，用于评估基于 AI 的 Windows 恶意软件检测器的性能、时间鲁棒性、对抗鲁棒性和计算开销，并通过单一分数进行直接比较。分析表明，部署后进行的评估不全面，而特征工程注入的领域知识在抵抗时间和对抗攻击方面仍然有效，这与多数仅在部署后表现优异的深度网络形成对比。
Motivation: 现有的 AI 恶意软件检测器评估存在数据不一致、缺乏时间分析、忽略对抗攻击和计算开销等问题，导致无法确定部署哪个检测器。
Method: 开发 EXE-Bench 基准，综合评估性能、时间鲁棒性、对抗鲁棒性和计算开销，并聚合为单一分数。
Result: 通过 EXE-Bench 分析发现，部署后评估是次优的；特征工程注入的领域知识在抵抗时间和对抗攻击方面非常有效，而深度网络仅在部署后表现优异。
Conclusion: 强调综合评估的重要性，并指出领域知识仍然关键。

papers.title: Where Quality Breaks in Compressed Short-Text Generation: Staged Bottleneck Localization
papers.abstract_en: Compressed short-text generators can fail in two different places: the codec may discard information before generation starts, or the latent generator may produce weak codes. Without separating these failure modes, researchers can spend compute improving the wrong component. We study this problem in a controlled 64-to-16 TinyStories case study built from a hierarchical VQ-VAE-2 codec and a masked discrete diffusion generator (MDLM). We use a staged validation protocol that separates codec reconstruction fidelity, latent generation quality, and auxiliary latent diagnostics under one shared external GPT-2 scorer, while reporting complementary semantic metrics for the geometry study. In the tested configuration, codec reconstruction alone raises median external perplexity from 15.17 to 27.36 (+80.4%) and p95 from 25.10 to 98.91 (+294.1%), showing that the dominant quality loss appears before latent generation begins. Under the same scorer, code-space MDLM remains materially stronger than token-space diffusion, reducing mean, median, and p95 by 32.9%, 30.9%, and 36.6%, respectively. Geometry-aware regularization improves local latent proxies but does not improve decoded-text metrics in the available runs. The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: the paper presents a reusable staged diagnosis for one concrete pipeline and shows that, in this setting, codec fidelity rather than latent denoising sets the practical quality ceiling.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Published in the Proceedings of FRUCT'39
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 39th Conference of the Open Innovations Association FRUCT (FRUCT'39), 2026, pp. 69-76
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究压缩短文本生成中的质量瓶颈定位，通过分层VQ-VAE-2编码器和掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM）在TinyStories数据集上的实验，发现编码器重建是主要质量损失来源（重建后困惑度增加80.4%），而非潜在生成器。贡献在于提出可复现的阶段性诊断方法，而非新算法。
Motivation: 压缩短文本生成器可能在编码器或潜在生成器两个环节失效，但现有研究未能分离故障模式，导致计算资源浪费在改进错误组件上。
Method: 采用分阶段验证协议，在共享GPT-2评分器下分离编码器重建保真度、潜在生成质量和辅助潜在诊断，同时报告语义指标。
Result: 编码器重建使中位外部困惑度从15.17升至27.36（+80.4%），p95从25.10升至98.91（+294.1%）；码空间MDLM在均值、中位、p95上分别比令牌空间扩散低32.9%、30.9%、36.6%；几何正则化改善局部潜在代理但未改善解码文本指标。
Conclusion: 在此设置下，编码器保真度而非潜在去噪是实际质量瓶颈；方法贡献是提供一种可复用的阶段性诊断框架。

papers.title: Forecasting the Emergence and Evolution of Crash Hotspots: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Proactive Traffic Safety
papers.abstract_en: Road crashes remain among the gravest threats to public safety, and preventing them is a defining task of transportation systems worldwide. Much of that harm concentrates at hotspots, yet a hotspot is less a place than an episode; it emerges quietly at an intersection or along an arterial, intensifies for weeks, then subsides, only to reappear elsewhere. Enforcement guided by maps of past crashes inevitably trails this cycle, patrolling yesterday's hotspots while tomorrow's form unwatched. Breaking that lag requires three capabilities at once: detecting hotspots as they are born, forecasting where they will sit next week, and following each one through its life. We introduce HERALD (Hotspot Emergence, Risk Anticipation, and Life-cycle Dynamics), a unified deep learning framework that provides all three from a single statewide model. HERALD distills each county's recent crash history into weekly risk maps and forecasts the next with a CNN--Transformer, whose mixture-of-experts lets one model serve dense urban cores and sparse rural corridors alike. Each forecast is anchored in the county's long-run crash geography, sharpened by the self-exciting effect of recent crashes, and paired with explicit warnings of where new hotspots are about to appear. Followed over time, every hotspot acquires a legible life story, from birth through growth and stability to decline and death. Across six heterogeneous Wisconsin counties, HERALD forecasts more accurately than five identically trained baselines, locates hotspots most precisely, and flags emerging risks before they take hold. A single adjustable setting trades accuracy for extra sensitivity where deployment demands it. The result shifts hotspot management from mapping the past to anticipating the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一深度学习框架 HERALD，用于预测交通事故热点（hotspots）的涌现与演化。该框架结合 CNN-Transformer 架构与混合专家模型（MoE），从历史事故数据生成每周风险图，并预测下一周的热点分布，同时追踪每个热点从诞生到消亡的生命周期。在威斯康星州六个县的数据上，HERALD 在热点定位和风险评估方面优于五个基线模型。
Motivation: 传统交通执法基于过去事故的热力图滞后于实际风险演变，无法主动预警即将出现的热点。现有方法缺乏同时检测新热点、预测未来位置并追踪其生命周期演化的一体化能力。
Method: HERALD 将县级事故历史压缩为周风险图，通过 CNN-Transformer 编码时空依赖，并用混合专家模型（MoE）适应不同密度区域（城市与乡村）。预测中融合长期地理分布、自激发效应（self-exciting effect）及热点涌现预警，最后利用时间序列为每个热点标注生命周期阶段（诞生、成长、稳定、衰退、消亡）。
Result: 在威斯康星州六个异构县上，HERALD 在热点定位精度和风险预测准确性上均优于五个相同训练设置的基线方法，并能提前识别新兴风险。模型还提供一个可调节参数，允许在部署时权衡精度与灵敏度。
Conclusion: 该框架将事故热点管理从被动映射历史转变为主动预测未来，但实验仅基于单一州的数据，跨区域泛化性有待验证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Falsifiable Commitment Planning for Self-Correcting Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon web agents often go off track before final failure: a trajectory can remain locally plausible even after the current state, reused skill, or plan assumption no longer supports the user instruction. Existing agents can plan, reflect, or reuse experience, but their plans rarely specify the evidence under which an active step should still be trusted. We propose FCPAgent, a falsifiable commitment planning framework for robust long-horizon web agents. FCPAgent represents each plan step as a Falsifiable Commitment Unit (FCU): a subgoal grounded in a reusable skill, together with confirming evidence, falsifying evidence, and a confidence score. Execution is organized as a plan-test-repair loop. The hybrid commitment testing module checks candidate actions before they modify the browser and checks observations after execution; for efficiency, it combines lightweight evidence matching with LLM-based diagnostic verification. When evidence falsifies a commitment, scope-aware repair localizes the contradiction to the execution, skill, or planning level and revises the smallest adequate part. On WebArena, FCPAgent achieves a 13.8% relative improvement in average success over the strongest baseline, with especially large gains on long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FCPAgent，一个基于可证伪承诺规划（falsifiable commitment planning）的框架，用于自我纠正的长期web agents。它将每个计划步骤表示为可证伪承诺单元（FCU），包含子目标、确认证据、证伪证据和置信度。通过计划-测试-修复循环执行，结合轻量级证据匹配和LLM诊断验证。在WebArena上相比最强基线平均成功相对提升13.8%，尤其在长时域任务上增益显著。
Motivation: 现有web agents在长期任务中容易偏离轨道，而现有方法（规划、反思、经验重用）很少明确指定在何种证据下当前步骤应被信任。
Method: 提出FCPAgent，每个步骤表示为FCU，包含子目标、可重用技能、确认/证伪证据和置信度。执行过程为计划-测试-修复循环：混合承诺测试模块在动作前检查候选动作，并在动作后检查观测；结合轻量级证据匹配和LLM诊断验证。当证据证伪承诺时，作用域感知修复将矛盾定位到执行、技能或规划层面并修订最小足够部分。
Result: 在WebArena基准上，平均成功相对提升13.8%，长时域任务上增益显著。

papers.title: Do Current Retrievers Cover All the Evidence? A Controlled Study of Conjunctive Cross-Page Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Finding a long document relevant to a multi-part request is not the same as establishing that it contains every requested piece of evidence. We study this gap for conjunctive document retrieval, where two or three explicit conditions must be supported on different pages of one document. We use n-Clue as a controlled measurement instrument: 1{,}000 queries over 2{,}021 documents pair all-condition golds with naturally occurring documents that satisfy only a subset, and a complete-first success requires a top-10 gold to precede every released subset qrel. Across 70 configurations, condition-wise decomposition improves two dense backbones by 6.8--7.3 points and lexical--visual fusion adds 8.7, while four generic rerankers all reduce Gold-NDCG; these directions replicate on a four-source stress set. Scaling one dense family from 0.6B to 8B changes complete-first success by 0.0 points. The strongest displayed hybrid illustrates the resulting gap: it finds a gold for 81.1\% of queries but succeeds complete-first on only 35.8\%, and the gap persists across condition count, target length, candidate density, query rendering, and the four-source stress set. Finally, page-aware visual systems surface stored support for every condition on only 5.1--5.3\% of queries. These results identify condition coverage, rather than gold discovery alone, as the central bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多条件文档检索中，检索器能否覆盖所有证据的问题。使用n-Clue作为控制测量工具，发现条件覆盖而非黄金文档发现是主要瓶颈。实验表明条件分解和词汇-视觉融合能改善性能，但缩放模型大小无帮助。
Motivation: 现有检索器评估关注是否找到相关文档，而非是否覆盖所有条件证据。本文针对多条件文档检索，研究检索器是否能真正满足所有条件。
Method: 使用n-Clue数据集（1000个查询，2021个文档），设计控制实验，比较不同检索器和重排序器在条件完全覆盖上的表现。
Result: 条件分解提升密集检索器6.8-7.3点，词汇-视觉融合提升8.7点；通用重排序器降低Gold-NDCG；模型规模从0.6B到8B无改善；最佳混合方法在81.1%查询中找到金标准，但仅35.8%完全覆盖。
Conclusion: 条件覆盖是检索的主要瓶颈，而非仅发现相关文档。

papers.title: Agent-UCT: Upper Confidence Bounds Applied to Trees for Agentic Workflow Optimization with Cost-Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing agentic workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, requires navigating a combinatorial space of discrete component choices under tight evaluation budgets. Existing approaches - heuristic search, black-box optimization, and standard tree search methods - do not explicitly exploit the compositional structure of these workflows, leading to redundant computation and inefficient budget allocation. We introduce Agent-UCT (Agent-based Cost-Aware Upper Confidence Bounds Applied to Trees), a tree search algorithm that extends UCT with a reuse-aware regularization term derived from a bipartite prefix reuse graph. Agent-UCT biases selection toward branches that leverage previously materialized configuration prefixes, reducing redundant execution while maintaining effective exploration. Our framework, RAGSpace, unifies heterogeneous RAG components from LongRAG, LightRAG, and Self-RAG into a five-dimensional configuration space, enabling systematic cross-framework recombination. WTB (Workflow Test Bench) provides deterministic replay, content-addressable caching, and transactional consistency, ensuring that intermediate states are materialized once and reused across the search. Experiments on HotpotQA and UltraDomain demonstrate that Agent-UCT identifies configurations with the highest out-of-sample performance among the evaluated fixed framework presets. Under full-pool evaluation, bipartite prefix reuse reduces logical search cost by 73.6% relative to the no-prefix-sharing cost upper bound. Compared with full-pool evaluation, sampling-based evaluation further achieves a 4.2x wall-clock speedup. Agent-UCT, RAGSpace, and WTB together provide a unified framework for cost-aware, reproducible, and compositionally efficient agentic workflow optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agent-UCT，一种扩展UCT的树搜索算法，用于优化代理工作流（如RAG管道），通过重用前缀图来减少冗余计算。作者构建了RAGSpace统一框架和WTB测试平台，在HotpotQA和UltraDomain上实验，表明Agent-UCT在固定预设下找到了最高性能配置，并且前缀重用降低了73.6%的逻辑搜索成本，采样评估加速4.2倍。
Motivation: 现有方法（启发式搜索、黑箱优化、标准树搜索）不能利用工作流的组合结构，导致冗余计算和低效预算分配。
Method: 提出Agent-UCT，引入重用感知正则化项（基于二分前缀重用图），偏向选择利用已计算前缀的分支；同时构建RAGSpace统一配置空间，WTB提供确定性重放和缓存。
Result: 在HotpotQA和UltraDomain上，Agent-UCT识别出最高性能配置；前缀重用降低73.6%搜索成本，采样评估实现4.2倍加速。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了成本感知、可复现、组合高效的代理工作流优化统一框架。

papers.title: Calibrated Tree-Neural Fusion for Fine-Grained Vegetation Community Classification
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vegetation-community classification is essential for ecological monitoring, habitat assessment, and evidence-based environmental management in heterogeneous landscapes. Existing studies often rely on standalone tree ensembles or generic neural networks, although fine-grained ecological classes frequently exhibit overlapping spectral, topographic, and structural characteristics. Many frameworks also provide limited protection against stacking leakage, insufficient probability calibration, weak minority-class evaluation, and little evidence of stability across repeated data splits. To address these limitations, this study proposes Calibrated EcoTreeFuseNet-Plus, a tree-neural probability-fusion framework that combines out-of-fold tree probabilities, EcoFuseNet-V2 outputs, validation-selected meta-learning, and post-hoc temperature scaling. Raster values from six LiDAR-derived terrain and canopy variables and two hyperspectral vegetation indices were extracted at coordinate-based reference locations. Quality control removed 26 samples with missing elevation and one sample with non-finite NDWI, producing 1,833 complete records across 29 vegetation and non-vegetation classes. On the held-out test set, the proposed model achieved an accuracy of 0.8000, a macro F1-score of 0.7768, a balanced accuracy of 0.7903, and an MCC of 0.7903. Calibration reduced the expected calibration error from 0.3866 to 0.0651 without changing class predictions. Five-seed evaluation yielded a macro F1-score of 0.7717 +/- 0.0112, indicating stable performance across repeated splits. The results demonstrate a reliable discrimination-calibration trade-off for small-sample, fine-grained ecological classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Calibrated EcoTreeFuseNet-Plus，一种融合树模型与神经网络的概率校准框架，用于精细尺度植被群落分类。在1,833个样本、29个类别的高光谱与LiDAR数据集上，测试集准确率0.8000，宏F1为0.7768，校准误差从0.3866降至0.0651。五折重复评估显示稳定性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理光谱重叠、样本量小、类别不平衡的精细植被分类时，存在堆叠泄露、概率校准不足和稳定性差的问题。
Method: 提出树-神经概率融合框架：结合出折树概率、EcoFuseNet-V2输出、验证选择的元学习以及事后温度缩放。从LiDAR地形/冠层变量和高光谱植被指数中提取栅格值，经质量控制得到1,833条完整记录。
Result: 测试集准确率0.8000，宏F1 0.7768，平衡准确率0.7903，MCC 0.7903。校准误差从0.3866降至0.0651。五折宏F1为0.7717±0.0112。
Conclusion: 该方法在细粒度小样本生态分类中实现了可靠的区分度-校准权衡。

papers.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
papers.abstract_en: Generalizable robot manipulation requires policies that can anticipate how visual scenes evolve while executing language instructions. While recent Vision-Language-Action models benefit from large-scale pretraining, their predominantly static pretraining objectives provide limited supervision for physical dynamics and temporal causality, leaving control-relevant knowledge to be learned from downstream robot demonstrations. Video generative models offer a promising foundation by encoding rich spatiotemporal priors through future predictions. However, existing Video-Action Models either couple video and action prediction in a shared backbone, making policy adaptation harder to optimize, or under-utilize video information when guiding the action branch. In this work, we introduce DeVA, a Decoupled Video-Action model with specialized video and action experts, multi-level feature transfer, and physically salient guidance. DeVA transfers representations from multiple video layers to the action expert, enabling rich information exchange while making policy learning more tractable. It further supervises intermediate video features and the action stream with physically salient guidance (affordance/depth). Experiments on both simulation benchmarks and real-world deployment demonstrate strong performance with limited data, faster convergence than a unified architecture, and clear performance gains from physical guidance.
papers.comment: Project page with videos, code, and checkpoints: https://deva-model.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeVA，一种解耦的视频-动作模型，用于机器人策略学习。该模型包含专门的视频和动作专家模块，通过多层次特征传输和物理显著引导（如 affordance/depth 信息），在有限数据下实现强性能和更快收敛。实验在仿真和真实场景中验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型依赖静态预训练目标，缺乏对物理动态和时间因果性的监督，而视频生成模型虽能编码时空先验，但现有视频-动作模型要么将视频和动作预测耦合在共享主干中导致策略优化困难，要么在引导动作分支时未充分利用视频信息。
Method: 提出解耦架构 DeVA，包含独立的视频专家和动作专家，从视频多层传递特征，并结合物理显著引导（affordance/depth）监督中间视频特征和动作流。
Result: 在仿真基准和真实部署中，有限数据下表现强，相比统一架构收敛更快，且物理引导带来明显性能提升。
Conclusion: 解耦的视频-动作架构结合物理引导能有效提升机器人策略学习的样本效率和泛化能力。

papers.title: UniGen-AR: Unifying Visual Generation with Auto-Regressive Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Modern computer vision pipelines remain fragmented, with tasks such as text-to-image generation, editing, restoration, and classical perception handled by separate models. We study Unified Visual Generation (UVG), where a single model produces diverse image-valued outputs through a unified multimodal interface. While diffusion-based systems dominate UVG due to strong quality and controllability, their iterative sampling incurs substantial inference latency, limiting practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose UniGen-AR, a framework that pairs a general-purpose multi-modal language model (MLLM) with an efficient next-scale visual auto-regressive (VAR) decoder. This design retains the flexibility of MLLM-based conditioning while leveraging the sampling efficiency and latent unification properties of VAR models. In our framework, the MLLM encodes free-form instructions and control signals into a unified sequence, which guides the VAR decoder to generate image-valued outputs for over 15 tasks spanning four families. Empirically, UniGen-AR achieves up to $19 \times$ lower inference latency than diffusion-based baselines while maintaining or improving output quality. Our ablations further reveal that VQ-VAE tokenizer design, particularly codebook size and hierarchy, is a critical factor for VAR scalability in UVG. These results establish visual auto-regressive modeling as a compelling and efficient backbone for unified visual generation. Our project page is at https://zpbao.github.io/projects/unigenar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniGen-AR框架，将通用多模态语言模型（MLLM）与高效的下一尺度视觉自回归（VAR）解码器结合，实现统一视觉生成（UVG）。该方法通过MLLM编码自由形式指令和控制信号，由VAR解码器生成图像输出，覆盖15种以上任务。实验表明，相比扩散基线，推理延迟降低高达19倍，同时保持或改善输出质量。消融实验揭示VQ-VAE tokenizer设计（尤其是码本大小和层级）是VAR在UVG中可扩展性的关键因素。
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉流程碎片化，文本到图像生成、编辑、恢复和经典感知等任务由不同模型处理，而扩散模型虽质量强但迭代采样导致推理延迟大，限制了实际部署。本文旨在通过单一模型实现统一视觉生成并提高推理效率。
Method: 提出UniGen-AR，将通用多模态语言模型（MLLM）与下一尺度视觉自回归（VAR）解码器配对。MLLM将自由形式指令和控制信号编码为统一序列，引导VAR解码器生成图像输出，支持包括文本到图像、编辑、恢复等15种以上任务。采用VQ-VAE tokenizer进行图像离散化。
Result: UniGen-AR在推理延迟上比扩散基线降低高达19倍，同时输出质量相当或更优。消融实验表明VQ-VAE tokenizer设计（尤其是码本大小和层级）是VAR在统一视觉生成中可扩展性的关键因素。
Conclusion: 本文结论指出视觉自回归建模（VAR）可作为统一视觉生成的强大且高效的骨干，兼具MLLM的灵活性和VAR的采样效率与潜在统一特性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文结论指出视觉自回归建模（VAR）可作为统一视觉生成的强大且高效的骨干，兼具MLLM的灵活性和VAR的采样效率与潜在统一特性。

papers.title: A Motion-Aware Vector Quantization Framework with Centroid Reuse for Efficient VLA Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong potential for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency on GPUs limits real-time deployment. Existing accelerators, such as Dadu-Corki, improve efficiency but treat VLA models as full-precision workloads, leaving substantial redundancy in both memory and computation underexploited. In this paper, we propose VQVLA, an algorithm-hardware co-design framework that accelerates VLA inference by exploiting weight similarity and execution dynamics. We first introduce MotionVQ, a motion-aware vector quantization scheme that dynamically adjusts quantization precision based on the robot's execution state, reducing memory access while preserving task success rate. We then propose a merged-centroid vectorized GEMM paradigm that operates on the codebook-index representation, eliminating redundant multiplications through spatial aggregation and temporal reuse of centroids. To realize these optimizations, we design an accelerator that efficiently supports dynamic precision selection and centroid-reuse computation. Experimental results show that VQVLA achieves 6.5x, 2.8x, 1.9x, 3.3x, and 4.3x speedup over the A100 GPU, Dadu-Corki, LUT-DLA, CodeGEMM, and ShiftAddLLM, respectively, with negligible accuracy degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VQVLA，一种算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过运动感知向量量化（MotionVQ）和合并质心向量化GEMM范式来加速VLA模型推理。MotionVQ根据机器人执行状态动态调整量化精度，合并质心范式消除冗余乘法。加速器支持动态精度选择和质心重用。实验表明，相比A100 GPU等基准，VQVLA获得6.5x、2.8x、1.9x、3.3x、4.3x加速，精度损失可忽略。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在GPU上推理延迟高，现有加速器如Dadu-Corki未利用模型中的权重相似性和执行动态冗余。

Result: 相比A100 GPU、Dadu-Corki、LUT-DLA、CodeGEMM、ShiftAddLLM分别实现6.5x、2.8x、1.9x、3.3x、4.3x加速，精度损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确局限性，但强调通过算法-硬件协同设计利用权重相似性和执行动态可显著加速VLA推理。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Feature Selection Granularity
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection aims to identify the most informative and relevant features for a given dataset, either in terms of capturing the underlying data structure and distribution better, or with respect to the performance on a downstream task. Existing research in this area has largely focused on developing novel algorithms (in both supervised and unsupervised settings), proposing new evaluation metrics and frameworks, or benchmarking the performance of existing methods. In this work, we examine feature selection through an algorithmic design perspective. Conventional feature selection algorithms typically compute feature importance scores globally across the entire feature set and then select the top-ranked features in a single step. However, this approach raises a critical question: Can the presence of less informative (or noisy) features mask or obscure the true importance of other, more relevant features? In other words, would a recursive strategy, where features are removed one by one while re-evaluating importance at each step, yield different and potentially better results than the standard global ranking approach? To answer this question, we conduct an extensive empirical study using five diverse feature selection algorithms. We implement each algorithm under both the conventional global selection design and the greedy recursive elimination design. We then analyze the impact of this algorithmic choice, both individually for each method and collectively across all methods, on a range of standard feature selection evaluation metrics. The empirical evaluation results show that the greedy approach improves the overall feature selection quality almost consistently, albeit on the expense of higher computational cost, supporting our initial expectation that the curse of dimensionality also obscures the ways of mitigating it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究比较了特征选择的两种策略：全局一次性排名与贪心递归消除。使用五种特征选择算法，在多个标准评估指标上测试，发现贪心递归方法几乎一致地提高了特征选择质量，但计算成本更高。
Motivation: 现有特征选择算法通常全局计算重要性后一次性选择顶部特征，但噪声特征可能掩盖其他特征的真实重要性。本文质疑递归逐个移除并重新评估重要性的策略是否更优。
Method: 对五种不同特征选择算法分别实现全局一次性选择设计和贪心递归消除设计，并在标准特征选择评估指标上进行对比分析。
Result: 贪心递归方法在几乎所有情况下都提升了特征选择质量，但代价是更高的计算开销。
Conclusion: 研究支持高维诅咒也会掩盖缓解高维问题的途径这一初始预期，即递归策略能更有效地处理特征间交互。

papers.title: Image Inpainting via Stochastic Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Image inpainting aims to recover missing regions while preserving structural consistency. We propose a non-parametric method without network training based on data-guided stochastic dynamics. Starting from a masked image, the missing pixels are evolved through a reverse-time stochastic differential equation with a kernel-weighted correction estimated directly from a reference dataset. This empirical correction guides the reconstruction toward high-density regions of the data distribution without training a neural network or fitting a parametric density model. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and MVTec show that the proposed method outperforms Mean Fill, Telea, and Navier-Stokes inpainting in PSNR, SSIM, and visual quality. On CelebA, it remains competitive and produces plausible completions for structure-sensitive occlusions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of empirical reference statistics as a non-parametric prior for image inpainting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数据引导随机动力学的非参数图像修复方法，无需网络训练。通过反向时间随机微分方程，利用参考数据集的核加权修正指导缺失像素重建。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和MVTec上，PSNR、SSIM和视觉质量优于均值填充、Telea和Navier-Stokes方法；在CelebA上表现有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法依赖大量训练数据和参数化模型，而传统非参数方法（如Telea、Navier-Stokes）在结构复杂区域效果有限。本文探索利用参考数据集经验统计作为非参数先验进行图像修复。
Method: 提出逆时随机微分方程，其中漂移项由参考数据集上的核加权经验分布修正直接估计，无需神经网络训练或参数密度建模。
Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、MVTec上，PSNR和SSIM优于均值填充、Telea和Navier-Stokes方法；在CelebA上保持竞争力，对结构敏感遮挡产生合理补全。
Conclusion: 经验参考统计可作为有效的非参数先验用于图像修复，尤其在缺乏训练数据或需要即插即用场景下具有潜力。

papers.title: LoTA-N2N: Local Trace Adaptation for Zero-Shot Self-Supervised Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Single-image self-supervised denoising replaces unavailable clean targets with surrogate targets constructed from noisy observations. Its effectiveness therefore depends on how closely the surrogate objective remains aligned with supervised denoising, especially when noise is correlated, spatially nonstationary, or unknown. We express the discrepancy between a broad class of MSE-based self-supervised objectives and supervised MSE as a parameter-independent constant and a trace interaction between the surrogate-target residual and the prediction error. The corresponding gradient discrepancy is determined by the gradient of this interaction. This formulation provides a common view of paired-noise, blind-spot, weak-noise, re-corruption, and sub-image methods, while revealing that a small global interaction may conceal substantial positive and negative regional interactions through spatial cancellation. Building on these observations, we propose LoTA-N2N, a two-stage zero-shot adaptation framework. Stage 1 trains a denoiser on complementary sub-image pairs and freezes it to construct detached clean-sub-image proxies. Stage 2 estimates the residual--prediction interaction using these proxies and suppresses its patch-wise absolute magnitude. We show that the local construction prevents spatial cancellation and upper-bounds the magnitude of the corresponding global interaction. Experiments across natural, confocal, and X-ray images, complemented by iteration-matched controls, controlled noise shifts, and gradient diagnostics, show consistent gains over MSE-only adaptation under IID, spatially varying, and mixed noise. Overall, LoTA-N2N demonstrates that estimated local interaction and spatial cancellation control provide effective design principles for single-image self-supervised denoising without paired clean targets, repeated acquisitions, or a predefined re-corruption model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LoTA-N2N，一种零样本自监督图像去噪的两阶段适应框架。通过分析MSE自监督目标与监督MSE之间的迹交互，发现全局小交互可能因空间抵消而隐藏正负区域贡献。该方法第一阶段训练互补子图像对去噪器并冻结以构建干净子图像代理，第二阶段估计并抑制残差-预测交互的块级绝对值，防止空间抵消。在自然、共聚焦和X射线图像上，针对IID、空间变化和混合噪声均优于仅MSE适应。
Motivation: 现有单图像自监督去噪依赖从噪声观测构造的代理目标，当噪声相关、空间非平稳或未知时，代理目标与监督目标偏差大。作者发现MSE类自监督目标与监督MSE的梯度差异由残差-预测交互的梯度决定，且全局小交互可能掩盖正负区域交互的空间抵消，这限制了性能。
Method: 提出两阶段零样本适应框架LoTA-N2N。第一阶段在互补子图像对上训练去噪器并冻结，构建脱离的干净子图像代理。第二阶段利用代理估计残差-预测交互，并抑制其逐块绝对值，通过局部构造防止空间抵消，同时上界全局交互幅度。
Result: 在自然图像、共聚焦显微镜图像和X射线图像上，与迭代匹配的对比实验、受控噪声偏移和梯度诊断表明，在IID、空间变化和混合噪声下，LoTA-N2N相比仅MSE适应获得一致提升。
Conclusion: 估计局部交互并控制空间抵消为单图像自监督去噪提供了有效设计原则，无需配对干净图像、多次采集或预定义重损坏模型。

papers.title: MAPLE: Efficient and Diverse Multi-Alpha Generation for Portfolio Construction
papers.abstract_en: Classical alpha mining achieves strong risk-adjusted returns by combining many low-correlated predictive signals, yet deep learning stock-ranking methods typically produce a single alpha per stock, rely on increasingly complex architectures with diminishing gains, and obtain diversity only through separate models or implicit routing, without explicitly controlling inter-alpha correlation. We introduce MAPLE (Multi-Alpha Position-aware Listwise Ensembling), a backbone-agnostic framework that recovers this diversity principle within a single training pass. MAPLE combines a unified, capacity-scaled prediction head with an extreme-rank weighted listwise ranking loss and a diversity regularizer that explicitly penalizes pairwise correlation across alphas. Across four equity markets spanning the US, China, and Japan, MAPLE achieves the best average Sharpe and Calmar ratios among nine baselines, using up to 55x fewer parameters and 2.5x less training time, and generalizes across five backbone architectures with Sharpe and Calmar Ratio gains of 10-23% and 17-43%, respectively. Behavioral analysis further shows why each component works: the unified head already reduces inter-alpha correlation before any diversity loss is applied, and the extreme-rank loss lets diversity regularization improve rather than erode per-alpha ranking quality as capacity scaling sustains this balance at scale. These results show that principled loss design and capacity allocation, rather than architectural complexity, drive diverse and effective multi-alpha generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAPLE框架，一种与主干无关的多alpha生成方法，通过统一容量缩放预测头、极端排名加权列表排序损失和多样性正则化，在单一训练过程中显式控制alpha间相关性。在美股、中国和日本四个市场，MAPLE以最多55倍少的参数和2.5倍少的训练时间，在夏普比率和卡尔玛比率上超越九种基线，并在五种主干架构上泛化。
Motivation: 传统alpha挖掘通过组合低相关预测信号实现强风险调整收益，但深度学习股票排序方法通常每个股票生成单一alpha，依赖日益复杂的架构且收益递减，多样性仅通过分离模型或隐式路由获得，缺乏显式控制alpha间相关性。
Method: 提出MAPLE框架，包含统一容量缩放预测头、极端排名加权列表排序损失和显式惩罚alpha间成对相关性的多样性正则化，可在单一训练过程中生成多样且有效的多alpha。
Result: 在美、中、日四个股票市场，MAPLE在夏普比率和卡尔玛比率上达到最佳，参数最多减少55倍，训练时间减少2.5倍，并在五种主干架构上泛化，夏普比率和卡尔玛比率分别提升10-23%和17-43%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，原则性的损失设计和容量分配而非架构复杂性是驱动多样且有效的多alpha生成的关键。

papers.title: TEmBed-T: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Table-Level Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data is the dominant structured-data modality, and learning table representations has become a core research direction. Table-level embeddings in particular underpin a wide range of applications, including table retrieval, data lake discovery, and table classification. Despite their importance, there is still limited understanding of how different embedding approaches behave across tasks, making systematic evaluation and analysis essential. In this work, we introduce a systematic evaluation of table-level embeddings that captures several complementary properties required for downstream effectiveness. We realize this evaluation by extending TEmBed, a recently proposed testbed for tabular embeddings, whose table-level coverage is currently limited to a single retrieval task. An empirical study over the TEmBed model pool confirms that no single model excels across all tasks, demonstrating that table-level embedding quality cannot be reduced to retrieval alone.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TEmBed-T，一个用于表格级嵌入的多维基准，扩展自TEmBed测试床，系统评估表格嵌入在多个下游任务上的性能。实证表明没有单一模型在所有任务上表现最优，表格嵌入质量不能仅由检索性能衡量。
Motivation: 表格嵌入在表格检索、数据湖发现等应用中至关重要，但现有评估仅限于单一检索任务，缺乏对不同嵌入方法在多任务上的系统比较。
Method: 在TEmBed测试床基础上扩展，引入多个互补的表格级嵌入任务，并利用现有模型池进行实证研究。
Result: 实证结果表明没有单一模型在所有任务上表现最优，表格嵌入质量不能仅由检索性能衡量。
Conclusion: 需要更全面的基准来评估表格嵌入，本工作为系统评估提供了框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EEGForceFusion: Joint Tokenised-Continuous Representation Learning for Subject-Independent Grasp Force Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Brain-machine interfaces provide a link between neural activity and external devices, enabling restoration of motor function and advancing human-machine interaction using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG). However, continuous grasp force decoding remains challenging due to complex temporal dynamics, high inter-subject variability, and limited generalisation of existing approaches. To address this, we propose a hybrid EEG decoding framework that jointly models continuous and tokenised representations, enabling capture of both fine-grained neural structure and long-range temporal dependencies. The proposed approach integrates convolutional-recurrent representation learning, quantisation-based tokenisation, and transformer-based temporal modelling within a unified fusion-based regression architecture. Experimental evaluation on the WAY-EEG-GAL dataset under strict leave-one-subject-out conditions achieves $R^2$ = 0.817 in offline settings and $R^2$ = 0.793 in simulated real-time evaluation, with latency suitable for real-time deployment. These results demonstrate strong cross-subject generalisation and highlight the practicality of hybrid continuous-tokenised representations for real-time EEG-based force decoding in assistive robotics, neuro-rehabilitation, and human-machine interaction.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables, accepted at Brain-Machine Interface (BMI) Systems Session, IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EEGForceFusion框架，联合建模连续和离散化的脑电信号表示，用于抓取力解码。在WAY-EEG-GAL数据集上，留一受试者交叉验证下离线R²=0.817，模拟实时R²=0.793，延迟适合实时应用。
Motivation: 连续抓取力解码受限于脑电的复杂时间动态、高个体差异和现有方法的泛化能力不足。
Method: 混合框架结合卷积循环表示学习、量化分词和Transformer时序建模，在统一融合回归架构中联合优化连续和token化表示。
Result: 离线R²=0.817，模拟实时R²=0.793，跨受试者泛化能力强，实时延迟可部署。
Conclusion: 混合连续-离散表示方法在实时脑电抓取力解码中有效，适用于辅助机器人、神经康复和人机交互。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ViDS: Video Diffusion Shader using 3D Face Tracking
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ViDS, a Video Diffusion Shader that leverages 3D face tracking for expressive and identity-preserving portrait animation. We first reconstruct the identity-specific 3DMM mesh from the reference image, and then animate it using expression and pose parameters from a driving video. Leveraging dense geometric cues from 3DMM normal maps, we employ a video diffusion model as a neural shader to synthesize lifelike portrait animations while preserving the appearance and identity of the reference image. We find that more accurate 3DMM tracking enables finer-grained expression control. We also introduce an autoregressive diffusion sampling process that extends generation beyond the model's native window while reducing discontinuities between adjacent clips. Compared with prior diffusion-based approaches for portrait animation that rely on landmark-based conditioning or implicit motion latents, our method achieves more detailed and consistent expression and pose control while faithfully preserving identity and appearance. Detailed ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our design choices. Project page: https://fusheng-ji.github.io/ViDS/
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, and 8 tables. Project page: https://fusheng-ji.github.io/ViDS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViDS，一种利用3D人脸跟踪的视频扩散着色器，用于表现力丰富且身份保持的人像动画。先重建身份特异性的3DMM网格，然后用驱动视频的表情和姿态参数进行动画化，利用3DMM法线图的密集几何线索，采用视频扩散模型作为神经着色器合成逼真人像动画。相比基于地标或隐式运动潜变量的方法，该方法实现了更精细的表情和姿态控制，同时忠实保持身份和外观。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的人像动画方法通常依赖地标或隐式运动潜变量，在表情和姿态控制上不够精细且身份保持不足。本文旨在通过精确的3D人脸跟踪实现更细粒度的控制。
Method: 提出ViDS框架，包括三部分：(1) 从参考图像重建身份特异性的3DMM网格；(2) 使用驱动视频的表情和姿态参数驱动网格；(3) 将3DMM法线图作为几何条件，结合视频扩散模型作为神经着色器合成视频。还引入了自回归扩散采样过程，扩展生成长度并减少剪辑间的不连续性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在表情和姿态控制上比基于地标或隐式运动的方法更详细和一致，同时更忠实地保持身份和外观。消融研究验证了设计选择的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调更精确的3DMM跟踪可以实现更细粒度的表情控制，且自回归采样过程扩展了生成长度并减少不连续性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grading the Narrators: An Isnad-Rijal Framework for Claim-Level Provenance in Multi-Agent Knowledge Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modern multi-agent knowledge systems increasingly accumulate knowledge through chains of autonomous transformations rather than direct retrieval. Existing provenance work records what happened - execution traces, tool calls, evidence links - and source-reliability estimation is long established (truth discovery, reputation systems). What is missing is an operational framework that attaches graded, per-domain transmitter reliability to claim-level transmission chains, with completeness semantics, transformation-typed aggregation, decoupled content criticism, and serve/review/quarantine routing. Classical Islamic hadith science confronted a structurally similar problem: deciding whether knowledge transmitted through chains of human narrators should be accepted. Over centuries it developed a rigorous methodology - isnad (a complete transmission chain attached to every claim), rijal (systematic grading of each narrator's integrity and precision), weakest-link chain evaluation, corroboration through independent chains, and matn criticism (content evaluated independently of chain quality). This paper transfers that methodology to AI system design. We contribute a formal mapping from hadith-science concepts to multi-agent pipelines, a relational schema implementing claim chains and a graded narrator registry, a decision matrix combining chain grade with content criticism, and an evaluation on 20,000 claims from real physics textbooks. The evaluation validates weakest-link quarantine and independent-chain corroboration; reports a partial failure of the grade-recovery loop, which missed the highest-fault narrator; and reports two analyses as inconclusive, including a matched-coverage comparison the framework could not reach with the reference content critic. The paper is explicit throughout about which claims the evidence does and does not yet support.
papers.comment: 25 pages. Code, data, and analysis: https://github.com/alizahidraja/isnad (v2.0.4). Software archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21216873
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文借鉴伊斯兰圣训学（isnad-rijal）方法论，为多智能体知识系统提出一个基于声明链的溯源框架。该框架对每个声明附加完整的传输链（isnad），对每个传输者（智能体）按领域分级评估（rijal），并通过决策矩阵结合链等级与内容批评来路由声明。在物理教科书20000条声明上的实验验证了最弱环节隔离和独立链佐证的有效性，但报告了等级恢复循环的部分失败。
Motivation: 现有溯源工作记录执行轨迹、工具调用等，但缺乏对跨领域传输者可靠性进行分级，并将其与声明级传输链结合的操作性框架，尤其在AI系统自主知识积累场景下。
Method: 形式化映射伊斯兰圣训学概念到多智能体管道，设计关系模式实现声明链与分级传输者注册表，构建结合链等级与内容批评的决策矩阵，并包含完整语义、转换类型聚合、解耦内容批评及服务/审查/隔离路由。
Result: 在20000条物理教科书声明上，验证了最弱环节隔离和独立链佐证的有效性；报告了等级恢复循环的部分失败（遗漏了最高故障传输者）；两个分析（包括匹配覆盖比较）因框架无法达到参考内容批评而无法得出定论。
Conclusion: 论文明确指出证据支持和不支持的声明，强调该框架在内容批评未达到参考水平时存在局限性，需要进一步改进等级恢复循环。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Non-Stationary Dynamic Pricing: Adaptivity and Optimality
papers.abstract_en: We study the contextual dynamic pricing problem under non-stationarity, where a firm sells products to $T$ sequentially arriving consumers that behave according to an unknown demand model that can change over time. The demand model is assumed to be a generalized linear model (GLM), allowing for a feature vector in $\mathbb{R}^d$ that encodes products and consumer information. To achieve optimal revenue (i.e., least regret), the firm needs to learn and exploit the unknown GLMs while monitoring for potential changes. We propose a multiscale change-point detection based algorithm that achieves a regret of order $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{s_TdT}\wedge\{V_T^{1/3}d^{1/3}T^{2/3}+\sqrt{dT}\})$, where $s_T$ is the number of piecewise stationary segments and $V_T$ is a newly defined notion of design-adjusted variation budget of model parameters. Our algorithm is adaptive and does not require knowing $s_T$ or $V_T$. Moreover, to our knowledge, this is the first dynamic pricing algorithm that is adaptive to the nature of changes and achieves the best-of-both-worlds rate, thus closing a long-standing gap in the literature. We remark that, due to the varying contexts, existing works in the adaptive non-stationary bandit literature cannot be applied to achieve optimality for contextual dynamic pricing. The regret is further accompanied with a newly constructed minimax lower bound, confirming the optimality of our algorithm (up to logarithmic factors). Extensive numerical experiments are conducted to illustrate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed algorithm in non-stationary dynamic pricing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非平稳环境下的上下文动态定价问题，其中消费者需求模型为随时间变化的广义线性模型（GLM）。作者提出一种基于多尺度变点检测的算法，能够自适应未知的段数s_T和设计调整变差预算V_T，实现遗憾为Õ(√(s_T d T) ∧ (V_T^{1/3} d^{1/3} T^{2/3} + √(d T)))，并证明其最优性（至多对数因子）。这是首个在非平稳上下文动态定价中达到“两全其美”遗憾率的算法。
Motivation: 现有动态定价研究大多假设需求模型固定不变，但实际中模型可能随时间变化。非平稳情境下，已有自适应非平稳bandit算法因上下文的存在而无法直接应用于动态定价，因此需要专门方法。
Method: 提出一种多尺度变点检测算法，用于学习与利用未知的GLM参数，同时监测参数变化。算法无需预先知道段数或变差预算，通过设计调整变差预算（design-adjusted variation budget）这一新概念来实现自适应性。
Result: 算法达到的遗憾上界为Õ(√(s_T d T) ∧ {V_T^{1/3} d^{1/3} T^{2/3} + √(d T)})，并且通过构造minimax下界验证了其最优性（至多对数因子）。数值实验展示了算法的效率和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了非平稳上下文动态定价中自适应与最优性之间的文献空白，首次实现了对变化类型自适应的“两全其美”遗憾率。算法无需已知非平稳性参数，具有实用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Case Study on the Acceptance of a Humanoid Robotic Head Employed in Three Public Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Previous research has shown that a human-like robot's acceptance heavily depends on the setting in which it operates and its ability to perform relevant tasks. This paper, first, reports on how our robot processes natural language to generate a multimodal, verbal response integrating emotional expressions based on an emotion simulation backend. Then, it describes how visitors were invited to speak with our robot in their own language at three different, public locations, where the robot was running continuously for several days. The TAM2 questionnaire results reveal that on average users were motivated to use the robot and found it rather useful and easy to use regardless of the specific location. However, public spaces like the tourist information and the city library seem to be a better fit for our interactive, robotic head than an office environment such as the building authority, where the willingness to interact was lower. Overall, the robot's multi-lingual responses were very much appreciated, but every fifth user found the response time too slow impeding the dialog flow, which remains to be improved in future work.
papers.comment: accepted at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026) Kitakyushu, Japan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个类人机器人头部在三个公共场所（旅游信息中心、城市图书馆和建筑管理局）连续运行数天的自然语言交互案例。机器人通过情感模拟后端生成多模态言语响应，接受多语言输入。TAM2问卷结果显示用户整体认为机器人有用且易用，但在建筑管理局的交互意愿较低；约五分之一的用户认为响应速度过慢。
Motivation: 类人机器人的接受度高度依赖于其运行环境和执行相关任务的能力，现有研究缺乏在真实公共场所长期运行的案例研究。
Method: 机器人使用自然语言处理生成多模态言语响应，集成基于情感模拟后端的情感表达；在三个不同公共场所邀请访客用自己的语言与机器人对话，并采用TAM2问卷评估用户接受度。
Result: 用户平均动机较高，认为机器人有用且易用；旅游信息中心和图书馆的适合度高于建筑管理局；多语言响应受到赞赏，但20%的用户认为响应时间过慢影响对话流畅性。
Conclusion: 交互式机器人头部更适合旅游信息中心和图书馆等公共场所，而非办公室环境；响应速度仍需改进。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文报告了一个类人机器人头部在三个公共场所（旅游信息中心、城市图书馆和建筑管理局）连续运行数天的自然语言交互案例。机器人通过情感模拟后端生成多模态言语响应，接受多语言输入。TAM2问卷结果显示用户整体认为机器人有用且易用，但在建筑管理局的交互意愿较低；约五分之一的用户认为响应速度过慢。

papers.title: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
papers.abstract_en: We introduce State Transition Pretraining (STP) as a new scaling axis for GUI agents. During the STP stage, we continually pretrain a unified multimodal model on visual state transitions by jointly optimizing inverse dynamics (predicting actions from state changes) and forward dynamics (predicting next states from current states and actions). This optimization equips the model with better action-grounded visual representations and an internal world model of GUI dynamics. When subsequently fine-tuned on trajectories with task instructions, our STP-trained models consistently outperform baselines trained solely via direct trajectory fine-tuning across agent benchmarks in both desktop and mobile GUI scenarios (AgentNetBench, AndroidControl, and GUIOdyssey). Further empirical studies show that joint dynamics optimization yields stable improvements over single-objective training, and downstream performance scales steadily with the volume of transition data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出状态转换预训练（STP）作为GUI智能体的新扩展轴，通过联合优化逆动力学和正动力学，在多模态模型上持续预训练，使其获得更优的动作相关视觉表示和GUI动态世界模型。在桌面和移动GUI基准测试中，STP预训练后微调的模型优于仅直接微调的基线。
Motivation: 现有GUI智能体通常直接从任务轨迹中微调，缺乏对GUI状态转换的深层理解，限制了泛化能力和性能。
Method: 提出STP，在预训练阶段联合优化逆动力学（从状态变化预测动作）和正动力学（从当前状态和动作预测下一状态），使模型学习动作相关的视觉表示和GUI动态内部模型。
Result: 在AgentNetBench、AndroidControl和GUIOdyssey等桌面和移动GUI基准上，STP预训练模型始终优于仅直接微调的基线。联合动力学优化比单目标训练更稳定，下游性能随转换数据量增加而稳定提升。
Conclusion: STP通过大规模状态转换预训练，为GUI智能体提供了有效的表示学习和世界模型，是一种可扩展的改进方法。

papers.title: BeyondFusion: Self-Aligned Latent Diffusion for Calibration-Free Infrared Super-Resolution and Infrared-Visible Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Mobile infrared-visible imaging typically pairs a compact infrared sensor with a high-resolution visible camera for complementary perception. While cross-sensor misalignment caused by different optics, viewpoints, fields of view, and exposure timings hinders practical deployment. In this paper, we propose BeyondFusion, a unified latent diffusion framework for calibration-free visible-guided infrared super-resolution and infrared-visible fusion tasks. The proposed framework supports both task-specific training and joint training where two tasks are optimized and executed as two readouts of the same generative process. Instead of relying on explicit registration or geometric warping, BeyondFusion introduces a cross-modal self-aligning (CMSA) module into the denoising U-Net. CMSA reorganizes infrared and visible latent tokens into a shared attention space to learn content-adaptive cross-modal correspondence during the denoising process. Together with misalignment augmentation module, the model is facilitated to exploit visible structural and semantic cues while preserving thermal consistency, enabling high-frequency infrared reconstruction and informative fused-image generation under uncalibrated conditions. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and a mobile infrared-visible imaging system show strong performance across aligned inputs, low-resolution infrared observations, synthetic misalignments, and real mobile captures with unsynchronized sensors. Ablation studies, unified training analysis, and downstream pedestrian detection further validate the effectiveness of BeyondFusion for calibration-free multimodal imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BeyondFusion，一个统一的潜在扩散框架，用于无校准的可见光引导红外超分辨率和红外-可见光融合。该框架通过跨模态自对齐（CMSA）模块在去噪U-Net中学习内容自适应的跨模态对应，无需显式配准或几何变换，同时支持任务特定训练和联合训练。在公共基准和移动红外-可见光成像系统上的实验表明，该方法在处理对齐、低分辨率、合成未对齐和真实未对齐输入时均表现优异，并通过消融和下游行人检测验证了有效性。
Motivation: 移动红外-可见光成像中，由于不同光学、视角、视场和曝光时间导致的跨传感器未对齐，阻碍了实际部署。现有方法依赖显式配准或几何变换，在未校准条件下性能有限。
Method: BeyondFusion基于潜在扩散模型，引入跨模态自对齐（CMSA）模块，将红外和可见光潜在特征重新组织到共享注意力空间，在去噪过程中学习内容自适应对应关系。同时设计未对齐增强模块，帮助模型利用可见光结构和语义线索同时保持热一致性，实现无校准的高频红外重建和融合图像生成。
Result: 在公共基准和移动红外-可见光成像系统上，BeyondFusion在多种输入条件（对齐、低分辨率红外、合成未对齐、真实未对齐）下均表现强性能，消融实验和联合训练分析证明了各模块的有效性，下游行人检测任务进一步验证了生成图像的信息量。
Conclusion: BeyondFusion通过统一框架支持任务特定和联合训练，在无校准条件下实现高质量红外超分辨率和融合，为移动多模态成像提供了可行的解决方案。

papers.title: LU-500: A Logo Benchmark for Concept Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Concept unlearning is increasingly used to limit the reproduction of protected or unsafe visual concepts in text-to-image models. Existing evaluations, however, mostly study targets that dominate the whole image, such as styles, broad object categories, or portrait-like identities, leaving company logos comparatively underexamined. Logos create a different failure mode: a small localized mark can carry the entire protected concept, must be visually precise to remain recognizable, and can be triggered implicitly by products, storefronts, packaging, or advertisements even when the word ``logo'' is absent. We introduce LU-500, a logo-unlearning benchmark built from Fortune Global 500 companies to study this localized and semantically entangled setting. LU-500 contains nearly 10,000 curated text-query and logo-image pairs, with an explicit track (LUex-500) and an implicit contextual track (LUim-500). To avoid reducing the task to a binary detector score, we define a multi-grained protocol that evaluates both local logo removal and global image preservation in pixel and latent spaces. Experiments on representative inference-time methods, including NP, SLD, and SEGA, and compatible fine-tuning-based methods such as ESD and Forget-Me-Not, show that the evaluated methods struggle to remove logo evidence without changing non-target content. We further analyze ProLU, a prompt-space multi-agent baseline: it improves local erasure by removing logo-inducing semantics, but also illustrates why prompt filtering is not a substitute for weight-level disentanglement. Correlation analyses over logo area, location, and structural complexity suggest that future logo unlearning may need spatially aware controls, such as SSIM-guided constraints, rather than purely global concept suppression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像模型中概念去学习（concept unlearning）的评估，指出现有基准主要关注风格、物体类别或肖像等主导全图的目标，却忽视了公司标志（logo）这一微小而语义纠缠的保护概念。作者基于财富全球500强公司构建了LU-500基准，包含近万对文本查询与标志图像，并划分显式（explicit）和隐式上下文（implicit contextual）两个子集。实验表明现有方法（如NP、SLD、SEGA、ESD、Forget-Me-Not）难以在删除标志证据的同时保持非目标内容不变；提示空间多智能体基线ProLU虽改善局部擦除，但提示过滤无法替代权重层面的解耦。相关性分析暗示未来的标志去学习可能需要空间感知约束而非纯全局概念抑制。
Motivation: 现有概念去学习评估主要关注风格、物体类别或人像等主导全图的目标，公司标志这一微小但可携带完整受保护概念且常隐式触发的场景未被充分研究。标志去学习面临局部定位、视觉精度高和语义纠缠等独特挑战。
Method: 构建LU-500基准，包含显式与隐式上下文两个子集及近万对数据；定义多粒度评估协议，在像素和潜在空间同时评估局部标志移除与全局图像保留；分析多种推理时和微调方法，并引入提示空间多智能体基线ProLU。
Result: 现有方法在移除标志证据时普遍改变非目标内容；ProLU通过移除标志引发语义提升局部擦除，但依赖提示过滤而非权重解耦；标志面积、位置和结构复杂度与擦除效果相关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调标志去学习需要空间感知约束（如SSIM指导）而非纯全局概念抑制，提示过滤无法替代权重层面的解耦。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReflexTrack: A Feedback-Driven Agent for Training-Free Referring Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring video object segmentation (RVOS) requires segmenting a target specified by natural language throughout a video. Recent agentic approaches combine multimodal large language models with promptable segmentation models to perform RVOS without task-specific training. However, most pipelines rely on one-shot spatial grounding followed by mask propagation, leaving both the initial prompts and temporal predictions largely unverified. We introduce ReflexTrack, a training-free, feedback-driven agent that closes this loop at both spatial and temporal levels. Mask-guided Spatial Refinement evaluates the mask induced by the current keyframe prompt and iteratively updates the bounding box together with positive and negative points, yielding a more reliable initialization. Video-level Mask Reflection assesses the complete mask sequence, localizes unreliable intervals, selects complementary repair keyframes, and generates candidate predictions through mask-guided re-propagation. Only candidates that provide a verified improvement are used to update the affected intervals, preserving reliable predictions elsewhere. All components remain frozen during inference. ReflexTrack achieves an overall $\mathcal{Q}$ score of $69.7$ on Ref-VPS and a $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ score of $67.2$ on ReasonVOS. These results demonstrate that prediction-level feedback substantially improves the reliability of training-free RVOS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReflexTrack，一种无需训练的反馈驱动智能体，用于指代视频对象分割（RVOS）。它通过空间级和视频级的反馈循环，利用掩码引导的空间细化和视频级掩码评估，迭代优化初始提示和时序预测，无需任务特定训练。在 Ref-VPS 和 ReasonVOS 上分别取得 69.7 的 Q 分数和 67.2 的 J&F 分数。
Motivation: 现有无需训练的 RVOS 方法依赖一次性空间定位和掩码传播，初始提示和时序预测缺乏验证，导致可靠性不足。
Method: 提出 ReflexTrack，包含两个反馈模块：掩码引导的空间细化（Mask-guided Spatial Refinement）迭代更新边界框和正负点以改进初始化；视频级掩码评估（Video-level Mask Reflection）定位不可靠区间，选择修复关键帧并通过掩码引导的再传播生成候选预测，仅采纳验证为改进的候选。
Result: 在 Ref-VPS 上整体 Q 分数为 69.7，在 ReasonVOS 上 J&F 分数为 67.2，表明预测级反馈显著提升了无需训练 RVOS 的可靠性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预测级反馈能有效提高无需训练 RVOS 的可靠性，所有组件在推理时保持冻结。

papers.title: MemChain: Learning Interpretable Memory Traces for Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented LLM agents typically answer queries by retrieving relevant memories and feeding them directly to an answer model. This retrieval-as-evidence paradigm assumes retrieved memories are already suitable for reasoning, leaving the answer model to resolve redundancy, conflicts, and weak relevance while incurring substantial context overhead in long-term memory tasks. We propose MemChain, a trainable post-retrieval memory policy that transforms retrieved candidates into answer-facing active memory, represented as a compact and grounded evidence context. Given a user query and retrieved candidates, MemChain first generates a question-conditioned evidence plan, then constructs an ordered grounded evidence trace that organizes retrieved memories according to their semantic roles and dependencies, and finally executes explicit memory actions to produce a concise evidence context for answer generation. To train the mediator, we introduce a two-stage learning framework. Supervised trace learning first teaches the policy to generate structurally valid plans, traces, actions, and evidence contexts. We then propose Trace-Guided Memory Policy Optimization (TMPO), a reinforcement learning objective that optimizes the memory policy using downstream answer quality while jointly encouraging trace grounding, evidence support, structural validity, and answer stability across multiple rollouts. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that MemChain consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across both closed-source and open-weight frozen answer models while substantially reducing the memory context passed to the answer model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemChain，一种可训练的后检索记忆策略，将检索到的候选记忆转换为面向答案的主动记忆（active memory），表示为紧凑且有依据的上下文证据。它通过问题条件证据计划、有序证据链和显式记忆动作生成简洁的证据上下文。同时提出两阶段学习框架，包括监督痕迹学习和痕迹引导记忆策略优化（TMPO），在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上取得最佳性能并显著减少上下文长度。
Motivation: 现有基于检索的记忆增强LLM代理将检索到的记忆直接作为证据，假设它们已适合推理，但存在冗余、冲突和弱相关性问题，且长上下文内存任务中上下文开销大。
Method: 提出MemChain框架，包含三个步骤：生成问题条件证据计划、构建有序接地证据链、执行显式记忆动作生成简洁证据上下文。训练使用两阶段：监督痕迹学习 + TMPO强化学习优化下游回答质量同时鼓励证据支撑、结构有效性和稳定性。

Conclusion: MemChain通过可训练的后检索策略改善了记忆增强LLM代理的效率和有效性，未提及限制。
