papers.title: Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, weakly observable, and mainly benefits others. Drawing on Holmström's team moral-hazard model, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a controlled textual game that operationalizes this hidden-action structure for language agents. In each episode, an agent can preserve an immediate local reward or pay a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate seven open-weight language models and decompose behavior into query use, realized information transfer, local-reward preservation, unsafe choice, format validity, and team success. Base models commonly preserve local reward without team success or query without communicating information that changes the final decision. We then use supervised fine-tuning, RLOO, sequential SFT+RLOO, and GEPA prompt optimization as diagnostic update mechanisms. Their effects are heterogeneous: OLMo-7B shows the clearest mechanism-consistent weight-level improvement, whereas GEPA sometimes improves team success while reducing or eliminating costly queries. Thus, optimization can shift aggregate reward without recovering the intended cooperative mechanism, motivating evaluations that report mechanism-level behavior rather than team success alone.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Second Workshop on Social Simulation with LLMS: Fidelity in Applications at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文借鉴 Holmström 的团队道德风险模型，提出了对话道德风险博弈（Dialogue Moral Hazard Game），这是一个用于语言智能体的受控文本游戏，模拟了隐藏行动结构。实验评估了七个开源语言模型，发现基础模型通常倾向于保留局部奖励而牺牲团队成功，或进行查询但未能传递能改变最终决策的信息。随后使用多种优化方法进行诊断，结果表明优化可以改变总体奖励而不恢复预期的合作机制，因此需要报告机制级行为而非仅团队成功。
Motivation: 合作可能因有价值的社会努力成本高昂、弱可观测且主要惠及他人而失败，现有研究缺乏将道德风险模型应用于语言智能体的操作性框架。
Method: 提出对话道德风险博弈，智能体可在保留即时局部奖励或支付查询成本以揭示主要帮助其他智能体下游决策的隐藏安全事实之间选择。使用七个开源语言模型进行实验，并应用监督微调、RLOO、序列 SFT+RLOO 和 GEPA 提示优化作为诊断更新机制。
Result: 基础模型倾向于保留局部奖励而不实现团队成功，或进行查询但未传递改变最终决策的信息。优化效果异质：OLMo-7B 表现出最清晰的机制一致权重改进，而 GEPA 有时在减少或消除昂贵查询的同时提高团队成功。
Conclusion: 优化可以改变总体奖励而不恢复预期的合作机制，因此评估应报告机制级行为而非仅团队成功。

papers.title: Multimodal Semantic-Probabilistic Objectness for Open World Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-world object detection (OWOD) requires a detector to recognize known categories, discover unnamed objects from unseen categories, and incrementally learn newly annotated classes. PROB improves unknown discovery by modeling class-agnostic probabilistic objectness in the decoder-query space. However, visual objectness alone cannot determine whether an object-like query corresponds to a hard known instance, an unseen-category object, or background clutter, resulting in an ambiguous known-unknown decision boundary. We propose MSPO, a lightweight semantic calibration framework that augments PROB with task-aware known-category language priors while preserving its detector architecture and incremental learning protocol. For each currently known category, MSPO constructs an extended text description covering category attributes, visual appearance, typical scenes, and functional usage, and encodes it using a frozen CLIP text encoder. Decoder query features are projected into the same semantic space to estimate their support from the current known-category semantics. This semantic evidence is fused with PROB's visual objectness to calibrate known and unknown predictions without turning OWOD into open-vocabulary classification. Importantly, MSPO never uses future-category names, and all unseen categories remain unnamed during evaluation. Experiments on M-OWODB and S-OWODB show that MSPO improves the strong PROB baseline on the main aggregate metrics while retaining competitive unknown recall. It also improves early unknown-confusion metrics and raises PASCAL VOC final mAP by up to 2.7 points. These results demonstrate that known-category language semantics provide an effective calibration signal for probabilistic objectness under the standard OWOD setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MSPO框架，通过融合已知类别语言先验（CLIP文本编码器）和视觉概率对象性（PROB），改进开放世界目标检测（OWOD）中的未知物体发现。在M-OWODB和S-OWODB基准上，MSPO提升了主要聚合指标，PASCAL VOC最终mAP最高提高2.7点，且不依赖于未来类别名称。
Motivation: 现有OWOD方法（如PROB）仅依赖视觉对象性区分已知、未知和背景，导致已知-未知决策边界模糊。需要一种不开放词汇化的语义校准信号来提升未知发现而不牺牲已知性能。
Method: 对每个已知类别构建扩展文本描述（属性、外观、场景、功能），用冻结CLIP文本编码器编码；将解码器查询特征投影到同一语义空间，估计其已知类别语义支持度，并与PROB的视觉对象性融合，校准已知/未知预测。
Result: 在M-OWODB和S-OWODB上，MSPO优于PROB基线，提升主要聚合指标，保持竞争性未知召回率；早期未知混淆指标改善，PASCAL VOC最终mAP提升最高2.7点。
Conclusion: 已知类别语言语义可为概率对象性提供有效校准信号，无需转为开放词汇分类，适用于标准OWOD设置。

papers.title: Mutual Modality Trust with Lightweight Reconstruction Regularization for Fine-grained Tire Pattern Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual tire recognition serves as a core supporting technique for vehicle safety monitoring, autonomous driving perception and automated automotive maintenance. Existing fine-grained tire recognition techniques suffer from three prominent limitations. They tend to depend on only one visual source, lack the capacity to jointly model spatial and frequency cues for minute tread texture extraction, and suffer severe overfitting given limited annotated tire imagery. This paper proposes a lightweight fine-grained tire pattern recognition method incorporating dual-branch independent inference and enhanced feature fusion to boost recognition performance. The framework employs two task-specialized branches dedicated to tire surface and tread indentation, respectively, to extract modality-specific discriminative features. Each branch conducts independent prediction, while cross-branch feature fusion exploits Mutual Modality Trust (M$^2$T) to realize complementary feature enhancement across two modalities. Besides, a frequency-domain hierarchical guidance module is devised, which leverages bandpass filters to decompose feature maps into high- and low-frequency components and enables fine-grained cross-layer feature modulation. Furthermore, a Lightweight Reconstruction Regularization (LR$^2$) is introduced to retain abundant intrinsic information within feature embeddings, substantially improving feature stability and recognition robustness under limited labeled training data. In addition, we establish a surface-indentation multi-source dataset namely MTire299 for fine-grained tire tread recognition, which covers 299 categories with a total of 14795 paired image samples. Extensive experiments conducted on two public tire datasets validate the superiority and efficacy of the proposed algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级细粒度轮胎花纹识别方法，包含双分支独立推理和跨分支特征融合。方法利用互模态信任（M²T）实现跨模态互补特征增强，并设计了频域分层引导模块用于细粒度特征调制。此外，引入轻量级重建正则化（LR²）来在有限标注数据下保持特征稳定性。作者构建了包含299类14795对图像的MTire299数据集，在两个公开数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有细粒度轮胎识别方法依赖于单一视觉源，缺乏联合建模空间和频率线索的能力，且在有限标注数据下容易过拟合。
Method: 提出双分支独立推理框架（分别处理轮胎表面和胎面压痕），通过互模态信任（M²T）进行跨分支特征融合；设计频域分层引导模块，利用带通滤波器分解高低频分量实现细粒度跨层调制；引入轻量级重建正则化（LR²）提升特征稳定性。
Result: 在两个公开轮胎数据集上的实验表明该方法优于现有算法。
Conclusion: 该轻量级方法通过双分支融合和频率域调制有效提升了细粒度轮胎识别性能，在有限数据下具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: Disentangling Acoustic Cues in Alzheimer's Pathology and Perception: The Roles of Language and Gender
papers.abstract_en: Acoustic biomarkers show promise for detecting Alzheimer's Disease (AD), yet whether the cues driving diagnostic AI align with those salient to human listeners is underexplored across languages and genders, where pathological markers and perceptual strategies differ. We train models to predict clinical AD status (pathology) and human perceptual scores across Mandarin and Greek, male and female speakers. Using SHAP for interpretability and statistical models for validation, we compare feature importance by subgroup. Results reveal a context-dependent divergence: pathological-perceptual alignment is significant for Mandarin and female speakers but disappears for Greek and male speakers, where pathology models did not exceed chance; this is a failure mode that population-specific auditing surfaces. Global Explainable AI (XAI) explanations can mask critical demographic divergences, highlighting the need for population-specific explainability auditing for equitable deployment of clinical speech AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究Alzheimer病理与人类感知之间声学线索的对齐程度，跨语言（普通话和希腊语）和性别（男性和女性）进行。通过SHAP解释性分析和统计模型验证，发现病理-感知对齐在普通话和女性说话者中显著，但在希腊语和男性说话者中消失（后者的病理模型未超过随机水平）。全局XAI解释会掩盖关键人口统计学差异，呼吁对临床语音AI进行人群特定的可解释性审计。
Motivation: 现有声学生物标志物研究未充分考察病理线索与人类感知线索在不同语言和性别之间是否一致，可能导致AI模型在不同群体中表现偏差。
Method: 训练模型预测临床AD状态（病理）和人类感知分数，使用SHAP进行特征重要性解释，并用统计模型验证子组间的特征重要性差异。
Result: 普通话和女性说话者中病理-感知对齐显著；希腊语和男性说话者中病理模型未超过随机水平，对齐消失。
Conclusion: 全局XAI解释可能掩盖关键人口统计学差异，需要人群特定的可解释性审计以确保临床语音AI的公平部署。

papers.title: Tag Questions and the Generational Reversal of Sycophancy Across 45 Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Appending a two-word confirmation tag to a decision question -- "Is X the better choice?" versus "X is the better choice, right?" -- changes whether a language model endorses the choice. We measure this tag effect on 20 frozen, ground-truth-free decisions between two defensible options, counterbalanced so a model's own preferences cancel, scored by exact match on clamped yes/no replies -- no LLM judge, no embeddings. Across 45 models the effect spans +32% to -32% -- a 64-point swing on one word -- with 5 models significantly sycophantic and 17 significantly resistant (BH-FDR q=.10). The sign is a clock: within model families the effect crosses from positive to negative as generations advance (GPT +4 to -28; Claude +7 to -32; Qwen and Grok likewise), roughly -6 points per year, a reversal robust to vendor tier; one lineage (DeepSeek) never crosses, and two releases during the study window (Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash) land on the trend out-of-sample. A full-panel ablation localizes the resistance as a double dissociation: a synonym tag reproduces each model's response almost exactly (r=0.89), while planting the same preference without a tag produces resistance in no resistant model (stance effects +6 to +49; r=0.23 with tag effects). The resistance is keyed to the surface construction of a tacked-on agreement bid, not the user's stance -- a pattern-match, not a principle. And the tag's polarity matters more than its presence: swap one word -- "X is the better choice, maybe?" -- and agreement rises above the neutral baseline in 45 of 45 models (+19.6 points), with ten models affirming both mutually exclusive options at 90-100%. Agreement tracks how sure the user sounds, in opposite directions at the two poles. The instrument is one word, one dollar, and judge-free; run per release, it reads the field's anti-sycophancy training directly off model behavior.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Data, code, and raw model replies: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun. Interactive explorer: https://tap2k.github.io/modelun/suggestibility/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在二元选择问题中附加确认性尾句（如“X是更好的选择，对吧？”）对45个语言模型回答的影响。实验采用无真值、无法官的精确匹配方法，发现尾句效应导致模型赞同率变化范围达64个百分点，且模型家族的世代间出现从谄媚到抗拒的翻转（约每年-6个百分点）。抵抗效应与尾句的构造形式相关，而非用户立场。
Motivation: 现有研究关注模型谄媚现象，但缺乏对尾句这种细微语言结构如何影响模型决策的系统量化测量。
Method: 通过20个无真值的二元选择问题，每个问题构造带确认尾句的版本，与中性版本对照，测量模型对两个可选答案的赞同率变化，使用精确匹配（exact match）评分，避免LLM法官或嵌入。
Result: 45个模型中尾句效应从+32%到-32%不等，5个模型显著谄媚，17个显著抗拒；模型家族内世代越新，效应越呈负向（GPT +4到-28，Claude +7到-32），平均每年减6个百分点；同义词尾句高相关(r=0.89)，而植入立场无尾句则不产生抗拒。
Conclusion: 模型对尾句的抵抗是基于表面模式匹配而非原则性推理；尾句的极性（如“对吧？” vs “也许？”）影响大于其存在与否，且所有模型对“也许？”尾句赞同率均高于基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Plato-Bio: verification-first biological novelty screening with temporal rediscovery and structural benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Large language model research agents can connect literature retrieval, analysis code, and manuscript preparation, but coherent output does not establish scientific validity. We developed Plato-Bio, a biology-routed extension of the open Plato/Denario architecture that couples explicit workflow states with provenance records, citation checks, claim-to-evidence links, scoped file writes, and publication gates. A source audit identified and repaired three defects that could distort evaluation: loss of task domain in the default factory, omission of declared method signals from scoring, and evidence sidecars that lacked the drafted-claim denominator. On the current clean revision, the full Python suite completed with 931 passes, six skips, and no failures or errors; targeted biology, genomics, evidence/citation, and adversarial-safety suites likewise completed without failure. We evaluated two narrow use cases. In a frozen historical rediscovery task, independent pre-1986 literature bridges ranked the later-studied relation between fish oil and Raynaud phenomenon first; TF-IDF ranked it second and corpus frequency third. This single curated task measures retrospective ranking, not prospective discovery. In a separate comparison of AlphaFold models with experimental structures for 15 human proteins, 11 targets had high-confidence-core C-alpha RMSD below 1 Angstrom (median 0.501 Angstrom). Four targets exceeded 2 Angstrom, and confidence masking reduced the SUMO1 discrepancy from 16.61 to 2.58 Angstrom over 74 residues. The workflow emitted 27 traceable discrepancy regions, all retained as unvalidated hypotheses. Plato-Bio therefore provides reproducible software contracts and auditable screening baselines; broader claims of agent efficacy or biological novelty require preregistered evaluation, independent review, and prospective validation.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Companion code and data: https://github.com/Eldergenix/Plato-Scientific-Research-Autonomous-Agent. This fork-specific validation study cites, but does not duplicate, arXiv:2510.26887
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Plato-Bio，一个基于开放 Plato/Denario 架构的生物学路由扩展，通过显式工作流状态、来源记录、引用检查、声明-证据链接和发布门控，实现验证优先的生物新颖性筛选。系统修复了三个源代码缺陷，并通过了全部测试套件。在历史再发现任务中，鱼油与雷诺现象的关系被正确排名；在 AlphaFold 模型比较中，11 个靶点的高置信度核心 Cα RMSD 低于 1 埃，4 个超过 2 埃，共输出 27 个可追踪差异区域作为未验证假设。研究强调更广泛的代理效能声明需要预注册评估和独立审查。
Motivation: 大型语言模型研究代理能整合文献检索和分析，但连贯的输出不保证科学有效性，亟需验证优先的筛选方法。
Method: Plato-Bio 在 Plato/Denario 架构上扩展生物学路由，加入显式工作流状态、来源记录、引用检查、声明-证据链接、范围文件写入和发布门控，并通过源代码审计修复了任务域丢失、方法信号遗漏和证据侧车缺少分母等缺陷。
Result: 在历史再发现任务中，文献桥排名将鱼油与雷诺现象关系列第一（TF-IDF 第二，词频第三）；在 AlphaFold 比较中，15 个人类蛋白质中 11 个 Cα RMSD 低于 1 埃（中位数 0.501 埃），4 个超过 2 埃，置信度掩码将 SUMO1 偏差从 16.61 降至 2.58 埃。
Conclusion: Plato-Bio 提供可重复的软件合同和可审计的筛选基线，但生物新颖性等更广泛声明需预注册评估、独立审查和前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Color Fundus Photography Analysis: Co-evolution of Data, Preprocessing, and Modeling toward Multimodal AI
papers.abstract_en: Color Fundus Photography (CFP) is a primary non-invasive imaging modality for large-scale screening of ophthalmic and systemic diseases. Existing surveys mainly summarize task-specific algorithms, datasets, or preprocessing techniques independently, lacking a unified perspective on their co-evolution with modern artificial intelligence. This review provides an integrated overview of CFP AI through the interplay of dataset evolution, preprocessing paradigms, and modeling frameworks. We show that CFP datasets have evolved from small single-center collections with task-specific labels to large multi-center resources featuring multimodal pairings and longitudinal clinical records. Preprocessing has progressed from conventional image enhancement to neural data-engineering pipelines, hardware-aware token optimization, and self-supervised imputation for incomplete electronic health records (EHRs). Meanwhile, modeling has advanced from convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to vision foundation models, state space models (SSMs), and multimodal expert architectures. At the multimodal frontier, CFP is increasingly integrated with EHRs and longitudinal patient information, enabling more comprehensive clinical reasoning beyond isolated image analysis. We conclude that future progress depends on the collaborative optimization of datasets, preprocessing, and multimodal modeling, providing a roadmap toward robust clinical deployment, improved cross-domain generalization, and resource-efficient edge intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于彩色眼底照相（CFP）人工智能分析的综合综述，从数据集演化、预处理范式和建模框架三个角度综述其协同发展。摘要指出CFP数据集从单中心小规模向多中心多模态纵向记录发展，预处理从传统图像增强演进到神经数据工程和自监督插补，建模从CNN发展到视觉基础模型、状态空间模型和多模态专家架构。文章认为未来进展依赖于数据集、预处理和多模态建模的协同优化，为临床部署和跨域泛化提供路线图。
Motivation: 现有调查主要独立总结特定任务的算法、数据集或预处理技术，缺乏从统一视角审视它们与现代人工智能协同演化的综述。
Method: 本文采用综述方法，整合分析了CFP AI中数据集演化、预处理范式和建模框架三方面的共同演进关系。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值结果，但总结了CFP AI领域的发展趋势和前沿方向。
Conclusion: 未来进展依赖于数据集、预处理和多模态建模的协同优化，以实现稳健的临床部署、跨域泛化和资源高效的边缘智能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Machine Unlearning Through the Lens of Mode Connectivity
papers.abstract_en: Machine Unlearning aims to remove undesired information from trained models without full retraining from scratch. Despite recent progress, the loss landscape and optimization geometry of unlearning are poorly understood. In this paper, we study machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity--the phenomenon that independently trained models can often be connected by smooth low-loss paths in parameter space. We introduce {\em mode connectivity in unlearning} (MCU) and evaluate it across a range of settings, including curriculum learning, second-order optimization, and connectivity across different unlearning methods. We find that many unlearned models lie in connected basins with smooth retain/forget behavior, while changes in training dynamics can move solutions into different basins. MCU also reveals that models within the same basin can differ substantially on privacy metrics, and that unlearning progresses nonlinearly from the original model to the unlearned model. In addition, linear connectivity suggests that most approximate unlearning methods are mechanistically distinct from retraining. Finally, MCU-based ensembling can improve generalization and robustness to relearning attacks, and MCU smoothness correlates with unlearning difficulty. To our knowledge, this is the first study of machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从模式连通性（mode connectivity）的角度研究机器遗忘（machine unlearning），发现未学习模型往往位于连接盆地中，具有平滑的保留/遗忘行为，而训练动态变化可将解移至不同盆地。还揭示了同一盆地内模型在隐私指标上差异显著，未学习过程是非线性的。基于MCU的集成可提升泛化性和对重新学习攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 机器遗忘的损失景观和优化几何特性尚不清晰，缺乏对未学习模型之间连通性的理解。
Method: 引入模式连通性在机器遗忘中的概念（MCU），在课程学习、二阶优化及不同未学习方法等设置下评估连通性。
Result: 未学习模型多位于具有平滑保留/遗忘行为的连接盆地中；训练动态改变可导致不同盆地；线性连通性表明近似未学习方法与重新训练机制不同；MCU集成提升泛化性和对重新学习攻击的鲁棒性；MCU平滑性与未学习难度相关。
Conclusion: 首次从模式连通性视角研究机器遗忘，揭示了未学习模型的几何特性，并提出MCU作为理解和改进未学习的工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grokking on the Weight-Decay Clock: A Rate Hierarchy from Softly Broken Symmetries
papers.abstract_en: Delayed generalization, or grokking, remains poorly understood despite extensive empirical study. We identify an exactly solvable late-time relaxation mechanism for grokking in linear models trained with full-batch heavy-ball optimization and weight decay, together with a locally quadratic extension to nonlinear neural networks. Our analysis reveals a distinguished population-active component of the empirical null space, which we call the grokking subspace. Along this subspace, the training predictions remain unchanged, leaving weight decay as the sole restoring force and giving rise to a slow dissipative relaxation governed by an exact discrete-time and continuous-time law. We show that only this subspace contributes to the slow asymptotic decay of the population risk and derive explicit iteration-scale predictions for the grokking time, recovering the familiar $(1-β)/(ηλ)$ scaling in the weak-regularization regime. The theory further predicts distinct effects of optimizer choice, distinguishing coupled $L_2$ regularization from decoupled weight decay, and yields causal predictions for interventions that modify the grokking component. We verify all theoretical identities without fitted parameters in a synthetic model where every subspace and relaxation rate is computable in closed form. We further observe genuine delayed generalization in modular addition, where the measured delay follows the predicted scaling and the late-time relaxation agrees closely with the theoretical clock.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了延迟泛化（grokking）现象，在线性模型和全批量heavy-ball优化与权重衰减的训练中，识别出一个精确可解的松弛机制。作者发现了名为grokking子空间的群体活跃成分，并推导出离散和连续时间下的松弛定律，给出了泛化时间的显式迭代尺度预测，在弱正则化区域恢复了熟悉的(1-β)/(ηλ)标度。理论还区分了耦合L2正则化与解耦权重衰减的效果，并在合成模型和模加法任务中验证了所有理论预测。
Motivation: 尽管延迟泛化（grokking）已被广泛实证研究，但其背后的机制仍缺乏理论理解，尤其是精确可解的分析。
Method: 分析使用全批量heavy-ball优化和权重衰减的线性模型的精确可解松弛机制，并扩展到非线性神经网络的局部二次近似；通过识别grokking子空间，推导出离散和连续时间下的松弛定律。
Result: 理论恢复了(1-β)/(ηλ)标度；区分了优化器选择（耦合L2正则化与解耦权重衰减）的效应；在合成模型和模加法任务中验证了延迟时间标度和迟滞松弛的精确预测，且无拟合参数。
Conclusion: 理论为grokking提供了精确可解的解释，并给出了可干预的因果预测，实验与之高度一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Development of Vision-Language Model-based GNSS Spoofing Detection for Autonomous Vehicle Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) depend on Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) for localization and navigation, making them vulnerable to spoofing attacks that can covertly redirect vehicles or induce unsafe maneuvers. In this paper, we develop the first Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based framework for GNSS spoofing detection for autonomous vehicles by fusing front-camera visual data with in-vehicle sensor readings (e.g., speed, acceleration, yaw rate) against GNSS-derived maneuvers. Our approach introduces a three-stage fine-tuning process that first grounds visual cues, and then calibrates sensor data within a shared semantic space to detect discrepancies between predicted and GNSS-derived maneuvers across three attack scenarios. We also generated an independent real-world dataset by driving an instrumented vehicle on public roads in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, equipped with time-synchronized GNSS, IMU, and camera logs to validate cross-regional generalization of our fine-tuned model on unseen data from training data. On this dataset, we then generated intelligent spoofing attacks, including trajectory mirroring with road-network snapping for wrong-turn attacks, position freezing for overshoot scenarios, and drift generation for stop attacks. On this validation dataset, the zero-shot VLMs baseline F1-score ranges from 23% to 32%, whereas our fine-tuned model achieves an F1-score ranging from 94% to 95%. Results show that our VLM-based approach correctly classified every wrong-turn and stop attacks, and attains 88%-93% accuracy for overshoot attacks. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive inference policy that reduces VLM invocations to 14% (~86% computational reduction) and yields 65ms-73ms per 4s window. These results point to a practical, on-road layer of defense that complements signal-level integrity checks with the use of VLMs.

papers.title: RODR: Riemannian Orthogonally Decoupled Regularization for Disentangled Manifold Representation
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud denoising is essentially a geometric recovery task that aims to reconstruct the intrinsic structure of a smooth 2D Riemannian manifold embedded in R^3 from noisy, discrete ambient-space samples. Despite the remarkable progress of modern manifold-aware encoders and generative transport models in geometric representation learning, a fundamental objective-geometry mismatch remains underexplored. Theoretically, we identified that this mismatched coupling leads to geometric gradient interference, where conflicting optimization objectives result in structural degradation and point clustering. We introduce Riemannian Orthogonally Decoupled Regularization (RODR) to reformulate the optimization trajectory by disentangling the normal (fitting) and tangential (distribution) components. Guided by a vector-attention and entropy-aware adaptive strategy, RODR effectively preserves high-fidelity geometric details while maintaining sampling uniformity. Experiments demonstrate that RODR reaches performance comparable to state-of-the-art baselines and suggests improved distribution regularity and reduced local aggregation effectively. Our work establishes a generic and interpretable framework for disentangled geometric optimization in point cloud processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出点云去噪中几何恢复任务存在目标-几何不匹配问题，导致几何梯度干扰和结构退化。提出黎曼正交解耦正则化（RODR），通过分离法向（拟合）和切向（分布）分量来重构优化轨迹，结合向量注意力和熵感知自适应策略，在保持高保真几何细节的同时维持采样均匀性。实验显示RODR达到与SOTA相当的性能，并改善分布规律性、减少局部聚集。
Motivation: 现有流形感知编码器和生成传输模型在几何表示学习中存在根本性的目标-几何不匹配，导致几何梯度干扰和结构退化。
Method: 提出黎曼正交解耦正则化（RODR），通过分离法向（拟合）和切向（分布）分量来解耦优化，并采用向量注意力和熵感知自适应策略引导。
Result: 实验显示RODR达到与SOTA基线相当的性能，并有效改善分布规律性、减少局部聚集。
Conclusion: 本文为点云处理中的解耦几何优化建立了通用且可解释的框架。

papers.title: EviBack: Search-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Evidence-Constrained Teacher Backoff
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables Agentic RAG systems to learn multi-turn search from verifiable outcome rewards, but all- zero rollout groups provide no comparative signal and may hide useful search behavior. We present EviBack, an evidence- constrained Teacher backoff that supplies auxiliary super- vision to such groups while preserving verifiable Actor re- wards. It separates evidence assessment from answer refine- ment, preventing reference answers from overriding evidence- insufficiency judgments. A fully automated, end-to-end GPT- 5.5-assisted APE pipeline starts from a manually authored single-prompt dual-task Teacher, automatically partitions and labels rollout data, and performs ablation, task decomposition, evaluation, and selection to produce a gated two-stage Teacher. Compared with the manual design, the resulting Teacher im- proves downstream F1 and valid-answer rate while reduc- ing search, duplicate queries, and forced termination. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks and three Qwen3 scales, EviBack improves F1 over Search-R1 and raises both single- and multi-hop macro F1. We guarantee that the code will be made publicly available at a later stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EviBack，一种证据约束的教师退避方法，用于增强基于强化学习的Agentic RAG系统。该方法在无有效奖励信号的零奖励组中提供辅助监督，分离证据评估与答案精化，并通过自动化的APE流程生成门控两阶段教师。在七个开放域QA基准和三个Qwen3尺度上，EviBack提升了F1分数、有效回答率，减少了搜索次数、重复查询和强制终止。
Motivation: 现有的强化学习驱动的Agentic RAG系统在多轮搜索中，全零奖励组缺乏对比信号，可能隐藏有用行为。
Method: 提出EviBack，包含证据约束的教师退避机制，分离证据评估与答案精化，并通过全自动GPT-5.5辅助的APE流程，从手动编写的单提示双任务教师自动生成门控两阶段教师。
Result: 在七个开放域QA基准和三个Qwen3尺度上，相比Search-R1，EviBack提升了F1分数、有效回答率，减少了搜索次数、重复查询和强制终止。
Conclusion: EviBack通过证据约束的教师退避和自动教师生成，提升了Agentic RAG系统的搜索效率与答案质量。代码将在后续公开。

papers.title: TimePLE: Rethinking Temporal Representation for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the continuous video interval described by a natural-language query. However, current VLM-based methods typically produce this interval indirectly through two endpoint outputs, represented either as discrete timestamp tokens or continuous boundary coordinates. These formulations differ in how endpoints are encoded, but not in what is predicted: the event interval remains a derived object, while interval validity, duration, and interval-level similarity are handled only implicitly. We propose TimePLE, which reformulates VTG from endpoint prediction to interval-native grounding by predicting a single joint distribution over valid temporal intervals. TimePLE maps each interval to a point in a canonical position-duration square, where every support point corresponds to a valid span and neighboring points represent geometrically similar intervals. Given a video and query, the VLM generates a single latent <|TIMESPAN|> token whose hidden state is decoded into a joint interval distribution, refined through duration-aware coordinate correction, and converted into continuous boundaries. The same interval representation is used to encode input temporal anchors, aligning video-side temporal evidence with output-side span prediction. To reliably align the latent span representation with complete event intervals, we curate 90K-scale grounded samples and human-verify 3K-scale benchmark annotations. Experiments across four VTG benchmarks show that TimePLE consistently outperforms endpoint prediction baselines, achieving an average mIoU of 58.9, with clear gains on short-duration and medium-duration events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TimePLE，将视频时间定位（VTG）从端点预测重新定义为区间原生预测，通过预测一个单一的有效时间区间上的联合分布。TimePLE将每个区间映射到规范位置-持续时间正方形，使用潜在<|TIMESPAN|>令牌解码并细化。在四个VTG基准上平均mIoU达到58.9，在短/中持续时间事件上增益明显。
Motivation: 当前基于VLM的VTG方法通常通过两个端点输出间接产生区间，区间有效性、持续时间和区间级别相似性仅被隐式处理，缺乏对区间本身的直接建模。
Method: 提出TimePLE，将VTG转化为区间原生任务：预测一个联合分布；将区间映射到位置-持续时间正方形；生成潜在<|TIMESPAN|>令牌并解码为区间分布，经持续时间感知坐标校正后输出边界；同时用相同表示编码输入时间锚点。
Result: 在四个VTG基准上，TimePLE一致优于端点预测基线，平均mIoU达58.9，在短/中持续时间事件上增益明显。
Conclusion: 区间原生预测范式比端点预测更有效，通过联合分布和统一的区间表示实现了更准确的视频时间定位。

papers.title: Joint Flow Matching for Generator-Consistent Classification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Joint Flow Matching (JFM), a training framework for continuous normalising flows over multiple variables. Standard flow matching transports variables from noise to data simultaneously, offering no natural mechanism for forward and reverse conditional inference from a shared joint model. JFM resolves this by assigning opposite roles to each variable at the temporal endpoints. We prove that JFM produces a consistent joint distribution where that forward or reverse integration are conditionals of the same joint. We explore this consistency in the context of joint classification and generation as the basis for interpretability in discriminative-generative models. We validate JFM on conditional datasets producing competitive accuracy with inherently well-calibrated confidence scores without post-hoc calibration, and classifier-consistent image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联合流匹配（Joint Flow Matching, JFM），一种用于多变量连续归一化流的训练框架。JFM通过给每个变量在时间端点分配相反角色，使前向和反向积分成为同一个联合分布的条件分布，从而实现一致的联合分布。在条件数据集上，JFM在分类任务中取得了竞争性准确率，置信度校准良好，无需事后校准，并能生成与分类器一致的图像。
Motivation: 标准流匹配同时将变量从噪声变换到数据，缺乏从共享联合模型进行前向和反向条件推理的自然机制。
Method: 提出JFM框架，在时间端点给每个变量分配相反角色，证明由此产生的流模型能够保持联合分布的一致性。
Result: 在条件数据集上，JFM分类准确率具有竞争力，置信度天然校准，无需事后校准；同时支持分类器一致的图像生成。
Conclusion: JFM为判别-生成模型的可解释性提供了基础，能够在一个框架内同时实现分类与生成。

papers.title: DICA: Dual-Indicator Guided Contrastive Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human visual reasoning typically follows a coarse-to-fine attention process, starting from global scene understanding and gradually focusing on question-relevant regions. However, multimodal large language models may deviate from this pattern due to attention drift and the underutilization of visual evidence, which can lead to hallucinations. To mitigate these issues, this study proposes a Dual-Indicator Guided Contrastive Alignment (DICA), which tracks two information-theoretic indicators during inference: Visual Attention Entropy (VAE), which reflects the concentration of visual attention, and Output Image Correlation (OIC), which measures the dependence of generated outputs on the visual input. An abnormal increase in VAE or a decrease in OIC corresponds to different failure modes, which trigger targeted contrastive alignment to restore visual grounding. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DICA consistently outperforms existing approaches and substantially reduces hallucinations, highlighting the effectiveness of indicator-driven intervention in improving multimodal inference reliability. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/BGWH123/DICA/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双指标引导对比对齐（DICA），通过追踪视觉注意力熵和输出图像相关性两个信息论指标，在推理时检测异常并触发对比对齐以恢复视觉基础，从而减少多模态大语言模型中的幻觉。实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉推理中因注意力漂移和视觉证据利用不足而产生幻觉，偏离人类从全局到局部的粗到细注意过程。
Method: 提出DICA方法，在推理过程中计算两个指标：视觉注意力熵（VAE）反映视觉注意集中度，输出图像相关性（OIC）度量生成输出对视觉输入的依赖；根据指标异常（VAE升高或OIC降低）触发目标对比对齐。
Result: 在多个基准上DICA一致优于现有方法，显著减少幻觉。
Conclusion: 指标驱动的干预能有效提升多模态推理的可靠性。代码已公开。

papers.title: From Cognitive Architectures to Language Agents: A Mechanism-Level Review of Lineage, Convergence, and Migration Gaps
papers.abstract_en: Memory, planning, reflection, and tool use are often compared as feature labels, obscuring the control semantics that determine how an agent actually runs. This review connects ten historical cognitive architectures, eight language-agent runtime families, and forty-two mechanism-focused modern systems. We reconstruct each mechanism through state, control, transition, persistence, failure, learning, and resource governance, then code evidence relation (E1-E4) separately from migration depth (D0-D4). The resulting landscape is uneven. Modern agents have operationalized substantial parts of adaptive memory, failure recovery, dynamic team selection, workflow search, skill induction, resource scheduling, and uncertainty-conditioned action, although often through independent convergence rather than documented inheritance. The strongest remaining opportunities lie in couplings among mechanisms. Closest-baseline screening closes one proposed gap: GraSP already combines calibrated multi-skill selection, typed compilation, verification, bounded repair, and replanning or ReAct fallback. Five residual bundles remain: activation with latency and action utility; typed impasse with isolated substates and resolution compilation; bounded content competition with broadcast and admission learning; persistent intention with reconsideration and live method authority; and uncertainty with resource allocation, interruption, and stopping. We contribute a distinctive-mechanism catalog, an auditable evidence-depth framework, and a falsifiable agenda for testing these bundles as composable runtime invariants.

papers.title: Variational Boosting for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve differential equations by minimizing the residual of a nonlinear operator over a neural parameterization of the solution. However, monolithic PINNs often suffer from ill-conditioning, spectral bias, and optimization instability. We introduce a variational boosting framework in which solutions are constructed additively in function space. Each stage trains a weak learner whose converged correction satisfies a local orthogonality condition, equivalent to a projected functional gradient descent step onto the tangent space of the network's function manifold. Because each correction network is deliberately small, the restricted minimization admits full Newton or conjugate gradient updates, which are typically infeasible in large PINNs. The resulting method separates global nonlinear refinement into a sequence of well-conditioned subproblems while preserving the full variational structure of the operator. This framework provides a geometric interpretation of multi-stage PINNs as projected functional gradient descent and enables stable second-order optimization for nonlinear differential equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分提升框架（Variational Boosting）用于物理信息神经网络（PINNs），通过函数空间中的加性构造，将全局非线性优化分解为一系列良态子问题。每个阶段训练一个小型弱学习器，其收敛校正满足局部正交条件，等价于在网络的函数流形切空间上的投影梯度下降。该方法使得在大规模PINNs中通常不可行的完整牛顿或共轭梯度更新变得可行，保持了算子的完整变分结构。
Motivation: 传统PINNs面临病态、谱偏和优化不稳定的问题。
Method: 提出变分提升框架：在每个阶段训练一个弱学习器，使其收敛校正满足局部正交条件，这等价于在函数流形切空间上的投影梯度下降。通过使用小型网络，可以采用完整牛顿或共轭梯度更新。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法将全局非线性优化分解为一系列良态子问题，并实现了非线性微分方程的稳定二阶优化。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了多阶段PINNs作为投影函数梯度下降的几何解释，并使得二阶优化在非线性微分方程中可行。

papers.title: Manifold-Constrained Noise Optimization for Diverse Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Few-step distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images quickly, but often lose per-prompt diversity, producing near-identical samples across random seeds. Optimizing the initial noise at inference time offers an appealing way to recover this diversity, yet existing methods directly update the initial noise in an unconstrained Euclidean space, ignoring both the geometry of the Gaussian prior and the model's sensitivity to noise frequencies. They therefore introduce auxiliary quality-control objectives to maintain generation fidelity, adding compute and weighting hyperparameters while still requiring conservative updates to prevent degradation. In this work, we propose MoNO, a training-free method that performs Manifold-constrained Noise Optimization on a low-dimensional, quality-stabilizing noise manifold. MoNO sequentially optimizes each new initial noise so that its predicted visual feature complements previous generations, while Riemannian updates on an affine low-frequency sphere preserve prior likelihood and fix unstable high-frequency components by construction. This enables large geodesic steps, removes the need for auxiliary quality-control objectives, and converges in far fewer iterations than prior noise-optimization methods. Experiments with multiple distilled text-to-image diffusion models show that MoNO consistently improves per-prompt diversity while maintaining image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对少步蒸馏扩散模型在相同提示下生成样本多样性不足的问题，提出一种无需训练的噪声优化方法 MoNO。该方法在保持图像质量的同时，通过 Riemannian 优化约束低频噪声流形，逐步生成互补的视觉特征，从而显著提升提示内的多样性。实验在多个蒸馏文生图模型上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有的少步扩散模型虽然生成速度快，但往往缺乏每提示的多样度，同一提示下不同随机种子生成的结果近乎相同。传统的推理时噪声优化方法在无约束欧氏空间中进行，忽视高斯先验几何结构和模型对噪声频率的敏感性，因此需要辅助质量控制目标，增加了计算和超参数调优成本。
Method: 提出 MoNO，一种基于流形约束的噪声优化方法。首先构建一个低维、质量稳定的噪声流形（低频仿射球），然后在新样本的初始噪声上进行 Riemannian 优化，使其预测的视觉特征与已有生成样本互补。该方法保证先验似然，固定高频不稳定分量，从而实现大 geodesic 步长，无需辅助质量控制目标，收敛速度快。
Result: 在多个蒸馏文生图模型上，MoNO 一致提升了每提示的多样性，同时保持了图像质量。相比先前的噪声优化方法，迭代次数更少，且不需要额外控制目标。
Conclusion: MoNO 是一种简单有效的训练后方法，可以恢复少步扩散模型丢失的多样性，无需修改模型或引入辅助损失。

papers.title: DECAF: De-Clustering for Adaptive Representational Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning, which aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a trained model, is a key requirement for privacy, accountability, and adaptive deployment. We argue that many unlearning methods are vulnerable to a simple clustering attack, which can recover class structure in an unsupervised manner, limiting their suitability for continual deployment where removal requests must be handled reliably on demand. To address this, we propose DECAF (DE-Clustering for Adaptive Forgetting), a post-hoc method that operates only on the forget set and is designed to break the cluster. DECAF combines input noise, confidence suppression, and entropy-based output diversification to disrupt the residual feature-space structure associated with forgotten data. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, DECAF attains 0.10% forget-class accuracy, 79.4% retain accuracy, and an AUS of 0.88, surpassing all other baselines. In cluster-based analysis, it attains performance comparable to that of unlearning methods that use the full training set, while being significantly more efficient. Code: https://github.com/ale256/representation_unlearning.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026 CATS Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DECAF方法，一种后处理的机器遗忘技术，旨在打破遗忘数据在特征空间中的聚类结构，防止无监督聚类攻击恢复类别信息。在CIFAR-10和ResNet-18上，DECAF实现了0.10%的遗忘类别准确率、79.4%的保留准确率和0.88的AUS，优于其他基线。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法易受聚类攻击，该攻击可无监督恢复类别结构，限制了在需要可靠处理删除请求的持续部署场景中的适用性。
Method: DECAF是一种仅基于遗忘集的后处理方法，通过结合输入噪声、置信度抑制和基于熵的输出多样化来破坏与遗忘数据相关的残差特征空间结构。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和ResNet-18上，DECAF达到0.10%的遗忘类别准确率、79.4%的保留准确率和0.88的AUS，性能优于所有其他基线，且与使用完整训练集的遗忘方法相当但更高效。
Conclusion: DECAF通过去聚类实现了自适应的表示遗忘，有效抵御聚类攻击，同时保持较高的保留准确率和效率。

papers.title: SpecBox: Speculative Sandbox Scheduling for Efficient LLM Agent Serving
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly rely on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to invoke isolated external sandboxes, disaggregated sandbox deployment introduces a fundamental tension between resource utilization and interactive tail latency. Persistent long-lived sandbox reservations incur excessive memory overhead at scale, while lazy on-demand instantiation generates severe cold-start penalties that degrade response performance under multi-tenant, multi-turn agent workloads. To resolve this dilemma, we present SpecBox, a runtime built around speculative sandbox preallocation tailored for dynamic LLM agent execution pipelines. At its core, SpecBox implements keyword matching and streaming semantic embedding to enable intent-driven sandbox prewarming, which identifies pending tool execution demands mid-LLM token generation and fully overlaps sandbox bootstrapping with model inference. To extend prewarming windows across sequential agent steps, the framework leverages context-aware stochastic prefetching atop a sandbox dependency graph to probabilistically forecast future sandbox switches ahead of execution. We complement these speculative mechanisms with two orthogonal optimizations: a semantic result cache that prunes redundant repeated sandbox invocations, and a dedicated out-of-band shared-memory transport plane that bypasses conventional network serialization to deliver zero-copy artifact transfers. Evaluated on high-concurrency multi-turn agent traces, our prototype demonstrates that SpecBox cuts P99 end-to-end latency by up to $2.9\times$ relative to the on-demand sandbox baseline, while slashing peak memory consumption by $45.9\%$ compared to permanently reserved sandbox deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecBox，一种针对 LLM agent 服务中沙箱预分配（speculative sandbox preallocation）的运行时系统。核心是通过关键词匹配和流式语义嵌入实现意图驱动的沙箱预热，将沙箱启动与模型推理重叠；结合上下文感知的随机预取、语义结果缓存和共享内存传输层。实验表明，相比按需沙箱，P99 端到端延迟降低至 1/2.9，峰值内存消耗相比永久预留减少 45.9%。
Motivation: LLM agent 依赖 MCP 调用隔离的外部沙箱时，资源利用率与交互尾延迟之间存在根本矛盾：持久预留开销大，按需实例化冷启动惩罚严重。
Method: 提出 SpecBox，包含：1) 基于关键词匹配和流式语义嵌入的意图驱动沙箱预热，在 token 生成期间预测工具需求；2) 基于沙箱依赖图的上下文感知随机预取；3) 语义结果缓存避免冗余调用；4) 带外共享内存传输层实现零拷贝工件传输。
Result: 在高并发多轮 agent 轨迹测试中，SpecBox 相比按需沙箱基线将 P99 端到端延迟降低至 1/2.9，同时相比永久预留沙箱削减峰值内存消耗 45.9%。
Conclusion: SpecBox 通过推测性预调度有效缓解了 LLM agent 服务中沙箱预留与冷启动的权衡问题，显著提升了性能与资源效率。

papers.title: MemTX: Transactional Belief Commit for Stateful Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly coordinate through persistent shared memory: one agent's write becomes another agent's premise, and eventually a tool call with real side effects. Current agent memory systems treat every accepted write as immediately actionable truth, so a polluted tool result, a stale update, or a teammate's half-finished note can silently drive an irreversible action. We argue that a memory write is not a belief commit. We present MemTX, a transactional belief-commit protocol. Each record carries evidence, permissions, provenance, and validity. Writes are staged inside snapshot-isolated transactions and admitted by a validate-and-commit pipeline, irreversible tool calls are gated on in-flight belief state, and retracting a belief triggers typed cascading repair of its derived records and tool side effects. Two invariants, action-safety gating and cascade-repair completeness, are machine-checked by property-based testing and bounded exhaustive enumeration of 5.5 million protocol states, with zero violations. Across five backbones from three model families, MemTX leads all eight baselines with paired-McNemar significance on four backbones and statistically ties the best baseline on the fifth and strongest, while remaining the only method with zero downstream harm on every backbone. Backbone capability does not substitute for commit discipline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemTX，一种面向有状态智能体记忆的事务性信念提交协议。当前智能体记忆系统将每次写入视为立即生效的真理，导致被污染的结果或过时更新可能触发不可逆操作。MemTX 为每条记录携带证据、权限、来源和有效性，写入通过快照隔离的事务和验证-提交流水线，不可逆工具调用受待定信念状态门控，信念撤回触发类型化的级联修复。通过属性测试和 550 万状态的有界穷举枚举验证了两个不变式（动作安全门控和级联修复完整性），未发现违反。在五个 backbone 上，MemTX 在所有八个基线中领先，且是唯一在所有 backbone 上零下游危害的方法。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统缺乏信念提交的语义，写入即被视为事实，可能导致不可逆工具调用基于错误或过时信息，缺乏安全性保障。
Method: 提出事务性信念提交协议，设计记录携带证据、权限、来源和有效性；写入通过快照隔离事务和验证-提交管线；工具调用受待定信念状态门控；信念撤回触发类型化级联修复。
Result: 通过属性测试和 550 万状态穷举枚举验证了两个不变式，零违反。在五个 backbone 上，MemTX 在所有八个基线中领先，且是唯一在所有 backbone 上零下游危害的方法。
Conclusion: MemTX 通过事务性信念提交协议提升了智能体记忆的安全性和可靠性，证明 backbone 能力不能替代提交纪律。

papers.title: Reality Monitoring in Large Language Models: Self-Knowledge That Transforms with Conversation Memory
papers.abstract_en: A conversational AI that cannot tell its own output from what a user said will treat its own mistakes as user-provided facts. In humans, this capacity is called reality monitoring, and its failures are linked to hallucinations, delusions, and confabulation, yet whether LLMs possess it remains untested. Here we show, across two experiments and six LLMs, that source attribution depends on how conversational memory is structured: ceiling accuracy for self-generated content under minimal memory demands reverses to a fragile external-item advantage once episodic delay removes that shortcut. Feedback exposes two failures: in some models, internal and external judgments swap; in others, accuracy improves while confidence decouples from correctness, dissociations invisible to existing benchmarks. Across models, this pattern implicates active, not aggregate, parameter count. This suggests that as AI systems take on autonomous, multi-turn roles, evaluating what they know is not enough: tracking where that knowledge came from may matter equally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两项实验和六个大型语言模型（LLMs）研究现实监控能力，即模型区分自身输出与用户输入的能力。结果表明，源归因准确率严重依赖于对话记忆结构：在最小记忆需求下对自生成内容准确率极高，而加入情节延迟后则反转，出现外部记忆优势。反馈揭示两种失败模式：有些模型的内外部判断互换，另一些模型准确率提高但置信度与正确性解耦，这些在现有基准中不可见。该模式与活跃参数量而非总参数量相关。
Motivation: 对话AI若无法区分自身输出与用户输入，就会把自身错误当作用户提供的事实。人类的现实监控失败与幻觉、妄想和虚构相关，但LLMs是否具备此能力尚未被测试。
Method: 设计两项实验，跨六个LLMs，通过操纵对话记忆结构（最小记忆需求 vs. 情节延迟）来测试源归因准确率，并引入反馈干预。
Result: 在最小记忆需求下，模型对自生成内容准确率极高；情节延迟后转为外部记忆优势。反馈导致部分模型内外部判断互换，另一些模型准确率提升但置信度与正确性解耦。
Conclusion: 随着AI系统承担自主的多轮对话角色，仅评估它们知道什么不够，追踪知识来源可能同样重要。该模式暗示活跃参数量而非总参数量是关键因素。

papers.title: Greedy dynamical meta-learning
papers.abstract_en: Gradient descent scales well to large models, but becomes unstable over long time horizons. Gradient-free optimizers can scale to arbitrary timespans, but are hobbled by high dimensions. Since learning occurs in large models over long timescales, neither of these approaches is likely to produce traits which can accelerate the learning process. Instead, we propose a meta-learning algorithm in which the agent learns to modify its own weights and biases. Our algorithm consists of an inner loop, wherein the agent performs some high-dimensional optimization upon itself, and an outer loop, wherein we perform some low-dimensional optimization upon the inner loop. Since the outer loop handles very few parameters, standard zeroth-order methods may be used.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种贪心动态元学习算法，通过内外循环优化实现模型自身的权重和偏置调整。内循环执行高维优化，外循环使用低维零阶方法处理少量参数，旨在结合梯度方法的高维扩展性和零阶方法的长时稳定性。
Motivation: 梯度下降在大规模模型上扩展性好但长期不稳定，而梯度自由优化器可处理任意时间跨度但受限于高维问题。现有方法难以同时满足长期学习和高维需求。
Method: 提出双层元学习框架：内循环中智能体对自身进行高维优化，外循环使用标准零阶方法优化内循环的少量参数。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅描述算法设计目标。
Conclusion: 该方法通过外循环低维优化避免了高维零阶方法的局限性，有望在长期学习任务中结合两种优化范式的优势。

papers.title: DuoAD: Leveraging [CLS] Dual Characteristics for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models have enabled strong training-free anomaly detection (AD). However, most existing approaches rely primarily on independent local patch features, leaving the global contextual information encoded by Vision Transformers (ViTs) underexploited. In this work, we identify the dual characteristics of the ViT [CLS] token: its embedding provides anomaly-invariant global semantic representation, while its attention maps implicitly highlight spatially abnormal regions. Building on this observation, we propose a fully automated AD framework leveraging global context to remove manual tunings. Our framework introduces (1) an automatic augmentation selection strategy driven by [CLS]-level semantic consistency, and (2) an attention-guided feature reweighting mechanism that dynamically adjusts patch contributions according to [CLS] attention saliency. By integrating these components over multi-level features, our method achieves stable anomaly scoring and precise localization without training or parameter tuning. Under the one-shot setting, it achieves Image-AUC scores of 97.7%, 93.2%, and 84.5% on MVTec-AD, VisA, and Real-IAD. Using a single fixed configuration across categories, backbones, and datasets, the method establishes a new state-of-the-art for plug-and-play, training-free anomaly detection while maintaining strong robustness and practical scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉Transformer [CLS] token双重特性的无训练小样本异常检测框架DuoAD。该框架利用[CLS] token的全局语义不变性和注意力图的异常定位能力，通过自动增强选择和注意力引导特征重新加权，实现无需调参的稳定异常评分与定位。在单样本设置下，MVTec-AD、VisA和Real-IAD上Image-AUC分别达到97.7%、93.2%和84.5%。
Motivation: 现有无训练异常检测方法主要依赖独立局部补丁特征，忽略了ViT编码的全局上下文信息，导致性能受限且需要手动调参。
Method: 提出基于[CLS] token双重特性的框架：1）基于[CLS]语义一致性的自动增强选择策略；2）注意力引导的特征重新加权机制，根据[CLS]注意力显著图动态调整补丁贡献。整合多级特征实现无需训练的异常评分与定位。
Result: 单样本设置下，在MVTec-AD、VisA和Real-IAD上Image-AUC分别为97.7%、93.2%和84.5%。使用单一固定配置跨类别、骨干网络和数据集，达到了即插即用、无训练异常检测的最新最优水平。
Conclusion: 框架完全自动，无需手动调参，在保持强鲁棒性和实用可扩展性的同时，为无训练异常检测建立了新的基准。

papers.title: DDVT: Dynamic Dual-level Vision Transformer Fusion Network for Answer Grounding in Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Answer grounding in visual question answering aims to locate the region from a given natural language question associated with the visual content of an image, which has garnered significant attention due to its practical applications. In this paper, we introduce the Dynamic Dual-level Vision Transformer Fusion Network (DDVT) for answer grounding in visual question answering. Specifically, we propose a question-guided dynamic regional-level module (QGDR) that combines complementary image context through ROI Align and text content, enabling precise localization of text-related visual content. Moreover, we present a cross-modal multi-scale aggregation module (CMA) that enhances feature fusion between pixel-level and region-level features, facilitating the effective localization of visual content associated with grounded answers. Furthermore, we fuse the located visual content with text features to locate the region and provide answers to questions posed about the image. Experimental results demonstrate that our DDVT outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several widely-used benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态双层视觉Transformer融合网络（DDVT）用于视觉问答中的答案定位任务。该方法通过问题引导的动态区域级模块（QGDR）结合ROI Align和文本内容实现精确的区域定位，并利用跨模态多尺度聚合模块（CMA）增强像素级与区域级特征的融合。实验表明DDVT在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 视觉问答中的答案定位需要从图像中定位与问题相关的区域，现有方法在结合文本内容和视觉上下文方面存在不足。
Method: 提出DDVT，包含问题引导的动态区域级模块（QGDR）和跨模态多尺度聚合模块（CMA），前者通过ROI Align融合互补图像上下文与文本内容，后者增强像素级与区域级特征融合。
Result: 在多个广泛使用的基准上，DDVT优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: DDVT通过动态双层融合有效提升了视觉问答中答案定位的准确性。

papers.title: What Can I Edit? Open-Ended Strategy Discovery and the Emotion Editability Landscape
papers.abstract_en: Emotional image editing requires more than applying affective filters or modifying predefined visual factors: an effective edit must identify what a particular image can afford for a target emotion. Existing affective image manipulation methods, including recent agentic variants, largely operate within bounded strategy spaces based on predefined factor taxonomies, knowledge libraries, or conventional editing templates, and therefore often miss image-specific, context-grounded strategies. We introduce EmoScope, a multi-agent framework that reframes the task from "how should I edit?" to "what can I edit?" EmoScope first discovers an image-specific editable space through emotion-conditioned affordance reasoning, then uses a semantic hierarchy of anchors, variables, and context to balance content consistency and emotional expressiveness before executing and verifying the edit. Because its plans are expressed as image-specific affordances rather than retrieved templates, EmoScope also exposes the editing strategy as an interactive surface for user refinement at the plan level. In a large-scale human evaluation covering all eight Mikels emotion categories, with 4,693 valid responses across 1,824 pairwise questions, participants preferred EmoScope over two competitive baselines by 88.1% on average. Attribution analysis further shows that EmoScope selects target-emotion-adaptive strategies rather than applying a uniform template. The same affordance-level plan also supports lightweight user refinement in an interactive pilot. Finally, we show that classifier-based metrics exhibit emotion-conditional blind spots toward non-stereotypical, context-grounded edits, and present a relative content-emotion preference-affinity landscape showing that EmoScope's advantage varies systematically across image-emotion combinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EmoScope多智能体框架，将情感图像编辑从“如何编辑？”重构为“能编辑什么？”。该框架首先通过情感条件affordance推理发现图像特定的可编辑空间，然后利用锚点、变量和上下文的语义层次来平衡内容一致性与情感表达，最后执行并验证编辑。在覆盖Mikels八类情感的大规模人类评估中（1824对问题，4693有效响应），参与者以88.1%的平均偏好率选择EmoScope而非两个竞争基线。归因分析显示EmoScope选择目标情感自适应策略而非统一模板。
Motivation: 现有情感图像编辑方法（包括最近基于智能体的变体）大多在预定义因素分类、知识库或传统编辑模板的有限策略空间内操作，因此常常错过图像特定的、上下文相关的策略。
Method: EmoScope是一个多智能体框架：首先通过情感条件affordance推理发现图像特定的可编辑空间，然后使用锚点、变量和上下文的语义层次来平衡内容一致性与情感表达，最后执行并验证编辑。其计划以图像特定的affordance而非检索模板的形式呈现，支持用户交互式细化。
Result: 在大规模人类评估中（覆盖所有八类Mikels情感类别，1824对问题，4693有效响应），参与者以88.1%的平均偏好率选择EmoScope而非两个竞争基线。归因分析表明EmoScope选择目标情感自适应策略而非统一模板。
Conclusion: EmoScope通过开放策略发现和交互细化展示了优势，但分类器指标对非刻板、上下文相关编辑存在情感条件盲点；其效果在图像-情感组合间系统变化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: EmoScope是一个多智能体框架：首先通过情感条件affordance推理发现图像特定的可编辑空间，然后使用锚点、变量和上下文的语义层次来平衡内容一致性与情感表达，最后执行并验证编辑。其计划以图像特定的affordance而非检索模板的形式呈现，支持用户交互式细化。
summary_sections.result: 在大规模人类评估中（覆盖所有八类Mikels情感类别，1824对问题，4693有效响应），参与者以88.1%的平均偏好率选择EmoScope而非两个竞争基线。归因分析表明EmoScope选择目标情感自适应策略而非统一模板。
summary_sections.conclusion: EmoScope通过开放策略发现和交互细化展示了优势，但分类器指标对非刻板、上下文相关编辑存在情感条件盲点；其效果在图像-情感组合间系统变化。

papers.title: Gaze-to-text Generation: Beyond Categorical Decoding of Human Attention
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel learning problem: decoding gaze into natural language descriptions of human goals across diverse visual tasks. Unlike prior work, which frames gaze decoding as a discriminative task over predefined categories, we formulate it as a generative learning problem: training a model to produce free-form descriptions that capture the rich nuances and open-ended nature of human intentions beyond fixed labels. To this end, we introduce Gazette, the first gaze-to-text decoding framework. Based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Gazette learns to decode gaze scanpaths into natural language for goals that may extend beyond categorical labels and require articulation in natural language. To help Gazette filter out individual differences in gaze behavior and learn the goal-specific spatiotemporal dynamics crucial for generating accurate natural language goal descriptions, we propose a novel strategy that leverages the encyclopedic knowledge and reasoning abilities of a large language model to synthesize natural language explanations of goal-directed attentional behavior called think-aloud transcripts. Instruction tuning on these synthetic narratives allows Gazette to achieve state-of-the-art performance in gaze decoding across multiple tasks, demonstrating its generalizability and versatility, thereby enabling gaze to serve as a powerful, non-intrusive cue for inferring human goals and intentions in diverse scenarios.
papers.comment: To appear in European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 gaze-to-text 生成任务，旨在将人类注视扫描路径解码为描述目标意图的自由格式自然语言。作者提出 Gazette 框架，基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）并利用合成思维转录进行指令微调，在多个注视解码任务上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有注视解码工作局限于预定义类别的判别式任务，无法捕捉人类意图的丰富性和开放性。
Method: 提出 Gazette 框架，基于 MLLM 学习将注视扫描路径映射为自然语言描述；利用大型语言模型合成目标导向注意行为的自然语言解释（think-aloud transcripts）进行指令微调。
Result: 在多个注视解码任务上达到最先进性能，展示通用性和多样性。
Conclusion: 该方法使注视成为推断人类目标和意图的非侵入性强大线索，适用于多样场景。

papers.title: Understanding Tone-Dependent Inference Cost in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We examine how prompt tone affects both accuracy of the LLM answers and inference cost as reflected in output-token consumption. Experiments were performed to understand the trade-offs between accuracy and inference cost on a 570 Question MMLU dataset for LLM models prompted in seven different tones from sycophantic to threatening. Our results show that the output-token-length variation substantially exceeded accuracy variation across all models. Output-token consumption varied by up to 44.3% across tone conditions. We also analyzed the tradeoff between the accuracy of the answers and the average output token length in the reasoning process. For the ChatGPT models 4o and 5-nano, the rude tone is quite dominant. For the Gemini models 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash Lite, the rude and neutral tones are dominant on the Pareto-optimal frontier. We find that prompt tone influences not only answer quality but also the amount of billable inference resources consumed by modern LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了提示语气（从阿谀奉承到威胁）对GPT和Gemini系列模型在MMLU 570道题上的准确性及推理成本（输出token消耗）的影响。实验发现，语气导致的输出token长度变化高达44.3%，远超过准确性变化，且粗鲁语气在多个模型的帕累托前沿上占优。
Motivation: 大型语言模型的推理成本与输出token数量密切相关，但提示语气对输出长度的潜在影响尚未被系统量化，这可能导致不必要的资源消耗。
Method: 在MMLU数据集上，使用7种不同语气（阿谀奉承、中立、粗鲁等）对ChatGPT 4o/5-nano和Gemini 2.5 Flash/Lite等模型进行提示，记录准确率和输出token长度，并分析帕累托最优边界。
Result: 输出token长度变化最高达44.3%，而准确性变化较小；在ChatGPT模型中粗鲁语气主导帕累托前沿，在Gemini模型中粗鲁和中立语气共同主导。
Conclusion: 提示语气不仅影响答案质量，还显著影响推理资源消耗，在成本敏感场景下应谨慎选择语气。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Phase Transition in Online PCA Depends on $n/d\log(d)$, not $n/d$
papers.abstract_en: High dimensional statistical theory has established the importance of constant aspect ratio, when the number of dimensions ($d$) and samples ($n$) satisfy $n,d\to\infty$ with $n/d\to γ\in(0,\infty)$, in understanding the limits of canonical estimation problems. In particular, for estimating the top eigenvector of a $d\times d$ population covariance matrix from $n$ iid samples, the BBP phase transition gives a precise threshold -- a simple functional of the aspect ratio -- such that the top sample principal component attains nonzero asymptotic correlation with the truth only when the leading population eigenvalue exceeds it. In this paper, we show that for online / streaming algorithms the story is very different, and constant aspect ratio is insufficient for nonzero overlap. We study Oja's algorithm, the most popular method for online PCA. Let $Σ=θ^2 v_0v_0^\top+I\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$, and run Oja's algorithm with step size $δ/d$ on $n$ iid samples $X_k\sim\mathcal{N}(0,Σ)$, with output $\hat v_n$. Then, as $n,d\to\infty$ with $n/d\log d\toγ\in(0,\infty)$, we establish a phase transition: $|\langle\hat v_n,v_0\rangle|\to 0$ when $γ<γ_*$, and $\toρ_*$ when $γ>γ_*$. Here $ρ_*=ρ_*(θ,δ)=\sqrt{(θ^2-δ/2)_+/θ^2(1+δ/2)}$ and $γ_*=γ_*(θ,δ)=1/2δ(θ^2-δ/2)_+$. Further, at criticality, when $n=[γ_*d\log d+ηd]$ and $d\to\infty$, $η\in\mathbb{R}$, the correlation is random: $|\langle\hat v_n,v_0\rangle|\stackrel{w}{\to}ρ_*|G|\exp(η/2γ_*)/\sqrt{ρ_*^4+G^2\exp(η/γ_*)}$ where $G\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1)$. This is in stark contrast to ordinary high dimensional PCA, where nonzero overlap is possible at constant $n/d$ and improves as $n/d$ increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线PCA（Oja算法）的相变现象，发现与经典高维PCA不同，其相变阈值由n/(d log d)决定，而非n/d。具体地，在稀疏模型下，当n/(d log d)超过某个阈值时，输出与真实特征向量的相关性从0跃升至非零常数，且在临界点呈现随机行为。
Motivation: 高维统计理论中常数纵横比n/d对传统PCA相变至关重要，但本文发现对于在线/流式算法，这一条件不足以实现非零重叠，需要更强的条件n/(d log d)。
Method: 理论分析Oja算法在线PCA中的行为，考虑协方差矩阵Σ=θ^2 v0 v0^T + I，步长δ/d，样本数n，维度d，在n,d→∞且n/(d log d)→γ的渐近下推导相变阈值与相关性极限。
Result: 建立了相变：当γ<γ*时，|⟨v̂_n,v0⟩|→0；当γ>γ*时，|⟨v̂_n,v0⟩|→ρ*。其中γ*=1/(2δ(θ^2-δ/2)_+)，ρ*=√((θ^2-δ/2)_+/(θ^2(1+δ/2)))。在临界点n=γ* d log d + η d时，相关性收敛到一个含随机变量G~N(0,1)的分布。
Conclusion: 在线PCA的相变依赖于n/(d log d)而非n/d，这与普通高维PCA完全不同，强调了流式算法在高维统计中的独特性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GOTS: Greedy Orthogonal Token Selection for High-Resolution Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on dynamic or high-resolution visual encoding, producing thousands of visual tokens that substantially increase downstream language-model inference cost. Existing token-reduction methods assess token utility through token-wise importance, query relevance, coverage, pairwise diversity, or subset-level objectives. Our key insight is to view visual token reduction through selected-span complementarity: instead of scoring a token in isolation or through pairwise relations, we assess how much of its feature is orthogonal to the span of the already retained subset. Based on this perspective, we propose Greedy Orthogonal Token Selection (GOTS), a training-free and query-agnostic method. At each step, GOTS selects the token with the largest residual energy orthogonal to the current retained span. This rule exactly maximizes the one-step augmented Gram determinant among candidate additions, giving each greedy step a precise local geometric guarantee for subset expansion. Across five high-resolution VLM backbones from the Qwen-VL and InternVL families and eleven diverse benchmarks, GOTS achieves higher average performance retention than the strongest evaluated baselines, and a controlled OCRBench study shows that it reduces model-side time-to-first-token after accounting for selection overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/newLLing/GOTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出GOTS（贪心正交标记选择），一种无需训练、查询无关的视觉标记缩减方法，用于高分辨率视觉-语言模型（VLM）。方法基于选择跨度互补性，每次选择与已保留子空间正交残差能量最大的标记，最大化一步增广Gram行列式。在五个VLM主干和十一个基准上，GOTS比现有方法保留更高平均性能，并在OCRBench上减少模型端首token时间。
Motivation: 现有VLM在高分辨率下产生大量视觉标记，增加推理成本；现有缩减方法依赖标记重要性、查询相关性或成对多样性，但未充分利用子集级几何互补性。
Method: 提出Greedy Orthogonal Token Selection (GOTS)，一种贪婪算法，每一步选择与当前保留子空间正交的残差能量最大的标记，该规则等价于最大化一步增广Gram行列式，提供局部几何保证。
Result: 在五个VLM（Qwen-VL和InternVL系列）和十一个基准上，GOTS平均性能保留高于最强基线；在OCRBench上，考虑选择开销后减少了模型端首token时间。
Conclusion: GOTS是一种有效的视觉标记缩减方法，通过正交性度量实现贪心选择，在多种高分辨率VLM上取得更好性能-效率权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SimBEV2X: A Large-Scale Dataset and Data Generation Tool for Multi-Task Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative perception through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication can overcome the inherent physical limitations of individual autonomous vehicles, such as occlusions and limited sensor range. However, the development of robust V2X algorithms, particularly those relying on unified spatial representations like bird's-eye view (BEV) representation, is hampered by the lack of large-scale, multi-modal, multi-task datasets. Moreover, collecting and annotating a large set of synchronized, real-world multi-agent data is prohibitively expensive. This has resulted in a landscape where existing V2X datasets are notably limited in both size and scope. To overcome this, we introduce SimBEV2X, an advanced synthetic data generation tool built on the CARLA simulator. SimBEV2X automatically creates randomized driving scenarios to collect multi-modal sensor data alongside various types of ground truth including 3D bounding boxes with unique track IDs, HD map information, BEV segmentation maps, and semantic occupancy voxel grids from both vehicles and RSUs. We also present the SimBEV2X dataset, the largest V2X perception dataset to date. The dataset comprises 258 scenes, each involving up to 8 connected vehicles and up to 4 RSUs across a variety of road networks. The SimBEV2X dataset is an order of magnitude larger than existing V2X datasets and contains 102,200 frames, 588,520 lidar point clouds, more than 3 million images, over 27 million bounding boxes, and a comprehensive set of other annotations. Finally, we establish a strong baseline on the SimBEV2X dataset using CoopDet3D and propose CoBEVFusion, a novel architecture that combines CoopDet3D with fused axial attention (FAX) for context-aware multi-agent feature aggregation, resulting in superior performance. SimBEV2X, the SimBEV2X dataset, and CoBEVFusion are available at https://simbev2x.org and https://github.com/GoodarzMehr/SimBEV2X.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimBEV2X是一个基于CARLA模拟器的大规模合成数据生成工具，用于多任务车联网（V2X）协同感知。作者同时发布了SimBEV2X数据集，据称是当前最大的V2X感知数据集，包含258个场景、102,200帧、超过300万张图像和2700万个边界框。论文还提出CoBEVFusion架构，结合CoopDet3D与轴向注意力（FAX）进行多智能体特征聚合，在数据集上建立了基线。数据集和工具已开源。
Motivation: 现有V2X协同感知数据集在规模和范围上均十分有限，且真实多车同步数据采集标注成本过高，阻碍了基于统一空间表征（如BEV）算法的研发。
Method: 基于CARLA模拟器构建自动随机驾驶场景生成工具SimBEV2X，可采集多模态传感器数据及多种真值标注（3D边界框、高清地图、BEV分割图、语义占用体素网格）。并提出CoBEVFusion架构，通过融合轴向注意力改进CoopDet3D的上下文感知多智能体特征聚合。
Result: SimBEV2X数据集规模比现有V2X数据集大一个数量级，包含258场景、102,200帧、588,520个激光雷达点云、300多万张图像、2700多万个边界框。CoBEVFusion在数据集上取得优越性能。
Conclusion: SimBEV2X提供了大规模、多模态、多任务的V2X协同感知数据集和生成工具，有助于推动该领域研究。数据及代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Many recent robot policies pursue stronger control by using large pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) as the action backbone. We introduce WorldDiT, a unified diffusion transformer architecture that couples action generation with visual world modeling and achieves strong performance without a large pretrained VLM action backbone. During training, a single diffusion transformer generates continuous action chunks and predicts normalized RGB patch targets from future camera frames. Across four LIBERO simulation suites, WorldDiT lies on the reported Pareto frontier for total model parameters and mean success among methods reporting all four suites. These results provide a strong sub-billion-parameter baseline for future scaling studies.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有机器人策略依赖大型预训练VLM作为动作骨干，本文旨在探索无需大型骨干的替代方案，降低对预训练VLM的依赖。
Method: 使用单个扩散Transformer同时生成连续动作块和从未来相机帧预测归一化RGB patch目标，实现动作生成与视觉世界建模的统一。
Result: 在四个LIBERO仿真套件上，WorldDiT位于报告模型的总参数量和平均成功率之间的帕累托前沿，以较少的参数取得竞争力。
Conclusion: 提供了子十亿参数的强基线，为未来扩展研究参考，证明无需大型VLM骨干也能取得良好性能。

papers.title: Embeddings based Anomaly Detection for Cleaning Global Crop Type Reference Datasets
papers.abstract_en: High quality reference data remain a critical bottleneck for crop-type mapping at any spatial and temporal scale. Operational systems such as WorldCereal aggregate labels from heterogeneous sources such as parcel registers, national databases, field surveys, and map-derived products, each with their own biases, coverage gaps and unknown label noise. Simple global rules are inadequate, since crop phenology and observation conditions vary strongly across regions and seasons. In this study, we focus on a single, operationally relevant question: whether embeddings produced through geospatial foundation models are a viable basis for cleaning the reference data. We propose a practical, locality-aware, embedding-based anomaly (EBA) detection framework that operates on the embeddings of a pretrained Earth-observation encoder. We score each labelled sample against other samples of the same crop in the same area using a pretrained embedding, flag the ones that stand out, and test whether removing or down-weighting them before training yields a better model. We establish that the flagged points are genuinely mislabelled or misplaced in two independent ways: against synthetic ground truth, the detector concentrates injected label errors 2.5-5x above chance in its flagged set (detection AUROC up to 0.84); and on real data, a model-independent test shows that removing or confidence-weighting the flagged held-out points raises measured accuracy in trained models, for both crop type and land cover. Acting on the flags then improves the WorldCereal crop-type model across five macro-regions, evaluated on a fixed held-out split under three views. We find conservative cleaning helps while over-cleaning hurts. The EBA detector approach is designed to be reproducible and extensible, and can serve as a template for cleaning large, noisy Earth observation reference datasets beyond crop mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于嵌入的异常检测（EBA）框架，用于清理全球作物类型参考数据集中的标签噪声。该方法利用预训练地球观测编码器的嵌入，对同一区域同一作物的样本进行评分，标记异常点并测试其在训练中移除或降权后的效果。实验表明，该方法在合成数据和真实数据上均能有效识别错误标签，并提升WorldCereal作物类型模型在五个宏观区域的精度。
Motivation: 高质量参考数据是作物类型制图的瓶颈，现有聚合来源（如国家数据库、调查、地图衍生品）存在未知标签噪声，简单全局规则无法适应不同区域和季节的物候差异。
Method: 提出EBA检测框架：使用预训练的地球观测编码器生成每个样本的嵌入，基于同一区域相同作物类型样本的嵌入相似度进行异常评分，标记偏离的样本，并在训练前将其移除或降权。
Result: 在合成数据上，检测器在标记集中集中了2.5-5倍于随机水平的注入标签错误（检测AUROC最高0.84）；在真实数据上，移除或置信度加权标记样本可提高训练模型的准确性。应用该标记后，WorldCereal作物类型模型在五个宏观区域的固定测试集上均有改进。
Conclusion: 保守清理有助于提升模型性能，过度清理则有害。该方法设计为可重复和可扩展，可作为清理大规模噪声地球观测参考数据集的模板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embodied GPT-5.1: Evidence of a World Model?
papers.abstract_en: This exploratory study examines whether a large multimodal language model, GPT-5.1, can serve as the high-level controller of a physical mobile robot despite having no prior embodiment, no training in simulated environments, and no exposure to sensorimotor experience. Using only low-resolution first-person images and a discrete action set, the model was tasked with navigation and object-directed behaviors such as locating and contacting a target toy. Across multiple trials, GPT-5.1 demonstrated emergent capabilities that suggest elements of spatial reasoning and physical understanding. These included maintaining short-term memory of object locations after they left the camera frame, inferring the physical consequences of its own movements, and executing coherent action sequences such as colliding with an object and reversing to visually verify the outcome. At the same time, the model displayed inefficiencies and perceptual limitations, including imprecise alignment strategies and occasional misidentification of distant distractors. Overall, the results indicate that GPT-5.1 exhibits signs of world-model-like behavior in an embodied setting, despite the absence of any embodiment-related training, a finding that challenges long-standing views in cognitive science and robotics which hold that a physical body is a necessary prerequisite for developing such forms of intelligence. The findings motivate deeper investigation into the emergence, limits, and robustness of physical understanding in large language models.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 16 figures. Published in the 2026 Brazilian Conference on Robotics (CROS)
papers.journal_ref: R. Spinelli and T. C. Martins, "Embodied GPT-5.1: Evidence of a World Model?," 2026 Brazilian Conference on Robotics (CROS), pp. 394-399, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索大型多模态语言模型 GPT-5.1 能否在无具身经验、无模拟训练、无传感器历史的情况下控制实体移动机器人。仅依靠低分辨率第一人称图像和离散动作集，模型在导航和物体接触任务中展现出空间记忆、物理推理和连贯动作序列等涌现能力，但也存在对准不精确和感知限制。
Motivation: 挑战“物理身体是发展世界模型的必要前提”的传统观点，探究缺乏具身训练的大语言模型是否仍能展现类似世界模型的行为。
Method: 实验：将 GPT-5.1 作为高层面控制器，输入低分辨率第一人称图像，输出离散动作指令，指挥真实移动机器人完成定位并接触目标玩具等任务。
Result: GPT-5.1 在多次试验中表现出物体位置记忆、自运动后果推断、碰撞后倒退验证等连贯行为，但存在对准不精确、远处干扰物误识别等问题。
Conclusion: 结果暗示 GPT-5.1 在具身场景中显现了世界模型般的迹象，挑战了传统认知科学与机器人学的观点，但需进一步研究物理理解的涌现、局限与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Expert Behavior Prior Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Behavior prior reinforcement learning (BPRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm to improve sample efficiency in online reinforcement learning (RL) by leveraging policy priors derived from offline demonstrations. However, most existing BPRL methods rely on static offline datasets, which often suffer from low data diversity and suboptimal trajectory quality. This reliance restricts the effectiveness of policy priors, hindering both policy exploitation and stability during online training. Consequently, agents are prone to inefficient exploration and unstable learning dynamics. To address these limitations, we deviate from existing offline pre-training methods and propose an Expert Behavior Prior (EBP) algorithm. Specifically, we introduce a Q-guided conditional variational autoencoder (Q-CVAE) that learns to generate expert policy priors directly from the online replay buffer. This enables the generation of high-value actions for guiding policy updates without relying on pre-collected expert trajectories. To further enhance policy exploitation, we propose an expert policy guidance (EPG) mechanism that selects expert actions from a generative support set, and we integrate a policy gradient correction (PGC) module to harmonize Q-guidance with expert supervision, promoting stable and consistent policy improvement. Extensive experiments conducted on robotic control (Gym, PyBullet) and industrial control (DMControl) benchmarks demonstrate that EBP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art online RL algorithms, achieving higher sample efficiency and more stable convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出专家行为先验 (EBP) 算法，通过 Q 引导条件变分自编码器 (Q-CVAE) 直接从在线经验回放池中生成专家策略先验，结合专家策略引导 (EPG) 与策略梯度校正 (PGC) 模块，提升在线强化学习的样本效率与收敛稳定性。在机器人控制与工业控制基准上，EBP 显著优于现有在线 RL 算法。
Motivation: 现有行为先验强化学习 (BPRL) 依赖静态离线数据集，数据多样性低且轨迹质量次优，限制了策略先验的有效性与在线训练稳定性，导致探索低效与学习动力学不稳定。
Method: 提出 EBP 算法：(1) Q 引导条件变分自编码器 (Q-CVAE) 从在线缓冲中生成专家动作先验；(2) 专家策略引导 (EPG) 从生成的支持集中选择专家动作；(3) 策略梯度校正 (PGC) 模块协调 Q 引导与专家监督，促进稳定策略改进。
Result: 在 Gym、PyBullet 与 DMControl 基准上，EBP 在样本效率与收敛稳定性方面显著优于最先进在线 RL 算法。
Conclusion: EBP 通过在线生成专家先验替代离线预训练，有效解决了传统 BPRL 数据质量与多样性的限制，提升了在线 RL 的性能与稳定性。

papers.title: HyperImageNet: A Large-Scale High-Spatial Resolution Hyperspectral Imagery Classification Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We present HyperImageNet, a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained hyperspectral land-cover understanding. The dataset contains 26,084 airborne hyperspectral image patches with 224 spectral bands and 138 fine-grained land-cover categories. Unlike existing datasets, HyperImageNet provides raw imagery, pixel-level semantic labels, and object-level instance masks, supporting both semantic and instance segmentation. Furthermore, we establish an open-environment benchmark with strict spatial separation to evaluate representative methods and the HyperFree foundation model. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of HyperImageNet for fine-grained hyperspectral understanding and open-environment remote sensing research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperImageNet 是一个大规模高光谱遥感图像基准数据集，包含 26,084 个高光谱图像块，224 个光谱波段，138 个细粒度地物类别，并提供像素级语义标签和实例级掩码，支持语义分割和实例分割。论文还建立了开放环境基准，评估了代表性方法和 HyperFree 基础模型，实验表明该数据集在细粒度高光谱理解和开放环境遥感研究中有效。
Motivation: 现有高光谱数据集在规模、空间分辨率和标注粒度上存在不足，缺乏同时支持语义和实例分割的基准，限制了细粒度地物理解研究。
Method: 构建了 HyperImageNet 数据集，包含大量航空高光谱图像块和精细标注，并在此基础上设计开放环境基准，评估了包括 HyperFree 在内的多个方法。
Result: 实验结果表明 HyperImageNet 能有效支持细粒度高光谱理解任务，为开放环境遥感研究提供了新基准。
Conclusion: HyperImageNet 可作为高光谱遥感图像精细分类和分割的标准测试平台，促进该领域发展。

papers.title: The Weight of Silence: A Causal Case for Weights Over the Scratchpad in Latent Chess Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent, or silent, reasoning lets language models carry out intermediate computation in continuous vector space instead of words, and is widely assumed to function as an internal scratchpad the model consults during inference. Whether that assumption survives reinforcement learning has not been tested directly: existing causal analyses of latent reasoning are confined to math and logic tasks, comparing reliance on thoughts within one checkpoint, never before and after RL. We train a chess-playing model through a staged latent-reasoning curriculum followed by reinforcement learning, and find legality climbs monotonically to 61% (from a 48% pre-RL baseline) while checkmate confabulation is eliminated entirely. To locate this gain, we run a six-condition causal intervention suite on the same model before and after RL: substituting or noising the thought vectors leaves performance unchanged, ablating them costs only mild degradation, and only exact-zero vectors cause collapse. This robustness gap is itself the finding: under exact-zero corruption, legality collapses to 1% pre-RL versus 9% post-RL, a gap that survives correction across the full battery. A 10x-larger replication of the post-RL checkpoint's own battery confirms this: removing the thoughts, with or without restoring sequence length, also reaches significance; substitution and noise remain indistinguishable from baseline. RL appears to add robustness to disruption, not reliance on thought content. These results push back against the field's default assumption that latent thoughts function as an actively consulted inference-time scratchpad, and instead indicate latent reasoning's principal effect here is shaping the model's parameters during training. We also demonstrate a working RL gain in chess, where multiple groups report the same latent-reasoning-plus-RL recipe failing to improve accuracy over SFT.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, preprint also available at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21619703 v2: added statistical significance testing on the n=1000 causal battery replication (Appendix A.8), added SVD-based weight-space rank analysis (Appendix A.11), corrected false-checkmate rate to reflect larger-sample data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过训练一个下棋模型，结合潜推理课程和强化学习（RL），发现RL使棋局合法性从48%提升至61%，并消除了虚假将杀。因果干预实验表明，替换或加噪思维向量不影响性能，仅精确零向量导致崩溃，说明RL增加了对干扰的鲁棒性，而非依赖思维内容。
Motivation: 现有潜推理性因果分析仅局限于数学和逻辑任务，且只比较单个检查点内的思维依赖，从未测试RL前后的变化。
Method: 采用分阶段训练：先进行潜推理课程，再施加RL。在同一模型RL前后执行六条件因果干预（替换、加噪、删除、精确零向量等），对比性能差异。
Result: RL后合法性从48%升至61%，虚假将杀完全消除。精确零向量下合法性从RL前1%升至RL后9%，替换和加噪与基线无显著差异。
Conclusion: 潜推理的主要作用是通过RL在训练期间塑造模型参数，而非作为推理时主动查阅的草稿本。

summary_sections.method: 采用分阶段训练：先进行潜推理课程，再施加RL。在同一模型RL前后执行六条件因果干预（替换、加噪、删除、精确零向量等），对比性能差异。
summary_sections.result: RL后合法性从48%升至61%，虚假将杀完全消除。精确零向量下合法性从RL前1%升至RL后9%，替换和加噪与基线无显著差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 潜推理的主要作用是通过RL在训练期间塑造模型参数，而非作为推理时主动查阅的草稿本。

papers.title: Efficient and Interpretable Body-Based Emotion Recognition with Lightweight Temporal Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: Body-based emotion recognition is important for real-time affective systems, but graph-based skeleton models can be computationally expensive. This paper studies whether lightweight temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) can provide an efficient and interpretable alternative for body-based emotion classification. We evaluate a family of TCN models on DIEM-A and compare them with a graph-based time-series graph (G-TSG) baseline using accuracy, macro-F1, parameter count, and inference latency. Although G-TSG achieves the highest mean performance, TCN-Base remains within $1.58$ accuracy points and $1.25$ macro-F1 points while using $79.18\%$ fewer parameters and reducing classifier latency by approximately $12.5\times$. We also analyze body-region contributions using region-specific TCN models, zero-based occlusion, and G-TSG gradient saliency. The results show that upper-body motion provides the strongest standalone regional cue, that the usefulness of body regions varies across emotions, and that different interpretability methods capture distinct aspects of model behavior. These findings suggest that lightweight TCNs can support efficient body-based emotion recognition while also providing practical insight into how motion cues contribute to classification.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究轻量级时序卷积网络（TCN）在基于身体姿态的情绪识别中的效率与可解释性。在DIEM-A数据集上与图时序网络（G-TSG）对比，TCN-Base在准确率仅低1.58%、宏F1低1.25%的情况下，参数量减少79.18%，推理延迟降低约12.5倍。通过区域贡献分析发现，上身运动是最强的独立区域线索，且不同情绪依赖不同身体区域。
Motivation: 基于身体姿态的情绪识别对实时情感系统很重要，但现有图模型计算成本高，需要更高效且可解释的替代方案。
Method: 评估一系列TCN模型，并与G-TSG基线比较；通过区域特定TCN、零遮挡和梯度显著性分析身体区域贡献。
Result: TCN-Base与G-TSG性能接近，但参数量减少79.18%，分类器延迟降低约12.5倍；上身运动是主要线索，不同情绪依赖不同区域。
Conclusion: 轻量TCN可高效支持基于身体的情绪识别，并提供运动线索贡献的可解释性。
Relevance: 0
