papers.title: Analyzing the Importance of Blank for CTC-Based Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of large pre-trained foundation models for automatic speech recognition new challenges appear. While the performance of these models is good, runtime and cost of inference increases. One approach to make use of their strength while retaining efficiency is to distill their knowledge to smaller models during training. In this work, we explore different CTC-based distillation variants, focusing on blank token handling. We show that common approaches like blank elimination do not always work off the shelf. We explore new blank selection patterns as a potential sweet spot between standard knowledge distillation and blank elimination mechanisms. Through the introduction of a symmetric selection method, we are able to remove the CTC loss during knowledge distillation with minimal to no performance degradation. With this, we make the training independent from target labels, potentially allowing for distillation on untranscribed audio data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CTC（Connectionist Temporal Classification）知识蒸馏中blank token处理的重要性进行研究。作者表明常见的blank消除方法并不总是有效，并提出了一种对称选择方法，在知识蒸馏中移除CTC损失时几乎不造成性能下降，从而可能允许在无转写音频数据上进行蒸馏。
Motivation: 大规模预训练语音模型性能优异但推理成本和运行时高，知识蒸馏是一种利用其优势同时保持效率的方法，但现有CTC蒸馏中blank token的处理方式需要深入探索。
Method: 探索不同的CTC蒸馏变体，重点研究blank token的处理，包括提出新的blank选择模式和对称选择方法，以消除知识蒸馏中的CTC损失。
Result: 对称选择方法能够在移除CTC损失时实现最小到无性能退化，从而使得训练独立于目标标签，可能允许在无转写音频数据上进行蒸馏。
Conclusion: 本文为CTC知识蒸馏提供了新的blank处理策略，特别是在无标签数据上的应用前景。

papers.title: Hybrid AI-Physical Modeling for Penetration Bias Correction in X-band InSAR DEMs: A Greenland Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Digital elevation models derived from Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) data over glacial and snow-covered regions often exhibit systematic elevation errors, commonly termed "penetration bias." We leverage existing physics-based models and propose an integrated correction framework that combines parametric physical modeling with machine learning. We evaluate the approach across three distinct training scenarios - each defined by a different set of acquisition parameters - to assess overall performance and the model's ability to generalize. Our experiments on Greenland's ice sheet using TanDEM-X data show that the proposed hybrid model corrections significantly reduce the mean and standard deviation of DEM errors compared to a purely physical modeling baseline. The hybrid framework also achieves significantly improved generalization than a pure ML approach when trained on data with limited diversity in acquisition parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对X波段InSAR数字高程模型（DEM）在冰川积雪区域存在的系统性穿透偏差，提出一种混合物理-人工智能校正框架。该方法结合参数化物理模型与机器学习，在格陵兰冰盖的TanDEM-X数据上评估了三种训练场景，结果显示混合模型相比纯物理基线显著降低了DEM误差的均值和标准差，并在有限多样性的训练数据下比纯机器学习方法具有更好的泛化能力。
Motivation: InSAR DEM在冰川与积雪覆盖区域常因雷达波穿透而产生系统性高程偏差（穿透偏差），现有纯物理模型校正精度有限，而纯机器学习方法在数据多样性不足时泛化能力差。
Method: 提出集成参数化物理模型与机器学习的混合校正框架，利用物理模型提供先验知识，结合机器学习从数据中学习残差模式，并在不同采集参数组合的训练场景下进行验证。
Result: 在格陵兰冰盖TanDEM-X数据上，混合模型校正后的DEM误差均值和标准差均低于纯物理基线；当训练数据中采集参数多样性有限时，混合模型的泛化能力显著优于纯机器学习方法。
Conclusion: 混合AI-物理建模可有效校正X波段InSAR DEM的穿透偏差，并在训练数据不充分时提供更好的泛化性，适用于冰川环境的高程建模。

papers.title: Sampling Decisions: Exact Path-Space Correction, Prior Cancellation and Local-Boltzmann Guidance
papers.abstract_en: How can a cheap but biased sequential, finite-horizon sampler over a discrete space be corrected so that its terminal output follows a prescribed Gibbs distribution? We formulate Sampling Decisions as a path-space relative-entropy projection on a growing autoregressive state graph. The unique prior-relative minimizer is a Doob transform governed by a linear backward recursion. A route-resolved formulation then yields a finite-particle algorithm based on conditional self-normalized importance sampling, and we prove convergence of its transition kernels and terminal law as the path budget grows. For binary graphical models, we prove an exact cancellation theorem: all fixed singleton-product priors disappear from the population correction; only the ordering policy survives. Thus, more accurate one-point marginals may not produce a better finite-budget sampler. We therefore introduce a prefix-dependent autoregressive Local-Boltzmann prior that conditions each new spin on its revealed neighbors, while the path-space correction supplies the missing look-ahead field generated by the unrevealed subgraph. Experiments on 3*3, 4*4, and 5*5 Ising grids show that singleton-product priors suffer severe importance-weight degeneracy, whereas Local-Boltzmann guidance maintains substantially larger effective sample size and reaches the exact-target reference band at the tested budgets. The results identify correlated, prefix-dependent guidance as the decisive ingredient in sequential sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种路径空间校正方法，将廉价但有偏的离散状态顺序采样器调整为遵循预定吉布斯分布的终端输出。通过推导Doob变换和线性后向递归，得到先验相对最小化器，并基于条件自归一化重要性采样给出有限粒子算法。对于二元图模型，证明了精确抵消定理：所有固定单元素乘积先验在校正过程中消失，只有排序策略保留。引入前缀依赖的自回归局部玻尔兹曼先验，在3*3、4*4和5*5伊辛网格上实验表明，其有效样本量远大于单元素乘积先验，且在给定预算下达到精确目标参考带。
Motivation: 廉价但有偏的有限时域顺序采样器在离散空间上容易产生偏差，需要校正以得到指定吉布斯分布。现有方法可能因先验选择不当导致重要性权重退化，影响校正效果。
Method: 将采样决策建模为路径空间上的相对熵投影，利用Doob变换和线性后向递归得到唯一先验相对最小化器；提出基于条件自归一化重要性采样的有限粒子算法，并证明转移核和终端定律的收敛性。针对二元图模型，引入前缀依赖的自回归局部玻尔兹曼先验进行指导。
Result: 在伊辛网格上，单元素乘积先验出现严重的重要性权重退化，而局部玻尔兹曼引导在测试预算下维持了显著更大的有效样本量，并达到精确目标参考带。
Conclusion: 相关的前缀依赖引导是顺序采样中决定性因素；固定先验（如单元素乘积）在校正中会被完全抵消，只有排序策略保留。

papers.title: A Survey of Graph Transformers: Architectures, Theories and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Graph Transformers (GTs) have demonstrated a strong capability in modeling graph structures by addressing the intrinsic limitations of graph neural networks (GNNs), such as over-smoothing and over-squashing. Recent studies have proposed diverse architectures, enhanced explainability, and practical applications for Graph Transformers. In light of these rapid developments, we conduct a comprehensive review of Graph Transformers, covering aspects such as their architectures, theoretical foundations, and applications. In this survey, we first categorize the architecture of Graph Transformers according to their strategies for processing structural information, including graph tokenization, positional encoding, structure-aware attention, and model ensemble. Then, from the theoretical perspective, we examine the expressivity of Graph Transformers in various discussed architectures and contrast them with other advanced graph learning algorithms to discover their connections. For applications, we organize the literature around four graph organization forms, from relational, geometric, dynamic to heterogeneous. A Practical Guidance table then maps architectural components to these graph forms by adoption frequency, so practitioners can narrow down which design families to consider for a given input structure. Lastly, we will discuss the current challenges and prospective directions in Graph Transformers for potential future research.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted to ACM Computing Surveys
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面综述了图Transformer（GT）的架构、理论基础与应用。首先根据处理结构信息的策略（图标记化、位置编码、结构感知注意力、模型集成）对GT架构进行分类；然后从理论角度分析不同架构的表达能力，并与先进图学习算法对比；最后按关系型、几何型、动态型、异质型四种图组织形式组织应用文献，并给出实践指南表格。
Motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）存在过平滑和过挤压等固有限制，图Transformer（GT）通过建模图结构能缓解这些问题。近年来GT发展迅速，需要系统性的综述来梳理架构、理论与应用进展。
Method: 采用分类法：将GT架构分为图标记化、位置编码、结构感知注意力和模型集成四类；从理论角度分析表达性；按四种图组织形式（关系、几何、动态、异质）组织应用，并提供实践指南表格。
Result: 提供了GT架构分类、理论表达性分析、应用文献组织，以及基于采用频率的架构组件与图形式映射表。
Conclusion: GT在建模图结构方面具有优势，但仍面临挑战。本文为从业者选择适合特定图结构的GT设计家族提供指导，并指出未来研究方向。

papers.title: Nearly Tight Bounds for Cross-Learning Contextual Bandits with Graphical Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Repeated first-price auctions are contextual decision problems with censored but reusable feedback: after submitting a bid, a learner can infer the outcomes of related bids and evaluate them under different private values. This structure motivates cross-learning contextual bandits with graphical feedback, where playing an arm reveals the losses of its out-neighbors in every context. A central open question was whether, under i.i.d. contexts and a fixed strongly observable feedback graph with independence number $α$, one can remove every polynomial dependence on the number of contexts while attaining the classical graphical-bandit rate $\widetilde O(\sqrt{αT})$. The question was open even for stochastic losses and graphs in which every arm has a self-loop. We answer it affirmatively under the stronger model of oblivious adversarial losses and for all strongly observable graphs, including those with arms without self-loops. The key obstruction is that a frequently played no-self-loop arm can nevertheless have a vanishing observation probability. Our algorithm isolates one such arm per epoch, uses a pessimistic correction to cancel its first-order estimation drift, and shifts the losses in the FTRL analysis to control the resulting quadratic term. It achieves expected regret $\widetilde O(\sqrt{αT})$. Controlled synthetic experiments show the benefit of combining graph feedback with cross-learning and exhibit the predicted scaling in both $T$ and $α$. The main theorem is formalized in Lean in an end-to-end development exceeding 100,000 lines of Lean code. The formalization and experiment artifacts are available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/RuiyuanHuang/graphical-cross-learning-review-artifact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有图形反馈的交叉学习上下文赌博机，证明了在强可观测图和对抗性损失下，可以实现 ~O(√(αT)) 的期望遗憾，其中 α 是反馈图的独立数。该结果肯定地回答了关于能否消除上下文数量多项式依赖的开放问题，并提供了 Lean 形式化验证。
Motivation: 现有上下文赌博机在重复第一价格拍卖等场景中，反馈被删失但可复用，需要交叉学习。核心问题是：在独立同分布上下文和固定强可观测反馈图下，能否达到经典图形赌博机速率 Õ(√(αT)) 而消除对上下文数量的多项式依赖？该问题之前即使对于随机损失和图中有自环的臂也未知。
Method: 提出一种算法，每个 epoch 隔离一个无自环臂，使用悲观校正消除其第一阶估计漂移，并在跟随正则化领导者（FTRL）分析中平移损失以控制二次项。该算法适用于所有强可观测图，包括臂没有自环的情况。
Result: 算法实现期望遗憾 Õ(√(αT))，合成实验验证了结合图反馈与交叉学习的优势，并展示了在 T 和 α 上的预测缩放。主定理在 Lean 中进行了超过 10 万行代码的端到端形式化证明。
Conclusion: 本文肯定地回答了交叉学习上下文赌博机在强可观测图下的开放问题，证明了即使在没有自环臂的情况下也能达到最优速率，并通过形式化验证保证了理论严谨性。

papers.title: Dementia classification from spontaneous speech using wrapper-based feature selection
papers.abstract_en: Dementia encompasses a group of syndromes that impair cognitive functions such as memory, reasoning, and the ability to perform daily activities. As populations globally age, nearly 10 million new dementia cases occur annually. Clinical diagnosis remains challenging because symptoms overlap with other conditions and require comprehensive cognitive assessment, highlighting the need for feasible and accurate detection methods. Recent advances in machine learning have highlighted spontaneous speech as a promising noninvasive, cost-effective, and scalable biomarker for dementia detection. In this study, spontaneous speech recordings from the ADReSS dataset and the extended Pitt Corpus were analyzed, consisting of picture description tasks performed by cognitively healthy individuals and participants with Alzheimer's disease or dementia. Unlike many prior approaches relying on speech-active segments, acoustic features were extracted from entire recordings with the openSMILE toolkit. This recording-level representation reduces the number of feature vectors and provides a computationally efficient framework for dementia classification, while indirectly incorporating pause- and hesitation-related information. Classification models with classifier-based wrapper feature selection were employed to estimate feature importance and identify diagnostically relevant acoustic characteristics. Among the evaluated classifiers, the extreme minimal learning machine emerged as the most computationally efficient method, providing competitive classification accuracy with substantially lower training time in repeated leave-one-subject-out validation. The results demonstrated that the proposed framework is computationally efficient, interpretable, and well-suited as a supportive tool for speech-based dementia assessment.
papers.journal_ref: Applied Computing and Intelligence, 2026, 6(1): 89-114
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自发言语的痴呆症分类框架，使用openSMIKE提取全录音声学特征，并通过基于分类器的包裹式特征选择（wrapper-based feature selection）识别诊断相关的声学特征。在ADReSS和Pitt Corpus数据集上，极端最小学习机（extreme minimal learning machine）在重复留一受试者交叉验证中表现出计算效率高、分类准确率竞争性的优点。
Motivation: 痴呆症临床诊断因症状重叠和评估复杂而困难，亟需可行、准确的检测方法。自发言语作为非侵入性、低成本且可扩展的生物标志物（biomarker）具有潜力。
Method: 利用openSMIKE从完整录音中提取声学特征（而非仅语音活跃段），采用基于分类器的包裹式特征选择评估特征重要性，比较了多种分类器的性能。
Result: 极端最小学习机在计算效率上最优，训练时间大幅降低，同时保持了竞争性的分类准确率。
Conclusion: 该框架计算高效、可解释，适合作为基于言语的痴呆症辅助评估工具。

papers.title: Fisher Information based Stochastic Gradient Ascent for Online Learning of Dirichlet Process Mixture and Theory
papers.abstract_en: Scalable algorithms of posterior approximation allow Bayesian nonparametrics such as Dirichlet process mixture to scale up to larger dataset at fractional cost. Recent algorithms, notably the stochastic variational inference performs local learning from minibatch. The main problem with stochastic variational inference is that it relies on closed form solution. Stochastic gradient ascent is a modern approach to machine learning and is widely deployed in the training of deep neural networks. In this work, we explore using stochastic gradient ascent as a fast algorithm for the posterior approximation of Dirichlet process mixture. However, stochastic gradient ascent alone is not optimal for learning. In order to achieve both speed and performance, we turn our focus to stepsize optimization in stochastic gradient ascent. As as intermediate approach, we first optimize stepsize using the momentum method. Finally, we introduce Fisher information to allow adaptive stepsize in our posterior approximation. In the experiments, we justify that our approach using stochastic gradient ascent do not sacrifice performance for speed when compared to closed form coordinate ascent learning on these datasets. Lastly, our approach is also compatible with deep ConvNet features as well as scalable to large class datasets such as Caltech256 and SUN397.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对狄利克雷过程混合模型（Dirichlet process mixture）的在线学习，提出基于Fisher信息的随机梯度上升（SGA）后验近似方法，以替代需要闭式解的随机变分推理。作者首先用动量法优化步长，再引入Fisher信息实现自适应步长。实验表明该方法在不牺牲性能的前提下达到更快速度，并兼容深度ConvNet特征和大型数据集如Caltech256和SUN397。
Motivation: 随机变分推理虽能处理大规模数据，但依赖闭式解，限制了应用。论文旨在探索随机梯度上升作为快速后验近似算法，并解决其步长优化问题以实现速度与性能的平衡。
Method: 提出基于Fisher信息的自适应步长随机梯度上升算法，作为中间步骤先使用动量法优化步长，最终利用Fisher信息调整步长，实现后验近似。
Result: 实验证明所提方法在速度上不牺牲性能，并能在Caltech256和SUN397等大规模数据集上与闭式坐标上升学习相媲美，同时兼容深度ConvNet特征。
Conclusion: 论文验证了随机梯度上升结合Fisher信息自适应步长在狄利克雷过程混合模型在线学习中的有效性，且可扩展至大型数据集和深度特征。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CodexGraph: Bridging Large Language Models and Code Repositories via Code Graph Databases
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in stand-alone code tasks like HumanEval and MBPP, but struggle with handling entire code repositories. This challenge has prompted research on enhancing LLM-codebase interaction at a repository scale. Current solutions rely on similarity-based retrieval or manual tools and APIs, each with notable drawbacks. Similarity-based retrieval often has low recall in complex tasks, while manual tools and APIs are typically task-specific and require expert knowledge, reducing their generalizability across diverse code tasks and real-world applications. To mitigate these limitations, we introduce CodexGraph, a system that integrates LLM agents with graph database interfaces extracted from code repositories. By leveraging the structural properties of graph databases and the flexibility of the graph query language, CodexGraph enables the LLM agent to construct and execute queries, allowing for precise, code structure-aware context retrieval and code navigation. We assess CodexGraph using three benchmarks: CrossCodeEval, SWE-bench, and EvoCodeBench. Additionally, we develop five real-world coding applications. With a unified graph database schema, CodexGraph demonstrates competitive performance and potential in both academic and real-world environments, showcasing its versatility and efficacy in software engineering. Our application demo: https://github.com/modelscope/modelscope-agent/tree/master/apps/codexgraph_agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CodexGraph，一个将LLM代理与代码仓库的图数据库接口相结合的系统，以解决LLM在处理整个代码仓库时的困难。通过利用图数据库的结构特性和查询语言，LLM代理能够构建和执行精确的代码结构感知上下文检索与导航。在CrossCodeEval、SWE-bench和EvoCodeBench三个基准测试以及五个真实世界编码应用中展示了竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有LLM处理代码仓库的方法（如基于相似度的检索或手动工具/API）存在低召回率或任务特定、需要专家知识等问题，缺乏通用性。本文旨在克服这些局限，提供一种更灵活、可泛化的代码仓库交互方式。
Method: CodexGraph将LLM代理与从代码仓库提取的图数据库接口集成，利用图数据库的结构化特性和图查询语言的灵活性，使LLM代理能够自动构建并执行查询，实现精确的代码结构上下文检索与导航。
Result: 在CrossCodeEval、SWE-bench和EvoCodeBench三个基准测试上评估，并开发了五个真实世界编码应用，结果显示CodexGraph在学术和真实环境中均具有竞争性能。
Conclusion: CodexGraph验证了统一图数据库模式在学术和真实环境中的通用性和有效性，展示了其在软件工程中的多功能性和潜力。

papers.title: Fairness Interventions in Classification: A Study on AI Explainability
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a philosophical and experimental study of fairness interventions in AI classification, centered on the explainability and transparency of corrective methods, and on the opposition between two fairness criteria, namely Demographic Parity and Equalized Odds. Our main argument is that even as a gap in Demographic Parity is used to diagnose inequality between groups, Equalized Odds constitutes a more reliable fairness criterion to guide bias correction in classification. To establish this, we present FairDream, a fairness package intended for lay users, whose mechanism increases the model's weights of errors on disadvantaged groups. To justify FairDream's results, we analyze its reweighting algorithm, and we present the results of a benchmark experiment in which we compare FairDream with a distinct in-processing correction method that enforces Demographic Parity more drastically, the GridSearch method. We then propose a normative justification of Equalized Odds, with a discussion of the criterion's limitations. We draw on the structural similarity between FairDream's results and a version of Simpson's paradox to justify conditioning on true labels in counterfactual evaluations of fairness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文从哲学和实验角度研究AI分类中的公平性干预，重点讨论矫正方法的可解释性和透明度，并对比人口均等（Demographic Parity）与均等几率（Equalized Odds）两个公平性标准。作者提出FairDream包，通过增加对弱势群体错误的权重来校正偏差，并通过基准实验与GridSearch方法比较，论证均等几率是更可靠的公平性准则。
Motivation: 现有公平性干预方法缺乏对可解释性和透明度的深入分析，且人口均等与均等几率两个标准在分类校正中的优劣尚待厘清。
Method: 提出FairDream公平性包，采用重加权算法增加模型对弱势群体错误的权重；并通过实验与强制执行人口均等的GridSearch方法进行对比。
Result: 基准实验表明FairDream在矫正偏差上有效，且作者指出其机制与辛普森悖论的结构相似性，为以真实标签为条件的反事实公平性评估提供依据。
Conclusion: 论文主张均等几率比人口均等更适合作为分类偏差校正的公平性准则，但也承认该准则存在局限性。

papers.title: Weighted Low-Rank Matrix Approximation: Acceleration and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Weighted low-rank matrix approximation (WLRMA) generalizes classical low-rank approximation and matrix completion by allowing arbitrary elementwise weights. Such formulations arise naturally in a broad class of statistical models, including generalized linear low-rank models, where WLRMA serves as the computational primitive for parameter estimation. Despite its broad applicability, efficient optimization methods for general WLRMA remain relatively underdeveloped. In this paper, we formulate both the rank-constrained and nuclear-norm WLRMA problems within a unified first-order optimization framework by showing that the corresponding iterative algorithms are projected and proximal gradient methods. Building on this perspective, we develop accelerated algorithms based on Nesterov momentum and Anderson acceleration, together with a regularized Anderson scheme that improves numerical stability for non-convex problems. We further propose scalable implementations for large sparse data matrices and introduce a practical effective-rank criterion that provides a meaningful correspondence between rank-constrained and nuclear-norm solutions. We further show that fitting generalized linear low-rank models can be reduced to a sequence of weighted low-rank matrix approximation problems, allowing the proposed algorithms to be used as computational building blocks for their estimation. Simulation studies demonstrate substantial computational gains achieved by the proposed accelerated algorithms. Applications to the MovieLens dataset further illustrate the proposed framework for matrix completion, heteroscedastic Gaussian low-rank modeling, and logistic low-rank modeling.

TL;DR: 本文提出加权低秩矩阵近似（WLRMA）的统一一阶优化框架，将秩约束和核范数问题分别看作投影梯度法和近端梯度法，并引入Nesterov动量、Anderson加速及正则化Anderson加速来提升收敛速度。通过将广义线性低秩模型的拟合转化为序列WLRMA问题，算法可作为其计算基石。在MovieLens数据集上验证了矩阵补全、异方差高斯和逻辑低秩建模中的加速效果。
Motivation: 加权低秩矩阵近似在统计模型中广泛应用，但高效优化方法相对不成熟，尤其是在大规模稀疏数据和广义线性低秩模型背景下。
Method: 将秩约束WLRMA视为投影梯度法，核范数正则化WLRMA视为近端梯度法，在此基础上应用Nesterov动量加速、Anderson加速以及改进数值稳定性的正则化Anderson加速；并提出适用于大规模稀疏数据的可扩展实现和有效秩准则。
Result: 模拟研究表明加速算法在计算时间上取得显著收益；MovieLens数据集上的矩阵补全、异方差高斯和逻辑低秩建模实验证实了实际加速效果。
Conclusion: 所提加速框架为多种广义线性低秩模型提供统一且高效的计算模块，但摘要未讨论其在降水或天气预报等特定领域的应用。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Optimal Level Synchronization Based on Flow-Based Deep Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional state and action spaces combined with sparse reward structures in reinforcement learning (RL) environments typically require advanced control architectures. Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) demonstrates superior performance compared to atomic RL approaches in these challenging scenarios. HRL can manage the complexity of commands to achieve task objectives through its hierarchical structure. One of the key challenges in HRL is efficiently training each level's policy with optimal data collection from its experience. Off-policy correction is a critical technique for facilitating sample-efficient off-policy training in HRL, as it addresses the non-stationary issue of higher-level policy training. However, existing methods typically employ indirect probabilistic approaches that fail to accurately capture the current capability of the lower-level policy. This mismatch ultimately constrains the effectiveness of higher-level policy training. In this paper, we propose a novel HRL model that supports direct off-policy correction based on a Flow-based Deep Generative Model (FDGM). This approach leverages the inverse operation of FDGM to achieve goals aligned with the current knowledge of the lower-level policy. Additionally, our model addresses the limitations of FDGM to enable its effective use in HRL. Through comparative experiments on benchmark environments, our model demonstrates superior performance over existing models.

Result: 在基准环境上的对比实验表明，所提模型性能优于现有模型。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Recovery-Pathway Identification and Bayesian Optimization for Autonomous Materials Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous laboratories automate experimental execution, but a campaign must also decide which recovery pathway merits optimization. We formulate this as a sequential decision problem with a discrete pathway-identification stage and a continuous within-pathway optimization stage under heterogeneous experimental costs. Our implementation, Coactive learning, combines a cost-sensitive Bayesian hypothesis-discrimination policy motivated by EC2 (Golovin et al., 2010) with Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization (Srinivas et al., 2010). Under explicitly stated assumptions, the expected spend of one fixed-budget campaign attempt is bounded by the expected pathway-identification cost plus the capped within-pathway optimization budget. We evaluate the method on synthetic benchmarks constrained by selected results reported for PNNL's CICERO selective-precipitation study (Ritchhart et al., 2026). The method performs comparably to an oracle-pathway Bayesian-optimization reference and to a strong split-plate baseline that discriminates pathways with its first plate, without receiving an oracle label for the correct pathway. It is given a candidate hypothesis space and a diagnostic likelihood model. On an NdFeB-inspired instance, it avoids the simulated penalty of a commit-first baseline that initially selects a plausible but inferior hydroxide pathway. This hypothetical wrong-first-commitment scenario is motivated by the hydroxide-oxalate performance contrast reported by CICERO. We characterize the sensitivity of these conclusions to the assumed cost model. The code and benchmark are open source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种成本感知的自主材料发现方法，将实验优化建模为离散路径识别和连续内路径优化的两阶段决策问题，采用结合EC2策略的高斯过程贝叶斯优化（Coactive learning），在合成基准和CICERO选择性沉淀研究上评估，表现接近或优于参考方法。
Motivation: 自主实验室需要决定哪个恢复路径值得优化，但现有方法未考虑不同路径的异构实验成本，导致预算浪费。
Method: 将问题分解为离散路径识别（成本敏感贝叶斯假设判别）和连续内路径优化（高斯过程贝叶斯优化），并引入Coactive learning框架，联合优化两阶段成本。
Result: 在合成基准和CICERO研究的NdFeB实例上，该方法与Oracle路径贝叶斯优化性能相当，并优于一次性选择错误路径的基线，避免了错误投入的惩罚。
Conclusion: 在明确假设下，固定预算单次尝试的期望开销可分解为路径识别成本加内路径优化预算上限，且方法对成本模型敏感。

papers.title: Visible to the Court: How AI Is (and Isn't) Litigated in U.S. Federal Court Opinions
papers.abstract_en: In the United States, artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly deployed amid limited federal regulation. With courts become a recurring forum in which AI-related practices are scrutinized, it is important to empirically understand the AI litigation landscape to date. We address this gap through a systematic review of 559 U.S. federal court opinions in which AI plays a role in the parties' contentions, taxonomizing (1) common topics of dispute, (2) the AI technologies implicated, and (3) the parties involved, including common plaintiff and defendant types. We identify seven recurring dispute areas, six categories of AI technologies at the center of litigation, and four types of common litigants, alongside legal doctrines used by the litigants. A comparison of this taxonomy to the AI Incident Database revealed substantial gaps in coverage, definitions, and prevalence between documented and litigated harms, suggesting courts capture only part of the AI risk landscape. In addition, we found that court decisions primarily rely on pre-existing legal doctrines to manage AI rather than making new AI-specific laws, producing a form of "piecemeal" AI governance. As a result, federal court outcomes are shaped less by where AI has caused harms and more by which harms are cognizable under existing statutes, leading to certain AI harms remaining unresolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统审查了559份美国联邦法院意见中涉及AI的争议，分类了争议主题、AI技术和当事人类型，并比较了与AI事件数据库的差距，发现法院仅覆盖部分AI风险，且依赖现有法律而非制定新法。
Motivation: 在美国联邦监管有限的情况下，AI快速部署，法院成为审查AI相关实践的重要场所，但缺乏对AI诉讼格局的实证理解。
Method: 对559份联邦法院意见进行系统审查，分类争议主题、AI技术、当事人类型及使用的法律原则，并与AI事件数据库比较。
Result: 识别出7个反复出现的争议领域、6类AI技术、4种常见当事人类型；发现法院判决主要依赖现有法律，形成“零散”的AI治理，导致某些AI伤害未解决。
Conclusion: 联邦法院的结果更多取决于现有法规是否认可该伤害，而非AI实际造成的危害地点，因此部分AI伤害仍悬而未决。

papers.title: Harnessing X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy Data through Multimodal Mining of Battery Literature
papers.abstract_en: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is central to understanding the local electronic and atomic structure of materials, yet most published spectra remain inaccessible to data-driven analysis because they are embedded in figures and described through fragmented textual context in the literature. Here, we use multimodal (image and text) literature mining to transform this dispersed knowledge into an AI-ready experimental data resource. We developed a scalable spectroscopy data digitization pipeline that identifies XAS figures in full-text articles, digitizes spectral curves, and links each spectrum to accompanying metadata on the measured edge and material. Applying this pipeline to the battery literature produced an open dataset of 13,740 XAS spectra, spanning 66 absorbing elements and diverse battery chemistries, with expert validation confirming accurate extraction of spectral and metadata information. By converting literature-embedded spectra into structured numerical data, this dataset provides a foundation for large-scale XAS analysis, cross-laboratory comparison, high-throughput characterization, and autonomous discovery of advanced materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态（图像和文本）文献挖掘流程，从电池文献中自动识别X射线吸收光谱（XAS）图形、数字化谱线并提取相关元数据，构建了一个包含13,740条XAS光谱的开放数据集，覆盖66种吸收元素和多种电池化学体系。经验证，该流程能够准确提取光谱和元数据信息，为大规模XAS分析、跨实验室比较和高通量材料发现提供数据基础。
Motivation: 大量已发表的XAS谱图以图形形式存在于文献中，且文本描述碎片化，导致这些数据难以被数据驱动的方法直接利用，阻碍了材料的规模化分析。
Method: 开发了一个可扩展的光谱数据数字化流水线，包括从全文文章中识别XAS图形、数字化谱线曲线，并将每条谱线与测量边和材料等元数据关联。
Result: 在电池文献上应用该流水线，得到包含13,740条XAS光谱的开放数据集，覆盖66种吸收元素和多种电池化学体系；专家验证表明光谱和元数据提取准确。
Conclusion: 该工作将文献中嵌入的谱图转化为结构化数值数据，为大规模XAS分析、跨实验室比较、高通量表征和自主材料发现奠定了基础。

papers.title: Long-Tailed Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we examine the difficulties of using standard techniques for medical image classification due to long-tailed distributions (wherein rarer conditions have very few samples) resulting in bias towards diagnosing common diseases and away from rarer diseases. We then discuss and implement deep learning models with techniques such as augmentation to minimize error, especially from rarer diseases. We evaluate various different models with AP, F1 score, AUROC, and loss (all on the validation set). We conclude with the promising results from our best model, and potential applications in the healthcare space.

papers.title: ADVERSARIAL: And-Inverter Graph-Assisted Hardware Trojan Detection At Scale
papers.abstract_en: Modern System-on-Chip (SoCs) often contain hundreds of millions to tens of billions of gates, making existing Hardware Trojan (HT) detection methods impractical due to their immense scale. The proposed approach incorporates symbolically enabled learning by modeling flattened gate-level netlists as Boolean networks represented as And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs), where all internal nodes are 2-input AND gates and inversions reside on the edges. Each directed connection is expressed as a triple within a Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) framework, producing compact, constant-size per-node representations that retain multi-hop structural context. The AIG's bounded fan-in and uniform semantics ensure training and inference complexity scale linearly with edge count, addressing major scalability bottlenecks in HT detection. Symbolically enabled learning across deep datapaths enables the model to differentiate circuit structures from rare and functionally inconsistent connections that signify potential Trojan triggers and payloads. Experiments on large-scale SoC benchmarks demonstrate clear geometric separation between Trojan and benign nodes and practical scalability.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于与反相图（AIG）和知识图谱嵌入（KGE）的硬件木马检测方法，将门级网表建模为布尔网络，利用AIG的有界扇入和统一语义实现线性复杂度，并在大规模SoC基准上验证了木马节点与良性节点的几何可分离性。
Motivation: 现有硬件木马检测方法在处理包含数亿至数百亿门的现代SoC时因规模过大而不可行，亟需可扩展的检测技术。
Method: 将平层门级网表建模为以AIG表示的布尔网络，每个内部节点为2输入AND门，反相位于边上；将每条有向连接表示为知识图谱嵌入框架中的三元组，生成紧凑的定长节点表示以保留多跳结构上下文，利用AIG的有界扇入实现训练和推理复杂度与边数呈线性关系。

Conclusion: 符号启发的学习能够在深层数据路径中区分电路结构与表示木马触发器和负载的罕见功能不一致连接，为解决硬件木马检测的可扩展性问题提供了有效途径。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Predicting Nitrous Oxide Flux
papers.abstract_en: Nitrous oxide (N$_2$O) is the dominant ozone-depleting substance emitted in the 21st century, and the third largest contributor to anthropogenic greenhouse gases due to its high potency and long atmospheric lifetime, with more than 70% of N$_2$O emissions occurring as a result of agricultural processes. Current approaches to predicting N$_2$O flux emissions include process-based models such as DayCent and Cycles, as well as classical AI models, but the application of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to predicting N$_2$O flux emissions is largely underexplored. Our paper draws upon the mechanistic equations that underlie the DayCent family of process-based models to construct a rigorously derived, literature-traceable physics residual. We then build and train an MLP-based PINN on a multi-site agricultural dataset spanning four geographically distinct US agricultural sites. Across all tested values of the physics loss weighting hyperparameter $λ$, our PINN consistently and substantially outperformed uncalibrated Cycles simulation (R$^2=0.01$), with our MLP baseline achieving mean R$^2=0.411$ across ten random seeds. Physics constraints consistently degrade model performance in holdout validation, with marginal degradation at low $λ$ and significant degradation at high $λ$, but consistently improve model performance and reduce performance variability in leave-one-site-out validation. This suggests that physics constraints sacrifice in-distribution accuracy for out-of-distribution robustness, anchoring the model toward biogeochemically plausible behavior on unfamiliar soil conditions --- though cross-site generalization remains challenging, with negative R$^2$ across all seeds and $λ$ values on our geographically distinct held-out site.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将物理信息神经网络（PINNs）应用于预测农业土壤一氧化二氮（N₂O）通量排放。基于DayCent过程模型的机理方程构建物理残差，并在多个美国农业站点数据集上训练MLP基PINN。结果表明，物理约束在分布内验证中会降低精度，但在留一站点验证中提升鲁棒性和泛化能力，然而跨站点泛化仍然困难（所有种子和λ值下R²为负）。
Motivation: 现有N₂O通量预测方法（如DayCent、Cycles过程模型和经典AI模型）存在局限性，而PINNs的应用尚未被充分探索。
Method: 基于DayCent系列模型的机理方程推导出可溯源的物理残差，采用MLP架构，通过调整物理损失权重超参数λ来训练PINN。
Result: 在所有λ值下，PINN一致优于未校准的Cycles模拟（R²=0.01），MLP基线平均R²=0.411；物理约束在留出验证中导致性能下降（低λ时轻微，高λ时显著），但在留一站点验证中提升性能和降低变异，然而跨站点泛化仍为负R²。
Conclusion: 物理约束牺牲了分布内精度以换取分布外鲁棒性，使模型在陌生土壤条件下趋向生物地球化学合理行为，但跨站点泛化仍是挑战。

papers.title: Flash-CNNCap: Capacitance Extraction via Image Mapping
papers.abstract_en: We present Flash-CNNCap, a CNN-based capacitance extractor that reformulates full-matrix capacitance prediction as image-to-image regression over spatial contribution maps. Prior scalar CNN-based extractors require $O(n^2)$ forward passes to recover all pairwise capacitances in a window with $n$ conductors. Flash-CNNCap replaces the scalar target with dense contribution maps: a total-capacitance model and a master-conditioned coupling model each predict a spatial map that is reduced to conductor-level values through mask aggregation, cutting full-matrix reconstruction to $O(n)$ passes. The resulting totals and symmetrized pairwise couplings define the corresponding Maxwell-style capacitance matrix under the standard off-diagonal sign convention. The maps are learned from conductor-level labels without per-pixel supervision. An ablation study over 13 model configurations selects a U-Net that matches ResNet baselines on total capacitance (1.5-3.1% MARE) and achieves the strongest coupling accuracy (3.0-4.6% MARE) across all evaluated CapBench subsets, with a $17.5\times$ full-matrix speedup on windows containing 134 conductors on average. A deployed pipeline reads Design Exchange Format (DEF) geometry and writes Standard Parasitic Exchange Format (SPEF) output, processing 1,024 windows in 51.23 seconds with a $4.4\times$ speedup over OpenRCX on the same benchmark. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/THU-numbda/flash-cnncap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flash-CNNCap，一种基于 CNN 的电容提取器，将全矩阵电容预测转化为图像到图像的回归问题。通过预测稠密贡献图（总电容图和主条件耦合图），经掩码聚合还原为导体级电容值，将全矩阵重构的 pass 数从 O(n²) 降至 O(n)。在 CapBench 数据集上，总电容 MARE 1.5-3.1%，耦合电容 MARE 3.0-4.6%，全矩阵速度提升 17.5 倍，并在实际流程中比 OpenRCX 快 4.4 倍。
Motivation: 现有标量 CNN 电容提取器需要 O(n²) 次前向传播才能恢复窗口内 n 个导体的所有成对电容，效率低下。
Method: 将标量目标替换为稠密贡献图：一个总电容模型和一个主条件耦合模型分别预测空间图，通过掩码聚合降维为导体级电容值，实现 O(n) 次前向传播重建全矩阵。标签来自导体级标签，无需像素级监督。
Result: 在 CapBench 上，U-Net 模型的总电容 MARE 1.5-3.1%，耦合电容 MARE 3.0-4.6%，在含 134 个导体的窗口上全矩阵速度提升 17.5 倍；实际流程处理 1024 窗口耗时 51.23 秒，比 OpenRCX 快 4.4 倍。
Conclusion: 基于图像映射的电容提取方法在精度和速度上均优于现有方法，且可部署到标准 EDA 流程。

papers.title: MulRobBench: A Decision-Level Benchmark for Safe and Security-Policy-Compliant Multimodal UAV Agents
papers.abstract_en: Smart-city airspace is transforming Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from passive sensing platforms into cyber-physical decision makers that must follow operational rules under degraded observations and ambiguous language. Existing UAV and multimodal benchmarks evaluate perception, navigation, collaboration, and reasoning, but few assess whether physical evidence, protocol constraints, and action risk remain coupled during critical decisions. We introduce MulRobBench, an offline, protocol-conditioned benchmark for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) UAV agents in smart-city environments. MulRobBench integrates real UAV multimodal observations, protocol-level security policies, and action-level cyber-physical safety into a unified evaluation framework. The benchmark contains 3,024 samples spanning 17 task taxonomy nodes and 12 scoring dimensions across four stages: operational context understanding, multimodal evidence arbitration, degradation-aware reasoning, and risk-aware action planning. Evaluation combines semantic scoring with structural diagnostics, including policy compliance, format compliance, unsafe actions, parsing failures, and dimension-level validity. Across 17 multimodal models, the best semantic protocol-decision score reaches only 0.5141, while the best strict mean scoring-dimension accuracy is 0.1599. A controlled 20-anchor modality-ablation study changes 4-15 action selections per model, confirming that both visual and textual inputs influence decisions. Analysis identifies modality-trust selection, constraint extraction, glare, missing data, and operator shorthand as the primary causes of decision instability. MulRobBench provides a reproducible benchmark for trustworthy multimodal UAV decision making under realistic operational constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了MulRobBench，一个针对智能城市环境中无人机（UAV）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）智能体的离线、协议条件基准测试。基准整合了多模态观测、协议级安全策略和动作级网络物理安全，包含3024个样本，覆盖17个任务分类节点和12个评分维度。评估了17个多模态模型，最佳语义协议决策分数仅0.5141，严格平均评分维度准确率仅0.1599。
Motivation: 现有UAV和多模态基准主要评估感知、导航、协作和推理，但很少评估在关键决策中物理证据、协议约束和动作风险是否耦合。需要评估在退化的观测和模糊语言下UAV智能体是否能遵循操作规则。
Method: 提出MulRobBench基准，包含四个阶段：操作上下文理解、多模态证据仲裁、退化感知推理和风险感知动作规划。评估结合语义评分与结构诊断，包括策略合规性、格式合规性、不安全动作、解析失败和维度级有效性。
Result: 在17个多模态模型中，最佳语义协议决策分数仅0.5141，严格平均评分维度准确率0.1599。20个锚点模态消融研究表明，视觉和文本输入都影响决策，每模型改变4-15个动作选择。主要决策不稳定原因包括模态信任选择、约束提取、眩光、数据缺失和操作员简写。
Conclusion: MulRobBench为在现实操作约束下可信的多模态UAV决策提供了可重复基准，并揭示了当前模型的严重不足。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Coulomb Particle Model for Learning Kernel Attention in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Randomized features provide a scalable approximation to kernel machines, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of feature distribution. We propose a particle-based method that learns this distribution by optimizing kernel-target alignment while regularizing particles with a Riesz/Coulomb repulsive potential. The resulting Hamiltonian yields diverse, task-adaptive random features and admits a mean-field description through a McKean--Vlasov equation. We instantiate the method in linearized Transformer attention by learning positive random-feature maps in a first alignment phase, then freezing the kernel and training the remaining network parameters with cross-entropy. Experiments on synthetic classification and sentence-level benchmarks show that learned kernelized attention can improve accuracy, calibration, and robustness for several feature maps while preserving linear-attention inference complexity.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于粒子的方法，通过优化核-目标对齐并利用Riesz/Coulomb排斥势对粒子进行正则化，学习核特征分布。该方法在Transformer线性化注意力中实现，通过第一阶段学习正随机特征图，然后冻结核并训练网络参数。实验表明，该方法在合成分类和句子级基准上提高了准确性、校准性和鲁棒性，同时保持线性注意力推理复杂度。
Motivation: 随机特征为核机器提供可扩展近似，但其性能高度依赖于特征分布的选择。现有方法缺乏对特征分布的自适应学习，本文旨在通过学习分布来改善核机器性能。
Method: 提出一种基于粒子的方法，通过优化核-目标对齐并添加Riesz/Coulomb排斥势正则化，学习随机特征的分布。该方法通过Hamiltonian动力学实现，并可用McKean-Vlasov方程进行平均场描述。在Transformer中，先学习正随机特征图（核对齐），再冻结核并训练其他网络参数。
Result: 在合成分类和句子级基准上，学习的核化注意力相比多种特征图提高了准确性、校准性和鲁棒性，同时保持线性注意力推理复杂度。
Conclusion: 该方法有效提升了线性化Transformer注意力的性能，且不增加推理复杂度。

papers.title: XMix: Combating Extremely Noisy Labels via Local Smoothness in Self-Supervised Feature Space
papers.abstract_en: Supervised deep learning models rely on large, accurately labeled datasets, yet noisy annotations are often unavoidable and can severely degrade performance under high noise levels. Recent state-of-the-art methods tackle this by using sample selection strategies that exploit the memorization effect to filter out clean data for semi-supervised learning. However, these methods struggle with extreme noise, class imbalance, and require careful tuning or prior noise knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose XMix, a novel framework that leverages local smoothness in the self-supervised feature space to systematically enhance all stages of the sample selection process, without dependence on potentially corrupted labels. First, XMix estimates the noise rate using maximum likelihood among self-supervised feature neighbors. Second, these neighbors then help identify additional clean samples and ensure balanced selection across classes during sample selection. Finally, in the semi-supervised learning phase, XMix uses neighboring samples to generate more reliable pseudo-labels. Our empirical results show that XMix substantially outperforms existing methods in extremely noisy environments and maintains superior performance in standard LNL benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XMix框架，利用自监督特征空间中的局部平滑性来改进样本选择过程，以应对极端噪声标签问题，无需依赖被破坏的标签。该方法通过最大似然估计噪声率、利用邻居识别干净样本并确保类别平衡选择、以及在半监督学习阶段生成更可靠的伪标签。实验表明，在极端噪声环境下性能显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在极端噪声、类别不平衡时表现不佳，且需要仔细调参或先验噪声知识。
Method: XMix框架包含三个改进：1) 利用自监督特征邻居的最大似然估计噪声率；2) 在样本选择时使用邻居识别额外干净样本并平衡类别；3) 在半监督学习阶段使用邻居生成更可靠的伪标签。
Result: 在极端噪声环境下显著优于现有方法，并在标准LNL基准上保持优越性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调XMix通过利用自监督特征空间的局部平滑性，系统地增强了样本选择的各个阶段，且不依赖可能被破坏的标签。

papers.title: Head Avatars with Dynamic Explicit Hair
papers.abstract_en: We present DynHair, a novel method for tracking and modeling dynamic hair for human head avatars. From video input, we reconstruct a dynamic head avatar with an explicit strand-based hair representation using structured 3D Gaussian Splatting. In contrast to the face region of human head avatars, which can be modeled with 3D Gaussians that are attached or generated with respect to some expressive 3D head model, hair is particularly challenging as it exhibits dynamic motion effects. Therefore, we present a novel method that models the dynamic deformations of the hair strands using a temporal network that is conditioned on angular velocity and acceleration of the head, as well as relative gravity. Specifically, an LSTM encodes the motion history and modulates per-point strand features via FiLM conditioning which further used by MLP to produce physically plausible displacements to canonical hairstyle. We jointly optimize this motion and appearance representation of the hair, with a 3DGS-based representation of the face-region, via differentiable Gaussian splatting with photometric, geometric, and physics-based supervision. As a result of our method, we retrieve hair tracking of the training video data and an animatable head avatar with controllable hair dynamics. In our experiments, we demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of hair dynamics, temporal consistency, and generalization across subjects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynHair 提出一种从视频中重建动态头部头像的方法，采用显式发丝表示。通过结构化的 3D Gaussian Splatting 建模面部，并利用时间网络（LSTM + FiLM）基于头部角速度、加速度和相对重力预测发丝的物理形变。联合优化头发和面部，实现了可驱动的动态头发头像，在头发动态、时间一致性和跨对象泛化上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有头部头像建模中对头发动态处理不足，头发因受头部运动和重力影响而具有复杂运动，难以用传统 3D 高斯表示。
Method: 利用结构化的 3D 高斯表示显式发丝，通过 LSTM 编码运动历史并用 FiLM 调制发丝特征，由 MLP 输出物理合理的位移；结合面部 3DGS 进行联合优化，使用光度、几何和物理监督。
Result: 在头发动态、时间一致性和跨对象泛化上达到 SOTA 性能，能从训练视频中提取头发跟踪并生成可控动态的头部头像。
Conclusion: DynHair 实现了动态头发的显式建模与驱动，为高保真头部头像提供了有效方法。

papers.title: Controllable Diversity in Normalization-Based Implicit Ensembles via Softmax-Temperature Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Deep ensembles provide the most reliable uncertainty estimates in deep learning, but their cost grows linearly with the number of members. Implicit ensembles lower this cost by sharing a single backbone across members. Member diversity is a primary determinant of ensemble quality, yet no implicit ensemble can shape it during training; existing methods fix it at initialisation or build it into the architecture. We introduce $σ$N-Ens, a normalisation-based implicit ensemble that treats each member as a task in a multi-task architecture and modulates the shared backbone through sigmoid-bounded scalers. We also introduce a softmax-temperature regulariser, which shapes the equilibrium level of sharing between members and traces the accuracy-calibration frontier. Because only normalisation layers are replicated, the mechanism can wrap convolutional and transformer backbones alike, also allowing pretrained models to be adapted through a short fine-tune. We frame the epistemic uncertainty such an ensemble expresses as modulation uncertainty, and explain why its calibration holds under input corruption, and why its out-of-distribution detection is weaker. Our method is evaluated across ResNets and transformers on CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet and SST-2. $σ$N-Ens matches or outperforms deep ensembles at a fraction of their parameter cost, scales with ensemble size where partitioning methods collapse, and maintains calibration under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出σN-Ens，一种基于归一化的隐式集成方法，通过sigmoid有界缩放器将每个成员视为多任务架构中的独立任务，并引入softmax温度正则化器来动态调控成员之间的共享水平，从而在训练中塑造多样性。该方法仅复制归一化层，可包裹卷积和Transformer骨干，并支持预训练模型微调。在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet和SST-2上，σN-Ens以远低于深度集成的参数成本，匹配或超越其性能，且在分布偏移下保持校准。
Motivation: 深度集成提供最佳不确定性估计但成本随成员数线性增长；隐式集成通过共享骨干降低成本，但现有方法无法在训练中控制成员多样性，多样性要么固化于初始化要么内置在架构中。
Method: 提出σN-Ens：将每个集成成员视为多任务学习中的一个任务，通过sigmoid有界缩放器（σ参数）调制共享骨干输出；仅复制归一化层（如BatchNorm）实现成员特异性；引入softmax温度正则化器，通过调整温度参数T刻画准确率-校准前沿，平衡成员间的共享程度。
Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet和SST-2上，σN-Ens匹配或超越深度集成，参数成本仅为深度集成的几分之一；能随集成规模有效扩展（而分区方法会失效）；在输入损坏和分布偏移下保持校准，但OOD检测能力较弱。
Conclusion: σN-Ens通过可控多样性的归一化隐式集成，实现了高性价比的不确定性估计，其表达的认知不确定性（调制不确定性）在分布偏移下校准良好，但OOD检测能力有限，为未来改进指明了方向。

papers.title: Covariance Last-Layer Ensembles: Function-Space Diversity for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: A Last-Layer Ensemble (LLE), $K$ linear units on one shared frozen feature map, is an efficient single-pass approach to the disagreement-based epistemic uncertainty for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Its weakness is that members share the backbone gradient and can converge toward the same function, collapsing the inter-member diversity the signal depends on. Whether last-layer diversity can be restored, and what mitigates the collapse, is an open question. The weight-orthonormality defining Orthonormal Certificates (OC), the weight-orthonormal special case of the LLE, is only an indirect correction; it decorrelates the weights of the members, not their predictions. Here, we instead target the collapse directly in function space, with a Covariance Last-Layer Ensemble (cov-LLE) that places a direct covariance penalty on member activations. Cov-LLE restores the function-space diversity that weight-orthonormality cannot, and at matched $K$ recovers much of the diversity and calibration of a deep ensemble at $1\times$ backbone cost (in-distribution prediction variance $0.05\!\to\!9.3$ vs.\ $22.1$ ($\times10^{-3}$), and ECE $0.135\!\to\!0.090$ vs.\ $0.035$, for a $K\times$-cost deep ensemble), at no cost to accuracy. Viewing OC as a last-layer ensemble also organizes detectors into a two-axis taxonomy (by how their units are trained and how their outputs are scored) and exposes the OC score as a magnitude, motivating a scale-invariant, label-free direction score that repairs its near-OOD failure, adding $+0.16$ to $+0.18$ ROC AUC on every backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协方差最后一层集成 (cov-LLE)，通过直接对成员激活施加协方差惩罚来恢复函数空间多样性，解决最后一层集成中成员预测崩溃的问题。在相同K值下，cov-LLE以单倍骨干网络成本恢复了深度集成的大部分多样性和校准性能，且不损失精度。
Motivation: 最后一层集成 (LLE) 的成员共享骨干梯度，易收敛到相同函数，导致基于分歧的认知不确定性信号失效。权重正交性 (OC) 作为间接矫正，仅去相关权重而非预测，无法根本解决。
Method: cov-LLE 在共享冻结特征图上放置K个线性单元，并对成员激活施加直接的协方差惩罚，以在函数空间上直接促进多样性。
Result: cov-LLE 将分布内预测方差从0.05提升至9.3（×10^{-3}），ECE从0.135降至0.090，接近深度集成的22.1和0.035，且骨干网络成本不变。此外，通过将OC视为最后一层集成，提出尺度无关、无标签的方向分数，修复了近OOD检测失败，在所有骨干网络上ROC AUC提升+0.16至+0.18。
Conclusion: 协方差惩罚是恢复最后一层集成多样性的有效方法，在低成本下实现了接近深度集成的校准与不确定性质量。

papers.title: OmniVAE: An Audio-Video VAE with Cross-Modal Alignment for Joint Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent generative models are moving beyond silent video or standalone audio synthesis toward the joint generation of synchronized audio and video. Despite this progress, jointly generating audio and video with fine-grained cross-modal correspondence remains challenging due to their fundamental structural differences. Most existing methods use audio and video VAEs trained separately. As a result, the two latent spaces lack cross-modal alignment, leaving the downstream generative model to learn cross-modal synchronization from scratch. We present OmniVAE, a jointly trained audio-video VAE that learns fine-grained semantic alignment between audio and video latent representations. Beyond reconstruction, OmniVAE uses a segment-level audio-video contrastive objective to capture temporal-semantic correspondence and align the two latent spaces. In parallel, it distills features from pretrained modality-specific semantic encoders into each modality, improving the downstream learnability of both latent spaces. Extensive experiments show that both objectives consistently improve the learnability of the latent spaces, translating into higher generation quality and more accurate cross-modal synchronization in downstream text-to-audio-video generation. These findings underscore the importance of learning unified representations as a foundation for omnimodal modeling.1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniVAE，一个联合训练的音频-视频 VAE，通过段级对比学习和语义编码器蒸馏实现潜在空间的跨模态语义对齐。实验表明该方法提升了下游文本到音视频生成的质量和同步准确性。
Motivation: 现有音频和视频 VAE 独立训练，潜在空间缺乏对齐，导致下游生成模型需从头学习跨模态同步。
Method: 联合训练音频-视频 VAE，引入段级对比损失（segment-level contrastive objective）对齐潜在空间，并蒸馏预训练语义编码器特征到各模态。
Result: 两种训练目标一致提升潜在空间可学习性，带来更高的生成质量和更准确的跨模态同步。
Conclusion: 学习统一的多模态表示是高质量跨模态生成的基础。

papers.title: Understanding Human-like Solutions in Combinatorial Optimization via Learning and Search
papers.abstract_en: Humans often find good solutions to combinatorial optimization problems that are computationally hard even for advanced computer algorithms. In the Euclidean traveling salesman problems (TSP), people rapidly produce tours that are near-optimal, despite severe limits on time and computation. What makes a tour human-like, and how might such solutions be learned? Here we address these questions through a large-scale behavioral and computational investigation of human performance in Euclidean TSP. We sampled a broad space of TSP instances, collected human solutions, and compared them with neural policies based on Pointer Networks, which are recurrent neural networks with an attention-based pointing mechanism that define probability distributions over valid tours. We trained these networks under multiple objectives, including reinforcement learning (RL), supervised learning from optimal tours, supervised learning from human tours, and RL fine-tuning after optimal-supervised pretraining. Human tours were not identical to optimal tours, but occupied a near-optimal geometric basin: they shared many structural properties with optimal solutions while preserving systematic human-specific deviations. The best account of human tours was not direct imitation of optimal tours, but a model pretrained on optimal tours, fine-tuned by RL, and decoded through $\text{Best-of-}N$ sampling. These findings suggest that human-like solutions may emerge from a combination of structured supervised learning, RL, and test-time search, echoing computational principles underlying many modern artificial intelligence systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模行为与计算实验研究人类在欧几里得旅行商问题（TSP）中的解，发现人类解并非最优但位于近优几何盆地；对比多种训练目标，最优策略是先对最优解进行监督预训练，再经强化学习微调，并采用Best-of-N采样解码。
Motivation: 人类能在计算困难的组合优化问题上快速找到好解，但其机制尚不清楚，本文旨在理解什么是类人解以及如何学习。
Method: 采样大量TSP实例，收集人类解，训练基于Pointer Network的神经策略，分别使用强化学习、从最优解监督学习、从人类解监督学习，以及先最优监督预训练再强化学习微调等多种目标。
Result: 人类解与最优解共享许多结构特性，但存在系统性偏差；最佳模型是预训练于最优解后经强化学习微调，并通过Best-of-N采样解码。
Conclusion: 类人解可能来自结构化监督学习、强化学习和测试时搜索的结合。

papers.title: Do Visual Features Improve Other-Initiated Repair Detection? A Dyadic Multimodal Approach
papers.abstract_en: Other-initiated Self-repair, or in short Other-initiated Repair (OIR), is an essential mechanism in conversational interaction, whereby a recipient signals a problem in speaking, hearing, or understanding, prompting the previous speaker to resolve it. In the case of conversational agents, it is essential to accurately identify these repair initiation strategies to address communication breakdowns efficiently. While conversational analysis studies have shown that OIR initiation is accompanied by both verbal and non-verbal signals such as gaze shifts, facial expressions, body postures, and hand gestures, existing computational approaches rely mainly on text and audio. This paper introduces a novel multimodal model for OIR detection and classification, incorporating a set of visual features drawn from conversation analysis. We evaluate our approach on two corpora with distinct languages and interaction settings. Results demonstrate that visual information consistently improves performance over text and audio baselines, and provide insights into cross-modal feature contributions across two corpora.

papers.title: OmniCache: Multidimensional Hierarchical Feature Caching For Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution image and video diffusion models, including SD3, FLUX, and recent video diffusion transformers, have substantially improved generative quality but remain expensive at inference time because they repeatedly evaluate attention-heavy denoisers over many sampling steps. We address this inefficiency by exploiting redundancy in intermediate diffusion features rather than changing model weights or retraining. We identify four complementary redundancy sources in image and video generation: intra-frame, inter-frame, motion, and denoising-step redundancy. Based on this analysis, we propose OmniCache, a unified hierarchical caching framework that performs multidimensional feature reuse through Token Cache, Frame Cache, Block Cache, and Layered Cache. Unlike token-merging baselines that average matched features, OmniCache uses similarity matching to select cacheable features, skips redundant computation, and restores positionally consistent cached activations, preserving feature order and spatial-temporal structure. The resulting framework reuses spatial features in temporal layers and temporal features in spatial layers, while Layered Cache captures cross-step redundancy at the model-layer level. Across SD3, SVD-XT, and Latte, OmniCache reduces inference latency by up to 35%, 25%, and 28%, respectively, while maintaining visual fidelity and motion coherence in a training-free setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniCache，一种无需重新训练的统一层次化缓存框架，通过识别图像和视频扩散模型中的四种冗余来源（帧内、帧间、运动、去噪步冗余）并利用 Token Cache、Frame Cache、Block Cache 和 Layered Cache 进行多维特征复用，在不改变模型权重的情况下，在 SD3、SVD-XT 和 Latte 上分别减少 35%、25% 和 28% 的推理延迟，同时保持视觉质量和运动一致性。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像和视频扩散模型在推理时因重复评估注意力密集的去噪器而成本高昂，现有方法需要改变权重或重新训练，本文旨在通过利用中间扩散特征的冗余性来降低计算开销。
Method: 提出 OmniCache，包含四种缓存机制：Token Cache（帧内冗余）、Frame Cache（帧间冗余）、Block Cache（运动冗余）和 Layered Cache（跨去噪步冗余）。通过相似度匹配选择可缓存特征，跳过冗余计算并恢复位置一致的缓存激活，保持特征顺序和时空结构。
Result: 在 SD3、SVD-XT 和 Latte 上分别实现高达 35%、25% 和 28% 的推理延迟降低，同时保持视觉保真度和运动连贯性，且无需训练。
Conclusion: OmniCache 通过多维特征复用有效加速扩散模型推理，适用于多种图像和视频生成架构，且不依赖重新训练。

papers.title: Limbomorphs
papers.abstract_en: Artificial life systems are typically defined by a set of dynamical rules over an environment, an agent, or both, from which lifelike patterns may emerge. Gifbreeder is an animated version of the interactive evolutionary computation (IEC) platform Picbreeder, and was initially created to generate visual art. Instead of encoding the agent or the environment, Gifbreeder genomes encode a spatiotemporal field and evolve through the user's aesthetic selection. The evolved expressions can sometimes resemble motile lifelike creatures that we term Limbomorphs, given that they exist in a deterministic three-second looping "limbo". We assess their behavior via input-space perturbations and find species-specific reactions to different kinds of perturbations. We discuss whether these reactions may reflect goal-directed behavior like navigation, or merely the appearance of it, and more broadly how agent-like dynamics may emerge in a system with no explicitly defined agent, environment, or interaction rules.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 3 figures. Extended abstract accepted as a Late Breaking Abstract at the Artificial Life Conference (ALIFE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Limbomorphs，即Gifbreeder平台上通过用户审美选择进化出的类似运动生物的时空场模式，存在于三秒循环中。作者通过输入扰动分析其行为，发现物种特异性反应，并讨论这些反应是否体现目标导向行为。
Motivation: 现有的人工生命系统通常明确定义环境和智能体，而Gifbreeder无明确智能体或环境定义，却可生成类似运动生物的模式，这促使作者研究其行为本质。
Method: 使用Gifbreeder平台（Picbreeder的动画版本），通过交互式进化计算让用户选择可视化结果，编码时空场而非智能体或环境；对进化出的Limbomorphs施加输入空间扰动以观察反应。
Result: 发现不同Limbomorph物种对不同扰动类型有特异性反应，暗示可能存在类似于导航的目标导向行为，但摘要未提供定量指标。
Conclusion: 讨论了在没有明确定义智能体、环境和交互规则的系统如何涌现类似智能体行为，并指出需进一步区分真实目标导向与表面现象。

papers.title: STEER: Steerable Dyadic Head Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Facial movement and expression are central to face-to-face communication, conveying turn-taking, attention, agreement, and engagement alongside speech. While speech-driven facial animation has made strong progress in lip synchronization and audio-conditioned motion generation, most methods treat conversational behavior as an emergent byproduct of audio, or expose only coarse sequence-level affect control. As a result, key non-verbal channels such as gaze contact and aversion, rhythmic head motion, and emotion remain difficult to explicitly control. We present STEER, a controllable 3D dyadic motion prior for reactive conversational head avatars. STEER factorizes conversational behavior into explicit controls for gaze, head rhythm, and emotion, allowing users to steer how an avatar listens, reacts, and engages with a conversation partner. Since temporally aligned annotations for these behaviors are not available in public dyadic corpora, we introduce a tracking and annotation pipeline that recovers behavioral pseudo-labels from in-the-wild dyadic video. A causal flow-matching transformer then learns partner-aware target motion conditioned on audio, partner motion, emotion and the proposed behavioral controls. We further embed STEER in a photorealistic avatar pipeline by extending a Universal Gaussian Head-Avatar Prior with a learned mapping from tracked parametric motion into its avatar-driving space. This enables controllable animation of high-fidelity Gaussian head avatars without re-training the underlying avatar model. STEER outperforms recent dyadic motion baselines on motion quality, dynamics, and diversity, remains competitive on partner coupling, and enables gaze, head-rhythm, and emotion edits together with an interactive live deployment. We make our code and dataset annotations available at our webpage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEER，一种可控的 3D 二元运动先验，用于反应性对话头头像。它通过 gaze、head rhythm 和 emotion 等显式控制，使头像能够以可编辑的方式参与对话。方法包括从野生二元视频中提取行为伪标签的管道，以及因果流匹配变换器来生成目标运动。STEER 嵌入到基于通用高斯头头像先验的逼真头像管道中，无需重新训练即可实现高保真控制。实验表明，STEER 在运动质量、动态和多样性上优于近期基线，并支持交互式实时部署。
Motivation: 现有语音驱动面部动画方法难以显式控制非语言交流通道（如目光接触、头部节奏和情感），这些通道对于面对面交流至关重要。
Method: 提出一个跟踪和标注管道，从野生二元视频中恢复行为伪标签，并利用因果流匹配变换器学习以音频、伙伴运动、情感和行为控制为条件的运动生成。通过将跟踪的参数运动映射到高斯头头像驱动空间，实现无需重新训练的可控动画。
Result: STEER 在运动质量、动态和多样性上优于近期二元运动基线，在伙伴耦合方面保持竞争力，并支持 gaze、head-rhythm 和 emotion 的编辑和交互式实时部署。
Conclusion: STEER 通过显式解耦行为控制实现了对话头像的高度可控性，且无需重新训练底层头像模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TriShieldRAG: A Three-Ring Defense-in-Depth Framework Against Knowledge Corruption in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) lets a large language model answer questions using documents retrieved from an external knowledge base at query time. This makes RAG useful for private data, fast-changing information, and reducing hallucination, but it also means the model's answer is only as trustworthy as whatever the retriever hands it. If the knowledge base accepts writes from more than one party, an attacker needs only a handful of adversarial documents to steer the model toward a chosen wrong answer. PoisonedRAG demonstrated this: as few as five crafted documents flip an undefended system's answer roughly 90% of the time, and three natural single-stage defenses (perplexity filtering, query paraphrasing, knowledge-base expansion) leave attack success at 30% or higher. We built TriShieldRAG to close that gap. Rather than relying on one checkpoint, we place three independent, formally specified rings across the pipeline: an Ingest Guard that screens documents for lexical and statistical poisoning signatures; a Retrieval Scorer that re-ranks the retrieved set by a provenance and consistency-weighted trust score; and a Cross-LLM Consensus stage that polls three architecturally diverse language models (Claude, Mistral Small, Llama 3.2) and allows one bounded re-retrieval on disagreement. We derive the conditions under which Rings 2 and 3 are expected to work: a minority-poison assumption and an explicit provenance-tag assumption. Our reported configuration is consistent with this analysis, though we have not yet run the controlled poison-fraction sweep needed to confirm it independently. Evaluated against the non-adaptive attacker from the original PoisonedRAG, over a 5,000-document Wikipedia knowledge base with 10 target questions, the full pipeline reduces attack success rate from roughly 91% to roughly 13% while preserving accuracy on benign queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriShieldRAG，一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）中知识投毒攻击的三环防御框架。该框架包含文档摄入守卫、检索重排序评分器以及跨LLM共识阶段，旨在降低攻击成功率。评估表明，在 PoisonedRAG 的非自适应攻击下，攻击成功率从约 91% 降至约 13%，同时保持对良性查询的准确性。
Motivation: RAG 系统依赖外部知识库，当知识库接受多方写入时，恶意文档可轻易操纵模型输出。现有单阶段防御（如困惑度过滤、查询改写、知识库扩展）在 PoisonedRAG 攻击下仍留有超过 30% 的攻击成功率，亟需更鲁棒的防御方案。
Method: 提出三环防御：1) 摄入守卫：基于词汇和统计特征检测投毒文档；2) 检索评分器：根据来源可信度和一致性对检索结果重新排序；3) 跨LLM共识：使用三个架构不同的语言模型（Claude, Mistral Small, Llama 3.2）进行投票，并在意见分歧时进行一次受限的重新检索。
Result: 在包含 5,000 篇文档的 Wikipedia 知识库和 10 个目标问题的测试中，完整管线将 PoisonedRAG 非自适应攻击的成功率从约 91% 降至约 13%，同时保持对良性查询的准确性。
Conclusion: TriShieldRAG 通过多环独立防御显著降低了知识投毒的攻击成功率，但作者指出尚未完成对投毒比例的系统性扫描实验以独立验证理论条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent-LoRA: Compact Latent-Space Adapters with Gradient-Free Routing for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models generalize well to individual tasks but lack an inherent mechanism for learning them sequentially, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To mitigate this, LoRA-based continual learning methods allocate a separate low-rank adapter per task, yet existing approaches either require task identity at inference or sum all adapters indiscriminately, letting irrelevant branches distort the output. Recent gating-based solutions route inputs to the correct adapter but introduce trainable parameters that themselves need protection against forgetting. In this work, we observe that pooled token embeddings from a frozen LLM embedding layer already separate task distributions throughout the learning sequence. A Gaussian mixture model fitted on these embeddings, without any gradient-based training, is sufficient for task-agnostic adapter selection at test time. This eliminates the need for a learned gating module. On the adapter side, constraining each task's parameters to the principal subspace of the pretrained weights via SVD yields a compact latent-space parameterization. Within this subspace, orthogonal regularization directly controls inter-task interference. The resulting system, Latent-LoRA, is replay-free, requires no trainable routing component, and uses substantially fewer parameters per task. Experiments across five model scales and two established continual learning benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance with near-zero forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent-LoRA，一种无需梯度训练的路由机制，利用冻结 LLM 嵌入层池化后的 token 嵌入来拟合高斯混合模型，实现任务无关的适配器选择；同时通过 SVD 将任务参数约束在预训练权重的子空间内，用正交正则化控制任务间干扰。实验表明该方法在多个模型规模和基准上达到近乎零遗忘的持续学习性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 LoRA 的持续学习方法要么需要推理时任务标识，要么不加区分地求和所有适配器导致输出扭曲；基于门控的方法引入了需要防止遗忘的可训练参数。
Method: 观察冻结 LLM 嵌入层池化后的 token 嵌入已能分离任务分布，在其上拟合高斯混合模型实现无梯度路由；通过 SVD 将每个任务参数约束在预训练权重的主子空间，并在该子空间内施加正交正则化控制任务间干扰。
Result: 在五个模型规模和两个持续学习基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，遗忘率接近零，且每任务参数量显著减少。

papers.title: Consistent Evidence, Robust Recognition: Faithful Attribution Regularization under Geometric Transformations
papers.abstract_en: Attribution methods are widely used to characterize the evidence underlying model predictions, yet their potential to improve model behavior remains underexplored. Attribution inconsistency under label-preserving geometric transformations may indicate transformation-sensitive evidence reliance, motivating attribution regularization. However, such supervision is valid only when attribution faithfully reflects the evidence driving predictions. Existing self-supervised methods typically align gradient-based maps such as Grad-CAM, whose limited faithfulness means that attribution consistency need not imply consistency of the underlying decision process, leaving transformation robustness unresolved. We propose an annotation-free attribution regularization framework based on submodular search over image regions. By measuring how candidate subsets affect model outputs, the search extracts compact, class-discriminative evidence as search-derived supervision. We further introduce a submodular ranking loss with path-consistency and termination-alignment terms that respectively align spatially corresponding candidate rankings along paired search trajectories and encourage the transformed trajectory to satisfy the stopping criterion at the target terminal step. The loss provides a differentiable surrogate for regularizing both final attributions and the otherwise discrete evidence-selection process. Experiments on ImageNet-100 show that our method substantially improves attribution stability, Insertion, and Deletion on ViT-B/16 with only a 0.28-point accuracy drop, with similar gains on ViT-L/16. On ImageNet-1K, it improves transformed-input accuracy on ResNet-50 and ConvNeXt-B while limiting the clean-accuracy drop to 0.30 points, demonstrating more consistent evidence reliance with minimal performance loss. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对几何变换下归因不一致问题，提出一种无需标注的归因正则化框架。通过子模搜索提取紧凑、类别判别性的证据作为监督信号，并引入子模排序损失，包含路径一致性和终止对齐项，用于正则化最终归因和离散证据选择过程。实验表明，该方法在ImageNet-100上显著提升ViT-B/16的归因稳定性和插入/删除分数，仅导致0.28点准确率下降；在ImageNet-1K上提升ResNet-50和ConvNeXt-B的变换输入准确率，干净准确率下降控制在0.30点以内。
Motivation: 现有归因方法在标签保持的几何变换下往往不一致，暗示模型依赖于对变换敏感的证据；自监督对齐方法通常对齐Grad-CAM等梯度图，其忠实性有限，导致归因一致性不一定反映决策过程的一致性，无法解决变换鲁棒性问题。
Method: 提出基于子模搜索的无标注归因正则化框架：通过测量候选子集对模型输出的影响，提取紧凑且类别判别性的证据作为搜索导出监督；引入子模排序损失，包含路径一致性项（对齐空间对应的候选排名沿成对搜索轨迹）和终止对齐项（鼓励变换后的轨迹在目标终止步满足停止准则），为离散证据选择过程提供可微替代。
Result: 在ImageNet-100上，ViT-B/16的归因稳定性、插入和删除分数显著提升，仅下降0.28点准确率；ViT-L/16上也有类似增益。在ImageNet-1K上，ResNet-50和ConvNeXt-B的变换输入准确率提升，干净准确率下降不超过0.30点。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了基于子模搜索的归因正则化能有效提高模型对几何变换的证据一致性，同时保持极小的性能损失，为提升模型鲁棒性提供了一种无需额外标注的途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DriveDNA: A Large-Scale Multimodal Naturalistic Driving Dataset and Benchmark for Driving Style Identification
papers.abstract_en: Driving style captures stable, driver-specific patterns in how a vehicle is driven. In naturalistic data, however, this signal is hard to isolate because drivers are observed in different vehicles, on different roads, and under different conditions, so models may mistake vehicle- or situation-specific regularities for driver-specific style. We introduce DriveDNA, a large-scale naturalistic dataset and benchmark for personalized driving-style modeling, comprising 4,121 drives from 465 drivers across 115 vehicle models and totaling 975 hours of human-controlled driving at 10 Hz with forward video, collected from community drivers in everyday use. DriveDNA defines driving style as a consistent, driver-specific behavioral pattern in how a vehicle moves under similar conditions. The benchmark evaluates this signal through three core tasks: few-shot driver re-identification, personalized behavior prediction, and condition-matched comparison, and provides behavioral annotations plus 276,248 rule-generated maneuver events across six classes with large-scale human auditing. We evaluate baselines spanning classical descriptors, supervised and self-supervised time-series encoders, multimodal fusion, probabilistic prediction, and zero-shot foundation models under a fixed multi-seed protocol. Learned representations substantially outperform classical descriptors on unseen drivers (AUROC .935 vs. .707) and retain driver-specific information under matched driving conditions, while descriptor performance approaches chance. Video-only models achieve comparable re-identification accuracy but exhibit severe route leakage, showing that strong recognition may arise from contextual shortcuts rather than driving behavior. These findings show that reliable driving-style evaluation must assess both the behavioral value of learned representations and their robustness to vehicle, drive, and condition confounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍DriveDNA，一个大规模多模态自然驾驶数据集，用于驾驶风格建模，包含4121次驾驶、465名驾驶员、115种车型，共975小时，10Hz采样及前视视频。定义了驾驶风格为相似条件下驾驶员特定的一致模式，通过少样本驾驶员重识别、个性化行为预测和条件匹配比较三个任务评估。实验表明学习表示显著优于经典描述符，但视频模型存在路线泄漏问题。
Motivation: 现有自然驾驶数据难以隔离驾驶员风格，因为驾驶员在不同车辆、道路和条件下被观测，模型可能混淆车辆或情境特征与驾驶员风格。
Method: 构建DriveDNA数据集，定义三个核心任务（少样本驾驶员重识别、个性化行为预测、条件匹配比较），并提供行为标注和276,248个规则生成的事件。评估基线包括经典描述符、监督/自监督时间序列编码器、多模态融合、概率预测和零样本基础模型。
Result: 学习表示在未见驾驶员上AUROC达到0.935，经典描述符仅0.707；学习表示在匹配驾驶条件下保留驾驶员特定信息，而描述符接近随机；仅视频模型重识别精度相当但存在严重路线泄漏。
Conclusion: 可靠的驾驶风格评估必须同时评估学习表示的行为价值及其对车辆、驾驶和条件混杂因素的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCTA: An Agentic Framework for Stable and Interpretable Target Gene Discovery from Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
papers.abstract_en: Identifying therapeutic target genes from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data remains a fundamental challenge in translational biology. Unlike bulk assays, scRNA-seq captures heterogeneous cellular states and rare subpopulations, but this same heterogeneity makes target discovery highly sensitive to analytical choices throughout the pipeline, including preprocessing, cell population selection, differential expression analysis, and downstream biological interpretation. As a result, existing workflows and general-purpose analysis agents often produce unstable or difficult-to-interpret target hypotheses, limiting their reliability for disease-focused discovery. We present SCTA (Single-Cell Target Agent), a decision-centric agentic framework for stable and interpretable target gene discovery from scRNA-seq data. Rather than treating analysis as a single general-purpose reasoning task, SCTA decomposes target discovery into specialized agents aligned with key decision points in the single-cell pipeline and constrains downstream reasoning with structured biological evidence. In a representative ablation study on hereditary chronic pancreatitis, we demonstrate that SCTA's full evidence integration yields the most stable target selection across independent runs among the tested configurations, while recovering biologically coherent, disease-relevant mechanisms validated in prior studies. These results suggest that decision-aware agent orchestration tailored to the structure of single-cell analysis can improve the robustness, interpretability, and practical utility of target discovery in precision medicine.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. To appear in the ACM SIGKDD Workshop on Data Mining in Bioinformatics (BioKDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCTA，一个面向单细胞RNA测序数据的目标基因发现框架，将分析分解为多个专门智能体，并利用结构化生物学证据约束推理。在遗传性慢性胰腺炎的消融研究中，SCTA的完整证据集成在多次独立运行中实现了最稳定的目标选择，并恢复了先前研究验证的生物学相关机制。
Motivation: 单细胞RNA测序数据分析流程中的各个环节（预处理、细胞群选择、差异表达分析、生物学解释）的选择会严重影响目标发现稳定性，现有工作流和通用分析智能体常产生不稳定或难以解释的目标假设。
Method: SCTA将目标发现分解为与单细胞分析关键决策点对齐的专门智能体，并用结构化生物学证据约束下游推理。
Result: 在遗传性慢性胰腺炎的消融研究中，SCTA的完整证据集成在多次独立运行中实现了最稳定的目标选择，并恢复了生物学一致、疾病相关的机制，与先前研究一致。
Conclusion: 针对单细胞分析结构定制的决策感知智能体编排可以改善精准医学中目标发现的鲁棒性、可解释性和实用性。

papers.title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The key opportunity is pipelined execution across semantic operators: when intermediate tuples flow directly from one operator to the next, their KV-cache state can be reused instead of recomputed. We present Kalypso, a relational LLM serving system that exposes an API for semantic query plans and executes them using an adaptive, memory-aware scheduling algorithm. Kalypso addresses a new online scheduling problem in which pipelined operator execution is coupled with GPU memory pressure management to reuse KV-cache state in the serving engine before eviction. Its scheduler continuously adjusts memory allocations to balance upstream parallelism, downstream progress, and GPU utilization. Our evaluation shows that Kalypso improves query completion time over baselines using request-centric LLM serving, with speedups up to 4.57x across diverse workloads, demonstrating that query-aware LLM serving can substantially improve the efficiency of semantic query execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出关系型LLM服务（relational LLM serving）抽象，使LLM服务感知语义查询计划，通过跨语义操作符的流水线执行和KV缓存重用提升效率。实现的系统Kalypso采用自适应内存感知调度算法，在GPU内存压力管理下实现流水线操作符执行。实验表明，与请求中心型LLM服务基线相比，Kalypso在多种工作负载上将查询完成时间提升最高4.57倍。
Motivation: 现有语义查询处理系统使用请求中心型LLM服务，不感知查询计划，导致大量性能机会未被利用。
Method: 提出关系型LLM服务抽象，并实现Kalypso系统，该系统通过流水线执行语义操作符（中间元组直接流动）重用KV缓存状态，并采用自适应、内存感知的调度算法平衡上游并行度、下游进度和GPU利用率。
Result: 摘要报告Kalypso在多种语义查询工作负载上将查询完成时间提升最高4.57倍。
Conclusion: 查询感知的LLM服务能够显著提升语义查询执行的效率。

papers.title: Earnings25: A Comprehensive 500-Hour Speech Benchmark for Finance
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Earnings25, a finance-domain benchmark for evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) on English-language earnings calls under realistic conditions. Earnings25 comprises two complementary test sets: (i) testset-full, 498 hours of full English-language S&P 500 earnings calls from Q4 2025, and (ii) testset-segmented, a 46-hour industry-balanced set of 290 segments sampled from English-language U.S. earnings calls in 2025. The benchmark provides aligned transcripts and structured metadata, including speaker roles, industry labels, and call structure, enabling speaker- and industry-aware evaluation beyond aggregate word error rate (WER). We report reproducible baselines for Whisper and Parakeet-TDT using standardized scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Earnings25，一个用于金融领域英语财报电话会议自动语音识别（ASR）评估的基准测试。基准包含两个互补测试集：testset-full（498小时完整S&P 500电话会议）和testset-segmented（46小时行业均衡分段集）。提供对齐转录和结构化元数据（说话人角色、行业标签、会议结构），支持说话人和行业感知评估，并报告了Whisper和Parakeet-TDT的可重复基线。
Motivation: 现有ASR基准缺乏专门针对金融领域的评估，尤其是财报电话会议场景；通常仅报告总体词错误率（WER），忽略了说话人角色、行业差异等细微因素。
Method: 构建大规模（498小时）和均衡（46小时，覆盖290个分段）两个测试集，并提供带说话人角色、行业标签、会议结构的元数据。使用标准化评分脚本对Whisper和Parakeet-TDT进行基线评估。

papers.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Agentic tasks are inherently long-horizon and multi-turn, constantly accumulating context through interactions with the environment. Existing context compression methods inevitably incur information loss and are triggered by rigid heuristic rules, leaving them misaligned with the agent's evolving reasoning focus. We propose Agentic Context Management (ACM), a framework that equips agents with purpose-built context editing tools for lossless context management. Inspired by the interaction between short-term and long-term human memory, the agent autonomously decides when to compress its context, offloads discarded content to an external memory system, and queries it on demand for later retrieval. Building on this framework, we further develop a post-training pipeline that constructs high-quality demonstrations of context management and improves model performance on both agentic search and coding tasks. Further analysis reveals that effective context management reduces peak token pressure, enables extended explorations, and yields more consistent solutions across independent trials. Code, data, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/lixiaochuan2020/agentic-context-management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Context Management (ACM) 框架，让智能体自主管理长程任务中的上下文，通过上下文编辑工具实现无损压缩，并利用外部记忆系统存储和检索丢弃的内容。基于该框架的后训练流程在搜索和编程任务上提升了模型性能。
Motivation: 现有上下文压缩方法依赖固定启发式规则，导致信息丢失且与智能体的推理重点不匹配，无法有效应对长程多轮任务。
Method: 受人类短期与长期记忆交互启发，ACM 框架赋予智能体自主决策何时压缩上下文的工具，将丢弃内容卸载到外部记忆系统，并在需要时按需查询。后训练阶段构建高质量上下文管理示范，优化模型。
Result: 该方法在搜索和编程任务上提升性能，有效降低峰值 token 压力，支持更长的探索，并获得更一致的解决方案。
Conclusion: 论文强调自主上下文管理能够缓解长程任务中的信息过载问题，代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: Indic DiarBench: A Multilingual Joint Diarization and ASR Benchmark for Indian Languages
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce Indic DiarBench, a speaker diarization and ASR benchmark dataset spanning all 22 scheduled languages of India. This corpus comprises approximately 108 hours of natural multi-speaker audio from near-field meetings, far-field recordings, and in-the-wild audios. All annotations are human-corrected with time-aligned speaker attributed transcriptions. The dataset captures conversational nuance prevalent in Indian speech, such as English code-mixing, dialectal variation, and frequent speaker overlap. To establish a baseline for joint ASR and diarization capabilities we evaluate leading systems including commercial speech APIs and multimodal large language models. Indic DiarBench is released as an open-access resource to advance inclusive, multilingual speech technology research for Indian languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Indic DiarBench，一个覆盖印度全部22种官方语言的联合说话人日记化（speaker diarization）与自动语音识别（ASR）基准数据集。该语料库包含约108小时的自然多说话人音频，涵盖近场会议、远场录制及野外音频，所有标注均经过人工校正并附带时间对齐的说话人转录。数据集还捕捉了印度语音中的常见会话特征，如英语混合编码、方言变异及说话人重叠。研究评估了包括商业语音API和多模态大语言模型在内的主流系统在联合ASR与日记化任务上的基线性能。该数据集以开放获取形式发布，旨在推动面向印度语言的包容性多语种语音技术研究。
Motivation: 现有语音处理基准在印度语言的覆盖上不全面，缺乏同时支持说话人日记化与ASR的标准数据集，且对印度英语混合编码、方言多样性等特有挑战关注不足。
Method: 构建包含108小时多说话人音频的语料库，覆盖22种印度语言，包含三种录制场景（近场、远场、野外）。所有标注经过人工校正，提供时间对齐的说话人转录。评估了商业语音API（如Google/Amazon等）及多模态大语言模型在联合任务上的表现。
Result: 建立了联合ASR与日记化的基线性能，展示了当前系统在处理印度语言特有挑战（如代码混合、说话人重叠）时的不足。数据集公开可用。
Conclusion: Indic DiarBench 提供了首个覆盖全部印度官方语言的联合日记化与ASR基准，有助于推动多语种、低资源语音技术的发展。
Relevance: 0
