papers.title: SpecAHD: Localize to Specialize for Automated Heuristic Design in Large-Scale Routing Problems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) typically scores executable programs on complete instances or within fixed solver components. In large-scale routing problems, localized reconstruction reduces the size of each optimization task, but repair regions within the same incumbent can exhibit substantially different structures. One construction rule must therefore compromise across them. In this paper, we propose SpecAHD, a coupled bilevel framework for within-instance specialization. An upper-level search learns where to expose bounded repair regions, while a lower-level search evolves a complementary repertoire of executable heuristics for the induced repair tasks. The upper-level program determines the repair tasks seen by the lower level, while checked repair outcomes determine how upper-level programs are evaluated. The lower-level objective favors heuristics that perform well on average or solve tasks that the current repertoire handles poorly. For the repair tasks induced by a fixed upper-level program and a fixed lower-level candidate pool, this objective is monotone submodular, allowing greedy repertoire selection with a (1-1/e) approximation guarantee. Across four routing problems and multiple LLM backbones, SpecAHD reduces held-out objective cost by up to 57.7% against the strongest competing AHD baseline and outperforms the per-instance baseline envelope on most public instances.

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecAHD，一个用于大规模路径问题中自动启发式设计（AHD）的双层优化框架。上层次搜索确定有界修复区域，下层次进化互补的启发式程序池。目标函数是单调子模的，允许贪心选择保证(1-1/e)近似。在四个路径问题和多个LLM骨干上，该方法将held-out目标成本降低最多57.7%，优于最强基线。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的AHD通常在完整实例或固定求解器组件内评分，但在大规模路径问题中，局部重建任务的结构差异很大，单一构造规则需妥协。
Method: 提出耦合双层框架：上层次学习暴露有界修复区域，下层次进化互补的可执行启发式程序池。下层次目标函数是单调子模的，可贪心选择近似最优池。
Result: 在四个路由问题和多个LLM骨干上，SpecAHD将held-out目标成本降低最多57.7%，并在大多数公开实例上超越每个实例的基线信封。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过局部化与专业化，可以显著提升自动启发式设计在大规模路径问题中的性能。

papers.title: An empirical investigation into the properties of standard word embeddings
papers.abstract_en: The embedding of word sequences into continuous vector spaces has been one of the most important developments in Natural Language Processing in the recent past. Such embeddings have found application in areas such as Automatic Speech Recognition, Machine Translation, Sentiment Analysis and many more. This essay reviews the various mechanisms that have been proposed for the calculation of word embeddings, investigates popular toolkits and embedding matrices that are available in the public domain, and experiments with one or more selected implementations to better understand their characteristics. La représentation vectorielle continue de mots a été l'un des développements les plus importants dans le domaine du traitement automatique du langage naturel au cours des dernières années. Ces représentations ont trouvé application dans des domaines tels que la reconnaissance vocale, la traduction automatique, l'analyse des sentiments, etc. Ce travail passe en revue les différents mécanismes proposés pour le calcul de ces vecteurs de mots, étudie les kits d'outils populaires et les matrices disponibles publiquement en ligne, et expérimente avec une ou plusieurs implémentations sélectionnées pour mieux comprendre leurs caractéristiques.

papers.title: Contrastive Parameter Disentanglement for Multi-modal Remote Sensing Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing remote sensing image generation methods are largely confined to single-modality synthesis and therefore fail to exploit the complementary information inherent in multimodal imagery. To address this limitation, we propose a contrastive parameter disentanglement framework for multimodal remote sensing image generation, which generates semantically consistent and structurally aligned images across multiple modalities, including optical, infrared, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR), from a single text prompt. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive parameter disentanglement module that disentangles shared semantics from modality-specific attributes at the parameter level within an orthogonal core subspace. Based on this module, we develop a disentangled optimization strategy that first constrains the parameter matrix A of the LoRA adapter to capture modality-invariant semantics through a multimodal contrastive objective and then guides multiple parameter matrices B to learn modality-specific attributes under text conditioning. This strategy enables the simultaneous generation of multimodal images with consistent semantic content and distinct modality characteristics. Furthermore, to ensure structural alignment across the generated images, we devise a query-key structure transfer mechanism that jointly models multimodal sampling trajectories during inference by transferring structural correlation priors from an anchor modality to the remaining modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art remote sensing image generation approaches in terms of generation quality, semantic consistency, and structural alignment, while also achieving superior performance in the downstream object classification task.

TL;DR: 本文提出对比参数解缠框架，用于多模态遥感图像生成，从单一文本提示同时生成光学、红外和SAR图像。通过对比参数解缠模块在正交核心子空间内分离共享语义与模态特定属性，并设计查询-键结构转移机制确保生成图像的结构对齐。实验表明该方法在生成质量、语义一致性和结构对齐上超越现有方法，并在下游目标分类任务中表现优异。
Motivation: 现有遥感图像生成方法局限于单模态合成，无法利用多模态图像的互补信息。
Method: 提出对比参数解缠框架，包括对比参数解缠模块（在正交核心子空间内从参数层面分离共享语义与模态属性）和查询-键结构转移机制（通过从锚模态转移结构相关性先验来联合建模多模态采样轨迹）。
Result: 在生成质量、语义一致性和结构对齐方面超越现有方法，并在下游目标分类任务中取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 该方法能同时生成具有一致语义和不同模态特征的多模态遥感图像，且结构对齐良好。

papers.title: Plans Work in Mysterious Ways: Evaluating a Plan Mode for Spreadsheet Agents
papers.abstract_en: Plan Modes have become standard features in agentic programming tools, allowing users to gain transparency and control by working with the agent to develop a plan before task execution. However, it remains unclear whether the benefits of this feature translate to end-user programming environments such as spreadsheets. Since spreadsheet programmers tend to work iteratively and care less about technical correctness, upfront planning may not fit into their workflows as easily. In this paper, we build a prototype of a Plan Mode for spreadsheet programming and evaluate it against a non-planning baseline through a within-subjects user study (N=24). We found that despite similar task outcomes with both tools, using Plan Mode led to a reduction in refinement and a better perception of the tool across dimensions of creativity support and human-machine collaboration. We discuss the implications of these results for the future design of Plan Modes, and for the broader role of human-AI planning in end-user programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了电子表格编程场景中计划模式（Plan Mode）的有效性。研究者构建了一个电子表格编程的计划模式原型，并通过24名被试的受试者内用户研究，将其与无计划基线进行了对比。结果显示，虽然两种工具的任务结果相似，但使用计划模式减少了用户对任务的迭代调整，并在创造力支持和人机协作感知方面获得了更好的评价。
Motivation: 计划模式已成为智能编程工具的标准功能，但其对电子表格这类终端用户编程环境是否同样有效尚不明确。电子表格用户倾向于迭代式工作，对技术正确性关注较少，因此预先规划可能难以融入其工作流程。
Method: 构建了一个电子表格编程的计划模式原型，并通过对24名被试的受试者内用户研究，将其与无计划的基线工具进行对比评估。
Result: 两种工具的任务结果相似，但使用计划模式减少了用户的迭代调整次数，并在创造力支持和人机协作感知维度上获得了更好的评价。
Conclusion: 讨论了对未来计划模式设计的启示，以及人机协作规划在终端用户编程中的更广泛作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Robust object 6D pose tracking is critical for robotic systems operating in dynamic and occluded scenes. Per-frame estimators are accurate but computationally expensive, while current trackers struggle with fast motion and complete occlusion due to their reliance on continuous visibility. To address these challenges, we present RRTrack, an efficient, recoverable object 6D pose tracker that enables robust tracking through fast motion and target disappearance--reappearance. RRTrack introduces a 2D--6D closed-loop tracking strategy that integrates memory-based video object segmentation (VOS) with 6D pose refinement. The 2D branch maintains target localization, and the 6D branch verifies geometric consistency before memory updates. In addition, a DINOv2-based dual-bank template matching module is developed to recover lost targets by jointly exploiting offline synthetic templates and online observation anchors while maintaining real-time efficiency. We also introduce a synthetic RGB-D benchmark comprising three robotic scenarios with fast motion and full occlusion. Experimental results on the synthetic benchmark demonstrate that RRTrack improves equal-subset mean ADD-S AR by 66.3\% and ADD-S AUC by 65.7\% over FoundationPose while achieving 55.2 FPS. Real-world experiments further validate the robustness of RRTrack under noisy sensing conditions. Project page: https://github.com/7kevin24/RRTrack
papers.comment: 6D Pose Tracking, 10 pages, real-world experiments, training-free
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RRTrack，一种针对动态场景的鲁棒且可恢复的物体6D姿态跟踪器，能在快速运动和完全遮挡下保持跟踪。方法结合基于记忆的视频目标分割与6D位姿精化，并引入DINOv2双模板匹配模块恢复丢失目标。在合成基准上，相比FoundationPose，同等子集平均ADD-S AR提升66.3%，ADD-S AUC提升65.7%，达到55.2 FPS。真实实验验证了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有逐帧估计器计算昂贵，而基于连续可见性的跟踪器难以应对快速运动和完全遮挡，因此需要一种能够处理目标消失-重现的鲁棒跟踪方法。
Method: 提出2D-6D闭环跟踪策略，整合基于记忆的视频目标分割（VOS）与6D位姿精化；2D分支维护目标定位，6D分支在记忆更新前验证几何一致性；开发基于DINOv2的双模板匹配模块，联合利用离线合成模板和在线观测锚点恢复丢失目标，并保持实时性。
Result: 在合成基准上，相比FoundationPose，同等子集平均ADD-S AR提升66.3%，ADD-S AUC提升65.7%，速度达55.2 FPS。真实场景实验也验证了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法在动态场景中表现鲁棒，能够处理快速运动和完全遮挡，具有实时性和可恢复性，适用于机器人操作等应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No Free Lunch in Flow Surrogates under Time-Varying Boundary Conditions: A Two-Regime Study
papers.abstract_en: A flow surrogate validated on a simple regime is often taken as evidence that the approach will carry to a richer one. We test this assumption on two transient flows under time-varying boundary conditions emulating the process startup: the three-dimensional slurry film in chemical-mechanical planarisation (CMP), a core semiconductor-manufacturing process, and the two-dimensional Karman vortex street (KVS) behind a cylinder. Eight surrogate models are compared on one shared evaluation pipeline, differing in whether they learn the full field or a latent representation, and whether they predict trajectories in one shot or step by step. No single architecture wins both regimes. On the film, a one-shot full-field model reconstructs the process-relevant cumulative wall shear stress to 3.2% relative error. On the wake, a latent autoregressive DeepONet retains 96% of the shedding power that direct and one-shot models damp to almost zero. The deciding axis is the treatment of time. The self-sustained wake requires the phase memory that autoregressive feedback provides, while the boundary-driven film rewards a direct map. Pointwise RMSE picks the wrong model in both regimes, so the evaluation scores five physical questions instead, the field, its structure, invented motion, amplitude, and timing. The trained surrogates answer queries $10^3$ to $10^4$ times faster than the finite-element solver, but the offline cost of the training simulations means they pay off from the first query beyond the training set for CMP and the third for the KVS. The choice of surrogate should follow the dynamical character of the target flow, and its validation should use failure-mode-resolved metrics, since neither the winning architecture nor its validation transfers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时变边界条件下的瞬态流，比较了八种代理模型在三维化学机械平坦化浆液膜和二维卡门涡街两个不同动态特征流上的表现。结果显示没有单一架构同时胜出：一次性全字段模型在CMP上达到3.2%的相对误差，而潜在自回归DeepONet在KVS上保留了96%的脱落功率。点状RMSE在两个场景中都选错模型，因此采用五个物理问题作为评估指标。代理模型比有限元求解器快10^3-10^4倍，但训练仿真成本较高。
Motivation: 现有流代理通常在简单场景验证后默认能推广到复杂场景，本文质疑这一假设，研究不同动态特征流（边界驱动与自维持流动）下代理模型的选择与验证方法。
Method: 提出一个统一评估管道，在两种瞬态流（三维CMP浆液膜和二维卡门涡街）上比较八种代理模型，包括全字段/潜在表示、一次性/逐步预测方式，并采用五个物理问题（场、结构、虚构运动、振幅和时序）而非点状RMSE进行评价。
Result: 一次性全字段模型在CMP上预测累积壁剪切应力相对误差为3.2%；潜在自回归DeepONet在KVS上保持96%的脱落功率，而直接和一次性模型几乎将功率阻尼为零。代理模型比有限元求解器快10^3-10^4倍。
Conclusion: 代理模型的选择应取决于目标流的动态特性（边界驱动或自维持），验证应采用故障模式分解度量，因为胜出架构和验证方法不能跨场景迁移。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: XMatchAD: A Cross-Modal Matching Perspective on Reconstruction-based Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable success of reconstruction-based methods in Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (UAD) lies in their ability to identify and localize anomalies by modeling discrepancies between input images and their reconstructed counterparts. However, these approaches often struggle to capture subtle anomalies and tend to produce blurred anomaly boundaries, which significantly limits their effectiveness, particularly in complex multi-class scenarios. To address these issues, we present XMatchAD, a novel UAD framework that reinterprets the task from a pseudo cross-modal matching perspective. Specifically, the input and reconstructed images are treated as two complementary modalities and their matching relationships are precisely exploited for anomaly detection. First, a pre-trained feature extractor is employed to encode discriminative representations. Second, an attention-guided cross-modal matching mechanism is introduced to match local inter-modal anomaly-related patterns while mutually refining the features. This enhances the sensitivity to anomalies with diverse shapes and subtle deviations and significantly improves the precision of anomaly detection and localization. Third, we design an adaptive frequency-aware fusion module that further delineates sharp anomaly boundaries through the coupling of high-frequency components from cross-modal multi-scale representations. Comprehensive evaluations on MVTec-AD, VisA, and MPDD benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in multi-class anomaly detection and localization. The code will be released at https://github.com/Mingxiu-Cai/XMatchAD.
papers.comment: accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XMatchAD，一种基于跨模态匹配视角的重建异常检测框架，将输入图像与重建图像视为互补模态，通过注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制和自适应频率融合模块，提升多类异常检测和定位的精度。
Motivation: 现有重建方法难以捕捉细微异常且边界模糊，尤其在多类场景中效果有限。
Method: 采用预训练特征提取器编码判别表示；引入注意力引导的跨模态匹配机制，匹配局部跨模态异常相关模式并互相细化特征；设计自适应频率感知融合模块，通过跨模态多尺度高频成分耦合锐化异常边界。
Result: 在MVTec-AD、VisA和MPDD基准上，该方法在多类异常检测和定位中一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 跨模态匹配视角可有效提升重建异常检测的精度和边界清晰度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GRAPE: Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Articulated portrait mesh estimation is fundamental to 3D understanding, avatar generation, and immersive interaction. Existing approaches primarily rely on 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs). However, face-centric models suffer from the "floating head" assumption, conflating head pose with global rotation due to the lack of neck kinematics. Conversely, body-centric models lack high-fidelity facial expression capabilities. Furthermore, current methods struggle to disentangle jaw articulation from expression blendshapes, often over-relying on expressions for mouth opening. These limitations make monocular portrait recovery difficult across representation, supervision, and anatomical parameter estimation. To address these limitations, we introduce GRAPE(Graduated Routing for Articulated Portrait mesh Estimation). We build a Portrait Parametric Model (PPM) with an explicit torso-to-head kinematic chain and a canonical injection step to merge FLAME and the SMPL-X torso. We propose a Progressive Anatomical Alignment (PAA) network, which is composed of a pretrained portrait encoder, a Graduated-Mask Router, and coarse-to-fine experts that follow the portrait anatomical prior. We then train this network with multi-source supervision that combines sparse anatomical keypoints, feature distillation, foreground mask constraints, and relative geometry constraints. Experiments show that GRAPE improves portrait mesh recovery quality, pose alignment, and jaw--expression disentanglement over prior methods. We also demonstrate that our method can benefit the downstream tasks of audio-driven talking-head generation and 3D portrait generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRAPE，一种用于从单目图像估计带关节的人脸肖像网格的方法。通过构建包含显式躯干到头部的运动学链的肖像参数模型 (PPM)，以及渐进式解剖对齐 (PAA) 网络，结合多源监督训练，改进了肖像网格重建质量、姿态对齐和下颚-表情解耦。
Motivation: 现有方法中，脸部模型缺乏颈部动力学导致头部姿态与全局旋转混淆，身体模型缺乏高保真面部表情能力，且难以解耦下颌关节与表情混合形状，从而限制了单目肖像恢复。
Method: 构建肖像参数模型 (PPM)，合并 FLAME 和 SMPL-X 躯干，引入标准注入步骤；提出渐进式解剖对齐 (PAA) 网络，包含预训练肖像编码器、渐进掩码路由器和从粗到细的专家；使用多源监督（稀疏解剖关键点、特征蒸馏、前景掩码约束、相对几何约束）训练。
Result: 实验表明 GRAPE 在肖像网格重建质量、姿态对齐和下颚-表情解耦方面优于以往方法。
Conclusion: GRAPE 可有益于音频驱动的说话头生成和3D肖像生成等下游任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: DP-IVON-Gradsq: Differentially Private Squared-Gradient Improved Variational Online Newton
papers.abstract_en: Differential privacy provides formal privacy guarantees for training neural networks on sensitive data, while Bayesian deep learning offers a principled framework for uncertainty-aware prediction. Combining these two objectives remains challenging, as privacy noise can interact with the stochasticity introduced by Bayesian posterior sampling. In this work, we investigate differentially private variational Bayesian learning through the Improved Variational Online Newton (IVON) optimizer. We introduce DP-IVON-Gradsq, a private variant of IVON. The proposed method constructs its curvature estimate from the privatized gradient using a noise-corrected squared-gradient estimator, reducing the direct interaction between posterior-sampling noise and privacy noise while preserving the Adam-like computational efficiency of IVON. We evaluate DP-IVON-Gradsq on CIFAR-10 against the standard private optimizers DP-SGD and DP-Adam over a range of privacy budgets. The results show that DP-IVON-Gradsq is competitive under weak-to-moderate privacy constraints, i.e., large-to-moderate values of $\varepsilon$, while degrading under strong privacy. Code is available at https://github.com/NourJamoussi/DP-IVON-Gradsq.git.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Machine Unlearning and Privacy Preservation (WIPE-OUT 2), held in conjunction with ECML PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DP-IVON-Gradsq，一种差分隐私的改进变分在线牛顿（IVON）优化器私有变体，用于训练贝叶斯神经网络。该方法通过噪声校正的平方梯度估计器构建曲率估计，减少后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的交互，同时保持 IVON 的 Adam 类计算效率。在 CIFAR-10 上，该方法在弱到中等隐私预算（大至中等的 ε）下与 DP-SGD 和 DP-Adam 竞争，但在强隐私下性能下降。
Motivation: 差分隐私与贝叶斯深度学习结合时，隐私噪声会与贝叶斯后验采样的随机性相互作用，导致挑战。现有方法在平衡隐私和不确定性量化方面存在不足。
Method: 提出 DP-IVON-Gradsq，在 IVON 优化器基础上，利用噪声校正的平方梯度估计器（从私有化梯度中构造曲率估计），从而减少后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的直接交互，保持 Adam 类计算效率。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，DP-IVON-Gradsq 在弱到中等隐私约束（大至中等的 ε）下与 DP-SGD 和 DP-Adam 竞争力相当，但在强隐私（小 ε）下性能下降。

papers.title: CALMRec: Causally Aligned Language Memory for Long-Horizon Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can summarize heterogeneous user evidence in natural language, but current LLM recommenders often collapse enduring preferences, transient intent, and exposure-induced behavior into one profile. This makes recommendation vulnerable to feedback loops: repeated exposure is mistaken for preference, immediate clicks dominate delayed satisfaction, and fluent explanations need not reflect the ranking decision. We propose our method, a model-agnostic framework for long-horizon recommendation. Our method uses a frozen multimodal language model to convert item content and feedback into evidence-grounded semantic atoms, then maintains separate short-term, long-term, and exposure memories. Propensity-weighted updates reduce policy-induced exposure bias, while a conservative offline critic reranks candidates for delayed satisfaction under a behavior-support constraint. Explanations use only influential evidence atoms and are checked by counterfactual deletion. We provide an identification result and evaluate the framework in e-commerce-like, news-like, and short-video-like environments. Across ten seeds, our method improves discounted long-term value over the strongest alternative by 6.1%, 7.6%, and 6.7%, respectively. Twenty-seed paired ablations show significant value drops after removing propensity correction (0.739 +/- 0.191) or conservative support regularization (0.523 +/- 0.234). A frozen instruction language model also more than doubles semantic-atom NDCG over TF-IDF on a held-out paraphrase benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CALMRec，一种针对长期推荐（long-horizon recommendation）的模型无关框架。它利用冻结的多模态大语言模型将用户证据分解为语义原子，并分别维护短期、长期和暴露记忆以解耦不同类型的影响。通过倾向性加权更新减少暴露偏差，并采用保守离线评判器优化延迟满意度。在电商、新闻和短视频模拟环境中，CALMRec在折扣长期价值上分别提升6.1%、7.6%、6.7%，消融实验证实了各组件的有效性。
Motivation: 现有LLM推荐器将用户持久偏好、瞬时意图和暴露诱导的行为混合成一个profile，导致反馈循环和暴露偏差，且推荐解释与真实决策脱节。需要一种能够分离这些因素并支持长期价值的推荐框架。
Method: 提出CALMRec，包含三个模块：1) 使用冻结的多模态语言模型将内容与反馈转化为证据基础的语义原子；2) 维护短期、长期和暴露三种记忆，并通过倾向性加权更新减少暴露偏差；3) 采用保守离线评判器（conservative offline critic）在行为支持约束下对候选重新排序，以优化延迟满意度。解释生成仅使用影响性证据原子并通过反事实删除检查。
Result: 在三个模拟环境（电商、新闻、短视频）中，CALMRec相对于最强基线分别提升折扣长期价值6.1%、7.6%、6.7%。消融实验显示移除倾向性校正后价值下降0.739±0.191，移除保守支持正则化后价值下降0.523±0.234。冻结指令语言模型在释义基准上NDCG超过TF-IDF一倍以上。
Conclusion: CALMRec通过解耦记忆和因果对齐的方法有效提升了长期推荐价值，减少了暴露偏差，并提供了可解释的推荐。

papers.title: When Rates Are Geometric: Rate-Certificate Transfer for Contact Splittings in Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Discrete optimization algorithms are often analyzed through continuous-time limiting ODEs, but a convergence certificate for the ODE is not automatically one for the discrete algorithm. We develop contact Hamiltonian systems as a setting where the transfer can be made precise. A contact Hamiltonian $H$ on $J^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$ obeys the intrinsic decay identity $\dot H = -H\,\partial_s H$, so an augmented energy $\mathcal{E}$ built from $H$, together with the conformal rate $\partial_s H$, is a continuous-time rate certificate whenever $\mathcal{E}$ controls the objective gap. Our main theorem states, under three named and independently checkable hypotheses, that an order-$r$ contact splitting with step $h$ transfers this certificate over the finite horizon set by backward error analysis. The discrete decay envelope is governed by the modified conformal factor up to $O(h^r)$ perturbations plus a backward-error shadowing defect, and the mechanism is inherited exactly because the modified Hamiltonian is itself a contact Hamiltonian. Quadratic heavy ball is a fully solvable example: its projected dissipative-leapfrog spectrum agrees with established conformal-symplectic optimization theory, while the augmented contact Hamiltonian yields a sharp objective-to-certificate comparison that verifies the transfer hypotheses. For strongly convex objectives with state-dependent damping, an explicit Bregman-type Lyapunov certificate instead transfers by an auxiliary-shadowing corollary. The decomposition $H=K+V+D$ into kinetic, objective-encoding potential, and dissipation terms serves as a design template, with a catalogue of closed-form sub-flows including contact-specific damping families. Numerical experiments confirm the predicted conformal-factor tracking orders and show competitive performance on ill-conditioned benchmarks and deep-learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立接触哈密顿系统框架，用于将连续时间ODE的收敛证书精确传递给离散优化算法。主要定理在三个可检验假设下，证明接触分裂的离散衰减包络由修正共形因子控制，直至高阶误差和影子缺陷。以二次重球法为完全可解实例验证传递假设，并展示如何为强凸目标及状态相关阻尼构造显式李雅普诺夫证书。数值实验验证了共形因子跟踪阶数，并在病态基准和深度学习任务上表现有竞争力。
Motivation: 离散优化算法的收敛分析常依赖连续极限ODE，但ODE的收敛证书并不能自动推广到离散算法。本文旨在建立一种精确传递机制，使得从连续模型导出的收敛速率估计能够可靠地适用于离散实现。
Method: 提出了接触哈密顿系统作为统一框架。通过构造由接触哈密顿量H和共形因子∂_s H组成的增广能量E，建立连续时间速率证书。主要定理在三个可检验假设下，证明阶为r的接触分裂能够将证书传递给离散算法，离散衰减受修正共形因子控制，误差通过后向误差分析界定。
Result: 二次重球法的投影耗散-蛙跳谱与已有共形辛优化理论一致，增广接触哈密顿量给出严格的目标-证书比较。对于强凸目标与状态相关阻尼，通过辅助影子推论实现了Bregman型李雅普诺夫证书的传递。数值实验验证了共形因子跟踪阶数，并在病态基准和深度学习任务上表现有竞争力。
Conclusion: 接触哈密顿系统为优化算法的速率证书传递提供了精确数学框架。该方法通过分解哈密顿量为动能、势能和耗散项，设计了接触分裂子流族，并可通过后向误差分析保证离散收敛阶。

papers.title: Distributed Convolutional Rank Regression over Decentralized Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies convolution rank regression (CRR) over decentralized distributed learning networks. We propose a novel decentralized CRR framework, in which estimators are obtained by solving consensus-constrained optimization with kernel-smoothed rank loss. The developed estimation scheme relies solely on local node data and information shared by neighboring nodes, thereby achieving privacy preservation and high communication efficiency. For heterogeneous network settings, we establish finite-sample error bounds for the decentralized CRR estimator and derive exact support recovery guarantees for the sparse decentralized CRR LASSO estimator. To facilitate numerical implementation, we adopt a generalized consensus ADMM to efficiently solve local subproblems across all network nodes. We verify the favorable performance of our developed approach via extensive numerical simulations and real-data experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了去中心化分布式学习网络中的卷积秩回归（CRR）框架，通过核平滑秩损失和共识约束优化实现隐私保护与通信高效的估计，并给出了稀疏去中心化CRR LASSO估计量的有限样本误差界和支持恢复保证。
Motivation: 现有分布式学习中的秩回归方法多依赖中心节点或全局数据共享，无法很好地在去中心化网络中保护节点隐私并实现高效通信。
Method: 采用共识约束优化结合核平滑秩损失的估计方案，节点仅利用本地数据和邻居节点共享信息，使用广义共识ADMM求解局部子问题。
Result: 在异质网络下建立了去中心化CRR估计量的有限样本误差界，并给出了稀疏去中心化CRR LASSO估计量的精确支持恢复保证，仿真和真实数据实验验证了方法的优越性能。
Conclusion: 去中心化CRR框架能在不依赖中心节点的情况下有效进行分布式秩回归，适用于隐私敏感和通信受限的网络场景。

papers.title: WGDnet: Wishart-guided Geometric-aware Deep Network for PolSAR Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar (PolSAR) classification underpins all-weather Earth observation. Conventional Wishart methods depend on rigid handcrafted operators with limited adaptability, while mainstream deep networks ignore PolSAR native Wishart scattering statistics. Additionally, fixed convolution windows fail to capture multi-scale, multi-directional terrain patterns, harming boundary detection and small-object characterization. To mitigate these drawbacks, we propose WGDNet, a Wishart-guided geometric-aware deep network. It integrates three core designs: (1) learnable Wishart convolutions with directional kernels for multi-scale statistical edge feature extraction; (2) an orientation-prior aggregation module that estimates dominant local directions and confidences to refine directional Wishart outputs adaptively; (3) GAnet, a scale-direction adaptive geometric-aware convolution that dynamically reshapes sampling grids to model anisotropic terrain and retain fine details. Our contributions lie in learnable Wishart statistical modeling, orientation-prior feature aggregation, and geometry-adaptive convolution. Evaluations across four real PolSAR datasets verify WGDNet surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches in classification accuracy and boundary fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对PolSAR图像分类中传统Wishart方法依赖手工算子且适应性差、主流深度网络忽略PolSAR本征Wishart散射统计、固定卷积窗口难以捕获多尺度和多方向地形模式等问题，本文提出WGDNet，融合可学习Wishart卷积、方向先验聚合模块和几何感知自适应卷积。在四个真实PolSAR数据集上，该方法在分类精度和边界保真度上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在PolSAR图像分类中要么依赖刚性手工算子（Wishart方法），要么忽略PolSAR的Wishart散射统计（深度网络），且固定卷积窗口难以适应多尺度和多方向地形模式，导致边界检测和小目标表征不佳。
Method: 提出WGDNet，包含三个核心组件：(1) 可学习Wishart卷积，使用方向核提取多尺度统计边缘特征；(2) 方向先验聚合模块，估计局部主导方向和置信度以自适应细化方向性Wishart输出；(3) GAnet，尺度-方向自适应几何感知卷积，动态重塑采样网格以建模各向异性地形并保留细节。
Result: 在四个真实PolSAR数据集上的评估表明，WGDNet在分类精度和边界保真度上超越了现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文通过可学习的Wishart统计建模、方向先验聚合和几何自适应卷积，有效提升了PolSAR图像分类的性能。

papers.title: Extending Desbordante with Probabilistic Functional Dependency Discovery Support
papers.abstract_en: Data profiling aims to extract complex patterns from data for further analysis and use that data in domains such as data cleaning, data deduplication, anomaly detection, and many more. Functional dependencies (FDs) are one of the most well-known patterns. However, they are poorly suited for these tasks, as real data is usually dirty, and the rigid definition of FDs does not allow algorithms to locate them. For this reason, there are several formulations aimed at relaxing FDs to support dirty data, with approximate functional dependency (AFD) being the most popular one. Another formulation is the Probabilistic Functional Dependency (pFD), which we aim to support inside Desbordante - a science-intensive, high-performance and open-source data profiling tool implemented in C++. However, pFDs are relatively poorly studied, compared to AFDs. In this paper we study pFDs, both analytically and empirically. We start by assessing how different pFDs and AFDs are by studying cases in which pFDs have an edge over AFDs. Then, we implement the algorithm for pFD discovery, as well as study its run time and memory consumption. We also compare it with an AFD discovery algorithm. Lastly, we study the output of both algorithms to learn whether or not it is possible to use AFD discovery algorithm to get pFDs and vice versa.

papers.title: Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA):TailoredAttentionMattersfor Science
papers.abstract_en: Attention enables context modeling via query-key scoring with softmax normalization. Driven by industrial long-context demands, mainstream research has converged toward sparsity and efficiency--yet softmax's independence assumption persists. For scientific tasks unburdened by long-token constraints, however, richer structured coupling may often be essential, making tailored attention both viable and more appropriate. To this end, we propose Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA), which augments softmax normalization with an interacting Ising model; attention patterns emerge from learnable pairwise couplings via variational mean-field inference, redefining attention from a ranking over isolated items to a collective state over interacting entities. We instantiate VIA on retrosynthesis reaction center prediction, a task inherently governed by cooperative bond-breaking constraints. Comprehensive experiments across model variants, coupled with mechanistic analyses, demonstrate that VIA consistently and substantially outperforms standard softmax attention. More broadly, our findings suggest that for scientific problems, the optimal solution is not general-purpose efficiency, but appropriately tailored attention aligned with intrinsic domain structure. This work provides a theoretically grounded and empirically validated instantiation of this paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分伊辛注意力（VIA），通过引入可学习成对耦合的伊辛模型来增强标准softmax注意力，使用变分平均场推断使注意力模式从孤立项排序变为相互作用实体的集体状态。在逆合成反应中心预测这一受合作键断裂约束的任务上，VIA一致且显著优于标准softmax注意力，表明科学问题需要量身定制的注意力而非通用高效方案。
Motivation: 主流注意力研究聚焦于长上下文的稀疏性与效率，但softmax的独立性假设对于需要结构化耦合的科学任务可能不适当，因此需要更能体现内在领域结构的注意力机制。
Method: 提出Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA)，在softmax归一化中结合交互的伊辛模型，通过变分平均场推断从可学习的成对耦合中涌现注意力模式，重新定义注意力为相互作用实体的集体状态。
Result: 在逆合成反应中心预测任务上的综合实验表明，VIA在各种模型变体下一致且显著优于标准softmax注意力，辅以机制分析验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 对于科学问题，最优方案并非通用高效，而是与领域内在结构对齐的定制化注意力；本文提供了理论扎实且经验验证的实例。

papers.title: A Controlled Visual-Backbone Benchmark for Multimodal Short-Term Solar Irradiance Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Sky-image irradiance studies often compare forecasting systems in which the image encoder, temporal model, fusion block, target definition, and training recipe all change together. We use a narrower protocol: the multimodal forecasting pipeline is fixed, and only the visual backbone is varied. The shared setup keeps preprocessing, clear-sky-index normalization, weather-history encoding, fusion, regression head, loss, optimizer schedule, seed, and chronological split policy unchanged. We compare ConvNeXt, Swin Transformer, VMamba, Spatial Mamba, and MambaVision backbones for 10min-ahead forecasting on Folsom and a strict matched NREL split. Forecast skill is measured against clear-sky-index smart persistence, and temporal-only rows are reported as weather-history diagnostics rather than as the main ranking criterion. On the Folsom strict split, all evaluated visual-backbone runs improve over smart persistence. In the evaluated single-seed strict runs, VMamba Small and Swin Base reach matched Folsom RMSE values of 65.39 W/m^2 and 65.50 W/m^2; the temporal-only diagnostic reaches 69.51 W/m^2. On the 313-sample NREL strict split, smart persistence remains strongest at 17.48 W/m^2, while the lowest visual RMSE is obtained by Swin Tiny at 23.76 W/m^2. These results provide a reproducible encoder comparison under one fixed multimodal operating point rather than establishing architecture-level dominance, statistically resolved ranking, or fully optimized forecasting performance. Code available here: https://github.com/Oshadha345/irradiance_benchmark

TL;DR: 本文通过固定多模态预测流水线中的视觉骨干网络变量，系统比较了ConvNeXt、Swin Transformer、VMamba、Spatial Mamba和MambaVision在短时太阳辐照度预测中的表现。在Folsom数据集上，所有视觉骨干模型均优于智能持久性基线；在NREL数据集上，智能持久性仍最强。研究提供了可复现的编码器对比基准，而非架构级最优性结论。
Motivation: 现有天空图像辐照度研究常同时改变图像编码器、时序模型、融合块等多个组件，导致难以单独评估视觉骨干网络的影响。本文旨在通过固定其他所有组件，提供一种受控的视觉骨干网络对比协议。
Method: 固定多模态预测流水线（包括预处理、晴空指数归一化、天气历史编码、融合、回归头、损失、优化器、随机种子和时间划分策略），仅替换视觉骨干网络（ConvNeXt、Swin Transformer、VMamba、Spatial Mamba、MambaVision），在Folsom和NREL数据集上进行10分钟前瞻预测。
Result: 在Folsom严格划分下，所有视觉骨干模型均优于晴空指数智能持久性；VMamba Small和Swin Base的RMSE分别为65.39 W/m²和65.50 W/m²。在NREL严格划分下，智能持久性仍最佳（17.48 W/m²），视觉模型最佳为Swin Tiny（23.76 W/m²）。
Conclusion: 该基准测试提供了在固定多模态操作点下不同视觉骨干网络的可重复比较，但并未建立架构级别的主导性、统计显著排名或完全优化的预测性能。

papers.title: Order in Desbordante: Techniques for Efficient Implementation of Order Dependency Discovery Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Science-intensive data profiling focuses on discovery and validation of various patterns in datasets. This study considers discovery of one such pattern - order dependency (OD). Simply put, OD states that some list of columns is ordered according to another one. It is of use for database query optimization, data cleaning and deduplication, anomaly detection, and much more. Existing discovery methods have approached this problem solely from the algorithmic standpoint, without focusing on the implementation side. At the same time, this problem is very computationally intensive, and therefore this part should not be ignored, as it brings ODs closer to industrial use. In this paper, we study two algorithms for OD discovery which target different OD axiomatizations - FASTOD and ORDER. We start by reimplementing these algorithms in C++ in order to speed them up and lower their memory consumption. We then analyze their bottlenecks and propose several techniques which improve their performance even further. To perform evaluation, we have implemented these algorithms inside Desbordante - a science-intensive, high-performance, and open-source data profiling tool developed in C++. Experiments have demonstrated a performance improvement of up to 3x obtained by reimplemented versions, and, with the application of our techniques, up to 10x. Memory consumption has been lowered by up to 2.9x.

Method: 在C++中重新实现FASTOD和ORDER算法，分析瓶颈，提出多种性能改进技术，并在开源数据剖析工具Desbordante中集成。
Result: 重新实现的版本性能提升最高3倍，应用提出的技术后最高10倍，内存消耗降低最高2.9倍。

papers.title: PathSelect: Sequential Token Selection for Whole Slide Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) present a fundamental computational bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs) due to extreme sequence lengths. Existing approaches predominantly rely on spatial sampling or training-free pruning, which risk diluting weak but informative signals, leading to the loss of critical diagnostic evidence due to the spatially diffuse nature of pathological cues. We reformulate WSI token pruning as a sequential selection process, enabling the model to autonomously learn an optimal routing strategy rather than relying on static heuristics. We herein propose a decoupled routing framework integrated as an active plugin into the fully pre-trained SlideChat base model, leaving both the slide encoder and large language model frozen. To provide continuous gradients for the non-differentiable pruning operation during training, we introduce PathSelect. PathSelect employs a variance-preserving noise gate to modulate each patch's information flow via a differentiable Soft Top-K operator, paired with a diagonal-attention Denoiser that recovers the perturbed representations without semantic leakage. At inference, the PathSelect module is entirely detached. Relying solely on the trained Scorer, a deterministic Hard Top-K operator executes adaptive, data-dependent trajectory termination, significantly accelerating downstream generative processing with exceptionally low sequential token selection latency. Driven by an empirical average of only 44.86 tokens under a maximum constraint of K = 128, our framework achieves 74.00% overall accuracy on SlideBench (TCGA), representing an approximate 36.6x spatial token reduction relative to the uncompressed baseline average while consistently outperforming sampling-based counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全切片病理图像（WSI）中因极长序列导致视觉-语言模型（VLM）计算瓶颈的问题，提出一种可学习的顺序令牌选择框架PathSelect。该方法将WSI令牌剪枝重新定义为序列选择过程，通过解耦路由框架整合到预训练的SlideChat基座模型中，冻结切片编码器和大型语言模型。PathSelect采用方差保持的噪声门控和可微Soft Top-K算子，结合对角注意力去噪器，在训练时提供连续梯度，推理时仅使用训练好的评分器进行确定性Hard Top-K选择。实验表明，在最大约束K=128下，平均仅需44.86个令牌，在SlideBench（TCGA）上达到74.00%的整体准确率，相对于未压缩基线实现约36.6倍空间令牌缩减，并持续优于基于采样的方法。
Motivation: 现有WSI方法依赖空间采样或无训练剪枝，可能稀释弱但信息丰富的信号，导致关键诊断证据丢失，因为病理线索在空间上分布分散。
Method: 提出PathSelect，一种顺序令牌选择框架，包含：1) 方差保持噪声门控（variance-preserving noise gate）通过可微Soft Top-K算子调节每个补丁的信息流；2) 对角注意力去噪器（diagonal-attention Denoiser）恢复扰动表示而不引起语义泄漏；3) 推理时仅使用训练好的评分器执行确定性Hard Top-K操作，实现自适应、数据依赖的轨迹终止。
Result: 在最大约束K=128下，平均仅选择44.86个令牌，在SlideBench（TCGA）上达到74.00%整体准确率，相对于未压缩基线实现约36.6倍空间令牌缩减，并持续优于基于采样的方法。
Conclusion: 本文强调将WSI令牌剪枝作为可学习的顺序选择过程，能够使模型自主学习最优路由策略，而非依赖静态启发式，实验证明该方法在显著缩减令牌的同时保持或提升性能。

papers.title: Maximum updraft velocity beyond CAPE: the role of boundary layer dynamics and pressure perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Deep convective updraft velocities play a key role in the Earth's climate system, influencing precipitation extremes, lightning, and the planetary energy budget. While Convective Available Potential Energy (CAPE) is widely used to explain maximum updraft velocity ($w_{\max}$), CAPE is an imperfect predictor as updrafts are also influenced by entrainment, boundary layer dynamics, pressure perturbations, and condensate loading. However, the relative importance of these processes and how they interact to set $w_{\max}$ in individual clouds remains unclear. Here, we use equation learning to identify compact, physically interpretable relationships linking environmental and in-cloud conditions to $w_{\max}$ in individual tracked clouds across idealized radiative-convective equilibrium regimes spanning a range of sea surface temperatures and radiative cooling rates. For pre-storm prediction, CAPE and local mean boundary layer vertical velocity ($\overline{w_{\mathrm{bl}}}$) together explain nearly half the variance in $w_{\max}$ across regimes ($R^2=0.47$). While CAPE captures regime-mean differences, it has little predictive value within a single simulation. $\overline{w_{\mathrm{bl}}}$ is essential for capturing cloud-to-cloud variability, including the suppression of $w_{\max}$ even at high CAPE values. At the time of peak intensity, a simple approximate Bernoulli-like invariant combining maximum pressure perturbation and maximum cloud condensate explains 89\% of the variance ($R^2=0.89$). The tight link between $w_{\max}$ and pressure perturbation supports the sticky thermals hypothesis and highlights the importance of dynamic pressure effects, often neglected in updraft theories. These results highlight $\overline{w_{\mathrm{bl}}}$ as an important regulator of convective intensity alongside CAPE, and demonstrate that dynamic pressure plays an important role within individual updrafts.

TL;DR: 本文通过方程学习识别影响深对流上升气流最大速度（w_max）的关键因素。在理想化辐射-对流平衡模拟中，CAPE与边界层平均垂直速度共同解释约47%的方差，而一个包含最大气压扰动和最大云凝结物的近似伯努利不变量可解释89%的方差。结果表明边界层动力学和动态气压效应是调节对流强度的重要机制。

Result: CAPE与边界层平均垂直速度共同解释w_max方差的47%；最大气压扰动和最大云凝结物的组合不变量解释89%方差，支持粘性热块假说。

papers.title: Segmentation Robustness and Predictive Utility in Glioblastoma Radiomics: Evidence for a Trade-off in Survival Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Radiomic biomarkers derived from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) have been widely investigated as non-invasive tools for tumor characterization and prognostic modeling in glioblastoma (GBM). However, their clinical translation remains limited, in part due to sensitivity to tumor segmentation variability. In this study, we systematically investigate the relationship between feature robustness and predictive utility in GBM survival modeling using the University of Pennsylvania Glioblastoma Imaging, Genomics, and Radiomics (UPENN-GBM) cohort. A total of 4,752 radiomic features were obtained from multiparametric MRI across three tumor subregions: enhancing tumor (ET), peritumoral edema (ED), and necrotic core (NC). Feature robustness was quantified using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) based on the automatic and expert-refined segmentation versions. Among features with valid ICC estimates, 48.1% were classified as robust. Survival prediction was evaluated using cross-validation with Coxnet, Random Survival Forest, and Gradient Boosting Survival Analysis models. In this cohort, radiomic feature inclusion showed no consistent improvement over the clinical baseline, and robustness filtering produced no detectable performance gain. Model-selected features were less robust than the overall feature pool, indicating a lack of enrichment for robustness. These findings suggest that robustness alone is not a reliable criterion for feature selection in radiomics-based survival modelling.
papers.comment: Accepted as a full paper at HCist 2026 and for publication in Procedia Computer Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用UPENN-GBM队列系统地研究了胶质母细胞瘤影像组学中特征鲁棒性与生存预测效用之间的关系。从多参数MRI的三个肿瘤亚区提取了4752个特征，基于自动与专家修正分割版本计算ICC，发现48.1%的特征是鲁棒的。在Coxnet、随机生存森林和梯度提升生存模型上评估，加入影像组学特征未带来一致改进，鲁棒性过滤也未提升性能，且模型选择的特征鲁棒性甚至低于整体特征池。结果表明，鲁棒性本身并非可靠的生存建模特征选择标准。
Motivation: 影像组学生物标志物在胶质母细胞瘤预后建模中具有潜力，但临床转化受限于对肿瘤分割变异性的敏感性。
Method: 使用UPENN-GBM队列，提取4752个多参数MRI影像组学特征（包括增强肿瘤、瘤周水肿和坏死核心三个亚区），以ICC量化特征鲁棒性（基于自动与专家修正分割版本），并采用Coxnet、随机生存森林和梯度提升生存模型评估生存预测性能。
Result: 48.1%的特征被归类为鲁棒；加入影像组学特征未优于临床基线模型；鲁棒性过滤未带来性能提升；模型选择的特征鲁棒性低于整体特征池。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性单独不能作为影像组学生存建模中特征选择的可靠依据。

papers.title: Where Is the Cost of Third-Party API Routers in Agentic Software Development?
papers.abstract_en: Third-party API routers have become a common layer that unifies access across increasingly diverse LLM providers. In coding-agent workflows, high-autonomy operation is widely adopted because it reduces interaction overhead. As a result, a third-party API router, which sits between the agent and the upstream provider, inevitably occupies the trusted path. It can inspect and modify every request and response, yet no mechanism verifies alignment between the provider's output and the repository-level actions ultimately executed by the agent. Consequently, client-side permission mechanisms may become ineffective in practice. Whether this control gap produces real, hard-to-detect effects on software development tasks remains empirically unmeasured. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study of router-side injection in coding agents, examining four intervention levels of increasing subtlety: Response Substitution (L1), Response Append (L2), LLM-Polished Injection (L3), and LLM-Polished with Distribution Alignment Injection (L4). Moreover, we develop SIDEL, a framework for trace recording, replay, injection, and defense evaluation, with a curated dataset of 400 samples. We evaluate four representative coding agents, and further evaluate whitelist-based execution control and LLM review. Router-side intervention substantially alters repository-level actions and remains difficult for existing client-side safeguards to detect. Without additional mitigations, all evaluated agents achieved a defense success rate of 0 percent across all injection levels. Client-side mitigations and reactive reviews improve resistance but do not fully restore end-to-end control, motivating provider-side output-integrity guarantees. Our code is available at https://github.com/Riyasushin/SIDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证研究第三方API路由器在编码代理工作流中的安全风险，发现路由器可以篡改请求/响应而客户端无法检测，提出四个干预级别（L1-L4）和SIDEL框架，评估四个编码代理，结果显示现有防护机制成功率0%。
Motivation: 第三方API路由器位于代理和提供商之间，可检查修改所有请求响应，但无机制验证输出与代理执行动作的一致性，导致客户端权限机制可能失效，缺乏实证测量。
Method: 设计四种逐渐隐蔽的路由器侧注入干预级别（响应替换、响应追加、LLM润色注入、LLM润色+分布对齐注入），开发SIDEL框架进行轨迹记录、重放、注入和防御评估，使用400样本的数据集，评估四个编码代理和两种防御（白名单执行控制、LLM审查）。
Result: 路由器侧干预显著改变仓库级动作，现有客户端防护难以检测，所有评估的代理在无额外缓解措施时防御成功率为0%，客户端缓解和反应式审查提高了抵抗力但未完全恢复端到端控制。
Conclusion: 强调需要提供商侧输出完整性保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal Reward Shaping: Autonomous Car Parking Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective reward functions for model-free reinforcement learning under non-holonomic constraints remains a persistent challenge, often resulting in severe local minima such as policy paralysis or over-conservative hazard avoidance. In this work, we present a parameterized reward shaping framework featuring coverage-gated alignment feedback, drive-direction switch regularization, and an aligned episode termination mechanism evaluated on an autonomous parallel parking task. Crucially, we show that environmental reward parameters and algorithmic hyperparameters are deeply co-dependent, requiring joint meta-optimization to achieve stable convergence. By employing surrogate-based Bayesian optimization, our co-optimized Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent resolves characteristic control failure modes, significantly outperforming uncalibrated baselines across both success rate and trajectory smoothness.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Includes supplementary video demonstration and open-source code link
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非完整约束下无模型强化学习的奖励函数设计难题，提出一种参数化奖励塑形框架，包含覆盖门控对齐反馈、驱动方向切换正则化和对齐剧集终止机制，并在自主平行泊车任务上验证。通过代理辅助贝叶斯优化对奖励参数和算法超参数进行联合元优化，训练的DQN智能体在成功率和轨迹平滑度上显著优于未校准基线。
Motivation: 非完整约束下的无模型强化学习奖励函数设计常导致策略瘫痪或过度保守的避障等局部最优，需要有效的奖励塑形方法。
Method: 提出参数化奖励塑形框架，包括覆盖门控对齐反馈、驱动方向切换正则化和对齐剧集终止机制，并使用代理辅助贝叶斯优化对环境和算法超参数进行联合元优化。
Result: 在自主平行泊车任务上，联合优化的DQN智能体成功解决了典型控制失败模式，在成功率和轨迹平滑度上显著优于未校准基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调环境奖励参数与算法超参数深度相互依赖，联合元优化是实现稳定收敛的关键。

papers.title: Restoration Flow Matching-Based Channel Refinement and Equalization Correction for MIMO Semantic Communications
papers.abstract_en: In multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) semantic communication, imperfect channel state information (CSI) and equalization mismatch can seriously degrade semantic reconstruction quality. To address this issue, we propose a unified restoration flow matching (RFM)-based framework for channel refinement and equalization correction. Specifically, the channel RFM (CRFM) module is developed to refine the coarse channel, thereby improving channel estimation accuracy. Based on the refined channel, the developed semantic RFM (SRFM) module is employed to correct the residual distortions in the post-equalization latent space. The key idea is to formulate the two cascaded inverse problems of channel estimation and equalization as the unified conditional restoration task, in which the learned conditional velocity field guides the perturbed distribution towards the target distribution. To enhance the robustness of these two modules under various distortion conditions, we develop a dual-anchor perturbation training strategy that jointly learns near-manifold refinement and large-error correction, and implement inference through a few-step deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver. Extensive experiments on MIMO channels and visual semantic transmission tasks demonstrate that the proposed scheme improves key metrics for channel estimation and semantic reconstruction quality. Moreover, compared with representative diffusion-based generative baselines, the proposed method requires fewer sampling steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多输入多输出 (MIMO) 语义通信中信道状态信息不完善和均衡失配导致语义重建质量下降的问题，提出基于修复流匹配 (RFM) 的统一信道细化与均衡校正框架。该框架包含信道 RFM (CRFM) 模块和语义 RFM (SRFM) 模块，分别用于细化粗糙信道和校正均衡后潜空间中的残余失真。通过将信道估计和均衡两个级联逆问题统一为条件修复任务，并采用双锚扰动训练策略增强鲁棒性，实现了少步确定性常微分方程求解器推理。实验表明，该方法在信道估计和视觉语义传输任务上提升了关键指标，且相比扩散基线需要更少采样步数。
Motivation: 现有 MIMO 语义通信中，不完美的 CSI 和均衡失配严重降低语义重建质量，而现有方法未有效联合处理这两个级联问题。
Method: 提出统一的条件修复流匹配框架，包含 CRFM 模块（细化信道）和 SRFM 模块（校正均衡后失真）；采用双锚扰动训练策略联合学习近流形细化与大误差校正；通过少步确定性 ODE 求解器进行推理。
Result: 在 MIMO 信道和视觉语义传输任务上，该方法提升了信道估计与语义重建的关键指标，且相比扩散基线需要更少的采样步骤。
Conclusion: 所提 RFM 框架能有效解决 MIMO 语义通信中的信道估计和均衡问题，在少步推理下取得优异性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DualityCert: Verifier-Gated Language-Model Repair of Broken Duality Claims in Quantum Field Theory
papers.abstract_en: We present DualityCert, a symbolic verifier for candidate Seiberg-duality claims in four-dimensional N=1 quiver gauge theories. The verifier evaluates 't Hooft anomaly matching, superpotential R-charge consistency, central-charge matching, and a bounded chiral-ring proxy. A claim that passes receives a consistency certificate, which states that no tested inconsistency was found, not that the duality is proven. We use the verifier as a repair environment for language-model agents, which receive a deliberately broken claim and must edit it until it certifies. On a preregistered benchmark of 145 broken claims, with the analysis fixed before the first confirmatory model call, verifier-gated retry improves final repair success over a single attempt by +8.3 percentage points (pp) on deepseek-chat and +7.1 pp on qwen-plus (Holm-adjusted p<0.002). Under an equal budget of eleven attempts, the stop-first strategy portfolio underperforms independent verifier-filtered resampling by 10.3 percentage points on deepseek-chat but outperforms it by 14.7 points on qwen-plus, reversing the ordering of the two tested verifier-exploitation policies across the two confirmatory models. On qwen-plus, category-level verifier feedback is worth +8.7 pp over content-free retry, and interpretable obligation identities alone are worth +6.4 pp over structurally identical masked feedback. Neither effect is detected on deepseek-chat. Separately, a preregistered MiniMax-M2.5 extension again finds an iteration gain and independent verifier-filtered resampling outperforming the strategy portfolio. Which policy is better thus differs between the two models, while every winning policy uses the same cheap certificate. The verifier, benchmark, protocol, and all per-attempt records are released.

TL;DR: 本文提出 DualityCert，一个用于四维 N=1 quiver 规范理论中 Seiberg 对偶候选声明的符号验证器，评估't Hooft 反常匹配、超势 R-荷一致性、中心荷匹配和有界手性环代理。验证器作为语言模型代理的修复环境，代理接收故意破坏的声明并编辑直至通过验证。在 145 个破坏声明的基准上，验证器门控重试相比单次尝试在 deepseek-chat 上提升 +8.3 百分点，在 qwen-plus 上提升 +7.1 百分点。不同模型上的最优策略不同，但所有获胜策略使用相同的廉价证书。
Motivation: 语言模型在生成科学声明时可能产生不一致的表述，需要自动验证和修复方法，但现有工作在量子场论对偶性领域缺乏符号验证和修复框架。
Method: 开发符号验证器 DualityCert，检查候选声明的多个一致性条件；将验证器作为语言模型代理的重试门控环境，代理编辑声明直至通过验证。比较不同重试策略（如 stop-first 组合策略与独立验证器过滤重采样）和反馈类型（类别级反馈、可解释义务身份）的效果。
Result: 验证器门控重试在 deepseek-chat 上提升 +8.3 pp，在 qwen-plus 上提升 +7.1 pp（Holm 校正 p<0.002）。在 qwen-plus 上，类别级反馈比无内容重试提升 +8.7 pp，可解释义务身份比结构相同的掩码反馈提升 +6.4 pp。不同模型上最优策略不同，但所有获胜策略使用相同证书。
Conclusion: 验证器门控重试有效修复语言模型生成的对偶性声明，但最优重试策略依赖于模型选择。证书本身是廉价的，但策略选择重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Markerless Motion Capture in Routine Clinical Upper Limb Assessments: Validity and Insights Beyond Ordinal Scoring
papers.abstract_en: The Action Research Arm Test (ARAT) is a widely-used upper limb outcome measure in neurorehabilitation, but its ordinal scoring is subjective and suffers from limited sensitivity and specificity. We evaluated whether artificial-intelligence (AI)-based markerless motion capture (MMC), embedded into ARAT assessments during clinical routine, accurately reconstructs upper limb movement and yields valid, objective kinematic metrics carrying clinically meaningful information beyond the ordinal score. Across 47 sessions from 20 mixed-neurological patients (1,174 ARAT tasks), biomechanical reconstruction was accurate and robust across impairment levels, and kinematic metrics showed the discrimination pattern expected of a construct-valid measure. In longitudinal case studies, the metrics added the specificity and sensitivity the ordinal score lacks: a domain decomposition exposed patient-specific recovery profiles underlying equal ARAT gains (specificity), and kinematic improvement continued to be detected after the ARAT had saturated (sensitivity). MMC in clinical routine can thus provide valid, objective, sensitive, and specific kinematic measurement complementing ordinal scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了基于AI的无标记运动捕捉（MMC）在临床常规上肢评估（ARAT）中的有效性。通过对20名混合神经疾病患者的47次会话、1174个ARAT任务的分析，显示生物力学重建准确且稳健，运动学指标表现出预期的判别模式。纵向案例研究表明，MMC能够提供序数评分所缺乏的特异性和灵敏度，包括患者特异性恢复曲线和ARAT饱和后的继续检测。
Motivation: ARAT是神经康复中广泛使用的上肢结果测量，但其序数评分主观且灵敏度和特异性有限。需要更客观、敏感且特异的测量方法。
Method: 将基于AI的无标记运动捕捉（MMC）嵌入到临床常规ARAT评估中，通过47次会话（20名混合神经疾病患者，1174个任务）评估其重建准确性和运动学指标的有效性。
Result: 生物力学重建在不同损伤水平上准确稳健；运动学指标表现出构建有效测量应有的判别模式。纵向案例中，领域分解暴露了患者特异性恢复曲线，且运动学改进在ARAT饱和后继续被检测到。
Conclusion: MMC在临床常规中可提供有效、客观、灵敏、特异的运动学测量，补充序数评分的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MS-GPT: Rethinking MS/MS De Novo Structure Elucidation as Spectrum-Induced Posterior Querying of a Molecule-Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) is a central inverse problem in analytical chemistry. Most existing approaches to MS/MS identification remain tied to reference libraries or predefined candidate sets, whereas de novo methods aim to generate structures directly from spectra. A common de novo route predicts a molecular fingerprint from the spectrum and then decodes structures from it, enabling decoder pretraining on large molecule-only corpora. However, this paradigm creates a training-inference mismatch: the decoder is trained on oracle fingerprints computed from molecules, but at inference it is queried with a noisy spectrum-induced fingerprint posterior that is typically collapsed to a single thresholded fingerprint. We introduce MS-GPT, which recasts fingerprint-mediated de novo elucidation as spectrum-induced posterior querying of a conditional molecule-language model. MS-GPT conditions a molecule-language model on fingerprints and formulas, then converts the spectrum-induced posterior into a band of fingerprint queries near the oracle-fingerprint manifold through active-bit density calibration. Candidates sampled across this band are pooled and ranked by generation-frequency consensus. A lightweight LoRA adapter further mitigates domain-specific posterior bias while preserving the pretrained molecular prior. On NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym, MS-GPT sets a new state of the art, reaching Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy of 29.8\%/41.1\% and 23.9\%/28.7\%, respectively. Candidate-pool scaling shows that efficient autoregressive molecular generation continues to improve recall with a little additional inference cost. The source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 14 figures, and 9 tables, including appendices. Source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS-GPT将质谱从头结构解析问题重新定义为基于光谱诱导后验的分子语言模型查询。该方法通过活跃位密度校准将光谱后验转化为靠近真实指纹的查询带，并从带中采样候选分子，利用生成频率共识排序。在NPLIB1和MassSpecGym基准上取得新最先进结果，Top-1精确度分别为29.8%和23.9%。
Motivation: 现有指纹中介的从头解析方法存在训练-推理不匹配：解码器在真实指纹上训练，但推理时使用光谱诱导的噪声指纹后验，通常被坍缩为单一阈值化指纹，导致性能损失。
Method: MS-GPT将分子语言模型条件于指纹和分子式，通过活跃位密度校准将光谱诱导后验转换为靠近真实指纹的查询带。从带中采样多个候选指纹，利用条件分子语言模型生成候选分子，并通过生成频率共识进行排序和筛选。使用轻量LoRA适配器缓解领域特异性后验偏差，同时保留预训练的分子先验。
Result: 在NPLIB1和MassSpecGym上，MS-GPT分别达到Top-1/Top-10精确度29.8%/41.1%和23.9%/28.7%，超越此前方法。候选池缩放实验表明，高效自回归生成能以较低额外推理成本持续提升召回率。
Conclusion: MS-GPT通过光谱诱导后验查询分子语言模型有效解决了训练-推理不匹配问题，在多种质谱数据集上取得新最先进性能，并展现了候选池缩放的高效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid Advantage Estimation with Unified Critic for VLM Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) now act as agents in interactive environments, where success requires coherent reasoning and decision-making across turns. Although end-to-end training in agentic environments can improve such multi-turn decision-making abilities, current methods mainly rely on either token-wise optimization over concatenated token trajectories or turn-wise optimization with uniform within-turn credit. In this work, we establish theoretical formulations for the two levels of optimization and derive a hybrid advantage that serves both objectives. Furthermore, with an appropriate choice of discount factor and learning target, we prove that a unified critic model can estimate values for both turn-wise and token-wise. As such, we propose HyGAE, an actor-critic framework that jointly optimizes token- and turn-level objectives with the hybrid advantage and unified critic. We conduct extensive evaluations of HyGAE across five multi-turn decision-making environments, where it achieves an average success rate of 91% and a significant improvement of 10% over other methods. Furthermore, we provide an in-depth analysis showing that the exact analytic form of the hybrid advantage and return is crucial for optimization. Project Page: https://wx-zhang.github.io/hygae-web/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多轮交互环境中的决策优化问题，提出HyGAE框架，结合混合优势估计（hybrid advantage）和统一评论家（unified critic），同时优化token级和turn级目标。在五个多轮决策环境中平均成功率91%，相比其他方法提升10%。
Motivation: 现有VLM端到端训练方法要么采用token级优化（忽略turn级结构），要么采用turn级优化（同turn内信用分配均匀），缺乏同时考虑两种粒度的理论框架。
Method: 从理论上推导token和turn两个层级的优化目标，提出混合优势函数（hybrid advantage），并证明在合适折扣因子和学习目标下，统一评论家模型可同时估计两个层级的价值。基于此构建演员-评论家框架HyGAE。
Result: 在五个多轮决策环境中，HyGAE平均成功率达91%，比最佳对比方法高10%。分析表明混合优势与回报的确切解析形式对优化至关重要。
Conclusion: HyGAE通过联合优化token和turn级目标显著提升VLM智能体在多轮环境中的性能，理论的解析形式是关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Action from Adjacent Set in Physical Space Outperforms the Best Prediction in World Models
papers.abstract_en: Controllers based on sampling and latent world models assign a predicted terminal cost to each candidate action sequence, choose the minimum, execute its first action block, and replan. This rule can fail even when the terminal cost perfectly and accurately reflects the true task objective in the physical world. Residual prediction error can give an infeasible sequence an anomalously low cost, and a larger proposal pool gives such errors more chances to outrank feasible alternatives. We call this conditional failure proposal overgeneration. In Cube candidate execution audits, increasing the total proposal budget from 72 to 288 reduces the feasibility of selection by minimum latent cost from .375 to .062 for position targets and from .344 to .031 for targets defined by position and yaw, although every larger pool contains a feasible sequence. We introduce Adjacent Set Action Reconstruction (ASAR). Among proposals with low cost, ASAR measures density from standardized early action prefixes and reconstructs a full sequence from an adjacent set with a light anchor from the sequence with minimum cost. On a Carry and Release evaluation set of 75 queries, Kernel ASAR improves event completion success over matching selection by 28.0, 24.0, and 18.7 percentage points under latent cost and by 18.7, 20.0, and 17.3 points under a trajectory reachability cost at 72, 144, and 288 proposals. Analysis of finite proposal pools characterizes selection risk from the lower tail, separation by a related radius support statistic, and sequence containment under an explicit local feasibility condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于采样和潜在世界模型的控制器中，即使终端成本完全准确，残差预测误差也可能导致不可行序列被选中，称为“提议过度生成”。作者提出相邻集动作重建 (ASAR) 方法，通过测量低成本提议的早期动作前缀密度，从相邻集重建完整序列。在Carry and Release评估集上，Kernel ASAR在三种提议预算下将事件完成成功率提高17-28个百分点。
Motivation: 基于采样和潜在世界模型的控制器在候选序列中选择最小预测成本，但残差预测误差可能使不可行序列获得异常低成本，导致选择失败。增加提议池规模反而加剧问题。
Method: 提出Adjacent Set Action Reconstruction (ASAR)：在低成本提议中，通过标准化早期动作前缀测量密度，并从具有最小成本的提议的相邻集中用轻锚点重建完整序列。
Result: 在Cube候选执行审计中，提议预算从72增加到288，最小潜在成本选择的可行性从0.375降至0.062（位置目标）和0.344降至0.031（位置+偏航目标）。在Carry and Release评估集上，Kernel ASAR在72、144、288提议下，事件完成成功率比匹配选择提高28.0、24.0、18.7个百分点（潜在成本）和18.7、20.0、17.3个百分点（轨迹可达性成本）。
Conclusion: 分析有限提议池的特征选择风险，并通过相关半径支持统计和显式局部可行性条件下的序列包含来表征。

papers.title: ConFusion: Continuous Fusion Space Learning for Fine-Grained Controllable Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Controllable infrared-visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary thermal and structural information with flexible region-aware modulation, producing fused images that adapt to diverse user requirements and downstream tasks. However, existing methods typically rely on predefined discrete control conditions, leading to a sparse space that fails to support fine-grained modulation demands. To address this, we propose ConFusion, a novel framework that learns the continuous fusion space via Gaussian-conditioned spatial-aware modulation, enabling instance-level fine-grained controllable infrared and visible image fusion. ConFusion employs a dual-branch architecture to disentangle modality-invariant and modality-specific representations under joint reconstruction and text-guided semantic alignment. Gaussian-conditioned instance modulation variables coupled with Grounded SAM-based instance masks guide instance-level fine-grained modulation through the Mask-Guided Specific Feature Modulator, while the Text-Driven Invariant Feature Enhancer improves semantic consistency and enhances fusion. During inference, the multimodal large language model parses user intents into instance-level modulation variables to guide image fusion. Extensive experiments show that ConFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics in both fusion quality and downstream tasks, while supporting fine-grained controllable image fusion. Our code is available at https://github.com/HeyufeiAnto/Confusion

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Instance-Level Gleason Pattern Estimation Using Primary and Secondary Labels
papers.abstract_en: In prostate cancer histopathology, the Gleason Score is determined by the most frequent (Primary) and second most frequent (Secondary) Gleason patterns within a whole-slide image. Although these slide-level labels are routinely available in clinical practice, instance-level Gleason annotations are rarely provided, making patch-level learning challenging. We propose a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that estimates instance-level Gleason patterns from slide-level Primary and Secondary labels. The proposed method formulates instance-level learning according to the clinical definition of the Gleason Score by aggregating instance predictions into class counts and explicitly modeling the Primary pattern, Secondary pattern, and their dominance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed formulation enables effective instance-level learning and outperforms existing MIL approaches on the SICAP-MIL dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多实例学习（MIL）框架，利用幻灯片级别的原发性和继发性Gleason模式标签，估计实例级别的Gleason模式。方法通过聚合实例预测为类别计数，并显式建模原发、继发模式及其优势，与Gleason评分的临床定义一致。在SICAP-MIL数据集上，该方法优于现有MIL方法。
Motivation: 临床实践中幻灯片级别的Gleason评分标签（原发和继发模式）常规可用，但实例级别的Gleason注释很少，导致斑块级别学习困难。本文旨在利用弱监督的幻灯片级标签进行实例级模式估计。
Method: 提出一种MIL框架，根据Gleason评分的临床定义，将实例预测聚合为类别计数，并显式建模原发模式、继发模式及其优势，从而实现实例级学习。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在SICAP-MIL数据集上实现了有效的实例级学习，并优于现有的MIL方法。
Conclusion: 该框架能够从幻灯片级别的原发和继发标签中学习实例级Gleason模式，为临床应用提供潜在帮助。

papers.title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
papers.abstract_en: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an evolving project state. Existing prompt-based, chat-based, and node-based generation systems only partially support this state, as they often discard intermediate context, rely on linear conversations, or require manually specified workflows. Recent commercial systems indicate a shift toward agent-assisted creative production, but their closed architectures make it difficult to study how agents represent context, choose tools, revise artifacts, recover from failures, and maintain consistency over time. To address this gap, we introduce JarvisHub, a canvas-native creative agent harness for long-horizon multimodal creation. JarvisHub treats an editable canvas as the user workspace, the agent's external memory, action space, and shared project state, representing multimodal artifacts, dependencies, versions, and feedback as typed canvas nodes and links. Through a three-layer architecture of canvas state, protocol bridge, and agent runtime, JarvisHub enables agents to act within an inspectable and editable creative state. This design moves creative agents beyond isolated tool use toward sustained, human-steerable creative automation, where agents can progressively plan, generate, revise, and organize multimodal projects while users remain able to inspect, guide, and intervene throughout the process.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Project page: https://www.jarvishub.site/ Code github: https://github.com/LYL1015/JarvisHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JarvisHub 是一个面向长时间跨度多模态创意制作的画布原生智能体平台。它将可编辑画布作为用户工作区、智能体的外部记忆和共享项目状态，通过三层架构（画布状态、协议桥接、智能体运行时）支持智能体在可检查和可编辑的创意状态中进行操作，实现从孤立工具使用到可持续、人工可引导的创意自动化。
Motivation: 现有生成系统仅部分支持创意项目状态，常丢弃中间上下文、依赖线性对话或需要手动指定工作流，且商业系统封闭，难以研究智能体如何表示上下文、选择工具、修改作品和保持一致性。
Method: 提出 JarvisHub 架构，核心是画布状态层（存储多模态资产、依赖、版本和反馈为类型化节点和链接）、协议桥接层和智能体运行层，使智能体能在可检查和可编辑的创意状态中行动。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的实验结果或量化指标。
Conclusion: 该设计推动创意智能体从孤立工具使用转向可持续、人工可引导的创意自动化，用户可在全过程中检查、引导和干预。

papers.title: Are You Still the Agent I Authorized? Earned Authority under a Fixed Ceiling for Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-lived AI agents increasingly evolve after deployment by retaining experience, acquiring skills and tools, revising workflows, delegating work, and moving across task phases. This improves adaptation but creates a distinct authorization problem. Tool-enabled agents can turn model errors and prompt injections into consequential external actions; when evolution occurs under a live grant, the subject exercising that authority or the context in which it acts may no longer match what the user evaluated. Evolution can change both the effects reachable under an old grant and the authority required by the task, which may rise, fall, or become incomparable. Existing tool policies constrain actions but do not determine when a grant survives this change. We formulate authorization continuity: when does an existing grant remain valid, how may active authority change, and what boundary must never move? Our state-bound model fixes a transition envelope and an immutable effect ceiling at grant time. The envelope determines whether the grant survives a mutation; below the ceiling, authority may contract freely and expand only under specified evidence conditions. We distinguish requested from realized effects and prove that, under complete mediation, sound effect abstraction, attenuating delegation, and monitor integrity, mutation cannot amplify protected effects beyond the user-issued ceiling. Agent-produced evidence may allocate authority below the ceiling but cannot raise it. Finally, we map six mutation classes to their authorization consequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长期运行AI代理在部署后通过经验积累、技能获取、工作流修订等方式进化所引发的授权连续性问题。提出一个状态边界模型，在授权时固定过渡包络和不可变效果上限，确保代理突变不会将受保护效果放大到用户设定的上限之外。文中还定义了六类突变及其授权后果。
Motivation: 现有AI代理的进化可能导致实际行使授权的主体或上下文与用户评估时不一致，而现有工具策略只约束动作，未判断授权何时失效，形成授权漏洞。
Method: 提出基于状态边界的模型，包含过渡包络和不可变效果上限；在完全中介、合理效果抽象、衰减委派和监控完整性条件下，证明突变不能放大受保护效果。
Result: 形式化证明表明，在给定假设下，代理产生的证据可以在上限以下分配授权，但不能提高上限；突变不会扩大受保护效果的到达范围。
Conclusion: 该模型为代理授权连续性提供理论保障，并系统分类了六种突变情况下的授权后果。

papers.title: Verification-Notebook Learning for Source-Aware Multimodal Misinformation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal misinformation verification is challenging because misleading signals may come from different parts of a post and require different forms of evidence. LVLMs are well suited to this task, but their verification performance often depends on the inference procedure applied to each instance. Existing methods improve this procedure through stronger prompting, retrieval, or deliberation, but rarely retain the verification patterns learned from previous examples. We propose Verification-Notebook Learning (VNL), a non-parametric framework that learns an external verification procedure for a frozen LVLM before inference. VNL builds a compact notebook of decision principles, evidence cues, and recurring pitfalls from prior verification experience. The notebook remains fixed during inference and guides the verification of new examples. Rather than updating model parameters or storing demonstrations, VNL records learned knowledge in an artifact that can be inspected directly. Experiments show that VNL consistently outperforms a range of competitive baselines. Further analyses show that the Verification Notebook improves fine-grained source attribution while remaining compact and interpretable, providing an effective way to accumulate verification knowledge without model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Verification-Notebook Learning (VNL) 框架，为冻结的大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 在学习外部验证过程后，用于多模态虚假信息检测。VNL 从先前验证经验中构建一个包含决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱的紧凑笔记本，在推理时固定使用，无需更新模型参数。实验表明 VNL 优于多种基线，并改善了细粒度来源归因。
Motivation: 多模态虚假信息验证中，误导信号可能来自帖子的不同部分，需要不同形式的证据。现有方法通过更强的提示、检索或推理来改进验证过程，但很少保留从先前示例中学习到的验证模式。
Method: 提出 Verification-Notebook Learning (VNL)，一种非参数框架，在推理前为冻结的 LVLM 学习一个外部验证过程。构建一个紧凑的笔记本，记录决策原则、证据线索和常见陷阱，在推理时固定使用以指导新示例的验证，不更新模型参数或存储示例。
Result: 实验表明 VNL 一致优于多种竞争基线。进一步分析显示，验证笔记本改进了细粒度来源归因，同时保持紧凑和可解释性。
Conclusion: VNL 提供了一种无需模型训练即可积累验证知识的有效方式。

papers.title: SketchMamba: A Lightweight State-Space Model for Joint Progressive Sketch Classification and Stroke Auto-Completion
papers.abstract_en: Existing vector-sketch models treat recognition and generation as separate tasks, leaving a gap for streaming interfaces that must understand a drawing as it is being made. We present SketchMamba, a single causal sequence model that continuously classifies a sketch from any partial prefix while simultaneously generating its continuation. We achieve this by applying a dense per-step classification loss to a selective state-space backbone. Evaluated on a 58-class subset of the Quick, Draw! dataset, SketchMamba yields 94.93% final-step accuracy and a progressive-accuracy Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.706, crossing 90% of its final accuracy by the time 70% of the strokes are drawn. In a matched-budget comparison, the 1.55 million-parameter backbone ties a causal Transformer while outperforming recurrent and convolutional baselines. Ablations confirm that the dense supervision regime, rather than the architecture alone, drives the early-prediction capability. The results demonstrate that a single causal hidden state can unify progressive recognition and autoregressive generation without auxiliary encoders or task-specific branching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出SketchMamba，一个单一的因果序列模型，联合进行渐进式草图分类和笔画自动补全。在Quick, Draw!数据集子集上达到94.93%的最终步准确率和0.706的渐进准确率AUC，参数1.55M。实验证明密集逐步监督是早期预测能力的关键。
Motivation: 现有矢量草图模型将识别与生成分开处理，不适用于流式界面（需要随着绘画过程理解草图）。
Method: 采用一个因果序列模型，应用选择性状态空间骨干（selective state-space backbone），并施加密集的逐步分类损失（per-step classification loss），同时实现分类和生成。
Result: 在58类Quick, Draw!子集上，最终步准确率94.93%，渐进准确率AUC 0.706，在绘制70%笔画时达到最终准确率的90%。1.55M参数模型与因果Transformer持平，优于RNN和CNN基线。
Conclusion: 证明单个因果隐状态可以统一渐进识别和自回归生成，无需辅助编码器或任务特定分支。

papers.title: Neuromorphic Object Detection: An In-Depth Study and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Conventional frame-based cameras face significant challenges in detecting objects under high-speed motion blur or in low-light environments. Neuromorphic cameras provide asynchronous visual streams with high temporal resolution and a wide dynamic range, offering a promising solution for object detection under challenging conditions. Despite the development of numerous models and the emergence of various applications in neuromorphic object detection, there is still a lack of deep understanding and standardized benchmarks to assess progress and address key challenges. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and benchmark of existing neuromorphic object detection algorithms. Specifically, we first present a problem description, review the available datasets, and revisit the evaluation metrics. We then explore existing neuromorphic object detection approaches from various perspectives, including event representation, temporal modeling, multimodal fusion, asynchronous processing, low-latency processing, and energy-efficient computing. Furthermore, we evaluate a wide range of representative neuromorphic object detection models and offer detailed analyses of the comparative results. Finally, we discuss unresolved issues in neuromorphic object detection and propose potential future research directions. We hope this survey and benchmark will be a valuable resource for researchers and provide guidance for future advancements in neuromorphic object detection.

TL;DR: 本文是对神经形态目标检测（neuromorphic object detection）的全面综述与基准测试，涵盖了问题描述、现有数据集、评价指标，并从事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步处理、低延迟处理和节能计算等多个角度梳理了现有方法。作者评估了多种代表性模型并进行了详细分析，最后讨论了未解决的问题和未来研究方向。
Motivation: 传统帧相机在高速运动模糊或低光照环境下检测物体面临困难，神经形态相机虽提供高时间分辨率和动态范围优势，但该领域缺乏系统性的理解和标准化的基准来评估进展。
Method: 通过综述现有神经形态目标检测算法并构建基准，对方法进行分类（如事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合等），并公开评估代表性模型。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化结果，但提供了比较分析，突出了不同方法的优劣。
Conclusion: 总结了当前神经形态目标检测中的关键挑战，并指出了未来可能的研究方向，强调该综述可作为研究人员的参考资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: D3O: Dynamic Distribution Distillation for Ordinal Regression
papers.abstract_en: Ordinal regression is widely used in scenarios where labels are discrete yet inherently ordered. In practice, however, ordinal labels are often obtained by discretizing underlying continuous semantics through subjective human judgment, resulting in ambiguous boundaries and annotation noise. Such uncertainty challenges existing methods that rely on fixed supervision targets, which may reinforce biased ordering under subjective annotations. To address this limitation, we propose D3O, a dynamic distribution distillation framework that replaces static supervision with training-driven evolution of ordinal label distributions via self-distillation. Specifically, we introduce a contrastive ordinal-aware label enhancement module that leverages vision-language alignment to recover refined label distributions capturing both inter-class ambiguity and instance-level uncertainty. Furthermore, we design a CDF-based cross-layer interaction distillation mechanism to propagate cumulative ordinal structure across network hierarchy, ensuring consistent ordinal geometry in intermediate representations. Extensive experiments on four general ordinal regression tasks demonstrate that our proposed D3O consistently outperforms existing approaches, particularly under severe class imbalance and noisy supervision. These results highlight the effectiveness of dynamic supervision in learning robust ordinal representations beyond fixed targets. The code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D3O，一种动态分布蒸馏框架，用于有序回归任务，通过自蒸馏将静态监督替换为训练驱动的有序标签分布演化。方法包括对比有序感知标签增强模块和基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制，在四个通用有序回归任务上优于现有方法，尤其在类别不平衡和噪声监督下表现突出。
Motivation: 有序回归中标签通过主观离散化得到，导致边界模糊和标注噪声，现有依赖固定监督目标的方法可能强化偏差。
Method: 提出动态分布蒸馏框架 D3O，包含对比有序感知标签增强模块（利用视觉-语言对齐恢复精细标签分布）和基于CDF的跨层交互蒸馏机制（传播累积有序结构，保证中间表示的有序几何一致性）。
Result: 在四个通用有序回归任务上，D3O 持续优于现有方法，尤其在严重类别不平衡和噪声监督条件下。
Conclusion: 动态监督有助于学习超越固定目标的鲁棒有序表示。

papers.title: Anticipatory Risk-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Safe Flight Through Dynamic Clutter
papers.abstract_en: Safe quadrotor navigation in cluttered and dynamic environments depends not only on instantaneous geometric perception, but more critically on anticipating collision risks induced by relative motion. Conventional modular pipelines frequently suffer from perception latency, while end-to-end learning methods relying on implicit scalar rewards often struggle to extract reliable spatio-temporal features without physics-grounded supervision. To address this, we propose an anticipatory risk-guided reinforcement learning framework. Leveraging privileged simulator states, we construct a directionally aligned future collision risk map based on the Closest Point of Approach (CPA). Through an asymmetric actor-critic architecture, the network is trained to self-predict this structured risk, which explicitly guides the visual policy during deployment. A lightweight spatio-temporal encoder extracts motion cues directly from onboard depth sequences, bypassing explicit object tracking or optical flow estimation. Extensive simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate that our method effectively improves safety margins and flight efficiency in dense dynamic clutters compared to existing baselines. Furthermore, the learned policy achieves robust zero-shot Sim-to-Real transfer on a physical quadrotor, relying purely on abstracted spatio-temporal depth sequences and its self-predicted risk priors, validating the effectiveness of our approach and its robust generalization from simulation to reality.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种预期风险引导的强化学习框架，用于四旋翼在动态杂乱环境中的安全导航。通过利用特权模拟器状态构建基于最近接近点（CPA）的方向对齐未来碰撞风险图，并采用非对称actor-critic架构训练网络自预测该结构化风险，从而在部署时显式引导视觉策略。轻量级时空编码器直接从机载深度序列提取运动线索，避免显式目标跟踪或光流估计。模拟和真实实验表明，该方法在密集动态杂乱中提高了安全裕度和飞行效率，并实现了零样本sim-to-real迁移。
Motivation: 传统模块化管道常受感知延迟影响，而端到端学习方法依赖隐式标量奖励，难以在没有物理基础监督的情况下提取可靠的时空特征。因此需要一种能预期碰撞风险并有效引导策略的方法。
Method: 提出预期风险引导的强化学习框架：利用特权模拟器状态基于最近接近点（CPA）构建方向对齐的未来碰撞风险图，通过非对称actor-critic架构训练网络自预测该风险，并在部署时显式引导视觉策略。轻量级时空编码器直接从机载深度序列提取运动线索。
Result: 模拟和真实实验表明，该方法在密集动态杂乱中相比现有基线有效提高了安全裕度和飞行效率，并在物理四旋翼上实现鲁棒的零样本sim-to-real迁移，仅依赖抽象的时空深度序列和自预测风险先验。
Conclusion: 该方法验证了预期风险引导和自预测风险先验的有效性，以及从仿真到现实的鲁棒泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Random Forest-Based Prediction of Bone Volume Fraction and Fracture Position from S-Parameters
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a method for predicting bone volume fraction (BVF) and fracture position by constructing a random forest model based on multichannel S-parameters. A nine-antenna microwave scanning system is designed and fabricated to acquire the multichannel S-parameter data. Bone-mimicking phantoms are developed, and corresponding experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Both synthetic and experimental results demonstrate the validity of the method.
papers.comment: 5 pages,6 figures,This is a summary report prepared by undergraduate students I supervised, formatted as a letter

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多通道S参数的随机森林模型，用于预测骨体积分数（BVF）和骨折位置。设计并制作了一个九天线微波扫描系统采集S参数数据，同时开发了骨模拟体模进行实验验证。合成与实验结果表明该方法有效。

Result: 合成数据和实验结果均证明该方法在预测骨体积分数和骨折位置方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 基于微波S参数和随机森林的预测方法在骨密度评估方面具有潜力。
