papers.title: An Unofficial FastLAS Tutorial: A Programmer's Guide
papers.abstract_en: FastLAS is a scalable system for Inductive Logic Programming (ILP): you give it some background knowledge, a language bias, and a set of examples, and it searches for a set of logic program rules (a hypothesis) that explains the examples. These notes are a hands-on introduction to writing FastLAS programs. They are organised as a programmer's guide: syntax first, then a ladder of worked, numbered examples of increasing difficulty. Every self-contained example here has been run against FastLAS 2.2.0 and shows the tool's actual output. We keep theory to the minimum needed to write correct programs; throughout, set-off notes flag where FastLAS differs from its sibling system ILASP, and where the two learning algorithms (--opl and --nopl) behave differently. The document is intended as an unofficial tutorial to FastLAS 2.2.0, not as an official language specification.
papers.comment: 49 pages. A tutorial on the FastLAS input language. All examples are verified against FastLAS 2.2.0 and clingo 5.8.0; the accompanying task files are available at https://github.com/dasaro/fastlas_manual
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是FastLAS 2.2.0的非官方教程，以程序员指南的形式介绍其输入语言和编程方法。内容包含语法、逐步递增的示例，并对比了FastLAS与ILASP的差异以及两种学习算法的不同行为。理论部分保持最小化，重点在于实操。
Motivation: 现有FastLAS文档缺乏面向程序员的入门教程，作者希望提供一种手把手的编程指南以降低使用门槛。
Method: 以程序员指南的形式组织，先讲解语法，再通过一系列难度递增的独立示例逐步演示。每个示例均在实际FastLAS 2.2.0上运行并展示输出结果，同时指出与ILASP的差异及不同算法的行为。
Result: 摘要声称该教程提供了快速上手FastLAS的途径，所有示例已验证通过。
Conclusion: 本文旨在作为非正式教程，并非官方语言规范。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GTIN: A Unified Framework for Joint Event and Time Prediction in Temporal Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graphs are increasingly used to model dynamic systems in diverse domains such as social networks, financial networks, and traffic networks. Predicting both what the next event will be and when it will occur in these systems is crucial for understanding and anticipating complex behaviors, but has not been studied much. To address this gap, we propose a unified mathematical framework capable of capturing varying degrees of complexity across temporal graphs. Our framework is flexible and expressive enough to accommodate a wide range of network structures and temporal dynamics. Building upon this analysis, we introduce our novel approach for jointly predicting the next event and its occurrence time. Empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing techniques, particularly in scenarios involving irregular event patterns and complex temporal dependencies. These findings highlight the potential of our framework as a robust foundation for future research in temporal event prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GTIN，一个用于时间图（temporal graphs）中联合事件与事件时间预测的统一框架。该框架能够捕捉时间图的不同复杂度，灵活适应多种网络结构和时间动态。实验表明，在多个数据集上，该方法在预测下一个事件及其发生时间方面优于现有技术，尤其擅长处理不规则事件模式和复杂时间依赖。
Motivation: 现有研究大多单独预测事件或时间，很少同时预测时间图中的下一个事件及其发生时间。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一个统一的数学框架。
Method: 提出一个灵活且表达能力强的统一数学框架，能够适应不同复杂度的网络结构和时间动态。基于该框架，设计了一种联合预测下一个事件及其发生时间的新方法。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验显示，该方法在事件和时间的联合预测上持续优于现有技术，特别是在不规则事件模式和复杂时间依赖场景中表现突出。
Conclusion: 该框架为时间事件预测提供了一个稳健的基础，有望推动未来研究。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Neonatal Hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy Classification from the EEG and HRV Signals Using a Conformer based Masked Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose the MAEConformer, a novel self-supervised learning framework that combines the Conformer architecture with the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) paradigm for large-scale representation learning from unlabelled electroencephalography (EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV) signals. By integrating convolutional operations with Transformer-based self-attention, MAEConformer effectively captures both local temporal patterns and long-range contextual dependencies in physiological time series. To enhance reconstruction fidelity and representation quality, a multi-resolution short-time Fourier transform (MR-STFT) loss is incorporated alongside the reconstruction objective, enabling the model to jointly learn temporal and spectral characteristics across multiple scales. Modality-specific EEG and HRV MAEConformer models were pretrained on 6,030h and 4,868h of unlabelled recordings, respectively, and subsequently transferred to expert-annotated downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned representations provide strong transferability and data efficiency. In EEG-based hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) severity classification, the pretrained MAE-EEG model achieved test AUCs of 97.19% and 96.56% for binary and four-class classification tasks, respectively, outperforming a range of state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines. On the HRV-based HIE severity classification task, MAE-HRV achieved a test AUC of 82.42%, surpassing both self-supervised Transformer-based and supervised convolutional baselines. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of MAEConformer for learning robust and transferable representations across multiple physiological modalities.
papers.comment: Paper submits to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAEConformer，一种结合Conformer架构与掩码自编码器（MAE）的自监督学习框架，用于从无标注脑电图（EEG）和心率变异性（HRV）信号中学习表示。模型通过集成卷积与Transformer自注意力捕获局部时序和长程依赖，并引入多分辨率短时傅里叶变换（MR-STFT）损失以提升重构质量。分别在6030小时EEG和4868小时HRV无标注数据上预训练，然后迁移到专家标注的下游任务。在新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）严重程度分类中，基于EEG的模型在二分类和四分类任务上分别达到97.19%和96.56%的测试AUC，基于HRV的模型达到82.42% AUC，均优于多种监督和自监督基线。
Motivation: 现有的生理信号表示学习通常依赖有标注数据，且缺乏能同时捕获局部和全局时序依赖的框架。本文旨在利用大规模无标注EEG和HRV数据，通过自监督预训练学习鲁棒且可迁移的表示，以提升下游HIE分类任务的性能和数据效率。
Method: 提出MAEConformer框架，将Conformer（卷积+Transformer）与掩码自编码器（MAE）范式的自监督学习结合；设计多分辨率短时傅里叶变换（MR-STFT）损失作为重构目标的一部分，使模型同时学习时域和频域的多尺度特征。对EEG和HRV信号分别预训练独立的MAEConformer模型。
Result: 在HIE分类任务中，基于EEG的预训练模型在二分类和四分类测试AUC分别达97.19%和96.56%；基于HRV的模型测试AUC达82.42%，均超越多种现有监督和自监督方法。
Conclusion: MAEConformer能有效从多种生理模态中学习鲁棒且可迁移的表示，为无标注生理信号的自监督学习提供了有效框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GaitFace: A Multimodal Dataset for Long-Range Person Identification
papers.abstract_en: Efficient border control is becoming a significant global challenge, mainly due to severe congestion and extended passenger waiting times. To mitigate these bottlenecks and facilitate passenger flow, biometric technologies are increasingly deployed to streamline identity verification and enhance crossing efficiency. Technical limitations frequently impede biometric identification, particularly in long-range surveillance, where systems must deal with adverse atmospheric conditions and degraded image quality. While high-quality frameworks like BRIAR exist, they are frequently restricted to specific government agencies. This paper introduces GaitFace, a new public dataset that contains face and gait data captured at long distances. To ensure that the research reflects authentic border scenarios, we use Pre-Enrollment data, where a traveler registers via a mobile device, and "In-the-Wild" captures, which records individuals at a distance across multiple viewing angles and different cameras. Benchmarking SOTA face and gait models reveals that current architectures fail under low-resolution and elevated viewpoints despite success with optical assistance. GaitFace exposes these critical vulnerabilities, providing a rigorous public benchmark to drive more robust, unconstrained biometric research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了GaitFace，一个用于长距离人员识别的多模态人脸与步态公开数据集。数据集包含移动设备预注册数据和远距离多视角野外采集数据，用于评估现有顶级人脸和步态模型在低分辨率和俯视角下的性能，暴露其脆弱性。
Motivation: 长距离监控中的人脸识别受大气条件和图像质量退化影响，现有高质量数据集（如BRIAR）多限于政府机构，缺乏公开的基准来推动非受限场景下的生物识别研究。
Method: 构建GaitFace数据集，包含移动设备预注册数据（Pre-Enrollment）和远距离多视角多相机的野外数据（In-the-Wild），并采用现有的先进人脸和步态模型进行基准测试。
Result: 当前架构在低分辨率和俯视角下表现失败，尽管有光学辅助时成功，数据集暴露了这些关键脆弱点。
Conclusion: GaitFace提供了严格的公开基准，以推动更鲁棒、更无约束的生物识别研究。

papers.title: Global-mean surface air temperature change overestimates global warming rate
papers.abstract_en: Current climate policies are targeted at slowing down the global warming rate, or the global mean surface air temperature (SAT) change (ΔTmean), which is measured by the arithmetic mean approach under the assumption that SAT changes are symmetrically distributed. However, in reality, the SAT change is asymmetric in nature and its influence on the ΔTmean interpretation seldom received attention in previous research about climate change. This study theorizes, based on the image histogram approach, that while ΔTmean measures the Earth's overall SAT change, it yields a value larger than the global-scale SAT change (ΔTgs) because of the asymmetrical distribution of SAT change. Results show that ΔTmean is greater than that based on ΔTgs by 0.19-0.23°C from 2000-2019, relative to the global SAT in 1979. In future climate projections, where more significant inhomogeneous warming is expected, the disagreement between ΔTmean and ΔTgs reach 0.27-0.54°C by the end of the 21st century (2080-2099) under different emission scenarios. The large difference between ΔTmean and ΔTgs implies that there is a net positive regional-scale warming effect over the globe which is mainly contributed by Arctic Amplification. This paper constitutes a warning that extreme regional warming effects could have large impacts on the interpretation of ΔTmean, which is often considered in climate assessments and policies making, and illustrates the limitations and cautions inherent in using ΔTmean as the only indicator of the global warming rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前使用算术平均法计算全球平均地表气温变化（ΔTmean）会高估全球变暖速率，原因是气温变化的空间分布不对称。基于图像直方图方法，作者提出全球尺度气温变化（ΔTgs）概念，并证明ΔTmean比ΔTgs高0.19–0.23°C（2000–2019年），在21世纪末不同排放情景下差异可达0.27–0.54°C。北极放大效应是导致区域性增暖净正效应的主要因素，警示仅依赖ΔTmean解读气候变暖存在局限。
Motivation: 当前气候政策以减缓全球变暖速率为目标，但传统的算术平均法ΔTmean假设气温变化对称分布，忽视了实际情况中的不对称性，该问题在以往气候变化研究中未受足够重视。
Method: 基于图像直方图方法，理论推导并定义全球尺度气温变化ΔTgs，对比ΔTmean，分析两者差异及其来源。
Result: 2000–2019年ΔTmean比ΔTgs高0.19–0.23°C；21世纪末（2080–2099年）不同排放情景下差异达0.27–0.54°C。差异主要由北极放大效应引起的区域性增暖净正贡献导致。
Conclusion: ΔTmean作为全球变暖速率指标存在高估问题，气候评估和政策制定应关注其局限性，不能仅依赖单一指标。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: ObsDriveBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Understanding under Adverse Weather with Observability Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving under adverse weather remains a critical challenge, yet existing vision-language benchmarks mainly evaluate under standard conditions, synthetic corruptions, or single modality. As a result, it remains unclear how vision-language models behave under real-world adverse weather with multi-modal inputs. We argue that a key difficulty lies in degraded environmental observability: under fog, rain, snow, and low illumination, multi-modal observations become unreliable and cross-modally inconsistent, posing challenges to scene understanding, and subsequent decision-making. To study this, we introduce \textbf{ObsDriveBench}, a real-world multi-modal benchmark for adverse-weather autonomous driving. Our benchmark is designed with three capability dimensions: \textbf{observability awareness}, \textbf{spatial reliability}, and \textbf{risk-aware decision-making}, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of model behavior under degraded observations. We construct the benchmark through observability meta-annotation, scene description, and capability oriented multiple-choice tasks over synchronized camera, LiDAR, and radar inputs, forming a benchmark with over 14k training and 13k test questions. Experiments reveal consistent performance degradation of existing vision-language models. We further introduce \textbf{ObsDrive} model with normal-weather supervised fine-tuning and adverse-weather reinforcement learning, improving robustness across all three capabilities. The dataset and evaluation code will be released at \href{https://github.com/russellyq/ObsDriveBench}{\texttt{ObsDriveBench}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ObsDriveBench，一个面向恶劣天气下自动驾驶的多模态视觉-语言基准测试，包含超过14k训练和13k测试题目，覆盖观测感知、空间可靠性和风险感知决策三个能力维度。实验发现现有模型性能下降，并提出 ObsDrive 模型，通过正常天气监督微调和恶劣天气强化学习提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言基准测试主要评估标准条件或单模态数据，缺乏对真实恶劣天气下多模态输入中观测退化（如雾、雨、雪、低照度导致的多模态不一致）的系统评估。
Method: 构建包含同步相机、LiDAR和雷达输入的基准，通过观测元标注、场景描述和能力导向的多选题设计三个能力维度。提出 ObsDrive 模型，采用正常天气监督微调与恶劣天气强化学习相结合的两阶段训练方法。
Result: 实验表明现有视觉-语言模型在所有三个能力维度上性能一致下降，而 ObsDrive 模型在三个维度上均提升了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该基准和模型强调了观测感知在恶劣天气自动驾驶中的关键作用，但仅限于所提出的三个能力维度和数据集场景。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Mission-Level Runtime Assurance for LLM-Assisted ISR Swarms over a Verification-Aware Fabric
papers.abstract_en: Swarms of LLM-assisted autonomous robots are increasingly proposed for cooperative intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) in contested environments. A growing class of their assurance failures arises not within any single platform but across the swarm: individually-compliant actions compose into a mission-level violation: a prohibited objective split across platforms to evade per-platform lim- its, or a collective budget quietly exceeded. Per-platform guardrails miss these by construction, and contested communications let the violation hide behind lost or delayed evidence. We present a three-tier (platfor- m/squad/mission) compositional runtime-verification framework that de- composes a mission policy into per-agent and cross-agent aspects, aggre- gates per-platform verdicts over a verification-aware messaging fabric, and fuses them with an evidence-aware, two-axis (security x complete- ness) algebra whose provenance names the platforms that jointly trig- gered a violation. Because the fabric makes evidence loss and silence observable, unsupported negative verdicts are downgraded to an explicit unknown rather than reported as mission-wide all-clears. On a simulated ISR mission, an indirect prompt injection that causes real LLM planners to split a prohibited collection task across four platforms is invisible to every per-platform monitor yet detected compositionally with full prove- nance; under an injected fault campaign a best-effort central monitor emits silent false all-clears while the verification-aware fabric emits none
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM辅助自主机器人蜂群在情报、监视和侦察（ISR）任务中跨平台协同违规检测问题，提出一个三层（平台/小队/任务）组合运行时验证框架。该框架将任务策略分解为个体和跨平台约束，通过验证感知的消息结构聚合各平台裁决，并采用证据感知的二维代数（安全性与完整性）生成违规溯源。在模拟ISR任务中，该方法成功检测到因间接提示注入导致的跨平台违规（四个平台协同执行禁止任务），并在注入故障场景下避免了中央监控的虚假安全信号。
Motivation: 现有单平台防护机制无法检测跨平台协同导致的全局违规（如任务目标被分散执行），尤其在通信受限环境下，违规可能因证据丢失或延迟而被掩盖。
Method: 提出三层组合运行时验证框架：底层平台监控个体行为，中间层聚合小队内各平台裁决，顶层评估任务全局策略。采用验证感知消息结构使证据丢失和静默可观测，并通过证据感知代数（安全性与完整性二维）生成违规溯源，明确标识共同触发违规的平台。
Result: 在模拟ISR任务中，间接提示注入使真实LLM规划器将禁止收集任务分给四个平台，每个平台单点监控均未检测到违规，而该框架成功组合检测并输出完整溯源；在注入故障下，尽力而为中央监控发出虚假错误全清信号，而验证感知结构未发出任何错误信号。
Conclusion: 该框架能够弥补单平台防护的盲点，在通信受限和恶意攻击下提供跨平台合规性保证，并生成可解释的违规溯源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry Meets Semantics: Fractional Gradient Stabilization for Semantic-Driven Bounding Box Optimization in Visual Detection Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Bounding boxes are fundamental for object localization in visual detection tasks. Among them, oriented bounding boxes are widely used in visual detection tasks, which provide a more precise directional representation. Generally, IoU-based losses are widely adopted to optimize box regression. However, we observed that IoU-driven box optimization suffers from two key issues: (1) it relies solely on geometric properties while ignoring semantic cues; (2) orientation optimization suffers from unstable gradients, causing oscillations in orientation convergence. In this paper, we propose a Fractional Semantic IoU loss to achieve unified semantic-geometric learning with gradient stabilization. First, we design a semantic similarity metric to guide IoU optimization, building a Semantic IoU loss (SIoU loss) with an adaptive gradient gating mechanism. Then, we revisit the gradient instability issue in oriented box optimization and extend the SIoU loss to a fractional-order formulation to build the \textbf{Fr}actional \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{IoU} \textbf{loss} (FrSIoU loss). The FrSIoU loss accumulates historical IoU states to regularize abnormal gradients during bounding box optimization process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves stable performance gains across different bounding box formulations and diverse visual detection tasks. The code will be available on GitHub.

TL;DR: 本文针对目标检测中边界框回归的IoU损失依赖几何属性而忽略语义线索，以及方向优化梯度不稳定导致振荡的问题，提出分数阶语义IoU损失（FrSIoU损失），通过语义相似度度量引导IoU优化，并利用分数阶梯度累积历史IoU状态来稳定梯度。实验表明该方法在不同边界框形式和多种检测任务上均能稳定提升性能。
Motivation: IoU驱动的边界框回归仅利用几何属性，忽略语义信息；方向优化梯度不稳定导致收敛振荡，影响检测精度。
Method: 设计语义相似度度量用于引导IoU优化，构建语义IoU损失（SIoU loss）并引入自适应梯度门控机制；进一步将SIoU扩展到分数阶形式，通过累积历史IoU状态来正则化异常梯度，得到分数阶语义IoU损失（FrSIoU loss）。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在不同边界框形式和多种视觉检测任务上均能稳定获得性能提升。
Conclusion: 所提方法统一了几何与语义学习，并解决了方向优化中的梯度不稳定问题，代码将开源。

papers.title: Delegation Intelligence in Deep Search: A Controllable Framework for Disentangled Capability Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Deep search is becoming a core capability of modern agent systems, yet it is typically evaluated solely based on end-to-end answer accuracy. This coupled evaluation paradigm entangles retrieval quality, long-context comprehension, evidence verification, and tool-use decisions, making it difficult to determine whether a model truly knows when and how to delegate information seeking to search. To this end: (1) We formalize this meta-capability as Delegation Intelligence in deep search and decompose it into complementary dimensions-Search Decision-Making (recognizing information insufficiency and deciding whether, when, and how to search) and Information Synthesis and Verification (aggregating evidence from multiple sources, judging source reliability, and synthesizing information under noisy, potentially adversarial conditions). (2) To enable disentangled and reproducible measurement, we develop a controllable synthesis pipeline built on document-grounded reverse engineering. This yields a general recipe for constructing controlled deep-search evaluations rather than a single fixed dataset. (3) As a concrete instantiation, we construct DelegSearchBench, together with a disentangled evaluation protocol that isolates each capability dimension by varying document composition and tool access. (4) Across representative models, we demonstrate that deep-search competence cannot be adequately characterized by final-answer accuracy alone...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了深度搜索中的委派智能（Delegation Intelligence），将其分解为搜索决策和信息综合验证两个维度，并提出一个基于文档逆向工程的可控合成流程，用于构建解耦的评估基准。具体实例化为DelegSearchBench数据集和对应的解耦评估协议，实验表明最终答案准确率不足以刻画深度搜索能力。
Motivation: 现有深度搜索评估仅依赖端到端答案准确率，无法区分检索质量、长上下文理解、证据验证和工具使用决策等能力，难以判断模型是否真正懂得何时以及如何委派信息搜索。
Method: 提出可控合成流程：通过文档逆向工程生成合成数据，并设计解耦评估协议，通过改变文档组成和工具访问来隔离每个能力维度。
Result: 在代表性模型上的实验表明，深度搜索能力无法由最终答案准确率充分刻画。
Conclusion: 需要解耦的能力诊断而非单一准确率指标来评估深度搜索中的委派智能。

papers.title: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification
papers.abstract_en: Motor imagery (MI)-based electroencephalography is widely used in non-invasive brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but robust decoding remains challenging due to inter-subject variability and cross-session non-stationarity. This work proposes ATCNet-CIAM, an enhanced attention temporal convolutional network that integrates a lightweight channel-integrated attention module (CIAM) into the ATCNet framework to improve channel-spatial feature representation for MI decoding. The proposed model is evaluated on BCI Competition IV-2a, BCI Competition IV-2b, and the multi-day WBCIC-MI dataset under standard, within-session, and cross-session protocols. Experimental results show that ATCNet-CIAM achieves 86.32% accuracy on BCI IV-2a and 87.96% on BCI IV-2b under the standard protocol, while reaching 89.46% and 83.64% in the within-session WBCIC-MI on 2C and 3C, respectively. The proposed framework consistently improves classification stability and robustness under session-varying conditions, and ablation study confirms the complementary contribution of the proposed architectural components.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in the International Conference on Intelligence Systems and Robotics for Sustainable Development (ISRSD) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，通过集成轻量级通道集成注意力模块（CIAM）增强ATCNet框架的通道-空间特征表示，用于多会话运动想象脑电信号分类。在BCI Competition IV-2a、IV-2b和WBCIC-MI数据集上的实验表明，该方法在标准和跨会话协议下均提升了分类准确率和鲁棒性，消融研究验证了各组件的互补贡献。
Motivation: 运动想象脑电解码因受试者间差异和跨会话非平稳性而面临挑战，现有方法在会话变化条件下鲁棒性不足。
Method: 在ATCNet框架中嵌入轻量级通道集成注意力模块（CIAM），通过通道-空间注意力机制改进特征表示，同时保持计算效率。
Result: 在标准协议下，BCI IV-2a和BCI IV-2b分别达到86.32%和87.96%准确率；在WBCIC-MI数据集内会话协议下，2C和3C任务分别达到89.46%和83.64%准确率。
Conclusion: ATCNet-CIAM在会话变化条件下显著提升了分类稳定性和鲁棒性，消融研究证实了各架构组件的互补贡献，适用于多会话运动想象脑电解码场景。

papers.title: Auditing Alignment Controllability in LLMs via Political Axes
papers.abstract_en: Political audits of large language models (LLMs) usually reduce each to one point on a political compass. But that resting point barely matters in deployment: a model must land somewhere, and what counts is how far, and in which directions, its answers can be steered. That steering runs through the system prompt: the personalization layer a platform sets, or one induced from a user's history, not necessarily written by hand. We run a dispersion-first stress test of prompt-based controllability across 12 ideological personas plus an unsteered baseline, 70 Political Compass items, ten replicates, and seven leading LLMs: GPT-5, Claude, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Qwen (63,700 responses). Contextual framing explains roughly 88%-93% of variance on the economic and society axes, model identity under 3%: responses are highly instruction-adjustable. Models do not shift alike: some move more, and some saturate under extreme framings. Conflicting directional-steering results in prior audits resolve once baselines are recognized as non-centered: displacement and proximity diverge, so the effect is geometric, not differential compliance. Under authoritarian prompts, models produce similar shifts on the same questions. Political-coordinate audits therefore need steerability audits reporting dispersion, symmetry, saturation, and refusal floors. We release prompts, benchmark data, and code.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AIES 2026 (AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society). This version includes the supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/mbrcic/llm-political-steerability (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21489805)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对大型语言模型（LLMs）在政治立场上的可操控性进行了压力测试，考察系统提示（system prompt）如何通过意识形态角色引导模型回答。在7个先进LLM（GPT-5、Claude、Grok、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen）上进行了大规模实验（63,700个回答），发现上下文框架解释了经济和社会轴上约88%-93%的方差，而模型本身的影响不到3%。不同模型的响应可调整性不同，一些模型在极端框架下饱和。先前审计中的方向性冲突结果可以通过考虑基线非中心化来解释。作者呼吁在政治坐标审计中报告可控性的离散度、对称性、饱和度和拒绝底线。
Motivation: 现有政治审计通常将每个LLM简化为政治指南针上的一个点，但部署中更重要的是模型答案可以被引导多远、向哪些方向。本文旨在系统性测试提示层（system prompt）对模型回答的操控程度。
Method: 设计离散度优先的压力测试，使用12个意识形态角色（加上未引导基线）、70个政治指南针问题、10次重复，对7个领先LLM（GPT-5、Claude、Grok、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen）进行实验，共收集63,700个响应。通过分析角色框架对回答的影响，测量其在经济和社会轴上的移动。
Result: 上下文框架解释了经济和社会轴上约88%-93%的方差，模型身份的解释力不足3%。不同模型的可移动性不同，一些在极端框架下饱和。先前审计中的矛盾结果可以通过基线非中心化解释：位移和邻近性不一致，效果是几何性的而非差异合规性。在威权提示下，模型对同一问题产生相似偏移。
Conclusion: 政治坐标审计应报告可控性的离散度、对称性、饱和度和拒绝底线。作者公开了提示、基准数据和代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination. However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design. Here, we introduce Chamaileon, which unifies multi-target and multi-state binder design by formulating the problem as cross-context binding landscape modeling. The framework is underpinned by a training paradigm termed In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling. During inference, we employ Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS), a scalable strategy that optimizes a single sequence across contexts while alleviating the scarcity of high-quality multi-conformational paired data. Extensive evaluation on our newly constructed benchmark, CROSS, demonstrates that Chamaileon effectively generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements. The code is available on https://github.com/caohengyuan/Chamaileon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chamaileon 是一个用于蛋白质结合剂设计的统一框架，通过跨环境结合景观建模解决多靶点和多状态设计问题。其核心是上下文感知的序列-结构共建模训练范式 I3CD，以及推理时的混合路径采样（MoPS）策略。在新建的 CROSS 基准上，Chamaileon 展现出生成适应多种构象景观和多靶点需求序列的能力。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质结合剂设计方法大多假设单靶点、单状态，无法建模多靶点或多状态交互，限制高级功能导向设计。
Method: 提出 Chamaileon 框架，包含 In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) 训练范式和 Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS) 推理策略，实现跨环境上下文感知的序列-结构联合建模。
Result: 在自建基准 CROSS 上，Chamaileon 能有效生成适应多样构象景观和多靶点需求的序列。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了多靶点和多状态结合剂设计，但摘要未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: Real-Time Human-Centric World Modeling for Upper-Body Human-Object Interaction
papers.abstract_en: We present a real-time human-centric world model for upper-body interactive generation, aiming to synthesize coherent local world dynamics centered on a person, where coordinated body, hand, and facial motions evolve jointly with controllable human-object discrete interaction. To this end, we adopt a continuous-discrete joint control scheme with two complementary components: a continuous human state and a discrete interaction state. For continuous human-state control, we introduce a unified implicit representation based on multi-scale motion encoding, in which motion latents from the upper body, hands, and face are fused into a shared latent space. This multi-scale design improves expressiveness across different spatial scales, captures fine-grained human dynamics more effectively, and enables direct control without explicit retargeting. For discrete object interaction-state control, we represent object contact using a small set of language-encoded discrete interaction states, where text serves as an explicit interaction-state command, such as \emph{no contact} or \emph{grasp}, rather than an open-ended generation prompt, and we further construct a dedicated rendering pipeline for human-object interaction data to supervise such discrete interaction states. By combining continuous implicit human-state control with discrete interaction-state control, our model enables precise modeling of how a person moves and interacts with the local environment, including controllable changes to nearby scene states. Finally, we distill the model for efficient streaming real-time inference, achieving 25 FPS on two H100 GPUs. Experiments demonstrate improved fine-grained motion fidelity, more realistic hand-object coordination, and effective real-time interaction, establishing a practical step beyond motion reproduction toward real-time human-centric world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个实时以人为中心的世界模型，用于上半身交互生成，通过连续-离散联合控制方案，融合多尺度运动编码和语言编码离散交互状态，在H100 GPU上达到25 FPS，展示了精细运动保真度和真实手-物协调。
Motivation: 现有运动生成方法主要关注动作复制，缺乏对人与局部环境交互的实时可控建模，尤其缺少协调的身体、手和面部运动与离散交互的联合控制。
Method: 采用连续-离散联合控制，连续部分使用基于多尺度运动编码的统一隐式表示，融合上身、手和面部运动潜变量；离散部分使用语言编码的离散交互状态（如“无接触”、“抓取”）控制物体接触，并构建专用渲染管线监督。
Result: 在H100 GPU上实现25 FPS实时推理，实验显示改进的细粒度运动保真度、更逼真的手-物协调和实时交互能力。
Conclusion: 该工作超越了运动复制，向实时以人为中心的世界建模迈出了实际一步。

papers.title: Novel Claim or Déjà Vu? Rethinking "Contamination-Free'' Dynamic Evaluation for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal automated fact-checking (MAFC) verifies claims by retrieving and reasoning over external evidence. However, most existing static benchmarks risk contamination: they primarily consist of outdated claims verifiable using an LLM's internal knowledge without external evidence. This can inflate performance estimates and fail to reflect true capability on novel claims that require up-to-date information. To address this, emerging dynamic benchmarks collect claims published after LLMs' knowledge cut-off dates, assuming they are uncontaminated. This work revisits this assumption by empirically studying contamination risks in both the state-of-the-art (SOTA) static AVeriTeC benchmark and our newly constructed dynamic ClaimReview2025Q4 benchmark, as well as their impact on MAFC evaluation. Our experiments yield 16 findings, highlighting three key results: (1) Dynamic evaluation reduces but does not eliminate contamination risks, as 17.09\%--29.30\% of post-cut-off claims remain potentially contaminated; (2) Many newly published claims can be verified either directly or by synthesizing multiple pieces of public knowledge available before the cut-off; and (3) Contamination can induce statistically significant inflation in MAFC performance, increasing Macro-F1 by up to 11.34 points and distorting system rankings. In light of these findings, we re-evaluate SOTA LLMs under a strictly contamination-controlled setting. Our study provides practical guidelines for trustworthy MAFC evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了多模态自动事实核查（MAFC）动态评估中“无污染”的假设，通过在静态基准AVeriTeC和新构建的动态基准ClaimReview2025Q4上的实验，发现动态评估虽降低但并未消除污染风险，大量新发布声明仍可通过已有知识验证，且污染会显著高估模型性能（Macro-F1提升最多11.34点）并扭曲系统排名。
Motivation: 现有MAFC静态基准存在污染风险（使用LLM内部知识即可验证的过时声明），而动态基准假设截止日期后的声明无污染，但该假设未经验证，可能导致性能评估不可靠。
Method: 通过静态（AVeriTeC）和动态（ClaimReview2025Q4）基准上的实验，分析声明可被内部知识直接验证或合成验证的比例，并对比有无污染控制下的模型性能差异。
Result: 16项实验结果中的三个关键发现：（1）动态基准中仍有17.09%-29.30%的声明存在潜在污染；（2）许多新声明可直接或通过合成截止日期前的公共知识验证；（3）污染导致Macro-F1虚高最多11.34点，改变系统排名。
Conclusion: 强调了污染控制对MAFC评估可靠性的重要性，并提供了构建可信评估的实践指南。

papers.title: Do Diagrams Help Large Language Models Reason? Evidence from Syllogistic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Diagrams are widely used to support logical reasoning, and prior studies suggest that representations such as Euler diagrams can improve human reasoning performance. Recent work has also explored their effects on large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we compare four representational conditions for syllogistic reasoning: natural language, logical notation, linear diagrams, and Euler diagrams. Using 285 problems from Ando et al. (2024), we evaluate two contemporary LLMs, Claude 3.5~Sonnet and GPT-4o-mini. Our results show that diagrammatic representations do not consistently improve performance. Although the models perform well on entailment and contradiction problems, they struggle with neutral problems and often make systematic conversion errors. Overall, the results suggest that the tested models gain limited benefit from diagrams in logical reasoning tasks.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 15th International Conference on the Theory and Application of Diagrams (Diagrams 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过对比自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图和欧拉图四种表示条件，评估了Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o-mini在三段论推理任务上的表现。结果表明，图表表示并未持续提升LLM的推理性能，模型在蕴含和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中性问题上挣扎且常犯系统性转换错误。
Motivation: 尽管图表广泛用于支持逻辑推理，且先前研究表明欧拉图等表示能提升人类推理，但图表对大型语言模型推理的影响尚不明确。
Method: 使用来自Ando等人（2024）的285个三段论推理问题，对比四种表示条件（自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图、欧拉图），评估两个当代LLM。
Result: 图表表示未持续提升推理性能；模型在蕴含和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中性问题上表现差，且出现系统性转换错误。
Conclusion: 当前测试的LLM在逻辑推理任务中从图表获得的收益有限。

papers.title: MOJITO: Modal Joint Learning for Unified End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems commonly follow a cascaded two-stage pipeline where a perception stage compresses multi-modal sensor inputs into a compact context and a downstream planner predicts trajectories conditioned on this context. We argue that this one-way perception-to-planning interface forces sensor inputs into a compact representation, losing the fine-grained details critical for planning. Moreover, by constraining the planner to this compressed context, it is difficult to leverage the rich representations offered by modern vision foundation models. To address these issues, we propose MOJITO, a unified sensor-to-action framework for end-to-end autonomous driving built on modal joint learning. MOJITO removes the cascaded interface and instead performs block-wise Modal Joint Attention that simultaneously updates action, image, and LiDAR features, allowing the planner to directly access multi-modal features during action generation. MOJITO achieves 88.9 PDMS on the NAVSIM v1 dataset and 88.4 EPDMS on the more challenging NAVSIM v2 dataset, setting a new state-of-the-art. Extensive experiments further demonstrate strong scalability, instruction following, and diverse trajectory generation. Code and models are available at https://github.com/mumucc01/MOJITO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOJITO，一种统一的端到端自动驾驶框架，通过模态联合学习消除传统级联感知-规划接口，使规划器在动作生成时直接访问多模态特征。在NAVSIM v1和v2数据集上达到新的最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统采用级联两阶段流水线，感知阶段将多模态输入压缩为紧凑表示，丢失了规划所需的关键细节，且难以利用现代视觉基础模型的丰富表示。
Method: 提出MOJITO，基于模态联合学习（Modal Joint Learning），采用分块模态联合注意力（Block-wise Modal Joint Attention）同时更新动作、图像和LiDAR特征，移除级联接口，使规划器直接访问多模态特征。
Result: 在NAVSIM v1数据集上达到88.9 PDMS，在更具挑战性的NAVSIM v2数据集上达到88.4 EPDMS，均创下新纪录。实验还展示了强可扩展性、指令跟随能力和多样化轨迹生成能力。
Conclusion: MOJITO通过模态联合学习有效提升了端到端自动驾驶的性能，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: Topological Data Analysis and Graph-Theoretic Approaches for Tennis Match Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We present two approaches for predicting tennis match outcomes using topological data analysis and graph theory on ATP singles matches from 2000-2025. The first method applies lower-star filtration to player competitive networks, extracting topological features through persistent homology using four summary methods (VAB, HNAV, HWNAV, OW-HNPV) combined with Modified Band Depth analysis. Algorithmic optimizations including ego graph approximations and triangle elimination enable analysis of about 66k matches. Our Random Forest model achieves 66.2% accuracy (AUC = 0.719) using topological, graph-theoretic, and ranking features. Feature importance analysis reveals that rankings contribute 36.3%, centralities 25.5%, and TDA features 24.0%, with topological features providing complementary signal. When rankings are unavailable, the topology-only model maintains 63.56% accuracy, demonstrating that network-derived features alone capture meaningful competitive structure. The second method uses a modified Katz similarity index with temporal edge weighting, achieving 62.48% accuracy on held-out test data. This work represents the first application of lower-star filtration to tennis prediction, provides systematic comparison of four topological summary methods in sports analytics, and demonstrates that TDA can achieve above-chance prediction using network topology alone while providing additional value when combined with traditional features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于拓扑数据分析（TDA）和图论的方法预测网球比赛结果，使用2000-2025年ATP单打比赛数据。第一种方法通过下星滤波（lower-star filtration）构建选手竞争网络，结合持久同调（persistent homology）和四种拓扑摘要方法（VAB, HNAV, HWNAV, OW-HNPV）及修正带深度分析，随机森林模型达到66.2%准确率（AUC=0.719），其中拓扑特征贡献24.0%。第二种方法使用改进的Katz相似性指标与时序边缘加权，在留出测试集上准确率为62.48%。这是下星滤波首次应用于网球预测，并系统比较了四种拓扑摘要方法。
Motivation: 现有网球预测方法多依赖排名和统计数据，未充分利用选手对战的网络结构和拓扑特征。本文旨在探索拓扑数据分析和图论能否提供互补信号，并在排名信息缺失时仍能有效预测。
Method: 第一种方法构建选手竞争图，应用下星滤波提取拓扑特征，结合四种拓扑摘要方法和修正带深度分析，并使用随机森林分类器，同时引入图近似和三角消除等优化处理约66k场比赛。第二种方法采用修改的Katz相似性指标，对边进行时间加权以反映近期表现。
Result: 随机森林模型达到66.2%准确率和0.719 AUC，特征重要性显示排名贡献36.3%，中心性25.5%，TDA特征24.0%。当排名不可用时，仅拓扑特征模型仍保持63.56%准确率。第二种方法在留出测试集上准确率为62.48%。
Conclusion: 本文表明拓扑数据分析和图论特征在网球预测中能提供互补信号，即使在无排名信息时也能实现高于随机水平的预测，为体育分析中拓扑方法的应用提供了系统比较。

papers.title: Choosing a Text Embedding Model: A Practical Benchmarking and Decision Framework
papers.abstract_en: Choosing the right text embedding model is one of the most consequential -- and most frequently under-examined -- decisions in building a retrieval or search system, yet the model that tops a leaderboard is rarely the best choice for a given deployment. This report develops a practical, evidence-based framework for embedding model selection, built on a benchmarking study that evaluates T3EM (Text 3 Embedding Model), a commercial API-based embedding model, against a broad set of open-source alternatives on English-language retrieval tasks, and situates these findings within the wider Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) landscape spanning classification, clustering, semantic similarity, reranking, pair classification, bitext mining, and summarization. Beyond raw benchmark scores, the report traces the full path from embedding model to retrieved result -- how embeddings are produced, how they are indexed and searched at scale, and how document chunking strategy shapes retrieval quality -- so that model choice can be reasoned about as one decision within a complete retrieval pipeline rather than in isolation. The result is a consolidated set of practical recommendations for selecting an embedding model according to task, latency, cost, and deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提供一个基于证据的文本嵌入模型选择框架，通过对商业API模型T3EM与多种开源模型在英文检索任务上的基准测试，并结合MTEB全景分析，覆盖分类、聚类、语义相似度、重排序等任务。报告还追踪了从嵌入生成到检索结果的完整流程，包括索引、搜索和分块策略的影响，最终给出根据任务、延迟、成本和部署约束选择嵌入模型的实用建议。
Motivation: 许多系统在构建检索或搜索时随意选择文本嵌入模型，而排行榜最高的模型往往不是最佳部署选择。需要一个实际、基于证据的决策框架。
Method: 开发一个基准测试研究，评估T3EM（商业API模型）与多种开源模型在英文检索任务上的表现，并在MTEB框架下跨多个任务类型进行比较。同时分析嵌入生成、索引、搜索和文档分块策略对检索质量的影响。
Result: 摘要报告提供了针对不同任务、延迟、成本和部署约束的嵌入模型选择实用建议，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 结论强调了模型选择应作为完整检索管道中的一个决策来考虑，而不是孤立地看，并提供了基于多维度约束的推荐。

papers.title: MemVLN: Episodic and Procedural Memory for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to maintain long-horizon visual history for trajectory consistency while executing actions with low latency. Existing video-based VLN approaches typically struggle to satisfy both demands simultaneously. To address these challenges, we propose MemVLN, a novel VLN framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance with real-time inference efficiency (14 FPS). MemVLN utilizes a visual encoder to process continuous observations and a Large Language Model (LLM) to interpret instructions and generate actions. Central to our approach is an Episodic Memory management that applies pyramidal resolutions. This mechanism concentrates computation on immediate percepts while retaining compressed long-term history. Complementing to this design, we introduce Procedural Memory for fast action with a compact vocabulary of atomic mid-level actions to bypass auto-regressive decoding latency. Experiments on VLN-CE show that MemVLN-4B surpasses the baseline Qwen3-VL-4B architecture by 5.8\% SR in R2R and 9.7\% SR in RxR, while achieving a 7$\times$ speedup in inference latency.

papers.title: Impute On-Demand: Adaptive Correlated Time Series Imputation for Changing Environments
papers.abstract_en: Internet of Things (IoT) applications generate vast amounts of Correlated Time Series (CTS) data that often contain missing values and require imputation. Existing methods emphasize accuracy but often lack adaptability to changing IoT environments: they are vulnerable to sensor failures, cannot selectively impute only incomplete sensors, and use static architectures that do not adapt to resource availability. To address these limitations, we propose AdaCTSi, an adaptive CTS imputer for changing environments. AdaCTSi combines a One-shot Temporal Convolutional Network with a Learned Time-Sensor Index Table to extract and decouple complex spatio-temporal features into sensor-wise embeddings, enabling adaptation to varying sensor subsets. Sparse Spatial Attention efficiently extracts dynamic spatial correlations, while Correlation-Weighted Sensor Selection selects informative sensors to provide sufficient spatial context. Experiments with twelve baseline methods, three adaptability scenarios, and five benchmark datasets covering traffic, air quality, and trajectory data show that AdaCTSi reduces MAE by an average of 33.1% relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. A single trained model supports sensor-subset and resource-adaptive inference, and its modest memory footprint enables deployment on commodity computing devices, including MCUs.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (IEEE TKDE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaCTSi，一种针对变化 IoT 环境的自适应相关时间序列插补方法，结合单次时间卷积网络与学习时间-传感器索引表以实现传感器子集自适应，利用稀疏空间注意力和相关性加权传感器选择提升性能。在五个基准数据集上，相对于最强基线 MAE 平均降低 33.1%，且单个模型支持传感器子集和资源自适应推理，内存占用低至可在 MCU 上部署。
Motivation: 现有 CTS 插补方法在变化 IoT 环境中缺乏适应性，面对传感器故障无法选择性插补，架构静态无资源自适应能力。
Method: AdaCTSi 融合单次时间卷积网络（One-shot TCN）与学习时间-传感器索引表（LTSIT）以解耦时空特征为传感器嵌入，采用稀疏空间注意力（Sparse Spatial Attention）提取动态空间相关性，并通过相关性加权传感器选择（CWS）提供空间上下文。
Result: 在五个基准数据集（交通、空气质量、轨迹）上，相对于每个数据集的最强基线，MAE 平均降低 33.1%；单模型支持传感器子集和资源自适应推理，内存占用低。
Conclusion: AdaCTSi 在变化环境下实现了高效且自适应的 CTS 插补，适合资源受限的 IoT 设备，但尚未探索天气预测等特定领域。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Learning switched non-linear dynamical systems from a single trajectory
papers.abstract_en: We study empirical risk minimization for learning non-linear dynamical systems whose transition dynamics may switch over time. Under stability assumptions, and i.i.d switching over a set of $K$ modes, we derive non-asymptotic bounds on the prediction risk expressed in terms of the metric entropy of the underlying function class. We instantiate our general result for Hölder and linear function classes, obtaining explicit convergence rates that depend on the effective sample size $Tp_i$, where $T$ is the trajectory length and $p_i$ is the probability of observing mode $i$. Numerical simulations support our theoretical findings. To the best of our knowledge, these results are the first non-asymptotic guarantees for learning switched nonlinear dynamical systems from a single trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从单条轨迹学习切换非线性动力系统的经验风险最小化问题。在稳定性假设和模式独立同分布切换条件下，推导了预测风险的非渐近界，该界依赖于函数类的度量熵。针对 Hölder 和线性函数类给出了显式收敛速率，依赖于有效样本量 Tp_i。数值实验支持理论结果。据作者所知，这是首个从单条轨迹学习切换非线性动力系统的非渐近保证。
Motivation: 现有学习动力系统的工作大多假设动力学不随时间变化，但实际系统常在不同模式间切换。缺乏从单条轨迹学习切换非线性动力系统的非渐近理论保证。
Method: 采用经验风险最小化框架，在稳定性及模式独立同分布切换假设下，利用度量熵推导预测风险的上界，并针对 Hölder 和线性函数类给出具体收敛速率。
Result: 推导出预测风险的非渐近界，收敛速率依赖于模式出现概率 p_i 和轨迹长度 T，有效样本量为 Tp_i。数值仿真验证了理论。
Conclusion: 提供了切换非线性动力系统学习的首个非渐近理论保证，但分析依赖于稳定性假设和独立同分布切换，实际应用中的依赖切换情况有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Discovering Periodic Orbits in the Gravitational Three-Body Problem
papers.abstract_en: Locating periodic solutions of chaotic dynamical systems normally requires an initial guess close enough to the target orbit for numerical continuation or gradient-based search to converge. We show that Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) trained on sparse, noisy observations \emph{without} initial conditions recover periodic orbits of the gravitational three-body problem, including orbit families absent from the training data. The method rests on a second-order ODE formulation, fixed-frequency Fourier features, percentile-based adaptive refinement, and a trainable scaling parameter, each validated on forward problems. Across two 100-seed ensembles, $23$--$25\%$ of runs converge to families not present in the training data. We then ask what determines which family emerges. Two $χ^2$ tests give a consistent answer: changing the training data source significantly shifts the distribution of recovered families ($p < 0.001$, Cramér's $V = 0.339$), whereas switching between the two initialization distributions tested does not ($p = 0.620$, $V = 0.094$). The random seed selects which family a given run recovers; the \emph{distribution} the weights are drawn from does not shift the aggregate frequencies, but the training data does. The evidence is empirical: we do not characterize the loss landscape analytically, and PINNs remain slower than conventional integrators on well-posed initial-value problems. What the experiments establish is that the recovered orbits are verifiable rather than merely plausible: the identified ones refine to genuine periodic solutions, a network trained on Lagrange data recovers the figure-eight choreography (Li--Liao class I.A.1, matched to seven significant digits in $T^*$), and one trained on figure-eight data recovers a Broucke--Hadjidemetriou--Hénon orbit closing to $δ_T < 10^{-9}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）从稀疏有噪观测中恢复三体问题的周期轨道，无需初始猜测。实验表明，在100种子的集合中，23-25%的运行收敛到训练数据中不存在的轨道族。卡方检验显示训练数据源显著影响恢复的轨道族分布（p<0.001），而初始化分布无显著影响。恢复的轨道可精确验证，如figure-eight轨道匹配到七位有效数字。
Motivation: 传统方法需要接近目标轨道的初始猜测才能收敛，而PINNs可以在无初始条件下从稀疏数据中恢复周期轨道，解决混沌系统中寻找周期解的困难。
Method: 采用二阶ODE公式、固定频率傅里叶特征、基于百分位的自适应细化以及可训练缩放参数，构建PINN框架，无需初始条件进行训练。
Result: 两个100种子集合中23-25%的运行收敛到训练数据不存在的轨道族。卡方检验表明训练数据源显著影响轨道族分布（p<0.001, Cramér's V=0.339），而初始化分布无显著影响。恢复的轨道可精确匹配已知周期解（如figure-eight轨道T*匹配七位有效数字，另一轨道闭合至δ_T<10^-9）。
Conclusion: 实验证实PINNs可从稀疏数据中恢复可验证的真实周期轨道，但PINNs在适定初值问题上仍慢于传统积分器，且未分析损失景观。

papers.title: Formalizing Flag Algebras in Lean
papers.abstract_en: Razborov's flag algebra method is a powerful tool for proving asymptotic inequalities in extremal graph theory, often reducing the task to finding a finite certificate by semidefinite programming. We present a machine-checked formalization of the method for finite simple graphs, together with a certificate-to-proof compiler that turns externally generated certificate data into algebraic proofs checked by Lean. The formalization covers the foundations of the method: partially labeled graphs, their densities in large graphs, the quotient algebra of density expressions, graph-limit semantics through positive homomorphisms, and the downward operators used to average out labels. The compiler treats the external semidefinite programming output as candidate data rather than trusted input: Lean independently computes the required density and multiplication facts, verifies positive semidefiniteness exactly over $\mathbb{Q}$, and carries out the algebraic normalization steps of flag-algebra proofs. Our case studies yield formal proofs of seven Turán-type upper bounds, including Mantel's theorem and the Erdős pentagon theorem, a $C_4$-density bound for triangle-free graphs, and edge-density bounds for $K_4$-free, $K_5$-free, and $C_5$-free graphs. Independently of the compiler, we formalize the matching constructions that complete the exact Turán densities of Mantel's theorem and the Erdős pentagon theorem, and prove two inequalities of Goodman. Our constrained semantics also prompted a meta-theoretic comparison of two ways of imposing graph constraints: building a hereditary constraint into the flag algebra from the start, or testing inequalities afterward on constrained graph limits with labels chosen at random. We state the resulting root-plantability criterion characterizing when the two approaches agree; a forthcoming paper will present the complete account.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Lean中形式化了Razborov的flag代数方法，用于有限简单图的极值图论渐近不等式证明。他们开发了一个证书到证明的编译器，将外部SDP输出转换为可验证的代数证明。形式化覆盖了部分标记图、密度、商代数、图极限语义等基础。案例研究包括七个Turán型上界，如Mantel定理、Erdos五边形定理等。还比较了两种约束图极限的方法。
Motivation: 在极值图论中，flag代数方法依赖SDP求解，但解的可信度依赖外部工具。本文目标是通过机器验证的形式化提高证明的可信度，并提供编译器自动将外部SDP结果转化为Lean可检查的证明。
Method: 在Lean中形式化flag代数的基础概念，包括部分标记图、密度表达式、商代数、正同态图极限语义和向下算子。开发一个编译器，接收外部SDP输出作为候选数据，由Lean独立计算密度和乘法事实，精确地在Q上验证半正定性，并执行代数归一化步骤。
Result: 实现了七个Turán型上界的形式化证明，包括Mantel定理、Erdos五边形定理、三角形自由图的C4密度界、K4-free、K5-free、C5-free图的边密度界。此外，独立形式化了Mantel和Erdos五边形定理的精确Turán密度匹配构造，并证明了Goodman的两个不等式。还提出了根可植入性准则，比较两种约束方法。
Conclusion: 本文展示了flag代数方法可以在Lean中完全形式化，并且编译器可以将外部SDP结果转化为可靠证明。形式化覆盖了方法的基础，并产生了多个知名极值图论定理的严谨证明。根可植入性准则为约束图极限提供了理论比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do LLMs Know Their Vulnerable Scenarios?
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned large language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet embedding the same requests in particular scenarios can bypass their safeguards. Existing red-teaming methods empirically identify effective scenarios through observed attack outcomes, but why particular scenarios weaken refusal remains mechanistically unclear. Meanwhile, mechanistic interpretability studies have characterized both refusal directions and jailbreak-associated features, without explaining the relationship between the two representations. In this work, we show that scenario-wrapped prompts activate internal scenario directions whose causal steering consistently reduces refusal scores. Building on this finding, we propose \textsc{Concept2Scenario}, a concept-based attribution framework for vulnerable scenario discovery. It instantiates a broad concept space with a sparse autoencoder, attributes refusal suppression to individual concepts, translates the identified concepts into interpretable natural-language scenarios, and identifies synergistic scenario combinations through interaction attribution. Across three open-source models, two safety benchmarks, and six black-box jailbreak methods, the discovered scenarios serve as reusable priors that improve average attack success rates by up to $18.2$ percentage points. They also transfer to GPT-5, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and Gemini-3-Flash, suggesting that some scenario-level refusal vulnerabilities are shared across model families. Moreover, the identified combinations outperform their individual constituents and enable iterative attacks to succeed in fewer turns.

papers.title: Token-Region Guided Cross-Attention Fusion for Multimodal Affect Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Automated analysis of multimodal content on social networks has become a critical task for understanding public sentiment and information diffusion in the digital age. However, classifying internet memes remains computationally challenging due to the intricate interplay between visual cues and embedded, often stylized, text, particularly in low-resource languages like Bengali Language. This paper addresses the detection of political intent in Bengali memes by introducing Multimodal Cross-Attention Fusion framework. We first leverage a Vision-Language Model to extract high-fidelity OCR text from noisy meme images. Subsequently, we encode visual and textual features and synthesize them through a cross-modal multi-head attention mechanism that aligns semantic tokens with visual regions. We also investigate the integration of a domain-specific political lexicon as a knowledge prior. Experimental evaluation on the PoliMemeDecode1 dataset shows that our attention-based fusion significantly outperforms unimodal baselines and standard concatenation methods, achieving a state-of-the-art Macro-F1 of approximately 0.94. Interpretability analyzes further confirm that the model effectively learns to ground textual semantics in visual evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于跨模态注意力融合的框架，用于检测孟加拉语模因中的政治意图。该方法先利用视觉-语言模型提取OCR文本，再通过交叉多头注意力机制对齐语义token与视觉区域，并引入领域政治词典作为先验知识。在PoliMemeDecode1数据集上，该方法达到约0.94的Macro-F1，显著优于单模态基线和拼接方法。
Motivation: 互联网模因的自动分类因视觉与嵌入文本的复杂交互而困难，尤其是在低资源语言（如孟加拉语）中，现有方法难以有效融合多模态信息。
Method: 提出多模态跨注意力融合框架：先使用视觉-语言模型提取噪声模因图像中的高保真OCR文本，然后通过跨模态多头注意力机制对齐语义token与视觉区域，并集成领域特定政治词典作为知识先验。
Result: 在PoliMemeDecode1数据集上，注意融合方法达到约0.94的Macro-F1，优于单模态基线和标准拼接方法，可解释性分析表明模型能将文本语义充分映射到视觉证据。
Conclusion: 跨模态注意力融合能有效提升孟加拉语模因政治意图检测的性能，未来可扩展到其他低资源多模态任务。

papers.title: To Erase, or Not to Erase: Robust Training-Free Concept Erasure with Preservation aware Adaptive Ranked Subspace Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure techniques (CETs) edit text-to-image diffusion models to erase undesired targets such as NSFW content or copyrighted styles, while preserving model utility on benign concepts. Current CETs face a trade-off between erasure robustness and utility: stronger edits erase the target more reliably but degrade utility on non-target concepts, and vice versa. This stems from how existing methods define what to erase and what to preserve. Many CETs rely on static concept banks specified manually, generated by LLMs, or selected by CLIP image-text similarity. Such banks do not model how prompts steer the model during denoising, leaving it vulnerable to triggers that reintroduce the target while suppressing nearby benign concepts. We present Preservation-aware Adaptive Ranked Subspace Expansion (PARSE), a training-free framework for robust concept erasure in latent diffusion models. Given a target, PARSE queries the diffusion model with classifier-free guidance to dynamically discover target-inducing erase concepts and nearby retain concepts in the model vocabulary. It then edits the cross-attention value space with a preservation-aware projection that removes target directions while leaving retain directions intact. For triggers beyond this vocabulary-indexed space, PARSE iteratively searches for re-emergence triggers by textual inversion and adaptively expands the erased subspace only when a new trigger direction does not conflict with retain semantics. We also introduce the Balanced Erasure Utility Score (BEUS), which combines robustness (ASR under multiple attacks) and utility preservation (FID) via bounded monotone transforms and harmonic mean aggregation. Experiments on NSFW, artistic style, and object erasure, with a large-scale robustness-utility analysis over many CET baselines, show that PARSE erases multiple concepts robustly without sacrificing post-edit utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PARSE，一种无需训练的概念擦除框架，用于潜在扩散模型。通过动态发现目标诱导擦除概念和邻近保留概念，并利用保留感知投影编辑交叉注意力值空间，同时通过文本反转迭代搜索重新出现触发器并自适应扩展擦除子空间。实验表明PARSE在NSFW、艺术风格和物体擦除上能稳健擦除多个概念而不牺牲效用。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除技术在擦除鲁棒性和模型效用之间存在权衡，且依赖静态概念库，无法应对提示词引导的触发器。
Method: 引入保留感知自适应排序子空间扩展（PARSE），通过无分类器引导动态发现擦除和保留概念，编辑交叉注意力值空间，对冲突触发器通过文本反转迭代搜索并扩展子空间。
Result: 在NSFW、艺术风格和对象擦除任务上，PARSE在多个攻击下保持鲁棒性（低ASR）并维持效用（低FID）。
Conclusion: PARSE提供了一种训练免费、鲁棒的概念擦除方法，能平衡擦除与效用，且适用于多种概念。

papers.title: PlanCraft: Sketch, Refine, and Furnish for Architect-Inspired Progressive 3D Residential Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Two structural insights have been overlooked in automated residential floor plan generation. First, design is inherently progressive. Architects begin with rough strokes and refine them over time, whereas existing methods typically require their conditioning representation to be fully specified before generation, a fundamental mismatch with how design actually works. Second, the 2D floor plan is not an optional intermediate but an irreplaceable spatial contract. Once room boundaries, doors, and windows are fixed, furnishing reduces from open-ended spatial reasoning to bounded constraint satisfaction. Bypassing this contract, as existing 3D systems do by delegating layout to language models, yields overlapping rooms and implausible proportions; directly calling general-purpose language models likewise produces geometrically invalid layouts. Guided by these insights, we present PlanCraft. SketchPlan supplies the missing training signal by replaying the architect's drawing process on 80K real floor plans, producing partial sketches at every completeness level. PlanCraft-Diff progressively sharpens an incomplete sketch into a geometrically precise, vectorizable floor plan through a coarse-to-fine strategy. With the spatial contract established, PlanCraft-Agent then furnishes the scene within well-defined room boundaries. Experiments show that PlanCraft achieves a 61.1\% lower FID than the best existing 2D method and surpasses existing 3D systems by 15 points in expert-rated spatial rationality, with a sketch at only 25\% completion already outperforming all fully specified baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlanCraft，一种受建筑师启发的渐进式三维住宅场景生成方法。该方法通过三阶段流程（SketchPlan、PlanCraft-Diff、PlanCraft-Agent）从草图逐步细化到可矢量化的平面图，并在边界内布置家具。实验表明，方法在 2D 指标上 FID 降低 61.1%，在专家评估的空间合理性上超过现有 3D 系统 15 个百分点，且仅需 25% 完成度的草图即可超越完全指定基线的性能。
Motivation: 现有自动化住宅平面图生成方法忽略了两个结构性问题：设计本质上是渐进式的，而现有方法要求输入完全确定；2D 平面图是不可替代的空间约束，绕过它会导致几何无效布局。
Method: PlanCraft 包含三个模块：SketchPlan 通过重放80K真实平面图的绘制过程提供训练信号；PlanCraft-Diff 采用粗到细策略逐步锐化不完整草图；PlanCraft-Agent 在确定的房间边界内布置家具。
Result: PlanCraft 在 FID 上比最佳现有 2D 方法低 61.1%，在专家评价的空间合理性上超过现有 3D 系统 15 个百分点，且仅 25% 完成度的草图已超过所有完全指定基线。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了对设计渐进性和 2D 平面图约束的建模对于生成几何合理室内布局的重要性。

papers.title: Learning Sampling Parameters for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models expose many inference-time sampling parameters, including prompts, negative prompts, classifier-free guidance scales, and noise schedules. These parameters are typically manually chosen once and then held fixed across prompts and denoising timesteps, even though different prompts and stages of generation can benefit from different parameter values. We introduce LeSAMP, a framework for learning prompt-conditioned, timestep-varying sampling parameters. We formulate parameter selection as a reinforcement learning problem: Given a user prompt, a large language model is trained to emit schedules for the chosen sampling parameters. We optimize our model using rewards from human preference models and VLM-as-a-judge. We evaluate our model on Flux.1 [dev] and Stable Diffusion 3.5, and find that compared to baselines, LeSAMP has a win rate of up to 68.12% using human preference scores and 73.37% using VLM-as-a-judge. These gains are validated in a user study where we achieve win rates of up to 59.46% over previous baselines. Our results suggest that learned sampling-parameter policies provide a complementary approach to existing post-training methods for improving diffusion model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LeSAMP 框架，通过学习提示条件、时间步变化的采样参数来改进文本到图像扩散模型。将参数选择建模为强化学习问题，使用大语言模型生成参数调度，并通过人类偏好模型和 VLM-as-a-judge 优化。在 Flux.1 和 Stable Diffusion 3.5 上，LeSAMP 在人类偏好评分中胜率达到 68.12%，在 VLM 评判中达到 73.37%，用户研究验证了改进。
Motivation: 当前文本到图像扩散模型的推理时采样参数（如提示、负面提示、无分类器引导尺度、噪声调度）通常手动固定，未针对不同提示和生成阶段进行优化，导致输出质量受限。
Method: 将采样参数选择形式化为强化学习问题：给定用户提示，训练大语言模型生成时序变化的参数策略；使用人类偏好模型和 VLM-as-a-judge 作为奖励信号进行优化。
Result: 在 Flux.1 和 Stable Diffusion 3.5 上，LeSAMP 相比基线在人类偏好评分中胜率最高达 68.12%，VLM-as-a-judge 胜率最高达 73.37%，用户研究显示胜率最高 59.46%。
Conclusion: 学习的采样参数策略可以作为现有后训练方法的补充，进一步提升扩散模型输出质量。

papers.title: An adaptive multi-fuzzy logic model for diagnosing transformer faults using dynamic weight optimization
papers.abstract_en: Dissolved gas analysis (DGA) is crucial for diagnosing early power transformer failures. Traditional DGA interpretation methods like Duval Triangle, IEC ratio, Roger ratio, Doernenburg ratio and Key Gas are inconsistent and vary in accuracy, especially for multiple fault conditions. We propose an Adaptive Multi-Fuzzy Logic (AMFL) model integrating multiple DGA methods with fuzzy logic and a dynamic weight adjustment mechanism. Unlike existing approaches with fixed weights, this system iteratively evaluates each method's diagnostic performance, identifies multiple fault types, and adjusts weights based on fault prediction accuracy. A feedback-based optimization recalibrates weights after each cycle to ensure optimal solution convergence. The model, implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, is validated against DGA datasets with known error conditions. Results show the AMFL model significantly improves diagnostic accuracy, especially in complex error scenarios, and enhances adaptability to new datasets. Comparative analysis demonstrates the proposed method outperforms traditional fixed weight multi-fuzzy systems in accuracy, consistency, and reliability of error detection. This work provides a robust, flexible diagnostic tool for transformer condition monitoring and supports more accurate asset management decisions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应多模糊逻辑模型（AMFL），用于变压器故障诊断。该模型集成多种溶解气体分析（DGA）方法与模糊逻辑，并通过动态权重优化机制迭代调整各方法的权重。在已知误差的DGA数据集上验证，AMFL在复杂故障场景下显著提升了诊断准确性，优于传统固定权重多模糊系统。
Motivation: 传统DGA解释方法（如Duval三角形、IEC比值法等）在多故障条件下结果不一致且准确率波动，亟需更鲁棒的自适应诊断方法。
Method: 构建自适应多模糊逻辑模型，将多个DGA方法作为模糊推理子系统，通过反馈机制动态调整各方法权重，并利用优化循环确保收敛。
Result: 在MATLAB/Simulink中实现，并在已知误差条件的DGA数据集上测试，AMFL在复杂错误场景下诊断准确率显著提升，且比传统固定权重多模糊系统具有更好的准确性、一致性和可靠性。

papers.title: Charging Phase Health Indicators for Battery State-of-Health Estimation: A Systematic Comparison of CC, CV, and Combined Approaches under Cross-Battery Validation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate State-of-Health estimation is essential for safe battery operation and cost-effective maintenance. Although numerous health indicators have been derived from constant-current (CC) and constant-voltage (CV) charging phases, their effectiveness under realistic cross-battery validation remains insufficiently studied. This work addresses this gap through a systematic comparison of CC-only, CV-only, and combined indicator sets using rigorous Leave-One-Battery-Out (LOBO) validation on the NASA battery aging dataset. Four CV-phase indicators and CC phase duration are evaluated individually and in combination. Results show that the combined CC+CV approach achieves the best performance (R2 = 0.874), confirming that CC and CV phases capture complementary degradation information. Moreover, a 119% performance gap is observed between standard 5-fold cross-validation and LOBO validation, indicating that conventional evaluation overestimates practical accuracy. Based on these findings, practical guidelines are provided for indicator selection under data and computational constraints.

papers.title: A Multi-stage Constrained Optimization Framework for Data-driven Problems
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) transform high-dimensional, often noisy data into a compact latent representation, making downstream optimization more tractable. Three challenges persist in VAE-based constrained optimization: (i) sampling effectively within the latent space, (ii) identifying the active decision variables that actually influence the objective and constraints, and (iii) enforcing constraints without destabilizing training. We propose a Multi-stage Constrained Optimization Framework (MCOF). First, an entropy-constrained VAE (EC-VAE) coupled with a feature selector embeds objective and constraint information into a designated subset of latent variables, so that optimization proceeds over a low-dimensional subspace while the remaining coordinates supply solution diversity. Second, a Uniform Transformation (UT) module applies a per-dimension probability integral transform, replacing the irregular aggregate posterior with a uniform distribution over a bounded box and mitigating posterior collapse and Gaussian mixture bias. Third, a constraint-priority filter method (CPFM) solves the resulting surrogate problem by alternating violation-reduction and objective-reduction steps under a filter acceptance test, returning solutions that are feasible for the learned surrogate to a specified tolerance without requiring multiplier estimation. Finally, unselected latent coordinates are resampled to generate diverse decodings of a single optimized solution. We validate MCOF on a synthetic problem, where we ablate each stage and recover the analytic optimum, and on a ZINC250k drug design task, where the generated molecules satisfy the imposed constraints and are entirely novel relative to the training set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多阶段约束优化框架（MCOF），用于解决基于变分自编码器（VAE）的约束优化问题中的三个关键挑战：潜在空间中有效采样、识别活跃决策变量以及在不破坏训练的情况下强制执行约束。MCOF包含三个核心组件：结合特征选择器的熵约束VAE（EC-VAE）、均匀变换（UT）模块和约束优先过滤器方法（CPFM）。在合成问题（每个阶段消融并恢复分析最优）和ZINC250k药物设计任务（生成满足约束且完全新颖的分子）上验证了有效性。
Motivation: VAE将高维数据映射到紧凑潜在空间，但基于VAE的约束优化面临采样困难、活跃变量识别和约束稳定施加三个挑战，限制了其在实际问题中的应用。
Method: MCOF分三步：1) EC-VAE与特征选择器将目标和约束信息嵌入潜在变量的指定子集，使优化在低维子空间进行而其余坐标提供多样性；2) 均匀变换模块通过逐维概率积分变换将非规则的聚合后验替换为有界盒上的均匀分布，缓解后验坍塌和高斯混合偏差；3) 约束优先过滤器方法交替进行违反减少和目标减少步骤，在过滤器接受测试下求解替代问题，无需乘子估计即可返回满足指定容差的可行解。
Result: 在合成问题上，MCOF的每个阶段消融实验均能恢复分析最优解；在ZINC250k药物设计任务中，生成的分子满足施加的约束且相对于训练集完全新颖。
Conclusion: MCOF通过多阶段设计系统性地解决了VAE-based约束优化的三个核心难题，在合成和现实药物设计任务中展示了可行性和解多样性，但摘要未提及方法的局限性或泛化范围。

papers.title: ATLAS: Automated Approximation of Transformers for Efficient Homomorphic Inference in One Hour
papers.abstract_en: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) provides strong cryptographic guarantees for private inference, but deploying transformer models under FHE remains prohibitively expensive. A key bottleneck is that non-linear operations such as softmax, normalization, and activation must be replaced with polynomial approximations compatible with the CKKS scheme, and the multiplicative depth consumed by these approximations dominates inference cost. Recent frameworks have advanced approximation techniques, yet all rely on manually configured approximation hyperparameters (e.g., number of iterations, polynomial degree), applied uniformly across all layers. While convenient, this uniform-configuration approach is overly rigid: different layers can tolerate different levels of approximation error without degrading predictive accuracy, and uniform configurations cannot exploit this variability to reduce latency. Allowing each layer to adopt its own configuration, however, causes the search space to explode with model depth, reaching roughly $10^{84}$ configurations for BERT/ViT (12 layers) and $10^{225}$ for LLaMA3 (32 layers), rendering manual exploration practically impossible. We present ATLAS, an automated framework that configures per-layer approximation settings by formulating the problem as a multi-objective optimization over latency and predictive accuracy. The resulting problem is inherently difficult: 1) competing objectives over a large decision space (120 or 320 variables for BERT/ViT or LLaMA3); 2) expensive evaluation, as each configuration takes 70-1,000 seconds even in cleartext; and 3) sparse optimization signals, as 35-50% of candidate configurations yield numerically invalid solutions. ATLAS addresses these challenges through a two-stage optimization strategy that progressively relaxes layer-wise constraints, combined with surrogate models to accelerate evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATLAS，一个自动化框架，用于配置同态加密（FHE）下Transformer模型的逐层多项式近似参数。ATLAS将逐层近似配置问题建模为延迟与预测精度的多目标优化，并采用两阶段优化策略与代理模型，以应对巨大搜索空间（BERT/ViT约10^84，LLaMA3约10^225）和昂贵评估（每个配置需70-1000秒）等挑战。实验声称能在一小时内完成自动化配置。
Motivation: 现有框架手动统一配置所有层的近似超参数，无法利用不同层对近似误差的容忍度差异，导致延迟优化受限。逐层配置虽可降低延迟，但搜索空间随层数指数爆炸（如32层模型达10^225），手动探索不可行。
Method: ATLAS将逐层近似配置形式化为多目标优化（延迟 vs. 精度），并采用两阶段优化策略逐步放松逐层约束，结合代理模型加速评估，解决搜索空间大、评估昂贵、优化信号稀疏（35-50%配置无效）的难题。
Result: 摘要未给出具体延迟或精度数值，但指出ATLAS可在约一小时内完成自动配置，而传统手动统一配置无法利用层间差异来降低延迟。
Conclusion: ATLAS通过自动化逐层近似配置，实现了FHE下Transformer高效推理，克服了手动配置的刚性限制和搜索空间爆炸问题。

papers.title: Sparse Gaussian-Mixture-Model Q-Functions via Hadamard Overparametrization for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops an online, off-policy policy-iteration framework for reinforcement learning (RL), based on sparse Gaussian-mixture-model Q-functions (S-GMM-QFs). The framework reconciles streaming, non-stationary data with the Riemannian structure of the parameter space while handling distributional mismatch through experience replay. S-GMM-QFs are introduced via Hadamard overparametrization, enabling interpretable sparsification through smooth regularization that facilitates Riemannian-based optimization. Overparametrization allows the framework to adaptively identify meaningful components from a large initial pool, yielding sparse models where interpretability emerges naturally from geometry: each component's parameters (means and covariances) explicitly encode its geometric role in the ambient state-action space. These geometric roles are learned through online gradient descent on a smooth objective over a (Cartesian-product) Riemannian manifold. Numerical tests demonstrate that S-GMM-QFs match or exceed deep RL methods while using substantially fewer parameters and achieving faster improvement per observed transition. Notably, parameter efficiency and interpretability combine to maintain strong generalization in low-parameter regimes where sparsified deep RL approaches degrade.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于稀疏高斯混合模型Q函数（S-GMM-QF）的在线离策略强化学习框架，通过Hadamard过参数化实现可解释的稀疏化，并利用黎曼流形上的随机梯度下降优化。数值实验表明，S-GMM-QF在参数远少于深度RL方法的情况下，匹配或超越其性能，且在低参数区间保持强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有深度RL方法参数效率低且可解释性差，难以在资源受限场景下应用。
Method: 通过Hadamard过参数化引入稀疏高斯混合模型Q函数，使用平滑正则化实现稀疏化，并在黎曼流形（笛卡尔积）上进行在线梯度下降优化，同时利用经验回放处理分布不匹配。
Result: S-GMM-QF在数值测试中匹配或超越深度RL方法，参数数量显著减少，且每观测到的转移步数性能提升更快；在低参数区间，稀疏化深度RL方法性能下降，而S-GMM-QF仍保持强泛化。
Conclusion: 该框架通过几何可解释的稀疏化实现了参数效率与可解释性的结合，为在线RL提供了一种轻量级替代方案。

papers.title: VIPER: Visual In-Context Physics Reasoning for Physically Plausible Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern video generation models can synthesize visually compelling and temporally coherent clips, yet controlling their physical behavior remains difficult with standard text and image conditions. The core challenge is a conditioning bottleneck: material response, contact interaction, deformation, and motion trajectory are continuous and relational physical cues that are hard to specify exhaustively in language but can be demonstrated naturally by video. We propose VIPER, a Visual In-Context Physics Reasoning framework for reference-guided image-to-video generation. Given a target image, a brief target prompt, and a reference video, VIPER treats the reference as a dense visual demonstration of the desired physical process rather than an appearance template. It uses a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to extract reference-derived physical cues and guide a pretrained image-to-video generator through a hierarchical training strategy, enabling physical behavior transfer while preserving the visual prior of the base generator. To support this setting, we construct VIPER-19K, a curated dataset with material, trajectory, and physical-impact annotations, together with filtered reference-target pairs. Experiments on an unseen validation set show that VIPER achieves stronger reference-video physical similarity and higher human preference than representative video generation and video-as-prompt baselines, while maintaining competitive general video quality. Qualitative results further demonstrate that VIPER can transfer reference-derived physical behavior to new target scenes without requiring carefully engineered prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIPER 框架，利用参考视频作为物理过程的视觉演示，结合多模态大语言模型提取物理线索，通过层次化训练策略指导预训练图像到视频生成器生成物理合理的视频，并构建了 VIPER-19K 数据集支持训练与评估。实验表明该方法在物理相似性和人工偏好上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以通过文本和图像条件精确控制物理行为（如材料响应、接触变形、运动轨迹），而语言描述无法穷举这些连续关系型物理线索，视频本身可以自然地演示这些物理过程。
Method: 提出 Visual In-Context Physics Reasoning (VIPER) 框架：使用参考视频作为密集物理演示，通过多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 提取参考中的物理线索，并采用层次化训练策略引导预训练图像到视频生成器，实现物理行为迁移同时保持视觉先验。
Result: 在未见验证集上，VIPER 相比代表性视频生成和视频作为提示的基线方法，取得了更强的参考视频物理相似性和更高的人工偏好，同时保持了具有竞争力的通用视频质量。定性结果展示 VIPER 能够将参考中的物理行为迁移到新目标场景，无需精心设计的提示。
Conclusion: VIPER 证明了利用参考视频作为物理演示可以有效解决视频生成中的物理合理性控制问题，但摘要未讨论局限性。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Visual In-Context Physics Reasoning (VIPER) 框架：使用参考视频作为密集物理演示，通过多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 提取参考中的物理线索，并采用层次化训练策略引导预训练图像到视频生成器，实现物理行为迁移同时保持视觉先验。
summary_sections.result: 在未见验证集上，VIPER 相比代表性视频生成和视频作为提示的基线方法，取得了更强的参考视频物理相似性和更高的人工偏好，同时保持了具有竞争力的通用视频质量。定性结果展示 VIPER 能够将参考中的物理行为迁移到新目标场景，无需精心设计的提示。
summary_sections.conclusion: VIPER 证明了利用参考视频作为物理演示可以有效解决视频生成中的物理合理性控制问题，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: When Every Simulation Counts: Value-Based Reinforcement Learning for Accelerated Photonics Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: Photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs) can combine high-power operation with narrow-divergence surface emission, but optimizing coupled parameters requires costly full-wave simulations. Deep Q-network (DQN) optimization can reuse simulated transitions to guide edits, yet which value-learning mechanisms remain reliable under tight simulation budgets is unknown. We address this gap by comparing baseline DQN and six value-based variants for a seven-variable PCSEL design under a shared objective, simulator, 83-call budget, and four matched initializations. Beyond endpoints, we analyze sample efficiency, policy behavior, and physical response to separate learning gains from favorable starts or exploratory jumps. Dueling DQN is the only variant to improve all four seeds. Relative to the first evaluated designs, its selected structures increase the mean quality factor () from to (), reduce wavelength error by 64%, and increase upward power by 47%; compared with baseline DQN, they achieve a higher mean under the same budget. Other variants yield no consistent improvement; Double DQN reproduces baseline trajectories, while Rainbow-lite shows high upside but strong seed dependence. These results identify Dueling DQN as the most reliable configuration tested for simulation-budget-limited PCSEL inverse design and provide a reproducible framework for attributing algorithmic gains in scientific optimization. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Longying-Wen/PCSEL-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光子晶体表面发射激光器（PCSEL）逆设计中全波模拟成本高昂的问题，比较了基础DQN与其六种值基变体在七变量设计上的表现。在83次模拟预算和四种初始化下，仅Dueling DQN在所有种子中一致提升性能，将平均品质因子提高、波长误差降低64%、上向功率提高47%，优于其他变体。研究表明Dueling DQN是模拟预算受限下PCSEL逆设计最可靠的强化学习配置。
Motivation: PCSEL优化涉及耦合参数，全波模拟成本高，亟需能在极紧模拟预算下可靠工作的值学习方法，而现有研究对不同DQN变体在此场景下的可靠性缺乏系统比较。
Method: 在统一目标、模拟器、83次调用预算和四种随机种子下，对照基础DQN与Double DQN、Dueling DQN、Rainbow-lite等六种值基变体，分析样本效率、策略行为及物理响应，以分离学习收益与初始或探索优势。
Result: Dueling DQN是唯一在所有种子中提升性能的变体：相对首批设计，平均品质因子提高，波长误差减小64%，上向功率增加47%；相对基础DQN在相同预算下获得更高平均品质因子。其他变体无一致改进，Rainbow-lite方差大。
Conclusion: Dueling DQN被识别为模拟预算有限的PCSEL逆设计最可靠选择，并提供了可归因算法增益的复现框架；研究强调在科学优化中需谨慎区分学习收益与初始条件效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust 6-DoF Object Pose Tracking with Built-In Recovery under Occlusions and Rapid Object Motions
papers.abstract_en: Real-time 6-DoF object pose tracking is essential for many robotics applications, and several approaches exist. Yet even today's approaches remain unreliable under temporary full occlusions and rapid object motions. Once tracking is lost, most methods struggle to detect the failure and recover automatically, often requiring manual re-initialization. In this paper, we address the problem of robust model-based 6-DoF tracking of unseen objects from RGB-D data, especially in scenarios with occlusion and fast motion. We propose a novel method that combines efficient learning-based keypoint matching with optimization-based alignment and introduces a novel failure detection and recovery module. Our system monitors pose reliability, detects tracking divergence or occlusions, and performs a global re-detection and pose estimation step that robustly verifies recovery candidates before resuming tracking. Our evaluation on standard tracking benchmarks and on a new dataset of occluded and fast-moving scenes shows that our method matches state-of-the-art accuracy on easy tracking sequences, maintains high tracking speed at 57.6 frames per second, and provides the most robust tracking performance under challenging conditions. Thus, we believe that our approach is a relevant step forward in robust 6-DoF object tracking from RGB-D data.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RGB-D数据中6自由度物体姿态跟踪在遮挡和快速运动下的鲁棒性问题，提出一种结合学习型关键点匹配与优化对齐的方法，并引入故障检测与恢复模块。系统监控姿态可靠性，在跟踪丢失或遮挡时执行全局重新检测和姿态估计，以鲁棒验证恢复候选。在标准基准和新数据集上，该方法达到57.6 FPS的高跟踪速度，在困难条件下提供最鲁棒的跟踪性能。
Motivation: 现有6-DoF物体姿态跟踪方法在暂时完全遮挡和快速物体运动下仍不可靠，一旦跟踪丢失，大多数方法难以自动检测故障并恢复，通常需要手动重新初始化。
Method: 提出一种新颖方法，结合基于学习的高效关键点匹配和基于优化的对齐，并引入新颖的故障检测与恢复模块：监控姿态可靠性，检测跟踪发散或遮挡，执行全局重新检测和姿态估计，在恢复跟踪前稳健验证恢复候选。
Result: 在标准跟踪基准和新的遮挡及快速运动场景数据集上，该方法在简单跟踪序列上达到与最先进方法相当的精度，保持57.6 FPS的高跟踪速度，并在挑战性条件下提供最鲁棒的跟踪性能。
Conclusion: 该方法在鲁棒性方面是RGB-D数据6-DoF物体跟踪的重要进步，特别适用于遮挡和快速运动场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Optimize: Joint Routing and Flow Allocation on Sparse Non-Euclidean Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study an integrated pickup-and-delivery problem on sparse, non-Euclidean networks that jointly optimizes cyclic routing, cargo flow allocation, and cross-cycle service. The tight coupling of these operational constraints creates a complex discrete-continuous decision space with highly restricted feasible regions. To overcome these computational challenges, we propose Double-Channel Graph Attention (DCGA), an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework. DCGA isolates network reachability and demand-service logic into separate graph channels and constructs valid routes using a simulator-coupled, constraint-informed decoder. Experiments on LinerLib benchmarks demonstrate that DCGA achieves seconds-level inference and delivers state-of-the-art solution quality on instances beyond a specific scale, with its advantage over existing baselines widening significantly as problem size increases. Supported by extensive stability and ablation analyses, our results demonstrate that this structure-aware learning approach provides an effective, low-latency engine for realistic routing-and-flow optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏非欧几里得网络中的联合取送货路由与流量分配问题，提出双通道图注意力（DCGA）框架，一种端到端强化学习方法。DCGA将网络可达性和需求-服务逻辑分离到两个图通道，并通过模拟器耦合的约束感知解码器构建有效路由。在LinerLib基准上，DCGA在特定规模以上的实例上实现秒级推理和最先进的解质量，且优势随问题规模扩大而增加。
Motivation: 稀疏非欧几里得网络中的路由与流量分配问题存在离散-连续混合决策空间和严格可行域，传统方法难以高效求解。
Method: 提出双通道图注意力（DCGA）框架：将网络可达性和需求-服务逻辑编码为分离的图通道，并使用与模拟器耦合的约束感知解码器生成可行路由。采用端到端强化学习训练。
Result: 在LinerLib基准上，DCGA实现秒级推理，在特定规模以上实例上达到最先进的解质量，且优势随问题规模扩大而显著增加。消融实验和稳定性分析支持其有效性。
Conclusion: 结构感知的强化学习方法为现实路由与流量优化提供了有效且低延迟的求解引擎。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Extending Fourier Neural Operators for Modeling Parameterized and Coupled PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Parameterized and coupled partial differential equations (PDEs) are central to modeling phenomena in science and engineering, yet neural operator methods that address both aspects remain limited. We extend Fourier neural operators (FNOs) with minimal architectural modifications along two directions. For parameterized dynamics, we propose a hypernetwork-based modulation that conditions the operator on physical parameters. For coupled systems, we conduct a systematic exploration of architectural choices, examining how operator components can be adapted to balance shared structure with cross-variable interactions while retaining the efficiency of standard FNOs. Evaluations on benchmark PDEs, including the one-dimensional capacitively coupled plasma equations and the Gray-Scott system, show that our methods achieve up to 55-72% lower errors than strong baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of principled modulation and systematic design exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过最小架构修改扩展傅里叶神经算子（FNO），分别针对参数化动力学（使用超网络调制）和耦合系统（系统探索架构选择），在电容耦合等离子体方程和Gray-Scott系统等基准PDE上实现了比强基线低55-72%的误差。
Motivation: 现有神经算子方法对参数化PDE和耦合PDE的处理有限，而这两类PDE广泛存在于科学和工程建模中。
Method: 提出两种扩展：一是基于超网络（hypernetwork）的调制机制，使算子条件化于物理参数；二是对耦合系统的架构选择进行系统探索，平衡共享结构与跨变量交互，同时保持标准FNO的效率。
Result: 在一维电容耦合等离子体方程和Gray-Scott系统等基准上，所提方法比强基线降低了55-72%的误差。
Conclusion: 有原则的调制和系统性的架构探索能显著提升FNO在参数化和耦合PDE上的性能。
Relevance: 30
