papers.title: Confidently Wrong: Exception Chain Collapse in Frontier LLM Rule Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: We document a failure class in frontier large language models -- exception chain collapse -- observed in eligibility evaluation under nested conditional rules of the form "A is required UNLESS B applies, UNLESS C overrides B". The failure reproduces at first observation, but its empirical surface is unstable: between March and April 2026 several failure cells closed silently under the same model alias, with no version bump (GPT-5.4 on construction insurance moved from 96.6% to 100%, same prompt and harness). For regulated workflows, frontier-model accuracy is a moving compliance boundary that shifts without notice. We present the Aethis Eligibility Module, a neuro-symbolic architecture in which LLMs author rules from authoritative sources and an SMT-based layer executes them deterministically, consistent with the authored specification regardless of model drift, reasoning-effort defaults, or prompt format. Three evidence bases: (i) a controlled benchmark of 225 scenarios across four regulatory domains documents the pattern and, in replication, the drift that partially closed it; (ii) a 20-scenario adversarial extension on construction insurance, where the engine scores 20/20, as does one of four frontier configurations (GPT-5.4 at low reasoning effort), while the other three, including Anthropic's strongest model at evaluation time, fail the same coverage-gap edge case; (iii) external validation on nine peer-reviewed LegalBench tasks, 949 held-out cases, where the engine is significantly more accurate than all three frontier models (combined McNemar's p <= 0.003), with margins up to +41 points on the curated multi-prong tasks against the Anthropic models. The contribution is to relocate uncertainty from the inference boundary, where it is silent, to the specification boundary, where it is deliberate and audited. All scenarios, rule encodings, and results are public and reproducible.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 9 figures. Working paper v3.13.0. Benchmark data, rule encodings and per-case result artefacts: https://github.com/Aethis-ai/confidently-wrong-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文记录了前沿大型语言模型在嵌套条件规则下的失败模式——异常链坍塌，并提出了神经符号架构Aethis Eligibility Module，其中LLM从权威来源编写规则，SMT层确定执行。实验结果显示该模块在多个基准上显著优于现有模型，且所有数据公开可复现。
Motivation: 前沿LLM在法规评估中可能稳定复现但易变的失败模式，导致合规边界不可预测，影响监管工作流的可靠性。
Method: 提出神经符号架构，LLM从权威来源编写规则，SMT层确定执行，将不确定性从推理边界转移到规范边界，确保结果与规范一致。
Result: 在225个场景基准上记录了模式及漂移；在20个对抗性场景中，引擎得分20/20，而三个前沿配置失败；在LegalBench任务上，引擎显著优于所有三个前沿模型（McNemar检验p<=0.003），最大提升+41分。
Conclusion: 贡献是将不确定性从无声的推理边界转移到可审计的规范边界，使错误可追溯；所有场景、规则编码和结果公开且可复现。

papers.title: Semantic Semi-Incremental Data-Association-Free Object SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Data association between landmark measurements and landmark variables has long been a central challenge in SLAM, as estimation accuracy depends critically on associating measurements with the correct landmark variables. Recent advances in deep learning have created new opportunities for the problem; data association can now leverage not only positional measurements but also semantic information about object landmarks, such as class labels from neural object detectors and feature vectors from visual foundation models. In this paper, we present a generalized data-association-free SLAM framework that jointly estimates data associations, robot poses, landmark positions, and landmark semantics from odometry, and positional and semantic measurements of landmarks. The proposed framework (i) creates a synergy between data association and landmark semantics estimation; (ii) adopts a semi-incremental estimation scheme for improved accuracy and computational efficiency; and (iii) provides a principled justification, guidelines, and heuristics for landmark-number estimation, improving the interpretability and practical usability of the framework. The proposed framework and algorithms are evaluated on synthetic and real-world datasets with two types of semantic information, class labels and real-valued feature vectors, and demonstrate superior performance compared to strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种广义无数据关联的语义SLAM框架，联合估计数据关联、机器人位姿、地标位置和地标语义。采用半增量估计方案以提升精度和计算效率，并提供了地标数量估计的原则指导。在合成和真实数据集上，使用类标签和实值特征向量两种语义信息，性能优于强基线。
Motivation: 传统SLAM中数据关联是核心挑战，本文利用深度学习提供的语义信息（类标签、特征向量）来避免显式的数据关联，从而提升估计鲁棒性。
Method: 提出无数据关联的SLAM框架，联合优化数据关联、位姿、地标位置和语义；采用半增量估计策略平衡精度与效率；并给出地标数量估计的准则与启发式方法。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，使用类标签和实值特征向量两种语义信息，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性上均优于对比基线。
Conclusion: 该框架为无数据关联的语义SLAM提供了统一的联合估计方案，提高了可解释性和实际可用性，适用于多种语义信息类型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
papers.abstract_en: Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations. They offer a flexible interface for reading hidden information from model states, especially when relevant information is internally represented but absent or incomplete in visible behavior. However, AOs are themselves learned systems: their answers are shaped by training data, objectives, and learned reporting behavior, rather than being neutral readouts of represented information. We study this in a controlled Taboo Word Guessing setting, where subject models are fine-tuned to internally use a hidden concept while avoiding direct disclosure. Contrary to the expectation that an AO trained on such a subject becomes a specialist reader, we find that fine-tuned AOs can become concept-specific anti-readers: they selectively fail to recover the concept persistently present during their own training. This failure is not simply explained by absence of the concept from the subject or oracle representations: the target remains decodable inside the oracle, while LogitLens and layer-ablation analyses indicate that the failure arises in the AO readout pathway. Our results show that behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and AO-verbalizability can come apart, raising a reliability concern for learned interpretability interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究激活Oracle（Activation Oracles, AOs）——一种从另一模型内部激活中读取信息的语言模型。在Taboo Word Guessing设定中，发现微调后的AOs可能成为特定概念的反读器：它们选择性地无法恢复自身训练过程中持续存在的隐藏概念。该失效并非由于主体或Oracle表示中缺少该概念，而是源于Oracle读出路径的问题。结果提示行为泄露、表示级可解码性和AO可言语化可能分离，对学得可解释性接口的可靠性提出担忧。
Motivation: 激活Oracle被期望作为中立的读取接口，但它们是学习系统，其回答受训练数据与目标影响。需要检验它们是否可靠地从模型状态读取隐藏信息，尤其是在主体模型被微调以隐藏概念时。
Method: 在受控的Taboo Word Guessing设定中，主体模型被微调以内部使用隐藏概念但避免直接披露。随后训练AOs并分析其行为，通过LogitLens和层消融定位失效来源。

Conclusion: 行为泄露与表示级可解码性及AO可言语化可以分离，这表明学得可解释性接口可能不可靠，需要谨慎使用。

papers.title: UltraViT: Latency-Optimized On-device Vision Encoder for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain bottlenecked by massive computational footprints, precluding their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. While efforts to compress LVLMs focus heavily on vision token reduction or smaller language models, the vision encoder is largely overlooked, typically deployed as a monolithic, computationally heavy feature extractor. Moreover, there is no previous effort that designs a vision encoder for LVLMs directly optimized for on-device latency. In this paper, we present UltraViT, a vision encoder for LVLMs, explicitly designed and optimized for on-device performance. Specifically, by taking into account real on-device latencies, we systematically design a pyramidal architecture that strategically integrates and adapts heterogeneous spatial mixers at the macro-block level. Furthermore, to pre-train UltraViT, we propose a novel two-stage generative pre-training strategy: cultivating rich spatial features via dense distillation, followed by direct generative supervision from a capacity-mixed frozen LLM. Compared to standard contrastive and SSL, we show that our pre-training is much more effective for achieving high-level semantic grounding for UltraViT needed for the subsequent generative multimodal alignment of LVLM training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our on-device latency-informed design combined with our tailored training strategy establishes a new state-of-the-art for efficient LVLM encoding, significantly outperforming existing encoder-centric baselines while operating on-device at nearly 1.7xthe speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraViT是一种专为设备端部署优化的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）视觉编码器，采用金字塔架构和异构空间混合器，并提出了两阶段生成式预训练策略，在保持高速推理的同时显著优于现有编码器基线。
Motivation: 现有LVLM压缩工作主要关注视觉token减少或小型语言模型，忽略了视觉编码器的计算开销，缺乏直接针对设备端延迟优化的视觉编码器设计。
Method: 基于实际设备端延迟进行系统设计，在宏块级别集成并适配异构空间混合器，构建金字塔架构；预训练采用两阶段生成式策略：先通过密集蒸馏培养丰富空间特征，再使用容量混合的冻结LLM进行直接生成监督。
Result: UltraViT在设备端运行速度比现有编码器基线快约1.7倍，同时显著提升了编码效率，建立了新的最先进水平。
Conclusion: 设备端延迟感知的设计结合定制预训练策略可有效提升LVLM的视觉编码效率，为资源受限设备上的部署提供了新方案。

papers.title: Investigating the Visual Cues of CNNs for Vascular Segmentation: A Case Study in Microscopy and Fundus Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Vascular segmentation is a standard procedure for clinical diagnosis, yet the specific visual features determining model decisions remain poorly understood. This paper investigates the visual cues Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) use to segment blood vessels across two distinct imaging domains: fluorescence microscopy and retinal fundus photography. We employ a series of experiments to quantify the influence of shape, texture, and receptive field on segmentation performance. First, we isolate texture and intensity by evaluating performance on patches subjected to pixel shuffling and normalization. Second, we assess global shape relevance by training models on sparse contours and centerlines. Lastly, we quantify the required spatial context by systematically varying the network's theoretical and effective receptive fields. Within the scope of the evaluated datasets, we found that pixel intensity is more relevant than texture, though networks maintain surprisingly high accuracy even when both cues are removed. Furthermore, CNNs struggle to extrapolate full vessel geometry from shape cues alone, typically relying on a relatively small effective receptive field of around 20 pixels, though global context provides a modest benefit for fundus images. While specific to the modalities studied, this methodology offers a quantitative foundation to audit and refine deep learning systems in vascular imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究卷积神经网络（CNN）在血管分割中依赖的视觉线索，针对荧光显微镜和视网膜眼底图像两个领域。通过量化形状、纹理和感受野的影响，发现像素强度比纹理更重要，但即使移除两者网络仍保持高准确率；CNN难以从形状线索外推完整血管几何，有效感受野约为20像素，全局上下文对眼底图像有适度增益。
Motivation: 血管分割中模型决策依赖的具体视觉特征尚不清楚，论文旨在揭示CNN依赖的视觉线索（形状、纹理、感受野）以理解其行为。
Method: 使用三种实验：1）像素打乱和归一化隔离纹理与强度；2）稀疏轮廓和中心线评估全局形状相关性；3）改变理论/有效感受野量化所需空间上下文。在荧光显微镜和视网膜眼底图像上评估。
Result: 像素强度比纹理更相关，但移除两者后准确率仍高；CNN难以从形状线索外推完整血管；有效感受野约为20像素；全局上下文对眼底图像有适度帮助。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了量化基础来审计和改进血管成像中的深度学习系统，但结论限于所研究的成像模态。

papers.title: Bitcoin Price Direction Prediction via Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Fusion of Social Sentiment and Technical Features
papers.abstract_en: Bitcoin price prediction on sub-daily timescales is a hard open problem in computational finance. Bitcoin exhibits fat-tailed returns, non-stationary dynamics, and a price discovery process influenced by social discourse on Reddit and Twitter. Conventional approaches fuse OHLCV technical features with sentiment via static concatenation, applying identical fusion weights regardless of market state. This is inconsistent with the behavioural finance literature, which shows that retail sentiment is most predictive during volatile periods and noisy during calm ones. This paper proposes Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning (RAML), which conditions fusion of sentiment and price features on a dynamically detected binary market regime. Rolling 24-hour volatility partitions observations into stable and volatile regimes; a learnable sigmoid gate adjusts the weight of the sentiment embedding relative to the price embedding, trusting sentiment more during volatility and price dynamics more during stable phases. The system is evaluated on 3,491 hourly observations (July 2024-September 2025), combining Bitcoin OHLCV data with Reddit /r/Bitcoin FinBERT sentiment. Four models are compared - price-only BiLSTM, sentiment-only classifier, static-concatenation BiLSTM, and RAML - across 3-hour and 6-hour horizons, with an ablation study isolating the sentiment branch, regime detection, and adaptive fusion. RAML achieves macro-F1 of 0.5474 (3h) and 0.5513 (6h), with the highest AUC at 3 hours (0.5084), indicating better calibration. Ablation confirms every component is necessary, and replacing adaptive weighting with concatenation causes recall collapse at 6 hours (F1: 0.14). These results establish regime-conditioned adaptive fusion as a necessary design principle for multi-modal financial forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning (RAML)，根据市场状态动态融合社交媒体情绪和技术特征进行比特币价格方向预测。在3,491小时数据上评估，RAML在3小时和6小时预测窗口上达到macro-F1分别为0.5474和0.5513。消融实验表明每个组件都是必要的，自适应融合代替拼接导致6小时召回率崩溃。
Motivation: 现有方法对情绪和技术特征进行静态拼接，忽视了市场状态变化，与行为金融学证据不符（情绪在波动期预测性强，在平静期噪声大）。
Method: 提出RAML，使用滚动24小时波动率划分稳定和波动两种市场状态，通过可学习的Sigmoid门控动态调整情绪嵌入和价格嵌入的融合权重。
Result: 在3,491个每小时观测数据上，RAML在3小时和6小时预测达到macro-F1 0.5474和0.5513，3小时AUC 0.5084。消融证明所有组件必要，自适应融合替代拼接导致6小时F1降至0.14。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于市场状态的自适应融合是多模态金融预测的必要设计原则。

papers.title: Explaining BiomedCLIP with Weighted Banzhaf Interactions Supported by Tree-Gram Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are demonstrating significant capabilities in medical tasks like radiology analysis, yet providing faithful and interpretable explanations remains a key consideration for their responsible deployment in clinical settings. However, existing explanation methods, such as the widely used FIxLIP framework, often struggle with the fine-grained nature of modern tokenizers. The tokenization problem fragments clinical concepts---splitting terms like "saddle embolus" into scattered, meaningless subwords---which leads to noisy, semantically incoherent cross-modal attributions. Such fragmentation also results in a combinatorial explosion of interaction possibilities, obscuring the model's true reasoning. To address this, we introduce ParseFIxLIP, an extension that incorporates the Tree-Gram Parsing into the Banzhaf interaction game used by FIxLIP. This semantically informed strategy utilizes dependency parsing trees to define explanation players by grouping related text tokens into semantically coherent units. Our smart_depth grouping strategy, merging tokens according to spaCy token dependency tree, successfully mitigates concept fragmentation, yielding substantially more interpretable cross-modal interactions by unifying complex medical concepts. Quantitatively, while baselines struggled with the high dimensionality of long captions, our parsing approach maintained statistical robustness and semantic parsimony. Qualitative analysis on BiomedCLIP, validated on medical imagery (ROCOv2) and general examples, confirms that the approach accurately captures the synergistic influence of grouped words on model predictions. In conclusion, our work offers intuitive and clinically relevant insights into VLM decision-making, fulfilling the critical need for coherent explanations in the medical domain.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 13 figures. Accepted at EXPLIMED 2026 (Third Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence for the medical domain), IJCAI-ECAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ParseFIxLIP，通过将树语法解析（Tree-Gram Parsing）引入Banzhaf交互博弈，解决视觉语言模型在医学图像解释中的概念碎片化问题。方法利用依赖解析树对文本标记进行语义分组，生成更连贯的跨模态交互解释。在BiomedCLIP和ROCOv2数据集上的定性和定量分析表明，该方法在保持统计稳健性的同时，提供了更可解释的模型预测归因。
Motivation: 现有解释方法（如FIxLIP）因分词器细粒度导致临床概念碎片化（如“saddle embolus”被拆散），产生噪声且语义不连贯的跨模态归因，并且交互可能性组合爆炸，掩盖模型真实推理。
Method: 提出ParseFIxLIP，在FIxLIP的Banzhaf交互博弈中集成树语法解析：通过spaCy依赖解析树实现smart_depth分组策略，将相关文本标记合并为语义连贯的单元，从而缓解概念碎片化。
Result: 定量上，基于长标题的高维场景中，基线方法表现不佳，而解析方法保持统计稳健性和语义简洁性；定性上，在BiomedCLIP（ROCOv2医学影像及通用示例）上验证，准确捕捉了分组词对模型预测的协同影响。
Conclusion: 提供了直观且临床相关的VLM决策见解，满足医学领域对连贯解释的关键需求。

papers.title: Fair Division with Strictly Increasing Valuations: A Tight Threshold for Two-Agent EF1 and PO
papers.abstract_en: We study whether strictly positive marginal values restore the compatibility of envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) and Pareto optimality (PO) for indivisible goods. For two agents, we identify the exact threshold in the number of goods. Every instance with at most seven goods and strictly increasing valuations admits an allocation that is both EF1 and PO, without any submodularity assumption. In contrast, we construct an eight-good instance with normalized, integer-valued, strictly increasing, submodular valuations in which every EF1 allocation is strictly Pareto dominated. Thus, eight goods are necessary and sufficient for a two-agent counterexample. Finally, we strengthen the three-agent NP-hardness result of Chandramouleeswaran and Nimbhorkar (2026): deciding whether an EF1 and PO allocation exists remains NP-hard for normalized, integer-valued, monotone submodular valuations even when zero marginals are confined to eight fixed agent-good pairs, all involving a single agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究严格递增估值（strictly increasing valuations）下，不可分割物品的嫉妒自由（EF1）与帕累托最优（PO）的兼容性。对于两个智能体，确定了物品数量的精确阈值：最多七个物品时，总存在同时满足EF1和PO的分配；第八个物品时可构造反例。此外，强化了三个智能体的NP-hardness结果，即使零边际值仅出现在八个固定的智能体-物品对上。
Motivation: 现有反例通常依赖零边际值，而严格正边际值可能恢复EF1与PO的兼容性。本文旨在找出这种兼容性成立的确切边界。
Method: 通过构造与分析两个智能体场景下的分配，证明七个物品的充分性并给出八个物品的反例；对三个智能体，归约证明判定EF1+PO分配存在性仍为NP-hard。
Result: 两个智能体时，七个物品保证EF1+PO存在，八个物品时存在严格帕累托改进反例。三个智能体时，即使在归一化整值单调子模估值且零边际值严格受限的条件下，问题仍NP-hard。
Conclusion: 两个智能体的阈值是紧的（tight）；三个智能体的NP-hardness结果得到强化，表明即使零边际值极少，问题依然困难。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有反例通常依赖零边际值，而严格正边际值可能恢复EF1与PO的兼容性。本文旨在找出这种兼容性成立的确切边界。
summary_sections.method: 通过构造与分析两个智能体场景下的分配，证明七个物品的充分性并给出八个物品的反例；对三个智能体，归约证明判定EF1+PO分配存在性仍为NP-hard。

summary_sections.conclusion: 两个智能体的阈值是紧的（tight）；三个智能体的NP-hardness结果得到强化，表明即使零边际值极少，问题依然困难。

papers.title: Codebook Capacity Governs Perceptual Quality Across Resolutions in Hierarchical Discrete Video Compression
papers.abstract_en: Learned video codecs based on continuous latent representations typically require resolution-specific retraining or rate-distortion (RD) recalibration when scaling to new spatial resolutions, because entropy models and Lagrangian weights are tightly coupled to the operating point. We investigate whether hierarchical discrete latent codecs exhibit the same sensitivity. Using a controlled empirical study of MS-VQ-VAE video compression across codebook sizes $K \in \{128,256,512,1024\}$ and resolutions $64\times64$, $128\times128$, and $256\times256$ on UCF101, we show that perceptual quality (LPIPS) depends strongly on codebook capacity but only negligibly on spatial resolution. Fitting a log-linear model $Q(K,r) = α\log_2 K + β\log_2 r + γ$ to all 12 operating points yields $α=-0.0094$ ($t=-6.6$, $p<0.001$) and $β=-0.0009$ ($t=-0.43$, $p=0.68$, not significant), with $R^2=0.82$. Codebook capacity is therefore roughly $10\times$ more influential than spatial resolution per log-unit increase. In parallel, bottom-level entropy efficiency $η=H(z)/\log_2 K$ remains stable or improves with resolution (84-87% at $64\times64$; 92-94% at $256\times256$), confirming that larger spatial grids are utilized more efficiently rather than less. Across all resolutions and codebook sizes, our models outperform H.264 on LPIPS at matched or lower bitrate, with gains of 25-52% at $128\times128$ and 21-37% over H.265 at $256\times256$. These findings suggest that codebook size $K$, not spatial resolution, is the dominant design variable governing perceptual compression quality in hierarchical discrete video codecs -- a property that may simplify multi-resolution deployment and inform the design of scalable discrete tokenizers for generative video models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验研究层次离散视频压缩中码本容量与空间分辨率对感知质量的影响，发现码本容量是主导因素，而分辨率影响可忽略。在UCF101上，基于MS-VQ-VAE的模型在不同码本大小和分辨率下均优于H.264/H.265。
Motivation: 现有学习型视频编码器在扩展到新分辨率时需重新训练或调整率失真，研究者想探究层次离散潜在编码器是否同样敏感。
Method: 对MS-VQ-VAE视频压缩进行码本大小K∈{128,256,512,1024}和分辨率64×64、128×128、256×256的控制实验，拟合对数线性模型Q(K,r)=αlog₂K+βlog₂r+γ，并分析熵效率。
Result: 码本容量对感知质量（LPIPS）的影响约是空间分辨率的10倍（每对数单位增加），且分辨率效应不显著；分辨率提高时底层熵效率稳定或提升；模型在匹配或更低码率下LPIPS优于H.264（25-52%）和H.265（21-37%）。
Conclusion: 码本大小K是层次离散视频编码器中感知压缩质量的主导设计变量，可能简化多分辨率部署并指导生成式视频模型的离散分词器设计。

papers.title: On AI Safety and Security Technical Debt in Engineering AI-Enabled Systems
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, autonomous driving, finance, and education. While these systems offer powerful data-driven and adaptive capabilities, their complexity, rapid evolution, and dependence on dynamic data pipelines introduce new forms of engineering liability collectively referred to as AI Technical Debts (AITDs). AITDs arise from root causes spanning data governance, model implementation, algorithm design, architectural decisions, operational processes, documentation practices, and testing adequacy. Unlike conventional technical debt, many AITDs are latent and propagate across tightly coupled AI pipelines, leading to maintenance challenges, reliability degradation, and heightened safety or security risks. Guided by the principles of AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM), this study reinterprets technical debt through the interconnected dimensions of trustworthiness, focusing on AI safety and security technical debts. We conduct a systematic review of 60 primary studies and identify 31 distinct types of AITD, which are organized into a root-cause-oriented taxonomy comprising seven classes. The analysis examines how these debts map to 18 trust-related concerns, including 6 safety hazards and 12 security vulnerabilities. To support mitigation, the review synthesizes 34 actionable guidelines (8 safety and 26 security) targeting the prevention, detection, and reduction of AITDs across the AI lifecycle. Building on these findings, we introduce AITD-MAP, an integrated framework that connects the AITD taxonomy, quality and risk impacts, and mitigation strategies into a unified structure for risk-aware AI engineering. The framework aims to assist AI software engineers in making AI safety and security technical debts visible, understanding their root causes, and mitigating their presence.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables, submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对工程化 AI 系统中的安全与安全技术债务进行系统综述，基于 AI 信任、风险与安全管理（AI TRiSM）原则，从 60 篇主要研究中识别出 31 种 AI 技术债务（AITDs），归类为 7 类根因，并与 18 个信任问题（6 个安全危害、12 个安全漏洞）映射，提出 34 条缓解指南（8 条安全、26 条安全），并构建 AITD-MAP 框架以统一管理技术债务。
Motivation: AI 系统在高风险领域部署中，其复杂性、快速演进和数据管道依赖引入了新型工程负债（AI 技术债务），这些债务通常是潜伏的且在紧密耦合的 AI 管道中传播，导致维护困难、可靠性下降以及安全或安全风险增加。现有研究缺乏对 AI 安全与安全技术债务的系统性理解与缓解框架。
Method: 采用系统综述方法，分析 60 篇主要研究，基于 AI TRiSM 原则重新诠释技术债务，构建根因导向的 7 类 AITD 分类法，并将其映射到 18 个信任问题；进而合成 34 条可操作指南（8 条安全、26 条安全），并整合为 AITD-MAP 框架，连接分类法、质量风险影响与缓解策略。
Result: 识别出 31 种特定类型的 AI 技术债务，归为 7 类根因；发现这些债务与 18 个信任问题相关，包括 6 个安全危害和 12 个安全漏洞；提供了 34 条预防、检测和缓解 AITDs 的指南。
Conclusion: AITD-MAP 框架旨在帮助 AI 软件工程师可视化 AI 安全与安全技术债务，理解其根因并缓解其影响，从而支持风险感知的 AI 工程。

papers.title: On the Impossibility of Unbiased and Length-Invariant Policy Optimization with Outcome Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is the dominant reinforcement learning algorithm for training reasoning capabilities in large language models, notably adopted by DeepSeek-R1. The recent improvement Dr. GRPO (COLM 2025) identifies the response-level length bias caused by per-trajectory length normalization in GRPO and proposes removing this normalization, claiming the resulting optimizer is "unbiased." We show that this claim is incomplete. Specifically, we establish an impossibility theorem: under the standard outcome reward + GRPO setting, no length-based weighting scheme can simultaneously achieve the following two properties. (P1) Gradient unbiasedness: the gradient estimator is an unbiased estimate of the true policy gradient. (P2) Length invariance: each trajectory's effective contribution to the gradient is independent of its token length. GRPO approximately satisfies P2 but violates P1; Dr. GRPO satisfies P1 but violates P2. We characterize the complete tradeoff spectrum via the parametric family f_alpha(L) = L^{alpha - 1}, where alpha = 0 recovers GRPO, alpha = 1 recovers Dr. GRPO, and provide quantitative analysis showing that Dr. GRPO's length bias can cause longer trajectories to dominate gradient updates by a factor proportional to the length ratio. Our results reveal that neither algorithm is universally "done right"; they occupy opposite ends of a fundamental and unavoidable tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了在标准结果奖励+GRPO设置下，不存在一种基于长度的加权方案能同时实现梯度无偏和长度不变性。GRPO近似满足长度不变但违反无偏性，Dr. GRPO满足无偏但违反长度不变，两者处于不可调和的权衡两端。
Motivation: 现有GRPO及其改进Dr. GRPO在长度偏差问题上存在矛盾主张，缺乏理论统一认识，需要明确是否存在同时满足无偏和长度不变的优化器。
Method: 通过构造参数化族 f_α(L)=L^{α-1} 刻画权衡谱系，α=0对应GRPO，α=1对应Dr. GRPO，并给出定量分析。
Result: 证明不可能性定理：无偏性与长度不变性不可兼得；Dr. GRPO的长度偏差会导致长轨迹在梯度更新中占主导，影响与长度比成正比。
Conclusion: GRPO和Dr. GRPO并非“正确做法”，而是处于基本权衡的两端，算法设计必须根据具体任务在偏差和长度不变性间取舍。

papers.title: Hallucination Rates in Language Generation
papers.abstract_en: Language generation in the limit is an elegant model introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24] to formally study language generation by an algorithm that learns solely based on example strings. In this model, an algorithm is said to correctly generate from a language if it never makes an error after some finite time. In contrast, even sophisticated language models are known to regularly hallucinate in practice. In this paper, we initiate the study of language generation in the limit with (infinite) hallucination, i.e., the algorithm may generate incorrect strings infinitely often, but the errors occur at a limited rate (possibly even with 0-measure). We first show that hallucination, even at rate 0, makes generation in the limit strictly more powerful: there are language collections that cannot be generated with finite error but can be generated with infinite error, even when errors occur on a 0-measure set of time-steps. Furthermore, while all countable collections are generatable with finite error, we show a strict hierarchy of (uncountable) language collections characterized by the hallucination rate. This hierarchy extends to breadth, the fraction of the target language generated. While all countable collections can attain the optimal breadth of 1/2 [KW26b], we show strict separation at every breadth and hallucination rate. Finally, we study generation in the limit without repetition, where the algorithm may not repeat strings. This lets us compare the sets of correct and incorrect strings generated, rather than the fractions of correct and incorrect time-steps. Once again, we demonstrate a strict hierarchy at every hallucination rate and breadth. Taken together, these results reveal rich structure in language collections generatable in the limit with hallucination and establish hallucination rate as an important parameter in the theoretical study of language generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Kleinberg和Mullainathan提出的极限语言生成模型中引入无限幻觉（即算法可以无限次出错但错误发生速率受限）。作者证明即使错误出现在0测度的时间步上，允许幻觉也使生成能力严格强于有限错误情形；并且对于不可数语言集合，存在由幻觉率刻画的严格层级结构，该结构在生成广度（目标语言中被正确生成的比例）上也成立。此外，在不重复生成字符串的设置中，同样得到每个幻觉率和广度下的严格层级。这些结果揭示了含幻觉的极限语言生成中语言集合的丰富结构，并表明幻觉率是理论研究的重要参数。
Motivation: 现有语言模型在实践中频繁出现幻觉（hallucination），但缺乏对幻觉率的正式理论刻画；经典极限语言生成模型要求最终零错误，无法描述实际中可容忍有限率错误的情形。
Method: 在极限语言生成框架下定义带幻觉率的生成模型：算法可在无限时间步上无限次出错，但错误步数满足某种速率限制（如0测度或有界密度）。通过构造语言集合和归约论证，证明不同幻觉率和广度下的严格分离定理。
Result: 证明错误率0已使生成能力严格强于有限错误；所有可数语言集合可在有限错误下生成，但不可数集合按幻觉率形成严格层级结构；广度（目标语言生成比例）与幻觉率联合产生更细的层级，且在不重复生成设置中同样成立。
Conclusion: 摘要强调幻觉率是极限语言生成理论的关键参数，刻画了从有限错误到无限错误但速率受限的丰富层级，为语言模型幻觉的理论研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Exploration of the generative capabilities of Boltzmann machines applied to social systems under the majority rule
papers.abstract_en: We study the generative capabilities of Boltzmann machines to recover systems governed by the majority rule under critical conditions. To this end, we train deep belief networks (DBNs) with different configurations, where the first layer can use Gaussian visible units with more than two states (i.e., non-binary units). We then allow the DBN to "dream" samples conditioned on visible units that we keep fixed, and we measure the deviation of this dreamed system from the real one. We also corroborate, using a discrete thermometer based on a convolutional network, that the reconstructions remain in a critical state. Across several training sessions with different architectures, we show that, despite the complexity of the problem, the DBN can recover samples that remain critical even under input noise, with a gradual degradation of physical observables relative to the original sample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究玻尔兹曼机在多数规则下社会系统的生成能力。训练不同配置的深度信念网络（DBN），第一层使用非二进制高斯可见单元。让DBN在固定可见单元条件下“梦想”样本，并测量与真实系统的偏差。用卷积网络离散温度计确认重构处于临界状态。结果显示DBN能够恢复临界样本，即使在有输入噪声时，物理可观测量的退化也是渐进的。
Motivation: 探索玻尔兹曼机在模拟复杂社会系统（如多数规则下的临界行为）方面的生成能力，这是一个经典统计物理模型与机器学习交叉的问题。
Method: 训练深度信念网络（DBN），第一层采用高斯可见单元以支持多状态；通过条件生成（固定部分可见单元）使网络“梦想”样本，并利用卷积网络构建离散温度计来检验重构样本是否保持临界状态。
Result: 摘要报告，尽管问题复杂，DBN能够恢复保持临界性的样本，且在输入噪声下，物理观测量的退化是渐进的，即仍能保持部分临界特征。

papers.title: Logit-Coordinate Generative Models for Mixed Continuous-Categorical Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Mixed continuous--categorical data pose a representation problem for continuous generative models. Flow Matching and Gaussian diffusion operate in Euclidean spaces, whereas categorical laws lie on probability simplices and may be highly imbalanced. We study a logit-coordinate framework that encodes categorical variables as smoothed natural parameters and combines them with transformed numerical variables. This yields common formulations of Logit Flow Matching and Logit Diffusion. We introduce a mixed-distribution discrepancy separating categorical marginal error from conditional continuous Wasserstein error, and derive stability bounds and imbalance-aware nonparametric rates linking vector-field or drift error to decoded mixed-distribution error. Controlled simulations show that scaled-logit coordinates improve or match one-hot coordinates, especially under severe rare-cell imbalance. Across four real-data benchmarks and ten splits per dataset, Logit FM improves the primary distributional metrics on three datasets and is comparable on Churn2; Block-Conditional Logit FM consistently improves the flat model; and Logit Diffusion generally improves over or matches One-Hot Diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合连续-分类表格数据的生成问题，提出了logit坐标框架，将分类变量编码为平滑的自然参数并与变换后的数值变量结合，统一了Logit Flow Matching和Logit Diffusion。引入了混合分布差异，分离了分类边际误差和条件连续Wasserstein误差，并推导了稳定性边界和考虑不平衡的非参数速率。实验表明，缩放logit坐标在严重稀有不平衡下优于或匹配one-hot坐标；在四个真实数据基准上，Logit FM改善了三数据集的分布指标，Logit Diffusion总体上优于或匹配One-Hot Diffusion。
Motivation: 混合连续-分类数据的生成模型中，连续生成模型（如Flow Matching和高斯扩散）在欧几里得空间操作，而分类变量位于概率单纯形上且可能高度不平衡，现有表示方法存在挑战。
Method: 提出logit坐标框架：将分类变量通过平滑的自然参数编码，与变换后的数值变量结合，形成Logit Flow Matching和Logit Diffusion的通用公式。引入混合分布差异（分离分类边际误差和条件连续Wasserstein误差），并推导稳定性边界和不平衡感知的非参数速率。
Result: 在严重稀有不平衡的模拟中，缩放logit坐标改善或匹配one-hot坐标。在四个真实数据基准的十个划分上，Logit Flow Matching改进了三个数据集的分布指标，与Churn2持平；Block-Conditional Logit FM一致改进平面模型；Logit Diffusion总体上优于或匹配One-Hot Diffusion。
Conclusion: logit坐标框架为混合连续-分类表格数据生成提供了有效且稳定的方法，特别在分类高度不平衡时表现出优势。

papers.title: Trainable Nonexpansive Denoisers for Contractive Image Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Trainable denoisers with Lipschitz control have become central to convergent image reconstruction. However, training neural networks that simultaneously offer strong denoising performance and global Lipschitz guarantees is challenging. Existing approaches enforce Lipschitz control only empirically, providing no guarantees beyond the training data. In this work, we show that by exploiting the action of permutations on the image lattice, we can constrain a neural architecture that is globally nonexpansive (Lipschitz bound $\leqslant 1$). We integrate the proposed denoiser with forward imaging operators to develop a reconstruction mechanism that is provably contractive and therefore globally convergent. Experiments on standard inverse problems, such as superresolution and deblurring, demonstrate that our reconstruction performance is competitive with softly constrained baselines while providing Lipschitz guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可训练的非扩张去噪器，通过排列操作约束神经网络全局非扩张（Lipschitz界≤1），并将其与前向成像算子结合，构建可证明压缩的图像重建机制。实验在超分辨率和去模糊等逆问题上与软约束基线竞争，同时提供Lipschitz保证。
Motivation: 现有具有Lipschitz控制的训练去噪器在强去噪性能和全局Lipschitz保证之间存在矛盾，且现有方法仅在训练数据上提供经验性控制，缺乏全局保证。
Method: 利用图像网格上排列的作用来约束神经网络架构，使其全局非扩张（Lipschitz界≤1），然后与成像算子集成形成压缩重建机制，保证全局收敛。
Result: 在超分辨率和去模糊等标准逆问题上的实验表明，重建性能与软约束基线相当，同时提供了Lipschitz保证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的去噪器具有可证明的压缩性，从而实现全局收敛的重建，且性能有竞争力。

papers.title: SPRKD: Effective Knowledge Distillation for Deep Neural Networks via Saddle Region Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep neural networks are potent catalysts for scientific and industrial impact, yet excessive parameter counts impede deployment in low-compute settings such as hospital equipment and energy infrastructure. Predominant knowledge distillation (KD) methods favor replication: smaller students mimic teacher output logits, yet empirically yield low task performance, hamper convergence, and act merely as regularization rather than substantive knowledge transfer. We propose Saddle Point Recruitment for Knowledge Distillation (SPRKD), reframing distillation from replication to employing teachers as optimization-curvature and domain proxies, characterizing saddle points as regions of strong further-descent potential via embedding and basin-fractal properties. Using Hessian eigenvalue spectral density (ESD), SPRKD identifies low-loss saddle regions for student re-exploration; weak-teacher ensembles are aggregated into an Approximated Saddle Region (ASR), re-parameterized into the student via Transfer Learning by Injection, and approached with exponentially decaying Euclidean transformations, Negative Hessian Eigensteps, and Gaussian perturbations. On malaria blood smear classification with a 6,430-parameter CNN distilled from a weak 25,546-parameter teacher, SPRKD reaches 94.8% validation accuracy, outperforming Response KD by 24.70 percentage points (McNemar p = 6.3e-87) and matching scratch-trained baselines of the same architecture to statistical equivalence (p = 1.0). Across MNIST, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet, SPRKD exceeds scratch-trained baselines by up to 8 percentage points on preliminary benchmarks. Hessian ESD and 2-D loss landscape analysis show convergence to wider minima with substantially smaller Hessian trace and spectral radius than Response KD and control students, indicating smoother descent and greater noise robustness.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/thetechdude124/SADDLE-POINT-RECRUITMENT-FOR-KNOWLEDGE-DISTILLATION. Awarded 2nd Place in Mathematical and Cybersecurity Research (NSA) at Regeneron ISEF 2023 and an Outstanding Research Award at WAICY (World AI Competition for Youth) 2022
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出鞍点招募知识蒸馏（SPRKD），将知识蒸馏从复制教师输出重新定义为利用教师作为优化曲率和领域代理，通过Hessian特征值谱密度识别低损失鞍区供学生重新探索。在疟疾血涂片分类任务中，SPRKD以6,430参数的CNN从25,546参数的教师蒸馏，达到94.8%验证准确率，比响应KD高24.70个百分点，并在MNIST、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet上超过从头训练的基线。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法倾向于复制教师logits，但实际性能低、收敛慢，仅作为正则化而非实质性知识迁移。
Method: SPRKD利用Hessian特征值谱密度（ESD）识别低损失鞍区，通过弱教师集成聚合为近似鞍区（ASR），再通过注入式迁移学习重新参数化到学生中，并采用指数衰减欧几里得变换、负Hessian特征步长和高斯扰动进行优化。
Result: 在疟疾血涂片分类上，SPRKD达94.8%验证准确率，优于响应KD 24.70个百分点（McNemar p=6.3e-87），与相同架构从头训练基线统计等价（p=1.0）。在MNIST、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet上，SPRKD超过从头训练基线最多8个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SPRKD通过重新定义蒸馏为鞍点探索，利用教师提供优化曲率信息，使学生收敛到更宽、更鲁棒的最小值，且无需大型教师。

papers.title: BERT-based Models vs. Large Language Models for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition: A Comparative Study on Marathi
papers.abstract_en: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for low-resource languages such as Marathi remains a challenging task due to limited annotated resources and linguistic complexity. Although recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, their effectiveness for language-specific NER in low-resource settings remains uncertain. In this study, we fine-tune MahaBERT-v2 on different variants of the MahaNER dataset and systematically compare the performance of these models with an existing MahaNER baseline and prominent general-purpose LLMs, including Gemini, LLaMA-3.3-70B, and Gemma models. All models are evaluated on a Marathi NER test dataset using standard metrics of precision, recall, and F1-score. The experimental results show that the fine-tuned MahaBERT-based models consistently outperform both the baseline and all evaluated LLMs, with the fine-tuned models achieving F1-scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.91, surpassing the existing MahaNER model (0.8843) and significantly exceeding the performance of LLM-based approaches, whose F1-scores range from 0.57 to 0.69. These findings demonstrate that task-specific, language-focused models trained on domain-relevant data remain more effective than general-purpose LLMs for Marathi NER, highlighting the continued importance of specialized architectures for low-resource language processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低资源语言马拉地语的命名实体识别（NER）任务，系统比较了微调的MahaBERT-v2模型与通用大语言模型（Gemini、LLaMA-3.3-70B、Gemma）的性能。实验结果表明，微调的MahaBERT模型在F1分数（0.88-0.91）上显著优于现有的MahaNER基线（0.8843）和所有评估的LLM（0.57-0.69）。作者认为，任务特定的语言模型在低资源语言NER中仍比通用大语言模型更有效。
Motivation: 低资源语言（如马拉地语）的NER因标注数据稀缺和语言复杂性而面临挑战，通用大语言模型在语言特定NER任务中的有效性尚不确定。
Method: 微调MahaBERT-v2在MahaNER数据集的不同变体上，并与MahaNER基线及Gemini、LLaMA-3.3-70B、Gemma等LLM进行比较，使用精确率、召回率和F1分数进行评价。
Result: 微调MahaBERT模型F1分数范围为0.88-0.91，超过基线模型（0.8843），而LLM的F1分数仅0.57-0.69。
Conclusion: 任务特定、语言聚焦的模型仍比通用大语言模型更有效，凸显了专用架构在低资源语言处理中的重要性。

papers.title: Patient-Agnostic Synthetic Pretraining for Efficient Patient-Specific Intraoperative 2D/3D Registration
papers.abstract_en: Intraoperative 2D/3D registration aligns preoperative CT volumes with intraoperative X-ray or fluoroscopic images and is essential for image-guided interventions. Recent learning-based and differentiable registration methods have shown promising accuracy, especially in patient-specific settings where abundant digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) can be synthesized from the target CT. However, training a separate patient-specific model from scratch for every new patient is computationally inefficient and limits practical deployment. In this work, we propose an efficient patient-specific 2D/3D registration framework based on patient-agnostic synthetic pretraining and spherical similarity learning. The model is first pretrained on synthetic DRRs generated from multiple CT volumes to learn transferable pose-sensitive representations, and is then adapted to a new patient using only a limited number of synthetic projections from the target CT. To improve synthetic-to-real robustness without requiring anatomical labels, we introduce a segmentation-free domain randomization strategy that perturbs image intensity, projection physics, field-of-view, occlusion, and fluoroscopic artifacts. The adapted model provides an initial pose estimate, which is further refined using spherical similarity learning and differentiable Levenberg-Marquardt optimization. Experiments on multiple anatomical datasets evaluate whether patient-agnostic synthetic pretraining can improve the efficiency of patient-specific registration, with particular focus on the trade-off between adaptation cost and registration accuracy. The results demonstrate that patient-agnostic synthetic pretraining can significantly reduce patient-specific training requirements while preserving accurate intraoperative 2D/3D registration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种患者无关的合成预训练框架，用于高效的患者特异性术中2D/3D配准。该方法先在多个CT体积生成的合成DRR上预训练模型以学习可迁移的位姿敏感表示，再通过少量目标CT的合成投影进行适配，引入无分割的域随机化策略增强鲁棒性，并采用球面相似性学习和可微Levenberg-Marquardt优化进行精炼。实验表明该框架能显著降低患者特异性训练成本，同时保持配准精度。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的患者特异性2D/3D配准方法对每个新患者都需从头训练，计算效率低，限制了临床部署。
Method: 采用患者无关的合成预训练（在多个CT的合成DRR上学习位姿敏感表示），结合无分割的域随机化（扰动强度、投影物理、视场、遮挡和荧光伪影），再通过少量目标CT投影适配，最后用球面相似性学习和可微Levenberg-Marquardt优化细化初始位姿。
Result: 实验表明，患者无关的合成预训练可显著减少患者特异性训练需求，同时保持术中2D/3D配准的准确性。

papers.title: Stabilizing Deep Reconstruction Operators with Contractive Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained deep denoisers can be used to solve a wide range of model-based image reconstruction tasks via Plug-and-Play (PnP) and Regularization-by-Denoising (RED) algorithms, without retraining per task. These denoisers are trained only for single-step denoising. Using them as Image Reconstruction (IR) regularizers in an iterative process can destabilize reconstruction. A common failure mode is the peak-and-collapse behaviour: metrics such as PSNR improve for early iterations and then abruptly degrade, making these algorithms unreliable in practice. We propose a data-driven stabilization framework that (i) formalizes this instability of any IR operator through a local quantity and (ii) prevents collapse by regularizing this quantity adaptively, requiring no retraining or modification of the given pretrained network. Our key idea is to control the potentially unstable IR operator with a contractive operator whose stable iterates act as an anchor and prevent collapse. We further introduce an efficient family of trainable contractive operators that serve as strong anchors while remaining lightweight. Extensive experiments across proximal algorithms, denoiser architectures, noise levels, and imaging tasks show consistent, collapse-free performance and improved reliability of PnP and RED reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对Plug-and-Play (PnP)和Regularization-by-Denoising (RED)等迭代图像重建算法中常见的“峰值-崩溃”不稳定性问题，提出一种数据驱动的稳定化框架。通过定义局部不稳定性量，并引入可训练的收缩算子作为锚点，无需重新训练预训练网络即可防止迭代崩溃。实验表明该方法在多种算法、去噪器架构和成像任务上实现了稳定的重建性能。
Motivation: PnP和RED等算法虽能利用预训练去噪器解决多种图像重建任务，但迭代过程中常出现先改善后突然恶化的“峰值-崩溃”行为，导致算法不可靠。现有工作缺乏对不稳定性的形式化描述和通用解决方案。
Method: 提出稳定化框架，其核心思想是通过一个收缩算子（contractive operator）的稳定迭代作为锚点来控制不稳定的重建算子。具体而言，定义局部不稳定性量并自适应地正则化该量；同时设计了一类高效且可训练的收缩算子作为强锚点，保持轻量级。
Result: 大量实验涵盖多种近端算法、去噪器架构、噪声水平和成像任务，结果表明所提方法实现了无崩溃的性能提升，显著提高了PnP和RED重建的可靠性和稳定性。
Conclusion: 该工作为深度重建算子的不稳定性提供了形式化描述和有效解决方案，无需修改预训练网络即可通用地稳定迭代重建过程，使PnP/RED算法更适用于实际应用。

papers.title: Does Graph Compression Preserve Signal Propagation?
papers.abstract_en: Graph compression reduces the computational cost of graph learning, but its effect on signal propagation remains largely underexplored. Existing work evaluates compression through downstream task performance or structural preservation, neither of which directly captures how propagation dynamics change after compression. We study two fundamental compression paradigms, coarsening and sparsification, and ask whether they preserve the propagation behavior of the original graph. Across five datasets, varying compression rates, and propagation depths, we measure signal behavior through three complementary metrics. Our results reveal a consistent tension between the two compression families. Sparsification retains higher signal diversity and mitigates oversmoothing, but its propagation trajectory progressively diverges from that of the original graph. Coarsening more faithfully preserves propagation behavior, but at the cost of stronger smoothing and rank collapse. These findings demonstrate that two propagation-centric objectives, preserving signal diversity and preserving propagation fidelity, are distinct and empirically at odds under graph compression, highlighting the need for evaluation protocols that jointly consider both dimensions. The code and results are available at: https://github.com/KawshikBanerjee/Compression-Propagation-Duality
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了图压缩（粗化和稀疏化）对信号传播的影响。通过五个数据集和不同压缩率与传播深度的实验，发现稀疏化保持信号多样性、缓解过平滑，但传播轨迹偏离原图；粗化更忠实保留传播行为，但导致更强平滑和秩坍缩。结果表明信号多样性保持和传播保真度是两个对立的目标。
Motivation: 现有图压缩评估主要基于下游任务性能或结构保持，未能直接反映压缩后传播动力学的变化，因此需要系统研究压缩对信号传播的影响。
Method: 采用粗化（coarsening）和稀疏化（sparsification）两种压缩范式，在五个数据集上以不同压缩率和传播深度，通过三种互补指标测量信号行为。
Result: 稀疏化保留更高信号多样性并缓解过平滑，但其传播轨迹逐渐偏离原图；粗化更忠实保留传播行为，但以更强的平滑和秩坍缩为代价。两种传播目标（多样性保持与保真度）在压缩下存在冲突。
Conclusion: 图压缩需要同时考虑信号多样性保持和传播保真度，现有评估协议仅关注单一方面，需改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Neural operator discovery from heterogeneous trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators provide data-driven mappings for modeling dynamical systems. Extending them to families of systems typically requires explicit conditioning variables such as physical parameters, geometries, or boundary conditions. In many real-world settings, these quantities are unobserved. Here, we formulate neural operator discovery (NOD) as the problem of learning both shared solution operators and system-specific variation directly from heterogeneous trajectories without access to labeled governing factors. We introduce a factorized latent-conditioning formulation that jointly learns a neural operator and a low-dimensional latent representation through factorized prediction, trajectory-decoupled sampling, and dimension selection. Across diverse systems, the learned latent representation captures the intrinsic dimensionality of system variation and organizes system instances in a smooth and approximately invertible latent structure aligned with the underlying governing factors. This organization enables generalization to previously unseen system instances, including zero-shot extrapolation across regimes and stable long-horizon prediction. These results establish an interpretable paradigm for operator learning in the absence of explicit factor supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经算子发现（NOD）问题，即从异质轨迹中同时学习共享解算子和系统特定变化，无需知道显式的控制因子。采用因子化潜在条件化（factorized latent-conditioning formulation）方法，联合学习神经算子和低维潜在表示，通过因子化预测、轨迹解耦采样和维度选择实现。在多个系统上，学到的潜在表示捕捉了系统变化的内在维度，并组织了系统实例的平滑、近似可逆的潜在结构，实现了对未见系统实例的泛化，包括零样本外推和稳定长时预测。
Motivation: 现有神经算子通常需要显式的条件变量（如物理参数、几何、边界条件）来泛化到不同系统，但在现实场景中这些量往往不可观测。因此需要一种方法，直接从异质轨迹中学习共享算子和系统特定变化。
Method: 提出因子化潜在条件化方法，联合学习神经算子和低维潜在表示。包括因子化预测（factorized prediction）、轨迹解耦采样（trajectory-decoupled sampling）和维度选择（dimension selection）。
Result: 在多个系统上，学到的潜在表示捕捉了系统变化的内在维度，并组织成平滑、近似可逆的潜在结构，与底层控制因子对齐。实现了对未见系统实例的泛化，包括零样本外推和稳定长时预测。
Conclusion: 该方法为无显式因子监督的算子学习建立了可解释范式。

papers.title: The Gate Always Closes: On Injecting Auxiliary Signals into Frozen Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Auxiliary signal pathways in VLMs are routinely fitted with learnable gates so the optimiser can decide how much of the signal to admit. We find that the optimiser almost always decides on zero: across five injection designs, every gated pathway becomes behaviourally closed, with accuracy invariant to ablating the pathway at inference even when the gate parameter would nominally pass 30-45% of the signal. We attribute this suppression phenomenon to two regimes, a dead-gradient regime formalised through the caption-invariance of image-derived signals, and a negative-utility regime in which the auxiliary signal actively hurts the loss. Rather than fight suppression, we exploit it: we regularise LoRA fine-tuning with geometric auxiliary losses from hyperbolic visual relational graphs (IoA-driven entailment cones and angular repulsion on the Lorentz manifold), coupled only through the forward pass at training time and dropped at inference. Disaggregating GQA by question type exposes a clean dissociation. Three configurations without geometric losses at inference lose 2.85-3.39pp on relational questions while gaining ~1pp on attribute questions; a fourth that trains with the losses but infers through a soft prompt loses 5.14pp on rel for only +0.23pp on attr, so training-time regularisation alone does not protect relational accuracy without a geometric inference pathway. Configurations that keep the geometric pathway at inference preserve vanilla-level relational accuracy and match the attribute gain. Out of distribution on VSR, the RMS-prefix recipe preserves the spatial signal; stripping the geometric losses (G2) collapses VSR by 4.6pp, isolating them as the OOD source. A secondary result: embedding-norm alignment is necessary for generation-safe prefix injection, and learnable gates should be replaced with fixed, non-optional injection at matched scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）中辅助信号通路即使带有可学习门控，优化器几乎总是将其关闭（门控为零），导致通路在推理时无效。作者不抵抗这一抑制现象，而是利用其进行正则化：在LoRA微调中加入来自双曲视觉关系图的几何辅助损失（IoA驱动的蕴含锥和洛伦兹流形上的角度排斥），仅在训练时通过前向传播耦合，推理时丢弃。在GQA上按问题类型分解显示，无几何损失的配置在关系问题上下降2.85-3.39百分点，在属性问题上提升约1百分点；而保留几何推理通路的配置保持原始关系准确率并匹配属性提升。在VSR分布外测试中，去除几何损失导致性能下降4.6百分点，表明其是分布外泛化的来源。次要结果是：嵌入范数对齐对安全的前缀注入是必要的，可学习门控应替换为固定非可选的比例匹配注入。
Motivation: 以往VLM中辅助信号通路常使用可学习门控，但门控机制的有效性未被深入探讨。本文发现门控几乎总是关闭，导致信号通路无效；作者旨在利用这一抑制现象进行有益正则化，而非与之对抗。
Method: 在LoRA微调中引入双曲视觉关系图的几何辅助损失：包括IoA驱动的蕴含锥（entailment cones）和洛伦兹流形上的角度排斥（angular repulsion）。这些损失仅在训练时通过前向传播加入，推理时丢弃。同时发现嵌入范数对齐对安全的前缀注入至关重要，并建议用固定非可选的比例匹配注入替代可学习门控。
Result: 在GQA上，无几何损失的配置在关系问题上损失2.85-3.39pp，属性问题提升约1pp；几何损失保留的配置保持关系准确率并提升属性。在VSR分布外测试中，去除几何损失导致性能下降4.6pp。
Conclusion: 本文强调VLM中辅助信号的可学习门控几乎总是关闭，但可通过训练时加入几何损失而不在推理时使用来正则化模型，从而在保持关系推理能力的同时提升属性问题准确性。分布外泛化实验表明几何损失是空间信号的关键来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training with (Swap) Regret Loss in a Single-Layer Self-Attention Model: A Case Study on the Probability Simplex
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the regret loss framework introduced in Park et al. (2025), which uses decision-theoretic regret as a direct loss function for training models to make better decisions, through the lens of probability-simplex policies. Our first result shows that a single-layer self-attention model trained with regret loss admits a stationary point whose forward-pass exactly matches smoothed fictitious play with the appropriate stepsize that ensures no-regret behavior-i.e., for any given policy input, the model outputs the same update that smoothed fictitious play would produce. In parallel, we also newly introduce a swap-regret loss function, which extends the regret-loss framework beyond external regret and enables models to directly optimize for swap-deviation robustness. We further show that this swap-regret loss admits a stationary point whose forward pass implements the corresponding swap-regret update induced by classical Blum-Mansour no-pass implementation algorithm, with each head implementing an external-regret update via smoothed fictitious play. Together, these results show that regret-trained attention can realize differentiable mechanisms whose deployment induces equilibrium behavior in games: external-regret dynamics lead to coarse correlated equilibrium, while swap-regret dynamics lead to correlated equilibrium. Thus, regret-based objectives steer minimal attention architectures toward online-learning dynamics with game-theoretic guarantees, without supervised traces of those algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Park等人(2025)提出的遗憾损失框架，将其应用于概率单纯形策略上的单层自注意力模型训练。第一个结果表明，用遗憾损失训练的单层自注意力模型存在一个稳定点，其前向传播恰好匹配平滑虚拟博弈的更新规则，且保证无遗憾行为。同时，论文新提出交换遗憾损失，使模型能直接优化对抗交换偏差的鲁棒性，并且该损失存在一个稳定点，其前向传播实现Blum-Mansour算法诱导的交换遗憾更新，每个注意力头通过平滑虚拟博弈实现外部遗憾更新。这些结果证明，基于遗憾的目标可以引导简单注意力架构产生博弈论均衡行为：外部遗憾动态导致粗相关均衡，交换遗憾动态导致相关均衡。
Motivation: 现有遗憾损失框架尚未在概率单纯形策略上深入分析，且缺乏对交换遗憾的直接优化方法。论文旨在填补这一空白，通过单层自注意力模型展示遗憾损失的博弈论解释与均衡保证。
Method: 理论分析：证明单层自注意力模型在外部遗憾损失下的稳定点等价于平滑虚拟博弈更新；提出交换遗憾损失函数，并证明其稳定点实现Blum-Mansour算法中每个头的外部遗憾更新。
Result: 理论上证明了基于外部遗憾和交换遗憾训练的自注意力模型前向传播分别对应平滑虚拟博弈和Blum-Mansour算法，从而在博弈中实现粗相关均衡和相关均衡。
Conclusion: 基于遗憾的目标可以赋予最小注意力架构在线学习动态，并具备博弈论均衡保证，无需监督学习这些算法轨迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AlloBench: Measuring Online Tool Allocation Capability in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Creating a reusable tool is an investment: an agent pays a fixed cost now in exchange for the potential of future reuse. Therefore, a user should prefer an agent that creates a small number of highly reusable tools, rather than many one-offs. We introduce a paired benchmark that tests whether LLM agents exhibit conscious allocation behavior under a fixed budget in two contexts: an abstract text-based formulation and a code-construction task. We find that every frontier model we test---Claude Haiku, Claude Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, and GPT-5.6 Sol---acts near-optimally in the abstract framing but fails to transfer this ability to script-writing. Through further experiments, we identify the particular failure modes for each model. Notably, the first three models fail even when the scripts are not evaluated, while GPT-5.6 Sol stays selective under that weaker manipulation and collapses only at full construction. Furthermore, an open-source Qwen model policy-trained for abstract allocation generalizes this ability across held-out lexical variations, but sees no improvement at script allocation. Together, these results establish online tool allocation as a significant capability boundary, even for modern frontier models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个成对基准测试，评估LLM智能体在固定预算下是否表现出有意识的在线工具分配行为，即在抽象文本任务和代码编写任务中的表现。实验发现所有前沿模型在抽象框架中表现接近最优，但无法将能力迁移到脚本编写任务，且不同模型有不同的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在创建可重用工具时，往往倾向于创建大量一次性工具而非少量高重用性工具，缺乏有效的在线分配能力，这成为一个重要的能力边界。
Method: 设计了一个成对基准测试，包含抽象文本任务和代码编写任务，测试智能体在固定预算下的工具分配行为，并分析了未评估脚本和完全构建脚本条件下的模型表现。
Result: Claude Haiku、Claude Opus、GPT-5.4-mini和GPT-5.6 Sol在抽象任务中接近最优，但脚本编写任务中表现不佳；前三者在脚本未评估时即失败，而GPT-5.6 Sol仅在完全构建时崩溃；开源模型Qwen通过策略训练可泛化抽象分配能力，但脚本分配无改善。
Conclusion: 在线工具分配是现有前沿模型显著的能力边界，即使在抽象框架下表现优异，也无法迁移到实际代码构建任务中。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ESF-Bench: Benchmarking Challenging Slot-Filling Scenarios for Real-World Enterprise Applications
papers.abstract_en: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) has driven transformative adoption across enterprises. However, deploying these models in real-world settings presents unique challenges due to complex system constraints and unexpected user behaviors. Among these applications, slot filling is essential for converting unstructured input into structured, actionable data. In this work, we introduce ESF-Bench, a challenging Enterprise Slot Filling benchmark consisting of 810 multi-turn samples and 6530 slots over 8 unique domains. Curated using a taxonomy of the 57 most challenging slot-filling scenarios observed during real-world enterprise deployments, ESF-Bench exposes notable limitations in current state-of-the-art LLMs, with GPT-OSS-120b low successfully extracting slots for only 20.7% of benchmark samples. To support continued research in this area, we publicly release the benchmark dataset, taxonomy, and accompanying evaluation code on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ESF-Bench是一个针对企业级槽填充任务的基准，包含810个多轮样本和6530个槽，覆盖8个领域，基于57种从真实企业部署中观察到的具有挑战性的场景。评估表明，当前最强的LLM（GPT-OSS-120b）仅成功提取了20.7%的样本，揭示了现有模型在复杂企业场景中的显著局限性。
Motivation: 尽管LLM在企业中广泛应用，但在处理复杂系统约束和意外用户行为时存在独特挑战。槽填充作为将非结构化输入转换为结构化数据的关键任务，缺乏针对真实企业困难场景的基准。
Method: 基于57种真实企业部署中观察到的困难场景分类，构建了ESF-Bench基准，包含810个多轮样本和6530个槽，覆盖8个领域。
Result: 在GPT-OSS-120b上，仅有20.7%的样本能够成功提取所有槽，表明当前SOTA LLM在企业级槽填充任务中的表现不足。
Conclusion: 公开发布基准数据集、分类和评估代码，以促进该领域的进一步研究。

papers.title: IKS-Instruct: A 24,000-Example Multilingual Dataset for Teaching Language Models Indian Knowledge Systems
papers.abstract_en: Instruction tuning has become the standard method for adapting large language models to follow human intent, yet existing instruction datasets are dominated by English-language general-knowledge tasks and lack coverage of specialized pedagogical domains. This paper presents IKS-Instruct, a dataset of 24,795 instruction-response pairs for teaching language models to deliver educational content grounded in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS). The dataset spans seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam), covers 41 pedagogical techniques from the Vedic oral and mathematical traditions, and is aligned with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum for classes 6 through 12. The pairs are derived from six source types: classical text corpora (Bhagavad Gita, Thirukkural, Sangam literature, Vedic texts), curriculum-aligned pedagogical templates, Vedic mathematical sutra demonstrations, bilingual instruction pairs, technique-grounded multi-turn dialogues, and cross-tradition comparative analyses. Quality is assessed through a multi-judge evaluation framework in which independent language models score responses on 12 dimensions including technique fidelity, pedagogical quality, factual accuracy, and IKS cultural depth. Under a uniform five-judge external panel (median aggregation over 1,201 stratified items), the strongest IKS-Instruct fine-tune of a compact 7B model reaches a median judge score of 6.39, within 0.15 of a strong general-purpose reference model (Nemotron-Nano at 6.54) at a fraction of its deployment cost, while the base model without IKS fine-tuning scores near zero on the IKS-specific dimensions. Model quality does not increase monotonically with data curation, a result we report together with the corresponding data-quality gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍IKS-Instruct，一个包含24,795条指令-响应对的多语言数据集，用于教授语言模型印度知识系统（IKS）的教育内容。数据集涵盖7种语言、41种教学技巧，并基于CBSE课程。质量评估使用多裁判框架，在12个维度上评分。微调后的7B模型达到接近强通用参考模型的分数。
Motivation: 现有指令数据集以英语通用知识为主，缺乏专业教学领域覆盖，特别是印度知识系统。
Method: 构建IKS-Instruct数据集，从六种来源生成：经典文本语料、课程对齐教学模板、吠陀数学公式演示、双语指令对、基于技巧的多轮对话、跨传统比较分析。使用多裁判评估框架，独立语言模型在12个维度上评分。
Result: 在均匀五裁判评估中，微调后的7B模型达到中位数评分6.39，与通用参考模型Nemotron-Nano的6.54相差0.15，而基模型在IKS特定维度上接近零。
Conclusion: 论文报告模型质量并不随数据整理单调增加，同时报告了相应的数据质量增益。

papers.title: A Reference-Free Framework for Evaluating Single-Frame ISP Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating camera image signal processing (ISP) pipelines requires measuring low-level artifacts introduced by operations such as denoising, demosaicing, tone mapping, and compression. Blind image quality assessment (IQA) techniques can grade visual quality without a reference, but they typically focus on semantic and high-level visual cues or human perceptual scores rather than the low-level image-processing artifacts introduced by camera pipelines. In contrast, full-reference metrics such as PSNR and SSIM measure pixel-level differences and structural similarity, while LPIPS measures perceptual similarity in deep feature space. However, these metrics require perfectly aligned image pairs, which are difficult to collect in practical settings. We propose a reference-free learning framework that estimates full-reference image quality metrics from a processed sRGB image and its ISO metadata. Our method predicts a proxy sRGB reference, which is then compared with the processed image to compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS in their standard full-reference form. Our experiments show that the proxy-reference model can be learned from synthetic data and applied to real camera data. We further show that lightweight LoRA fine-tuning enables efficient adaptation when ISP components or pipeline configurations are changed. The proposed method outperforms direct metric regression in estimating metric values and achieves higher agreement with full-reference rankings than conventional blind IQA methods. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reference-free estimation of full-reference metrics for practical camera-pipeline evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无参考框架，用于评估单帧图像信号处理（ISP）管道。该框架从处理后的sRGB图像及其ISO元数据中预测一个代理参考图像，并基于此计算PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS等全参考指标。实验表明，代理参考模型可从合成数据学习并泛化到真实相机数据，且通过轻量级LoRA微调可高效适应ISP组件变化。该方法在指标估计和排序一致性上优于直接回归和传统无参考IQA方法。
Motivation: 现有全参考指标需要完美对齐的图像对，实际中难以获取；无参考IQA方法多关注高层语义，无法精细捕获ISP引入的低层伪影。因此，需要一种无需参考图像、又能测量低层伪影的评估方法。
Method: 提出一个无参考学习框架：输入处理后的sRGB图像和ISO元数据，预测一个代理参考图像，然后与处理图像计算标准全参考指标（PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS）。模型在合成数据上训练，并通过LoRA微调适应不同ISP配置。
Result: 代理参考模型能从合成数据泛化到真实相机数据；轻量级LoRA微调有效适配ISP变化；该方法在估计指标值上优于直接回归，与全参考排序的一致性高于传统无参考IQA方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明无参考估计全参考指标用于实际相机管道评估的可行性，为ISP评估提供了一种实用方案。

papers.title: BHARATI: Morphology-Aware Tokenizers for Classical Indian Languages with Subword Fertility Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Standard subword tokenization algorithms such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) and SentencePiece are trained predominantly on modern language corpora and produce inefficient segmentations when applied to classical Indian languages. Sanskrit, Tamil, and other classical Indic languages exhibit agglutinative morphology, productive sandhi (phonological fusion at word boundaries), and domain-specific vocabularies absent from general-purpose training data. This paper presents BHARATI, a set of SentencePiece BPE tokenizers trained on a balanced 781 MB corpus spanning seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam) with native script support for all languages. We describe three successive tokenizer versions: v1 (English and Sanskrit only, with broken byte-fallback for Tamil), v2 (four-language support with byte-level fallback for southern languages), and v3 (full seven-language native subword coverage). Subword fertility analysis demonstrates that v3 averages 2.6 tokens per Indian Knowledge System (IKS) technical term, compared to 5.25 tokens per term with GPT-2's tokenizer and 3.75 tokens with the multilingual SentencePiece baseline, with the largest gains on a set of reserved IKS terms that are represented as single tokens by construction. On a held-out test set of 490 IKS-domain sentences (70 per language across seven languages, released with the measurement script), v3 reduces sequence length by roughly 90% relative to GPT-2 and byte-level encoding (which lack native Indic subwords) and by approximately 25% relative to the mBART-50 multilingual baseline, averaged across the six Indic languages, directly translating to increased effective context length for downstream language models. The tokenizer models (32,000 vocabulary), training scripts, and evaluation benchmarks are released under open licenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对古典印度语言（如梵语、泰米尔语）的黏着形态和音韵融合等特点，提出了一套基于SentencePiece BPE的分词器BHARATI，覆盖英语、印地语、梵语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语和马拉雅拉姆语七种语言。通过逐步改进版本，最终v3实现了原生子词覆盖，并在印度知识系统术语上平均每词2.6个token，显著低于GPT-2的5.25个token。在保留测试集上，v3将序列长度比GPT-2缩短约90%，比mBART-50多语言基线缩短约25%。
Motivation: 标准子词分词算法（如BPE、SentencePiece）主要在现代表语言语料上训练，对古典印度语言效率低下，因为这类语言具有黏着形态、音韵融合以及通用数据中缺失的领域特定词汇。
Method: 构建了三个逐步改进的SentencePiece BPE分词器版本：v1仅支持英语和梵语，对泰米尔语采用字节回退；v2支持四种语言，对南部语言使用字节级回退；v3实现七种语言的原生子词覆盖，词汇量32,000。
Result: v3在印度知识系统技术术语上平均每词2.6个token（GPT-2为5.25，多语言SentencePiece基线为3.75）。在490句保留测试集上，v3相对于GPT-2和字节级编码将序列长度减少约90%，相对于mBART-50基线减少约25%。
Conclusion: 专门为古典印度语言设计的分词器能大幅提升下游语言模型的有效上下文长度，且模型、训练脚本和评估基准均已开放。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ordered Network Analysis of Epistemic Emotions during Collaborative Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Investigating how affective states such as confusion and frustration persist and transition during co-situated collaborative problem solving (CPS) is important for understanding the dynamics of epistemic emotions. However, the accurate identification of affective states remain challenging as there is no gold-standard truth in this space. Here, we analyze affective states collected through retrospective cued-recall during an in-person CPS task. Using ordered network analysis (ONA), we examine (1) the overall ordered structure of affective states and how this structure differs across self-caught and probe-caught reporting methods, and (2) what aspects of this ordered structure are emphasized differently in slower and faster groups. We find that ONA reveals differences in persistence and transition patterns that are not apparent from descriptive summaries alone. In particular, we observe a stable epistemic core linking curiosity, optimism, and confusion, with different reporting methods emphasizing different connections among states. An analysis between faster and slower groups show that roles of confusion and disengagement also shift significantly during collaboration, particularly in their relationship to conflict. We interpret our findings in the context of collaboration and discuss their implications in developing AI systems that support CPS.
papers.journal_ref: In Artificial Intelligence in Education. AIED 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science(), vol 16584. Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用有序网络分析（ONA）研究协作问题解决（CPS）中认知情绪（如困惑、挫败）的持续与转换模式。通过分析面对面CPS任务中回顾性线索回忆收集的情绪数据，发现ONA能揭示描述性摘要无法显示的持久性与转换差异。研究识别出一个稳定的认知核心（好奇心、乐观、困惑），并发现不同报告方法（自我捕获 vs. 探针捕获）及任务完成速度（快组 vs. 慢组）会显著影响情绪连接模式，尤其是困惑与解离在协作中与冲突的关系。
Motivation: 理解协作问题解决中情绪状态的动态变化对构建支持性AI系统至关重要，但情绪识别缺乏黄金标准，且现有描述性分析难以捕捉细微的转换模式。
Method: 采用有序网络分析（ONA）对面对面CPS任务中通过回顾性线索回忆收集的情绪数据进行建模，比较自我捕获和探针捕获两种报告方法，并分析快慢组之间的差异。
Result: ONA揭示了稳定的认知核心（好奇心、乐观、困惑）。不同报告方法强调不同的状态连接；快慢组在困惑、解离与冲突的关系上存在显著差异。
Conclusion: ONA能提供比描述性摘要更丰富的情绪动态洞察，这些发现对开发支持CPS的AI系统具有启示意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Fair Division with Budget Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study an online variant of discrete fair division under generalized assignment budget constraints. Goods arrive one at a time and must be assigned irrevocably to a feasible agent or to charity, which holds all unallocated goods, while fairness is evaluated only against budget-feasible subsets of every recipient's bundle. We first show that, without additional structure, no deterministic online algorithm can guarantee any fixed approximation to feasible envy-freeness, even in highly symmetric instances. We then identify bounded density spread as a structural condition that restores meaningful guarantees, obtaining approximation algorithms for arbitrary item sizes and showing that, under common valuations and sufficiently small goods, these guarantees can be strengthened to an optimal deterministic frontier. We further study resource augmentation, where the online algorithm is allowed slightly larger budgets than the fairness benchmark, and characterize the resulting improvement in the achievable guarantees. Finally, we develop a learning-augmented framework based on predicting joint value-size types, proving consistency under perfect predictions, robustness to prediction error, and showing that separate predictions of value and size marginals are insufficient to recover strong fairness guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线离散公平分配问题，在广义分配预算约束下，物品逐个到达必须立即分配，公平性基于每个接收者的预算可行子集进行评估。作者证明无额外结构时任何确定性在线算法都无法保证近似无嫉妒性，进而提出有界密度分散条件可恢复有意义保证，并研究了资源增强和学习增强框架。
Motivation: 在线公平分配中引入预算约束后，发现无额外结构时无法保证任何公平性近似，因此需要识别能恢复保证的结构性条件。
Method: 定义有界密度分散条件并推导近似算法；考虑资源增强（允许算法稍大预算）；设计基于预测联合价值-大小类型的学习增强框架。
Result: 无结构时任何确定性在线算法无法保证近似无嫉妒；有界密度分散条件下可获得近似算法，小物品时达最优确定性前沿；资源增强可改善保证；学习增强在完美预测下一致，对误差鲁棒，但单独预测边际不足以恢复强公平保证。
Conclusion: 有界密度分散是恢复在线公平分配保证的关键结构，资源增强和学习增强能进一步提升效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-Adaptive Inference: A Unified Statistical and Foundation-Model View
papers.abstract_en: Modern predictive systems are expected to adapt their behavior to the specific situation they are facing. A clinical model should not treat every patient the same; a retrieval-augmented model should change its answer when given different evidence; a mixture-of-experts model should route different inputs to different experts. We call this capability context-adaptive inference: before predicting, the system uses information about the current context to specialize its parameters or computation for that instance. This article provides a unified view of context-adaptive inference across three traditions that are usually treated separately: (i) explicit adaptation in statistics (e.g. varying-coefficient models, local regression, hierarchical sharing), (ii) rapid task-specific adaptation in meta-learning and transfer, and (iii) implicit adaptation in large foundation models via prompting, retrieval, and expert routing. We formalize these approaches under a common objective: to map context $c$ to adapted parameters $θ(c)$, then to predict via $f(x; θ(c))$. Under squared loss, linear prediction heads, and fixed features, we prove that explicit parameter adaptation and implicit routing are mathematically equivalent to kernel ridge regression on joint features of inputs and context. Building on this bridge, we propose practical design principles and evaluation metrics including adaptation-efficiency, routing stability, and context-specific robustness to guide when to specialize, how to constrain that specialization, and how to audit context-adaptive models in deployment. Finally, we identify open problems in identifiability, robustness under distribution shift, and efficient large-scale adaptation, outlining design principles for methods that are scalable, reliable, and transparent in real-world settings.
papers.comment: 90 pages, 13 figures. Manuscript source and living version: https://github.com/AdaptInfer/context-review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本综述统一了三种通常被分开处理的上下文自适应推理方法：统计学中的显式适应（变系数模型、局部回归）、元学习与迁移中的快速任务适应、以及基础模型中的隐式适应（提示、检索、专家路由）。在平方损失、线性预测头和固定特征下，证明显式参数适应与隐式路由在数学上等价于对输入和上下文的联合特征进行核岭回归。基于此桥梁，提出了适应效率、路由稳定性和上下文特定鲁棒性等设计原则与评估指标，并指出可解释性、分布偏移鲁棒性等开放问题。
Motivation: 现有的上下文自适应推断方法在统计学、元学习和基础模型中通常被分别研究，缺乏统一的理论框架来理解其共性和差异，难以为实际应用提供通用指导。
Method: 形式化统一目标：从上下文c映射到适应参数θ(c)，再通过f(x; θ(c))预测。在平方损失、线性预测头和固定特征下，证明显式适应与隐式路由等价于对联合特征的核岭回归，并据此推导出设计原则与评估指标。
Result: 证明显式参数适应与隐式路由在平方损失、线性预测头和固定特征下等价于联合特征的核岭回归；提出适应效率、路由稳定性、上下文特定鲁棒性等新评估指标。
Conclusion: 统一视角有助于设计可扩展、可靠且透明的上下文自适应系统，但可识别性、分布偏移鲁棒性和大规模高效适应仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FILLER: Feature Imputation via Latent Location Exploration and Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: In real-world machine learning applications, incomplete observations create a fundamental challenge. Researchers have come up with several ideas to address this crucial problem. However, current models still face challenges in balancing scalability and structural consistency. This study proposes a feature imputation method, called FILLER, that deliberately searches the two-dimensional latent space produced by a generative model and fills the missing values with appropriate entries. The generative model is trained on fully observed data to generate samples from the latent space, and FILLER uses this trained model to impute the values missing in the corrupted test samples. In this study, G-NeuroDAVIS serves the purpose of the generative model. This work also presents a mathematical proof on the convergence of the iterative search. Finally, FILLER has been evaluated on several image datasets under random and structured missingness patterns with varying levels of imputation complexities. In order to justify the efficacy of FILLER, it has been compared against existing state-of-the-art solution strategies in terms of RMSE, PSNR, and SSIM. In addition, Wilcoxon signed-rank test has been carried out to validate statistical significance. Moreover, downstream analyses (classification and clustering) have also established the quality of imputation in terms of standard metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种特征插补方法FILLER，通过在生成模型G-NeuroDAVIS的二维潜在空间中迭代搜索合适位置来填充缺失值。该方法在多个图像数据集上评估，在随机和结构化缺失模式下，RMSE、PSNR、SSIM等指标优于现有方法，并通过统计检验和下游任务验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现实应用中的不完整观测数据带来挑战，现有方法在可扩展性和结构一致性之间难以平衡。
Method: FILLER利用生成模型G-NeuroDAVIS在完整数据上训练，然后对测试样本的缺失值，在潜在空间中进行迭代搜索找到最佳位置，生成完整样本来填充缺失值，同时提供了收敛性数学证明。
Result: 在多个图像数据集上，针对随机和结构化缺失，FILLER在RMSE、PSNR、SSIM上优于现有方法，Wilcoxon符号秩检验验证统计显著性，下游分类和聚类任务也证明了插补质量。
Conclusion: 潜在空间搜索是一种有效的特征插补策略，为处理缺失数据提供了新思路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PathRIR: Physics-Guided Acoustic Path Selection and Late-Tail Compensation for Fast Room Impulse Response Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Image-source-method (ISM)-based room impulse response (RIR) simulation is a useful and physically interpretable tool for acoustic scene modeling, but full-order ISM becomes computationally expensive as the reflection order and room complexity increase. We propose a physics-guided framework for fast RIR simulation that preserves the geometric structure of ISM while learning to retain only acoustically important image-source paths during online traversal. To recover energy removed by pruning, the proposed PathRIR uses a lightweight compensation multilayer perceptron to predict the missing late-tail energy envelope and generate a compensation tail whose energy follows that envelope. Experiments on irregular 3D rooms show that PathRIR reduces image-source computation and improves runtime efficiency over a full-order ISM simulator, while achieving low waveform- and decay-related errors. Ablation results show that adding the compensation tail improves waveform fidelity and reduces energy-decay-curve error, reverberation-time error, and direct-to-reverberant-ratio error, with modest runtime overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 19th International Workshop on Acoustic Signal Enhancement (IWAENC 2026). Project page: https://github.com/ShaoHenry/PathRIR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理引导的快速房间冲激响应（RIR）模拟框架 PathRIR，通过保留图像源方法（ISM）的几何结构，在线遍历时仅选择声学重要的路径，并用轻量级补偿多层感知机预测并补偿被剪枝路径的能量包络。在不规则3D房间实验中，PathRIR相比全阶ISM减少了计算量并提高了运行效率，同时保持了较低的波形和衰减相关误差。
Motivation: 基于图像源方法的RIR模拟在反射阶数和房间复杂度增加时计算开销大，需要快速且保持物理可解释性的替代方案。
Method: 提出物理引导的路径选择策略，在线遍历时仅保留声学重要的图像源路径；使用轻量级补偿多层感知机预测被剪枝路径的晚期尾部能量包络，并生成跟随该包络的补偿尾部。
Result: 实验表明，PathRIR减少了图像源计算量并提升了运行效率，同时实现了较低的波形误差和衰减相关误差；消融实验显示添加补偿尾部改善了波形保真度，并降低了能量衰减曲线误差、混响时间误差和直达混响比误差，且运行时开销适中。
Conclusion: PathRIR通过物理引导的路径选择和尾部补偿，在保持RIR模拟精度的同时显著提升计算效率，适用于不规则三维房间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: An Effective Physical Adversarial Patch Attack against Visual-Infrared Fused Face Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based visual-infrared fused face detection models are increasingly deployed across a wide range of applications, yet they remain susceptible to adversarial patch attacks. Most prior attacks target either the visual or the infrared image alone in the digital domain, which renders them ineffective against fused models in the physical world. Moreover, many of these methods are readily noticeable, as their patch patterns deviate substantially from those seen in the real world. In this paper, we introduce VIPatch (Visual-Infrared Patch), a novel physical adversarial patch attack that produces inconspicuous, realistic, and natural-looking patches for facial images. Specifically, VIPatch crafts a gradient-color mask together with a band-aid sticker across both the visual and infrared images, and jointly optimizes these two elements; the resulting digital patches further guide the fabrication of their physical counterparts. Experimental results show that VIPatch achieves competitive attack success rates (over 90%) in both the digital and physical domains, while keeping the patches unobtrusive to human observers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VIPatch，一种针对视觉-红外融合人脸检测模型的物理对抗补丁攻击方法。通过联合优化梯度色掩码和创可贴贴纸，生成在视觉和红外图像上均自然且隐蔽的对抗补丁。实验表明，该方法在数字和物理域均达到超过90%的攻击成功率，且补丁对人类观察者不显眼。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击大多针对单模态或数字域，对物理世界中的视觉-红外融合模型无效，且生成的补丁不自然易被发现。
Method: 提出VIPatch方法，设计梯度色掩码和创可贴贴纸两种元素，在视觉和红外图像上联合优化，并将数字补丁转化为物理补丁。
Result: 在数字和物理域均取得超过90%的攻击成功率，补丁外观自然，不易被人类察觉。
Conclusion: 该方法能够生成在物理世界中有效的隐蔽对抗补丁，对视觉-红外融合人脸检测模型构成威胁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RareLens: Towards End-to-End Rare Disease Care via Aligning Divergent Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Rare diseases collectively affect an estimated 3.5% to 5.9% of the population, yet more than 70% of patients are misdiagnosed and many endure years of evaluation before a diagnosis is reached, because early presentations are nonspecific and relevant expertise is scarce and unevenly distributed. Artificial intelligence could provide support, but existing systems address isolated stages of care, overwhelmingly diagnosis. They typically depend on the results of downstream investigations, and they treat the variability between models as noise to be eliminated. Here we present RareLens, a system that supports clinical decision-making across the entire rare disease trajectory by exploiting this variability. When heterogeneous large language models evaluate the same case, they generate divergent but complementary reasoning, which RareLens aligns and calibrates into a single convergent, actionable decision at each stage. Four coordinated modules perform primary-visit risk screening, diagnosis, treatment planning and prognosis. Developed and evaluated on RareBench, a real-world dataset of 157,525 cases spanning all 33 Orphanet categories and more than 7,000 conditions, RareLens outperformed every frontier model tested, including GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1, Claude-3.7-Sonnet and Gemini-2.5-Pro, at each stage. It achieved an area under the curve of 0.917 for screening and top-1 accuracies of 65.5% and 89.8% for diagnosis and treatment. In an external study spanning 1,287 cases and 23 physicians, autonomous RareLens and physicians assisted by RareLens both substantially outperformed unaided physicians. These findings indicate that aligning divergent model reasoning, rather than scaling a single model, offers a generalizable strategy for high-uncertainty clinical decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RareLens，一个覆盖罕见病全病程的临床决策支持系统。它利用不同大语言模型（LLM）对同一病例产生的分歧推理，通过对齐与校准将其转化为统一的决策。系统包含初诊风险筛查、诊断、治疗计划和预后四个模块，在覆盖33个Orphanet类别、7000余种疾病的157,525例真实数据集RareBench上，各阶段均超越GPT-5等前沿模型，筛查AUC达0.917，诊断和治疗的top-1准确率分别为65.5%和89.8%。外部研究显示，自主RareLens及RareLens辅助的医生均显著优于无辅助医生。
Motivation: 罕见病误诊率高、专科医生分布不均，现有AI系统仅覆盖诊疗的孤立阶段（主要是诊断），且依赖下游检查结果，并将模型间的差异性视为噪声予以消除。
Method: RareLens通过四个协调模块实现全病程支持：初诊风险筛查、诊断、治疗计划和预后。核心思路是利用多个异质LLM对同一病例产生分歧但互补的推理，再将其对齐并校准为单一、收敛的决策。
Result: 在RareBench数据集上，RareLens在筛查阶段AUC达0.917，诊断top-1准确率65.5%，治疗top-1准确率89.8%，各阶段均超越GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Claude-3.7-Sonnet和Gemini-2.5-Pro。外部研究（1,287例，23名医生）中，自主RareLens和RareLens辅助的医生均大幅优于无辅助医生。
Conclusion: 对齐多种模型的发散推理，而非扩大单一模型规模，为高不确定性临床决策提供了一种可推广的策略。

papers.title: Continuous surrogates versus threshold Boolean networks for modeling Arabidopsis ISR gene regulation
papers.abstract_en: Gene regulatory network modeling often requires balancing predictive accuracy and mechanistic interpretability. In this work, we compare continuous surrogate models and a discrete mechanistic model on the same \textit{Arabidopsis thaliana} induced systemic resistance (ISR) dataset, using both the raw continuous gene-expression measurements and their sign-binarized representation. The study considers eight defense-related genes measured over nine time points and evaluates two continuous predictors, Random Forest (RF) regression and a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), against a threshold Boolean network (TBN). The models are assessed using rolling-origin one-step prediction, recursive multi-step rollout, and interpretability analysis. RF achieved the best average one-step numerical performance in the continuous domain, with an MAE of 1.910 and an RMSE of 2.836, compared with 2.089 and 3.106 for the MLP. In the binary domain, the TBN obtained the best average one-step qualitative performance, with a binary accuracy of 0.550 and a Hamming distance of 3.600, compared with 0.500 and 4.000 for RF, and 0.495 and 4.040 for the MLP. In recursive rollout, the TBN exactly reproduced the observed binarized trajectory, while the MLP also showed near-perfect fidelity, with a trajectory binary accuracy of 0.986, and RF accumulated substantially larger deviation, with a trajectory binary accuracy of 0.708. These results highlight that local numerical accuracy and global qualitative dynamical fidelity are not necessarily aligned, and suggest that continuous surrogates and threshold Boolean networks should be viewed as complementary tools for modeling biological regulation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在拟南芥诱导系统抗性(ISR)基因调控数据集上比较了连续替代模型（随机森林RF和多层感知器MLP）与阈值布尔网络(TBN)。RF在连续域一步预测中MAE为1.910，MLP为2.089；在二值域中TBN的一步预测准确率0.550优于RF的0.500和MLP的0.495。递归展开时TBN完美复现二值轨迹，MLP近于完美（准确率0.986），RF偏差较大（0.708）。结果表明局部数值精度与全局定性动力学保真度不一定一致，两类模型应视为互补工具。
Motivation: 基因调控网络建模需平衡预测准确性与机制可解释性，但连续模型与离散机理模型的比较尚不充分，尤其在同一数据集上。
Method: 使用原始连续基因表达测量及其符号二值化表示，分别训练RF回归、MLP和TBN，并通过滚动原点一步预测、递归多步展开和可解释性分析进行评估。
Result: RF在连续域一步预测中MAE=1.910、RMSE=2.836优于MLP；TBN在二值域一步预测中准确率0.550、汉明距离3.600优于RF和MLP；递归展开中TBN精确复现二值轨迹，MLP准确率0.986，RF仅0.708。
Conclusion: 局部数值精度与全局定性动力学保真度不一定一致，连续替代模型与阈值布尔网络应视为互补工具，适用于不同建模目标。
