papers.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
papers.abstract_en: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning technique for predicting time-series data. The quantization of the response signal from the reservoir is required for the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have been reported to investigate the effect of bit quantization and sampling frequency. In this study, we introduce a concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the amplitude of node states in the reservoir and output weights. We evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and energy consumption per sample. We achieve significant reduction of energy consumption by optimizing the number of quantization bits, the sampling frequency, and the injection current of the semiconductor laser, while maintaining the prediction performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了基于半导体激光器的近似储层计算（approximate reservoir computing）概念，通过量化储层节点状态和输出权重的幅度，优化量化位数、采样频率和注入电流，在混沌时间序列预测任务中显著降低了每样本能耗，同时保持了预测性能。
Motivation: 光子储层计算中需要量化响应信号，但目前对位量化和采样频率如何影响性能和能耗的研究很少，需要系统优化。
Method: 引入近似储层计算，对半导体激光器储层中的节点状态和输出权重进行量化，并联合优化量化位数、采样频率和激光器注入电流。
Result: 在混沌时间序列预测任务中，通过优化参数实现了每样本能耗的显著降低，同时预测性能得以维持。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了通过近似计算可以有效降低光子储层计算的能耗，为节能物理机器学习提供了新途径。

papers.title: Learning Asymptotics with Convergence-Rate Guarantees using Linear Least Squares
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new research area that is called Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT) and combines optimization with asymptotic analysis. In particular, ALT provides a unified approach for computing unknown constants/parameters in proven asymptotic expansions using optimization theory. In this paper, we focus on a general asymptotic form which includes a broad class of asymptotics. Furthermore, we study two powerful numerical methods, namely, sliding Linear Least Squares (sLLSQ) and sliding Tikhonov Linear Least Squares (sT-LLSQ). For these techniques we rigorously prove asymptotic estimates that lead to sufficient conditions for convergence (to the correct values of unknown parameters) and convergence-rate guarantees. Despite their strengths, both methods have also limitations, e.g., slow convergence---or even, counterintuitively, divergence---in some cases. Moreover, we present fundamental applications in analytic combinatorics, a beautiful field of mathematics that deals with asymptotic enumeration of discrete structures using complex analysis. The proposed techniques complement existing approaches, such as the ratio method and its variants. Numerical examples also verify the theoretical results. Finally, we discuss interesting research directions in ALT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出渐近学习理论（Asymptotics Learning Theory, ALT），将优化与渐近分析结合，用于从已知渐近展开中自动计算未知常数。重点研究了滑动线性最小二乘（sLLSQ）和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘（sT-LLSQ）两种方法，严格证明了收敛条件和收敛速率保证，并指出在某些情况下存在收敛慢甚至发散的问题。在解析组合学中展示了应用，数值实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有渐近分析方法通常依赖手动计算未知常数，缺乏系统化的自动求解框架。ALT旨在提供一个统一的优化理论，自动且可靠地估计渐近展开中的参数。
Method: 提出滑动线性最小二乘（sLLSQ）和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘（sT-LLSQ），通过滑动窗口和正则化技术改进传统最小二乘，从渐近数据中估计参数。
Result: 严格证明了sLLSQ和sT-LLSQ的收敛充分条件和收敛速率上界，数值例子验证了理论，但指出在特定设置下可能出现慢收敛甚至发散。
Conclusion: ALT为渐近计算提供了新范式，补充了比率方法等传统工具，但当前方法在收敛速度和稳定性上仍有局限，未来可探索更优的优化策略。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出渐近学习理论（Asymptotics Learning Theory, ALT），将优化与渐近分析结合，用于从已知渐近展开中自动计算未知常数。重点研究了滑动线性最小二乘（sLLSQ）和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘（sT-LLSQ）两种方法，严格证明了收敛条件和收敛速率保证，并指出在某些情况下存在收敛慢甚至发散的问题。在解析组合学中展示了应用，数值实验验证了理论结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有渐近分析方法通常依赖手动计算未知常数，缺乏系统化的自动求解框架。ALT旨在提供一个统一的优化理论，自动且可靠地估计渐近展开中的参数。
summary_sections.method: 提出滑动线性最小二乘（sLLSQ）和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘（sT-LLSQ），通过滑动窗口和正则化技术改进传统最小二乘，从渐近数据中估计参数。
summary_sections.result: 严格证明了sLLSQ和sT-LLSQ的收敛充分条件和收敛速率上界，数值例子验证了理论，但指出在特定设置下可能出现慢收敛甚至发散。
summary_sections.conclusion: ALT为渐近计算提供了新范式，补充了比率方法等传统工具，但当前方法在收敛速度和稳定性上仍有局限，未来可探索更优的优化策略。

papers.title: TopoFE: topology-aware LLM-guided Automated Feature Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Automatic feature engineering (AutoFE) for tabular learning can be naturally formulated as a program synthesis problem, where the objective is to discover predictive feature transformations from an exponentially large search space. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded the expressiveness of AutoFE by enabling feature program generation beyond predefined operator libraries. However, existing LLM-based approaches remain fundamentally limited by stateless generation and homogeneous search: feature proposals are produced from static prompts without accumulating search experience, while single-population exploration quickly converges to dominant transformation patterns and rarely discovers complementary feature compositions across transformation families. We propose TOPOFE, a topology-aware multi-island evolutionary framework for LLM-guided feature engineering. TOPOFE combines family-specialized exploration, adaptive prompt memory, and topology-guided knowledge transfer to efficiently discover diverse and compositional feature programs. Experiments on 29 public tabular datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art AutoFE methods across classification and regression tasks. Beyond predictive performance, TOPOFE discovers more diverse and transferable feature programs that generalize across multiple downstream predictors and LLM backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TOPOFE，一个拓扑感知的多岛屿进化框架，用于大语言模型引导的自动特征工程。该方法通过族专化探索、自适应提示记忆和拓扑引导知识转移，在29个表格数据集上优于现有方法，并发现更多样化、可迁移的特征程序。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动特征工程方法受限于无状态生成和同质搜索，无法积累搜索经验，且单种群探索易收敛到主导变换模式，难以发现互补特征组合。
Method: TOPOFE结合了族专化探索（family-specialized exploration）、自适应提示记忆（adaptive prompt memory）和拓扑引导知识转移（topology-guided knowledge transfer），在多个岛屿（island）上并行进化特征程序。
Result: 在29个公开表格数据集上，TOPOFE在分类和回归任务中一致优于最先进的自动特征工程方法，并发现更多样化、可迁移的特征程序。
Conclusion: TOPOFE通过拓扑感知的多岛屿进化框架，提升了LLM引导特征工程的多样性和迁移性，但主要聚焦于表格数据，未涉及其他模态。

papers.title: Photonic reservoir computing with complex networks
papers.abstract_en: Photonic reservoir computing has attracted increasing attention as a fast and low-cost approach for time-series prediction. Photonic reservoir computing utilizes the high speed, broad bandwidth, and spatial parallelism of light. However, the effect of the internal connection structure (network topology) on the computing performance has not been investigated for large-scale photonic reservoirs. In this study, we experimentally and numerically demonstrate photonic reservoir computing using a spatial light modulator to systematically evaluate the relationship between the network topology and the performance of reservoir computing. We introduce complex network structures such as small-world and scale-free network topologies of the internal nodes in the reservoir. We perform the memory capacity measurement and the one-step-ahead prediction task of the chaotic time series to compare the performance. We found that the small-world network exhibits the maximum memory capacity and the best prediction performance. Our numerical calculations reveal that the performance of the time-series prediction can be optimized by changing the rewiring probability of the network and the leak rate of the reservoir. We also implement photonic human brain network as a reservoir, which is designed by the connectomes of human brain activities. We found that the network topology strongly affects the performance of reservoir computing, and the small-world network structure outperforms the other configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验和数值方法研究了光子储层计算中网络拓扑对性能的影响。利用空间光调制器构建大规模光子储层，系统比较了小世界、无标度等复杂网络结构，发现小世界网络在记忆容量和混沌时间序列预测上表现最佳。数值计算表明，通过调节重连概率和泄漏率可以优化预测性能。
Motivation: 大规模光子储层计算中，内部连接结构（网络拓扑）对计算性能的影响尚未被系统研究。
Method: 使用空间光调制器构建光子储层计算系统，引入小世界、无标度等复杂网络拓扑，通过记忆容量测量和混沌时间序列一步预测任务评估性能。
Result: 小世界网络实现了最大记忆容量和最佳预测性能；数值计算表明可通过改变重连概率和泄漏率优化预测性能；基于人脑连接组的储层实验也证实网络拓扑强烈影响性能。
Conclusion: 网络拓扑对储层计算性能有显著影响，小世界网络结构优于其他配置。

papers.title: StageGuard: Physiologically Constrained Sleep Staging
papers.abstract_en: Automated sleep staging is increasingly used in large-scale studies to derive sleep-architecture endpoints: total sleep time, REM latency, sleep efficiency, and bout-duration statistics. Deep learning models achieve epoch-level accuracy approaching inter-rater agreement, yet often produce hypnograms that violate physiological invariants, such as rare transitions (e.g., direct Wake -> REM) or excessively fragmented sequences. Such violations can bias downstream sleep metrics, regardless of overall accuracy. We propose StageGuard, a plug-and-play, backbone-agnostic structured-inference framework that wraps any neural sleep-staging backbone with physiology-informed priors. StageGuard combines (1) a differentiable soft transition penalty that discourages physiologically rare transitions during training, and (2) a semi-Markov constrained decoder with a duration-augmented state space that jointly enforces transition penalties and minimum bout durations at inference. Unlike hard-prohibition methods, it admits rare transitions when emission evidence is overwhelming, leaving informative pathological events recoverable rather than blocked. StageGuard constrains staging outputs to satisfy known physiological priors rather than modeling sleep generatively. We quantify the validity gap using transition-violation rate (TVR) and fragmentation index (FI) and demonstrate that, across six backbones and four datasets, StageGuard reduces TVR to physiologically plausible levels and lowers FI by 56-62%, while maintaining or slightly improving classification accuracy. Crucially, improved constraint satisfaction translates into 59-79% lower error on derived sleep-architecture statistics not directly optimized by the method, and recovers the direction and effect size of expert-defined subgroup differences (OSA severity, age) more faithfully than the unconstrained baseline.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StageGuard，一个即插即用的生理约束框架，用于睡眠分期。它通过可微分的软过渡惩罚和半马尔可夫约束解码器，在训练和推理中联合施加生理先验，减少不符合规律的分期序列。在六个骨干网络和四个数据集上，StageGuard 将过渡违规率降至生理合理水平，碎片化指数降低 56-62%，同时维持或略提升分类准确率，并显著降低下游睡眠指标误差（59-79%），更忠实地恢复专家定义的亚组差异。
Motivation: 自动睡眠分期模型虽精度高，但常产生违反生理规律的 hypnogram（如罕见 Wake->REM 过渡或过度碎片化），导致下游睡眠指标偏差。现有方法缺乏有效的生理约束。
Method: StageGuard 结合 (1) 可微分的软过渡惩罚，在训练时抑制生理罕见过渡；(2) 半马尔可夫约束解码器，在推理时联合施加过渡惩罚和最小时长约束，采用时长增强状态空间，允许在证据充分时保留罕见过渡，而非硬性禁止。
Result: 跨六个骨干网络和四个数据集，StageGuard 将过渡违规率降至生理合理水平，碎片化指数降低 56-62%，分类准确率维持或略升；下游睡眠指标误差降低 59-79%，更忠实地恢复专家定义的 OSA 严重程度和年龄亚组差异。
Conclusion: 通过软约束而非硬禁止，StageGuard 在保持模型诊断价值的同时确保生理有效性，并显著改善睡眠指标推导。

papers.title: Statistically Supported LLM Ingredient and Recipe Data Collection in Computational Nutrition
papers.abstract_en: Computational nutrition needs precise ingredient data, but current databases are incomplete, inconsistent, and built for human reference rather than automated reasoning. LLMs could help fill these gaps, but single-pass outputs are unreliable and can introduce silent errors into downstream computation. We present a quality-controlled LLM pipeline for ingredient data acquisition that combines robust statistical estimation, domain-specific invariant checks, and a web-fetch fallback. An illustrative Heap's Law fit to 233 recipes suggests that unique-ingredient growth is sub-linear and front-loaded: the projected ratio of unique ingredients to recipes falls from 1.74 at 100 recipes to 0.19 at 5,000. For each ingredient attribute, repeated LLM queries are treated as samples from a model-induced answer distribution, and we apply robust point estimators and normalised confidence scores across numerical, Boolean, multiple-choice, open categorical, and optional integer types. An invariant guard layer enforces nutritional and logical self-consistency within each ingredient record. Minor numeric inconsistencies are reconciled via a linear program that minimises worst-case percentage deviation while preserving semantic zeros, and major violations are escalated to web-evidence-grounded repair, then human review only if that fails. On a curated 30-ingredient reference set, the pipeline achieves 98.4% exact match on nutrient flags and cuts median absolute percentage error on nutrient ratios from 31.9% for the median-aggregated baseline to 10.1%, a reduction of 21.8 percentage points, at an API cost of about $1 per ingredient. This frames LLM-assisted database construction as a controlled data-engineering workflow that makes uncertainty operational rather than discarding it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个质量控制的大语言模型（LLM）管线，用于收集计算营养学中的食材和食谱数据。该管线结合统计估计、领域特定不变性检查和网页抓取回退，将重复LLM查询视为采样，应用鲁棒点估计和归一化置信度分数，并通过线性规划解决数值不一致。在30成分参考集上，营养标志精确匹配达98.4%，营养比率绝对中位百分比误差从31.9%降至10.1%，成本约每成分1美元。
Motivation: 现有食材数据库不完整、不一致，且主要面向人工参考而非自动推理，LLM单次输出不可靠，可能引入静默错误。
Method: 提出质量控制的LLM管线：对每个成分属性进行重复LLM查询，视为模型诱导答案分布的样本，应用鲁棒点估计和归一化置信度分数；设置不变性守护层强制营养和逻辑自洽；轻微数值不一致通过线性规划优化，重大违规升级至基于网页证据的修复，再失败则人工审查。
Result: 在30成分参考集上，营养标志精确匹配98.4%；营养比率绝对中位百分比误差从基线31.9%降至10.1%，减少21.8个百分点；API成本约每成分1美元。
Conclusion: 该方法将LLM辅助数据库构建构建为受控数据工程工作流，通过统计方法操作化不确定性而非丢弃，为计算营养学提供可靠数据基础。

papers.title: What CLIP Knows but Cannot Say: Recovering Negation from Frozen Intermediate Features
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP map semantically opposite phrases (e.g., "a dog" vs. "not a dog") to nearly identical embeddings, rendering them insensitive to negation. We attribute this failure to a phenomenon we call Representational Collapse: by tracking compositional divergence and visual alignment across the CLIP text encoder, we show that middle layers build compositional syntax, but the final layers collapse this structure as visual alignment rises, producing a syntax-blind final representation. To recover the lost negation signal without altering pretrained weights, we propose PeakPatch, a lightweight post-hoc correction system that intercepts the encoder at its compositional peak. An Embedding Correction Network (ECN) uses cross-attention to extract a negation-specific signal from the peak layer, anchored to a stable baseline, and predicts a deviation vector that re-injects the lost syntax into the final-layer embedding space. A complementary Score Correction Network (SCN) predicts bounded scalar score offsets for discriminative tasks. Both modules are trained jointly end-to-end while all CLIP parameters remain frozen, adding only 5.2M parameters (3.5% of the backbone) and preserving the standard cosine similarity interface. On NegBench, PeakPatch achieves 74.3% on COCO MCQ (+35.1 over CLIP, +17.8 over the best encoder fine-tuning method) and 65.5% on VOC MCQ, while outperforming all fine-tuning baselines on fully out-of-distribution negation retrieval despite training only 3.5% of the parameters. The corrected embeddings also transfer to text-to-image generation (+18.4 negation score) and generalize across ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14, and SigLIP backbones. Project URL: https://stevencylu.github.io/PeakPatch/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现CLIP等对比视觉语言模型对否定表达（如"not a dog"）不敏感，归因于文本编码器后期层的结构坍缩。提出轻量级后处理系统PeakPatch，从编码器中间层提取否定信号注入最终嵌入，仅增加5.2M参数，在NegBench上大幅提升否定检测性能。
Motivation: CLIP等模型将语义相反的短语映射到几乎相同的嵌入，缺乏对否定的敏感性，这限制了其在需要精确语义理解的任务中的应用。
Method: 提出PeakPatch，包含嵌入校正网络(ECN)和分数校正网络(SCN)。ECN通过交叉注意力从编码器中间层（组成性峰值层）提取否定信号，预测偏差向量注入最终层；SCN预测标量分数偏移。所有CLIP参数冻结，仅训练新增模块。
Result: 在NegBench上，PeakPatch在COCO MCQ达到74.3%（+35.1 over CLIP，+17.8 over最佳微调方法），VOC MCQ 65.5%。在完全分布外否定检索上优于所有微调基线，且校正嵌入可迁移至文本到图像生成（否定分数+18.4）。
Conclusion: PeakPatch以极小参数增量有效恢复了CLIP对否定的敏感性，保持了标准余弦相似度接口，并泛化至多种骨干网络。

summary_sections.method: 提出PeakPatch，包含嵌入校正网络(ECN)和分数校正网络(SCN)。ECN通过交叉注意力从编码器中间层（组成性峰值层）提取否定信号，预测偏差向量注入最终层；SCN预测标量分数偏移。所有CLIP参数冻结，仅训练新增模块。
summary_sections.result: 在NegBench上，PeakPatch在COCO MCQ达到74.3%（+35.1 over CLIP，+17.8 over最佳微调方法），VOC MCQ 65.5%。在完全分布外否定检索上优于所有微调基线，且校正嵌入可迁移至文本到图像生成（否定分数+18.4）。
summary_sections.conclusion: PeakPatch以极小参数增量有效恢复了CLIP对否定的敏感性，保持了标准余弦相似度接口，并泛化至多种骨干网络。

papers.title: WaveZip: Wavelet-Driven Space-Time Decoupling for Video Token Condensation
papers.abstract_en: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) struggle with long-form video understanding due to the quadratic computational cost of visual tokens. While recent efficient methods attempt to compress tokens via hard pruning or uniform merging, they operate strictly in the spatial feature domain, where robust structural context and discriminative semantic details are inherently entangled. In this work, we propose WaveZip, a joint signal-frequency-domain framework for efficient video inference. Driven by the insight that temporal redundancy resides in low-pass approximation scales while spatial saliency strongly correlates with high-frequency components, WaveZip leverages Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT) to disentangle these signals. Temporally, it employs 1D DWT to analyze query-frame relevance, and the resulting high-frequency coefficients are further gated by inter-frame differences, with both signals jointly driving the dynamic allocation of a precise frame-level token budget. Spatially, a 2D DWT decomposes features into low-frequency approximations and high-frequency detail components, where the high-frequency coefficients are modulated within query-salient regions to regulate spatial reconstruction. Importantly, WaveZip requires no task-specific training and can be seamlessly integrated into off-the-shelf LVLMs to boost inference efficiency. Extensive experiments on long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that WaveZip retains 99.6% of the full performance under an extreme 10x compression ratio, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveZip，一种基于小波变换的时-空解耦视频令牌压缩框架，无需训练即可集成到现有大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中，在10倍压缩比下保留99.6%性能，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有LVLM处理长视频时面临视觉令牌二次计算成本，且硬修剪或均匀合并等方法在空间域中无法解耦结构与语义信息，导致压缩损失。
Method: WaveZip利用离散小波变换（DWT）进行时-空解耦：时间上使用1D DWT分析查询帧相关性，高频系数通过帧间差异门控分配帧级令牌预算；空间上使用2D DWT分解特征，高频系数在查询显著区域调制以控制空间重建。
Result: 在长视频理解基准上，10倍压缩比下保留99.6%性能，持续优于最先进方法。
Conclusion: WaveZip无需任务特定训练，可即插即用提升LVLM推理效率，但可能依赖视频内容的时-空特性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: X-Stage: An Overlooked Pipeline Stage for Communication-Computation Overlap in DiT Inference
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained, device-initiated communication lets persistent GPU kernels in distributed diffusion transformer (DiT) inference issue remote stores and overlap data movement with Tensor Core computation. Existing systems schedule when communication is issued and when received data becomes consumable, but omit post-issue progress before remote-visible completion, making sender backpressure hard to predict. We identify X-Stage, a software-visible post-issue pipeline stage. Measurements on an eight-GPU node with a recent NVIDIA architecture show that short remote-store bursts drain as the issuer resumes work, whereas sustained injection exhausts finite outstanding capacity and delays later issues. A lightweight Burst-Gap model parameterized by backpressure-free issue time, effective drain rate, and outstanding capacity predicts issue overhead, recovery between bursts, and the onset of backpressure. Guided by the model, we redesign two communication-computation fused kernels. For DeepGEMM MegaMoE, interleaving Linear-1 and Linear-2 work across expert waves places computation between concentrated remote-store bursts, yielding a 1.18x geometric-mean and 1.62x maximum kernel speedup over the Expert-Wave baseline across 84 configurations. For Ulysses sequence-parallel attention, tile-granular fusion of the post-attention All-to-All with FlashAttention lets an output-tile owner issue remote stores and resume computation without a dedicated communication warp or streaming multiprocessor. FlashAttention-3 and FlashAttention-4 reach maximum sender-visible speedups of 1.43x and 1.42x over serial execution, and at long sequences their steady-state times approach those of FlashAttention alone. These results establish post-issue progress as a measurable scheduling lever for shaping bursts, avoiding backpressure, and hiding sender-side overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在分布式扩散变换器（DiT）推理中识别了一个被忽视的流水线阶段 X-Stage，即软件可见的发布后进展阶段。测量表明，短远程存储爆发在发布者恢复工作时耗尽，而持续注入会耗尽有限容量并延迟后续发布。作者提出 Burst-Gap 模型预测发布开销和回压，并基于该模型重新设计两个通信-计算融合内核，实现了显著加速。
Motivation: 现有系统忽略了发布后进展阶段，使得发送方回压难以预测，影响了通信-计算重叠的效率。
Method: 识别 X-Stage（发布后进展阶段），提出 Burst-Gap 模型（参数为无回压发布时间、有效耗尽率、未完成容量），并基于该模型重新设计 DeepGEMM MegaMoE 和 Ulysses 序列并行注意力中的通信-计算融合内核。
Result: DeepGEMM MegaMoE 在 84 种配置下几何平均加速 1.18 倍，最大加速 1.62 倍；FlashAttention-3/4 最大发送端可见加速 1.43/1.42 倍，长序列稳态时间接近仅 FlashAttention 的情况。
Conclusion: 本文建立了发布后进展作为可测量的调度杠杆，用于塑造爆发、避免回压和隐藏发送端开销。

papers.title: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deciding whether a trajectory actually fulfills its instruction governs how we measure computer-use agents on long-horizon graphical-user-interface tasks and how we train them with reinforcement learning. This judgment has long relied on rule-based evaluation, which struggles to align with human intention and goes stale when an app updates or its online content drifts. Existing model-based judges attempt to address these problems but still leave a performance gap to the rule-based evaluation. We propose the \textbf{SeekJudge} framework, in which four role-specialized agents, a Condense, a Ground, a Seek and an Analyze agent, reach a verdict through a Seek--Analyze loop over the trajectory. A seed-calibrated distillation pipeline trains one specialized $9$B model to serve as the shared backbone for all four agents. Measured by downstream success rate on held-out RL test goals, SeekJudge is the first practical model-based reward to match or surpass native rule-based supervision in online RL. Beyond accuracy, SeekJudge provides step-level judgments, runs far cheaper than a closed-source large model, and keeps a small per-call context that scales to much longer trajectories. We further contribute a general architectural improvement to the reward server that speeds up judging in RL. Together these make model-based reward a practical drop-in for rule-based supervision in CUA reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeekJudge 奖励框架，用于计算机使用代理的强化学习。该框架由四个角色专用代理（Condense、Ground、Seek、Analyze）通过 Seek-Analyze 循环对轨迹进行判决，并使用种子校准蒸馏训练一个 9B 共享骨干网络。在在线 RL 中，SeekJudge 首次达到或超越基于规则的监督性能，且提供步级判断、成本更低、支持更长轨迹。
Motivation: 计算机使用代理的长期 GUI 任务依赖基于规则的评估，但难以对齐人类意图且随应用更新失效；现有模型判断器仍有性能差距。
Method: 提出 SeekJudge 框架，包含四个角色专用代理（Condense、Ground、Seek、Analyze）通过 Seek-Analyze 循环进行判决；使用种子校准蒸馏训练一个 9B 共享骨干网络；并改进奖励服务器架构加速评判。
Result: 在保留的 RL 测试目标上，SeekJudge 首次匹配或超越基于规则监督的在线 RL 成功率；提供步级判断，运行成本低于闭源大模型，且每次调用的上下文较小，可扩展至更长轨迹。
Conclusion: SeekJudge 使基于模型的奖励成为计算机使用代理强化学习中基于规则监督的实用替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAPT: A Multi-task Continuous Autoregressive Transformer enabling Cross-dataset and Cross-species Transfer for Calcium Population Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale calcium imaging has created an opportunity to build foundation-style models for neural population dynamics, but a central question remains unresolved: \textbf{whether a model pretrained on one collection of recordings can generalize to new datasets, experimental paradigms, and even species.} Existing approaches are often designed for specific tasks and evaluated on a single dataset, making it unclear whether their learned representations are reusable for new calcium trace datasets. To tackle this gap, we present \textbf{CAPT}, a \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{A}utoregressive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{T}ransformer for calcium population dynamics. CAPT models continuous calcium traces directly through a continuous patch tokenization strategy and is trained autoregressively, enabling end-to-end pretraining and adaptation to diverse downstream tasks. We first pretrain CAPT on a large-scale mouse calcium imaging dataset and evaluate its transferability across independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and \textit{C. elegans} datasets collected by different laboratories. In these transfer settings, the pretrained backbone is frozen and only adaptation modules are updated. Across neural population forecasting and behavior decoding tasks, CAPT consistently outperforms specialized and general-purpose baselines. Alongside predictive performance, multimodal analyses using NeuroPAL annotations in \textit{C. elegans} datasets show that CAPT embeddings form a shared functional space across datasets and capture anatomical cell-identity-related structure. These results suggest that the continuous autoregressive modeling opens up possibilities for a simple route towards general-purpose neural foundation models for calcium imaging, which can generalize across datasets, experimental paradigms, and species.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAPT，一个连续自回归Transformer，用于钙成像群体神经动力学。通过在大型小鼠钙成像数据集上预训练，并在其他小鼠、斑马鱼幼虫和线虫数据集上评估迁移能力，CAPT在神经群体预测和行为解码任务上优于专门和通用基线。多模态分析表明CAPT嵌入形成共享功能空间并捕获细胞身份相关结构。
Motivation: 现有方法通常针对特定任务和单一数据集设计，其表示能否泛化到新数据集、实验范式和物种尚不清楚。
Method: 提出CAPT，采用连续补丁分词化策略直接建模连续钙迹，通过自回归训练实现端到端预训练，并适配多种下游任务。迁移时冻结预训练骨干，仅更新适配模块。
Result: 在跨数据集和跨物种迁移中，CAPT在神经群体预测和行为解码上一致优于专门和通用基线；NeuroPAL注释的多模态分析显示CAPT嵌入形成共享功能空间并捕获细胞身份结构。
Conclusion: 摘要指出连续自回归建模为构建通用神经基础模型提供了简单途径，能够泛化到不同数据集、范式和物种。

papers.title: FedTaste: Topology-Aware Structural Transfer for Multimodal Federated Learning with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Federated Learning is often challenged by arbitrary modality missingness and Non-IID data distributions, which lead to severe representation drift and hinder effective collaboration across clients. Existing methods typically rely on generative imputation, external auxiliary data, or isolated unimodal training to bridge modality gaps, often incurring substantial communication and computational costs as well as potential privacy risks. To address these limitations, we propose FedTaste, a parameter-efficient framework for topology-aware structural transfer in Multimodal Federated Learning with missing modalities. Instead of aligning fragile first-order features, FedTaste focuses on more stable group-level semantic relations. Specifically, FedTaste leverages frozen foundation models to extract a joint multimodal topology from full-modality clients, which is then consolidated by the server into a global structural blueprint. To adapt clients with missing modalities, we introduce Modality-Adaptive Structural Prompts together with spectral consistency regularization, enabling lightweight branch-specific adaptation that aligns local partial representations with the shared blueprint. In this way, FedTaste avoids explicit modality imputation while preserving shared semantic structure across clients. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedTaste consistently achieves superior performance across multiple datasets and challenging Non-IID settings, while substantially reducing communication overhead compared with existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedTaste，一种面向多模态联邦学习中模态缺失问题的拓扑感知结构迁移框架。FedTaste利用冻结的基础模型提取完整模态客户端的联合多模态拓扑，由服务器整合为全局结构蓝图；针对缺失模态的客户端，引入模态自适应结构提示和频谱一致性正则化，实现轻量级分支特定适应，避免显式模态插补。实验表明，FedTaste在多个数据集和非独立同分布设置下持续取得优越性能，并显著降低通信开销。
Motivation: 现有多模态联邦学习方法在应对任意模态缺失和非独立同分布数据时，存在表示漂移、通信计算成本高、隐私风险等问题，亟需一种不依赖生成式插补或外部数据的参数高效框架。
Method: FedTaste采用冻结基础模型提取完整模态客户端的联合多模态拓扑，服务器聚合为全局结构蓝图；为缺失模态客户端设计模态自适应结构提示与频谱一致性正则化，使局部部分表示与共享蓝图对齐。
Result: 实验在多个数据集和挑战性非独立同分布设置下，FedTaste的性能优于现有方法，并大幅降低通信开销。
Conclusion: FedTaste通过结构迁移而非特征对齐，避免了显式模态插补，在参数高效的前提下保持了共享语义结构，适用于多模态联邦学习中的模态缺失场景。

papers.title: Characterisation of Density-based FM generation methods in the context of Information Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Fuzzy Integral (FI) based aggregation provides a powerful mechanism for nuanced aggregation, for example, in ensemble approaches or decision-level fusion more generally. The main challenge of this approach is the appropriate parametrization of the Fuzzy Measure (FM), which captures the worths of the individual components--and their combinations--which are being fused. Here, widely used approaches including the Sugeno-$λ$ and Decomposable FMs, parametrize the FM by extrapolating from the densities, i.e. the weights associated with individual sources, while respecting the FM's monotonicity constraint. This paper articulates that this information is, in general, insufficient to uniquely identify a discrete FM; but shows how an interval-valued FM can indeed be determined uniquely. We proceed to show how the incorporation of additional information beyond the above, such as the choice of a specific FI and a dataset, then allows for obtaining even more specific interval-valued FMs. In practice, establishing the quality of an empirically determined FM is not trivial. To help address this, we show how the likelihood with which a resulting interval FM encompasses the `ideal', i.e. the commonly intangible, best, or ground-truth numeric FM, can be determined, producing a confidence interval at a given confidence level. Finally, based on a series of experiments, we demonstrate empirically that the Choquet FI output based on this FM can also be regarded as the confidence interval for the `ideal' information fusion result, providing a novel means to characterize FI fusion outcomes a priori and charting a pathway for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了基于密度的模糊测度（FM）生成方法在信息融合中的特性，指出仅凭密度信息无法唯一确定离散FM，但可以确定区间值FM。进一步展示了如何通过融入额外信息（如特定模糊积分和数据集）获得更具体的区间值FM，并提出了确定区间FM包含“理想”数值FM的置信区间的方法。实验表明，基于此FM的Choquet模糊积分输出也可视为“理想”融合结果的置信区间。
Motivation: 模糊积分（FI）聚合需要恰当参数化的模糊测度（FM），而常用的Sugeno-λ和可分解FM等方法仅从密度（各信源权重）外推FM，但该信息不足以唯一确定离散FM，限制了融合结果的可靠性与可解释性。
Method: 通过形式化论证密度信息仅能确定区间值FM，并引入额外约束（如特定FI和数据集）进一步收紧区间。同时，利用统计方法计算区间FM包含“理想”数值FM的置信区间，从而量化FM的不确定性。
Result: 理论推导表明，仅凭密度信息可唯一确定区间值FM，而非单个数值FM。实验验证了Choquet FI输出基于该区间FM可被解释为“理想”融合结果的置信区间，为融合结果的不确定性表征提供了新手段。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了密度型FM生成方法的信息局限性，提供了区间值FM框架以量化不确定性，并提出置信区间方法评估融合结果的可靠性，为未来研究提供了方向。

papers.title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed conversational AI, yet high-quality multilingual code-mixed dialogue resources remain scarce, particularly for Indic languages where speakers naturally alternate between English and their native language in both native-script and Romanized forms. We present IndicTalk, one of the largest multilingual Indic code-mixed conversational corpora, comprising over 13,28,604 event-grounded multi-turn conversations across 18 language varieties covering 9 Indic languages. The corpus is generated through a fully automated pipeline that combines real-world news grounding, persona-conditioned dialogue generation using multilingual LLMs, and automatic quality validation. Extensive linguistic, automatic, and human evaluations demonstrate that IndicTalk produces fluent, coherent, and naturally code-mixed conversations across both script variants. We will release IndicTalk to support the development and evaluation of multilingual conversational AI for underrepresented Indic languages. The dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/IndicTalk .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IndicTalk，一个大规模多语言印地语代码混合对话语料库，包含超过 130 万轮对话，覆盖 9 种印地语语言的 18 种语言变体。语料通过自动流水线生成，结合真实世界新闻、基于人格的多语言大模型对话生成和自动质量验证。实验表明语料流畅、连贯且自然混合代码。
Motivation: 高质量的多语言代码混合对话资源稀缺，尤其是印地语语言，其中说话者自然地在英语和母语之间切换，并使用本地文字和罗马化形式。
Method: 采用全自动流水线：利用真实世界新闻作为事件基础，使用多语言大模型进行人格条件化的对话生成，并通过自动质量验证确保语料质量。
Result: 摘要报告 IndicTalk 包含 13,28,604 轮对话，覆盖 9 种印地语语言的 18 种语言变体；语言、自动和人工评估表明生成的对话流畅、连贯且自然混合代码。
Conclusion: 该语料库将公开发布，以支持印地语多语言对话 AI 的发展与评估。

papers.title: SARATR-X-v2: Scale-Aware Structural Pre-Training for SAR Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked image modeling has become a dominant paradigm for SAR pre-training, yet the design of the reconstruction target remains fundamentally unsettled. This article argues that a SAR pre-training target should satisfy two conditions to produce transferable representations: (i) physics-grounded stability, i.e., approximate invariance of the target operator to multiplicative speckle inherent in coherent imaging; and (ii) semantic scale compatibility, i.e., coverage of the heterogeneous spatial scales that downstream tasks demand. These two conditions are individually achievable but jointly difficult: physics-grounded stability favors fixed operators, while semantic scale compatibility favors data-driven composition. To this end, SARATR-X-v2 reconciles both within a single design. The target is constructed through fixed structural extractors spanning six receptive fields, from blind-spot local aggregation to directional log-ratio region contrast, and fused via learnable weights into one unified supervision signal for masked reconstruction. On twelve SAR benchmarks across classification, detection, and segmentation, SARATR-X-v2 achieves state-of-the-art transfer performance. Under synthetic speckle variation, the proposed target reduces perturbation drift in the learned representation by nearly two orders of magnitude relative to pixel-space supervision. Taken together, these results establish physics-grounded stability and semantic scale compatibility as a principled framework for pre-training target design under coherent imaging, and suggest that effective SAR pre-training is not about reconstructing more signal, but about reconstructing the right structural target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对SAR预训练中的掩码图像建模，提出一种兼顾物理稳定性和语义尺度兼容性的预训练目标。该目标通过固定结构提取器（覆盖六个感受野）和可学习权重融合，生成统一的监督信号用于掩码重建。在12个SAR基准（分类、检测、分割）上达到最优迁移性能，且合成斑噪变化下的表示扰动降低近两个数量级。
Motivation: 现有SAR预训练的重建目标设计未同时满足物理稳定性（对乘性斑噪近似不变）和语义尺度兼容性（覆盖下游任务所需的多尺度信息），而这两者对于可迁移表示至关重要。
Method: 构建一个由固定结构提取器（从盲点局部聚合到方向对数比区域对比）组成的多尺度目标，并通过可学习权重融合为统一的监督信号，用于掩码图像重建。
Result: 在12个SAR基准（分类、检测、分割）上取得最优迁移性能；在合成斑噪变化下，表示扰动相比像素空间监督降低近两个数量级。
Conclusion: 有效的SAR预训练不在于重建更多信号，而在于重建正确的结构目标；所提出的物理稳定性和语义尺度兼容性框架为相干成像下的预训练目标设计提供了原则性指导。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Context-Aware Concept Distillation for Trustworthy Flood Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Effective flood risk management relies on accurate forecasting, yet the "black box" nature of stateof-the-art Deep Learning models creates a barrier to trust and accountability in high-stakes public safety decisions. While existing Explainable AI (XAI) methods offer local attributions, they fail to provide the verifiable, operationally meaningful causal narratives required by disaster response authorities. To address this societal challenge, we propose Context-Aware Concept Distillation (CACD), a framework developed in collaboration with domain experts to distill opaque LSTMs into interpretable, hydrology-aware surrogate models. We introduce an unsupervised pipeline to discover a "Hydrological Language" and a Residual Hypernetwork that dynamically modulates these concepts based on static basin characteristics. Evaluated on 5,203 basins globally, our model achieves high fidelity (Median NSE 0.70), significantly outperforming black-box baselines (e.g., Multi Layer Perceptrons) on unseen future data. By demonstrating that human-interpretable concepts are sufficient to reconstruct flood dynamics, this work balances AI accuracy with the transparency required for responsible environmental decision-making.
papers.comment: to be published in IJCAI 2026 proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文感知概念蒸馏（CACD）框架，将不透明的LSTM洪水预测模型蒸馏为可解释的水文感知代理模型。该方法通过无监督管道发现“水文语言”，并利用残差超网络根据静态流域特征动态调制概念。在5203个流域上评估，中位数NSE为0.70，优于多层感知器等黑盒基线。
Motivation: 现有深度学习洪水预测模型是黑盒，缺乏可解释性和信任度，而现有XAI方法无法提供灾害响应所需的可验证因果叙述。
Method: 提出CACD框架，包括无监督概念发现管道（挖掘水文语言）和残差超网络（根据流域特征调整概念），将LSTM蒸馏为可解释的代理模型。
Result: 在5203个全球流域上，模型达到中位数NSE 0.70，在未见未来数据上显著优于多层感知器等黑盒基线。
Conclusion: 人类可解释的概念足以重建洪水动态，平衡了AI准确性与透明度，适用于负责任的决策。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: FedSLIM: Privacy-Preserving Federated MDL-Based Descriptive Pattern Mining Across Data Silos
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning has achieved considerable success for predictive modelling, yet federated descriptive analytics remains largely unexplored. Existing federated pattern mining approaches are predominantly support-based and do not optimise a principled global objective such as Minimum Description Length (MDL). We introduce FedSLIM, the first federated MDL-based framework for descriptive pattern mining. Building on the SLIM principle, FedSLIM enables collaborative optimisation of compact pattern models across distributed databases without sharing raw transactions. We propose two complementary variants that balance privacy, communication, and optimisation fidelity under different deployment assumptions. To evaluate federated MDL mining, we introduce fidelity and discovery-oriented metrics that quantify agreement with a centralised baseline and assess recovery of globally informative patterns. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets under IID and non-IID partitioning show that both variants preserve high-quality compression structure while requiring orders of magnitude less search than the centralised baseline. We further reveal a local-global discovery gap in distributed MDL mining, where globally compressive patterns may be undiscoverable through isolated local optimisation. Both variants recover globally informative patterns absent from all standalone local models, demonstrating the benefits of federated optimisation beyond independent local mining. These results establish federated MDL mining as a practical foundation for privacy-preserving descriptive analytics across distributed data silos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedSLIM，首个基于最小描述长度（MDL）的联邦描述性模式挖掘框架。它扩展了SLIM原则，使分布式数据库能够协作优化紧凑的模式模型，同时不共享原始交易数据。实验表明，在IID和非IID分区下，该框架能保持高压缩质量，且计算量比集中式基线低几个数量级。
Motivation: 联邦学习在预测建模中取得成功，但联邦描述性分析（如模式挖掘）尚未充分探索；现有联邦模式挖掘方法主要基于支持度，未优化像MDL这样的全局目标。
Method: 基于SLIM原则，提出两个变体以平衡隐私、通信和优化保真度；在分布式数据上协作优化MDL模式模型，并引入保真度和发现导向的评估指标。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，两个变体均能保持高压缩结构，搜索量比集中式基线低数个数量级；能恢复所有局部模型无法发现的全局压缩模式。
Conclusion: 联邦MDL挖掘可作为分布式数据孤岛上隐私保护描述性分析的实用基础，但存在局部-全局发现差距——全局压缩模式可能无法通过孤立局部优化发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Reconstruction-Based Framework for Caption Evaluation Beyond Reference Captions
papers.abstract_en: Image captioning is a primary task in vision--language research, yet assessing how faithfully a caption preserves image semantics without relying on reference captions remains unsettled. Prevailing evaluations rely on human-annotated references, whose content reflects annotator intent and captioning proficiency. In this paper, we study a reconstruction-based principle for caption evaluation: a caption is as good as its capacity to enable reconstruction of the original image. However, because captioning inherently compresses visual information, it is impossible to recover all details, and pixel-wise comparison between reconstructed and source images is neither feasible nor meaningful. Through our in-depth analysis of the nature of captions, whose fundamental purpose is to transmit the semantic content of an image, we propose a revised principle: a caption is as good as its capacity to enable a reconstruction that is semantically equivalent to the original. To assess semantic equivalence, we test whether the reconstruction matches the original image across a suite of downstream vision--language tasks, yielding a reference-free, task-conditioned caption score. We characterize component-dependent limitations and introduce the lower-cost Captioning Turing Test Dataset (CTTD) surrogate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需参考标注的图像描述评估框架，基于重建原则：描述的好坏取决于其能否使重建图像与原图语义等价。通过一系列下游视觉-语言任务检验语义等价性，得到无参考、任务条件下的描述评分。还引入了低成本的 Captioning Turing Test Dataset (CTTD) 替代数据集。
Motivation: 现有图像描述评估依赖人工标注的参考描述，但参考描述受标注者意图和能力影响，且缺乏无参考的语义保真度评估方法。
Method: 提出重建式评估原则：描述应能重建出与原图语义等价的图像。通过将描述输入图像生成模型得到重建图，再用多个下游视觉-语言任务（如分类、检索）比较重建图与原图的语义一致性，从而得到参考自由的评分。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出该方法可避免参考描述偏差，并分析了各组件依赖的局限性。同时提出低成本的 CTTD 替代数据集。
Conclusion: 基于语义等价重建的评估框架可行且无需参考描述，但受限于下游任务的覆盖范围。CTTD 数据集可降低评估成本。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出重建式评估原则：描述应能重建出与原图语义等价的图像。通过将描述输入图像生成模型得到重建图，再用多个下游视觉-语言任务（如分类、检索）比较重建图与原图的语义一致性，从而得到参考自由的评分。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出该方法可避免参考描述偏差，并分析了各组件依赖的局限性。同时提出低成本的 CTTD 替代数据集。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基于语义等价重建的评估框架可行且无需参考描述，但受限于下游任务的覆盖范围。CTTD 数据集可降低评估成本。

papers.title: From Score Learning to Discretized Sampling: An End-to-End Generalization Analysis of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the empirical success of score-based diffusion models, a complete theoretical understanding of how finite-sample learning, network parameterization, and numerical discretization jointly dictate generative quality remains underdeveloped. Existing sampling analyses often evaluate the generative performance conditional on an oracle score or a pre-specified error threshold. In this work, we establish a unified convergence and generalization framework for score-based diffusion models parameterized by practical ResNet-type architectures. We analyze the generalization and convergence properties from the practical finite-sample, discrete-time learning problem of the score function to the ideal continuous-time, population-level objective. Based on the generalization result of the learning problem of score function, we analyze the sampling process induced by the learned score function and provide an end-to-end total variation distance estimate for the generated terminal distribution. This estimate explicitly decomposes the overall generative error into four interpretable components: the truncation error of the forward process, the reverse-time discretization error, the generalization error incorporating both finite data and forward-time discretization, and the training optimization gap. Our results quantitatively characterize how the training sample size, temporal discretization grids, and optimization accuracy jointly control the final fidelity of samples generated by diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为基于分数的扩散模型建立了统一的收敛与泛化分析框架，从有限样本、离散时间的学习问题到理想连续时间、总体目标，给出了端到端的总变差距离估计，将生成误差分解为截断误差、离散化误差、泛化误差和优化间隙四个可解释部分。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型理论分析多基于神谕分数或预设误差阈值，缺乏从有限样本学习到数值离散化的完整理论理解。
Method: 针对实际ResNet型网络参数化的分数扩散模型，分析分数函数学习的泛化性质，并利用学习到的分数函数分析采样过程，得到端到端总变差距离界。
Result: 端到端误差估计显式分解为前向过程截断误差、反向离散化误差、有限数据和前向离散化引起的泛化误差以及训练优化间隙，量化了样本量、离散化网格和优化精度对生成质量的联合影响。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了扩散模型学习与采样阶段的误差分析，为理解实际扩散模型的生成质量提供了理论保障。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ParasGB: A Graph Benchmark Suite for Parasitic Estimation on AMS Circuits
papers.abstract_en: As chip manufacturing processes advance to deep submicron nodes, parasitic interconnect effects increasingly dominate the performance of analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits and often lead to costly layout iterations. This makes early-stage estimation of parasitic capacitance and resistance important for parasitic-aware design exploration before full physical implementation. However, progress on GNN-based parasitic modeling has been hindered by the lack of public, high-fidelity RC benchmarks that support reproducible evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce ParasGB, the first open-source benchmark suite for pre-layout parasitic parameter prediction on circuit graphs. ParasGB provides large-scale, heterogeneous RC networks extracted with commercial EDA tools from tape-out-proven designs, together with a unified evaluation protocol covering node-level ground capacitance, edge-level resistance, and edge-level coupling capacitance. Within this framework, we benchmark diverse GNN architectures using a standardized training pipeline and expose challenges such as extreme label imbalance, long-tailed parasitic distributions, and strong structural heterogeneity. By establishing a physically grounded and standardized benchmark for early-stage parasitic prediction, ParasGB provides an open platform for reproducible research on circuit graph learning and parasitic-aware model development. All datasets, preprocessing scripts, and configurations are publicly available in our code repository https://github.com/ShenShan123/ParasGB.git.
papers.comment: Published at ICCAD2026. Full appendix version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 ParasGB，首个面向模拟/混合信号 (AMS) 电路寄生参数 (电容、电阻) 估计的开源图基准测试套件。该基准包含从流片验证设计中提取的大规模异构 RC 网络，并提供节点级接地电容、边级电阻和边级耦合电容的统一评估协议。作者以标准化流程评测多种图神经网络 (GNN) 架构，揭示了标签不平衡、长尾分布和结构异质性等挑战。
Motivation: 随着工艺节点缩小，互连寄生效应主导 AMS 电路性能，但缺乏公开、高保真的 RC 基准来支持可复现的 GNN 寄生建模研究。
Method: 开发 ParasGB 基准套件，利用商用 EDA 工具从流片设计中提取大规模异构 RC 网络，提供节点级接地电容、边级电阻和边级耦合电容的预测任务，并统一训练/评估协议。
Result: 基准测试多种 GNN 架构，暴露了极端标签不平衡、长尾寄生分布和强结构异质性等难题。
Conclusion: ParasGB 为早期寄生预测提供了物理一致的标准化基准，促进电路图学习和寄生感知模型的可复现研究，所有数据及代码已开源。

papers.title: BoneAgeTW2: Automated Skeletal Maturation Assessment via the Tanner-Whitehouse 2 Method, Deep Learning, and Clinical Report Generation with Distribution Curves
papers.abstract_en: We present BoneAgeTW2, the first fully open-source system to automate the complete Tanner-Whitehouse 2 (TW2) clinical protocol for skeletal maturity assessment end-to-end. The system employs YOLOv8 for precise detection and localization of the 20 TW2 hand bones from radiographic images, and an EfficientNet-B3 backbone with 20 independent classification heads to assign maturation stages (A-I) to each bone simultaneously. From these predictions, the system automatically generates clinical PDF reports including interactive Gaussian distribution curves for all 20 bones, enabling direct comparison with population norms. The model is trained on the public RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Challenge dataset (12,611 hand radiographs) using a pseudo-labeling strategy to derive per-bone stage labels from global bone age annotations. The full codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/jmmana/BoneAgeTW2.
papers.comment: Thesis research article. Code available at https://github.com/jmmana/BoneAgeTW2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BoneAgeTW2，首个完全开源的全自动 Tanner-Whitehouse 2 (TW2) 骨龄评估系统。系统使用 YOLOv8 定位 20 块手骨，EfficientNet-B3 骨干网络搭配 20 个独立分类头同时预测各骨成熟分期（A-I），并自动生成包含高斯分布曲线的临床 PDF 报告。模型基于公开 RSNA 儿科骨龄数据集（12,611 张手部 X 光片）通过伪标签策略训练。完整代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有骨龄自动化评估系统大多部分闭源或未完整覆盖 TW2 协议，且缺乏临床报告生成功能。
Method: 采用 YOLOv8 检测和定位 20 块 TW2 手骨区域，利用 EfficientNet-B3 作为共享骨干，接 20 个独立分类头同时输出各骨分期（A-I）。训练时利用 RSNA 数据集的全局骨龄注释通过伪标签策略推导每骨分期标签。
Result: 在 RSNA 公开数据集上训练，系统能够自动生成包含 20 块手骨高斯分布曲线的临床 PDF 报告，便于与人群常模比较。
Conclusion: 该全开源系统首次实现了 TW2 协议从骨检测、分期预测到临床报告生成的端到端自动化，为骨龄评估的临床和研究应用提供了可复现的基础。

papers.title: An Ontology for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate quantum-mechanical energies and forces---conventionally computed by density functional theory (DFT) or wave-function methods---at a fraction of the cost. The field encompasses a growing ecosystem of algorithms, training datasets, hyperparameters, and target materials, yet the metadata needed to systematically compare, reproduce, and build upon MLIP studies remains scattered across papers, scripts, and ad-hoc file formats. We present the MLIPs ontology, an OWL 2 DL ontology that captures the concepts needed to describe MLIP methods, their hyperparameters, training datasets with DFT provenance, and published benchmarks. The ontology is organized into three modules---Method, Training Data, and Benchmark---and connects existing ontologies in materials science (MDO, CMSO/ASMO) and machine learning (ML-Schema), complementing dataset-side schemas such as Croissant. It declares 27 formal axioms enforcing data completeness and consistency, including property chains that link trained models to their methods and training data. We demonstrate the ontology through a running example based on Moment Tensor Potentials and evaluate it through competency-question execution on a 20-paper seeded knowledge graph, OWL reasoning, and comparison with existing ontologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的OWL 2 DL本体，分为方法、训练数据和基准三个模块，连接了材料科学和机器学习领域的现有本体，并通过27个形式化公理确保数据完整性和一致性。通过基于Moment Tensor Potentials的实例和20篇论文的知识图谱进行了评估。
Motivation: 机器学习原子间势领域的元数据散乱，难以系统比较、复现和扩展研究，需要一个统一的本体来结构化描述方法、超参数、训练数据和基准。
Method: 构建了MLIPs本体，采用OWL 2 DL，包含Method、Training Data和Benchmark三个模块，复用MDO、CMSO/ASMO和ML-Schema等本体，定义了27个形式化公理和属性链。
Result: 通过Moment Tensor Potentials实例演示，并在20篇论文的知识图谱上执行能力问题、OWL推理以及与现有本体的比较来验证。
Conclusion: 该本体能够系统描述和比较MLIPs研究，提升可复现性和可发现性。

papers.title: Counterfactual Motion Reliability Learning for Robust UAV Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Infrared unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tracking is challenging because the target is often small, low-contrast, and easily confused with thermal distractors or cluttered backgrounds. Recent Transformer-based trackers have achieved promising performance by learning strong appearance representations, but their responses can still be dominated by background structures when the target appearance is weak or ambiguous. A natural solution is to introduce temporal motion cues. However, in infrared UAV tracking, motion cues are not always reliable: camera jitter, dynamic backgrounds, sensor noise, and target disappearance may produce temporal variations that are stronger than the true target motion. Therefore, the key challenge is not simply how to use motion, but how to distinguish target-consistent motion from background-induced pseudo motion. To this end, we propose CMRTrack, a counterfactual motion reliability learning framework for robust infrared UAV tracking. CMRTrack first extracts temporal evidence from adjacent search regions using a lightweight motion evidence encoder. During training, a counterfactual target-erased history branch is introduced to construct hard motion references, encouraging the motion encoder to learn reliable target-consistent motion rather than arbitrary temporal changes. The learned motion evidence is then incorporated into a one-stream tracking framework through motion-guided token modulation and reliability-aware score fusion, enabling adaptive feature enhancement and response refinement. Extensive experiments on Anti-UAV410 demonstrate that CMRTrack consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art trackers and significantly improves the OSTrack baseline, with ablation studies and qualitative analysis verifying the effectiveness of the proposed counterfactual motion reliability learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对红外无人机跟踪中目标弱小、易与热杂波混淆的问题，提出基于反事实运动可靠性学习的框架 CMRTrack。通过轻量运动证据编码器提取时序信息，并利用反事实目标擦除历史分支构造硬运动参考，迫使编码器学习目标一致的运动而非背景伪运动。再通过运动引导的令牌调制和可靠性感知分数融合，实现自适应特征增强。在 Anti-UAV410 数据集上，该方法显著优于现有跟踪器（包括 OSTrack 基线），消融实验验证了反事实运动可靠性学习的有效性。
Motivation: 红外无人机跟踪中，时序运动线索不可靠：相机抖动、动态背景、传感器噪声和目标消失产生的时变可能强于真实目标运动。现有方法简单引入运动信息会被背景伪运动主导，因此关键挑战是如何区分目标一致运动与背景诱导的伪运动。
Method: 提出 CMRTrack 框架：先使用轻量运动证据编码器从相邻搜索区域提取时序特征；训练时引入反事实目标擦除历史分支构造硬运动参考，迫使编码器关注目标一致运动；通过运动引导的令牌调制和可靠性感知分数融合将运动证据集成到单流跟踪框架中，实现自适应特征增强与响应精炼。
Result: 在 Anti-UAV410 数据集上，CMRTrack 一致优于多个代表性 SOTA 跟踪器，并显著提升了 OSTrack 基线。消融实验和定性分析验证了反事实运动可靠性学习的有效性。
Conclusion: 反事实运动可靠性学习能有效提取红外无人机跟踪中目标一致的运动信息，抑制背景伪运动干扰，提升鲁棒性。方法适用于目标弱小、低对比度场景。

papers.title: Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS): Greedy Feature Selection via Orthogonal Deflation in PCA Loading Space
papers.abstract_en: We propose Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS), a greedy framework for unsupervised feature selection that operates in the weighted PCA loading space. After each selection, VPOS projects out the chosen feature's variance direction via null-space deflation, forcing subsequent selections to cover orthogonal parts of the covariance structure. Each step provably reduces the loading matrix rank by one, and the greedy objective connects to monotone submodular maximization. The single hyperparameter $d$ is selected via a reproducible rule: the value minimising reconstruction MSE in a sensitivity sweep. On eight benchmarks, VPOS achieves the lowest reconstruction MSE on all eight while running 10-140x faster than graph-based methods at scale. Comparing against PCA (no deflation) at matched $d$ confirms deflation as the primary driver, reducing MSE by 10-73%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS)，一种无监督特征选择框架，在加权 PCA 加载空间中通过正交归约 (deflation) 依次选择特征，迫使后续选择覆盖协方差结构的正交部分。在 8 个基准数据集上，VPOS 均获得最低重建 MSE，且运行速度比基于图的方法快 10-140 倍。
Motivation: 现有无监督特征选择方法在保持数据方差和计算效率之间存在权衡，尤其是图基方法在大规模数据上计算负担较重。
Method: VPOS 在加权 PCA 加载空间中进行贪心选择，每次选择后通过零空间归约 (null-space deflation) 投影掉所选特征的方差方向，每个步骤可证明降低加载矩阵秩 1，且贪心目标与单调子模最大化相关。超参数 d 通过最小化重建 MSE 的敏感性扫描确定。
Result: 在 8 个基准数据集上，VPOS 均取得最低重建 MSE，运行速度比基于图的方法快 10-140 倍；与无归约的 PCA 对比，归约机制将 MSE 降低了 10-73%。
Conclusion: 正交归约是 VPOS 性能提升的主要驱动因素，该方法在保持数据方差的同时实现高效的特征选择。

papers.title: Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling for Anomaly Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection on multivariate sensor time series is critical for industrial monitoring of cyber-physical systems (CPS), where even subtle deviations from normal behavior can indicate process disruption. Recent graph-based approaches have made significant progress, but they often struggle in small-scale physical systems with scarce labeled anomalies and limited normal data. In such settings, graph-based models tend to capture spurious correlations and produce unstable sensor topologies. We propose DPR-GM (Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling), a forecasting-based framework that incorporates system design knowledge into graph construction. DPR-GM leverages a large language model (LLM) to extract directed physical couplings between sensor pairs from system documentation, which are encoded as a binary domain adjacency matrix serving as a structural gate over sensor relations. This gate is then modulated by Pearson correlations estimated from normal training data. The anomaly score is further weighted by sensor-level reliability derived from the coefficient of variation. All graph and weighting components are fixed prior to training and add no learnable parameters. On the SKAB benchmark, DPR-GM outperforms graph-based, statistical, and deep learning baselines across F1, AUROC, and AUPRC, showing that domain-structured graph priors are a practical alternative to fully learned topologies in data-scarce CPS.
papers.comment: 12 pages, ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DPR-GM，一种基于域先验正则化图模型的异常检测框架，用于工业控制系统（CPS）的多变量传感器时间序列。DPR-GM 利用大语言模型（LLM）从系统文档中提取传感器间的有向物理耦合，构建二值域邻接矩阵作为结构门控，再通过正常训练数据的皮尔逊相关系数调制，最终用变异系数加权传感器级的异常得分。所有图结构和加权组件在训练前固定，不引入额外可学习参数。在 SKAB 基准上，DPR-GM 在 F1、AUROC 和 AUPRC 上优于图方法、统计方法和深度学习方法。
Motivation: 小规模物理系统中标记异常和正常数据稀缺，现有图方法易捕获虚假相关并产生不稳定拓扑，需要将系统设计知识引入图构建以避免过拟合。
Method: DPR-GM 包含三步：1) 用 LLM 从系统文档提取有向物理耦合，生成二值域邻接矩阵；2) 用正常数据计算皮尔逊相关系数矩阵，并与域矩阵逐元素相乘得到调制邻接矩阵；3) 计算每个传感器的变异系数作为可靠性权重，用于加权异常得分。所有组件均无学习参数。
Result: 在 SKAB 基准上，DPR-GM 在 F1、AUROC 和 AUPRC 上优于图方法、统计方法和深度学习方法。
Conclusion: 在数据稀缺的 CPS 场景中，利用域先验结构图（而非全学习拓扑）是实用且有效的异常检测替代方案。

papers.title: Out-of-Length Scene Text Recognition: A Two-Axis Diagnosis and a Training-Free Fix
papers.abstract_en: Scene Text Recognition (STR) models are trained almost exclusively on word crops of at most 25 characters, yet real deployments (signage, product labels, dense captions) require reading much longer text. This paper diagnoses that failure and then closes it. The diagnosis separates out-of-length failure into two simultaneously extrapolating axes (the encoder's width axis and the decoder's time axis) and shows that encoder width, not decoder length, is the dominant failure mode. Representation-side fixes bring only partial relief: training-free rotary rescalings recover at most 2-4 points of character error rate (CER), and a weighted fine-tuning recipe recovers 6-8 points while improving standard-benchmark accuracy, yet word accuracy on the Long Text Benchmark (LTB) stays near zero, because the residual gap lies in the decoding mechanism rather than the representation. We then close that gap at inference time, on an unmodified word-level checkpoint: the long image is sliced into overlapping crops at the model's training width, each decoded independently and in-distribution, and the reads stitched by geometry-anchored edit-distance alignment. This procedure reaches 42.79-43.05% bucket-average word accuracy on LTB across two base checkpoints, matching the published state of the art (41.57%) and beating it by 11-12 points on the hardest bucket, at wall-clock parity with plain decoding; applied unchanged to the public PARSeq checkpoint it reaches 47.11%. Once chunking is applied fine-tuning no longer helps: the decoding-side fix alone matches purpose-built architectures. We release the diagnosis harness and implementation.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 10 tables, includes supplementary material (folded in as Appendix S1-S4). Code: https://github.com/zobeirraisi/chunk-decode-stitch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断并解决了场景文本识别（STR）模型在处理超出训练长度（最多25字符）的长文本时的失败问题。诊断发现编码器宽度是主要失败模式，而非解码器长度。提出一种训练无关的修复方法：将长图像切成模型训练宽度的重叠块，分别解码后通过几何锚定的编辑距离对齐拼接。该方法在不修改预训练模型的情况下，在长文本基准（LTB）上达到42.79-43.05%的桶平均词准确率，匹配并超过已发表的SOTA。
Motivation: 现有STR模型几乎只训练于最多25字符的词裁剪，但实际应用（如标志、产品标签、密集字幕）需要读取更长的文本，导致部署时性能严重下降。
Method: 通过两轴诊断（编码器宽度轴和解码器时间轴）确定主要失败模式为编码器宽度。提出训练无关的修复：将长文本图像沿宽度方向切分成与模型训练宽度一致的重叠块，每个块独立解码，然后利用几何锚定的编辑距离对齐将各块读取结果拼接为完整文本。
Result: 在长文本基准（LTB）上，该方法在两种基础检查点上分别达到42.79%和43.05%的桶平均词准确率，匹配已发表SOTA（41.57%），并在最难桶上提升11-12个点，推理时间与普通解码持平。直接应用于公开的PARSeq检查点达到47.11%。
Conclusion: 解码侧的切分修复单独即可匹配专门构建的架构性能，微调不再带来额外收益；而表示侧的修复（如旋转缩放、加权微调）仅起到部分改善作用。本文开源了诊断工具和实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniScope: Modality-Decoupled Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance often peaks at different moments. This cross-modal salience mismatch makes unidirectional guidance prone to discarding answer-critical cues under aggressive compression. We propose OmniScope, a training-free token compression framework that uses the query as a shared semantic anchor while estimating relevance separately for audio and video. OmniScope allocates modality-specific token budgets, prunes visual tokens with an anchor-delta strategy that preserves both global context and temporal changes, and merges audio tokens within each second to reduce redundancy while maintaining temporal continuity. Across four audio-video benchmarks and two Qwen2.5-Omni model scales, OmniScope achieves the best average accuracy across all compression settings. At 25% overall token retention, it delivers up to 3.53x prefill speedup and more than 15% GPU memory reduction, with only a 0.35-point drop in average accuracy. These results suggest a simple design principle for OmniLLM inference: share the query across modalities, but not the salience estimates. The code is available at https://github.com/MAC-AutoML/OmniScope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有全模态大模型（OmniLLM）的token压缩方法依赖单一模态指导另一模态保留内容，但同一查询下音频和视频的相关性峰值往往不同步，导致单向引导在激进压缩时丢失答案关键信息。提出OmniScope，一种无需训练的解耦token压缩框架，以查询为共享语义锚点，分别估计音频和视频的相关性，分配模态特定token预算，对视觉token采用锚点-差分策略保留全局上下文和时间变化，对音频每秒内合并以减少冗余并保持时间连续性。在四个音视频基准和两个Qwen2.5-Omni模型规模上，OmniScope在所有压缩设置下取得最佳平均准确率；在25%整体token保留率下，实现高达3.53倍prefill加速和超过15%GPU内存减少，平均准确率仅下降0.35点。
Motivation: 现有token压缩方法假设一个模态可以指导另一模态保留内容，但同一查询下音频和视频的相关性峰值往往不同步，导致单向引导在激进压缩时丢失答案关键信息。
Method: 提出OmniScope框架，使用查询作为共享语义锚点，分别估计音频和视频的相关性；分配模态特定token预算；对视觉token使用锚点-差分策略以保留全局上下文和时间变化；对音频每秒合并以减少冗余并保持时间连续性。
Result: 在四个音视频基准和两个Qwen2.5-Omni模型规模上，OmniScope在所有压缩设置下取得最佳平均准确率；在25%整体token保留率下，实现高达3.53倍prefill加速和超过15%GPU内存减少，平均准确率仅下降0.35点。
Conclusion: 摘要指出全模态大模型推理的一个简单设计原则：共享查询但不共享相关性估计。代码开源。

papers.title: Data-Driven Diffusion Processes on Differential Forms via the Projected Ambient Connection Laplacian
papers.abstract_en: We develop a data-driven approximation of the projected ambient connection Laplacian acting on differential forms over smooth Riemannian manifolds sampled by point clouds. The proposed construction extends the classical framework of diffusion maps and Vector Diffusion Maps from scalar functions and tangent vector fields to differential forms of arbitrary degree. Our approach is based on a novel representation of differential forms as alternating differential arrays obtained through an extension of the classical musical isomorphism. This representation enables the construction of a matrix-valued diffusion operator that approximates the projected ambient connection Laplacian directly from point cloud data without requiring a mesh or simplicial complex. The proposed discretization admits the asymptotically optimal kernel bandwidth scaling inherited from diffusion maps, leading to sharper convergence guarantees than previous data-driven approximations of the Hodge Laplacian. Building upon this operator, we derive a fully data-driven explicit Euler scheme for the heat equation on differential forms and validate the proposed methodology through numerical experiments on the unit sphere. The experiments confirm the predicted decay of the analytical solution and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed discretization. The proposed framework provides a natural generalization of Vector Diffusion Maps to differential forms of arbitrary degree and establishes a practical foundation for the numerical approximation of geometric partial differential equations directly from point cloud data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的方法，通过点云数据近似光滑黎曼流形上作用于微分形式的投影环境连接拉普拉斯算子。该方法将扩散映射和向量扩散映射从标量函数和切向量场推广到任意阶微分形式，利用交替微分阵列表示，无需网格或单纯复形，并具有渐近最优核带宽缩放。数值实验在单位球面上验证了热方程解的衰减。
Motivation: 现有扩散映射方法仅限于标量函数和切向量场，缺乏对高阶微分形式的数据驱动近似，而几何偏微分方程在点云数据上的数值逼近需要此类工具。
Method: 通过扩展经典音乐同构，将微分形式表示为交替微分阵列，构造矩阵值扩散算子以近似投影环境连接拉普拉斯算子。采用扩散映射的渐近最优核带宽缩放，实现无网格离散。
Result: 在单位球面上的数值实验确认了热方程解析解的理论衰减速率，且收敛性保证优于先前数据驱动的Hodge Laplacian近似。
Conclusion: 该框架为任意阶微分形式提供了向量扩散映射的自然推广，为直接从点云数据近似几何偏微分方程奠定了实用基础。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在单位球面上的数值实验确认了热方程解析解的理论衰减速率，且收敛性保证优于先前数据驱动的Hodge Laplacian近似。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为任意阶微分形式提供了向量扩散映射的自然推广，为直接从点云数据近似几何偏微分方程奠定了实用基础。

papers.title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than None: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned code LLMs can be conditioned on a lightweight design-intent header to steer parametric CAD generation, but whether the model actually reads the header's content has not been tested under a metric independent of the conditioning itself, nor with a causal control. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid, sharing no code with the header-defining regex extractor. Across three seeds and a pre-registered {0%, 40%}-prefix $\times$ {correct, wrong, masked}-header matrix we find: (i) in conditional completion (40% prefix), a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the no-header baseline (0.43 $\to$ 0.30/0.21 text/token) on design intents the model can render unconditioned -- polygonal and thin geometries; circle and tall intents sit at a baseline generation floor for this checkpoint ($\approx$0 in both compared arms) and are uninformative for this contrast; (ii) a derangement control -- retrained with shuffled ground-truth headers, identical header marginal but destroyed content correlation -- remains competent yet is immune to wrong headers, while the standard model is not (text headers; interaction significant on 3/3 seeds, p $\leq$ $4.2\times10^{-3}$): the harm requires the learned header$\to$program mapping, excluding the marginal/mechanical distribution-shift confound; (iii) the independent metric deflates the apparent benefit of a correct header (token: +0.21 regex $\to$ +0.02 geometry), quantifying metric circularity; (iv) the harm is regime-specific -- at 0% prefix the unconditioned baseline cannot generate valid CAD at all. Wrong intent is not noise: it actively misdirects generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过精细控制的实验设计，研究CAD程序生成中设计意图头部条件对代码模型行为的影响。在CadQuery风格的草图-拉伸程序中，对Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B进行LoRA微调，使用五个特征的CADCON头部，并通过独立于头部的几何断言重新评分。实验发现：在40%前缀条件下，语义错误的头部会显著降低模型对设计意图的符合度，甚至低于无头部基线（0.43→0.30/0.21，文本/令牌）；通过打乱真实头部的排列控制实验证明，这种损害来自于学习到的头部到程序的映射，而非边缘分布改变；正确头部带来的实际收益被独立度量所削弱（令牌：+0.21正则→+0.02几何），揭示了度量循环性。结论：错误的意图不是噪声，而是主动误导生成。
Motivation: 现有方法使用轻量级设计意图头部条件化CAD生成，但模型是否真正读取头部内容未经独立于条件本身的度量或因果控制测试。
Method: 采用CADCON头部（五个特征），在CadQuery程序上对Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B进行LoRA微调，并通过可执行几何断言（B-rep实体）重新评分。设计3个种子和预注册的{0%,40%}前缀×{正确,错误,掩码}头部矩阵实验，以及打乱真实头部的排列控制（derangement control）来分离因果关系。
Result: 在40%前缀下，语义错误的头部使polygonal和thin几何符合度从无头部baseline（0.43）降至0.30/0.21（文本/令牌）；circle和tall意图因基线生成能力不足（≈0）无法对比。排列控制模型对错误头部免疫，而标准模型在3/3种子上显著受损（p≤4.2×10^{-3}）。正确头部的几何增益被独立度量从+0.21（正则）压缩至+0.02，证明度量循环。
Conclusion: 错误的意图不仅无益，而且会主动误导生成。伤害是机制特有的，而非边缘分布混淆。

papers.title: Fashion-3DLR: A Controllable 3D Garment Generation Using Pairwise Fashion Elements for Intelligent Design
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated content (AIGC) has made significant progress, with 2D generative models becoming ready-to-use tools for the digital fashion industry. However, 3D garment generation remains in its nascent stage, where in the realm of fashion, the semantic information of diverse design elements exhibits intricate coupling relationships in 3D representations, posing substantial challenges for generating diverse 3D garments. In this work, to handle the above problem, We introduce Fashion-3DLR, a novel 3D garment generation framework that utilizes diverse design elements to create high-quality, versatile 3D garment assets. Specifically, to bridge the semantic gaps between different fashion elements, we propose a Garment Feature Fusion Diffusion Transformer (GFF-DiT) module to integrate 2D fashion design elements, e.g., sketch and texture, into latent space. Within the latent space, we then employ a rectified flow transformer to generate geometry latents, which can be decoded into various 3D garment representations, including 3D Gaussians and meshes. Furthermore, we integrate Fashion-3DLR into downstream tasks, achieving the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-driven cloth physical simulation and mesh-based virtual try-on. Experimental results indicate that Fashion-3DLR surpass the previous state-of-the-art methods, which verify that the proposed work can generate well-structured, non-watertight garments capable of physical simulation and virtual try-on, underscoring its potential as a versatile 3D garment design tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fashion-3DLR，一个基于配对时尚元素的可控3D服装生成框架。通过服装特征融合扩散Transformer（GFF-DiT）模块将2D设计元素（如草图、纹理）映射到潜在空间，再利用整流流Transformer生成几何潜在表示，解码为3D高斯或网格。实验表明该方法在生成结构化、非水密性服装方面超越现有方法，并支持物理模拟和虚拟试穿。
Motivation: 现有3D服装生成技术难以处理不同设计元素在3D表示中的语义耦合关系，导致生成多样性受限。
Method: 提出GFF-DiT模块融合2D时尚元素到潜在空间，再使用整流流Transformer生成几何潜在表示，最后解码为3D高斯或网格表示。
Result: 实验表明Fashion-3DLR在生成质量上超越之前最先进方法，生成的服装可用于物理模拟和虚拟试穿。
Conclusion: 该框架可作为通用的3D服装设计工具，但当前工作聚焦于特定时尚元素组合，泛化到更复杂场景需进一步研究。

papers.title: A Scale-adaptive Vision Model Links C. elegans Neuronal Morphology to Behavior for Neurotoxicity Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Neurological disorders are a leading cause of global disability and are increasingly linked to environmental chemical exposures. Yet neurotoxicity assessment still relies on hand-scored morphological readouts that are subjective and poorly predictive of behavioral outcomes. Caenorhabditis elegans provides a genetically tractable, 3R-compliant alternative, but quantifying neuronal phenotypes from confocal microscopy at scale remains computationally challenging: existing vision foundation models, trained on natural or radiological images, cannot resolve the sparse signals and multi-scale lesions of neuronal imaging. Here, we introduce a dedicated self-supervised vision model for C. elegans dopaminergic neurons, together with CeNeuMorph, a multi-grained confocal benchmark of 27,117 annotated images. Specifically, moving beyond standard Masked Autoencoders, we propose a scale-adaptive masked image modeling strategy that jointly learns representations across resolutions and patch sizes under a fixed token budget. By decoupling structural semantic learning from rigid grid constraints, the model effectively resolves the full spectrum of neurodegenerative lesions - ranging from fine dendritic beading to gross soma shrinkage - within a tractable computational framework. Finally, our model surpasses both generalist and biomedical foundation models across classification, segmentation and detection tasks. Fusing visual features with morphological descriptors enables prediction of dopamine-dependent behavioral deficits ($R^2=0.498$). Screening 180 agrochemicals, we identify the benzimidazole moiety as a previously unrecognized determinant of dopaminergic neurotoxicity. Together, the work demonstrates how scale-adaptive self-supervised learning can connect morphology to function for a scalable alternative to mammalian in vivo models for neurotoxicity assessment and drug discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个尺度自适应视觉模型，用于秀丽隐杆线虫多巴胺能神经元的形态分析，结合大规模基准数据集CeNeuMorph（27,117张标注图像）。模型通过尺度自适应掩码图像建模策略，在固定token预算下联合学习多分辨率与多尺度特征，有效捕捉从树突珠串到胞体萎缩的神经退行性病变。在分类、分割和检测任务上超越通用及生物医学基础模型，融合视觉特征与形态描述符可预测多巴胺依赖性行为缺陷（R²=0.498），并在180种农用化学品筛选中发现苯并咪唑基团为未识别的新神经毒性决定因素。
Motivation: 现有神经毒性评估依赖主观的手工形态评分，难以预测行为结果；而秀丽隐杆线虫作为替代模型，其共聚焦显微镜图像的大规模量化面临计算挑战，现有视觉基础模型无法处理神经元成像的稀疏信号和多尺度病变。
Method: 提出尺度自适应掩码图像建模策略（scale-adaptive masked image modeling），在固定token预算下联合学习多分辨率与多尺度的表示，并通过解耦结构语义学习与刚性网格约束来提升对神经退行性病变的解析能力。
Result: 模型在分类、分割和检测任务上超越通用及生物医学基础模型；融合视觉特征与形态描述符预测多巴胺依赖性行为缺陷的R²=0.498；筛选180种农用化学品，识别出苯并咪唑基团为多巴胺能神经毒性的新决定因素。
Conclusion: 本文展示了尺度自适应自监督学习如何将形态与功能联系起来，为神经毒性评估和药物发现提供了一种可扩展的哺乳动物体内模型替代方案。

papers.title: Beyond ICA: Identifiability by Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract_en: We prove the identifiability of deep generative models (DGMs) with piecewise-affine (PWA) decoders and Gaussian mixture model (GMM) priors, in a purely unsupervised setting. We introduce three algebraic contrast principles for symmetry breaking: domain contrast, which trivializes the mixture symmetry group; mechanism contrast, which ensures every decoder branch is witnessed by a unique boundary; and interaction contrast, which forbids parameter conspiracies between latent components and decoder branches. Together they exploit the interplay between the discrete combinatorics of the PWA map and the continuous symmetry structure of the latent GMM. Continuity is replaced by algebraic symmetry conditions; injectivity is decoupled from structural identification and required only for pointwise inversion. Our results form a hierarchy: from law identifiability (LID; latent distribution up to a global affine map) through map identifiability (MID; decoder up to the same map) to posterior and pointwise identifiability. The ICA-form ambiguity emerges under conditions on diagonal component covariances. Assumptions are only on the data-generating process, not on learning methods, except for the interaction contrast. To our knowledge this is the first to make algebraic symmetry-breaking the engine of nonlinear identifiability, the first to admit discontinuous decoders, and the first to handle fully non-injective decoders, where every observation admits multiple latent codes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了在纯无监督设置下，具有分段仿射解码器和高斯混合模型先验的深度生成模型的可识别性。通过引入三种代数对比原则（领域对比、机制对比、交互对比）打破对称性，建立了从分布可识别性到逐点可识别性的层次结构。这是首次将代数对称破缺作为非线性可识别性的引擎，并允许非连续和非单射解码器。
Motivation: 非线性ICA（独立成分分析）的可识别性长期缺乏一般性理论保证，现有方法通常依赖连续性和单射假设。本文旨在通过代数对称性条件替代连续性，解决深度生成模型在无监督下的识别问题。
Method: 提出三种代数对比原则：领域对比（平凡化混合对称群）、机制对比（确保每个解码器分支被唯一边界见证）、交互对比（禁止潜在分量与解码器分支之间的参数共谋）。利用分段仿射映射的离散组合结构与潜在高斯混合模型连续对称性之间的相互作用。
Result: 建立了可识别性的层次：从律明性（LID，潜在分布至多全局仿射映射）到映射可识别性（MID，解码器至多相同映射）再到后验和逐点可识别性。ICA形式的不确定性在对角协方差条件下出现。
Conclusion: 本文方法仅依赖于数据生成过程的假设，不依赖学习方法，首次将代数对称破缺作为非线性可识别性的核心机制，并处理了非连续和非单射解码器。

papers.title: Towards Dual-Brain Minimal Sufficient Representation for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to ground language in egocentric observations and plan in unseen scenes. Although recent multimodal large models and world-model-based methods have improved navigation, they often preserve excessive task-irrelevant detail, weakening generalization and increasing computational burden. We propose BrainNav, a navigation framework grounded in the Principle of Minimal Sufficiency. BrainNav consists of three components: a Logical Anchor Model that implements instruction-aware selective perception to suppress environmental noise, a Minimalist Constraint Alignment module that serves as a compact cross-modal bottleneck, efficiently synchronizing discrete linguistic intent with continuous latent dynamics while filtering out redundant information, and a Compression World Model that predicts action-conditioned states within a condensed, low-rank latent space. These modules align semantic intent with spatial perception, enhancing the agent's robustness and efficiency in complex tasks. Experiments show that BrainNav improves over prior SOTA by 2.0 % / 1.0 in SR/SPL on R2R-CE val-unseen and 0.94 % / 0.78 on RxR-CE val-unseen. These results indicate that minimally sufficient world representations provide an effective foundation for robust VLN.

papers.title: Beyond a Global Norm: Personalizing Toxicity Sensitivity in Language Models Without Retraining
papers.abstract_en: Reducing toxicity is often framed as a global alignment problem, yet perceptions of harmful language are subjective and context-dependent. We present the first comparative evaluation of training-free methods for aligning language generation to user-specific toxicity sensitivities across three inference-time intervention stages: pre-decoding (prompt conditioning and rewriting), in-decoding (token, logit, and representation steering), and post-decoding (candidate re-ranking). Evaluated against toxicity sensitivity targets derived from the PRISM dataset, all methods reduce alignment error by 28-47%. However, the results reveal a fundamental trade-off between alignment effectiveness, personalization, and general language quality, showing how toxicity sensitivity alignment is an inherently multi-objective problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统比较了无需重新训练的方法，用于将语言模型的生成结果个性化对齐到用户特定的毒性敏感性（toxicity sensitivity）。研究覆盖了解码前（prompt条件化与重写）、解码中（token、logit与表示导向）以及解码后（候选重排序）三个干预阶段，并在PRISM数据集的目标上评估。所有方法均将对齐误差降低了28-47%，但结果显示对齐效果、个性化程度与通用语言质量之间存在根本性权衡，表明毒性敏感性对齐本质上是一个多目标问题。
Motivation: 现有毒性减少方法通常作为全局对齐问题处理，但有害语言的感知具有主观性和上下文依赖性。本文旨在探索无需重新训练即可将语言模型生成个性化对齐到用户特定毒性敏感性的方法。
Method: 比较了三种干预阶段下的训练无关方法：解码前（prompt条件化与重写）、解码中（token、logit与表示导向）和解码后（候选重排序）。以PRISM数据集导出的毒性敏感性目标作为评估标准。
Result: 所有方法均使对齐误差降低28-47%，但揭示了对齐效果、个性化与语言质量之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 毒性敏感性对齐是一个多目标问题，不同方法在不同目标上有不同表现，需要根据具体需求选择。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Scale Forecasting and Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction for Multivariate Nonstationary Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We propose ABF-T-GLCP, a model-agnostic framework for forecasting and uncertainty quantification in nonstationary multivariate time series. The central idea is to learn an adaptive predictive state representation for point forecasting and reuse it for conformal calibration. The forecasting module combines horizon-specific temporal experts through a learned gate and refines predictions using sparse predictive transfer across related series. The uncertainty module, Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction (GLCP), uses the learned gate state, together with temporal recency, to select locally relevant calibration residuals, thereby coupling uncertainty calibration to the predictive regimes used by the forecasting model. This shared representation allows point forecasts and prediction intervals to adapt consistently under evolving temporal dynamics while retaining the model-agnostic nature of conformal prediction and yielding approximate local coverage under mild stability conditions. Experiments on a large-scale high-frequency commodity forecasting benchmark show consistent gains in point forecasting accuracy and substantially narrower prediction intervals with empirical coverage close to the nominal level. Additional results indicate that the framework extends beyond the motivating financial application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ABF-T-GLCP框架，用于非平稳多元时间序列的点预测与不确定性量化。核心思想是学习自适应预测状态表示，并通过门控机制融合不同时间尺度的专家预测，同时利用稀疏预测传递跨序列信息。不确定性量化模块GLCP使用门控状态和时间近邻性选择局部校准残差，实现预测区间与预测模型的动态适配。在高频商品预测基准上，该方法在点预测精度和区间宽度上均取得一致改进，且经验覆盖接近名义水平。
Motivation: 现有方法在非平稳多元时间序列预测中难以同时保证点预测精度和可靠的不确定性量化，特别是当时间动态变化时，需要自适应地调整预测模型和校准区间。
Method: 提出基于自适应基函数变换（ABF）的预测状态表示，通过门控网络组合不同时间深度的专家预测，并采用稀疏预测传输机制在相关序列间共享信息。不确定性量化采用门控局部化保形预测（GLCP），利用门控状态和时间近邻性选择校准残差，实现局部覆盖近似。
Result: 在大规模高频商品预测基准上，点预测精度持续提升，预测区间显著更窄且经验覆盖接近名义水平。额外实验表明框架可推广至金融以外的领域。
Conclusion: 该框架模型无关，能自适应非平稳动态，同时保持保形预测的灵活性，在多种时间序列任务中具有潜力。

papers.title: CachedSearch: Training-Free Cached Exploration for Test-Time Search in Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Test-time search lets small video diffusion models rival larger ones, but costs 2-10x more. All candidates are fully denoised, although most are discarded. Training-free caching makes each rollout 2-3x faster at near-lossless quality. Composition is safe only if lossy caching preserves verifier rankings. We present the first study of whether caching corrupts candidate ranking in video test-time search. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with an adaptive caching wrapper (~2x per-candidate speedup), ImageReward scores seed-matched cached and full rollouts. Median per-prompt Spearman rank correlation is 0.905, with 72% top-1 agreement on the VBench suite. VBench-2.0 replicates this result on a harder suite. Recomputing the cached winner at full compute retains 90-94% of the full-search gain. Errors cluster among near-tied candidates, making corruption self-limiting. This finding leads to CachedSearch. It explores every candidate with aggressive caching, then re-generates only the winner at full compute. At N=8, it captures 94.7% of best-of-N's gain at 63% of the cost. Capture rises with width. At matched budget, it searches twice as wide for 38% more gain. The result holds from 1.3B-14B across six models and four families: Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, and Hunyuan. Wan2.1-14B matches the 1.3B model's fidelity. Mid-trajectory pruning multiplies the exploration saving to 3.11x at 88.6% capture. Ports to other model families require recalibrating a single parameter, showing that fidelity tracks architecture rather than parameter count. CachedSearch is training-free, verifier-agnostic, and orthogonal to the search algorithm, making it a plug-in multiplier for test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视频扩散模型测试时搜索中的缓存问题，提出一种无需训练的缓存方法CachedSearch，在几乎不损失质量的情况下加快每个候选的生成速度。实验表明，缓存不会严重破坏候选排名，且在Wan、LTX、CogVideoX、Hunyuan等模型族上一致有效。CachedSearch可作为测试时扩展的即插即用因子。
Motivation: 测试时搜索虽能让小模型媲美大模型，但代价是2-10倍的计算开销，且大部分候选被丢弃。现有训练无关缓存可加速每轮生成，但可能影响验证器排名，需要研究缓存是否会破坏候选排序。
Method: 提出CachedSearch：先用激进缓存探索所有候选，再只用完整计算重新生成胜出候选。采用自适应缓存包装，约2倍加速，并在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上验证排名相关性。
Result: Mediam每提示Spearman秩相关为0.905，72% top-1一致。在N=8时，CachedSearch以63%成本捕获94.7%的best-of-N增益。跨1.3B-14B六模型四系列一致有效。
Conclusion: 缓存导致的自相关错误限于几乎平局候选，具有自限性。CachedSearch无需训练、与验证器无关、与搜索算法正交，可作为测试时扩展的即插即用因子。移植到其他模型族只需重新校准一个参数。
