TL;DR: 本文提出 JAGG（Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient），利用扩散轨迹中隐藏状态和速度预测的线性近似特性，将 GRPO 训练扩散模型时每组连续 W 步的完整 Transformer 反向传播从 W 次减少为仅 2 次。通过 t 加权插值端点雅可比矩阵并聚合上游信号，实现约 2 倍反向加速，且在文生图基准上质量损失可忽略。
Motivation: GRPO 应用于扩散模型时，每一步都需要通过高容量 DiT 骨干反向传播，计算代价巨大，成为高分辨率文生图训练的瓶颈。
Method: JAGG 利用 DiT 隐藏状态和速度预测沿轨迹平滑近似线性变化的特点，通过 t 加权插值中间步骤的雅可比矩阵，将每步上游信号聚合为两个复合梯度，仅通过一次联合反向传播施加。同时使用余弦相似度路由规则决定是否应用 JAGG。
Result: 在文生图基准上实现约 2 倍反向传播加速，质量几乎无下降。
Conclusion: 摘要证明当速度在 (z, t) 中线性时插值是精确的，实验验证了加速效果和保持质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Interpreting Quantum Learning Models via Stochastic Processes
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning models define probabilistic input--output maps through coherent quantum evolution and measurement. While such models can exhibit computational advantages, their internal functioning and decision making generally resists interpretation in terms of stochastic trajectories through intermediate configurations. In contrast to classical (Markovian) stochastic processes, quantum dynamics generically violates the Chapman--Kolmogorov divisibility condition, preventing a decomposition into probabilistically meaningful intermediate transitions. We develop a probabilistic framework for representing quantum learning models as stochastic processes over configuration spaces where the dynamics are modeled as linear maps on probability distributions. Starting from a fixed POVM, arbitrary quantum channels induce transition kernels on the associated probability representation. For informationally complete POVMs, and in particular SIC-POVMs, these kernels are Markovian but generally quasi-stochastic, with non-classicality appearing as negativity. By contrast, projective spaces admit positive stochastic kernels but generally require non-Markovian dynamics due to the failure of Chapman--Kolmogorov divisibility. This yields a trade-off between negativity and dependence on past configurations, i.e. quantum dynamics can be represented either by Markovian quasi-stochastic maps or by positive stochastic processes with higher Markov order. We discuss how such representations of quantum dynamics can be interpreted as stochastic walks through a memory space in the spirit of Projective Simulation, a model of learning and agency in which decisions arise from random walks over an episodic memory network. We further outline how finite-order stochastic kernels can approximate such quantum deliberation processes and show in what regimes the classical machine learning model is recovered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个概率框架，将量子学习模型表示为配置空间上的随机过程。通过固定POVM，量子通道诱导转移核，信息完备POVM产生马尔可夫但准随机的核（非经典性表现为负性），而投影空间产生正随机核但通常需要非马尔可夫动力学。该表示揭示了量子动力学中负性与过去依赖之间的权衡，并讨论了如何将量子决策过程近似为有限阶随机核，恢复经典机器学习模型。
Motivation: 量子机器学习模型的内部工作机制难以用随机轨迹解释，因为量子动力学一般违反Chapman-Kolmogorov可分解条件。
Method: 基于固定POVM，将量子通道表示为概率表示上的线性映射，推导转移核。分别分析信息完备POVM（如SIC-POVM）和投影空间的核性质。
Result: 信息完备POVM产生马尔可夫准随机核（存在负性），投影空间产生正随机核但非马尔可夫。两者之间的权衡表明量子动力学可表示为马尔可夫准随机映射或更高阶马尔可夫的随机过程。
Conclusion: 该框架可解释为记忆空间上的随机游走，与投影模拟（Projective Simulation）学习模型一致，并展示了如何用有限阶随机核近似量子决策过程。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Cross-Modal Fusion for Adult-to-Pediatric ECG Transfer via Label-Conditioned Contrastive Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Adult and pediatric electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation relies on age-sensitive criteria, and models pretrained mainly on adult ECGs often transfer poorly to pediatric populations when pediatric labels are scarce. Existing multimodal ECG--text methods typically align waveforms and text at the global sample level, entangling evidence from co-occurring diagnoses and limiting transfer under this gap. We propose Pediatric-Adult ECG Alignment via Cross-modal Enhancement (PEACE), a knowledge-guided framework pretrained on the largely adult MIMIC-IV ECG corpus. PEACE describes each diagnosis along rhythm, morphology, and ST--T axes and, per recording, composes only positive-label descriptors into three axis tokens and a fused embedding. A label query network (LQN) uses diagnostic labels as queries to cross-attend over ECG tokens and axis tokens, while label set aware bidirectional contrastive learning (LSBC) aligns pooled ECG features with the fused embedding when recordings share diagnoses. Curriculum adaptive fusion (CAF) gates alignment strength according to smoothed classification loss and training progress, limiting disruption during early optimization. The knowledge branch is used only for training supervision; inference uses ECG signals alone. On ZZU-pECG, PEACE reaches macro average AUCs of 59.39%, 81.74%, and 91.56% under zero-shot, 50-shot, and full fine-tuning, with the clearest gains over foundation and knowledge-pretraining baselines under limited supervision; versus domain adaptation initializations, zero-shot improves substantially while 50-shot AUC is comparable to DANN. After fine-tuning on PTB-XL, PEACE reaches 96.90% macro average AUC over nine harmonized labels. Ablations confirm that label-conditioned knowledge alignment, rather than global text fusion, is the key driver of pediatric transfer gains.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PEACE框架，利用知识引导的跨模态融合将成人ECG模型迁移到儿童ECG，通过标签条件对比对齐解决成人-儿童ECG解释中的年龄敏感性差异。在ZZU-pECG数据集上，零样本、50样本和全微调设置下宏平均AUC分别达到59.39%、81.74%和91.56%，且仅需ECG信号即可推理。
Motivation: 现有ECG模型主要基于成人数据预训练，直接迁移到儿童人群时因儿科标签稀缺而效果不佳。多模态ECG-文本方法通常在样本级别对齐，混淆了共现诊断，限制了跨年龄迁移。
Method: 提出PEACE框架，包含：(1) 将每个诊断沿节律、形态、ST-T轴描述，并为每个记录构建轴标记和融合嵌入；(2) 标签查询网络(LQN)使用诊断标签作为查询对ECG标记和轴标记进行交叉注意力；(3) 标签集感知双向对比学习(LSBC)在共享诊断的记录间对齐池化ECG特征与融合嵌入；(4) 课程自适应融合(CAF)根据分类损失平滑值和训练进度调整对齐强度。知识分支仅用于训练监督，推理仅用ECG信号。
Result: 在ZZU-pECG数据集上，PEACE在零样本、50样本和全微调下宏平均AUC分别为59.39%、81.74%和91.56%，在有限监督下相比基线和知识预训练基线提升最明显；与域适应初始化相比，零样本显著提升，50样本AUC与DANN相当。在PTB-XL上微调后，九个统一标签的宏平均AUC达到96.90%。
Conclusion: 标签条件知识对齐是儿科迁移增益的关键驱动因素，而非全局文本融合。

papers.title: The One-Word Census: Answer-Choice Conformity Across 44 Language Models
papers.abstract_en: When a language model must pick one answer from a large space of equally valid options, which does it pick -- and how often is it the same answer every other model picks? Asked to "pick a word -- any word," 44 models chose "serendipity" 41% of the time. We characterize this convergence with a deliberately minimal instrument: 31 single-turn prompts, each naming a category with many valid one-word answers ("Name a tree."), asked four times per model with no system prompt. Analysis is exact-match on normalized tokens -- no embeddings, no judge -- at about a dollar per model. That models converge is well documented; our contribution is the instrument itself -- the One-Word Census -- and what it reveals about the structure of the convergence. We score each model by answer-choice surprisal: the average $-\log2$ probability of its answers under the pooled answers of all other models, leave-one-out. Convergence is extreme -- in 7 of 31 categories one answer takes over 80% of all answers -- yet conformity varies more than fourfold across models, and the variation is structured. Persona- and community-tuned models are the most divergent; the newest mainline flagships are the most conformist, producing almost no answer no other model gave. Within four lineages (Claude, GPT, Qwen, Grok) conformity rises with each generation -- but reverses for the latest flagship Claude and GPT models, a possible early signal of repositioning at the top tier. Rankings are robust to roster composition (leave-one-family-out rho = 0.985). Against human category-production norms, the field is more concentrated than people in 18 of 20 shared categories. All prompts, transcripts, and code are public.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Data, prompts, and code: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个简单的工具“One-Word Census”，用于测量语言模型在从大量有效选项中选择一个答案时的一致性。对44个模型使用31个类别（如“命名一棵树”）进行测试，发现模型之间存在高度收敛性（例如“serendipity”被选中的概率为41%），但不同模型的从众程度差异超过四倍，且这种差异具有结构：人物角色和社区调优的模型最不随大流，而最新的主流旗舰模型最从众。跨代际（Claude、GPT、Qwen、Grok）一致性上升，但最新旗舰出现反转。人类在20个共享类别中的18个比模型更多样化。
Motivation: 研究语言模型在同样有效的选项中如何选择，以及它们之间的一致性程度，特别是这种收敛的结构和变化。
Method: 设计一个包含31个单轮提示的“One-Word Census”，每个提示要求一个类别中的一个词（如“Name a tree”），对每个模型重复提问4次，不使用系统提示。分析采用精确匹配规范化token，不使用嵌入或评判器，每个模型成本约一美元。
Result: 在31个类别中，7个类别的一个答案占据超过80%的回答；模型间一致性变化超过四倍；人物角色和社区调优模型最不随大流，新旗舰模型最从众；跨代际（Claude、GPT、Qwen、Grok）一致性上升，但最新旗舰出现反转。人类在20个共享类别中比模型更多样化（18个类别上更集中）。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了One-Word Census工具及其揭示的语言模型回答收敛的结构性差异，所有提示、对话和代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-dimensional training-priority weighting based on physical information propagation paths: a unified residual-weighting framework for physics-informed neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown promise for solving partial differential equations (PDEs); however, their synchronous optimization treats residuals of different regions and constraints equally, which is inconsistent with the progressive "from source to response" physical information propagation path, degrading training stability and accuracy. Existing causal training methods focus mainly on the temporal dimension, lacking a unified characterization of spatial and boundary dimensions. To address this, we define a unified class of training priorities according to the physical information propagation path: premise regions should be learned before dependent regions; temporal, spatial, and boundary priorities are instances of this principle. Using neural tangent kernel (NTK) dynamics, we theoretically analyze why standard PINNs do not obey this priority: their residual convergence order is governed by the NTK spectrum and is independent of the propagation path. Accordingly, we propose a unified multi-dimensional priority-constraint framework that partitions the domain along the propagation path and constructs negative-exponential residual weights, converting the physical propagation order into a training priority. For cases with coexisting priorities, we introduce a directional compatibility coefficient to clarify that "orthogonal directions can be coupled multiplicatively in synergy, whereas coaxial opposite directions cannot." Benchmark cases show that this method consistently improves the convergence behavior and prediction accuracy of PINNs on problems with clear propagation paths or constraint-dominated structures, without modifying the network architecture and with controllable additional computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在多区域多约束同步优化时忽略物理信息传播路径的问题，定义了一类统一的训练优先级：前提区域应先于依赖区域学习。理论分析表明标准PINN的残差收敛顺序由神经正切核（NTK）谱决定，与传播路径无关。提出一个统一的多维优先级约束框架，沿传播路径划分区域并构造负指数残差权重，将物理传播顺序转化为训练优先级；对共存优先级引入方向兼容系数。基准算例表明该方法在不修改网络架构且计算开销可控的前提下，在具有清晰传播路径或约束主导结构的问题上持续提升了PINN的收敛行为和预测精度。
Motivation: 标准PINN的同步优化对所有区域和约束的残差平等对待，不符合物理信息从源到响应的渐进传播路径，导致训练不稳定和精度下降。现有因果训练方法主要关注时间维度，缺乏对空间和边界维度的统一刻画。
Method: 提出统一的多维优先级约束框架：根据物理信息传播路径定义前提区域和依赖区域；利用神经正切核（NTK）动力学理论分析标准PINN不遵循优先级的原因；构造负指数残差权重以转化传播顺序为训练优先级；针对共存优先级引入方向兼容系数（正交方向可乘法耦合，同轴相反方向不能）。
Result: 基准算例表明该方法在不修改网络架构且计算开销可控的前提下，在具有清晰传播路径或约束主导结构的PINN问题上持续提升了收敛行为和预测精度。
Conclusion: 该框架为PINN提供了一个统一的多维训练优先级机制，将物理传播顺序融入优化过程，扩展了因果训练的思路；但需要针对具体问题设计传播路径划分，且未讨论与其他正则化方法的结合。

papers.title: How Do Practitioners Build SE Agents? Insights from a Mixed-Methods Study
papers.abstract_en: The rise of Software Engineering (SE) agents, i.e., LLM-based agents that can understand large codebases and carry out engineering tasks with limited human intervention, has been marked by rapid advances and adoption, but little is known about how developers build these systems in practice: existing studies mine repositories or examine deployment, but few investigate how SE agents are constructed. Through semi-structured interviews with 20 practitioners from 12 organizations and an online survey of 80 practitioners, this paper is the first to study how SE processes are changing in the development of SE agents and what challenges developers face. We find that as implementation becomes cheaper, bottlenecks shift rather than disappear: long-standing work in requirements, coordination, and deployment becomes more visible, while reviewing generated code and evaluating agent behavior become new and increasingly central forms of work. We characterize a seven-stage workflow and five process shifts, including a move toward evaluation-driven development, in which evaluation is increasingly defined early and steers iteration, and the emergence of specifications as first-class artifacts that teams test and version alongside code. We further identify six challenges that teams face, together with 12 corresponding practices they use or propose to address them, including unreliable evaluation signals, comprehension debt as code outpaces understanding, and behavioral changes introduced by provider-side model updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对20位从业者的半结构化访谈和80位从业者的在线调查，首次系统研究了软件工程（SE）Agent的构建实践。研究发现，随着实现成本降低，瓶颈从实现转向需求、协调和部署，代码审查和Agent行为评估成为新的核心工作。论文总结了七个阶段的工作流和五个过程转变，包括评估驱动开发以及规格说明作为一等工件，并识别了六个挑战及十二种应对实践。
Motivation: 尽管SE Agent被广泛采用，但实践中如何构建这些系统尚不清楚——现有研究主要挖掘仓库或考察部署，缺乏对构建过程的深入理解。
Method: 采用混合方法：对来自12个组织的20名从业者进行半结构化访谈，并开展80名从业者的在线调查，以收集构建SE Agent的实践、工作流和挑战。
Result: 识别出七个阶段的工作流和五个过程转变，包括评估驱动开发（评估提前定义并指导迭代）和规格说明作为一等工件。发现六个挑战（如不可靠的评估信号、理解债务、模型更新导致的行为变化）和十二种应对实践。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了SE Agent开发中实践变化和持续存在的瓶颈，为从业者提供了结构化的工作流和挑战应对策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What You See Is What You Get: Observation-Aligned Supervision for Chart-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Chart-to-code generation is commonly trained with supervised fine-tuning on reference plotting scripts, implicitly treating the gold code as a fully observable target. We argue that this assumption is often invalid: many chart programs contain latent raw variables that cannot be uniquely recovered from the rendered image. We identify this systematic latent--observation mismatch with three forms: aggregation-induced mismatch, where raw samples are reduced to summary statistics or bin-level mass; normalization-induced mismatch, where absolute scale is removed; and projection-induced mismatch, where higher-dimensional information is lost through visual projection. These mismatches introduce target ambiguity and require models to complete information unsupported by the image. We propose Observation-Aligned Supervision, which replaces latent targets with visually constrained quantities. We instantiate it for boxplots, histograms, and pie charts using box statistics, bin weights, and wedge proportions, respectively, and study projection-induced mismatch through a controlled 3D scatter experiment. Across multiple VLMs on ChartMimic and ChartX, our rewritten supervision improves observable-value recovery, including under both-executable evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出图表到代码生成任务中常用的监督微调假设参考代码是完全可观察的，但实际上许多图表程序包含潜在原始变量，无法从渲染图像唯一恢复。作者识别出三种潜在-观察不匹配形式：聚合诱导、归一化诱导和投影诱导，并提出观察对齐监督方法，用视觉可约束的量替换潜在目标。在boxplots、histograms和pie charts上实例化，并在ChartMimic和ChartX上评估，改进了可观察值的恢复。
Motivation: 现有图表到代码生成训练假设参考代码是完全可观察目标，但实际中存在潜在原始变量无法从图像唯一恢复，导致目标歧义，需要模型补充图像不支持的信息。
Method: 提出观察对齐监督(Observation-Aligned Supervision)，用视觉可约束量替换潜在目标。对于boxplots使用箱线统计量，histograms使用bin权重，pie charts使用扇形比例。还通过受控3D散点实验研究投影诱导不匹配。
Result: 在ChartMimic和ChartX上，使用多个VLM进行实验，观察对齐监督改进了可观察值恢复，包括在双可执行评估下。
Conclusion: 通过识别和解决潜在-观察不匹配，观察对齐监督提高了图表到代码生成中可观察值恢复的准确性。

papers.title: XS-VLA: Coupling Coarse-grained Spatial Distillation with Latent Flow Matching for Lightweight Robotic Control
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong multimodal understanding and spatial grounding, but their computational cost limits real-time robotic control. In contrast, lightweight models are suitable for edge deployment but often suffer from "spatial blindness", namely weak native spatial prediction ability. Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on mixed human demonstrations can also degrade policy performance due to highly diverse behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose XS-VLA, a two-stage framework for efficient and spatially grounded robotic manipulation. First, we distill spatial semantic knowledge from Qwen3-VL-4B into the SmolVLM2-0.25B backbone by fine-tuning on curated coarse-grained spatial descriptions, turning the lightweight model into a spatially grounded engine. Second, we use this enhanced backbone to condition a Latent Flow Matching policy. Unlike deterministic controllers, our policy combines a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) with Flow Matching dynamics to model complex multimodal action distributions. On the LIBERO benchmark, XS-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance among models with fewer than 0.5B parameters. It improves average success rates by up to 7.2 percent, including a 23 percent gain on LIBERO-Long, over the SmolVLA 0.25B baseline, and outperforms the larger 2.2B vanilla SmolVLA. Ablations show that spatial tuning and generative latent flow control substantially improve lightweight VLA performance, delivering a 3.2 times speedup in mission execution over the previous lightweight flow matching policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XS-VLA，一个两阶段框架，用于高效的、具有空间定位能力的轻量级机器人操作。第一阶段将大视觉语言模型（Qwen3-VL-4B）的空间语义知识蒸馏到小模型（SmolVLM2-0.25B），第二阶段使用增强后的骨干网络作为条件，结合CVAE和流匹配（Flow Matching）来建模多模态动作分布。在LIBERO基准上，XS-VLA在少于0.5B参数的模型中取得最优性能，平均成功率提升7.2%，在LIBERO-Long上提升23%，优于更大的2.2B基线模型。
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型计算成本高，难以用于实时机器人控制；而轻量模型存在“空间盲”问题，且混合人类演示训练会因行为多样性导致策略性能下降。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过微调粗粒度空间描述，从Qwen3-VL-4B向SmolVLM2-0.25B蒸馏空间语义知识；第二阶段使用增强后的骨干网络作为条件，结合条件变分自编码器（CVAE）与流匹配（Flow Matching）生成动作，避免确定性控制器的局限性。
Result: 在LIBERO基准上，XS-VLA在少于0.5B参数的模型中达到最高性能，平均成功率比SmolVLA 0.25B基线提升7.2%（LIBERO-Long上提升23%），并优于2.2B的SmolVLA；任务执行速度比先前轻量流匹配策略提升3.2倍。
Conclusion: 空间调优和生成式潜在流控制显著提升轻量VLA模型的性能，所提框架在效率与空间定位能力之间取得平衡，适合边缘部署。

papers.title: From World Models to World Action Models: A Concise Tutorial for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Rather than providing an exhaustive survey, this paper presents a concise tutorial on world models and world action models for robotics. After reading the tutorial, readers should have a clear understanding of what constitutes a "world", how world models and world action models are defined, and what roles they play within robotic AI systems. The tutorial also develops a unified perspective for comparing representative approaches, such as World Labs' spatial intelligence models, Yann LeCun's JEPA framework, and NVIDIA's Cosmos platform, and clarifies how these models differ in their representations, predictive capabilities, and interaction mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向机器人的世界模型与世界行动模型的简明教程，旨在帮助读者理解‘世界’的构成、世界模型与世界行动模型的定义及其在机器人AI系统中的作用。教程还提供了统一视角来比较World Labs的空间智能模型、Yann LeCun的JEPA框架和NVIDIA的Cosmos平台等代表性方法，并澄清它们在表示、预测能力和交互机制上的差异。
Motivation: 机器人领域缺乏对世界模型与世界行动模型的统一、简洁的教程性介绍，尤其缺少对主流框架的横向比较，导致初学者难以快速形成清晰认知。
Method: 采用教程形式，通过逐步解释核心概念、定义与分类，并基于统一视角对比多种代表性方法（如空间智能模型、JEPA、Cosmos）的表示、预测和交互机制。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但预期读者能获得对世界模型与世界行动模型的系统性理解。
Conclusion: 本文强调其教程性质，旨在为机器人研究者提供清晰的概念框架，而非发表新方法或新结果。

papers.title: Ground4D: Consistency-Aware 4D Reconstruction from Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: Learning a 4D scene representation from a single monocular video that supports dynamic novel-view synthesis while maintaining faithful geometry over time remains challenging. Dynamic Gaussian Splatting achieves strong rendering performance through photometric optimization, yet does not explicitly enforce multi-view geometric consistency. In contrast, 3D foundation models recover coherent scene geometry and camera motion, but their point-based outputs are not designed for photorealistic rendering. We propose Ground4D, a geometry-grounded framework built on two stages. First, we perform geometry initialization via 3D foundation models, leveraging VGGT in a training-free manner to reconstruct multi-view-consistent 3D geometry and camera poses from monocular video. The recovered geometry provides a structured and reliable initialization for dynamic Gaussian representations. Second, we conduct geometry-consistency-aware refinement via dynamic Gaussian Splatting, optimizing the representation through differentiable rendering while maintaining multi-view geometric consistency across both observed and synthesized viewpoints. Furthermore, Ground4D inherently models the continuous 4D dynamics of the scene, naturally supporting rendering at arbitrary timestamps. By integrating foundation-level geometric priors into dynamic Gaussian optimization, Ground4D achieves stronger reconstruction fidelity and rendering performance, underscoring the role of geometry-grounded constraints in robust 4D scene modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ground4D，一个从单目视频进行4D场景重建的框架，结合3D基础模型（VGGT）进行几何初始化，然后通过动态高斯溅射进行几何一致性感知的精化，实现动态新视角合成和忠实几何重建。
Motivation: 单目视频动态场景重建中，动态高斯溅射缺乏多视图几何一致性约束，而3D基础模型虽能恢复几何但无法用于照片级渲染，现有方法难以兼顾两者。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用3D基础模型VGGT以训练无关的方式从单目视频重建多视图一致的3D几何和相机位姿，为动态高斯表示提供结构化初始化；第二阶段通过动态高斯溅射进行可微渲染优化，同时保持观测和合成视角下的多视图几何一致性。
Result: 摘要声称Ground4D在重建保真度和渲染性能上达到更强效果，并支持任意时间戳的连续4D动态渲染。
Conclusion: 几何基础约束在鲁棒4D场景建模中起关键作用，集成基础几何先验到动态高斯优化中提升了性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要声称Ground4D在重建保真度和渲染性能上达到更强效果，并支持任意时间戳的连续4D动态渲染。
summary_sections.conclusion: 几何基础约束在鲁棒4D场景建模中起关键作用，集成基础几何先验到动态高斯优化中提升了性能。

papers.title: Neural Machine Translation for Low-Resource Tangkhul--English
papers.abstract_en: We present a study on low-resource machine translation for the Tangkhul-English (nmf-en) language pair. Tangkhul is a severely under-resourced Tibeto-Burman language spoken primarily in Manipur, India, with virtually no prior natural language processing infrastructure. We describe two systems: (1) a primary system based on ByT5-large fine-tuned on 38,336 Tangkhul-English parallel sentence pairs, and (2) a contrastive system based on mT5-small fine-tuned on the same corpus. Our primary ByT5-large system achieves a corpus BLEU score of 39.97, chrF++ of 58.07, BERTScore F1 of 0.8104, and COMET (wmt22-comet-da) of 0.7302 on a held-out test set of 3,856 sentences. We further discuss the orthographic challenges specific to Tangkhul's Latin-script diacritics, the domain bias of our training corpus (which comprises biblical text, stories, and conversational data), and avenues for future improvement through data diversification and domain adaptation.

papers.title: Infinitesimal Causality
papers.abstract_en: Interventions can be varied continuously in many causal models. Differentiating a specified smooth intervention protocol produces vector fields on a statistical model, and their Lie brackets describe the noncommutativity of the corresponding local perturbations. We formulate this differential geometry of interventions on smooth statistical models and call the resulting framework infinitesimal causality (IC). Given a constant-rank distribution spanned by visible intervention fields, we define the normal Lie-bracket residual and show that its vanishing is exactly the involutivity condition in the classical Frobenius theorem. We establish the coordinate invariance of the zero-residual property and characterize its dependence on the intervention protocol, visible span, and metric. Fully observed and latent-variable examples delineate the additional structural assumptions needed to interpret bracket residuals causally. We also distinguish tangent vectors on a statistical parameter manifold from derivatives of stochastic kernels. In the finite-state linearization of a Markov category, normalization and copy compatibility yield well-typed first-order defects. Normalization is automatic for differentiable paths of stochastic kernels, whereas copy compatibility characterizes a more restrictive deterministic or comonoid-preserving perturbation. Together, the geometric and kernel-level constructions make IC a precise foundation for Lie-bracket-based causal diagnostics and identify the assumptions required to pass from local intervention geometry to causal conclusions.
papers.comment: Revised version with substantial corrections and expanded exposition. We clarify the categorical and tangent semantics of $\mathsf{Stat}_\infty$, and recast the three IC rules as tangent-level compatibility tests. We also add corrected examples, counterexamples delimiting the causal interpretation of Lie-bracket residuals, and new diagrammatic explanations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个新框架，称为无穷小因果性（Infinitesimal Causality, IC），用微分几何研究平滑统计模型上连续变化的干预。通过向量场和Lie括号定义正常Lie括号残差，将其消失等价于Frobenius定理中的可积条件，并探讨了残差为零的性质及其对因果解释所需的结构假设。
Motivation: 现有因果模型多数假设干预是离散的，但许多实际场景中干预可连续变化；缺乏统一的微分几何框架来处理连续干预及其非交换性。
Method: 利用向量场和Lie括号的微分几何工具，在平滑统计模型上定义干预的导数，通过正常Lie括号残差刻画局部扰动的非交换性；区分参数流形上的切向量与随机核的导数，并在有限状态马尔可夫范畴的线性化中引入归一化和复制兼容性条件。
Result: 证明了零残差性质等价于Frobenius定理中的可积条件，具有坐标不变性，并依赖于干预协议、可见张成和度量；通过有限状态马尔可夫范畴的例子阐明了从局部干预几何到因果结论所需的结构假设。
Conclusion: 该框架为基于Lie括号的因果诊断提供了精确基础，并明确了从局部干预几何得出因果结论所需的结构假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Intent-Governed Tool Authorization for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly act through external tools: they read private data, construct structured payloads, submit write requests, export records, and coordinate workflows across application boundaries. Existing authorization mechanisms usually ask whether an integration credential, app, or token can call a tool. That question is necessary but incomplete. A tool call can be authorized by static credentials and still be unjustified by the user's current request. For example, a credential that can read and export records should not expose export authority when the user only asked for a bounded summary, and a model-generated delete call should not execute merely because the integration has a delete scope. This paper proposes Intent-Governed Access Control (IGAC), a server-side authorization layer that treats the user's expressed intent as a monotone, auditable policy attribute for AI-agent tool use. IGAC introduces intent certificates, session-scoped policy narrowing, intent-aware manifest filtering, and intent-tool-payload consistency checks. The central invariant is that user intent may only reduce the authority granted by static integration policy; it never expands scopes, data policy, tenant boundaries, or review requirements. We map IGAC onto OpenPort, an existing governance substrate that already implements authorization-dependent discovery, scope and ABAC-style policy checks, draft-first writes, preflight impact binding, state-witness checks, idempotency, stable reason codes, and audit.
papers.comment: 28 pages. Corrected errors, revised the presentation, and updated supporting material; the main results and conclusions are unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出意图治理访问控制（IGAC），将用户表达意图作为单调、可审计的策略属性，用于AI代理工具调用的服务端授权层。IGAC引入意图证书、会话范围策略缩小、意图感知清单过滤以及意图-工具-负载一致性检查，确保用户意图只能减少静态集成策略授予的权限。
Motivation: 现有授权机制仅检查集成凭证、应用或令牌是否可以调用工具，但无法判断工具调用是否与用户当前请求一致。例如，拥有读写和导出权限的凭证不应在用户仅请求有限摘要时暴露导出权限。
Method: 提出意图治理访问控制（IGAC），作为服务端授权层，将用户意图作为单调、可审计的策略属性。包括意图证书、会话范围策略缩小、意图感知清单过滤、意图-工具-负载一致性检查。中心不变式：用户意图仅能减少静态集成策略授予的权限，绝不扩大范围。
Result: 将IGAC映射到OpenPort治理基板，该基板已实现授权依赖发现、范围和ABAC策略检查、先草稿后写入、预飞行影响绑定、状态见证检查、幂等性、稳定原因代码和审计。摘要未报告具体定量结果。
Conclusion: IGAC通过意图约束增强了现有授权框架，适用于AI代理工具使用场景，强调其中心不变式和可审计性。

papers.title: Basin-Specific Intensification of Tropical Cyclones
papers.abstract_en: This paper uses ADT v9.0 HURSAT v07b data to measure tropical cyclone (TC) activity in four basins from 1990-2024. It is only in the North Atlantic basin that relative sea-surface temperature contrasts and the number of extreme (category 3+) tropical cyclones increased. And it is only there that the complete chain held - from annual aerosol pollution to sea-surface temperature contrasts, and in turn from those contrasts to the number of cyclones. Conversely, associations are inconsistent, insignificant, or counterintuitive in the three Pacific Ocean basins, especially insofar as annual temperature contrasts did not associate with annual cyclone activity. (Where appropriate, our analysis controls for aerosol changes and the El Nino-Southern Oscillation.) Worldwide, it is no longer justified for the IPCC to hold that "It is likely that the global proportion of major (Category 3-5) tropical cyclone occurrence has increased over the last four decades" (Summary for Policymakers A.3.4).

TL;DR: 使用ADT v9.0 HURSAT v07b数据分析了1990-2024年四个海盆的热带气旋活动，发现只有北大西洋盆地的相对海表温度对比和极端气旋数量增加，且污染-温度-气旋链完整；太平洋盆地关联不一致或不显著。作者据此质疑IPCC关于全球强热带气旋比例增加的结论。

papers.title: Latent Confounded Causal Discovery via Lie Bracket Geometry
papers.abstract_en: We study causal discovery from observational and interventional regimes when latent variables may affect the measured system. Our first algorithm, BRIDGE (Bracket Residuals for Interventional Discovery and Geometric Estimation), combines a density-ratio or transport engine with a high-recall geometric screen and passes the retained arrows to a score-based or differentiable discovery method. The main formulation and experiments use known single-node intervention targets; in that regime the screen is designed to retain candidate directed effects, while a downstream learner determines the final graph or equivalence-class representation. Our second algorithm, Spectral Kernel Flow Matching (SKFM), amortizes the response fields, summarizes residual nonclosure by a spectral visible-footprint subspace, and applies an order-dependent graph extractor. Direct extraction succeeds on calibrated chains and selected motifs, but is unstable on harder random DAGs when the order must be learned. On ten-node nonlinear random DAGs, the more reliable hybrid role of the geometry is as a candidate generator: calibrated SKFM/Bridge fields followed by local BIC scoring achieve mean directed $F_1\simeq0.86$. Sachs protein signaling provides a real-data stress test and supports a diagnostic, not fully identified, interpretation. The contribution is therefore a practical interventional screening pipeline, explicit guarantees for screen retention and residual-footprint rank under stated assumptions, and a falsifiable account of the boundary between geometric diagnostics and causal identification.
papers.comment: Revised to remove unsupported Kan-extension interpretations and clarify scope. Lie brackets are now nonspecific closure diagnostics, not certificates of latent confounding. Theorems are narrowed to conditional screen retention, residual-footprint rank, and order-dependent acyclicity. BRIDGE/SKFM algorithms and experiments remain intact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究存在潜变量时，从观测和干预数据中进行因果发现的几何方法。提出了BRIDGE和SKFM两种算法，利用李括号（Lie bracket）的残差非闭合性作为诊断工具，保留候选因果边后由下游方法确定最终图结构。在十节点非线性随机DAG上，混合几何筛选与局部BIC评分达到平均有向F1约0.86。萨克斯蛋白信号数据作为真实数据压力测试，支持诊断性而非完全可识别解释。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在存在潜变量时面临挑战，李括号几何提供了一种新的筛选举证，但此前缺乏实用的算法和理论保证。
Method: 提出BRIDGE算法，结合密度比/传输引擎与高召回几何筛选，保留候选有向边后交由评分型或可微分发现方法；提出SKFM算法，通过谱可见足迹子空间总结残差非闭合性，并应用顺序依赖的图提取器。
Result: 在十节点非线性随机DAG上，BRIDGE/SKFM筛选后经局部BIC评分达到平均有向F1≈0.86；萨克斯蛋白信号数据验证了其诊断实用性。
Conclusion: 贡献在于实用的干预筛选流程、明确的筛选保留和残差足迹秩的理论保证，以及几何诊断与因果识别边界的可证伪刻画。

papers.title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: GPU kernel optimization represents a paradigm where functional correctness is assumed and execution efficiency is the objective. We present daVinci-kernel, a reinforcement learning framework that couples skill discovery with skill exploitation through a dynamically evolving skill library. daVinci-kernel jointly trains three agents sharing one LLM backbone: a Skill Selection Agent that retrieves relevant techniques via BM25 and LLM reranking, a Policy Agent that generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton kernels conditioned on selected skills, and a Skill Summary Agent that distills successful rollouts into reusable skills. Candidate skills are added only after execution-based verification confirms reproducible speedups. All three agents share a single LLM backbone, are initialized via a structured SFT cold start on diversity-filtered data, and are then jointly optimized end-to-end with multi-turn REINFORCE and per-agent advantage estimation. On KernelBench, daVinci-kernel-14B achieves 37.2%, 70.6%, and 32.2% on Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 under the Fast$_1$ threshold, outperforming the strongest prior RL-trained model, Dr\. Kernel-14B.

papers.title: Tree-Based Formalization of Multi-Agent Complementarity in Human-AI Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Complementarity is the case in which a human--AI interaction (HAI) outperforms the best prediction benchmark available among its members. Although this idea is central in HAI research, formal work on complementarity remains limited. Existing frameworks do not model how agents' predictions compose into workflow-sensitive multi-agent protocols. We close this gap by introducing a tree-based formalization of complementarity in multi-agent HAI. An HAI protocol is represented by an ordered agent-role configuration together with a rooted planar binary tree whose leaves are decorated by prediction vectors. A local binary composition rule is evaluated recursively along the tree, yielding a tree-relative complementarity functional relative to a pointwise-min benchmark. We prove four results. First, selector-based HAIs, including reliance, cannot achieve complementarity regardless of task, loss, or prediction quality. Second, in regression under squared loss, complementarity is equivalent to Euclidean distance minimization from the ground-truth vector; for $N=2$, the optimal linear-pooling weight has a closed form and a residual-correction interpretation. Third, under linear local composition, every protocol tree defines a barycentric coordinate chart on the simplex of leaf weights; Tamari-cover reparameterizations of protocol trees preserve complementarity, and for all $N$, any two Tamari paths with the same initial and terminal trees preserve the protocol output and complementarity. Fourth, in binary classification, no internal local composition can achieve complementarity under endpoint-monotone losses, including standard Bregman and many finite Bernoulli $f$-divergence losses; an analogous obstruction holds for multiclass aggregation under cross-entropy. In summary, our framework shows that complementarity is attainable in multi-agent regression, but obstructed in classification.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 10 figures. Improved notation and added Figure 8 w.r.t. the original submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于有序根平面二叉树的树形形式化框架，用于建模多智能体人-AI交互中的互补性（complementarity）。该框架将HAI协议表示为智能体-角色配置和预测向量装饰的叶子节点，通过递归评估局部二元组合规则得到树相对互补性泛函。作者证明了四个主要结果：基于选择器的HAI（包括reliance）无法实现互补性；平方损失回归下互补性等价于欧氏距离最小化；线性局部组合下协议树定义重心坐标且Tamari重参数化保持互补性；二元分类中点单调损失（包括Bregman和f-散度）下内部局部组合无法实现互补性，多分类交叉熵类似。总结而言，多智能体回归中可实现互补性，但分类中存在障碍。
Motivation: 现有HAI互补性研究缺乏形式化模型来描述智能体预测如何组合成对工作流敏感的多智能体协议。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供一个严格的树形框架。
Method: 引入树形形式化：HAI协议由有序智能体-角色配置和一棵根平面二叉树表示，叶子节点装饰有预测向量。沿树递归评估局部二元组合规则，得到相对于逐点最小基准的树相对互补性泛函。
Result: 证明了四个主要定理：1) 基于选择器的HAI（如reliance）无法实现互补性；2) 平方损失回归下互补性等价于与真实向量的欧氏距离最小化，且N=2时最优线性池权重有闭式解；3) 线性局部组合下协议树定义叶子权重的重心坐标，Tamari覆盖重参数化保持协议输出和互补性；4) 二元分类中端点单调损失（包括Bregman和f-散度）下内部局部组合无法实现互补性，多分类交叉熵也有类似障碍。
Conclusion: 框架表明互补性在多智能体回归中可实现，但在分类中受阻。

papers.title: Enhancing MedSAM with a Lightweight Box Predictor for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation in medical imaging is a critical yet challenging task due to data scarcity and high variability across modalities. While foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) show promise, they often struggle with medical images without specific adaptation. Moreover, point prompts, despite being the most natural form of user interaction, provide insufficient spatial context for reliable segmentation, particularly when target structures are irregular or poorly contrasted. In this paper, we propose an enhanced segmentation framework that integrates a lightweight Box Predictor module into the MedSAM architecture. The Box Predictor estimates an approximate bounding box from a single user click using localized image embedding features, providing spatial guidance that reduces the ambiguity of point prompts, while introducing only 1.6M additional parameters and negligible inference overhead. We introduce a two-stage training pipeline where the Box Predictor is trained independently before being integrated into MedSAM. To validate the generalization capability of our method, we conduct extensive evaluations on four diverse datasets (FLARE22, BRISC, BUSI, LungSegDB) spanning distinct imaging modalities, including CT, MRI, and Ultrasound. Our method improves segmentation accuracy and robustness across varied anatomical structures and imaging domains, achieving Dice scores of 0.89 (BUSI), 0.93 (FLARE22), 0.88 (BRISC), and 0.98 (LungSegDB). Code is available at https://github.com/Amirhosseinmovahedi/MedSAM-BoxPredictor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种增强型医学图像分割框架，在MedSAM基础上集成轻量级Box Predictor模块，从单一点点击预测边界框，仅增加1.6M参数且推理开销可忽略。采用两阶段训练：先独立训练Box Predictor，再整合到MedSAM。在FLARE22、BRISC、BUSI、LungSegDB四个不同模态数据集上验证，Dice得分分别为0.93、0.88、0.89、0.98。代码已公开。
Motivation: 医学图像分割中，点提示（point prompts）虽自然但空间上下文不足，对不规则或低对比度目标分割不可靠。现有基础模型如SAM需特定适配才能用于医学图像。
Method: 在MedSAM架构中插入轻量级Box Predictor模块，利用单一点点击的局部图像嵌入特征估计近似边界框，提供空间引导以降低点提示的不确定性。采用两阶段训练流程：先独立训练Box Predictor，再整体微调。
Result: 在FLARE22、BRISC、BUSI、LungSegDB四个数据集上分别达到0.93、0.88、0.89、0.98的Dice分数，覆盖CT、MRI、超声等模态。
Conclusion: 提出的Box Predictor模块能有效提升MedSAM在多种医学图像分割任务中的准确性和鲁棒性，且参数量小、推理开销低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Density Functions
papers.abstract_en: We study the full density ratio between a specified intervention regime $P_a$ and an observational regime $P_0$, $ρ_a=dP_a/dP_0$, under the prerequisite $P_a\ll P_0$. We call the regime-indexed ratio a causal density function when $P_a$ is an identified or directly observed interventional law. The underlying Radon-Nikodym derivative and the identity $ \mathbb{E}_{a}[f(Z)] = \mathbb{E}_{0}\!\left[f(Z)ρ_a(Z)\right] $ are classical importance weighting, not new identification results. Our narrower question is whether retaining the entire pointwise ratio is useful as a reusable diagnostic across several downstream functionals. We evaluate a two-density plug-in baseline through held-out moment transport and overlap stress tests on synthetic and perturbation data. We also report a pairwise graph-scoring heuristic as a negative result: its F1 is \(0.10\) on a synthetic DAG, \(0.12\) on Sachs, and \(0.33\) on a multi-regime chain. These experiments do not establish an estimation advantage over direct density-ratio, inverse-probability, Riesz, or doubly robust methods; they instead delimit what the pointwise ratio target and the present plug-in estimator do and do not provide.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and narrowed the paper: removed the erroneous categorical theorems; corrected the intervention, domination, convergence, and density-ratio claims; repositioned the estimator as a baseline; corrected reported experimental values and citations; and documented the pairwise graph scorer as a negative result. A detailed errata/change log appears in the supplement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究干预分布与观测分布之间的完整密度比，称为因果密度函数，并评估了一个两密度插件基线估计器在传递矩和重叠应力测试中的表现。此外，报告了成对图评分启发式方法的负结果（F1 很低）。作者明确指出这些实验并未证明该估计器优于现有方法，而是限定了点态比目标及其插件估计器的适用性。
Motivation: 干预分布与观测分布之间的密度比是一个经典重要性加权工具，但作者想探讨保留整个点态比值作为可复用诊断工具的实用性，以及当前插件估计器的局限性。
Method: 使用两密度插件基线通过留出矩传递和重叠应力测试进行评估，并在合成数据和扰动数据上实验。还测试了成对图评分启发式方法，但作为负结果报告。
Result: 成对图评分启发式方法在合成 DAG 上 F1=0.10，在 Sachs 数据上 F1=0.12，在多区间链上 F1=0.33。这些实验没有建立对直接密度比、逆概率、Riesz 或双稳健方法的估计优势。
Conclusion: 本文限定了点态密度比目标及其插件估计器能提供什么、不能提供什么。作者强调没有证明该方法的优势，而是提供了诊断性分析。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Universal Decision Learners
papers.abstract_en: Many theories of decision making -- planning, reinforcement learning, causal intervention, online learning, and game-theoretic equilibrium -- turn local information into globally coherent behavior. This paper proposes a common categorical formulation: a Universal Decision Learner (UDL) extends a partially specified decision functor from observed contexts to new contexts by a pair of universal constructions. Left Kan extensions express rollout, aggregation, and candidate generation; right Kan extensions express consistency, constraint satisfaction, and fixed-point semantics. The central claim is not that every decision problem has the same algorithm, but that many decision formalisms instantiate the same universal problem: extend local behavioral data canonically, then characterize the globally coherent extensions. We give the abstract UDL construction, prove its universal comparison property, define Kan-invariant behavioral equivalence and minimal abstractions, and show how Bellman equations, planning recursions, causal interventions, online regret, and equilibria arise as special cases. The supplementary material develops the reinforcement-learning specialization in more detail.
papers.comment: Revised the central construction to use type-correct staged left/right Kan extensions; corrected the semantic quotient theorem; added an explicit discounted-MDP/Bellman derivation; and expanded the non-RL decision examples and limitations. A detailed change log appears in the supplement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用的范畴论框架——Universal Decision Learner (UDL)，通过左Kan延拓表示展开、聚合与候选生成，右Kan延拓表示一致性、约束满足与不动点语义，统一了规划、强化学习、因果干预、在线学习与博弈论均衡等多种决策形式。摘要证明UDL的普适比较性质，定义了Kan不变行为等价与最小抽象，并展示了Bellman方程、规划递归、因果干预、在线遗憾与均衡如何作为特例出现。
Motivation: 现有决策理论（规划、强化学习、因果干预、在线学习、博弈论均衡）虽各有具体算法，但缺乏统一的范畴论形式化；本文旨在揭示这些形式化实例化同一个普遍问题：从局部行为数据规范地扩展到全局一致的决策。
Method: 构造Universal Decision Learner (UDL)，利用范畴论中的左Kan延拓与右Kan延拓分别建模展开/聚合与一致性/约束；通过一对普适构造从部分指定的决策函子扩展到新上下文。
Result: 证明UDL的普适比较性质（universal comparison property），定义Kan不变行为等价与最小抽象；并将Bellman方程、规划递归、因果干预、在线遗憾与博弈论均衡推导为特例。
Conclusion: 摘要强调核心主张不是所有决策问题都有相同算法，而是许多决策形式化实例化同一个普适问题，UDL提供了统一的范畴论理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KBF: Knowledge Boundary as Fingerprint for Language Model and Black-Box API Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Relay and reseller APIs increasingly intermediate access to large language models (LLMs), but users have no direct way to verify that a claimed endpoint is actually serving the advertised model. We introduce KBF, a low-cost black-box auditing protocol that fingerprints model APIs using stable numerical recall near the knowledge boundary. Across 16 production LLM endpoints, KBF flags all 155 economically relevant substitutions without rejecting any same-model controls, remains stable under deployment variation, detects high-separation mixed-routing attacks when only 5-10% of traffic is substituted, and finds that 7 of 27 platform model cells in a six-platform shadow API audit are statistically inconsistent with their reference endpoints, with inconsistencies concentrated on premium Claude endpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KBF协议，一种低成本的黑盒审计方法，通过知识边界处的稳定数值召回来为LLM API生成指纹。在16个生产LLM端点上，KBF检测出所有155个经济相关的替代攻击，且不误报；在混合路由攻击中仅5-10%流量被替换即可检测；在六平台影子API审计中发现27个模型单元中有7个与参考端点不一致，主要集中在高价Claude端点上。
Motivation: LLM的转发和转售API日益普遍，但用户无法验证声称的端点是否真正服务所宣称的模型，存在模型替代欺诈风险。
Method: 提出KBF协议，利用模型在知识边界附近的稳定数值召回行为作为指纹，进行低成本的端到端黑盒审计。
Result: 在16个生产LLM端点上，KBF正确识别全部155个经济相关的模型替代，无假阳性；在混合路由攻击中仅替换5-10%流量即可检测；在六平台审计中发现7个模型单元与参考端点统计不一致。
Conclusion: KBF能够有效检测LLM API中的模型替代攻击，包括混合路由，且对部署变化鲁棒。

papers.title: Kan Extension Transformers: A Categorical Unification of Attention, Diffusion, and Predict-Detach Self-Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: We propose Kan Extension Transformers (KETs) as a categorical design language for a diverse group of Transformer implementations. A layer can be viewed generally as a weighted structured extension operator: attention uses token neighborhoods, geometric mixing uses sparse incidences, and KET uses simplicial sources. This operator is an actual enriched left Kan extension only when the source values are functorial, the weights are representable hom-objects (or the specified profunctor action), and aggregation realizes the corresponding coend; otherwise ``Kan-style'' denotes an interpretation rather than an identity theorem. Predict-detach blocks gradients through a predictive carrier and avoids transporting teacher-forced hidden states, but detach alone does not make a noncausal update strictly autoregressive: every carrier consumed at target $t$ must also be measurable from the prefix available at $t$. We evaluate 12 implementations on Penn Treebank, WikiText-2, and WikiText-103 across strict-causal and self-conditioned regimes, using widths $d=64,256$ and depths $L=2,8,16$ across the reported studies. Quadratic KET is strongest among the compared strict-causal architectures on WikiText-2 and WikiText-103; the largest cross-regime gains arise from additional self-conditioning information, not neighborhood design alone.
papers.comment: Clarified that predict-detach is strictly autoregressive only under a target-relative prefix-measurability condition; restricted exact Kan-extension claims to representable enriched cases; and clarified experimental coverage across depths 2, 8, 16 and widths 64, 256. A detailed change log appears in the supplement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kan Extension Transformers (KETs) 作为一种基于范畴论的设计语言，统一了多种Transformer实现（如注意力、几何混合、KET自身）。每个层被视为加权结构化扩展算子，严格意义上的Kan扩展仅在函子化源、可表示同伦对象等条件下成立。Predict-detach机制阻断梯度通过预测载体，但单纯detach不保证非因果更新变为严格自回归。在Penn Treebank、WikiText-2和WikiText-103上评估了12种实现，表明二次KET在严格自回归架构中表现最强，但最大的跨机制增益来自额外的自条件信息而非邻域设计。
Motivation: 现有Transformer变体（注意力、扩散、自条件等）缺乏统一的范畴论框架，难以系统比较和设计新架构。
Method: 提出Kan Extension Transformers，将层视为加权结构化扩展算子（KET操作符），并严格区分真正的Kan扩展与仅具风格的解释。Predict-detach通过阻塞预测载体梯度并避免传递教师强迫隐藏状态，结合前缀可测性条件确保自回归性。
Result: 在12种实现中，二次KET在WikiText-2和WikiText-103的严格自回归设置下表现最优；但最大的跨机制性能提升来自引入额外自条件信息，而非改变邻域设计。
Conclusion: KET框架为理解Transformer层提供统一视角，但严格Kan扩展的适用条件有限；自条件信息比邻域结构对提升性能更重要。

papers.title: WeCon: An Efficient Weight-Conditioned Neural Solver for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization Problems
papers.abstract_en: Existing neural solvers for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization Problems (MOCOPs) commonly adopt decomposition-based strategies that scalarize a MOCOP into multiple subproblems associated with distinct weight vectors. However, they either inject weights only once during decoding, limiting weight-conditioned context modeling, or primarily during encoding, causing weight-signal dilution during decoding. Moreover, their preference optimization methods rely on purely random sampling to construct solution pairs for training solvers, which often produces less informative pairs and thus leads to low training effectiveness. To better address these limitations, we propose an efficient Weight-Conditioned neural solver (WeCon). Specifically, we design an encoder layer with three attention blocks and our proposed Gated Residual Fusion block to facilitate harmonious interaction between instance features and weights, thereby generating informative weight-conditioned context. We further introduce a plug-and-play Residual Fusion block in the decoder to alleviate weight-signal dilution. Finally, we propose Efficient Preference Optimization, which constructs high-quality solutions, thereby generating more informative pairs to improve training effectiveness. Experimental results on four MOCOP variants across different problem scales and distribution patterns demonstrate that WeCon achieves HyperVolume (HV) performance comparable to the state-of-the-art (SOTA) solver POCCO-W, while requiring approximately 40% less inference time. Moreover, the variant WeCon-CCO, which adopts an enhanced decoder, achieves the best overall HV performance with increased inference time. Ablation studies validate the contributions of all proposed designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WeCon，一种高效的权重条件神经求解器，用于多目标组合优化问题 (MOCOP)。WeCon 通过编码器中的门控残差融合块和注意力块增强权重与实例特征的交互，并在解码器中引入残差融合块缓解权重信号稀释。此外，提出高效偏好优化 (Efficient Preference Optimization) 生成高质量解对以提高训练效率。实验表明 WeCon 在 HyperVolume 指标上与最先进的 POCCO-W 相当，但推理时间减少约 40%。
Motivation: 现有基于分解的神经求解器在 MOCOP 中要么仅在解码时注入权重（限制权重条件上下文建模），要么主要在编码时注入（导致解码时权重信号稀释）。同时，偏好优化方法依赖纯随机采样构建解对，往往产生信息量低的配对，训练效果差。
Method: 设计编码器层，包含三个注意力块和提出的门控残差融合块，以促进实例特征与权重的和谐交互，生成信息丰富的权重条件上下文；在解码器中引入即插即用的残差融合块以缓解权重信号稀释；提出高效偏好优化，构造高质量解对以提高训练效果。
Result: 在四种 MOCOP 变体、不同问题规模和分布模式上，WeCon 实现了与最先进求解器 POCCO-W 相当的 HyperVolume 性能，同时推理时间减少约 40%。采用增强解码器的变体 WeCon-CCO 以增加推理时间为代价取得了最佳整体 HV 性能。
Conclusion: 消融研究验证了所有提出设计的贡献。WeCon 在保持性能的同时显著提高了推理效率，为 MOCOP 提供了一种有效的神经求解方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: AI/ML Deepfake Research is Misaligned with AI-Generated Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery (AIG-NCII)
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery (AIG-NCII) is not adequately addressed in AI/ML literature regarding AI-generated media, commonly referred to as "deepfakes". While research on deepfakes currently focuses on its epistemic harms -- or harms relating to truth and authenticity -- this is misaligned with the dominant reality of generative AI abuse involving sexualized imagery. We conduct a landscape analysis of highly-cited works to demonstrate that technical interventions addressing deepfakes almost entirely ignore AIG-NCII, limiting the research ecosystem to authenticity detection tools. In this position paper, we argue that existing interventions address viewer-centric epistemic harms, such as fraud or scams, but ignore subject-centric dignity harms, such as AIG-NCII. We illustrate that knowing an image is synthetic does not mitigate harms to subjects and may, in some cases, even exacerbate them. We conclude by offering recommendations to realign the field, including updating threat models to consider subject-centric harms and addressing AIG-NCII in AI safety research. Finally, we caution that researchers should only engage in this high-risk domain if they implement safety guardrails for both subjects and researchers and establish partnerships with domain experts in sexual violence prevention.
papers.comment: ICML 2026. Outstanding position paper honorable mention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前AI/ML深度伪造研究主要关注认识论危害（如欺诈），却忽视了AI生成非自愿亲密图像（AIG-NCII）这一更普遍的滥用形式。通过对高引用文献的分析，作者发现技术干预几乎完全忽略了AIG-NCII，仅聚焦于真实性检测工具。作者呼吁重新对齐研究重点，包括更新威胁模型以考虑主体尊严危害，并将AIG-NCII纳入AI安全研究。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造研究集中于认识论危害（真实性/真实性相关），但实际中生成式AI滥用更多表现为性化图像的非自愿传播（AIG-NCII），两者严重错位。
Method: 对高引用文献进行景观分析，识别技术干预的覆盖盲区；提出基于主体尊严的伤害框架，区别于观众中心的认知伤害。
Result: 发现几乎所有现有技术干预都忽略AIG-NCII，仅开发真实性检测工具；指出知道图像是合成的并不能减轻主体伤害，甚至可能加剧。
Conclusion: 建议更新威胁模型以包含主体尊严危害，将AIG-NCII纳入AI安全研究，并强调必须与性暴力预防专家合作，实施安全防护措施。

papers.title: Predicting Channel Closures in the Lightning Network with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: The Lightning Network (LN) is a second-layer protocol for Bitcoin designed to enable fast and cost-efficient off-chain transactions. Channels in the LN can be closed either by mutual agreement or unilaterally through a forced closure, which locks the involved capital for an extended period and degrades network reliability. In this paper, we study the problem of predicting channel closure types from publicly available gossip data, framing it as a temporal link classification task over the evolving channel graph. We construct a dataset spanning over two years of LN activity and benchmark a range of machine learning approaches, from MLPs to temporal graph neural networks and spectral encodings. Our experiments reveal that the dominant predictive signals are temporal and behavioural, namely how recently each endpoint was active and the per-node history of past closures, while the surrounding network topology provides no additional benefit. We find that a simple MLP operating on edge-level features, node-level event counts, and temporal patterns outperforms all graph-based approaches, and discuss how the inherent privacy of the LN, where critical information such as channel balances and payment flows remains hidden, fundamentally limits the predictability of closures from gossip data alone. We publicly release the dataset and code at https://github.com/AmbossTech/ln-channel-closure-prediction.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables Accepted at the 2026 8th International Conference on Blockchain Computing and Applications (IEEE BCCA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究闪电网络（Lightning Network）中通道关闭类型的预测问题，将其建模为随时间演化的图上的链路分类任务。作者利用公开的 gossip 数据构建了一个跨越两年多的数据集，并对比了多层感知机（MLP）、时间图神经网络和谱编码等多种机器学习方法。实验发现，预测的主要信号来自时间和行为特征（如端点最近活跃度和历史关闭次数），而网络拓扑结构没有额外贡献；一个简单的 MLP 在边特征、节点事件计数和时间模式上表现最优。论文还讨论了闪电网络的隐私特性（如通道余额和支付流不可见）从根本上限制了仅从 gossip 数据预测通道关闭的可能性，并公开了数据集和代码。
Motivation: 通道关闭（尤其是强制关闭）会锁定资金并降低网络可靠性，理解如何从公开的 gossip 数据预测关闭类型有助于提升网络稳定性。
Method: 将问题形式化为时序链路分类，构建包含两年多 LN 活动的数据集，采用 MLP、时间图神经网络、谱编码等多种方法进行基准测试。
Result: 简单 MLP 在边特征、节点事件计数和时间模式上优于所有基于图的方法；关键预测信号是每个端点最近的活跃度和历史关闭记录，而网络拓扑没有提供额外收益。
Conclusion: 由于闪电网络的隐私性质，关键信息（如通道余额和支付流）对预测者不可见，这从根本上限制了仅靠 gossip 数据预测关闭的可能性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Steering grids for sparse-autoencoder features: when a top-context label names an activation regime rather than a causal axis
papers.abstract_en: The standard protocol for interpreting sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features labels each feature from its top-activating contexts and validates the label by steering that single feature at a typical magnitude. We argue that this inspects one cell of a larger steering grid, steering condition (single feature, joint feature set, matched random direction) crossed with steering coefficient, and show that other cells carry information that changes the label. On Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct and Gemma-2-2B-it, with the matched-geometry control extended to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: (1) features labelled AI self-disclaimer from their top contexts switch to a second surface form under steering, a contemplative voice on Qwen, a collective we-voice on Gemma, so the label names an activation regime, not the causal axis; two anchor features separate genuine mode switches from monotonic response and from breakdown. (2) Three near-orthogonal features that are individually substitutable are jointly necessary for grounded composition: joint suppression collapses unrelated control tasks into placeholder text that single-feature suppression at the same coefficient leaves intact. (3) A matched-geometry random-direction control shows the collapse is direction-pattern-dependent, not magnitude-dependent: at the same residual-stream distortion, feature directions damage unrelated tasks where magnitude-matched random directions do not, with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals on all three models, including the one SAE trained on the model it is applied to.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征解释的标准协议，该协议通过顶部激活上下文给特征打标签，并通过操控单个特征来验证。作者提出在更大的操控网格（操控条件×操控系数）中检验，发现其他单元格包含改变标签的信息。在Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct、Gemma-2-2B-it和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的实验表明：被标为“AI自述”的特征在操控下切换为另一种表面形式，说明标签命名的是激活状态而非因果轴；三个近正交特征单独可替代，但联合抑制会导致无关控制任务崩溃；匹配几何的随机方向控制显示，破坏取决于方向模式而非幅度，即使SAE训练自同一模型也是如此。
Motivation: 标准SAE特征解释协议仅检查单一特征在典型幅度下的操控，可能忽略其他操控条件下的信息，导致标签错误地反映激活状态而非因果轴。
Method: 构建操控网格，将操控条件（单特征、联合特征集、匹配几何随机方向）与操控系数交叉，系统性地检查不同单元格对特征标签和模型行为的影响。
Result: 在三个模型上：1）被标为“AI自述”的特征在操控下变成另一种表面形式（如沉思语气或集体“我们”语气），说明标签描述的是激活状态而非因果轴；2）三个近正交特征联合抑制会导致无关控制任务崩溃，而单特征抑制在相同系数下则不会；3）匹配几何随机方向控制对任务无影响，而特征方向会破坏任务，且95%置信区间不重叠，表明破坏是方向依赖而非幅度依赖。
Conclusion: 标准SAE特征标签可能仅命名了激活状态，而非真实因果轴；要完整理解特征功能，需要在更全面的操控网格中检验不同条件和系数下的行为。

papers.title: CollabSkill: Evaluating Human-Agent Collaboration On Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are reshaping the workspace, leading to drastic change of how humans work. Despite the considerable potential of human-agent collaboration both in preserving human agency and generating economic value, this paradigm remains largely absent from occupational task evaluation, hindered by the difficulty of gathering real human data and accounting for inter-human variability. We introduce CollabSkill, a framework for evaluating human-agent collaboration on real-world occupational tasks. CollabSkill pairs real human workers with AI agents on tasks matched to their occupational background, collecting data that capture the complexity of economically valuable tasks and the usage patterns of real workers. To account for inter-human variability, CollabSkill employs a Bayesian skill rating system to disentangle and quantify the skill contributions of both humans and AI agents. Drawing on over 1,500 prompts from 386 working sessions contributed by 93 human workers, our analysis yields insights on two fronts: on the agent side, rankings on CollabSkill diverge meaningfully from those of existing fully autonomous benchmarks where Codex leads, with Claude Code ranking first; on the human side, CollabSkill reveals that practical experience emerges as the primary driver of collaboration skill, with hands-on collaboration meaningfully shifting workers' AI literacy. Together, we hope CollabSkill enables the community to invest in systematic evaluation of human-agent collaboration and spurs development efforts aimed at building AI agents that genuinely augment human workers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CollabSkill 框架，用于评估人类与 AI 智能体在真实世界职业任务上的协作能力。通过配对真实工作者与 AI 智能体执行与其职业背景匹配的任务，收集超过 1500 条提示和 386 次工作会话数据，并采用贝叶斯技能评级系统分离人类与 AI 的技能贡献。结果显示，Claude Code 在协作排名中领先于现有全自主基准，而实际经验是决定人类协作技能的主要因素。
Motivation: 当前人类-AI 协作在职业任务评估中缺失，主要由于难以收集真实人类数据以及处理人类间差异。
Method: CollabSkill 框架：1) 让真实工作者基于其职业背景与 AI 智能体协作完成真实任务；2) 使用贝叶斯技能评级系统（Bayesian skill rating）分离并量化人类与 AI 的技能贡献。
Result: 基于 93 名工作者、386 次工作会话、超 1500 条提示的分析显示，Claude Code 在协作排名中名列第一，而全自主基准中 Codex 领先；人类方面，实践经验是协作技能的主要驱动因素。
Conclusion: CollabSkill 为人类-AI 协作评估提供了系统框架，揭示现有全自主基准的局限性，并强调实际协作经验对提升 AI 素养的重要性。

papers.title: LAGS: Low-Altitude Gaussian Splatting with Groupwise Heterogeneous Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Low-altitude Gaussian splatting (LAGS) facilitates 3D scene reconstruction by aggregating aerial images from distributed drones. However, as LAGS prioritizes maximizing reconstruction quality over communication throughput, existing low-altitude resource allocation schemes become inefficient. This inefficiency stems from their failure to account for image diversity introduced by varying viewpoints. To fill this gap, we propose a groupwise heterogeneous graph neural network (GW-HGNN) for LAGS resource allocation. GW-HGNN explicitly models the non-uniform contribution of different image groups to the reconstruction process, thus automatically balancing data fidelity and transmission cost. The key insight of GW-HGNN is to transform LAGS losses and communication constraints into graph learning costs for dual-level message passing. Experiments on real-world LAGS datasets demonstrate that GW-HGNN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks across key rendering metrics, including PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. Furthermore, GW-HGNN reduces computational latency by approximately 100x compared to the widely-used MOSEK solver, achieving millisecond-level inference suitable for real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低空高斯喷洒（LAGS）中无人机图像传输的资源分配问题，提出了一种基于分组异构图神经网络（GW-HGNN）的方法。该方法通过将重建损失和通信约束转化为图学习成本，实现了双级消息传递，从而自动平衡数据保真度与传输成本。实验表明，GW-HGNN在PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS等渲染指标上显著优于现有方法，并将计算延迟降低约100倍，达到毫秒级推理，适合实时部署。
Motivation: 现有低空资源分配方案未考虑不同视角图像对重建质量的非均匀贡献，导致在LAGS中效率低下。
Method: 提出分组异构图神经网络（GW-HGNN），将LAGS损失和通信约束建模为图学习成本，通过双级消息传递（group-level和image-level）优化资源分配。
Result: 在真实LAGS数据集上，GW-HGNN在PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS等渲染指标上显著优于现有基准，且计算延迟比MOSEK求解器降低约100倍，达到毫秒级推理。
Conclusion: GW-HGNN通过显式建模图像组的非均匀贡献，有效平衡了数据保真度和传输成本，适用于实时低空3D重建场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Corner Reflector Array Jamming Discrimination Using Multi-Dimensional Micro-Motion Features with Frequency Agile Radar
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a robust discrimination method for distinguishing real ship targets from corner-reflector-array jamming with frequency-agile radar. The key idea is to exploit the multidimensional micro-motion signatures that separate rigid ships from non-rigid decoys. From Range-Velocity maps we derive two new hand-crafted descriptors-mean weighted residual (MWR) and complementary contrast factor (CCF) and fuse them with deep features learned by a lightweight CNN. An XGBoost classifier then gives the final decision. Extensive simulations show that the hybrid feature set consistently outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives, confirming the superiority of the proposed approach.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对频率捷变雷达中真实舰船目标与角反射器阵列干扰的区分问题，提出利用多维微动特征的方法。从距离-速度图提取两种手工设计的特征——平均加权残差（MWR）和互补对比因子（CCF），并与轻量CNN学习的深度特征融合，最后通过XGBoost分类器进行判别。仿真实验表明，该混合特征集在性能上一致优于现有方法，验证了所提方法的有效性。
Motivation: 在电子对抗场景中，角反射器阵列干扰会模拟舰船回波，导致雷达难以区分真实目标与假目标。现有方法往往依赖单一特征，区分能力有限。
Method: 提出一种基于多维微动特征的混合特征集。首先从距离-速度图导出两个新的手工特征MWR和CCF，然后利用轻量CNN提取深度特征，最后将两种特征融合后送入XGBoost分类器进行判别。
Result: 大量仿真表明，所提混合特征集在区分性能上一致优于现有最优方法，验证了该方法识别角反射器阵列干扰的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该混合特征集利用多维微动信息，能够鲁棒地区分刚体舰船与非刚体假目标，为频率捷变雷达的抗干扰提供了一种有效手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Physics to Surrogate Intelligence: A Unified Electro-Thermo-Optimization Framework for TSV Networks
papers.abstract_en: High-density through-substrate vias (TSVs) enable 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration but introduce significant signal-integrity and thermal-reliability challenges due to electrical coupling, insertion loss, and self-heating. Conventional full-wave finite-element method (FEM) simulations provide high accuracy but become computationally prohibitive for large design-space exploration. This work presents a scalable electro-thermal modeling and optimization framework that combines physics-informed analytical modeling, graph neural network (GNN) surrogates, and full-wave sign-off validation. A multi-conductor analytical model computes broadband S-parameters and effective anisotropic thermal conductivities of TSV arrays, achieving $5\%-10\%$ relative Frobenius error (RFE) across array sizes up to $15x15$. A physics-informed GNN surrogate (TSV-PhGNN), trained on analytical data and fine-tuned with HFSS simulations, generalizes to larger arrays with RFE below $2\%$ and nearly constant variance. The surrogate is integrated into a multi-objective Pareto optimization framework targeting reflection coefficient, insertion loss, worst-case crosstalk (NEXT/FEXT), and effective thermal conductivity. Millions of TSV configurations can be explored within minutes, enabling exhaustive layout and geometric optimization that would be infeasible using FEM alone. Final designs are validated with Ansys HFSS and Mechanical, showing strong agreement. The proposed framework enables rapid electro-thermal co-design of TSV arrays while reducing per-design evaluation time by more than six orders of magnitude.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (IEEE TCAD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的电热优化框架，用于高密度TSV网络的设计。该框架结合物理信息分析模型、图神经网络代理模型（TSV-PhGNN）和全波验证，实现了从物理到代理智能的协同优化。代理模型在15x15以上阵列上的相对Frobenius误差低于2%，设计评估时间减少超过六个数量级。
Motivation: 高密度TSV引入信号完整性和热可靠性挑战，传统有限元法（FEM）仿真精度高但计算量巨大，限制了大规模设计空间探索。
Method: 框架由三部分组成：多导体分析模型计算宽带S参数和有效各向异性热导率；物理信息GNN代理模型（TSV-PhGNN）在分析数据上训练并通过HFSS仿真微调；代理模型集成到多目标帕累托优化框架中，优化反射系数、插入损耗、串扰和热导率。
Result: TSV-PhGNN在15x15阵列上相对Frobenius误差为5%-10%，对更大阵列（如30x30）泛化误差低于2%，方差几乎恒定。优化框架可在几分钟内探索数百万种配置，最终设计经Ansys HFSS和Mechanical验证，与FEM结果高度一致。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了快速且可扩展的TSV阵列电热协同设计，将单次设计评估时间减少六个数量级以上，但依赖于初始分析模型的精度和代理模型的泛化边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Which Workloads Belong in Orbit? A Workload-First Framework for Orbital Data Centers Using Semantic Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Space-based compute is becoming plausible as launch costs fall and data-intensive AI workloads grow. This paper proposes a workload-centric framework for deciding which tasks belong in orbit versus terrestrial cloud, along with a phased adoption model tied to orbital data center maturity. We ground the framework with in-orbit semantic-reduction prototypes. An Earth-observation pipeline on Sentinel-2 imagery from Seattle and Bengaluru (formerly Bangalore) achieves 99.7-99.99% payload reduction by converting raw imagery to compact semantic artifacts. A multi-pass stereo reconstruction prototype reduces ~306 MB to ~1.57 MB of derived 3D representations (99.49% reduction). These results support a workload-first view in which semantic abstraction, not raw compute scale, drives early workload suitability.

papers.title: A General Deep Learning Framework for Wireless Resource Allocation under Discrete Constraints
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning (DL)-based methods have achieved remarkable success in continuous wireless resource allocation, efficient solutions for problems involving discrete variables remain challenging. This is primarily due to the zero-gradient issue in backpropagation, the difficulty of enforcing intricate constraints with discrete variables, and the inability in generating solutions with non-same-parameter-same-decision (non-SPSD) property. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a general DL framework by introducing the support set to represent the discrete variables. We model the elements of the support set as random variables and learn their joint probability distribution. By factorizing the joint probability as the product of conditional probabilities, each conditional probability is sequentially learned. This probabilistic modeling directly tackles all the aforementioned challenges of DL for handling discrete variables. By operating on probability distributions instead of hard binary decisions, the framework naturally avoids the zero-gradient issue. During the learning of the conditional probabilities, discrete constraints can be seamlessly enforced by masking out infeasible solutions. Moreover, with a dynamic context embedding that captures the evolving discrete solutions, the non-SPSD property is inherently provided by the proposed framework. We apply the proposed framework to two representative mixed-discrete wireless resource allocation problems: (a) joint user association and beamforming in cell-free systems, and (b) joint antenna positioning and beamforming in movable antenna-aided systems. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed DL framework consistently outperforms existing baselines in terms of both system performance and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用的深度学习框架，通过将离散变量建模为支持集上的随机变量并学习其联合概率分布，解决了无线资源分配中离散变量带来的零梯度、约束强制和非SPSD问题。在两种混合离散无线资源分配问题上，该框架在系统性能和计算效率上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 深度学习在连续无线资源分配中取得显著成功，但离散变量问题因零梯度、约束难以施加以及无法生成非SPSD解而面临挑战。
Method: 将离散变量用支持集表示，元素视为随机变量，学习其联合概率分布，通过因子化为条件概率序列逐步学习。操作概率分布而非硬决策避免零梯度，通过掩码施加约束，动态上下文嵌入提供非SPSD特性。
Result: 在联合用户关联与波束赋形（无蜂窝系统）和联合天线定位与波束赋形（可移动天线辅助系统）两个问题中，所提框架在系统性能和计算效率方面均优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了离散变量带来的挑战，为无线资源分配中的混合离散问题提供了通用解决方案。

papers.title: Act, Think or Abstain: Complexity-Aware Adaptive Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Current research on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly focuses on enhancing generalization through reasoning techniques. While effective, these improvements increase computational complexity and inference latency. Furthermore, these mechanisms are typically applied indiscriminately, wasting resources on trivial tasks while failing to provide the uncertainty estimation necessary to prevent catastrophic failure on out-of-distribution scenarios. Inspired by human cognition, we propose an adaptive framework that dynamically routes VLA execution based on the complexity of the perceived state. Our approach transforms the VLA's vision-language backbone into an active detection tool by projecting latent embeddings into a set of parametric and non-parametric estimators. This allows the system to execute known tasks immediately (Act), reason about ambiguous scenarios (Think), and preemptively halt execution when encountering physical or semantic anomalies (Abstain). We find that a Gaussian Mixture Model fitted to fused vision-language embeddings provides the most reliable task-complexity signal, combining visual novelty with instruction context and cross-modal compatibility. Evaluated on the LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO benchmarks as well as on a real robot, our fused configuration achieves up to 87.5% F1-score across two VLA backbones (SmolVLA and $π_0$), retains 83% with as little as 5% of training data, and surpasses state-of-the-art failure detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的自适应推理框架，根据感知状态的复杂度动态选择执行路径：直接执行已知任务（Act）、推理歧义场景（Think）或提前中止异常情况（Abstain）。该方法将VLA的视觉-语言骨干转化为主动检测工具，利用高斯混合模型拟合联合嵌入来评估任务复杂度。在LIBERO基准和真实机器人上，该方法在SmolVLA和π₀两个主干上实现了最高87.5%的F1分数，并超越现有失败检测器。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通过推理技术增强泛化能力，但导致计算复杂度和推理延迟上升，且缺乏不确定性估计，难以应对分布外场景的灾难性失败。
Method: 将VLA的视觉-语言嵌入式映射到参数化与非参数化估计器，利用高斯混合模型评估视觉新奇性、指令上下文和跨模态兼容性，从而动态路由执行策略。
Result: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO基准以及真实机器人上，所提配置在两个VLA骨干（SmolVLA和π₀）上取得最高87.5%的F1分数，仅用5%训练数据仍保持83%的F1，并优于现有失败检测器。
Conclusion: 所提出的复杂度感知自适应框架能够有效提升VLA模型的资源利用率和安全性，通过提前中止异常情况避免灾难性失败。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Lattice Representation Hypothesis of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Lattice Representation Hypothesis of large language models: a symbolic backbone that grounds conceptual hierarchies and logical operations in embedding geometry. Our framework unifies the Linear Representation Hypothesis with Formal Concept Analysis (FCA), showing that linear attribute directions with separating thresholds induce a concept lattice via half-space intersections. This geometry enables symbolic reasoning through geometric meet (intersection) and join (union) operations, and admits a canonical form when attribute directions are linearly independent. Experiments on WordNet sub-hierarchies provide empirical evidence that LLM embeddings encode concept lattices and their logical structure, revealing a principled bridge between continuous geometry and symbolic abstraction. Datasets and code are open available at https://github.com/xiongbo010/lattice-representation-hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大语言模型的格表示假说（Lattice Representation Hypothesis），认为嵌入空间中的线性属性方向结合阈值可以诱导出概念格（concept lattice），从而实现几何化的符号推理。通过WordNet子层级实验，证明LLM嵌入编码了概念格及其逻辑结构。
Motivation: 现有线性表示假说仅关注线性方向编码，未能解释符号推理中的层次概念和逻辑操作。本文旨在建立连接连续几何与符号抽象的理论框架。
Method: 将线性表示假说与形式概念分析（FCA）统一，通过半空间交集诱导概念格，并定义几何的meet（交）和join（并）操作，在属性方向线性无关时得到规范形式。
Result: 在WordNet子层级上的实验表明，LLM嵌入能够编码概念格及其逻辑结构，为连续几何与符号抽象之间提供了原则性桥梁。
Conclusion: 格表示假说揭示了LLM中蕴含的概念层次和逻辑运算的几何基础，但实验仅限于WordNet，需进一步验证更广泛知识结构的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AIFL: A Global Daily Streamflow Forecasting Model Using a Deterministic LSTM Pre-trained on ERA5-Land and Fine-tuned on IFS
papers.abstract_en: Reliable global streamflow forecasting is essential for flood preparedness and water resource management, yet data-driven models often suffer from a performance gap when transitioning from historical reanalysis to operational forecast products. This paper introduces AIFL (Artificial Intelligence for Floods), a deterministic LSTM-based model designed for global daily streamflow forecasting. Trained on 18,588 basins curated from the Caravan dataset, AIFL utilises a two-stage transfer-learning strategy to bridge the reanalysis-to-forecast domain shift. The model is first pre-trained on 40 years of ERA5-Land reanalysis (1980-2019) to capture robust hydrological processes, then fine-tuned on operational Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) forecasts (2016-2019) to adapt to the specific error structures and biases of operational numerical weather prediction. Ablation experiments confirm that this two-stage approach outperforms both a naive IFS-only baseline and a mixed-forcing single-stage alternative. To our knowledge, this is the first global model trained end-to-end within the Caravan ecosystem. On an independent temporal test set (2021-2024), AIFL achieves high predictive skill with a median modified Kling-Gupta Efficiency (KGE') of 0.66 and a median Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) of 0.53. Benchmarking results show that AIFL achieves comparable accuracy to current state-of-the-art global systems. The model provides a streamlined and operationally robust baseline for the global hydrological community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIFL，一种基于确定性LSTM的全球每日河流流量预测模型，采用两阶段迁移学习策略：先在ERA5-Land再分析数据上预训练（1980-2019），再在IFS业务预报数据上微调（2016-2019），以弥合再分析到预报的领域偏移。模型在Caravan数据集的18,588个流域上训练，在独立测试期（2021-2024）达到中位KGE'为0.66、中位NSE为0.53的性能，与当前最先进的全球系统精度相当。
Motivation: 数据驱动的全球河流流量预测模型在从历史再分析转向业务预报产品时存在性能差距，需要有效的领域自适应策略。
Method: 采用两阶段迁移学习：首先在40年ERA5-Land再分析数据上预训练LSTM以捕捉稳健水文过程，然后在IFS业务预报数据上微调以适应数值天气预报的误差结构和偏差。
Result: 在独立测试集（2021-2024）上，AIFL实现中位修正Kling-Gupta效率（KGE'）为0.66，中位纳什-萨特克里夫效率（NSE）为0.53，消融实验验证两阶段策略优于单阶段基线。
Conclusion: 该模型为全球水文界提供了一个简化的、业务稳健的基线，是首个在Caravan生态系统内端到端训练的全球模型。

papers.title: Compressing LLMs with MoP: Mixture of Pruners
papers.abstract_en: The high computational demands of Large Language Models (LLMs) motivate methods that reduce parameter count and accelerate inference. In response, model pruning emerges as an effective strategy, yet current methods typically focus on a single dimension-depth or width. We introduce MoP (Mixture of Pruners), an iterative framework that unifies these dimensions. At each iteration, MoP generates two branches-pruning in depth versus pruning in width-and selects a candidate to advance the path. On LLaMA-2 and LLaMA-3, MoP advances the frontier of structured pruning, exceeding the accuracy of competing methods across a broad set of compression regimes. It also consistently outperforms depth-only and width-only pruning. Furthermore, MoP translates structural pruning into real speedup, reducing end-to-end latency by 39% at 40% compression. Finally, extending MoP to the vision-language model LLaVA-1.5, we notably improve computational efficiency and demonstrate that text-only recovery fine-tuning can restore performance even on visual tasks.
papers.comment: Code and models are available at: https://github.com/c2d-usp/Efficient-LLMs-with-MoP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MoP（Mixture of Pruners），一种迭代式结构化剪枝框架，统一了深度剪枝和宽度剪枝两个维度。在LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3上，MoP在多种压缩率下均优于现有方法，且在40%压缩率下实现39%的端到端延迟降低。此外，MoP扩展到视觉-语言模型LLaVA-1.5时也提升了计算效率，并表明仅通过文本恢复微调即可恢复视觉任务的性能。
Motivation: 现有LLM剪枝方法通常只关注单一维度（深度或宽度），缺乏统一框架来处理两种剪枝策略的协同作用。
Method: 提出MoP，在每个迭代步骤中生成两个分支——深度剪枝和宽度剪枝——并选择其中一个候选者继续推进路径。
Result: 在LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3上，MoP超越多种竞争方法，在40%压缩率下实现39%的端到端延迟减少；在LLaVA-1.5上验证了跨模态有效性。
Conclusion: 统一深度和宽度剪枝的迭代框架能够显著提升压缩效果和推理速度，且文本恢复微调足以恢复视觉任务性能。

summary_sections.method: 提出MoP，在每个迭代步骤中生成两个分支——深度剪枝和宽度剪枝——并选择其中一个候选者继续推进路径。
summary_sections.result: 在LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3上，MoP超越多种竞争方法，在40%压缩率下实现39%的端到端延迟减少；在LLaVA-1.5上验证了跨模态有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 统一深度和宽度剪枝的迭代框架能够显著提升压缩效果和推理速度，且文本恢复微调足以恢复视觉任务性能。

papers.title: Parallel Swin Transformer-Enhanced 3D MRI-to-CT Synthesis for MRI-Only Radiotherapy Planning
papers.abstract_en: MRI provides superior soft tissue contrast without ionizing radiation; however, the absence of electron density information limits its direct use for dose calculation. As a result, current radiotherapy workflows rely on combined MRI and CT acquisitions, increasing registration uncertainty and procedural complexity. Synthetic CT generation enables MRI only planning but remains challenging due to nonlinear MRI-CT relationships and anatomical variability. We propose Parallel Swin Transformer-Enhanced Med2Transformer, a 3D architecture that integrates convolutional encoding with dual Swin Transformer branches to model both local anatomical detail and long-range contextual dependencies. Multi-scale shifted window attention with hierarchical feature aggregation improves anatomical fidelity. Experiments on public and clinical datasets demonstrate higher image similarity and improved geometric accuracy compared with baseline methods. Dosimetric evaluation shows clinically acceptable performance, with a mean target dose error of 1.69%. Code is available at: https://github.com/mobaidoctor/med2transformer.
papers.comment: This preprint has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE 23rd International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2026). The final published version is available at https://doi.org/10.1109/ISBI61048.2026.11515734. The copyright for this work has been transferred to IEEE
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 23rd IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于并行Swin Transformer的3D MRI到CT合成网络Med2Transformer，结合卷积编码和双Swin Transformer分支以建模局部细节和长程依赖。在公共和临床数据集上相比基线方法获得更高的图像相似性和几何精度，剂量评估平均目标剂量误差1.69%，达到临床可接受水平。
Motivation: 现有CT合成方法无法充分处理MRI-CT间的非线性关系和解剖变异性，且依赖配准增加复杂性。本文旨在实现高精度MRI-only放疗计划。
Method: 提出Parallel Swin Transformer-Enhanced Med2Transformer，集成卷积编码与双Swin Transformer分支，采用多尺度移位窗口注意力和层次特征聚合。
Result: 在公共和临床数据集上图像相似性和几何精度优于基线方法；剂量评估平均目标剂量误差1.69%，临床可接受。
Conclusion: 该方法可实现MRI-only放疗计划，减少配准不确定性和流程复杂性，且代码开源。

papers.title: Towards Isolated Interventions via Almost Orthogonal Features in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A central premise in mechanistic interpretability is that meaningful concepts in language models are represented by linear features in activation space. For such features to support reliable interventions, manipulating one feature should not substantially alter the effects of others. In practice, however, feature entanglement leads to interference such that localized interventions can have unintended downstream effects. Motivated by the \textit{Independent Causal Mechanisms} principle, we propose to constrain internal features to be almost orthogonal. We argue that this promotes modular representations amenable to causal intervention. We formalize this problem by characterizing the gap between an idealized isolated intervention and its realized effect on model outputs in terms of feature interference. We upper-bound the propagation of feature interference in terms of the self-coherence of the feature dictionary, and relate this discrepancy to an explicit orthogonality regularization on the dictionary itself. Empirically, we show that this regularization enables more isolated interventions on mathematical reasoning concepts while preserving model performance. Our code is available under \texttt{https://github.com/mrtzmllr/sae-icm}.
papers.comment: Accepted as a conference paper at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从独立因果机制（Independent Causal Mechanisms）原则出发，提出约束语言模型内部特征近似正交，以促进模块化表示并支持更可靠的因果干预。理论分析表明，特征字典的自相干性（self-coherence）上界控制了干扰传播，并通过正交正则化缩小理想干预与实际效果之间的差距。实验证明该方法在数学推理概念上实现更隔离的干预，同时保持模型性能。
Motivation: 语言模型中特征纠缠导致局部干预产生意外下游效应，违背了可解释性中特征应支持独立操作的假设。
Method: 基于独立因果机制原则，对模型内部特征字典施加显式正交正则化，约束特征近似正交，并理论推导了特征干扰传播的上界与字典自相干性的关系。
Result: 在数学推理概念上，正交正则化使得干预更隔离，模型性能保持。
Conclusion: 正交约束是促进特征解耦和可靠干预的有效手段，但局限于数学推理任务，需进一步验证其他领域。
Relevance: 0
