papers.title: Aortic Valve Disease Screening from PPG via Physiology-Guided Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Aortic valve disease (AVD) represents a major public health burden, while its diagnosis relies on echocardiography, which is limited by cost and specialist expertise, restricting scalable screening and risk stratification. Existing portable sensing modalities are constrained by indirect representations or acquisition dependencies. In this context, photoplethysmography (PPG), a widely available optical signal capturing peripheral hemodynamic dynamics, provides a scalable physiological measurement. However, the scarcity of clinically labeled PPG data severely constrains the development of effective data-driven models. To address this limitation, we propose Physiology-Guided Self-Supervised Learning (PG-SSL), leveraging approximately 170,000 unlabeled UK Biobank PPG recordings. PG-SSL constructs physiologically derived pseudo-labels based on clinically motivated waveform phenotypes associated with aortic stenosis (AS) and aortic regurgitation (AR), enabling large-scale pretraining without AVD-specific labels. Following fine-tuning on a small labeled cohort, the model achieved AUROCs of 0.8025 for AS and 0.7669 for AR. Further analyses demonstrated robustness under clinical confounding and covariate-balanced evaluation, as well as significant longitudinal associations with incident AVD events. This study demonstrates the feasibility of PG-SSL for leveraging large-scale unlabeled physiological signals under clinically labeled data-scarce conditions. The proposed approach provides a useful strategy for improving low-cost PPG-based screening and risk enrichment for clinically recognized AVD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生理引导自监督学习（PG-SSL），利用约17万条无标签UK Biobank PPG记录，通过构建基于主动脉瓣狭窄和反流的生理学波形表型伪标签进行预训练，然后在小规模标注队列上微调，实现PPG信号的无创主动脉瓣疾病筛查。在AS和AR上分别达到0.8025和0.7669的AUROC，并展示了临床混杂因素下的鲁棒性及与未来事件的相关性。
Motivation: 主动脉瓣疾病诊断依赖超声心动图，成本高且依赖专家，难以大规模筛查；现有便携式传感模式受限于间接表示或采集依赖。PPG信号虽可广泛获取，但临床标注数据稀缺，制约数据驱动模型开发。
Method: 提出生理引导自监督学习（PG-SSL），利用约17万无标签PPG记录，根据临床相关的波形表型（与AS和AR相关）构建生理学伪标签进行预训练，然后在小规模标注队列上微调。
Result: 微调后模型对主动脉瓣狭窄（AS）的AUROC为0.8025，对主动脉瓣反流（AR）的AUROC为0.7669；在临床混杂因素校正和协变量平衡评估中表现鲁棒，且与主动脉瓣疾病事件有显著纵向关联。
Conclusion: 本研究证明了在临床标注数据稀缺条件下，利用大规模无标签生理信号进行PG-SSL的可行性，为低成本PPG筛查和风险富集提供了有效策略。

papers.title: Does Faithfulness-Guided Alignment Hurt Accuracy? Unlocking Accurate and Faithful Post-Retrieval Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can achieve strong answer accuracy on multi-hop questions, but outcome-level rewards often leave reasoning traces weakly grounded and difficult to audit. Under noisy retrieval, models may exhibit right-answer-wrong-reason failures, where the final answer is correct but the supporting rationale exploits shortcuts or unsupported evidence. We therefore ask whether faithfulness-guided alignment hurts answer accuracy in post-retrieval reasoning. To study this question, we propose CRAFT (Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces), a reinforcement learning framework for the response-generation stage of retrieval-augmented multi-hop question answering. CRAFT trains models to produce structured reasoning traces with configurable auditability, while combining deterministic rewards for format compliance, answer correctness, and citation validity with a judge-based reward for semantic faithfulness. Experiments across model scales and benchmarks show that CRAFT unlocks task-specific reasoning capacity from 1.5B upward, improving both answer accuracy and Faithfulness; at 0.5B, performance remains sharply template-dependent. At 7B, CRAFT improves Faithfulness over the Base model in all evaluated settings and remains competitive with strong closed-source models. Code is available at https://github.com/Ameame1/CRAFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在检索增强的多跳问答中，忠实性引导的对齐是否会损害答案准确性。提出CRAFT框架，通过强化学习训练模型生成结构化推理轨迹，结合确定性奖励（格式、答案正确性、引用有效性）和基于评判器的语义忠实性奖励。实验表明，CRAFT在1.5B及以上规模模型上同时提升了答案准确性和忠实性，但在0.5B模型上性能严重依赖模板。
Motivation: 现有RAG系统在噪声检索下可能出现答案正确但推理轨迹不忠实的问题，本文旨在探究忠实性引导的对齐是否会影响后检索推理阶段的答案准确性。
Method: 提出CRAFT（Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces），一个用于检索增强多跳问答响应生成阶段的强化学习框架。训练模型生成结构化推理轨迹，结合确定性奖励（格式、答案正确性、引用有效性）和基于评判器的语义忠实性奖励。
Result: 在多个模型规模和基准上，CRAFT从1.5B参数起开启任务特定推理能力，同时提升答案准确性和忠实性；在7B参数下，忠实性在所有设置中优于基础模型，并与强闭源模型竞争。
Conclusion: 忠实性引导的对齐不会损害答案准确性，反而可以在适当模型规模下同时提升准确性和忠实性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bayesian-LoRA: Probabilistic Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models usually put more emphasis on accuracy and therefore, will guess even when not certain about the prediction, which is especially severe when fine-tuned on small datasets due to the inherent tendency toward miscalibration. In this work, we introduce Bayesian-LoRA, which reformulates the deterministic LoRA update as a probabilistic low-rank representation inspired by Sparse Gaussian Processes. We identify a structural isomorphism between LoRA's factorization and Kronecker-factored SGP posteriors, and show that LoRA emerges as a limiting case when posterior uncertainty collapses. We conduct extensive experiments on various LLM architectures across commonsense reasoning benchmarks. With only approximately 0.42M additional parameters and ${\approx}1.2{\times}$ training cost relative to standard LoRA, Bayesian-LoRA significantly improves calibration across models up to 30B, achieving up to 84% ECE reduction and 76% NLL reduction while maintaining competitive accuracy for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OoD) evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Bayesian-LoRA，将LoRA的确定性更新转化为概率低秩表示，基于稀疏高斯过程的Kronecker因子后验。该方法仅需少量额外参数和训练成本，就能显著改善大语言模型的校准性能，在多个常识推理基准上验证了高达30B参数模型的有效性。
Motivation: 大语言模型在微调时，尤其是小数据集上，容易出现校准错误，即模型预测过于自信。现有LoRA是确定性的，无法量化不确定性。
Method: 通过识别LoRA分解与Kronecker因子化的稀疏高斯过程后验之间的结构同构，将LoRA重新解释为后验不确定性崩溃的极限情况，从而引入概率低秩适应。
Result: 在多达30B参数的模型上，相比标准LoRA，仅增加约0.42M参数和1.2倍训练成本，实现了高达84%的预期校准误差(ECE)降低和76%的负对数似然(NLL)降低，同时保持竞争精度，在分布内和分布外评估中均有效。
Conclusion: Bayesian-LoRA提供了一种高效的概率化LoRA方法，在几乎不增加参数和计算开销的情况下大幅提升模型校准，适用于需要可靠置信度的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Risk reversal for least squares estimators under nested convex constraints
papers.abstract_en: In constrained stochastic optimization, one expects that restricting the feasible set, provided it still contains the true parameter, should not increase the statistical risk of the corresponding projection estimator. We show that this intuition can fail, even in basic settings. We investigate this phenomenon in the Gaussian sequence model. Given a compact, convex set $Θ\subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, one observes \[ Y = θ^\star + σZ, \qquad Z \sim N(0, I_d), \] and seeks to estimate an unknown $θ^\star \in Θ$. Here, the maximum likelihood estimator over $Θ$ coincides with the least squares estimator (LSE), given by the Euclidean projection of $Y$ onto $Θ$. We construct an explicit example exhibiting \emph{risk reversal}: for sufficiently large noise, there exist nested compact convex sets $Θ_S \subsetneq Θ_L$ and $θ^\star \in Θ_S$ such that the LSE constrained to $Θ_S$ has strictly larger squared-error risk than the LSE constrained to $Θ_L$. Moreover, we demonstrate that risk reversal can persist at the level of worst-case risk. Finally, we show that the phenomenon is not specific to Gaussian noise or squared-error risk, extending our results beyond both settings. We clarify this phenomenon by contrasting noise regimes. In the vanishing-noise limit, the risk is governed at first order by the statistical dimension of the tangent cone, and risk reversal cannot occur at the leading $σ^2$ scale. In the diverging-noise regime, the risk instead depends on the global geometry of the constraint sets, and the embedding of $Θ_S$ within $Θ_L$ can reverse the risk ordering. These results reveal a previously unrecognized failure mode of the LSE. They demonstrate that in sufficiently noisy settings, tightening a constraint can paradoxically degrade statistical performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，在约束随机优化中，收紧可行集（只要仍包含真实参数）可能反而增加最小二乘估计的风险，这违背了直观。通过高斯序列模型构造显式例子，证明嵌套凸集上的风险反转现象，并分析噪声 regime 的影响。表明在足够噪声下，更紧的约束可能降低统计性能。
Motivation: 挑战了“约束越强风险越低”的常规直觉，揭示最小二乘估计在噪声较大时可能因约束嵌套而出现风险反转的失败模式。
Method: 在高斯序列模型下，构造嵌套凸集 Θ_S ⊂ Θ_L，通过最小二乘估计（欧几里得投影）分析平方误差风险，并扩展到一般噪声和损失。
Result: 存在显式例子：对足够大的噪声，Θ_S 上的 LSE 风险严格大于 Θ_L 上的风险；最坏情况风险也可能反转；在噪声趋零时，风险由切锥的统计维度主导，反转不会发生；在噪声发散时，风险取决于全局几何，嵌入关系可反转风险顺序。
Conclusion: 揭示了一个此前未被认识到的 LSE 失败模式：在噪声足够大的情况下，收紧约束可能反而恶化统计性能。

papers.title: Multi-agent DRL-based Lane Change Decision Model for Cooperative Platooning in Mixed Traffic
papers.abstract_en: Connected automated vehicles (CAVs) possess the ability to communicate and coordinate with one another, enabling cooperative platooning that enhances both energy efficiency and traffic flow. However, during the initial stage of CAV deployment, the sparse distribution of CAVs among human-driven vehicles reduces the likelihood of forming effective cooperative platoons. To address this challenge, this study proposes a hybrid multi-agent lane change decision model aimed at increasing CAV participation in cooperative platooning and maximizing its associated benefits. The proposed model employs the QMIX framework, integrating traffic data processed through a convolutional neural network (CNN-QMIX). This architecture addresses a critical issue in dynamic traffic scenarios by enabling CAVs to make optimal decisions irrespective of the varying number of CAVs present in mixed traffic. Additionally, a trajectory planner and a model predictive controller are designed to ensure smooth and safe lane-change execution. The proposed model is trained and evaluated within a microsimulation environment under varying CAV market penetration rates. The results demonstrate that the proposed model efficiently manages fluctuating traffic agent numbers, significantly outperforming the baseline rule-based models. Notably, it enhances cooperative platooning rates up to 26.2\%, showcasing its potential to optimize CAV cooperation and traffic dynamics during the early stage of deployment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多智能体深度强化学习（QMIX框架结合CNN）的车道变换决策模型，旨在提高混合交通中联网自动驾驶车辆（CAV）参与合作编队的比例。在微观仿真环境中，该模型在不同CAV市场渗透率下均显著优于基线规则模型，合作编队率提升最高达26.2%。模型适用于CAV早期部署阶段，能够动态应对可变数量的CAV。
Motivation: 在CAV早期部署阶段，CAV稀疏分布降低了形成有效合作编队的可能性，现有规则模型难以动态优化车道变换以增加编队参与。
Method: 采用QMIX多智能体强化学习框架，用卷积神经网络（CNN）处理交通数据以适应动态变化的CAV数量；结合轨迹规划器和模型预测控制器确保车道变换的平滑与安全。
Result: 在微观仿真中，所提模型在不同CAV市场渗透率下均显著优于基线规则模型，合作编队率提升最高达26.2%。
Conclusion: 该模型在CAV早期部署阶段优化了合作编队和交通动态，具有提升交通效率与节能的潜力。

papers.title: Infinite-Precision Autoregressive Modeling for Vector Graphics and Layouts
papers.abstract_en: While Transformer-based autoregressive models excel in data generation, their token discretization strategy inherently limits their precision in continuous domains. We analyze the scalability limitations of existing discretization-based approaches for generating hybrid discrete-continuous sequences, particularly in high-precision domains such as logos, layouts, and semiconductor circuit designs, where precision loss potentially leads to visual artifacts, aesthetic degradation, and even functional failure. To address the challenge, we propose a novel unified framework that jointly models discrete and continuous values for variable-length sequences. Our approach employs a hybrid approach that combines categorical prediction for discrete values with diffusion-based modeling for continuous values, incorporating two key technical components: an end-of-sequence (EOS) logit adjustment mechanism that uses an MLP to dynamically adjust EOS token logits based on sequence context, and a length regularization term integrated into the loss function. Additionally, we present ContLayNet, a large-scale benchmark comprising 334K high-precision semiconductor layout samples with specialized evaluation metrics that capture functional correctness, where precision errors significantly impact performance. Experiments on multiple domains show that our approach achieves higher-fidelity hybrid vector representations than discretization-based and fixed-schema baselines, while effectively scaling to high-precision generation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无限精度自回归建模（IPAM）框架，联合建模离散和连续值用于向量图形和布局生成。方法结合分类预测与扩散模型，引入EOS logit调整和长度正则化。实验在多个高精度领域（如logo、布局、半导体电路）上优于离散化基线。
Motivation: 现有Transformer自回归模型因token离散化策略在连续域中精度受限，导致高精度应用（如半导体电路设计）中出现视觉伪影和功能失效。
Method: 提出混合框架：离散值使用分类预测，连续值使用扩散模型；包括基于MLP的动态EOS logit调整和损失函数中的长度正则化项。
Result: 在多个领域（logo、布局、半导体电路）上，方法生成更高保真度的混合向量表示，优于离散化和固定模式基线，并有效扩展到高精度生成。
Conclusion: 论文表明联合建模离散和连续值可提升高精度向量图形生成质量，方法在功能正确性评估中表现优越。

papers.title: Copula Based Fusion of Clinical and Genomic Machine Learning Risk Scores for Breast Cancer Risk Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Clinical and gene-expression models predict breast cancer outcomes, but simple linear fusion ignores dependence between their risk scores. Using METABRIC, we tested whether modeling the joint distribution of clinical and gene-expression scores improved stratification of 5-year cancer-specific mortality. We defined clinical and mRNA-expression predictor views, trained classifiers, and obtained out-of-fold probabilities through 5-fold cross-validation. The scores were transformed into pseudo-observations on (0,1)^2 and used to fit Gaussian, Clayton, Gumbel, and Frank copulas. The clinical model discriminated better than the gene-expression model (AUC 0.783 vs 0.721). Frank had the smallest goodness-of-fit statistic, with Gaussian performing similarly. Copula fusion did not improve ROC-AUC over the clinical model. However, joint score groups showed clear survival differences, with patients scoring high on both views having the poorest outcomes. Competing-risks analysis showed the same pattern for cancer-death incidence. We also conducted an external evaluation in independent TCGA data using shared predictors and a harmonized 5-year overall-mortality endpoint. Copula-fused, individual, and simple-fusion scores showed comparable discrimination with overlapping confidence intervals. All received the same METABRIC-based recalibration. No gene met the prespecified stability criterion under repeated cross-validated permutation importance, so gene-level findings were treated as exploratory. Copulas provide an explicit, interpretable description of dependence between clinical and gene-expression risk scores and support descriptive joint-group analyses. This methodological study does not establish superior prediction, validated clinical risk categories, or clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用copula函数对临床和基因表达风险评分进行联合建模，以改善乳腺癌5年特异性死亡风险分层。在METABRIC数据上，临床模型AUC优于基因表达模型（0.783 vs 0.721），copula融合并未提升ROC-AUC，但联合评分组显示出明显的生存差异。外部验证在TCGA上结果类似，但所有基因均未达到预设稳定性标准，基因水平发现仅为探索性。
Motivation: 现有临床和基因表达模型分别预测乳腺癌预后，但简单的线性融合忽略了它们风险评分之间的依赖关系，可能导致风险分层不充分。
Method: 在METABRIC数据中，分别训练临床和mRNA表达分类器，通过5折交叉验证得到风险概率，转换为伪观测值后拟合高斯、Clayton、Gumbel和Frank copula，从而建模联合分布。
Result: 临床模型AUC为0.783，基因表达模型为0.721，Frank copula拟合优度最佳，高斯copula类似。Copula融合未改善ROC-AUC，但联合评分高分组生存差异显著；外部TCGA验证显示各方法判别性能相当且置信区间重叠。
Conclusion: Copula提供了临床与基因表达风险评分依赖关系的显式可解释描述，支持描述性联合分组分析，但本研究未证明优于临床模型、验证临床风险类别或临床实用性。

papers.title: Uncertainty Modeling for Multi-Objective RTA Interception with Distillation Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Real-Time Auction (RTA) interception decides which incoming advertising requests reach downstream systems, and therefore controls the quality of the data those systems learn from. At JD.com, off-site advertising produces on the order of hundreds of billions of requests per day, and the RTA channel alone serves up to hundreds of millions of requests per minute. Filtering low-quality and fraudulent traffic at this scale requires estimating each request's value with calibrated confidence, which we treat as an uncertainty modeling problem. Two obstacles stand in the way. First, advertising labels are severely imbalanced: deals are rare, and we show both analytically and empirically that standard weight-based uncertainty degrades under such sparsity, collapsing onto predicted probability and adding no signal. Second, methods such as SWAG and Bayesian neural networks require multiple stochastic forward passes per request, making full-traffic scoring prohibitively expensive. We address both problems with UMDA, a multi-objective framework that shares uncertainty across funnel-correlated objectives, using the reliable uncertainty of a balanced metric to compensate for the degenerate uncertainty of sparse ones. We then distill the multi-pass teacher into a single-pass student that reproduces both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty at roughly one-tenth of the inference cost. On JD e-commerce dataset and the public Criteo dataset, UMDA supplies more effective samples to downstream tasks, and the distilled student preserves this capability. In production, it scores the full traffic in a near-line pipeline that feeds an hourly blacklist for online interception; a seven-day A/B test on 5% of live traffic cuts the click fraud rate by 3.59% and raises CVR by 4.01% at a matched interception ratio while leaving converted users essentially unchanged, and the model has since been deployed to full traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对实时竞价广告拦截中的不确定性建模问题，提出多目标不确定性建模框架UMDA，利用不同目标的可靠性转移，并通过蒸馏将多前向传播教师模型压缩为单前向传播学生模型。在京东和Criteo数据集上验证，线上A/B测试降低点击欺诈率3.59%，提升CVR 4.01%。
Motivation: 广告标签严重不平衡，标准基于权重的不确定性方法在稀疏标签下退化；同时SWAG等贝叶斯方法需要多次前向传播，计算成本过高。
Method: 提出UMDA框架，在漏斗相关目标间共享不确定性，用平衡指标的可靠不确定性补偿稀疏指标的退化不确定性；将多前向传播教师蒸馏为单前向传播学生模型，同时保留偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
Result: 在京东电商数据集和Criteo公开数据集上，UMDA提供更有效的样本给下游任务；蒸馏学生模型保留能力；线上A/B测试（5%流量，7天）将点击欺诈率降低3.59%，CVR提升4.01%，转化用户基本不变。
Conclusion: 该方法已部署到全流量，说明其有效性和实用性。

papers.title: Decentralized Causal Discovery using Judo Calculus
papers.abstract_en: We describe a theory and implementation of an intuitionistic decentralized framework for causal discovery using judo calculus, which is formally defined as j-stable causal inference using j-do-calculus in a topos of sheaves. In real-world applications -- from biology to medicine and social science -- causal effects depend on regime (age, country, dose, genotype, or lab protocol). Our proposed judo calculus formalizes this context dependence formally as local truth: a causal claim is proven true on a cover of regimes, not everywhere at once. The Lawvere-Tierney modal operator j chooses which regimes are relevant; j-stability means the claim holds constructively and consistently across that family. We describe an algorithmic and implementation framework for judo calculus, combining it with standard score-based, constraint-based, and gradient-based causal discovery methods. We describe experimental results on a range of domains, from synthetic to real-world datasets from biology and economics. Our experimental results show the computational efficiency gained by the decentralized nature of sheaf-theoretic causal discovery, as well as improved performance over classical causal discovery methods.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and shortened version. We refocus the paper on decentralized multi-environment causal discovery and its experiments, and relegate the theory to the companion revised j-do-calculus paper. A detailed revision log is included in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于直觉主义的去中心化因果发现框架，使用judo calculus（j-do-calculus在层论topos中的形式化）。该框架将因果效应的情境依赖性形式化为局部真理：因果主张在一组情境覆盖上成立，而非全局成立。Lawvere-Tierney模态算子j选择相关情境，j-稳定性保证主张在该族情境上构造性且一致地成立。算法上结合了基于分数、约束和梯度的因果发现方法，并在合成和真实（生物学、经济学）数据集上展示了计算效率和优于经典方法的性能。
Motivation: 现实世界中因果效应依赖于情境（如年龄、国家、剂量等），传统因果发现方法难以处理这种情境依赖性。
Method: 提出judo calculus，利用层论中的j-稳定性和局部真理形式化情境依赖的因果推理，并将其与标准因果发现方法（分数、约束、梯度）结合，实现去中心化因果发现。
Result: 实验结果表明，该去中心化的层论因果发现在计算效率上优于经典方法，并在生物学和经济学数据集上取得更好的性能。
Conclusion: judo calculus为情境依赖的因果发现提供了形式化框架，具有计算效率和性能优势，但实验仅限于合成和两个实际领域。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于直觉主义的去中心化因果发现框架，使用judo calculus（j-do-calculus在层论topos中的形式化）。该框架将因果效应的情境依赖性形式化为局部真理：因果主张在一组情境覆盖上成立，而非全局成立。Lawvere-Tierney模态算子j选择相关情境，j-稳定性保证主张在该族情境上构造性且一致地成立。算法上结合了基于分数、约束和梯度的因果发现方法，并在合成和真实（生物学、经济学）数据集上展示了计算效率和优于经典方法的性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现实世界中因果效应依赖于情境（如年龄、国家、剂量等），传统因果发现方法难以处理这种情境依赖性。
summary_sections.method: 提出judo calculus，利用层论中的j-稳定性和局部真理形式化情境依赖的因果推理，并将其与标准因果发现方法（分数、约束、梯度）结合，实现去中心化因果发现。
summary_sections.result: 实验结果表明，该去中心化的层论因果发现在计算效率上优于经典方法，并在生物学和经济学数据集上取得更好的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: judo calculus为情境依赖的因果发现提供了形式化框架，具有计算效率和性能优势，但实验仅限于合成和两个实际领域。

papers.title: Intuitionistic $j$-Do-Calculus in Topos Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we generalize Pearl's do-calculus to an Intuitionistic setting called $j$-stable causal inference inside a topos of sheaves. Our framework is an elaboration of the recently proposed framework of Topos Causal Models (TCMs), where causal interventions are defined as subobjects. We generalize the original setting of TCM using the Lawvere-Tierney topology on a topos, defined by a modal operator $j$ on the subobject classifier $Ω$. We introduce $j$-do-calculus, where we replace global truth with local truth defined by Kripke-Joyal semantics, and formalize causal reasoning as structure-preserving morphisms that are stable along $j$-covers. $j$-do-calculus is a sound rule system whose premises and conclusions are formulas of the internal Intuitionistic logic of the causal topos. We define $j$-stability for conditional independences and interventional claims as local truth in the internal logic of the causal topos. We give three inference rules that mirror Pearl's insertion/deletion and action/observation exchange, and we prove soundness in the Kripke-Joyal semantics. A companion paper in preparation will describe how to estimate the required entities from data and instantiate $j$-do with standard discovery procedures (e.g., score-based and constraint-based methods), and will include experimental results on how to (i) form data-driven $j$-covers (via regime/section constructions), (ii) compute chartwise conditional independences after graph surgeries, and (iii) glue them to certify the premises of the $j$-do rules in practice
papers.comment: Substantially revised. The \(j\)-do-calculus results are now derived from chartwise Pearl do-calculus and sheaf descent. We remove the unsupported general Kan-extension duality, make all hypotheses explicit, correct categorical and probabilistic formulations, and add a detailed revision log
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 Pearl 的 do-calculus 推广到直觉主义框架下的 $j$-稳定因果推断，基于拓扑斯层范畴（topos of sheaves）和 Lawvere-Tierney 拓扑，利用 Kripke-Joyal 语义定义局部真值，提出了 $j$-do-calculus 规则系统并证明了其可靠性。
Motivation: 经典 Pearl do-calculus 基于布尔逻辑和全局真值，难以处理局部或模态化的因果情境。本文旨在利用拓扑斯理论中的 Lawvere-Tierney 拓扑和 Kripke-Joyal 语义，将因果推理推广到直觉主义逻辑环境，从而支持更丰富的因果结构。
Method: 在拓扑斯因果模型（TCM）基础上，引入模态算子 $j$ 定义 $j$-覆盖和 $j$-稳定性，用 Kripke-Joyal 语义替换全局真值，给出三条推理规则（插入/删除、动作/观测交换）并证明其在直觉主义逻辑下的可靠性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值或实验，仅声明 $j$-do-calculus 是一个可靠规则系统，其前提和结论是因果拓扑斯内部直觉主义逻辑的公式。
Conclusion: 本文为直觉主义因果推理提供了理论框架，但实证部分（如数据驱动 $j$-覆盖构建、图手术后的条件独立性计算等）留待后续文章。

papers.title: Towards an Asymptotic Efficiency Theory on Regular Parameter Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Asymptotic efficiency theory is one of the pillars in the foundations of modern mathematical statistics. Not only does it serve as a rigorous theoretical benchmark for evaluating statistical methods, but it also sheds light on how to develop and unify novel statistical procedures. For example, the calculus of influence functions has led to many important statistical breakthroughs in the past decades. Responding to the pressing challenge of analyzing increasingly complex datasets, particularly those with non-Euclidean/nonlinear structures, many novel statistical models and methods have been proposed in recent years. However, the existing efficiency theory is not always readily applicable to these cases, as the theory was developed, for the most part, under the often neglected premise that both the sample space and the parameter space are normed linear spaces. As a consequence, efficiency results outside normed linear spaces are quite rare and isolated, obtained on a case-by-case basis. This paper aims to develop a more unified asymptotic efficiency theory, allowing the sample space, the parameter space, or both to be Riemannian manifolds satisfying certain regularity conditions. We build a vocabulary that helps translate essential concepts in efficiency theory from normed linear spaces to Riemannian manifolds, such as (locally) regular estimators, differentiable functionals, etc. Efficiency bounds are established under conditions parallel to those for normed linear spaces. We also demonstrate the conceptual advantage of the new framework by applying it to two concrete examples in statistics: the population Frechet mean and the regression coefficient vector of Single-Index Models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文旨在发展一种统一的渐近效率理论，允许样本空间和参数空间为满足正则条件的黎曼流形。构建了一套词汇将效率理论中的基本概念（如局部正则估计量、可微泛函）从赋范线性空间翻译到黎曼流形，并在与赋范线性空间平行的条件下建立了效率界。通过总体Frechet均值和单指标模型的回归系数两个统计例子展示了新框架的概念优势。
Motivation: 现有渐近效率理论主要基于样本空间和参数空间均为赋范线性空间的假设，难以直接应用于具有非欧/非线性结构的复杂数据集。因此需要一种更统一的效率理论，能够在黎曼流形上处理这些情形。
Method: 通过构建翻译词汇，将效率理论中的关键概念（局部正则估计量、可微泛函等）从赋范线性空间扩展到黎曼流形，并在与赋范线性空间平行的条件下推导效率界。
Result: 建立了黎曼流形上的渐近效率界，并通过总体Frechet均值和单指标模型的回归系数两个统计例子验证了新框架的概念优势。
Conclusion: 论文提供的统一框架有助于推广效率理论到非欧几里得空间，但适用范围限于满足一定正则条件的黎曼流形，且具体应用可能需要进一步的技术细节。

papers.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness of Zero-Shot CLIP with Confidence-Aware Weighting
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models such as CLIP demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Prior adversarial methods treat all samples equally in the loss function, despite the fact that not all inputs contribute equally to adversarial vulnerability. Some samples retain high confidence even under large perturbations, while others are unstable and change predictions with minor noise. To address this, we propose Confidence-Aware Weighting (CAW) to enhance the zero-shot robustness of vision-language models. CAW introduces two key components: (1) a Confidence-Aware Loss that prioritizes uncertain adversarial examples by scaling the KL divergence between clean and adversarial predictions, and (2) a Feature Alignment Regularization that preserves semantic consistency by minimizing the distance between frozen and fine-tuned image encoder features on adversarial inputs. Together, these components improve both clean and robust accuracy without compromising generalization. Extensive experiments on TinyImageNet and 14 additional datasets show that CAW outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods such as PMG-AFT and TGA-ZSR under strong adversarial attacks like AutoAttack, while also being more memory-efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对CLIP等视觉-语言模型在对抗攻击下脆弱的问题，提出置信度感知加权（CAW）方法，通过自适应损失权重和特征对齐正则化提升零样本鲁棒性，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有对抗训练方法对所有样本等同对待，但不同样本对攻击的敏感性不同，有的高置信度样本即使在大扰动下仍保持正确，有的则容易改变预测。因此需要利用置信度差异来优化。
Method: 提出CAW，包含两个组件：1）置信度感知损失（Confidence-Aware Loss），通过缩放干净与对抗预测之间的KL散度来优先处理不确定的对抗样本；2）特征对齐正则化（Feature Alignment Regularization），在对抗输入上最小化冻结和微调图像编码器特征之间的距离，保持语义一致性。
Result: 在TinyImageNet和14个额外数据集上，CAW在强攻击（如AutoAttack）下优于PMG-AFT和TGA-ZSR等最新方法，并且内存效率更高。
Conclusion: 论文强调所提方法在不牺牲泛化能力的情况下同时提高了干净准确率和鲁棒准确率，适用于零样本场景。

papers.title: From Camera-Based Sensing to Reasoning: A Comprehensive Review Toward Proactive Vulnerable Road User Safety
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safety of vulnerable road users (VRUs), such as pedestrians and cyclists, remains a critical challenge, as conventional infrastructure-based measures are often insufficient in dynamic urban environments. Recent advances in learning-based visual sensing systems have created new opportunities for more adaptive and context-aware VRU protection. This paper presents a comprehensive review of camera-based methods for proactive VRU safety, with a focus on developments over the past five years. Unlike prior surveys that primarily emphasize detection, we organize the literature into three interconnected components: visual perception (detection and classification), motion modeling (tracking and trajectory prediction), and behavior understanding (intent recognition and reasoning). These components form a unified hierarchical pipeline that enables early risk anticipation and timely intervention. Furthermore, this survey systematically incorporates emerging AI paradigms, including Vision Transformers (ViTs), Large Language Models (LLMs), and diffusion models, highlighting their roles in representation learning, uncertainty modeling, and semantic reasoning. Finally, we identify four key challenges specific to VRU safety, including data scarcity, behavioral uncertainty, edge deployment efficiency, and real-world sensing constraints, and discuss corresponding research directions. This work provides a unified foundation for the development of reliable, scalable, and deployable VRU safety systems.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, 2026, pp. 1-17
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面综述了基于摄像头的弱势道路使用者（VRU）安全方法，将文献组织为视觉感知（检测/分类）、运动建模（跟踪/轨迹预测）和行为理解（意图识别/推理）三个互连组件，并系统纳入Vision Transformers、大型语言模型和扩散模型等新兴人工智能范式。文章识别了数据稀缺、行为不确定性、边缘部署效率和现实传感约束四个关键挑战，并讨论了相应研究方向。
Motivation: 传统基于基础设施的VRU保护措施在动态城市环境中往往不足，需要更自适应和上下文感知的视觉感知系统。
Method: 对过去五年基于摄像头的VRU安全方法进行综述，构建统一层次化流水线，涵盖视觉感知、运动建模和行为理解三个组件，并整合Vision Transformers、大型语言模型和扩散模型等AI范式。
Result: 系统性地识别了数据稀缺、行为不确定性、边缘部署效率和现实传感约束四个关键挑战，并展示了ViT、LLM和扩散模型在表示学习、不确定性建模和语义推理中的作用。
Conclusion: 该综述为开发可靠、可扩展、可部署的VRU安全系统提供了统一基础。

papers.title: MaskAttn-SDXL: Controllable Region-Level Text-To-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved strong results in text-to-image generation, but important limitations remain as prompts become more structured and multi-object. On the architecture side, U-Net backbones are efficient and stable, yet their locality makes global coordination harder, while Transformer-based diffusion models improve global interactions but at substantially higher compute and memory cost. In parallel, compositional reliability remains weak: models often mix attributes across objects, violate spatial relations, or omit requested entities, and these errors are not reliably reflected by global metrics such as FID or CLIP-based scores. To address these issues without changing the SDXL pipeline, we propose MaskAttn-SDXL, a plug-in module that injects token-conditioned spatial gating into cross-attention logits before softmax. The gating sparsifies token-to-location interactions to suppress irrelevant bindings while preserving the pretrained backbone and standard sampling process, requiring no external supervision or inference-time editing.

papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MaskAttn-SDXL，一个即插即用模块，通过在对齐注意力（cross-attention）的 softmax 之前注入 token 条件化的空间门控（spatial gating），在不改变 SDXL 管线的前提下改善区域级文本到图像生成中的组合可靠性。该方法稀疏化 token 到位置的交互，抑制无关绑定，无需外部监督或推理时编辑。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在处理结构化多目标提示时，属性混叠、空间关系违反或实体遗漏等问题普遍存在，且全局指标如 FID 或 CLIP 分数无法可靠反映这些错误。
Method: 在 SDXL 的交叉注意力层中，在 softmax 之前加入 token 条件化的空间门控机制，通过稀疏化 token-位置交互来抑制无关绑定，保持预训练骨干和标准采样过程不变。
Result: 摘要未提供具体定量结果，仅声称该方法能提升组合可靠性。
Conclusion: 该方法作为即插即用模块，无需修改 SDXL 架构或训练流程，可改善区域级文本到图像生成中的组合错误。

papers.title: EGRA:Toward Enhanced Behavior Graphs and Representation Alignment for Multimodal Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: MultiModal Recommendation (MMR) systems have emerged as a promising solution for improving recommendation quality by leveraging rich item-side modality information, prompting a surge of diverse methods. Despite these advances, existing methods still face two critical limitations. First, they use raw modality features to construct item-item links for enriching the behavior graph, while giving limited attention to balancing collaborative and modality-aware semantics or mitigating modality noise in the process. Second, they use a uniform alignment weight across all entities and also maintain a fixed alignment strength throughout training, limiting the effectiveness of modality-behavior alignment. To address these challenges, we propose EGRA. First, instead of relying on raw modality features, it alleviates sparsity by incorporating into the behavior graph an item-item graph built from representations generated by a pretrained MMR model. This enables the graph to capture both collaborative patterns and modality aware similarities with enhanced robustness against modality noise. Moreover, it introduces a novel bi-level dynamic alignment weighting mechanism to improve modality-behavior representation alignment, which dynamically assigns alignment strength across entities according to their alignment degree, while gradually increasing the overall alignment intensity throughout training. Extensive experiments on five datasets show that EGRA significantly outperforms recent methods, confirming its effectiveness.

Motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法使用原始模态特征构建物品-物品链接，但未充分平衡协同信号与模态语义，且模态噪声未得到有效抑制；同时，统一的对齐权重和固定的对齐强度限制了模态-行为对齐的有效性。
Method: EGRA包含两个关键组件：1) 用预训练MMR模型生成的表示替代原始模态特征来构建物品-物品图，该图融入行为图以捕获协同与模态相似性并增强对噪声的鲁棒性；2) 双层动态对齐权重机制，根据实体对齐程度动态分配权重，并在训练过程中逐步增加整体对齐强度。
Result: 在五个多模态推荐数据集上，EGRA显著优于近期方法，验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: EGRA通过改进行为图构建和动态对齐权重，有效提升了多模态推荐性能。

papers.title: Machine Learning for Cloud Detection in IASI Measurements: A Data-Driven SVM Approach with Physical Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Cloud detection is fundamental for the interpretation and operational exploitation of hyperspectral infrared sounders, yet the capability of infrared radiances alone to provide reliable cloud information remains insufficiently assessed. We introduce the Cloud Identification Support Vector Machine (CISVM), a supervised framework for global clear and cloudy classification from Infrared Atmospheric Sounding Interferometer (IASI) Level 1C observations. The analysis spans four seasons and compares radiances and brightness temperatures, alternative spectral reductions, and stratifications by surface type and climate zone. Using AVHRR-derived IASI cloud labels for training, the classifier operates exclusively on hyperspectral infrared radiances and is evaluated against independent IASI and collocated MODIS observations. The best-performing configuration, based on radiances and principal component analysis, achieves 88.52 percent of agreement with the operational IASI cloud reference. The results show that infrared radiances alone can reproduce the large-scale behaviour of an operational cloud product while providing physically interpretable insight into the influence of surface properties, seasonality, and geography on cloud detection performance. The proposed framework provides an operational baseline for future hyperspectral infrared missions, including ESA's Far-infrared Outgoing Radiation Understanding and Monitoring (FORUM).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于支持向量机（SVM）的云检测框架（CISVM），用于从红外大气探测干涉仪（IASI）的L1C观测数据中进行全球晴空与有云分类。通过对比不同光谱降维方法、地表类型和气候分区，基于辐射率和主成分分析的最优配置达到88.52%的云检测准确率，表明红外辐射数据本身可再现操作云产品的大尺度行为。
Motivation: 红外探测器单独提供可靠云信息的能力尚未被充分评估，现有云检测方法常依赖多传感器数据，本文旨在评估仅用红外辐射进行云检测的性能。
Method: 使用监督学习SVM分类器，以AVHRR导出的IASI云标签为训练目标，仅基于IASI L1C红外辐射率或亮温数据，并采用主成分分析（PCA）进行光谱降维，同时考虑地表类型和气候区的分层影响。
Result: 最佳配置（辐射率+PCA）与操作IASI云参考的一致率达88.52%，且能揭示地表特性、季节性和地理因素对云检测的物理影响。
Conclusion: 该框架为未来远红外超光谱任务（如ESA的FORUM）提供了操作基线，表明仅凭红外辐射可实现可靠的云检测。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: GazeLT: Visual attention-guided long-tailed disease classification in chest radiographs
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present GazeLT, a human visual attention integration-disintegration approach for long-tailed disease classification. A radiologist's eye gaze has distinct patterns that capture both fine-grained and coarser level disease related information. While interpreting an image, a radiologist's attention varies throughout the duration; it is critical to incorporate this into a deep learning framework to improve automated image interpretation. Another important aspect of visual attention is that apart from looking at major/obvious disease patterns, experts also look at minor/incidental findings (few of these constituting long-tailed classes) during the course of image interpretation. GazeLT harnesses the temporal aspect of the visual search process, via an integration and disintegration mechanism, to improve long-tailed disease classification. We show the efficacy of GazeLT on two publicly available datasets for long-tailed disease classification, namely the NIH-CXR-LT (n=89237) and the MIMIC-CXR-LT (n=111898) datasets. GazeLT outperforms the best long-tailed loss by 4.1% and the visual attention-based baseline by 21.7% in average accuracy metrics for these datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/lordmoinak1/gazelt.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GazeLT，一种结合人类视觉注意力集成与分解的方法，用于胸部X光片中的长尾疾病分类。该方法利用放射科医生在图像解读过程中随时间变化的视觉搜索模式，通过集成-分解机制改善对长尾类别的识别。在NIH-CXR-LT和MIMIC-CXR-LT数据集上，GazeLT在平均准确率上分别比最佳长尾损失方法高4.1%，比基于视觉注意力的基线方法高21.7%。
Motivation: 现有长尾疾病分类方法未能充分利用放射科医生在图像解读过程中的动态视觉注意模式，特别是对细粒度或偶然发现的关注，这些往往是构成长尾类别的关键信息。
Method: 提出GazeLT框架，通过集成-分解机制（integration-disintegration mechanism）利用放射科医生眼动追踪数据的时序特征，将视觉注意力的集成与分解融入深度学习模型，以提升长尾疾病分类性能。
Result: 在NIH-CXR-LT和MIMIC-CXR-LT两个长尾疾病分类数据集上，GazeLT的平均准确率比最佳长尾损失方法提升4.1%，比基于视觉注意力的基线方法提升21.7%。
Conclusion: GazeLT通过模拟放射科医生动态视觉搜索过程，有效改善了长尾疾病分类，代码已开源。

papers.title: Evo-DKD: Dual-Knowledge Decoding for Autonomous Ontology Evolution in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Ontologies and knowledge graphs require continuous evolution to remain comprehensive and accurate, but manual curation is labor intensive. Large Language Models (LLMs) possess vast unstructured knowledge but struggle with maintaining structured consistency. We propose Evo-DKD, a novel dual-decoder framework for autonomous ontology evolution that combines structured ontology traversal with unstructured text reasoning. Evo-DKD introduces two parallel decoding streams within an LLM: one decoder generates candidate ontology edits (e.g., new concepts or relations) while the other produces natural-language justifications. A dynamic attention-based gating mechanism coordinates the two streams, deciding at each step how to blend structured and unstructured knowledge. Due to GPU constraints, we simulate the dual-decoder behavior using prompt-based mode control to approximate coordinated decoding in a single-stream mode. The system operates in a closed reasoning loop: proposed ontology edits are validated (via consistency checks and cross-verification with the text explanations) and then injected into the knowledge base, which in turn informs subsequent reasoning. We demonstrate Evo-DKD's effectiveness on use cases including healthcare ontology refinement, semantic search improvement, and cultural heritage timeline modeling. Experiments show that Evo-DKD outperforms baselines using structured-only or unstructured-only decoding in both precision of ontology updates and downstream task performance. We present quantitative metrics and qualitative examples, confirming the contributions of the dual-decoder design and gating router. Evo-DKD offers a new paradigm for LLM-driven knowledge base maintenance, combining the strengths of symbolic and neural reasoning for sustainable ontology evolution.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Evo-DKD，一种用于本体自主演化的双解码器框架，结合结构化本体遍历与非结构化文本推理。框架在一个LLM内并行运行两个解码流：一个生成候选本体编辑（如新概念或关系），另一个生成自然语言理由；动态注意力门控机制协调两流，并通过提示控制模拟双解码器行为。系统在闭环推理循环中验证编辑并注入知识库。在医疗本体精炼、语义搜索改进和文化遗产时间线建模等用例上，Evo-DKD在本体更新精度和下游任务性能上优于仅结构化或仅非结构化解码的基线。
Motivation: 本体和知识图谱需要持续演化以保持全面与准确，但人工标注费时费力；大语言模型（LLM）拥有大量非结构化知识，却难以维持结构化的一致性。
Method: 提出Evo-DKD双解码器框架：一个解码器生成候选本体编辑，另一个生成自然语言理由；动态注意力门控机制协调两流，每步决定如何融合结构化与非结构化知识。受GPU限制，使用基于提示的模式控制模拟双解码器行为（单流模式）。系统运行在闭环推理循环中：编辑经一致性检查与文本解释交叉验证后注入知识库，再影响后续推理。
Result: 在医疗本体精炼、语义搜索改进和文化遗产时间线建模等用例上，Evo-DKD在本体更新精度和下游任务性能上优于仅结构化或仅非结构化解码的基线。提供了定量指标和定性示例。
Conclusion: Evo-DKD提供了一种LLM驱动的知识库维护新范式，结合符号推理与神经推理的优势，实现可持续的本体演化。

papers.title: Reconstruction of SINR Maps from Sparse Measurements using Group Equivariant Non-Expansive Operators
papers.abstract_en: As sixth generation (6G) wireless networks evolve, accurate signal-to-interference-noise ratio (SINR) maps are becoming increasingly critical for effective resource management and optimization. However, acquiring such maps at high resolution is often cost-prohibitive, creating a severe data scarcity challenge. This necessitates machine learning (ML) approaches capable of robustly reconstructing the full map from extremely sparse measurements. To address this, we introduce a novel reconstruction framework based on Group Equivariant Non-Expansive Operators (GENEOs). Unlike data-hungry ML models, GENEOs are low-complexity operators that embed domain-specific geometric priors, such as translation invariance and rotational equivariance, directly into their structure. This provides a strong inductive bias, enabling effective reconstruction from very few samples. Our key insight is that for network management, preserving the topological structure of the SINR map, such as the geometry of coverage holes and interference patterns, is often more critical than minimizing pixel-wise error. We validate our approach on realistic ray-tracing-based urban scenarios, evaluating performance with both statistical metrics (mean squared error (MSE)) and, crucially, a topological metric (1-Wasserstein distance). Results show that our method achieves superior statistical and topological accuracy across diverse urban scenarios. Compared to the best-performing baselines, GENEO reduces MSE up to 45% and decreases the 1-Wasserstein distance up to 54%. Crucially, these performance gains are maintained even under the most extreme tested conditions, such as a 1% sampling rate with a 30% measurement error, and when measurements are spatially biased. This demonstrates the practical advantage of GENEOs for creating structurally accurate SINR maps that are more reliable for downstream network optimization tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对6G无线网络中SINR地图难以高分辨率获取的问题，提出了一种基于群等变非扩张算子（GENEOs）的重建框架。GENEOs通过嵌入平移不变性和旋转等变性等几何先验，在极稀疏测量下也能有效重建地图，并保持拓扑结构（如覆盖空洞和干扰模式）。在基于射线追踪的城市场景中，该方法相比基线将MSE降低最多45%，1-Wasserstein距离降低最多54%，且在1%采样率、30%测量误差等极端条件下依然稳健。
Motivation: 高分辨率SINR地图获取成本高昂，导致数据稀缺，现有机器学习模型通常需要大量数据。而网络管理更关注地图的拓扑结构（如覆盖空洞几何形状）而非逐像素误差。
Method: 引入群等变非扩张算子（GENEOs），这是一种低复杂度算子，直接将平移不变性和旋转等变性等几何先验嵌入结构，从而在极少量样本下提供强归纳偏置进行重建。
Result: 在真实射线追踪城市场景中，GENEO相比最佳基线在MSE上降低最多45%，在1-Wasserstein距离上降低最多54%。在1%采样率、30%测量误差以及测量空间偏斜等极端条件下，性能优势依然保持。
Conclusion: GENEOs能够创建结构准确的SINR地图，对下游网络优化任务更可靠；其低数据需求和高拓扑保真度使其在实际部署中具有优势。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Exact Evaluation of the Accuracy of Diffusion Models for Inverse Problems with Gaussian Data Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Used as priors for Bayesian inverse problems, diffusion models have recently attracted considerable attention in the literature. Their flexibility and high variance enable them to generate multiple solutions for a given task, such as inpainting, super-resolution, and deblurring. However, there is still a lack of understanding about how accurately these conditional diffusion algorithms perform conditional sampling. In this article, we investigate the errors induced by these models when applied to a Gaussian data distribution for which the score function is exactly known. Within this constrained context, we are able to precisely analyze the discrepancy between the theoretical resolution of inverse problems via conditional sampling and the practical distributions generated by conditional diffusion models. This is done by characterizing all the involved iterative Gaussian processes and by computing the exact Wasserstein distance between the distributions of the diffusion model samplers and the ideal conditional distribution associated with the inverse problem. Our findings allow for the comparison of two major algorithms from the literature, Deep Posterior Sampling (DPS) and Pseudo-inverse Guided Diffusion Models ($Π$GDM), and the introduction of the new paradigm Conditional Gaussian Diffusion Models (CGDM) that is shown to be more accurate for Gaussian data distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯数据分布，精确评估了扩散模型在逆问题中的条件采样误差。通过计算迭代高斯过程与理想条件分布之间的Wasserstein距离，比较了DPS和ΠGDM两种算法，并提出了更准确的CGDM范式。
Motivation: 扩散模型作为贝叶斯逆问题的先验受到关注，但缺乏对条件采样准确性的理解，本文旨在精确量化这些误差。
Method: 利用高斯分布已知的得分函数，精确分析迭代高斯过程，通过计算Wasserstein距离比较不同条件扩散算法的采样分布与理想条件分布。
Result: 提供了DPS和ΠGDM的精确误差比较，并证明了CGDM在高斯数据分布上具有更高的条件采样准确性。
Conclusion: 强调了精确评估扩散模型在逆问题中误差的重要性，并提出了更准确的CGDM范式，但限于高斯分布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LEDOM: Reverse Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive language models are trained exclusively left-to-right. We explore the complementary factorization, training right-to-left at scale, and ask what reasoning patterns emerge when a model conditions on future context to predict the past. We train LEDOM, an open-source purely reverse autoregressive language model (2B/7B parameters, 435B tokens), and find it develops capabilities distinct from forward models, including abductive inference, question synthesis, and natural resolution of the reversal curse. We then explore one application of the reverse model: combining forward likelihood $P(y \mid x)$ with reverse posterior $P(x \mid y)$ through noisy channel duality. We propose Reverse Reward, which reranks forward outputs using reverse posterior estimates, and prove that bidirectional scoring penalizes hallucinated reasoning chains whose backward reconstruction degrades. Reverse Reward yields gains of up to 6.6\% on AIME 2024 and 15\% on AMC 2023 across multiple strong baselines. We release all models, code, and data here: https://github.com/Arvid-pku/LEDOM.
papers.comment: Work in progress; Models can be found at: https://huggingface.co/Corning/Reverse-Model-7B-348B/tree/main
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LEDOM，一个纯反向自回归语言模型（2B/7B参数，435B tokens），从右到左训练。实验发现反向模型具备前向模型未有的能力，如溯因推理、问题合成和自然解决逆转诅咒。进一步提出Reverse Reward方法，利用反向后验估计对前向输出进行重排序，在AIME 2024和AMC 2023上分别提升6.6%和15%。
Motivation: 当前自回归语言模型仅以从左到右的顺序训练，忽略了互补的从右到左的因子分解，该方向可能带来新的推理模式和应用。
Method: 训练纯反向自回归语言模型LEDOM，并基于噪声信道对偶性，结合前向似然和反向后验提出Reverse Reward，通过双向评分惩罚重建退化的幻觉推理链。
Result: 在AIME 2024上取得6.6%的提升，在AMC 2023上取得15%的提升，且超过多个强基线。
Conclusion: 反向语言模型具有独特能力，结合双向信息可有效改进推理质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flick: Few Labels Text Classification using K-Aware Intermediate Learning in Multi-Task Low-Resource Languages
papers.abstract_en: Training deep learning networks with minimal supervision has gained significant research attention due to its potential to reduce reliance on extensive labelled data. While self-training methods have proven effective in semi-supervised learning, they remain vulnerable to errors from noisy pseudo labels. Moreover, most recent approaches to the few-label classification problem are either designed for resource-rich languages such as English or involve complex cascading models that are prone to overfitting. To address the persistent challenge of few-label text classification in truly low-resource linguistic contexts, where existing methods often struggle with noisy pseudo-labels and domain adaptation, we propose Flick. Unlike prior methods that rely on generic multi-cluster pseudo-labelling or complex cascading architectures, Flick leverages the fundamental insight that distilling high-confidence pseudo-labels from a broader set of initial clusters can dramatically improve pseudo-label quality, particularly for linguistically diverse, low-resource settings. Flick introduces a novel pseudo-label refinement component, a departure from traditional pseudo-labelling strategies by identifying and leveraging top-performing pseudo-label clusters. This component specifically learns to distil highly reliable pseudo-labels from an initial broad set by focusing on single-cluster cohesion and leveraging an adaptive top-k selection mechanism. This targeted refinement process is crucial for mitigating the propagation of errors inherent in low-resource data, allowing for robust fine-tuning of pre-trained language models with only a handful of true labels. We demonstrate Flick's efficacy across 14 diverse datasets, encompassing challenging low-resource languages such as Arabic, Urdu, and Setswana, alongside English, showcasing its superior performance and adaptability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flick，一种面向低资源语言的少标签文本分类方法。通过从初始聚类中提炼高置信度伪标签，并利用自适应 top-k 选择机制改进伪标签质量，在阿拉伯语、乌尔都语、Setswana 等低资源语言上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有少标签文本分类方法主要面向英语等资源丰富的语言，且容易受到噪声伪标签的影响，在真正低资源语言场景中表现不佳。
Method: Flick 引入一个新的伪标签精炼组件，通过识别并利用表现最好的伪标签聚类，采用单聚类凝聚性和自适应 top-k 选择机制从初始聚类中提炼高置信度伪标签。
Result: 在包含阿拉伯语、乌尔都语、Setswana 等低资源语言及英语的 14 个数据集上展示了优越性能和适应性。
Conclusion: Flick 通过改进伪标签质量，为低资源语言下的少标签文本分类提供了一种有效且鲁棒的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Principal Paths: A Spectral Perspective on Linear Representation Formation in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: High-level representations have become a central focus in enhancing AI transparency and control, shifting attention from individual neurons or circuits to structured semantic directions that align with human-interpretable concepts. While the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH) suggests that such directions emerge in representations, it remains unclear how these representations originate and why they become increasingly stable across layers. To solve this issue, we introduce the Input-Space Linearity Hypothesis, positing that concept-aligned directions originate in the input space and are steadily maintained with increasing depth. We then propose the Spectral Principal Path (SPP) framework, which formalizes how deep networks progressively distill linear representations along the spectral principal directions. We provide rigorous stability guarantees for the SPP based on the Wedin $\sinΘ$ perturbation theorem, identifying testable conditions, including spectral gap and context incoherence, that jointly ensure layer-wise directional preservation. By bridging theoretical analysis with empirical evidence, this work identifies a spectral view of how linear representations arise in LLMs, and suggests potential implications for concept-level controllable, robust, and coherent approaches to fairness and transparency in modern AI systems.
papers.comment: 21 Pages. In Conference on Language Modeling (COLM), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLMs）中线性表示如何形成的问题，提出输入空间线性假说（Input-Space Linearity Hypothesis），并引入谱主路径（Spectral Principal Path, SPP）框架，从谱角度解释深层网络如何逐步蒸馏线性表示。基于Wedin sinΘ扰动定理提供了稳定性保证，并识别了谱间隙和上下文不连贯性等可测试条件。摘要称该工作为理解LLMs中线性表示的起源提供了谱视角，并对可解释AI有启示。
Motivation: 尽管线性表示假说（LRH）表明人类可解释的概念方向存在于表示中，但这些表示如何起源以及为何跨层变得稳定仍不清楚。
Method: 提出输入空间线性假说，认为概念对齐方向源于输入空间并随深度稳定保持；进而提出谱主路径（SPP）框架，形式化深层网络如何沿谱主方向逐步蒸馏线性表示，并利用Wedin sinΘ定理提供稳定性保证，识别谱间隙和上下文不连贯性等条件。
Result: 摘要声称通过理论分析与实证证据结合，展示了线性表示在LLMs中产生的谱视角。
Conclusion: 该工作对概念级可控、鲁棒和一致的方法在公平性和透明性方面有潜在意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Steerable Chatbots: Exploring Personalization Control Interfaces via LLM Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing LLM responses typically requires users to articulate their preferences through prompting, which can be burdensome at cold start and difficult to articulate in natural language. We introduce an alternative paradigm, steerable chatbots: rather than asking users to describe what they want, let them directly manipulate it via a linear factor. We implement this through activation steering, leveraging a linear scalar to control how strongly a preference is expressed in the LLM's output. We first assess the computational viability of activation steering as a method to control granular preference expression, then we explore how the factor can be exposed to users. We prototype three activation steering interface designs that vary on the axes of agency (user-led vs. system-driven) and fluidity (static vs. adaptive). A within-subjects user study (n=14) in cold-start personalization tasks shows the potential for steerable chatbots to align better with underlying user preferences than prompting alone, while revealing heterogeneous values around control, persistence, and transparency in LLM personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可操纵聊天机器人范式，通过激活控制（activation steering）让用户直接调节线性因子来控制LLM响应中的偏好表达强度，而不是通过提示词描述偏好。研究评估了激活控制在细粒度偏好表达上的计算可行性，并设计了三种界面原型，通过用户实验（n=14）表明该方法在冷启动个性化任务中比单纯提示更符合用户潜在偏好，同时揭示了用户对控制、持久性和透明度等方面的异质性需求。
Motivation: 传统个性化要求用户通过提示词明确描述偏好，这在冷启动时很繁琐且难以用自然语言表达。本文旨在提供一种更直观的替代方案：让用户直接操纵偏好因子。
Method: 利用激活控制（activation steering）技术，通过线性标量控制LLM输出中偏好的表达强度。设计了三种界面原型，在用户主导/系统驱动（agency）和静态/自适应（fluidity）两个轴线上变化，并进行用户实验。
Result: 用户实验（n=14）表明，在冷启动个性化任务中，可操纵聊天机器人比单纯提示更符合用户潜在偏好。同时揭示了用户在控制、持久性和透明度方面的异质性价值观。
Conclusion: 激活控制为LLM个性化提供了一种有潜力的交互范式，但用户对控制方式的需求是多样化的，需要设计灵活可定制的界面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast approximate estimation of conditional Shapley values when using a linear explainer
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop three new methods, two approximate and one exact, for fast estimation of conditional Shapley values when a linear regression model is used as the explainer. We apply constrained Gaussian Markov Random Field theory and sparse matrix algebra packages to estimate the coefficients of all submodels jointly and not sequentially. In the numerical case studies, our methods match the accuracy of the Sequential method in the shapr R-package while reducing the computation time from hours to minutes or seconds. Compared to the Iterative method in shapr, which samples coalitions until a convergence criterion is met, our methods estimate all $2^p$ coalitions when there are $p$ predictors present. When the iterative method requires all or a large fraction of the coalitions, our methods are substantially faster and with equal or better accuracy. When few coalitions suffice and the shapr iterative method is very fast, our methods deliver enumeration of all submodels, and in one case study over two million models are estimated within minutes. We recommend the exact method, since it has no tuning parameters and the three methods give comparable results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性解释器下的条件Shapley值估计，提出了三种新方法（两种近似、一种精确）。利用约束高斯马尔可夫随机场理论和稀疏矩阵代数，联合估计所有子模型系数，而非顺序估计。数值案例表明，方法在匹配shapr R包Sequential方法精度的同时，将计算时间从数小时降至数分钟或数秒。
Motivation: 现有条件Shapley值估计方法（如shapr包的Sequential和Iterative方法）计算开销大，尤其当特征数p较大时，枚举所有2^p个联盟耗时过长。
Method: 基于约束高斯马尔可夫随机场和稀疏矩阵代数，提出三种方法：两种近似方法和一种精确方法，均通过联合估计所有子模型系数来加速计算。
Result: 数值案例中，方法在准确性上与shapr的Sequential方法相当，但计算时间从小时级降至分钟或秒级；当Iterative方法需要大量联盟时，新方法更快且精度相当或更好。
Conclusion: 推荐使用无调参的精确方法，三种方法结果可比，且能枚举所有子模型（如案例中200万个模型在数分钟内完成）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient-Free Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are notorious for forgetting old skills when taught new ones - a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. Standard continual learning techniques try to fix this by saving old data or relying on complex gradient updates, but these methods fail when past data cannot be stored due to memory or privacy constraints. To solve this, we propose EvoCL, a gradient-free approach that uses evolutionary algorithms to update the network without needing old data or gradients. EvoCL uses a lightweight adapter module to translate saved representations from past tasks into the model's current space, allowing it to learn new tasks while keeping past knowledge intact. Across multiple benchmarks, EvoCL matches or exceeds standard performance under strict memory constraints, offering a simple and flexible new direction for continual learning. The code to reproduce these results is available at https://github.com/grypesc/EvoCL.

papers.title: A Bayesian Additive Regression Tree Model for Learning Conditional Average Treatment Effects in Regression Discontinuity Designs
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops an effective Bayesian approach to conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimation in regression discontinuity designs (RDD), an increasingly prevalent form of quasi-experiment that facilitates causal inference. Earlier Bayesian approaches do not easily accommodate CATE estimation while recent frequentist approaches to this problem assume a known basis expansion, a steep model specification requirement that our approach avoids. The new model is a variant of a Bayesian additive regression tree (BART) model with linear leaf-level regressions on the running variable and a treatment dummy (and their interaction). The model adaptively partitions covariate space into regions where the slope on the running variable appreciably differs, providing interpretable Bayesian inference on conditional average treatment effects near the cutoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）的模型，用于在回归间断设计（RDD）中估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）。模型通过在运行变量和处理哑变量上引入线性叶回归，自适应地划分协变量空间，从而在断点附近提供可解释的贝叶斯推断。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯方法难以处理CATE估计，而频率学派方法需要已知基函数展开，模型设定要求高。本文旨在避免这些限制，提供一种灵活的贝叶斯非参数方法。
Method: 采用BART模型变体，在叶子节点包含运行变量、处理哑变量及其交互项的线性回归。模型通过树结构自适应地划分协变量空间，捕捉运行变量斜率的局部差异。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法能提供断点附近CATE的可解释贝叶斯推断。
Conclusion: 该方法为RDD中的CATE估计提供了一种灵活且可解释的贝叶斯替代方案，避免了对基函数展开的依赖。

papers.title: Robustness and Cybersecurity in the EU Artificial Intelligence Act
papers.abstract_en: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA) establishes different legal principles for different types of AI systems. While prior work has sought to clarify some of these principles, little attention has been paid to robustness and cybersecurity. This paper aims to fill this gap. We identify legal challenges and shortcomings in provisions related to robustness and cybersecurity for high-risk AI systems(Art. 15 AIA) and general-purpose AI models (Art. 55 AIA). We show that robustness and cybersecurity demand resilience against performance disruptions. Furthermore, we assess potential challenges in implementing these provisions in light of recent advancements in the machine learning (ML) literature. Our analysis informs efforts to develop harmonized standards, guidelines by the European Commission, as well as benchmarks and measurement methodologies under Art. 15(2) AIA. With this, we seek to bridge the gap between legal terminology and ML research, fostering a better alignment between research and implementation efforts.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了欧盟人工智能法案（AIA）中关于高风险AI系统和通用AI模型的鲁棒性与网络安全条款，指出当前法律在定义和实施这些要求时存在挑战，并建议将机器学习研究的最新进展纳入标准制定。
Motivation: 现有研究对AIA中的鲁棒性和网络安全关注不足，而这两方面对AI系统的安全至关重要，亟需从法律与技术层面进行衔接。
Method: 通过法律条文解读与机器学习文献综述相结合的方式，识别Art.15和Art.55中相关条款的法律缺陷与实施障碍。
Result: 揭示了鲁棒性和网络安全条款要求系统对性能干扰具有弹性，但现有法律定义模糊，且与最新ML研究成果存在脱节。
Conclusion: 本文旨在为制定统一标准、欧盟委员会指南以及基准测量方法提供参考，以弥合法律术语与ML研究之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sign-Symmetry Learning Rules are Robust Fine-Tuners
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation (BP) has long been the predominant method for training neural networks due to its effectiveness. However, numerous alternative approaches, broadly categorized under feedback alignment, have been proposed, many of which are motivated by the search for biologically plausible learning mechanisms. Despite their theoretical appeal, these methods have consistently underperformed compared to BP, leading to a decline in research interest. In this work, we revisit the role of such methods and explore how they can be integrated into standard neural network training pipelines. Specifically, we propose fine-tuning BP-pre-trained models using Sign-Symmetry learning rules and demonstrate that this approach not only maintains performance parity with BP but also enhances robustness. Through extensive experiments across multiple tasks and benchmarks, we establish the validity of our approach. Our findings introduce a novel perspective on neural network training and open new research directions for leveraging biologically inspired learning rules in deep learning.
papers.comment: Paper makes claims that were later found to be false
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了反馈对齐（feedback alignment）类学习方法，提出用符号对称学习规则（Sign-Symmetry learning rules）微调BP预训练模型。实验表明该方法在保持性能的同时增强了模型鲁棒性，为生物启发学习规则在深度学习中的应用提供了新视角。
Motivation: 反馈对齐方法虽具有生物合理性，但性能始终不及BP，导致研究兴趣下降。本文旨在探索如何将这些方法有效整合到标准训练流程中。
Method: 采用符号对称学习规则对BP预训练模型进行微调，而非从头训练。通过大量实验验证该方法的多任务有效性。
Result: 该方法在多个任务和基准上达到与BP相当的性能，并额外提升了模型鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 符号对称学习规则可作为BP微调的有效替代方案，开辟了利用生物启发规则进行深度学习的新方向。

papers.title: Shift-Aware Calibration for Fine-Tuned CLIP: Leveraging Image-Text Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, adapt effectively to downstream tasks through prompt tuning, but fine-tuning can misalign predictive confidence and accuracy, particularly on unseen classes. Existing VLM-specific calibration methods mainly rely on textual features of train classes, limiting their applicability across class and distribution shifts. We propose \textbf{Shift-Aware Calibration (SAC)}, a training-free, sample-wise method that uses the discrepancy between the output logits of the original and fine-tuned CLIP as a calibration signal. We explicitly call this quantity \emph{logit shift}, since it is measured in prediction space rather than between hidden representations. SAC maps this logit shift to a positive scaling factor that adjusts confidence while preserving the predicted class. Across 11 datasets and five fine-tuning methods, SAC improves calibration on train and unseen classes and under cross-dataset and domain-generalization evaluation. Mutual Information (MI) analysis shows a statistical dependency between the logit-shift signal and ECE across methods and datasets, providing empirical evidence that the signal used by SAC is informative for calibration and supporting the effectiveness of its shift-aware design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Shift-Aware Calibration (SAC)，一种无训练、样本级的校准方法，利用原始CLIP和微调CLIP输出logits之间的差异（logit shift）作为校准信号，将其映射为正缩放因子调整置信度，同时保持预测类别不变。在11个数据集和五种微调方法上，SAC改善了训练类和未见类的校准，并在跨数据集和域泛化评估中有效。互信息分析表明logit shift信号与ECE之间存在统计依赖性，支持其有效性。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（如CLIP）通过提示调优适应下游任务，但微调可能导致预测置信度和准确度不对齐，尤其在未见类上。现有校准方法主要依赖训练类的文本特征，限制了在类别和分布偏移下的适用性。
Method: 提出SAC，一种无训练、样本级的校准方法，通过计算原始CLIP和微调CLIP输出logits之间的差异（logit shift），将其映射为正缩放因子，调整模型置信度而不改变预测类别。
Result: 在11个数据集和五种微调方法上，SAC改善了训练类和未见类的校准，并在跨数据集和域泛化评估中有效。互信息分析显示logit shift信号与ECE之间具有统计依赖性。
Conclusion: SAC利用logit shift作为校准信号是有效的，其shift-aware设计有实证支持，但可能需要更多场景验证。

papers.title: ANSR-DT: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adaptive and Explainable Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins are increasingly used to monitor and optimize industrial systems, yet many existing frameworks remain difficult to interpret, slow to adapt, and limited in their ability to incorporate explicit domain knowledge. This paper presents ANSR-DT, an adaptive neuro-symbolic framework that unifies temporal anomaly detection, symbolic reasoning, and reinforcement-learning-based decision support within a single digital twin pipeline. ANSR-DT combines a CNN-LSTM model for multivariate pattern recognition with Prolog-based reasoning that converts learned signals into explicit rules, enabling transparent diagnoses and traceable decision paths. A PPO-based adaptation layer further refines operational responses under changing conditions while preserving interpretability. Experiments against eight baselines show that ANSR-DT delivers competitive predictive performance together with stable rule extraction, scalable symbolic reasoning, and actionable explanations. Additional validation on the Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark (SKAB) further indicates that the framework transfers beyond synthetic settings. These findings position ANSR-DT as a practical foundation for trustworthy, adaptive, and explainable industrial digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANSR-DT 是一个自适应神经符号框架，将时序异常检测、符号推理和强化学习决策支持整合到数字孪生管道中。它结合 CNN-LSTM 模型与 Prolog 推理，将学习到的信号转化为显式规则，并利用 PPO 层在保持可解释性的同时优化操作响应。实验表明，ANSR-DT 在多个基线中表现出色，并在 Skoltech 异常基准 (SKAB) 上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有数字孪生框架在可解释性、自适应能力和领域知识融入方面存在局限，难以满足工业系统对透明和可信决策的需求。
Method: 提出 ANSR-DT 框架，包含三个核心组件：CNN-LSTM 进行多变量模式识别，Prolog 推理引擎将学习信号转换为显式规则，以及 PPO 强化学习层在变化条件下优化操作响应同时保持可解释性。
Result: 在多个基线对比中取得有竞争力的预测性能，同时实现了稳定的规则提取、可扩展的符号推理和可操作的解释。在 SKAB 基准上的额外验证表明框架可迁移到非合成场景。
Conclusion: ANSR-DT 为可信、自适应和可解释的工业数字孪生提供了实用基础，但摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Mamba-CL: Optimizing Selective State Space Model in Null Space for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual Learning (CL) aims to equip AI models with the ability to learn a sequence of tasks over time, without forgetting previously learned knowledge. Recently, State Space Models (SSMs), particularly the Mamba model, have achieved notable success in computer vision. Building on the strengths of SSMs, this study explores leveraging the Mamba model for CL. Therefore, we introduce Mamba-CL, a framework that continuously fine-tunes the core SSMs of the large-scale Mamba foundation model by updating parameters orthogonal to the feature subspace of previous tasks. This approach theoretically guarantees the consistency objective aiming to preserves consistent output for each SSM module across both previous and current tasks, so as to overcome catastrophic forgetting issue. Specifically, we achieve this goal by deducing the overall consistency constraints on four key time-invariant parameters in the Mamba model, streamlining its recurrent state-space structure and non-linear discretization process in SSM. In practice, we apply the null-space projection to efficiently implement the orthogonality within Mamba model. Extensive experiments on four class-incremental benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Mamba-CL for anti-forgetting, achieving superior performances to state-of-the-art methods. Code is available in the supplementary materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mamba-CL框架，将Mamba状态空间模型应用于持续学习（continual learning），通过将参数更新约束在之前任务特征子空间的正交方向上，避免灾难性遗忘。在四个类别增量学习基准上，该方法取得了优于现有持续学习方法的性能。
Motivation: 持续学习面临灾难性遗忘问题，而状态空间模型（如Mamba）在视觉任务中表现优异，但尚未被充分探索用于持续学习。
Method: 推导了Mamba模型中四个关键时不变参数的整体一致性约束，通过零空间投影（null-space projection）实现正交约束，使得每个SSM模块在旧任务和新任务上的输出保持一致。
Result: 在四个类别增量学习基准上，Mamba-CL在抗遗忘方面优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: Mamba-CL通过正交参数更新有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，扩展了状态空间模型在持续学习中的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Phenology-based learning framework for yield estimation and harvest forecasting of raspberry fruits
papers.abstract_en: The future of agriculture is intertwined with automation. Accurate fruit detection, yield estimation, and harvest time prediction are crucial for efficient supply chain management by optimizing resources and logistic utilization. Computer vision can automate these tasks to reduce labour costs and improve efficiency by training deep learning models on appropriate data to perform knowledge-based tasks. Although fruit detection has been the focus of literature, yield prediction and harvest time estimation remain practical challenges for farmers. This is particularly important for high-value, highly perishable crops, such as raspberries, where contractual obligations require precise harvest timing. This paper addresses this gap by providing a learning-based framework for raspberry maturity detection and harvest time estimation. For this end, a phenology study of raspberry plants from three different cultivars was carried out, and seven development stages were identified based on the BBCH-scale; for the first time, a phenology-based dataset of developing raspberry flowers and fruit was curated and made available publicly, which contains 1,853 high-resolution images and 6,907 manually labelled annotations. A comprehensive benchmark was developed from state-of-the-art object detection models, and finally, a tailored deep learning model capable of real-time inference was established that achieved 92.2% detection accuracy in the vertical farm field test. This paper provides a model that can estimate raspberry yield 28 to 33 days in advance of harvesting, a dataset that can be used by other researchers for object detection and segmentation model development, and a framework that can be extended for precise yield and harvest time estimation.

papers.title: LIBMoE: A Library for comprehensive benchmarking Mixture of Experts in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture of experts (MoE) architectures have become a cornerstone for scaling up and are a key component in most large language models such as GPT-OSS, DeepSeek-V3, Llama-4, and Gemini-2.5. However, systematic research on MoE remains severely constrained by the prohibitive computational costs of training and evaluation, restricting large-scale studies accessible to most researchers. We introduce LibMoE, a unified framework for reproducible, efficient, and extensible MoE research that supports both pretraining and sparse-upcycling regimes. Beyond unified implementations, the framework provides transparent analytical tools for probing routing and expert dynamics. Leveraging this foundation, we conduct a comprehensive analysis along three dimensions: (i) routing dynamics, covering expert selection patterns, routing stability and optimality, and how routing entropy reveals task specialization and expert diversity; (ii) the effect of lightweight initialization on load balancing, demonstrating how subtle changes in router initialization shape early expert utilization; and (iii) training regime differences, revealing how sparse upcycling and full pretraining exhibit distinct routing patterns and stability profiles. By lowering the barrier to entry and standardizing evaluation, along with our comprehensive analysis, LibMoE broadens access to MoE research and establishes a reliable benchmark to guide future innovations. GitHub: \href{https://github.com/Fsoft-AIC/LibMoE}{https://github.com/Fsoft-AIC/LibMoE}.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LibMoE 是一个统一的可重复、高效、可扩展的混合专家 (MoE) 研究框架，支持预训练和稀疏升级 (sparse upcycling) 两种训练模式。框架提供透明的分析工具用于探测路由和专家动力学，并基于此对路由动态、轻量初始化的影响以及训练范式差异进行了三个维度的综合分析。通过降低计算门槛和标准化评估，LibMoE 旨在推动 MoE 研究的可复现性和未来创新。
Motivation: MoE 架构是大语言模型扩展的关键组件，但训练和评估的高昂计算成本严重限制了系统性的可复现研究，因此亟需一个统一高效的基准框架。
Method: 构建 LibMoE 统一框架，集成多种 MoE 实现；设计分析工具用于追踪路由选择、稳定性、最优性及熵变化；在三个方向进行实验：路由动力学、路由器初始化的扰动效应、稀疏升级 vs 预训练的训练差异。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称通过综合分析揭示了路由模式、初始化对负载均衡的早期影响，以及稀疏升级与预训练在路由稳定性和动态上的差异。
Conclusion: LibMoE 通过降低实验门槛和提供全面分析，为 MoE 社区建立了可靠的基准，有助于指导未来研究。

papers.title: No Optimal Language Set Exists for Multilingual Instruction Tuning: Insights from a Linguistically-Informed Study
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual instruction tuning (MIT) is challenged by the curse of multilinguality, data scarcity, and high computational cost. A natural hypothesis is that carefully selecting a linguistically diverse set of languages yields universally better models. We test this systematically by evaluating linguistically-informed selection strategies---based on typological, geographical, semantic, and learned features---against random baselines across three model families (mGPT, mT5-xl, BLOOM) and five multilingual benchmarks. Our key negative finding is that no universal language selection strategy emerges in our fixed-budget setting: performance is strongly task- and model-dependent, and adding more languages beyond a modest threshold triggers degradation consistent with the curse of multilinguality. We discuss implications for MIT data curation and the pitfalls of benchmark-averaged evaluation. All resources are publicly available at https://github.com/GGLAB-KU/ling-informed-mit.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures Updated the title and revised the manuscript for submission to the Workshop on Insights from Negative Results in NLP (Insights 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统测试了多语言指令微调（MIT）中基于语言学特征（类型学、地理、语义、学习表示）的语言选择策略，在三种模型（mGPT、mT5-xl、BLOOM）和五个多语言基准上发现，不存在通用的最优语言集合。性能强烈依赖于具体任务和模型，且增加语言数量超过适度阈值会引发性能下降（多语言诅咒）。
Motivation: 多语言指令微调面临多语言诅咒、数据稀缺和高计算成本，直觉上选择语言学多样的语言集合可能带来更好的通用模型，但缺乏系统验证。
Method: 采用基于类型学、地理、语义和学习表示的多种语言学信息选择策略，在固定预算下与随机基线对比，跨三个模型族和五个多语言基准进行评估。
Result: 没有任何语言选择策略在所有设置下优于随机基线；性能高度依赖于任务和模型，增加语言数量超过一定阈值会导致性能下降，验证了多语言诅咒。
Conclusion: 作者强调不存在普遍最优的语言集合，MIT数据筛选应基于具体任务和模型，并指出基于基准平均评估的潜在陷阱。

papers.title: Beyond Squared Error: Exploring Loss Design for Enhanced Training of Generative Flow Networks
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a novel class of generative models designed to sample from unnormalized distributions and have found applications in various important tasks, attracting great research interest in their training algorithms. In general, GFlowNets are trained by fitting the forward flow to the backward flow on sampled training objects. Prior work focused on the choice of training objects, parameterizations, sampling and resampling strategies, and backward policies, aiming to enhance credit assignment, exploration, or exploitation of the training process. However, the choice of regression loss, which can highly influence the exploration and exploitation behavior of the under-training policy, has been overlooked. Due to the lack of theoretical understanding for choosing an appropriate regression loss, most existing algorithms train the flow network by minimizing the squared error of the forward and backward flows in log-space, i.e., using the quadratic regression loss. In this work, we rigorously prove that distinct regression losses correspond to specific divergence measures, enabling us to design and analyze regression losses according to the desired properties of the corresponding divergence measures. Specifically, we examine two key properties: zero-forcing and zero-avoiding, where the former promotes exploitation and higher rewards, and the latter encourages exploration and enhances diversity. Based on our theoretical framework, we propose three novel regression losses, namely, Shifted-Cosh, Linex(1/2), and Linex(1). We evaluate them across three benchmarks: hyper-grid, bit-sequence generation, and molecule generation. Our proposed losses are compatible with most existing training algorithms, and significantly improve the performances of the algorithms concerning convergence speed, sample diversity, and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成流网络（GFlowNets）中回归损失函数的选择，证明不同损失对应不同的散度度量，具有零强制或零避免性质，并提出三种新损失函数（Shifted-Cosh、Linex(1/2)、Linex(1)），在超网格、比特序列生成和分子生成任务上提升收敛速度、多样性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有GFlowNets训练方法忽视了回归损失函数的选择，默认使用平方误差损失，缺乏理论指导。
Method: 从理论角度证明不同回归损失对应不同散度度量，基于零强制和零避免性质设计新损失，并与现有训练算法兼容。
Result: 新损失在三个基准上显著提升收敛速度、样本多样性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 损失函数设计对GFlowNets探索-利用行为有重要影响，提出的损失可广泛适用。

papers.title: Procedural Content Generation via Generative Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The attempt to utilize machine learning in PCG has been made in the past. In this survey paper, we investigate how generative artificial intelligence (AI), which saw a significant increase in interest in the mid-2010s, is being used for PCG. We review applications of generative AI for the creation of various types of content, including terrains, items, and even storylines. While generative AI is effective for PCG, one significant issues it faces is that building high-performance generative AI requires vast amounts of training data. Because content generally highly customized, domain-specific training data is scarce, and straightforward approaches to generative AI models may not work well. For PCG research to advance further, issues related to limited training data must be overcome. Thus, we also give special consideration to research that addresses the challenges posed by limited training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，调查了生成式AI（generative AI）在程序化内容生成（PCG）中的应用，涵盖地形、物品和故事线等内容的创建。文章指出，虽然生成式AI对PCG有效，但面临训练数据稀缺的挑战，因为内容高度定制化，领域专用数据不足。特别关注了针对有限训练数据问题的研究方向。
Motivation: 过去已尝试将机器学习用于PCG，但生成式AI在PCG中的系统应用和训练数据限制问题尚未被充分综述。
Method: 作为综述论文，本文通过文献回顾，分类讨论了生成式AI在各类PCG任务中的应用，并重点分析了应对训练数据稀缺的研究方法。
Conclusion: 生成式AI在PCG中有效，但必须克服有限训练数据的挑战，领域定制数据和数据增强可能是关键。

papers.title: Evaluation of Blood Vessel Segmentation Methods on Hard-to-Detect Vascular Structures
papers.abstract_en: Due to the intricate structure of vascular trees, minor segmentation errors can significantly alter connectivity patterns and increase variability in extracted morphological properties. Global metrics such as the Dice coefficient, precision, and recall often overlook inaccuracies in specific regions of a sample. To address this, we define a Local Vessel Salience (LVS) index to quantify the difficulty of identifying specific vessel segments. This index is used to evaluate the performance of 16 segmentation methods across six widely used 2D datasets. The LVS index is calculated for each vessel pixel by comparing local vessel intensity against the surrounding background. We introduce a metric termed mean Low-Salience Recall (mLSR) to quantify how effectively algorithms recover hard-to-detect vessels. Furthermore, we propose a proof-of-concept data augmentation procedure guided by the LVS index aimed at improving neural network segmentation performance. Our findings demonstrate that segmentation performance strongly correlates with LVS, revealing systematic errors in vessels with low salience. The mLSR across all evaluated methods was significantly lower than standard recall values, with a typical performance decrease of 20 percentage points. In benchmark datasets such as DRIVE and OCTA-500, mLSR values for the top-performing methods were approximately 58%. The developed methodology provides a quantitative basis for the design of segmentation algorithms with improved sensitivity to hard-to-detect vessels and enhanced capabilities for preserving vascular connectivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对血管树分割中难以检测的细小血管结构，提出局部血管显著性（LVS）指数来量化每个血管像素的检测难度，并引入平均低显著性召回率（mLSR）指标评估16种分割方法在6个2D数据集上的表现。结果发现分割性能与LVS强相关，低显著性血管的召回率普遍降低约20个百分点，最佳方法在DRIVE和OCTA-500上的mLSR约为58%。还提出了基于LVS的数据增强方法以改进神经网络分割。
Motivation: 全局指标如Dice系数等无法反映特定区域（如细小血管）的分割错误，而这些错误会显著改变血管连通性和形态学特征。需要针对难检测血管的专门评估方法。
Method: 定义局部血管显著性（LVS）指数，基于像素与其周围背景的强度对比度量检测难度；提出平均低显著性召回率（mLSR）作为性能指标；并开发基于LVS的数据增强方法。
Result: 在6个2D数据集上评估16种方法，发现分割性能与LVS强相关；所有方法的mLSR显著低于标准召回率，平均降低20个百分点；最优方法在DRIVE和OCTA-500上mLSR约58%。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了定量评估和提升难检测血管分割性能的方法，有助于保持血管连通性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该研究提供了定量评估和提升难检测血管分割性能的方法，有助于保持血管连通性。

papers.title: Speed Reading Tool Powered by Artificial Intelligence for Students with ADHD, Dyslexia, and Short Attention Span
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an artificial intelligence tool designed to assist students with dyslexia, ADHD, and short attention spans in processing text-based information more efficiently. The proposed solution addresses both cognitive and visual reading barriers by pairing a cloud-hosted large language model with adaptive typographic formatting. At its core, the tool streams a request to Google's Gemini API to generate accurate, context-aware summaries in real time, removing the need to host or fine-tune a local model. The application accepts pasted text as well as uploaded .txt, .pdf, and .docx files, extracting and summarizing each source independently. To further optimize readability, the system layers a custom half-word bolding technique with a second pass that identifies and highlights genuine keywords using part-of-speech tagging and frequency ranking, and lets users manually adjust line, word, letter, and text spacing. Deployed through a lightweight Flask web framework that proxies requests to Gemini, the system provides a highly personalized and accessible user interface. Initial results demonstrate that this integrated approach significantly improves both reading speed and comprehension, enabling targeted students to digest complex textual data with greater focus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个人工智能驱动的高速阅读工具，旨在帮助患有多动症（ADHD）、阅读障碍和注意力短暂的学生更高效地处理文本信息。该工具通过调用谷歌Gemini API生成实时摘要，并结合自适应排版格式、半词加粗技术、词性标注和频率排序来突出关键词，同时允许用户手动调整行、词、字母和文本间距。初期结果显示，该方法显著提高了目标学生的阅读速度和理解能力。
Motivation: 患有ADHD、阅读障碍和注意力短暂的学生在消化文本信息时面临认知和视觉双重障碍，现有阅读辅助工具不足以提供个性化、实时的支持。
Method: 采用轻量级Flask框架代理请求谷歌Gemini API，实现无需本地模型调优的实时摘要生成；结合半词加粗技术（half-word bolding）与基于词性标注和频率排序的关键词高亮；提供可调的行距、词距、字母间距和文本间距。
Result: 初步实验表明，该工具能显著提升目标学生的阅读速度和理解能力，帮助其更专注地消化复杂文本数据。
Conclusion: 该集成方法通过实时摘要、自适应排版和个性化间距调整，为特殊需求学生提供了一种有效的阅读辅助方案，但摘要未提及大规模或正式实验验证。
