papers.title: DomainPilot: Domain-Level Loss-Guided Two-Stage Data Mixture Optimization for Efficient Language Model Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: The training efficacy of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality and composition of training data. Existing dynamic data scheduling methods face critical limitations in industrial-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT): data selection incurs prohibitive O(N) costs on terabyte-scale corpora, mixture optimization schemes introduce severe I/O bottlenecks or require training auxiliary reference models, and sample-level reweighting strategies rely on loss signals that conflate noise, difficulty, and novelty. We present DomainPilot, a domain-level loss-guided two-stage data mixture optimization framework. DomainPilot introduces token-level domain loss monitoring to capture per-domain learning dynamics during training without halting the data pipeline. Building on these signals, we propose a Scaling Law guided coarse optimization stage that fits domain-specific convergence curves and derives a principled prior for mixture adjustment. A subsequent Mixing Law guided fine optimization stage refines the mixture by modeling cross-domain interaction effects through controlled sweep experiments. The entire mechanism is realized via a patch-based architecture that injects domain-aware loss computation into existing training frameworks (e.g., MindSpeed/Megatron-LM) with only ~30 lines of framework-specific adapter code. We validate DomainPilot on the Qwen3-1.7B model during SFT. Compared to the original data mixture, our optimized mixture achieves improvements of +2% on MMLU-Redux, +1.8% on AIME24, +3.8% on LiveCodeBench v5, and +3.6% on BFCL v3, without increasing total data volume or training cost. These results demonstrate that domain-level training signals provide an effective, lightweight alternative to expensive data selection or auxiliary model training for mixture optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DomainPilot，一个基于领域级别损失的数据混合优化框架，用于高效的大语言模型微调。它通过两阶段优化：Scaling Law引导的粗优化和Mixing Law引导的精优化，在不增加数据量或训练成本的情况下提升SFT性能。在Qwen3-1.7B上，MMLU-Redux等指标提升2%-3.8%。
Motivation: 现有动态数据调度方法在工业级预训练和SFT中存在高选择成本（O(N)）、I/O瓶颈或需要训练辅助模型等问题。样本级重加权依赖损失信号，难以区分噪声、难度和新颖性。
Method: 提出DomainPilot，包含令牌级领域损失监控、Scaling Law粗优化阶段（拟合领域收敛曲线获得混合调整先验）和Mixing Law精优化阶段（通过受控扫描实验建模跨领域交互效应）。采用补丁架构，仅需约30行适配器代码集成到现有训练框架。
Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B的SFT上，与原始数据混合相比，MMLU-Redux +2%，AIME24 +1.8%，LiveCodeBench v5 +3.8%，BFCL v3 +3.6%，不增加数据量或训练成本。
Conclusion: 摘要表明领域级别的训练信号为混合优化提供了一种轻量级有效替代方案，无需昂贵的数据选择或辅助模型训练。

papers.title: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality. As datasets scale, massive preference and instruction-tuning corpora inevitably accumulate hidden structural contradictions, safety risks, and systemic human annotation errors. Standard dataset auditing methods, such as semantic deduplication or LLM-as-a-judge, struggle to capture the actual predictive impact of individual records and often miss deep functional rule clashes. To address this, we introduce a scalable, inference-only data valuation pipeline that approximates the Shapley value without iterative model retraining. By mapping semantic k-NN neighborhoods into a directed graph, our framework evaluates data utility directly through a reference LLM's probability distribution using zero-shot and one-shot conditional log-likelihood shifts. Our pipeline then translates these predictive influence scores into localized advantage metrics to isolate gradient-conflicting records. We demonstrate the pipeline's efficacy in sanitizing two heavily vetted alignment datasets. First, applying our pipeline to the HelpSteer2 dataset reduced the manual audit search space by 99.1%, successfully uncovering falsely-labeled records across diverse failure modes. Second, applying our automated audit strategy to Anthropic's HH-RLHF training and evaluation splits identified thousands of hidden safety and factual preference inversions. Crucially, by extending this audit to the evaluation split, we expose severe vulnerabilities in current benchmark integrity: highly capable models frequently predict the safer or more helpful response, only to be penalized by objectively flawed human ground-truth labels. Overall, our work provides a mathematically grounded, highly efficient diagnostic tool to uncover human label failures, sanitize evaluation benchmarks, and ensure the integrity of LLM alignment data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展、仅需推理的数据价值评估管道，通过近似Shapley值而不需要迭代重训练模型。该管道将语义k-NN邻域映射为有向图，利用参考LLM的零样本和单样本条件对数似然变化评估数据效用，并转化为局部优势指标以隔离梯度冲突的记录。在HelpSteer2和Anthropic的HH-RLHF数据集上，该方法将人工审计搜索空间减少99.1%，并发现数千条隐藏的安全和事实偏好反转，揭示当前基准标签的严重缺陷。
Motivation: 大规模偏好和指令微调数据集中存在隐藏的结构矛盾、安全风险和人标注错误，现有审计方法如语义去重或LLM-as-a-judge难以捕捉单个记录的实际预测影响，且常忽略深层功能规则冲突。
Method: 提出基于Shapley值的可扩展推理数据审计管道：通过语义k-NN邻域构建有向图，使用参考LLM的零样本和单样本条件对数似然变化计算预测影响分数，再转化为局部优势指标以识别梯度冲突记录。
Result: 在HelpSteer2数据集上，该管道将人工审计搜索空间减少99.1%，成功发现多种故障模式的错误标签；在HH-RLHF数据集上识别出数千条隐藏的安全和事实偏好反转，并暴露当前基准标签的严重缺陷。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了数学上严谨、高效的诊断工具，可发现人类标注失败、净化评估基准、确保LLM对齐数据的完整性。

papers.title: Frequency-Aware Dual-Stream Learning for Balanced Realism and Fidelity in Electron Microscopy Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Electron microscopy enables nanoscale cellular visualization but faces a trade-off between imaging resolution and acquisition speed. Existing learning-based methods rely on single-stream architectures that struggle to balance perceptual realism and quantitative fidelity, either over-smoothing details or generating unrealistic hallucinations. This work introduces a frequency-adaptive dual-stream architecture to resolve this conflict. Using discrete wavelet transform, we decompose images into low-frequency structures and high-frequency details, then employ a conditional diffusion model for realistic global synthesis and a transformer network for precise detail recovery. Experiments on the EMDiffuse dataset show the method achieves superior LPIPS and resolution ratio, substantially outperforming existing approaches. The method also shows strong generalization across diverse biological samples, supporting fast and reliable electron microscopy imaging for structural biology and nanotechnology applications. The source code and associated dataset are publicly available to facilitate further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子显微镜成像中分辨率与采集速度的权衡问题，提出一种频率感知双流架构。该架构利用离散小波变换将图像分解为低频结构和高频细节，分别用条件扩散模型进行全局合成和用Transformer进行细节恢复。在EMDiffuse数据集上，该方法在LPIPS和分辨率比指标上优于现有方法，并展现出对不同生物样本的良好泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的单流架构难以平衡感知真实性和定量保真度，要么过度平滑细节，要么产生不真实的幻觉。
Method: 提出频率自适应双流架构：使用离散小波变换分解图像为低频结构和高频细节，采用条件扩散模型进行全局合成，同时用Transformer网络进行精确细节恢复。
Result: 在EMDiffuse数据集上，该方法在LPIPS和分辨率比指标上显著优于现有方法，并具备跨多种生物样本的强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该方法支持快速可靠的电子显微镜成像，适用于结构生物学和纳米技术应用，代码和数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robostral Navigate
papers.abstract_en: Deploying navigation systems at scale requires a recipe that minimizes sensor assumptions, generalizes across robot embodiments, and trains efficiently. Yet, today's best systems depend on depth sensors, multi-camera rigs, or pre-built maps, limiting the hardware they support and increasing deployment cost. We introduce Robostral Navigate, an 8B vision-language model built around this scalability objective. The model consumes only a stream of monocular RGB images - the most ubiquitous sensor across robotic platforms and predicts waypoints by pointing to the next target location in the current camera view. Operating purely in image space, rather than robot-specific coordinates, makes the policy naturally robust to changes in camera intrinsics and scene scale, enabling deployment across wheeled, legged, and aerial robots without recalibration. We generate 2.4 million trajectories across 350k simulated scenes to reduce the reliance on real-world data collection and scale easily. We further introduce a prefix-caching training recipe that packs entire episodes into single training sequences, reducing training tokens by 22x and cutting training time from months to days. A tree-based attention mask prevents conditioning on previous ground-truth actions, encouraging visually grounded action prediction, and reinforcement learning is used to further improve exploration and recovery capabilities. On the Room-to-Room and Room-Across-Room in Continuous Environments (R2R-CE and RxR-CE) benchmarks, Robostral Navigate sets a new state of the art. On R2R-CE, it achieves a 77.4% success rate, surpassing the best monocular method by 10.5 points and the strongest depth- or multi-camera system by 5.3 points despite using only a single RGB camera. On RxR-CE, it reaches 75.1% success rate, outperforming all monocular baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Robostral Navigate，一个8B参数视觉-语言模型，仅使用单目RGB图像进行导航，通过预测当前视图中的下一个目标点来生成航点。模型在模拟场景中生成240万条轨迹进行训练，并采用前缀缓存训练方法大幅减少训练时间和tokens。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上取得了新的SOTA，分别达到77.4%和75.1%的成功率，超越了依赖深度或多相机的系统。
Motivation: 现有导航系统依赖深度传感器、多相机或预建地图，增加了部署成本和硬件限制。本文旨在提出仅使用单目RGB相机即可跨机器人形态泛化的高效导航方法，降低规模化部署的障碍。
Method: 构建8B参数视觉-语言模型，仅输入单目RGB图像流，输出指向下一目标位置的航点。训练数据来自35万模拟场景中的240万条轨迹。提出前缀缓存训练配方，将整个episode打包为单个训练序列，减少22倍训练tokens。使用树形注意力掩码防止模型依赖先前真实动作，并通过强化学习进一步提升探索和恢复能力。
Result: 在R2R-CE上达到77.4%成功率，超过最佳单目方法10.5个百分点，超过最强深度/多相机系统5.3个百分点。在RxR-CE上达到75.1%成功率，超越所有单目基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仅使用单目RGB的视觉-语言导航方法能够达到超越深度/多相机系统的性能，且训练效率高，具有规模化部署的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Compositional Skills in Mixture-of-Experts VLAs
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning compositional robot policies end-to-end from expert demonstrations, without any pre-specified notion of task decomposition or hierarchy. We ask whether a VLA trained with a simplified Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) action head can emergently learn to decompose tasks into reusable, interpretable primitives. We find that learned experts are heavily reused across tasks and consistently correspond to qualitatively distinct low-level behaviors, suggesting that the router implicitly learns to perform high-level sequencing while experts serve as compositional primitives. Our MoE matches the task performance of a monolithic baseline while demonstrating meaningful expert specialization, a step toward modular, interpretable robot policies that emerge from data alone.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从专家演示中端到端学习组合性机器人策略，采用简化混合专家（MoE）动作头。实验表明，MoE路由器隐式学习高层任务分解，专家单元作为可复用且可解释的低级行为原语，在保持与单一体基线相当的任务性能的同时，实现了有意义的专家专业化。
Motivation: 现有机器人策略常需预定义任务分解或层次结构，本文探索能否从数据中自动涌现组合性原语。
Method: 在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中引入简化MoE动作头，通过端到端训练从专家示范中学习，无需任何任务分解先验。
Result: 学习到的专家在不同任务间被高度复用，且一致对应定性不同的低级行为，路由器隐式学习高层序列；MoE在任务性能上与单一体基线匹配。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了从数据中涌现模块化、可解释机器人策略的可行性，为无需人工分解的组合学习提供了一种方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Meta-Policies for Temporal Knowledge-Graph Memory under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Partially observable reinforcement learning requires deciding what to retain, retrieve, and forget over time. We introduce a neuro-symbolic meta-policy that learns which symbolic memory heuristic to apply at each decision point while keeping execution symbolic. Our setting uses temporal knowledge-graph memory in RoomKG, where hidden state and observations are represented as Resource Description Framework (RDF) graphs and memory is augmented with temporal RDF triple annotations. The model combines knowledge-graph encoding of memory contents with value heads for question answering, exploration, and forgetting, yielding a controller that is both adaptive and inspectable. This gives the work a direct Semantic Web grounding through RDF-based representation, annotation-compatible graph semantics, and graph-based symbolic operations over explicit memory state. On train/test room splits at long-term memory capacity of 512, the qualifier-aware StarE-GNN configuration achieves the best held-out performance among the compared symbolic, neural, and neuro-symbolic systems while preserving step-level traceability of memory-management decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号元策略（neuro-symbolic meta-policy），用于部分可观测强化学习中时间知识图谱记忆的管理。该方法在RoomKG环境中使用RDF图表示隐藏状态和观测，结合知识图谱编码与值函数头进行问答、探索和遗忘，实现自适应且可解释的控制。在512长期记忆容量下，qualifier-aware StarE-GNN配置在已分割的房间里取得最佳留出性能，同时保持记忆管理决策的逐步骤可追溯性。
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习需要智能体在时间上决定保留、检索和遗忘哪些信息，现有方法缺乏显式符号记忆的可解释性和灵活性。
Method: 提出神经符号元策略：学习在每个决策点选择符号记忆启发式（如保留、检索、遗忘），同时保持执行过程符号化。具体采用RDF图编码记忆内容，结合值函数头进行问答、探索和遗忘操作，形成自适应且可检查的控制器。
Result: 在RoomKG环境的train/test房间分割设置下，长期记忆容量为512时，qualifier-aware StarE-GNN配置在比较的符号、神经和神经符号系统中取得最佳留出性能，且能提供记忆管理决策的逐步骤可追溯性。
Conclusion: 该工作基于RDF表示、注释兼容图语义和显式记忆状态上的图符号操作，直接扎根于语义网，但摘要未讨论泛化到其他环境或大规模场景的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Search Beyond What Can Be Taught: Evolving the Knowledge Boundary in Agentic Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Visual generators excel at rendering, but they confidently fabricate what they do not know. User requests are unbounded, evolving, and deeply long-tailed: new characters, trending entities, post-cutoff events, and more. This world-knowledge bottleneck is structural: generators are trained on fixed corpora, but the visual world is open-ended. We construct SearchGen-20K and SearchGen-Bench, with 20,839 prompts spanning twelve failure categories and twenty-two domains, paired with a pre-executed multimodal SearchGen-Corpus-1M to support offline, reproducible research. On SearchGen-Bench, frontier open generators score only 21 to 28 out of 100, a 40-point collapse invisible to existing benchmarks. The natural remedy is to employ search tools, enabling agentic visual generation. However, we find that naive search fails: it retrieves indiscriminately, injecting noise into prompts the generator already handles. We trace the root cause to a generator-specific, evolving knowledge boundary: the divide between what a generator can internalize through training and what must remain in external context. Although this boundary is hard to specify in advance, we show that it is discoverable through a teach-then-search co-training framework. Even a minimal version of this co-training recipe produces monotonic improvement, laying the foundation for recursive self-improvement in visual generation that can meet world-knowledge-grounded requests. We release the full dataset, co-training corpus, and search corpus as a replayable harness for tool-augmented, world-knowledge-grounded visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前视觉生成模型在应对用户长尾、未知概念请求时存在知识边界瓶颈，即模型会自信地编造其不了解的内容。作者构建了SearchGen-20K基准和SearchGen-Corpus-1M语料库，发现前沿开源生成器在该基准上得分仅21-28/100，与现有基准存在40分差距。为解决此问题，提出了一种基于搜索的工具增强生成方法，但简单搜索会引入噪声，因此进一步提出“教而后搜”（teach-then-search）的协同训练框架，该框架能自动发现生成器特定的演变知识边界，并实现单调改进。
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型在训练时依赖固定语料库，无法处理用户不断提出的新角色、流行实体、截止日期后事件等长尾请求，存在结构性知识瓶颈。
Method: 提出“教而后搜”协同训练框架：先通过传统监督训练教生成器掌握可内化的知识，再使用搜索工具补充外部知识，通过迭代过程发现并扩展生成器的知识边界。
Result: 在SearchGen-Bench上，前沿开源生成器仅得21-28/100分，而所提出的协同训练框架（即便最小版本）能实现单调改进，奠定递归自我改进的基础。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为工具增强的、基于世界知识的视觉生成提供了可复现的研究平台，并指出知识边界虽难以预先指定但可通过协同训练自动发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSP with Predictions: Heatmap to Tour with Provable Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: The Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) has long served as a benchmark for evaluating the strength of optimization techniques in the classical theory of algorithms. In recent efforts to apply ML to algorithmic problems, TSP has also become a natural testbed for the development of ML-based techniques. A common approach is to train a neural network to output a heatmap estimating the likelihood of each edge to be part of the optimal tour; however, converting such a heatmap into an actual tour remains a non-trivial and often computationally intensive step. In this work, we propose algorithms for transforming heatmaps into tours with theoretical guarantees linking the achieved approximation ratio to the quality of the provided heatmap. In the spirit of algorithms with predictions, our results can be described as $(1+2\fracη{\mathrm{OPT}})$-approximation algorithms, where $η$ denotes the L1 distance between the prediction (heatmap) and an optimal solution (tour). Since the previous works lack such explicit guarantees, we compare our approach against them experimentally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对旅行商问题（TSP），提出将神经网络输出的热力图转化为实际游览的算法，并给出了理论保证：近似比与热力图质量相关，为 (1+2η/OPT)，其中 η 是热力图与最优游览的 L1 距离。实验部分与缺乏显式保证的现有方法进行了比较。
Motivation: 现有方法中，神经网络生成热力图后，如何将其转化为可行游览面临挑战且计算复杂，缺乏将热力图质量与最终近似比联系起来的理论保证。
Method: 提出将热力图转化为游览的算法，在“带有预测的算法”框架下，分析近似比与预测误差的关系，得到 (1+2η/OPT) 的近似比。
Result: 理论上证明了近似比与热力图质量的关系，实验表明与缺乏显式保证的先前方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该工作为基于预测的TSP求解提供了理论担保，但仅针对特定度量（L1距离）和特定近似形式，实际应用中的热力图质量可能不同。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出将热力图转化为游览的算法，在“带有预测的算法”框架下，分析近似比与预测误差的关系，得到 (1+2η/OPT) 的近似比。
summary_sections.result: 理论上证明了近似比与热力图质量的关系，实验表明与缺乏显式保证的先前方法相比具有竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为基于预测的TSP求解提供了理论担保，但仅针对特定度量（L1距离）和特定近似形式，实际应用中的热力图质量可能不同。

papers.title: Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Interpretable Keystroke Biomarkers in Parkinson's Disease
papers.abstract_en: Keystroke dynamics offer a passive window into motor function, but existing work extracts aggregate typing statistics and trains classifiers for PD/control discrimination, foregoing interpretability and rarely reporting reliability. We instead apply maximum-entropy inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to raw keystroke timing, recovering a per-subject speed-preference weight (w_speed) reflecting the implicit cost assigned to fast movement, without any clinical label during fitting. On the neuroQWERTY MIT-CSXPD dataset (85 subjects, 42 PD), we diagnose and correct a feature collinearity failure in an initial four-parameter decomposition, yielding an identifiable three-parameter model. The recovered w_speed correlates with UPDRS-III motor severity at r=-0.607 (95% CI [-0.770,-0.364], p<0.001, n=42), replicates across two independent sub-cohorts (r=-0.720, r=-0.588), and retains significant partial correlation after controlling for mean and SD of flight time (r=-0.371, p=0.016). It outperforms SHAP and LASSO on the same proxy features (r=+0.362 and r=+0.410) while additionally providing per-subject, interpretable output. A model-free AUC of 0.605 and LOO-CV AUC of 0.750 (95% CI [0.644,0.847]) confirm discriminative value. Test-retest reliability across clinic sessions yields ICC(2,1)=0.903 (95% CI [0.842,0.971]); no prior keystroke-PD study has reported formal reliability. Two other recovered weights (consistency, hand-alternation) did not survive confound checks, strengthening credibility of the surviving signal. Cross-modality external validation on independent mPower smartphone tapping data (n=200) recovers the same signal (r=-0.639, p=2.52e-24, OR=14.19), confirming convergent validity across modality, device, and country.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文应用最大熵逆强化学习（IRL）从原始击键时序中恢复每个受试者的速度偏好权重，作为帕金森病的可解释生物标志物。在neuroQWERTY数据集上，该权重与UPDRS-III运动严重度相关（r=-0.607），具有高重测信度（ICC=0.903），并在独立智能手机数据上验证。
Motivation: 现有击键动力学研究通常提取聚合统计特征并训练分类器，缺乏可解释性和可靠性报告。
Method: 使用最大熵逆强化学习（IRL）对原始击键时序建模，恢复每个受试者的速度偏好权重，无需临床标签。
Result: 恢复的速度偏好权重与UPDRS-III运动严重度显著相关（r=-0.607），重测信度ICC=0.903，优于SHAP和LASSO，并在跨模态数据上验证。

papers.title: An LMM for Precisely Grounding Elements in Documents
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding in documents is a crucial ability for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in areas such as document understanding, deep research and document error detection. However, existing approaches exhibit poor grounding precision in text-rich document images, often failing to accurately locate the critical document elements needed for reliable reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce PreciseDoc, an LMM specifically designed for precise element grounding and can be further optimized for Document VQA tasks. Specifically, to enhance the basic localization capability, we construct challenging training data by two pipelines capable of mass-producing high-quality documents with paired metadata of fine-grained coordinates, including synthetic hand-filled documents with camera effects. The model develops more real-world functions beyond straightforward localization of single text, such as locating personal information from CVs. Furthermore, we introduce a training paradigm for visual grounded reasoning where the grounding and reasoning are supervised jointly with reinforcement learning to improve the contribution of the grounded evidence. A comprehensive evaluation on various benchmarks demonstrates the advantage of the proposed data and methods in document spatial grounding and document understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PreciseDoc，一个专为文档中精确元素定位设计的大多模态模型（LMM），通过合成高质量文档数据和强化学习联合训练定位与推理，提升文档视觉定位和文档理解性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在富含文本的文档图像中定位精度差，无法准确找到关键文档元素以支持可靠推理。
Method: 构建两条数据流水线批量生成带有细粒度坐标配对元数据的高质量文档（含相机效果的手写填充文档），并设计视觉定位推理训练范式，用强化学习联合监督定位和推理。
Result: 在多个基准上的综合评估表明，所提出的数据和方法在文档空间定位和文档理解方面具有优势。
Conclusion: PreciseDoc通过专门的数据和训练范式提升了文档元素定位的精度，并可进一步优化用于文档VQA任务。

papers.title: When Average Calibration Fails: Site-Conditional Federated Conformal Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: Conformal risk control (CRC) provides distribution-free segmentation guarantees by calibrating a prediction-set threshold on held-out data. In federated deployments, the standard approach pools calibration scores into a single threshold. We quantify, on real multi-institutional brain tumor data (FeTS-2022, 1,251 subjects, 20 institutions), a critical failure: naive pooled CRC protects the average hospital but violates coverage at 40% of individual institutions, with the worst site exceeding the target false-negative rate by 7.8 percentage points. We trace this failure to a hidden design choice: the aggregation weights implicitly determine whose coverage is protected. Sample-size weighting optimizes patient-level validity but can sacrifice institution-level reliability; equal-site weighting improves institution-level reliability on this benchmark at comparable efficiency, using only a single scalar per site. We propose risk-curve shrinkage as a principled mechanism: each site transmits its empirical risk curve (G scalars) and a single hyperparameter n0 smoothly interpolates between site-specific local calibration and sample-size-weighted pooled calibration. Leave-one-site-out sensitivity analysis identifies n0=19, achieving 2.7/20 violations at 2.0x stretch. Direct Lagrangian budget optimization fails by concentrating risk on vulnerable hospitals; the finite-sample correction term is essential: removing it triples violations. No patient-level images, masks, or per-volume scores leave any site.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the DeCaF Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中的符合风险控制（CRC）在多中心医学图像分割中的校准失败问题。在20个机构的脑肿瘤数据（FeTS-2022，1251名受试者）上，标准池化CRC保护平均医院但导致40%的机构违反覆盖率，最差站点假阴性率超过目标7.8个百分点。作者提出风险曲线收缩机制，每个站点传输经验风险曲线（G个标量）和超参数n0，在站点局部校准和样本量加权池化校准之间平滑插值，利用留一法敏感性分析确定n0=19，实现2.7/20的违规数。
Motivation: 标准联邦训练中，池化CRC（Conformal Risk Control）通过单个阈值校准保护平均医院，但忽视了个体机构的覆盖率，导致在真实多中心脑肿瘤数据上40%的机构违反覆盖率，最差站点假阴性率超出目标7.8个百分点。
Method: 提出风险曲线收缩（risk-curve shrinkage）：每个站点传输其经验风险曲线（G个标量）和一个超参数n0，n0平滑插值于站点特定局部校准和样本量加权池化校准之间。通过留一站点敏感性分析确定n0，并强调有限样本修正项的关键作用。
Result: 在FeTS-2022数据集上，风险曲线收缩方法在n0=19时实现2.7/20的违规数，代价是2.0倍的区间伸展。直接拉格朗日预算优化失败，将风险集中在脆弱医院；去除有限样本修正项会使违规数增加三倍。
Conclusion: 联邦风险控制的聚合权重隐式决定保护谁的覆盖率，样本量加权优化患者级有效性但牺牲机构级可靠性，等站点加权可提高机构级可靠性。提出的风险曲线收缩提供了一种原则性机制，平衡局部与全局校准，且有限样本修正项至关重要。

papers.title: Market Design for AI: Beyond the Copyright Binary
papers.abstract_en: How can we design a market of human-generated content for use in training AI models that both enables technological progress and preserves individual incentives for high-quality content creation? Existing approaches take polar positions: a "free-for-all" model based on fair use and a "strong intellectual property rights" model. We show that both fail: Free-for-all does not compensate creators, and---by modeling as a static Stackelberg game---strong intellectual property rights also underpower creative incentives. We find this especially true for more innovative creators, a phenomenon we term the "originality penalty." Extending this insight to a dynamic model, we find another market failure undermining AI model performance, even for an initially good model: Such a model induces greater reliance by humans on AI-assisted creation, resulting in homogenized content feeding back into training, which degrades the model performance---a "curse of precision." We further propose a market design with a data intermediary negotiating collectively with the AI firm and subsidizing innovative contributions, thus restoring efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文探讨如何设计人类生成内容的市场用于训练AI模型，以平衡技术进步与创作者激励。分析两种极端模型：自由使用和强知识产权保护，指出两者均失败。特别地，强知识产权保护下创新创作者面临“原创性惩罚”，动态模型中存在“精确度诅咒”，即AI辅助导致内容同质化，损害模型性能。提出数据中介集体谈判并补贴创新贡献的市场设计。
Motivation: 现有市场设计在激励高质量内容创作与促进AI技术进步之间存在矛盾，两种极端方案（自由使用和强知识产权）均无法有效补偿创作者或维持创作激励。
Method: 分别建立静态Stackelberg博弈模型和动态市场模型分析两种极端方案，提出数据中介（data intermediary）作为集体谈判方，补贴创新贡献的市场机制。
Result: 强知识产权保护下，创新创作者受到“原创性惩罚”（originality penalty）；动态中，AI模型精准性导致人类过度依赖AI，产生内容同质化的“精确度诅咒”（curse of precision），反馈循环降低模型性能。
Conclusion: 通过集体谈判和补贴创新贡献的数据中介市场设计可以恢复效率，平衡技术进步与创作者激励。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: As recommender systems transition toward agentic, multi-turn conversational interfaces, evaluation paradigms have struggled to keep pace. Current benchmarks often rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" evaluations, which introduce subjectivity, high costs and inconsistency. We present $τ$-Rec, a benchmark for agentic recommender systems that replaces subjective evaluation with verifiable rewards and a reveal-tagged elicitation (RTE) mechanism that controls how task constraints surface during dialogue. By testing agents against structured catalog predicates and employing a pass^k reliability metric, $τ$-Rec provides a systematic test for consistent reasoning. Our evaluation of nine configurations across five model families -- GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3-32B and GPT-5 mini -- reveals a steep reliability cliff, where even the best model achieves only ~57% at pass^1 and ~35% at pass^4, highlighting a critical gap in current conversational agent deployment. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM RecSys 2026 (Reproducibility and Resource Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出τ-Rec基准，用于评估智能推荐系统在多轮对话中的表现。该基准使用可验证奖励和揭示标签引导机制替代主观的LLM-as-a-judge评估。实验发现，即使在最佳模型上，pass^1仅约57%，pass^4约35%，显示当前对话代理存在严重的可靠性悬崖。
Motivation: 当前推荐系统评估依赖LLM-as-a-judge，存在主观性、高成本和不一致性问题，需要更客观的基准。
Method: 提出τ-Rec基准，通过可验证奖励和揭示标签引导机制控制任务约束在对话中的呈现方式，并使用pass^k可靠性指标测试一致推理能力。
Result: 评估了GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6等5个模型家族9种配置，最好模型pass^1约57%，pass^4约35%，凸显可靠性悬崖。
Conclusion: 当前面向对话的智能推荐系统在一致推理方面仍存在显著不足，需要更可靠的评估与部署方案。

papers.title: Key-Value Means: Transformers with Expandable Block-Recurrent Compressed Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recall presents a difficult choice: transformers have a linearly growing memory that slows each successive token, while linear RNNs typically have fixed costs but limited recall. We present Key-Value Means ("KVM"), a novel block-recurrence for attention that can accommodate either fixed-size or growing state. Equipping a strong transformer baseline with fixed-size KVM attention layers yields a strong $O(N)$ chunked RNN, while adding only an insignificant number of new parameters. We train a transformer with a growable KVM cache and show it performs competitively on long-context tests with only subquadratic prefill time and sublinear state growth. KVM is implementable with standard operations and without custom kernels, and supports chunk-wise parallelizable training and prefill. It provides many of the benefits of both traditional transformers (expandable context memory, chunk-wise parallelizable training and prefill) and RNNs in a single unified package. It can be used on every layer, saving KV-cache memory, and allowing a continuous range of choices of prefill time complexity between $O(N)$ and $O(N^2)$. We release our code at https://github.com/featherless-ai/KVM-paper and trained models at https://huggingface.co/collections/featherless-ai/kvm-paper under the Apache 2.0 license.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Key-Value Means (KVM)，一种针对 Transformer 的块循环 (block-recurrence) 注意力机制，支持固定大小或可扩展的记忆状态。KVM 将强 Transformer 基线转化为具有固定大小状态和 O(N) 复杂度的块状 RNN，同时仅增加极少量参数。可扩展的 KVM 缓存版本在长上下文测试中表现具有竞争力，具有次二次预填充时间和次线性状态增长，且无需自定义内核即可实现，支持块级并行训练和预填充。
Motivation: Transformer 的线性增长记忆使每个后续 token 变慢，而线性 RNN 通常有固定成本但记忆有限。需要一种统一的方法，既能提供 Transformer 的可扩展上下文记忆和并行训练，又能提供 RNN 的固定成本。
Method: 提出 Key-Value Means (KVM) 块循环注意力机制：使用固定大小的键值记忆（类似 RNN 状态）或可增长的缓存，通过块级循环更新。每个块内应用注意力，块间传递压缩记忆。支持在 O(N) 和 O(N^2) 之间连续选择预填充时间复杂度。
Result: 固定大小 KVM 将强 Transformer 基线转化为 O(N) 块状 RNN，仅增加极少量参数。可增长 KVM 在长上下文测试中具有竞争力，预填充时间次二次，状态增长次线性。
Conclusion: KVM 以标准操作实现，无需自定义内核，统一了 Transformer 和 RNN 的优势（可扩展上下文记忆、块级并行训练和预填充），可应用于每一层以节省 KV 缓存内存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Symbolic Structure in Health Foundation Models: Extraction, Alignment, and Cross-Modal Transfer
papers.abstract_en: We show that information can be transferred post-hoc across independently trained health foundation models (FMs), each pretrained on ~20M minutes of wearable sensor data from ~172K participants, by aligning their data-dependent coordinate systems. From frozen embeddings we extract candidate symbol-like components using linear decomposition methods, and align them across models with simple linear maps. Aligned symbols associate selectively with health conditions and physiological attributes, with associations similar across modalities and architectures. A classifier trained on one model's symbols and applied to another retains more than 95% of its in-domain performance, with similar retention in both directions. Overall, our results indicate that independently trained health FMs converge toward a common representation of the same underlying physiology.
papers.comment: 8 pages, Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, 4 main figures
papers.journal_ref: Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了如何在独立训练的健康基础模型之间进行事后信息传递，通过对齐数据依赖的坐标系，从冻结嵌入中提取候选符号组件，并跨模型对齐。结果发现对齐的符号与健康状况和生理属性选择性关联，跨模态和架构相似。一个模型上训练的符号分类器应用到另一个模型上，保留了超过95%的域内性能。这表明独立训练的健康FM收敛到同一生理的共同表示。
Motivation: 多个独立训练的健康基础模型可能学到不同的表示，但能否事后对齐并传递符号信息是一个重要问题。
Method: 使用线性分解方法从冻结嵌入中提取候选符号组件，并通过简单线性映射跨模型对齐。
Result: 在包含约20M分钟可穿戴传感器数据、来自172K参与者的数据集上，跨模型符号对齐后，分类器保留>95%域内性能，双向类似。
Conclusion: 独立训练的健康基础模型收敛到共同的生理表示，可以实现跨模型符号传递。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variational Neural Belief Parameterizations for Robust Dexterous Grasping under Multimodal Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Contact variability, sensing uncertainty, and external disturbances make grasp execution stochastic. Expected-quality objectives ignore tail outcomes and often select grasps that fail under adverse contact realizations. Risk-sensitive POMDPs address this failure mode, but many use particle-filter beliefs that scale poorly, obstruct gradient-based optimization, and estimate Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) with high-variance approximations. We instead formulate grasp acquisition as variational inference over latent contact parameters and object pose, representing the belief with a differentiable Gaussian mixture. We use Gumbel-Softmax component selection and location-scale reparameterization to express samples as smooth functions of the belief parameters, enabling pathwise gradients through a differentiable CVaR surrogate for direct optimization of tail robustness. In simulation, our variational neural belief improves robust grasp success under contact-parameter uncertainty and exogenous force perturbations while reducing planning time by roughly an order of magnitude relative to particle-filter model-predictive control. On a serial-chain robot arm with a multifingered hand, we validate grasp-and-lift success under object-pose uncertainty against a Gaussian baseline. Both methods succeed on the tested perturbations, but our controller terminates in fewer steps and less wall-clock time while achieving a higher tactile grasp-quality proxy. Our learned belief also calibrates risk more accurately, keeping mean absolute calibration error below 0.14 across tested simulation regimes, compared with 0.58 for a Cross-Entropy Method planner. We provide code, simulation assets, and a dataset of 243 force-closed grasps at the following link: www.github.com/coenwerem/vnb-grasp.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication at IROS 2026. Code, simulation assets, and dataset at https://github.com/coenwerem/vnb-grasp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分神经信念参数化（VNB）用于鲁棒灵巧抓取，将抓取获取建模为对潜在接触参数和物体姿态的变分推断，使用可微高斯混合表示信念，并通过Gumbel-Softmax和重参数化实现路径梯度，直接优化尾部鲁棒性（CVaR）。仿真结果表明，相比粒子滤波模型预测控制，规划时间降低约一个数量级，同时在接触不确定性和外力扰动下提高鲁棒抓取成功率。真实机器人实验验证了抓取提升的成功率和速度，且信念校准误差更低。
Motivation: 接触变异性、感知不确定性和外部扰动使抓取执行随机化，期望质量目标忽略尾部结果导致在不利实现下失败。风险敏感POMDPs虽能解决，但粒子滤波信念扩展性差、阻碍梯度优化，且CVaR估计方差高。
Method: 将抓取获取公式化为对潜在接触参数和物体姿态的变分推断，用可微高斯混合表示后验信念。使用Gumbel-Softmax组件选择和位置-尺度重参数化使样本成为信念参数的平滑函数，从而通过可微CVaR代理实现路径梯度，直接优化尾部鲁棒性。
Result: 仿真中，VNB方法在接触参数不确定性和外力扰动下提高鲁棒抓取成功率，规划时间降低约一个数量级。真实机器人实验中，相比高斯基线，控制器在更少步数和更短墙钟时间内成功，触觉抓取质量代理更高，且信念校准更准确（平均绝对校准误差0.14 vs. 交叉熵方法0.58）。
Conclusion: 变分神经信念参数化通过可微信念表示和尾部鲁棒性优化，实现了高效、鲁棒的抓取规划，并在风险校准上优于传统方法。代码、模拟资产和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation of Winning Solutions of 2025 Low Power Computer Vision Challenge
papers.abstract_en: The IEEE Low-Power Computer Vision Challenge (LPCVC) aims to promote the development of efficient vision models for edge devices, balancing accuracy with constraints such as latency, memory capacity, and energy use. The 2025 challenge featured three tracks: (1) Image classification under various lighting conditions and styles, (2) Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Text Prompt, and (3) Monocular Depth Estimation. This paper presents the design of LPCVC 2025, including its competition structure and evaluation framework, which integrates the Qualcomm AI Hub for consistent and reproducible benchmarking. The paper also introduces the top-performing solutions from each track and outlines key trends and observations. The paper concludes with suggestions for future computer vision competitions.

TL;DR: 本文介绍IEEE低功耗计算机视觉挑战赛（LPCVC 2025）的设计、评估框架和获胜方案。挑战赛包括三个赛道：图像分类、开放词汇分割和单目深度估计。论文总结了各赛道最佳解决方案及趋势，并利用了高通AI Hub进行一致性基准测试。
Motivation: 推动边缘设备上高效视觉模型的发展，平衡准确性与延迟、内存和能耗等约束。
Method: 设计三个赛道（图像分类、开放词汇分割、单目深度估计），采用高通AI Hub进行可重复的基准测试，并分析获胜方案。
Result: 报告了各赛道获胜解决方案及其性能特点，但具体数值未在摘要中详述。
Conclusion: 总结了比赛中的关键趋势，并为未来计算机视觉竞赛提出建议。

papers.title: Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Auditable Commercial Registry Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Public commercial registries are formally open, yet their practical analysis remains difficult because relevant facts are scattered across millions of records that combine structured metadata, multilingual legal notices, temporal events, and entity aliases. This paper presents a controlled, tool-mediated agentic GraphRAG architecture for auditable natural-language analysis of such registries. The proposed pipeline transforms publications from the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce into a Neo4j knowledge graph comprising over five million nodes and 4.7 million relationships. It combines deterministic ingestion of structured registry fields, LLM-assisted extraction of latent actors from unstructured notices, and a deterministic identity-resolution layer. An analytical agent operates on this graph through intent routing, restricted graph tools, bounded reflection, and state-machine-guided response synthesis. We evaluate the system using a multi-tier protocol covering answer quality, retrieval behavior, entity resolution, and multi-turn conversational performance. The complete architecture is compared with dense, lexical, and hybrid flat-retrieval baselines and with controlled architectural ablations. On a manually curated benchmark, graph-mediated retrieval increases factual correctness from 0.26 for the strongest flat-retrieval baseline to 0.83 for the complete system, with comparable improvements in relevance and completeness. Ablation results show that bounded reflection improves answer quality while intent routing and LLM-based graph enrichment improve reliability in difficult entity resolution tasks. An exploratory dashboard displays the graph evidence and execution traces underlying each response, allowing users to inspect how answers were produced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受控的、工具中介的Agentic GraphRAG架构，用于可审计的自然语言分析公共商业注册数据。系统将瑞士商业公报转换为包含超过500万个节点和470万关系的Neo4j知识图谱，结合确定性摄取和LLM辅助提取，并通过有界反思等机制提高答案质量。评估表明，图中介检索将事实正确性从强平面检索基线的0.26提高到完整系统的0.83。
Motivation: 公共商业注册数据形式开放但实际分析困难，因为相关信息分散在数百万条记录中，包含结构化元数据、多语言法律通知、时间事件和实体别名，难以高效检索和关联。
Method: 提出由确定性摄取、LLM辅助提取潜在参与者、确定性的身份解析层组成的管道，构建Neo4j知识图谱。分析代理通过意图路由、受限图工具、有界反思和状态机引导的响应合成进行操作，并与密集、词汇和混合平面检索基线及架构消融进行对比。
Result: 在手工策划的基准上，图中介检索将事实正确性从0.26（最强平面检索基线）提高到0.83（完整系统），相关性和完整性也有可比提升。消融实验表明有界反思提高答案质量，意图路由和LLM图丰富改进实体解析的可靠性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过探索性仪表板展示图证据和执行轨迹，支持审计，在商业注册分析中显著提升事实正确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MolCryst-MLIPs: A Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials Database for Molecular Crystals
papers.abstract_en: We present an open Molecular Crystal (MC) database of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials (MLIP) called MolCryst-MLIPs. The first release comprises fine-tuned MACE models for nine molecular crystal systems---Benzamide, Benzoic acid, Coumarin, Durene, Isonicotinamide, Nicotinic acid , Niacinamide, Pyrazinamide, and Resorcinol---developed using the Automated Machine Learning Pipeline (AMLP), which streamlines the entire MLIP development workflow, from reference data generation to model training and validation, into a reproducible and user-friendly pipeline. Models are fine-tuned from the MACE-MH-1 foundation model omol head), yielding a mean energy MAE of 0.141 kJ/mol/atom and a mean force MAE of 0.648 kJ/mol/Angstrom across all systems. Benchmarked against three state-of-the-art foundation models on the DFT-labelled polymorph set, only the fine-tuned models resolve the polymorphic energy landscape. Dynamical stability and structural integrity, as assessed through energy conservation, P2 orientational order parameters, and radial distribution functions, are evaluated using molecular dynamics simulations. The released models and datasets constitute a growing open database of validated MLIPs, ready for production MD simulations of molecular crystal polymorphism across the polymorphic landscape of each target compound under different thermodynamic conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 MolCryst-MLIPs 的开源分子晶体机器学习势（MLIP）数据库，首个版本包含针对九种分子晶体系统微调的 MACE 模型，通过自动机器学习流水线（AMLP）实现从参考数据生成到模型训练的流程化。微调模型来源于 MACE-MH-1 基础模型，所有系统的平均能量 MAE 为 0.141 kJ/mol/atom，平均力 MAE 为 0.648 kJ/mol/Å。与三个最先进的基础模型在 DFT 标记的多晶型集合上比较，仅微调模型能分辨多晶型能量景观。分子动力学模拟验证了能量守恒、P2 取向序参数和径向分布函数等动力学稳定性与结构完整性。
Motivation: 分子晶体多晶型现象的准确建模需要高精度的原子间势，但现有基础模型难以分辨细微的能量差异，且 MLIP 开发流程复杂耗时，缺乏系统化的开放数据库。
Method: 开发自动化机器学习流水线（AMLP），从参考数据生成到模型训练与验证全流程自动化；基于 MACE-MH-1 基础模型，对九种分子晶体分别进行微调，生成专用 MLIP 模型。
Result: 微调模型在九种分子晶体上的平均能量 MAE 为 0.141 kJ/mol/atom，平均力 MAE 为 0.648 kJ/mol/Å；在 DFT 标记的多晶型集合上，仅微调模型能准确区分多晶型能量顺序。
Conclusion: 该数据库为分子晶体多晶型模拟提供了经过验证的 MLIP 模型，可用于不同热力学条件下的生产级分子动力学模拟，是一个持续增长的开源资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can an Actor-Critic Optimization Framework Improve Analog Design?
papers.abstract_en: Analog design often slows down because even small changes to device sizes or biases require expensive simulation cycles, and high-quality solutions typically occupy only a narrow part of a very large search space. While existing optimizers reduce some of this burden, they largely operate without the kind of judgment designers use when deciding where to search next. This paper presents an actor-critic optimization framework (ACOF) for analog sizing that brings that form of guidance into the loop. Rather than treating optimization as a purely black-box search problem, ACOF separates the roles of proposal and evaluation: an actor suggests promising regions of the design space, while a critic reviews those choices, enforces design legality, and redirects the search when progress is hampered. This structure preserves compatibility with standard simulator-based flows while making the search process more deliberate, stable, and interpretable. Across our test circuits, ACOF improves the top-10 figure of merit by an average of 38.9% over the strongest competing baseline and reduces regret by an average of 24.7%, with peak gains of 70.5% in FoM and 42.2% lower regret on individual circuits. By combining iterative reasoning with simulation-driven search, the framework offers a more transparent path toward automated analog sizing across challenging design spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模拟电路尺寸调整中仿真开销大、搜索空间狭窄的难题，提出一种演员-评论家优化框架 (ACOF)，将设计者式的智能引导引入优化循环。ACOF 分离提议与评估角色，兼容标准仿真流程，使搜索更稳定、可解释。在测试电路上，平均提升前10品质因数38.9%，降低后悔值24.7%。
Motivation: 模拟设计因器件尺寸或偏置的微小变化需要昂贵仿真，且高质量解在巨大搜索空间中占比极窄，现有优化器缺乏设计者式的引导能力。
Method: 提出演员-评论家优化框架 (ACOF)，演员负责提议设计空间的有希望区域，评论家评估提议、确保设计合法性并在进展受阻时重定向搜索。
Result: 在测试电路上，ACOF 在 top-10 品质因数上平均提升38.9%，后悔值平均降低24.7%，单个电路上最高提升70.5% FoM 和降低42.2% 后悔值。
Conclusion: ACOF 通过结合迭代推理与仿真驱动搜索，提供了一条更透明的模拟尺寸自动化调整路径，适用于挑战性设计空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reconstructing Item Characteristic Curves using Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Traditional methods for determining assessment item parameters, such as difficulty and discrimination, rely heavily on expensive field testing to collect student performance data for Item Response Theory (IRT) calibration. This study introduces a novel approach that implicitly models these psychometric properties by fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) to simulate student responses across a spectrum of latent abilities. Leveraging the Qwen-3 dense model series and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), we train models to generate responses to multiple choice questions conditioned on discrete ability descriptors. We reconstruct the probability of a correct response as a function of student ability, effectively generating synthetic Item Characteristic Curves (ICCs) to estimate IRT parameters. Evaluation on a dataset of Grade 6 English Language Arts (ELA) items and the BEA 2024 Shared Task dataset demonstrates that this method competes with or outperforms baseline approaches. This simulation-based technique seems particularly effective at modeling item discrimination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新方法，通过微调大语言模型（LLM）模拟不同能力水平学生的答题行为，从而隐式建模题目心理测量属性，并重建项目特征曲线（ICC）以估计项目反应理论参数。在六年级英语语言艺术试题和BEA 2024共享任务数据集上的评估表明，该方法在估计题目区分度方面表现良好，可与基线方法竞争或超越。
Motivation: 传统项目参数（如难度、区分度）的确定依赖昂贵的现场测试收集学生表现数据，成本高且周期长。
Method: 利用Qwen-3密集模型系列和低秩适配（LoRA），微调LLM以在离散能力描述条件下生成多项选择题的回答，进而重建正确概率关于能力的函数，合成项目特征曲线。
Result: 在六年级ELA试题和BEA 2024数据集上，该方法与基线方法相比具有竞争力或更优，尤其在建模题目区分度方面效果显著。
Conclusion: 基于LLM模拟的合成数据可有效估计IRT参数，减少对大规模现场测试的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GCR: Geometry-Consistent Routing for Task-Agnostic Continual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Feature-based anomaly detection is widely adopted in industrial inspection due to the strong representational power of large pre-trained vision encoders. While most existing methods focus on improving within-category anomaly scoring, practical deployments increasingly require task-agnostic operation under continual category expansion, where the category identity is unknown at test time. In this setting, overall performance is often dominated by expert selection, namely routing an input to an appropriate normality model before any head-specific scoring is applied. However, routing rules that compare head-specific anomaly scores across independently constructed heads are unreliable in practice, as score distributions can differ substantially across categories in scale and tail behavior. We propose GCR, a lightweight mixture-of-experts framework for stabilizing task-agnostic continual anomaly detection through geometry-consistent routing. GCR routes each test image directly in a shared frozen patch-embedding space by minimizing an accumulated nearest-prototype distance to category-specific prototype banks, and then computes anomaly maps only within the routed expert using a standard prototype-based scoring rule. By separating cross-head decision making from within-head anomaly scoring, GCR avoids cross-head score comparability issues without requiring end-to-end representation learning. Experiments on MVTec AD and VisA show that geometry-consistent routing substantially improves routing stability and mitigates continual performance collapse, achieving near-zero forgetting while maintaining competitive detection and localization performance. These results indicate that many failures previously attributed to representation forgetting can instead be explained by decision-rule instability in cross-head routing. Code is available at https://github.com/jw-chae/GCR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GCR，一个轻量级混合专家框架，用于稳定任务无关的持续异常检测。GCR通过在共享冻结patch嵌入空间中最小化累积最近原型距离来路由测试图像，避免跨头分数比较，从而解决跨头路由不可靠问题。实验表明，该方法在MVTec AD和VisA上显著提高路由稳定性，实现近乎零遗忘，同时保持检测和定位性能。
Motivation: 现有任务无关持续异常检测依赖跨头异常分数比较进行专家选择，但各专家分数分布尺度和尾部行为差异大，导致路由不可靠，整体性能下降。
Method: GCR在共享冻结patch嵌入空间中，为每个类别维护原型库；测试时计算输入到所有原型库的累积最近原型距离，选择距离最小的专家进行路由，然后仅在该专家内使用标准基于原型的评分规则计算异常图。
Result: 在MVTec AD和VisA上，GCR显著提升路由稳定性，缓解持续性能崩溃，实现近零遗忘，检测和定位性能与现有方法相当或更优。
Conclusion: 许多持续异常检测中的失败并非源于表示遗忘，而是跨头路由的决策规则不稳定性；GCR通过分离跨头决策与头内评分有效解决了该问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Safe-Set Bayesian Optimization for Quality Improvement in Fuselage Assembly
papers.abstract_en: Recent efforts in smart manufacturing have enhanced aerospace fuselage assembly processes, particularly by innovating shape adjustment techniques to minimize dimensional gaps between assembled sections. Existing approaches have shown promising results but face the issue of low sample efficiency from the manufacturing systems. It arises from the limitation of the classical Monte Carlo method when uncovering the mean response from a distribution. In contrast, recent work has shown that quantum algorithms can achieve the same level of estimation accuracy with significantly fewer samples than the classical Monte Carlo method from distributions. Therefore, we can adopt the estimation of the quantum algorithm to obtain the estimation from real physical systems (distributions). Motivated by this advantage, we propose a Quantum Bayesian Optimization (QBO) framework for precise shape control during assembly to improve the sample efficiency in manufacturing practice. Specifically, this approach utilizes a quantum oracle, based on finite element analysis (FEA)-based models or surrogate models, to acquire a more accurate estimation of the environment response with fewer queries for a certain input. QBO employs an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) as the acquisition function to strategically select input values that are most likely to maximize the objective function. It has been theoretically proven to require much fewer samples while maintaining comparable optimization results. In the case study, force-controlled actuators are applied to one fuselage section to adjust its shape and reduce the gap to the adjoining section. Experimental results demonstrate that QBO achieves significantly lower dimensional error and uncertainty compared to classical methods, particularly using the same queries from the simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子贝叶斯优化（QBO）框架，用于飞机机身装配中的形状调整，以提高样本效率。该方法利用量子算法从分布中更高效地估计均值响应，结合有限元分析或代理模型，并使用上置信界（UCB）采集函数选择输入。案例研究表明，在相同查询次数下，QBO比经典方法实现了更低的尺寸误差和不确定性。
Motivation: 现有智能制造的形状调整方法面临样本效率低的问题，因为经典蒙特卡洛方法需要大量样本才能准确估计分布均值，限制了制造系统的效率。
Method: 提出量子贝叶斯优化框架，利用量子算法从物理系统（分布）中高效估计环境响应，结合有限元分析或代理模型作为量子oracle，并采用UCB采集函数选择输入。
Result: 在力控执行器调整机身段形状以减少间隙的案例中，QBO在相同查询次数下实现了比经典方法更低的尺寸误差和不确定性。
Conclusion: 量子贝叶斯优化能显著提高制造中的样本效率，理论上需要更少的样本即可获得相当的优化结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Symbolic Regression for Equation Discovery via Operator-induced and Regularized Symbolic Forests
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression has emerged as a powerful tool for artificial intelligence-driven scientific discovery by learning interpretable analytical expressions that reveal governing relationships directly from data. Existing methods, however, often rely on heuristic search, struggle to balance predictive accuracy with expression complexity in noisy settings, and offer limited characterization of symbolic uncertainty. Probabilistic approaches that address these challenges in a unified manner remain underexplored. We introduce a probabilistic symbolic regression framework that represents mathematical expressions as ensembles of symbolic trees. A regularizing prior over tree topology controls expression complexity, while an Occam's window-based posterior summary captures uncertainty across multiple plausible symbolic models. Given the limited existing theoretical treatment of symbolic regression, we develop posterior concentration guarantees under approximate symbolic realizability, yielding a near-parametric rate for exact symbolic representability. Additionally, we establish a sharp oracle concentration result under symbolic misspecification. Comparisons of our proposed framework with state-of-the-art competitors demonstrate superior predictive accuracy, optimal symbolic complexity, and stable structural recovery when learning benchmark scientific equations, together with the identification of scientifically interpretable descriptors in a challenging materials discovery problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种概率符号回归框架，将数学表达式表示为符号树的集成，通过正则化先验控制复杂度，并利用奥卡姆窗口的后验总结量化不确定性。在基准科学方程和材料发现任务上，该方法在预测精度、符号复杂度和结构恢复方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有符号回归方法依赖启发式搜索，难以在噪声环境下平衡预测精度与表达式复杂度，且缺乏不确定性表征。概率方法尚未被充分探索。
Method: 将数学表达式表示为符号树集成，设计正则化先验控制树拓扑复杂度，基于奥卡姆窗口的后验总结捕捉多个合理符号模型的不确定性；并推导了近似符号可实现性下的后验集中速率和符号误设定下的尖锐oracle集中结果。
Result: 在基准科学方程上，该方法取得优于最先进水平的预测精度、最优符号复杂度和稳定的结构恢复；在材料发现问题中识别出科学可解释的描述符。
Conclusion: 提出的概率框架统一了符号回归中的正则化与不确定性量化，并提供了理论保证，在科学发现中展现了实际效用。

summary_sections.method: 将数学表达式表示为符号树集成，设计正则化先验控制树拓扑复杂度，基于奥卡姆窗口的后验总结捕捉多个合理符号模型的不确定性；并推导了近似符号可实现性下的后验集中速率和符号误设定下的尖锐oracle集中结果。
summary_sections.result: 在基准科学方程上，该方法取得优于最先进水平的预测精度、最优符号复杂度和稳定的结构恢复；在材料发现问题中识别出科学可解释的描述符。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提出的概率框架统一了符号回归中的正则化与不确定性量化，并提供了理论保证，在科学发现中展现了实际效用。

papers.title: Realizing Scaling Laws in Recommender Systems: A Foundation-Expert Paradigm for Hyperscale Model Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws have been established for recommender systems, yet efficiently deploying foundation model (FM) across multiple recommendation surfaces remains a major unsolved challenge. Existing methods for transfer learning face fundamental limitations in this setting: knowledge distillation suffers from transfer fidelity degradation in the large-data regime, and static user or item embeddings lack the expressiveness to capture contextualized user-item interactions. We propose the Foundation-Expert paradigm, where a central FM generates target-aware embeddings which are ingested by lightweight surface-specific expert models. Target-aware embeddings are representations that dynamically capture a user's interest in a specific item conditioned on their full interaction history. Unlike knowledge distillation, which transfers FM knowledge as soft labels, our approach provides these embeddings as input features to each expert model, enabling direct interaction with surface-specific representations. This paradigm achieves transfer ratios of 0.64--1.0 from FM to experts, substantially exceeding existing methods. Fully deployed at Meta serving tens of billions of daily requests since 2025, it delivers 0.050% statistically significant online topline metric improvement and 0.359% cumulative gains across multiple surfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Foundation-Expert范式，通过中央基础模型生成目标感知嵌入（target-aware embeddings）并输入轻量级表面特定专家模型，以在超大规模推荐系统中高效部署基础模型。该方法在Meta部署后，处理每日数百亿请求，实现0.050%的统计显著在线指标提升和0.359%的累计收益，转移比率达到0.64-1.0。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统基础模型跨表面部署面临知识蒸馏传递保真度下降和静态嵌入缺乏表达能力的问题，无法高效利用缩放定律。
Method: 提出Foundation-Expert范式：中央FM生成动态目标感知嵌入（捕捉用户对特定物品的兴趣），作为输入特征供给轻量级专家模型，而非像知识蒸馏那样传递软标签。
Result: 在Meta部署后，转移比率0.64-1.0，远超现有方法；每日处理数百亿请求，带来0.050%统计显著在线指标提升和0.359%累计收益。
Conclusion: 该范式验证了推荐系统中缩放定律的实用性，通过分离FM与专家模型实现高效部署，但具体应用场景和局限性需进一步研究。

papers.title: LEGO Co-builder: Exploring Fine-Grained Vision-Language Modeling for Multimodal LEGO Assembly Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are facing the challenges of understanding and following multimodal assembly instructions, particularly when fine-grained spatial reasoning and precise object state detection are required. In this work, we explore LEGO Co-builder, a hybrid benchmark combining real-world LEGO assembly logic with programmatically generated multimodal scenes. The dataset captures stepwise visual states and procedural instructions, allowing controlled evaluation of instruction-following, object detection, and state detection. We introduce a unified framework and assess leading VLMs such as GPT-4o, Gemini, and Qwen-VL, under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings. We also evaluated the framework using a reasoning-focused model, GLM-4.1-thinking. Our results show that while object detection achieved high performance (98.16% with fine-tuned InstructBLIP), fine-grained scene understanding and assembly state detection remain challenging: Fine-tuned MiniGPT-v2 reached only 37.52% F1 for identifying theme entities, and even advanced models such as GPT-4o achieved just 40.54% F1 on state detection. This highlights gaps in fine-grained visual understanding among existing models. We release the benchmark, codebase, and generation pipeline to support future research on multimodal assembly assistants grounded in real-world workflows.
papers.comment: This version has been accepted by ICMI 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LEGO Co-builder，一个结合真实LEGO组装逻辑与程序生成场景的多模态基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在细粒度指令跟随、物体检测和状态检测上的能力。实验表明，微调后的InstructBLIP在物体检测上达到98.16%的准确率，但在细粒度场景理解和组装状态检测上性能有限（如MiniGPT-v2主题实体识别F1仅37.52%，GPT-4o状态检测F1仅40.54%），揭示了现有模型在细粒度视觉理解方面的不足。
Motivation: 现有VLM在处理需细粒度空间推理和精确物体状态检测的多模态组装指令时表现不佳，且缺乏对应的标准化评估基准。
Method: 构建混合基准，通过程序生成包含逐步视觉状态和过程指令的多模态场景，并采用统一框架评估GPT-4o、Gemini、Qwen-VL等VLM在零样本和微调设置下的性能。
Result: 物体检测性能较高（微调InstructBLIP达98.16%），但细粒度场景理解困难：微调MiniGPT-v2主题实体识别F1仅37.52%，GPT-4o状态检测F1仅40.54%。
Conclusion: 当前VLM在细粒度视觉理解上仍存在显著差距，该基准和代码的发布有望推动多模态组装助手在真实工作流中的研究。

papers.title: Lions and Muons: Optimization via Stochastic Frank-Wolfe under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic Frank-Wolfe is a classical optimization method for solving constrained optimization problems. On the other hand, recent optimizers such as Lion and Muon have gained quite significant popularity in deep learning. In this work, building on recent initiatives, we provide a unifying perspective by interpreting these seemingly disparate methods through the lens of Stochastic Frank-Wolfe. Specifically, we show that Lion and Muon with weight decay can be viewed as special instances of a Stochastic Frank-Wolfe, and we establish their convergence guarantees in terms of the Frank-Wolfe gap, a standard stationarity measure in non-convex optimization for Frank-Wolfe methods. We further find that convergence to this gap implies convergence to a KKT point of the original problem under a norm constraint for Lion and Muon. Moreover, motivated by recent empirical findings that stochastic gradients in modern machine learning tasks often exhibit heavy-tailed distributions, we extend Stochastic Frank-Wolfe to settings with heavy-tailed noise by developing two robust variants with strong theoretical guarantees that hold for general compact convex sets without the need for a large batch size, filling the gap in the literature on Stochastic Frank-Wolfe for non-convex optimization. Our contributions in the later part of this work, in turn, yield new variants of Lion and Muon, that better accommodate heavy-tailed gradient noise, thereby enhancing their practical scope.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过随机Frank-Wolfe方法的视角统一解释了深度学习中流行的Lion和Muon优化器，证明它们在有权重衰减时可视为随机Frank-Wolfe的特例，并建立了在非凸优化中关于Frank-Wolfe间隙的收敛保证。进一步针对现代机器学习中常见的重尾噪声，提出了两种鲁棒变体，无需大批量即可在一般紧凸集上取得强理论保证，从而增强了Lion和Muon的实际适用性。
Motivation: Lion和Muon优化器在深度学习中广泛应用，但其理论基础尚不明确；同时，随机Frank-Wolfe是处理约束优化的经典方法，但缺乏对重尾噪声的鲁棒性分析。本文旨在统一这些方法并填补重尾噪声下随机Frank-Wolfe的理论空白。
Method: 将带权重衰减的Lion和Muon重新解释为随机Frank-Wolfe的具体实例，并推导其在非凸情形下Frank-Wolfe间隙的收敛速率。针对重尾噪声，通过设计鲁棒步长或截断策略，提出两种随机Frank-Wolfe变体，并在一般紧凸集上获得理论保证。
Result: 证明了Lion和Muon在范数约束下的收敛性（收敛到KKT点）；所提出的鲁棒变体在重尾噪声下收敛，且无需增大批量大小。
Conclusion: 本文的理论统一不仅解释了现有优化器的成功，还提供了对重尾噪声更鲁棒的新变体，扩大了其实际应用范围。

papers.title: Like a Baby: Visually Situated Neural Language Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: We examine the benefits of visual context in training neural language models to perform next-word prediction. A multi-modal neural architecture is introduced that outperform its equivalent trained on language alone with a 2% decrease in perplexity, even when no visual context is available at test. Fine-tuning the embeddings of a pre-trained state-of-the-art bidirectional language model (BERT) in the language modeling framework yields a 3.5% improvement. The advantage for training with visual context when testing without is robust across different languages (English, German and Spanish) and different models (GRU, LSTM, $Δ$-RNN, as well as those that use BERT embeddings). Thus, language models perform better when they learn like a baby, i.e, in a multi-modal environment. This finding is compatible with the theory of situated cognition: language is inseparable from its physical context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉上下文在训练神经语言模型进行下一词预测中的作用，提出一种多模态神经架构，在无测试视觉上下文时仍比纯语言模型困惑度降低2%，基于BERT的微调方法再提升3.5%。该优势在英语、德语、西班牙语及多种循环神经网络（GRU、LSTM、Δ-RNN）中均成立，支持情境认知理论。
Motivation: 探讨语言模型能否通过在多模态环境（如婴儿学习）中训练获得更好性能，验证情境认知理论。
Method: 引入多模态神经架构，联合处理视觉和语言输入；并在预训练BERT基础上进行语言建模微调。
Result: 与纯语言模型相比，困惑度降低2%（无测试视觉上下文），使用BERT嵌入时额外降低3.5%。
Conclusion: 语言模型在多模态环境中训练可提升无视觉上下文时的预测能力，结果跨语言和模型架构一致。

papers.title: An Integrated Deep Learning and Statistical Framework for Whole-Network Gene--Environment Association with Leaf Vascular Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Leaf veins exhibit remarkable diversity in architecture and patterning, yet existing gene--environment association studies have primarily quantified leaf venation using a small collection of low-dimensional summary traits, thereby discarding most of the structural information contained in the original images. We propose an integrated deep learning and statistical framework. The proposed framework achieves four methodological advances. First, it represents the complete leaf vascular architecture as a whole-network image phenotype. Second, it fine-tunes the deep learning-based Edge Detection with Transformers (EDTER) model to accurately extract whole-network leaf vascular architecture from RGB images by jointly learning local and global contextual features. Third, it constructs a new annotated leaf image database by integrating edge maps generated by DiffusionEdge with the Berkeley Segmentation Database (BSDS500). Fourth, it applies Semiparametric Sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis (SSCCA) to perform variable selection and model associations between repeatedly measured high-dimensional Bivariate image responses and high-dimensional predictors while simultaneously accommodating sparse, zero-inflated data represented by edge maps through a truncated latent Gaussian copula model. Two simulation studies demonstrate the performance of the proposed framework under increasing levels of complexity. Application to a real \emph{Populus} dataset identifies three significant gene--geography interactions associated with leaf vascular architecture, providing new biological insights and establishing a broadly applicable methodological framework for high-dimensional complex image phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成深度学习和统计学的框架，用于全网络叶脉结构与基因-环境的关联分析。该框架包括：利用微调后的EDTER模型从RGB图像中提取完整叶脉网络，构建新的带注释叶片图像数据库，以及使用半参数稀疏典型相关分析（SSCCA）进行高维图像响应和预测变量之间的关联建模和变量选择。在真实杨树数据集上识别出三个显著的基因-地理交互作用，为叶脉结构提供了新的生物学见解。
Motivation: 现有基因-环境关联研究大多使用低维汇总特征来量化叶脉，丢弃了原始图像中的大部分结构信息，无法充分捕捉叶脉的多样性。
Method: 提出一个四步框架：1）以全网络图像表型表示叶脉结构；2）微调基于深度学习的EDTER模型以准确提取叶脉网络；3）整合DiffusionEdge和BSDS500构建新叶片图像数据库；4）应用SSCCA进行变量选择和关联分析，并通过截断潜变量高斯copula模型处理稀疏零膨胀数据。
Result: 两个模拟实验验证了框架在不同复杂度下的性能。真实杨树数据集识别出三个显著的基因-地理交互作用与叶脉结构相关。
Conclusion: 该框架为高维复杂图像表型的关联分析提供了广泛适用的方法论，并揭示了叶脉结构的新生物学见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TLRNet: Estimating Individual Treatment Effect based on Local Information and Single Learner Structure
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference has become a central issue across various fields, including computer science, statistics, economics, education, healthcare, and medicine. The broad applicability of this discipline has garnered increased research funding and attention. In recent years, the estimation of causal effects from observational data has gained traction due to the vast amounts of collected data and the lower costs compared to randomized controlled trials. Advances in causal effect estimation methods have enhanced service personalization tools. For instance, these tools can help identify the most effective type of treatment (considering both cost and success rate) for each patient among different medical service options. This paper proposes an innovative method for estimating the heterogeneity of treatment effects. The structure of the proposed model is based on a deep neural network and a pseudo-single learner. The proposed method has been compared with other state-of-the-art methods on the IHDP benchmark. Acceptable results have been obtained by using one estimator to estimate the potential outcomes of two treatment groups. Accordingly, this paves the way for further development and improvement of the proposed method.

papers.title: DRC-Aid: Design-Rule Correction via Agentic Framework utilizing Inference-Time Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Resolving Design Rule Violations (DRVs) in layouts entails an iterative loop of geometric edits and verification. We present DRC-Aid, a closed-loop agentic framework that automates local DRC repair by formulating it as verification-in-the-loop search. To constrain the combinatorial geometric repair space, a deterministic Rule Engine converts physical verification tool-reported violations into a bounded menu of geometric edits. An off-the-shelf Large Language Model (LLM) evaluates local geometric context to select edits from this menu, with budgeted depth-first search and backtracking. Immediate feedback from verification tools such as Calibre nmDRC/nmLVS enforces geometric compliance and guards against electrical-topology degradation, while a global Memory Bank prevents cyclic re-exploration. Evaluated on FreePDK45 layouts containing DRVs, DRC-Aid achieves DRC-clean, LVS-equivalent repairs in ~92.5% of cases with a ~98% total violation reduction, while residual cases yield partially repaired LVS-equivalent candidates. Under an identical search and verification infrastructure, LLM-based selection outperforms random (54.4%) and deterministic-heuristic (83.3%) policies, with the gap widening on cases with six or more violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DRC-Aid，一个基于推理时大语言模型(LLM)的闭环框架，用于自动化布局设计规则违反(DRV)的局部修正。框架将物理验证工具报告的违规转化为有限的几何编辑菜单，LLM根据局部几何上下文选择编辑，结合预算深度优先搜索、回溯及验证工具的即时反馈，并利用全局记忆库避免重复探索。
Motivation: 现有的DRV修正依赖人工迭代，效率低，而自动化方法面临组合几何修正空间过大、难以保证电学拓扑一致性的问题。
Method: 构建一个确定性的规则引擎将验证工具报告的DRV转化为有限的几何编辑菜单；利用现成的LLM评估局部几何上下文并选择编辑，结合带预算的深度优先搜索与回溯；集成Calibre nmDRC/nmLVS等验证工具提供即时反馈，并设置全局记忆库防止循环探索。
Result: 在FreePDK45布局上评估，DRC-Aid在约92.5%的案例中实现了DRC干净且LVS等价的修复，总违规减少约98%；残例产生部分修复的LVS等价候选。在相同搜索与验证基础设施下，LLM策略优于随机(54.4%)和确定性启发式(83.3%)策略，在六个以上违规的场景中差距更大。
Conclusion: DRC-Aid展示了利用LLM与验证反馈相结合的代理框架在自动化物理验证后DRV修正中的有效性，但残例仍需进一步处理。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLMs for Verilog Design Flows
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in code generation, but their capabilities to produce correct, synthesizable hardware description language (HDL) code still remain to be properly benchmarked. Existing evaluations are primarily relying on pass@k metrics and lack proper end-to-end toolchain validation. This paper presents a reproducible benchmarking platform that evaluates open-source LLMs on Verilog RTL generation across 50 curated tasks consisting of combinational, sequential, finite state machine (FSM), and mixed designs. The pipeline consisting of constrained prompting, post-processing, and semantic-aware iterative refinement with waveform analysis, formal equivalence verification, and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based repair validates the generated code via Verilator compilation and Icarus Verilog simulation. Across the 12 benchmarks and the 1,610 total runs evaluating three models of different sizes (Llama-3-8B, StarCoder2-7B, and TinyLlama-1.1B), the pipeline improved syntax validity from 0% to a 70.43% average and simulation pass rate to 51.8% across three open-source models. Most notably TinyLlama (1.1B parameters) achieved the highest individual syntax validity at 80.0%, with functional correctness comparable to the 8B model. The platform and dataset are open-source, enabling reproducible evaluation of generative AI for hardware design workflows.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Manuscript prepared for submission to IEEE Design & Test
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可复现的基准测试平台，用于评估开源大语言模型在Verilog RTL生成上的表现。平台包含50个精心设计的任务，涵盖组合、时序、有限状态机和混合设计，并通过约束提示、后处理、语义感知迭代优化（含波形分析、形式等价验证和AST修复）以及Verilator编译和Icarus Verilog仿真来验证代码。在12个基准测试和1,610次运行中，评估了Llama-3-8B、StarCoder2-7B和TinyLlama-1.1B三个模型，语法有效性从0%提升至平均70.43%，仿真通过率平均达到51.8%。值得注意的是，TinyLlama（1.1B参数）取得了最高的单个语法有效性80.0%，功能正确性与8B模型相当。平台和数据集已开源。
Motivation: 现有评估主要依赖pass@k指标，缺乏端到端工具链验证，且对大语言模型生成正确、可综合的硬件描述语言代码的能力缺乏适当基准。
Method: 构建包含50个任务（组合、时序、FSM、混合设计）的基准平台，采用约束提示、后处理、语义感知迭代优化（含波形分析、形式等价验证和AST修复）以及Verilator编译和Icarus Verilog仿真的流水线。
Result: 在三个开源模型上，语法有效性从0%提升至平均70.43%，仿真通过率平均51.8%。TinyLlama-1.1B以80.0%的语法有效性领先，功能正确性与8B模型相当。
Conclusion: 该基准平台可复现地评估生成式AI在硬件设计流程中的表现，尤其展示了小模型在语法正确性上的潜力。

papers.title: Spectral Dynamics of Semantic Drift in Clinical Multi-Agent Language Model Networks
papers.abstract_en: The integration of iterative LLMs within multi-agent diagnostic frameworks requires a rigorous quantitative reevaluation of underlying communication topologies. Frequently used architectural paradigms depend on scale-free or small-world networks, assuming optimal communication efficiency. Our study mathematically dismantles that assumption for semantic data. By mapping multi-agent communication uncertainty trajectories onto a 768-dimensional Bio_ClinicalBERT embedding space via an analytical isotropic variance proxy using Barab'asi--Albert (BA) and Watts--Strogatz (WS) networks, we prove that structural bottlenecks compromise diagnostic safety. Our phase transition matrices illustrate that localized dense cliques confine hallucinated data, preventing global consensus and forcing the system toward a permanent entropy saturation threshold of $H_{\infty} \approx 5.947$. As a result, we measure a severe terminal cosine similarity degradation of 53.29%, completely overwriting the original ground-truth. Moreover, the terminal semantic drift reveals a catastrophic variance amplification of 51.81% ($ρ= 1.5181$) in highly clustered architectures, proving total system unpredictability when compared to Erdős--R'enyi configurations ($ρ= 1.0766$). Instead of reducing errors, hub-centric systems autonomously compound localized hallucinations. By introducing dynamic spectral monitoring operating at an $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ time complexity and imposing a strict lower bound on algebraic connectivity ($λ_{2_{min}}$) via the continuous eigen-decomposition of the graph Laplacian, we present a mathematically rigorous technique to ensure global state diffusion. Securing the reliability of autonomous medical diagnostics necessitates treating topological stability as a non-negotiable quantitative imperative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明多智能体临床诊断框架中常用的无标度或小世界网络拓扑对语义数据并非最优。通过将通信不确定性映射到768维Bio_ClinicalBERT嵌入空间，并分析Barabási-Albert和Watts-Strogatz网络，发现结构瓶颈导致全局共识失败：终端余弦相似度退化53.29%，方差放大51.81%（ρ=1.5181），系统达到熵饱和阈值H∞≈5.947。作者提出动态谱监测方法，通过图拉普拉斯特征分解施加代数连通性的严格下界，以确保全局状态扩散。
Motivation: 当前多智能体LLM网络常采用无标度或小世界拓扑，但作者认为这些结构假设对于语义数据可能造成诊断不安全，需要定量验证。
Method: 利用各向同性方差代理，将多智能体通信不确定性嵌入到768维Bio_ClinicalBERT空间，通过相变矩阵和谱图理论分析语义漂移，并提出基于图拉普拉斯连续特征分解的动态谱监测技术，施加代数连通性下界。
Result: 在高度聚类架构中，终端余弦相似度下降53.29%，方差放大51.81%（ρ=1.5181），而Erdős–Rényi配置仅ρ=1.0766；系统达到永久熵饱和阈值H∞≈5.947。
Conclusion: 作者强调确保自主医学诊断的可靠性必须将拓扑稳定性视为不可妥协的定量要求。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hierarchical Grading in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Graded Large Language Models (GLLMs), an algebraic framework that equips the representation space of a transformer with a grading and propagates the induced weighted scalar action through embeddings, self-attention, and the training objective. The construction extends the theory of graded neural networks and graded transformers to autoregressive language models while preserving expressive power, asymptotic computational complexity, and inference cost. The governing geometric picture is that of geometric invariant theory. The benefit of a grading is expressed by a Kempf--Ness functional on the grading torus; the grades that improve upon the uniform architecture form an open convex cone whose membership is decided by a Hilbert--Mumford-type criterion pairing a grade direction against two measurable profiles of the target and the data; the optimal grades are the coincidence point of two moment maps, given in closed form; and the ordinary transformer appears as a semistable isotropic point on the boundary of the cone: one member of a larger graded family rather than a distinguished optimum. Separately, for level-stratified targets we prove a minimax separation between the graded prior and its absence: over all estimators the risks of the graded and uniform target classes separate throughout an explicit window of sample sizes, by a factor that decays exponentially in the number of levels under geometric stratification. Both profiles are estimable offline, so the optimal grades solve a convex program certified before training begins. Because the grading is absorbed into the learned parameters after training, every GLLM compiles to a standard transformer of identical architecture and inference complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分级大语言模型（GLLMs）的代数框架，通过为Transformer的表示空间赋予分级并传播由此诱导的加权标量作用，扩展到自回归语言模型。该框架保持表达能力和计算复杂度，利用几何不变量理论描述，证明最优分级由凸优化问题解出，且训练后GLLM可编译为标准Transformer。
Motivation: 现有Transformer架构缺乏显式的分级结构，可能无法最优利用表示空间的几何性质；作者希望通过引入分级提升模型性能，同时保持推理成本不变。
Method: 提出基于分级代数结构的GLLM，通过Kempf-Ness泛函和Hilbert-Mumford型准则优化分级方向，最优分级由两个矩映射的相合点给出闭式解，分级先验在分层目标下具有最小最大优势。
Result: 证明了分级先验相对于均匀架构在分层目标下的最小最大分离：风险以指数因子分离，分离窗口由样本大小决定；最优分级可通过离线凸优化得到。
Conclusion: 分级大语言模型在理论上优于均匀架构，且编译后等价于标准Transformer，不增加推理成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: pyALDIC: A Python Implementation of Augmented Lagrangian Digital Image Correlation with a GUI, Adaptive Meshing, and Mask-Aware Subset Splitting
papers.abstract_en: pyALDIC is an open-source Python implementation of augmented Lagrangian digital image correlation (AL-DIC) for full-field displacement and strain measurement. The software combines a graphical user interface with a scriptable Python API and supports adaptive quadtree meshing, mask-aware subset splitting near cracks and holes, and selectable Local DIC and AL-DIC solver modes. Numba acceleration enables efficient analysis, while automated tests, documentation, and reproducible examples support reliable use acrossWindows, macOS, and Linux. Verification cases include synthetic displacement fields, rigid-body motion, Mode-I cracking, adaptive refinement, and experimental uniaxial tension. pyALDIC is distributed through PyPI, GitHub, and Zenodo under a BSD-3-Clause license for reproducibility. pyALDIC is openly available at https://github.com/zachtong/pyALDIC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: pyALDIC 是一个开源的 Python 软件包，实现了增强拉格朗日数字图像相关 (AL-DIC) 方法，用于全场位移和应变测量。它集成了图形用户界面和可脚本化的 Python API，支持自适应四叉树网格、掩膜感知子集分割（靠近裂缝和孔洞）以及可选的局部 DIC 和 AL-DIC 求解器模式。通过 Numba 加速实现高效分析，并包含自动化测试、文档和可重现示例，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
Motivation: 现有的 DIC 软件在自适应网格、裂缝附近子集分割以及易用性和可复现性方面存在局限，pyALDIC 旨在提供一个全面、跨平台、开源且易于扩展的解决方案。
Method: 采用增强拉格朗日方法 (AL-DIC)，结合自适应四叉树网格生成、掩膜感知子集分裂、可选的 Local DIC 和 AL-DIC 求解器模式，并利用 Numba 进行加速。
Result: 验证案例包括合成位移场、刚体运动、Mode-I 裂纹、自适应细化和实验单轴拉伸，结果表明该软件包在不同场景下都能有效工作。
Conclusion: pyALDIC 以 BSD-3-Clause 许可证通过 PyPI、GitHub 和 Zenodo 分发，旨在为 DIC 分析提供一个可复现、易用的开源工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real-time Reconstruction of Human Visual Perception from fMRI
papers.abstract_en: Real-time closed-loop neurofeedback based on functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has led to important scientific and clinical advances. However, the sophistication of the analysis methods used in real-time fMRI lags behind the state-of-the-art in fMRI decoding, largely due to computational factors: Most advanced decoding pipelines do not fit within the envelope of real-time processing, where the analysis needs to be conducted in a matter of seconds and without leveraging data acquired later in the session. Here, we present a real-time compatible adaptation of a computationally intensive state-of-the-art pipeline for reconstructing perceived natural images (MindEye2), and we demonstrate that reliable fine-grained decoding is still achievable in this setting. Using RT-Cloud, an open-source, scalable cloud-based platform, we performed a real-time scan where we decoded single-trial visual perception within seconds after an image was shown to the participant. Finally, we use simulated analyses to document the factors driving changes in performance from offline to real-time analysis. This work serves as a proof-of-concept that it is feasible to deploy these powerful fMRI decoding pipelines in real-time analysis, paving the way for their use in brain-computer interfaces for scientific discovery and clinical treatment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种适用于实时fMRI的自然图像解码管道，改编自计算密集的MindEye2，在RT-Cloud平台上实现单试次视觉感知的实时解码，并通过模拟分析比较离线与实时性能差异，证明先进解码管道可用于实时脑机接口。
Motivation: 实时闭环神经反馈虽重要，但现有实时fMRI分析方法远落后于离线解码技术，主要由于计算约束（需在几秒内完成分析且不能使用后续数据）。
Method: 将先进离线管道MindEye2实时化适配，利用开源云平台RT-Cloud进行实时扫描，在图像呈现后几秒内解码单试次视觉感知。
Result: 证明在实时约束下仍能实现可靠的细粒度解码；通过模拟分析揭示离线到实时性能变化的关键因素。
Conclusion: 该工作作为概念验证，表明先进的fMRI解码管道可用于实时分析，为脑机接口在科学发现和临床治疗中的应用铺路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Error-vs-Discard Characteristic: Toward Stable and Reliable Evaluation for Face Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Face Image Quality Assessment (FIQA) aims to estimate the utility of facial images for reliable recognition. The evaluation of FIQA methods is predominantly based on the Error-versus-Discard Characteristic (EDC), which evaluates performance by progressively discarding low-quality samples and measuring recognition error on the retained subset. In this work, we demonstrate that the widely used EDC protocol has fundamental limitations: Test-Set Divergence and Threshold Drift, which together limit the reliability and comparability of FIQA methods. To address this, we propose discard-based EDC variants and a rank-based Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE) metric that operates on the entire test set without discarding samples, using a fixed decision threshold. Extensive experiments on five datasets, four face recognition models, and 15 state-of-the-art FIQA methods demonstrate both the limitations of EDC and the effectiveness of the proposed approaches in enabling a more reliable and comparable evaluation. Despite evaluated on face images only, the limitations arise from the EDC protocol rather than the biometric modality, suggesting a broader applicability to biometric quality assessment in general.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人脸图像质量评估（FIQA）中广泛使用的Error-versus-Discard Characteristic (EDC)协议，指出其存在测试集发散（Test-Set Divergence）和阈值漂移（Threshold Drift）两个根本性局限，导致评估结果不可靠且难以比较。作者提出基于丢弃的EDC变体和基于排名的Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE)指标，后者使用固定决策阈值在全数据集上评估，无需丢弃样本。在五个数据集、四个人脸识别模型和15种当前最优FIQA方法上的实验证明了EDC的局限性和所提方法的有效性。尽管仅在面部图像上验证，但作者认为局限源于EDC协议本身，可能适用于更广泛的生物特征质量评估。
Motivation: 现有FIQA评估依赖EDC协议，但EDC存在测试集发散和阈值漂移问题，降低了评估的可靠性和不同方法之间的可比性。
Method: 提出丢弃式EDC变体（discard-based EDC variants）和基于排名的Rank Consistency Evaluation (RCE)指标。RCE使用固定决策阈值在整个测试集上评估，不丢弃任何样本。
Result: 在五个数据集、四个人脸识别模型和15种FIQA方法上的实验显示，EDC的局限性显著，而所提方法提供了更可靠和可比较的评估。
Conclusion: 论文强调EDC的局限性源于协议本身而非生物特征模态，因此所提的改进方法可能适用于一般生物特征质量评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Commitment To Cooperation With Self-Negotiated Contracts
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents operate with increasing autonomy in a multi-agent world, they will need to learn to cooperate with other agents and with humans to generate mutual benefits. However, cooperation is a challenge because the costs of cooperation are often incurred early on, but the benefits are only realized later, creating an incentive to defect. How can AI agents cooperate with commitment? Here, we draw on inspiration from legal institutions and contracting that human societies have used to solve principal-agent problems of this kind. Contracts provide observable representations of agreements that enable credible commitments through the enforcement of terms. We study the role of contract-based cooperation using LLM-based agents in \CT, a spatial-temporal game that combines bargaining with navigation towards a goal. We study a suite of contract representations that range from formal contracts that compile to code to natural contracts that require reinterpretation. We evaluate agents with a range of LLM backbones using different sizes and providers. We find that self-negotiated contracts can improve cooperative outcomes beyond what is possible with regular trading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何让AI代理通过自协商合同（self-negotiated contracts）实现合作，以解决合作成本早期投入而收益后期实现带来的背叛激励问题。作者在时空博弈CT中测试了LSTM和LLM基代理，发现自协商合同能改善合作效果，超越常规交易。
Motivation: AI代理在多智能体环境中需要学习合作，但合作的即时成本和延迟收益导致背叛诱惑，现有方法难以保证承诺的可信性。
Method: 借鉴人类社会中的法律合同机制，提出自协商合同表示，包括编译为代码的形式合同和需要重新解释的自然合同，并在CT游戏中结合LLM代理进行实验。
Result: 自协商合同能够提升合作结果，优于仅靠常规交易的基线；不同LLM骨干网和提供商均有效。
Conclusion: 合同式承诺机制可以为AI代理合作提供可信的约束，是解决多智能体合作问题的可行方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Post-Operative Glioma Segmentation via Loss Stabilization, Normalization and Subspace Attention
papers.abstract_en: Tracking residual tumor after surgery is essential for catching recurrence early, but automating post-operative glioma segmentation remains a difficult task. Although transformer-based architectures, such as SwinUNETR, achieved impressive results, few studies test how well they generalize across clinical protocols. In this paper, we conduct an ablation study on the MU-GLIOMA-POST and UCSF-ALPTDG datasets and show that the standard Generalized Dice Loss (GDL) is unstable under domain shift: the Whole Lesion (WL) Dice drops from 0.88 on the internal validation set to 0.73 on the external UCSF test set. To address this, we pair brain-masked percentile normalization with voxel-level contrastive learning. We also propose a Subspace-Aware Class Attention (SACA) module that re-calibrates the bottleneck features and raises Enhancing Tumor (ET) sensitivity by 8% (9.1% relative improvement) on internal validation. Ensembling these refinements with nnU-Net brings every stable configuration to a WL Dice of 0.94, and the SACA variant ensemble achieves the best boundary error (HD95) of 2.92 mm on MU-GLIOMA-POST.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对术后神经胶质瘤分割中域迁移导致的Dice不稳定问题，提出结合脑掩膜百分位归一化、体素级对比学习和子空间感知类注意力模块(SACA)，在MU-GLIOMA-POST和UCSF-ALPTDG数据集上验证。方法提高了增强肿瘤灵敏度，并通过集成达到高Dice和低边界误差。
Motivation: 现有模型如SwinUNETR在域迁移下性能下降，标准广义Dice损失不稳定，跨临床协议泛化能力未充分测试。
Method: 采用脑掩膜百分位归一化与体素级对比学习；提出子空间感知类注意力模块(SACA)重新校准瓶颈特征；最后与nnU-Net集成。
Result: 内部验证集上增强肿瘤灵敏度提升8%（相对9.1%）；集成配置达到全病变Dice 0.94，最佳HD95为2.92 mm。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提归一化和注意力模块能稳定分割性能并改善跨域泛化。
Relevance: 0
