papers.title: Learning to Access Computation: Accessibility Plasticity as a Principle of Adaptive Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural networks primarily adapt through parameter modification within predefined computational structures. While recent methods introduce modularity, conditional computation, and parameter-efficient adaptation, they generally do not distinguish computational capability from computational accessibility as separate adaptive variables. This work introduces Accessibility Plasticity, a principle of adaptive computation in which systems adapt not only by changing what computation exists, but also by reorganizing which existing computations can interact and participate. We formalize Accessibility Plasticity through a relationship-based operational realization and establish a reuse-first hierarchy of adaptation, where accessibility modification precedes more costly capability and structural changes. A proof-of-concept evaluation on sequential learning tasks shows that accessibility adaptation can reduce capability modification while maintaining comparable task performance. These results suggest accessibility as a distinct adaptive dimension and provide a foundation for future dynamic neural systems whose computational relationships evolve with changing environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出"可访问性塑性"(Accessibility Plasticity)原则，认为智能系统不仅应通过修改计算能力适应，还应通过重组已有计算之间的交互与参与来适应。作者通过关系形式化定义，并建立优先修改可访问性的"重用优先"适应层级。在序列学习任务上实验表明，可访问性适应可以在保持任务性能的同时减少能力修改。该工作为计算关系随环境演化的动态神经网络提供了基础。
Motivation: 现有神经网络主要通过修改参数适应，即使引入模块化和条件计算，也未将计算能力与计算可访问性作为分离的适应变量。本文目标是将可访问性作为独立的适应维度。
Method: 提出可访问性塑性原则，通过基于关系的操作实现形式化，并建立重用优先的适应层级：可访问性修改先于更昂贵的能力和结构改变。在序列学习任务上进行概念验证。
Result: 实验表明，可访问性适应可以在保持相当任务性能的同时减少能力修改。
Conclusion: 可访问性是一个独立的适应维度，为未来计算关系随环境演化的动态神经网络系统提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Advancing All-Weather Building Damage Mapping to the Instance Level: Outcomes and Insights from the 2026 Bright Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Rapid post-disaster response requires timely, building-level information on whether structures remain intact, are damaged, or are destroyed. Post-event optical imagery, however, may be unavailable because of cloud, smoke, or darkness. The Bright Challenge evaluated all-weather building damage mapping from a submeter-resolution pre-event optical image and a post-event SAR image. Participants were required to detect and delineate each building and assign exactly one of three mutually exclusive damage labels. The challenge extended the globally distributed \textsc{Bright} dataset with instance-level annotations for about 291,000 buildings across 16 disaster events spanning seven disaster types. The final phase was evaluated exclusively on two 2025 events absent from training: a wildfire event in California and a hurricane in Jamaica. A total of 157 participants made 1,289 submissions, and 46 teams entered the final phase. The two winning solutions achieved test mAPs of 0.182 and 0.181, approximately 8.7 times the public baseline of 0.021, but remained far below the best in-domain holdout score of 0.513. Across teams ranked in both phases, performance declined sharply and the rank order changed substantially. The two leading solutions independently favored modality-specific encoding, staged or late optical--SAR fusion, and an optical-dominant separation of building localization from damage recognition. The winning method additionally used scene-aware threshold adjustment and pseudo-label adaptation. These results identify cross-event generalization and stable severity discrimination as the principal remaining challenges. All data, annotations, baseline code, and winning solutions are publicly available at https://github.com/ChenHongruixuan/BRIGHT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍2026年Bright挑战赛，旨在利用灾前亚米级光学图像和灾后SAR图像实现全天候建筑物损伤实例级制图。挑战扩展了BRIGHT数据集，包含约29.1万栋建筑物标注，最终阶段测试2025年新灾害事件。157支队伍提交1289次结果，冠军方法mAP约0.18，远低于域内最佳0.513，表明跨事件泛化和损伤严重性判别仍是主要挑战。
Motivation: 灾后快速响应需要建筑物级别的损伤信息，但光学图像常因云、烟或黑暗不可用。现有方法缺乏实例级全天候制图基准，且跨灾害泛化能力不足。
Method: 挑战要求从灾前亚米级光学图像和灾后SAR图像中检测并分割每栋建筑物，并赋予三种互斥损伤标签之一。两个优胜方案独立采用模态特定编码、分阶段或晚期光学-SAR融合，以及以光学为主的建筑物定位与损伤识别分离。冠军方法还使用了场景感知阈值调整和伪标签适应。
Result: 157支队伍提交1289次结果，46队进入最终阶段。两个优胜方案测试mAP分别为0.182和0.181，约为公开基线0.021的8.7倍，但远低于域内最佳保留分数0.513。
Conclusion: Bright挑战揭示了跨事件泛化和稳定损伤严重性判别是全天候建筑物损伤制图的主要剩余挑战。所有数据、标注、基线代码和优胜方案已公开。

papers.title: AI-generated Images Challenge Visual Trust in High-risk Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advances in image generation are eroding the evidentiary value of visual content in settings where authenticity can affect public safety and personal reputation. Yet existing detection benchmarks rarely examine synthetic images in public- and individual-safety contexts, where misleading visual content may carry substantial risks. Here we introduce SafeIMG, a safety-oriented benchmark spanning 12 public- and individual-safety scenarios generated using GPT Image 2. Unlike benchmarks centred on generic imagery and image-level labels, SafeIMG evaluates not only whether detectors recognise synthetic images, but also whether their decisions reflect human-identified anomalies. To this end, SafeIMG provides human annotations that localise suspicious regions and explain local artefacts and higher-level commonsense or physical inconsistencies. We evaluate specialized synthetic-image detectors and vision-language models (VLMs), and find that neither provides reliable detection. The strongest VLM identifies only 49.5% of generated images, whereas the best specialised detector identifies 33.1%, compared with 81.7% accuracy for human evaluators. Model explanations cover only 29.8\% of human-annotated anomalies and predominantly capture local defects in text, faces and hands. Their coverage falls to 15.0% for commonsense conflicts and 12.0% for physical inconsistencies, while detection performance deteriorates further after dissemination-induced image degradation. These findings show that current detectors lack the accuracy, explanatory alignment and robustness needed to evaluate AI-generated images reliably across public- and individual-safety settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI生成图像在公共安全和个人安全场景中的信任问题，提出了安全导向的基准SafeIMG。该基准包含12个高风险场景，并提供人类标注的异常区域和解释。评估发现，现有检测器（包括专用检测器和视觉语言模型）检测准确率远低于人类，且模型解释只能覆盖少量人类标注的异常，特别是在常识冲突和物理不一致方面表现较差。结果表明当前检测器缺乏在高风险场景中可靠评估AI生成图像所需的准确性、解释一致性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有检测基准很少关注公共和个人安全场景中误导性视觉内容的风险，而快速进步的图像生成技术正在削弱视觉内容的可信度。因此需要针对安全场景的检测基准。
Method: 提出了SafeIMG基准，涵盖12个公共和个人安全场景，使用GPT Image 2生成图像；提供人类标注的本地化可疑区域和解释（包括局部伪影、常识和物理不一致）。评估了专用合成图像检测器和视觉语言模型。
Result: 最强的VLM仅识别49.5%的生成图像，最佳专用检测器识别33.1%，而人类准确率为81.7%。模型解释覆盖仅29.8%的人类标注异常，对常识冲突覆盖15.0%，物理不一致覆盖12.0%。图像传播退化后检测性能进一步下降。
Conclusion: 当前检测器缺乏在高风险公共和个人安全场景中可靠评估AI生成图像所需的准确性、解释对齐和鲁棒性。

papers.title: QFedPolyp: A Communication- and Inference-Efficient Federated Learning Framework for Polyp Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objective: Automatic polyp segmentation supports computer-aided diagnosis and early colorectal cancer detec- tion. Centralized deep learning requires hospitals to share sensitive medical data, while federated learning preserves privacy but introduces high communication costs through repeated transmission of full-precision model parameters. We propose QFedPolyp, a communication- and inference-efficient federated learning framework for collaborative polyp segmentation. Methods: QFedPolyp combines quantization-aware training with low-precision model communication. Each hospital locally trains a lightweight U-Net on private data while simulating quantization during training. Clients transmit quantized model parameters to a central server, where they are reconstructed and aggregated using Federated Averaging. Evaluation is performed on Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicVideoDB, PolypGen, and BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp. Results: Full-precision federated training achieves Dice scores of 0.910 on Kvasir-SEG and 0.930 on CVC-ClinicVideoDB. Uni- form 8-bit communication reduces transmission cost by approximately 4 times while preserving competitive segmentation accuracy. Quantized models also achieve up to 1.5 times faster inference than full-precision models. Conclusions: QFedPolyp enables privacy-preserving collaborative polyp segmentation with reduced communication overhead and faster inference. The resulting lightweight models are suitable for real-time clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QFedPolyp，一种通信和推理高效的联邦学习框架，用于协作性息肉分割。该方法结合量化感知训练与低精度模型通信，医院在本地训练轻量 U-Net 并传输量化参数，中央服务器通过联邦平均聚合。在 Kvasir-SEG、CVC-ClinicVideoDB 等数据集上，8-bit 通信将传输成本降低约 4 倍，推理速度提升 1.5 倍，同时保持接近全精度的分割精度。
Motivation: 集中式深度学习需要医院共享敏感医学数据，而联邦学习虽保护隐私但全精度参数传输导致高昂通信成本。本文旨在降低通信开销和推理延迟，同时保持竞争性分割性能。
Method: 采用量化感知训练（quantization-aware training），各客户端在私有数据上训练轻量 U-Net，并模拟量化过程；传输量化后的模型参数（如 8-bit）至中央服务器，通过 Federated Averaging 重构并聚合。
Result: 全精度联邦训练在 Kvasir-SEG 上达到 Dice 0.910，在 CVC-ClinicVideoDB 上达到 0.930。均匀 8-bit 通信减少约 4 倍传输成本，量化模型推理速度比全精度模型快 1.5 倍。
Conclusion: QFedPolyp 实现了隐私保护的协作息肉分割，显著降低了通信开销和推理时间，生成的轻量模型适合实时临床部署。

papers.title: A Diagnostic Gap Framework for Evaluating Reconstruction Fidelity in Weakly Supervised Mammography
papers.abstract_en: Weakly supervised pipelines for medical imaging have become increasingly popular over the years. These systems often include multiple stages and components, such as reconstruction, generation, and localization, yet standard evaluation metrics provide limited insight into whether clinically relevant information is preserved across each stage. We present the diagnostic gap framework, a practical evaluation tool that measures decision preservation and explanation preservation as a function of measured reconstruction fidelity. To isolate the effect of reconstruction from localization, we evaluate on curated lesion ROI crops using a fidelity ladder of three class-conditional reconstructors---VQ-VAE-GAN, VAE-GAN, and diffusion (SDEdit)---spanning a twenty-fold range in perceptual distance (LPIPS 0.029--0.584). At autoencoder fidelity, both decision and explanation are preserved: AUC changes remain within $\pm$0.005 and attribution similarity (HiResCAM, Grad-CAM++) stays high. At diffusion fidelity, both collapse: pooled AUC drops by 0.253 and mass-pathology AUC falls below chance. The diagnostic gap is thus a measurable function of reconstruction fidelity rather than an intrinsic cost of reconstruction, and the framework provides an architecture-agnostic instrument for identifying when and where multi-stage pipelines lose diagnostic signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出诊断差距框架，用于评估弱监督乳腺X线摄影系统中重建保真度对临床相关信息的保留程度。通过三种重构器（VQ-VAE-GAN、VAE-GAN、SDEdit）在病变ROI上构建保真度阶梯，实验表明自动编码器保真度下决策和解释均得以保留，而扩散保真度下两者均崩溃。
Motivation: 现有弱监督医学影像管道缺乏评估跨阶段临床信息保留的指标，标准评价指标无法衡量重建是否保留关键诊断信号。
Method: 提出诊断差距框架，通过决策保留（AUC变化）和解释保留（归因相似性）衡量重建保真度，并使用三种不同感知距离的重构器构建实验阶梯。
Result: 在自动编码器保真度下（LPIPS 0.029），AUC变化±0.005内，HiResCAM和Grad-CAM++相似度高；在扩散保真度下（LPIPS 0.584），AUC下降0.253，质量病理AUC低于随机。
Conclusion: 诊断差距是重建保真度的可测量函数而非内在成本，该框架可架构无关地识别多阶段管道丢失诊断信号的位置。

papers.title: Cortex: Compact Behavior Cloning for Quake with Frozen Visual Features
papers.abstract_en: We study how far a deliberately simple behavioral-cloning policy can progress in a visually rich first-person game before adding reinforcement learning or explicit memory. Cortex is a compact Quake policy with 10.98 million trainable parameters in a six-layer transformer over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. It is trained on the Quake subset of the public Pixels2Play corpus: 6,849 recordings (about 474.7 hours), represented as 17.09 million cached decision frames with keyboard and mouse actions. One sampled training epoch uses 517,048 four-frame windows and takes 3.3 minutes of policy-head optimization on one RTX 5080, excluding one-time feature extraction. We evaluate two independent batches of 20 stochastic, 120-second episodes on Quake E1M1. Cortex does not complete the level, but every episode reaches the opening door, button room, and gate descent; 19 of 20 episodes in each batch record at least one kill. Under the same time-controlled harness, released P2P-150M and NitroGen checkpoints remain shallower in five matched-duration episodes each. These comparisons are limited by small reference samples and different native interfaces. Ablations show that denser visual tokens improve combat and survival, while longer optimization and naive action history improve offline metrics without consistently improving play. The remaining failures are consistent with covariate shift and motivate targeted corrective data. We release the policy implementation, checkpoint, and a representative rollout.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, made with heavy assistance from LLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在视觉丰富的第一人称游戏《Quake》中，一个刻意简化的行为克隆策略在未加入强化学习或显式记忆前能取得多大进展。Cortex 是一个紧凑的 Quake 策略，包含 1098 万个可训练参数，采用六层 Transformer 和冻结的 DINOv3 编码器，在公开的 Pixels2Play 数据集上训练。评估显示 Cortex 未能通关，但每局都能到达特定区域，多数局能击杀敌人；与 P2P-150M 和 NitroGen 基线相比表现略优。实验表明较多的视觉 token 有利于战斗和生存，但优化时间的增加和朴素动作历史对离线指标有提升却未能持续改善实际游戏表现。
Motivation: 探索在无强化学习或显式记忆的情况下，简单的行为克隆策略在视觉丰富的第一人称游戏中的上限，以理解纯模仿学习的局限性。
Method: Cortex 使用冻结的 DINOv3 视觉编码器提取特征，后接六层 Transformer 策略头，参数量 10.98M；在 Quake 游戏数据集的 6849 段录制（约 474.7 小时）上训练，采用四帧窗口和缓存决策帧，单次训练轮次耗时 3.3 分钟（RTX 5080）。
Result: 在 Quake E1M1 地图的 120 秒随机回合中，Cortex 虽未通关，但每回合均到达大门、按钮室和闸门下降处，19/20 回合有击杀；与 P2P-150M 和 NitroGen 基线在五次匹配回合中相比表现更优。消融实验表明，密集的视觉 token 提升战斗和生存能力，更长优化时间和动作历史提升离线指标但不一致改善实际表现。
Conclusion: 当前策略受限于协变量偏移，未来需要通过针对性的校正数据来改进。论文发布策略实现、检查点和代表性回放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nova3D: Code-Native Generation of Programmable 3D Assets
papers.abstract_en: Current 3D generative models mostly produce a final surface: a visually strong but largely opaque mesh. Interactive 3D worlds need more than a surface. They need named parts, an assembly hierarchy, measurable constraints, local edit handles, and joints for articulation. We present Nova3D, a system that generates 3D assets as executable Blender source code; the compiled mesh, a binary glTF (GLB), is treated as the artifact, not the asset. Because the output is a program, semantic handles exist at generation time rather than being recovered afterward by segmentation or rigging. We evaluate on Nova3D-Bench, a frozen, spec-grounded benchmark of 54 items across six domains and three difficulty levels with text and image inputs, against eleven baselines in four families (mesh-native, part-structured, code-native, and CAD) plus a same-LLM ablation. Nova3D produces an executable program and a valid artifact for 54/54 items. Every asset exposes named parts organized in a parent-child assembly tree; no mesh-native, CAD, or segmentation baseline exposes either. It satisfies 51/52 prompt-stated numeric and count constraints (best baseline: 11/52), passes 14/18 blinded local edits with locality preserved in 18/18, and articulates 59 joints across 12 assets at 98.3% geometric validity, where every baseline exposes zero native joints. Its geometry is competitive: it wins the structured domains in a pairwise shape-quality tournament and is second only to the strongest mesh-native model, while conceding texture realism to baked-PBR systems. The central result is representational: code-native generation turns a generated 3D object from an opaque surface into a programmable asset that downstream systems can inspect, measure, edit, and animate.

Motivation: 当前3D生成模型主要输出最终表面（不透明网格），无法满足交互式3D世界对命名部件、装配层次、可测量约束、局部编辑手柄和关节的需求。事后通过分割或绑定恢复语义句柄效率低且不准确。
Method: Nova3D 系统将3D资产生成为可执行的Blender源代码，编译后的网格（GLB）被视为制品而非资产。输出是程序，因此生成时即存在语义句柄。在包含54项任务的基准上，使用文本和图像输入，与11种基线（网格原生、部件结构化、代码原生、CAD）及同一LLM消融进行比较。
Result: Nova3D 在54/54项任务中生成可执行程序和有效资产；每个资产暴露命名部件及父子装配树，而所有网格原生、CAD或分割基线均无法做到；满足51/52个提示约束（最佳基线11/52）；通过14/18个局部编辑且18/18保持局部性；在12个资产上生成59个关节，几何有效性98.3%，基线均为0。几何质量在结构化领域赢得配对形状质量锦标赛，仅次于最强网格原生模型，但纹理逼真度逊于烘焙PBR系统。

papers.title: Benchmarking the Domain Gap: Model Selection Instability Under Domain Shift in Video Capsule Endoscopy
papers.abstract_en: Video capsule endoscopy (VCE) classification is typically evaluated within a single dataset, yet clinical deployment demands robustness across acquisition sources, labeling policies, and patient populations. We examine this gap using Kvasir-Capsule, Capsule Vision 2024 (CV2024), and a shared-label subset of Galar. We fine-tune a suite of general-domain pretrained backbones on the official Kvasir-Capsule folds under a standardized protocol and evaluate the same checkpoints on two non-source targets within a documented shared-label decision space. We find that the predictive value of in-domain ranking is target-dependent: Kvasir-Capsule ranking aligns more closely with Galar than with CV2024, while the two non-source targets agree only weakly. Consequently, the strongest in-domain backbone leads on one target yet falls to mid-pack on the other, and no single evaluation target reliably predicts the others. A second CV2024-trained configuration set reproduces this target-dependent instability. We conclude that capsule endoscopy model selection should report cross-target ranking stability rather than peak single-dataset performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视频胶囊内镜（VCE）分类中，模型在跨数据集（Kvasir-Capsule、Capsule Vision 2024、Galar子集）部署时的领域偏移问题。实验发现，源域内排名对目标域的预测价值取决于目标域，不同目标域之间一致性弱，单一数据集峰值性能不可靠，建议报告跨目标排名稳定性。
Motivation: 现有VCE分类评估通常限于单数据集，但临床部署面临采集来源、标注策略和患者群体的差异，导致领域偏移，模型选择不稳定。
Method: 使用通用预训练骨干网络，在Kvasir-Capsule官方划分上微调，并在两个非源目标域（Galar和CV2024）上评估，分析共享标签子集下的模型选择稳定性。
Result: 发现域内排名对齐程度因目标而异：Kvasir-Capsule排名与Galar更接近，与CV2024较弱；两个非源目标域之间仅弱相关。最佳域内模型在某个目标上表现最好，但在另一个目标上仅居中。
Conclusion: 胶囊内镜模型选择应报告跨目标排名稳定性，而非仅依赖单数据集峰值性能。

papers.title: Fast Fourier Convolutional GAN for 30 m Clear-Sky Land Surface Temperature Gap-Free Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Satellite-derived Land Surface Temperature (LST) provides spatially comprehensive data that ground stations cannot match. However, its utility is frequently limited by severe data gaps due to the presence of clouds. As LST is essential for understanding land-atmosphere interactions, numerous methods have been proposed to address this challenge. Yet, the development of a scalable and adaptable pipeline for generating gap-free LST datasets and reconstructing cloud-contaminated pixels remains challenging. Moreover, the reconstruction of extensive missing regions in fine-spatial-resolution observations is particularly difficult. To address this challenge, we propose a Multimodal Fast Fourier Convolutional GAN for reconstructing cloud-contaminated pixels in fine-resolution (30 m) Landsat imagery to generate gap-free clear-sky LST products. The method leverages Fast Fourier Convolution to enable a global receptive field across the image, and is guided by a stack of data consisting of satellite observations and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. Across all LST quantiles, the interquartile range of scene-averaged RMSE (computed over reconstructed pixels) is consistently between 0.8 K and 1.8 K. The proposed approach enables the recovery of extensive missing regions, including scenes with more than 70% cloud-induced gaps, while relying on auxiliary data that are readily available at a near-global scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态快速傅里叶卷积生成对抗网络（FFC-GAN），用于重建30米分辨率Landsat影像中的云污染像素，生成无间隙晴空地表温度产品。该方法通过快速傅里叶卷积实现全局感受野，并联合卫星观测与合成孔径雷达（SAR）数据。在所有LST分位数上，场景平均RMSE的四分位距在0.8K至1.8K之间，可恢复超过70%云覆盖缺口的大面积缺失区域。
Motivation: 卫星遥感反演的地表温度（LST）因云覆盖存在严重数据缺失，现有方法在精细空间分辨率下重建大面积缺失区域仍具挑战。
Method: 提出多模态FFC-GAN，利用快速傅里叶卷积（Fast Fourier Convolution）实现全局感受野，以Landsat光学影像和SAR数据作为引导，生成无间隙的30米分辨率晴空LST产品。
Result: 重建像素的场景平均RMSE四分位距在所有LST分位数上稳定为0.8K-1.8K；能恢复超过70%云覆盖缺口的大面积缺失区域。
Conclusion: 该方法借助近全球尺度易获取的辅助数据（SAR等），在精细分辨率下有效重建大面积云污染像素，具备可扩展性。

papers.title: Generative Augmentation for EEG Motor Imagery Classification: A Class-Conditional VAE with Cycle-Consistent Decoder Refinement
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether a generative model can supply useful synthetic motor-imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) trials that improve the accuracy of independent downstream classifiers. We train a class-conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) with an integrated latent classifier on the Zhou motor-imagery dataset, using the learned per-class prior as a generator: sampling the prior for a given label and decoding it into a synthetic, label-consistent signal. A constraint on the covariance matrix of the generated data encourages preservation of covariance structure, and the model is trained with a schedule that alternates ordinary VAE training with a decoder-focused phase that sharpens the generative pathway used for augmentation. We measure the effect of adding synthetic trials to the training set under two evaluation protocols -- within-user (pooled 60/20/20 split across subjects) and cross-user (leave-one-subject-out, LOSO) -- across four representative EEG classification pipelines: Common Spatial Patterns with Linear Discriminant Analysis (CSP+LDA), tangent-space features with a Support Vector Machine (TGSP+SVM), Minimum Distance to Riemannian Mean (MDM), and a neural network based on EEGNetv4 (henceforth EEGNet). Results are aggregated across independent augmentation draws, random seeds (within-user), or leave-one-subject-out folds (cross-user), with uncertainty reported as 95\% confidence intervals (Student's $t$-distribution) computed over per-seed/per-fold averages. We find that synthetic EEG from the CVAE is most credible as a source of class-structured, covariance-like data rather than as a substitute for real raw EEG: it can raise the point estimate for MDM, but the broader augmentation claim remains conservative -- observed gains are small and classifier-dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究使用类条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成合成运动想象脑电图（EEG）信号，以增强下游分类器性能。在Zhou数据集上，通过向训练集添加合成样本来测试四种EEG分类流水线，结果发现合成EEG能提升MDM分类器的点估计，但整体增益较小且依赖分类器，合成信号更类似于类结构的协方差数据而非真实原始EEG。
Motivation: 探索生成模型能否提供有用的合成运动想象EEG样本，以提高独立下游分类器的准确性。
Method: 训练一个带有集成潜在分类器的类条件变分自编码器，使用学习到的每类先验作为生成器，通过采样先验并解码生成标签一致的合成信号，并对生成数据的协方差矩阵施加约束，采用交替训练策略。
Result: 在四种分类流水线（CSP+LDA, TGSP+SVM, MDM, EEGNet）上评估，合成EEG能提升MDM的点估计，但整体收益较小且依赖分类器。
Conclusion: 合成EEG更可信作为类结构协方差数据的来源，而非真实原始EEG的替代品；增强效果保守且分类器依赖。

papers.title: Spatial Reasoning in LLM Game Agents: Impact of Causal Context and Multi-Step Planning
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based game agents often perform poorly on more complex tasks. This work examines whether these failures are linked to limited spatial reasoning and evaluates whether causal prompt augmentation and multi-step planning can improve win-rates while managing response latency. Using the open-source Qwen3 model family, we conduct experiments across varying model scales, reasoning modes, and planning horizons. We further introduce a focused GVGAI benchmark consisting of three custom games with five difficulty levels to isolate spatial navigation. The evaluation follows two paradigms: an initial ``positioning experiment'' to test an agent's ability to find its exact coordinates, and a study of game-play success. Our results show that while larger models with an enabled thinking mode identify their positions more accurately, overall performance in coordinate matching remains limited for smaller models. Win rates decrease as game levels and layout complexity increase, validating the benchmark's difficulty scaling. Integrating causal context into the prompts tends to improve the agents' success rates, particularly for bigger models. While enabling thinking mode and longer planning horizons significantly improve performance, multi-step planning further reduces mean per-step response times, offering a practical trade-off between reasoning depth and execution speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的游戏智能体在复杂任务中的表现，特别是空间推理能力。通过因果提示增强和多步规划策略，在不同规模模型上测试定位准确率和胜率。结果表明大模型结合思考模式可提升定位，但小模型表现有限；因果上下文和长规划视界可提升胜率，多步规划降低响应时间。
Motivation: LLM游戏智能体在复杂任务中表现不佳，可能与空间推理能力有限有关。本文旨在检验这一假设并探索改进方法。
Method: 使用开源Qwen3模型，设计自定义GVGAI基准（三个游戏、五个难度级别），进行定位实验和游戏表现评估。采用因果提示增强、多步规划等策略，比较不同模型规模和推理模式。
Result: 大模型（启用思考模式）定位更准确，但小模型坐标匹配能力有限。胜率随游戏难度增加而下降。因果上下文提示提升胜率（尤其大模型）。多步规划和思考模式显著提升性能，且多步规划降低每步响应时间。
Conclusion: 因果提示增强和多步规划可提升LLM游戏智能体的空间推理和胜率，同时多步规划在推理深度和执行速度之间提供实用权衡。

papers.title: Calibration-Free 3D Multi-Camera People Tracking for Indoor Environment
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Camera People Tracking (MCPT) traditionally relies on precise intrinsic and extrinsic camera calibration to project 2D detections into a unified 3D world coordinate system.However, manual calibration constitutes a major bottleneck in large-scale dataset generation from unconstrained video archives. This work proposes a unified calibration-free 3D MCPT framework that infers geometric structure directly from visual data using deep foundation models. The system integrates anchor-free detection (YOLOX), robust tracking (BoT-SORT), omni-scale appearance embedding (OsNet), pose estimation (HRNet via MMPose), and transformer-based geometric reconstruction using the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT). A pose-guided 3D lifting strategy projects head keypoints onto a reconstructed manifold, eliminating dependence on ground-plane homography. Global identity association is formulated as hierarchical agglomerative clustering under a joint appearance-geometry cost with strict velocity gating. Evaluation on the AI City Challenge 2024 demonstrates a HOTA score of 53.13% without access to ground-truth calibration matrices, establishing a strong baseline for purely vision-based 3D tracking.

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种无需标定的3D多相机人物跟踪框架，利用深度基础模型直接从视觉数据推断几何结构，无需相机内外参。系统集成YOLOX检测、BoT-SORT跟踪、OsNet外观嵌入、HRNet姿态估计和VGGT几何重建，通过姿态引导的3D提升和层次聚类实现全局身份关联。在AI City Challenge 2024上达到53.13%的HOTA分数。
Motivation: 传统多相机人物跟踪依赖精确的相机标定，而手动标定是大规模数据集生成的瓶颈。论文旨在消除这一依赖，实现纯视觉的3D跟踪。
Method: 提出统一的无需标定框架，融合anchor-free检测、鲁棒跟踪、全尺度外观嵌入、姿态估计和基于Transformer的几何重建，通过姿态引导的3D提升和联合外观-几何代价的层次聚类进行全局关联。
Result: 在AI City Challenge 2024上，未使用任何真实标定矩阵的情况下，HOTA分数达到53.13%。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了纯视觉3D跟踪的强基线，证明无需传统标定即可实现有效的多相机人物跟踪。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open Your Model's Eyes: Video and Context-Aware Multimodal Backchannel Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Backchannels, which signal listener states like empathy and understanding, are fundamental to natural human interaction. However, current approaches rely solely on audio and text. This omits crucial visual cues, such as facial expressions and gestures, as well as broader conversational contexts, which are necessary for accurate prediction. In this paper, we introduce Context-Aware Multimodal Alignment for Backchannel Prediction (CAMA-BC), a novel framework that leverages visual information through Multi-Layer Multimodal Alignment (MMA). Our alignment process comprises two stages. First, Context Alignment (MMA-CA) utilizes unlabeled dialogues with videos to capture conversational contexts. Next, Backchannel Alignment (MMA-BA) fine-tunes the representations specifically for backchannel prediction. Experimental results show that CAMA-BC significantly outperforms both existing methods and simple multimodal baselines, with particular effectiveness in recognizing complex backchannels such as empathy.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), Association for Computational Linguistics, pp. 3738-3755, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAMA-BC框架，通过多模态对齐（MMA）引入视觉信息（面部表情、手势）和对话语境来预测反刍信号（如共情、理解）。方法包括两阶段对齐：语境对齐（MMA-CA）利用未标注对话视频捕获上下文，反刍对齐（MMA-BA）微调表示用于预测。实验表明该方法显著优于现有音频-文本基线，尤其在识别复杂反刍（如共情）上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有反刍预测方法仅依赖音频和文本，忽略了视觉线索和对话语境，导致预测不准确。
Method: 提出Context-Aware Multimodal Alignment for Backchannel Prediction (CAMA-BC)，包含两个阶段：语境对齐（MMA-CA）和反刍对齐（MMA-BA），利用未标注对话视频进行多模态对齐。
Result: 实验显示CAMA-BC显著优于现有方法和简单多模态基线，尤其在识别复杂反刍（如共情）方面效果显著。
Conclusion: 强调视觉信息和对话语境对反刍预测的重要性，所提对齐方法有效提升了预测性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CrossSpine: Multi-scale Cross-sequence Attention with Anatomical Priors for Automated Pfirrmann Grading
papers.abstract_en: Automated grading of Lumbar Disc Degeneration is essential for the objective quantification of structural changes associated with low back pain. Observing that baseline models underperformed on our data, we propose a framework designed to overcome these limitations. First, we present the Cross-sequence Attention Spine (CrossSpine) framework, a novel architecture that employs a cross-sequence attention mechanism to adaptively fuse features from different MRI sequences at multiple spa- tial scales. Second, we contribute a meticulously curated dataset aimed at automated Pfirrmann grading. Finally, we introduce an IVD-aware classification technique that integrates anatomical disc-level information, enabling the model to learn level-specific degeneration priors. Our experi- ments demonstrate the superiority of this approach: CrossSpine achieved a relative improvement exceeding 125% in the Macro F1 score, while boosting the Mean AUPRC by 99% and the Mean AUROC by 36% com- pared to the baseline.

TL;DR: 本文提出CrossSpine框架，用于自动Pfirrmann分级（腰椎间盘退变评估）。该框架采用跨序列注意力机制，从不同MRI序列中自适应融合多尺度特征，并引入椎间盘感知分类技术学习退变先验。实验在自建数据集上取得Macro F1相对提升125%、Mean AUPRC提升99%、Mean AUROC提升36%的效果。
Motivation: 基线模型在现有数据集上表现不佳，需要更鲁棒的方法来自动量化腰椎间盘退变的结构变化。
Method: 提出CrossSpine架构，包含跨序列注意力机制以融合多MRI序列的多尺度特征，以及椎间盘感知分类技术，利用解剖层级退化先验。
Result: 该方法在Macro F1上相对提升125%，Mean AUPRC提升99%，Mean AUROC提升36%。
Conclusion: CrossSpine通过跨序列注意力与解剖先验显著提升了Pfirrmann分级性能。

papers.title: Trustworthy Medical Segmentation: Uncertainty-Aware U-Net Evaluation Under Clinical Image Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation models often report high benchmark accuracy under ideal imaging conditions, yet their failures under clinical degradation can be quiet: sensor noise, patient motion, low- resolution acquisition, and contrast variability may all alter model behavior without producing an obvious warning. We present a reproducible framework for evaluating uncertainty-aware segmentation under con- trolled clinical degradation. Our experiments use a synthetic multimodal brain tumor MRI cohort generated with a biophysical phantom simulator that follows the BraTS protocol. We train U-Net and Attention U-Net baselines for multi-class tumor sub-region segmentation and augment both models with Monte Carlo dropout to estimate per-voxel uncertainty. Across eight clinically motivated corruption types at five severity levels, we measure segmentation accuracy, calibration, failure detection, and selective prediction coverage. On clean data, Attention U-Net achieves a whole-tumor Dice of 0.990; under severe Gaussian noise, its performance falls to 0.089. Predictive uncertainty rises with degradation and tracks segmentation error (Pearson r = 0.53 under severity-3 Gaussian noise), allowing us to flag failures with an AUROC of 0.843. These results argue for uncertainty-aware inference as a practical safety layer in physician-in-the-loop radiology workflows. We release the code, trained models, and evaluation protocol to support direct reproduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可复现的评估框架，用于在临床图像退化条件下测试不确定性感知的医学图像分割模型。使用合成多模态脑肿瘤MRI数据集，在U-Net和Attention U-Net上添加MC Dropout进行不确定性估计，在8种退化类型和5个严重级别下评估分割精度、校准、故障检测和选择性预测覆盖。清洁数据下Attention U-Net的全肿瘤Dice为0.990，严重高斯噪声下降至0.089，预测不确定性随退化上升并与分割误差相关（Pearson r=0.53），可检测故障（AUROC=0.843）。
Motivation: 医学图像分割模型在理想条件下表现良好，但在临床退化（传感器噪声、运动、低分辨率、对比度变化）下可能静默失败，缺乏预警机制。现有研究缺乏系统评估不确定性与退化关系的框架。
Method: 使用生物物理幻影模拟器生成遵循BraTS协议的多模态脑肿瘤MRI合成数据。训练U-Net和Attention U-Net进行多类肿瘤子区域分割，并添加MC Dropout以估计逐体素不确定性。在8种临床相关退化类型（5个严重级别）上进行系统测试。
Result: 清洁数据下Attention U-Net全肿瘤Dice=0.990；严重高斯噪声下降至0.089。预测不确定性与分割误差的Pearson相关系数为0.53（严重度3高斯噪声），故障检测AUROC达0.843。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知推理可作为临床放射学工作流程中的实用安全层。作者开源代码、模型和评估协议以支持复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PCA: Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation for Fast Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) that have displayed promising outcomes in video understanding, the redundancy in the long-duration frames remains a hindrance to efficient reasoning. This paper introduces a training-free $\mathbf{P}$ersistence-Aware $\mathbf{C}$ompression and $\mathbf{A}$ggregation (PCA) method designed to preserve high-fidelity raw visual information before the encoding stage. PCA can be built on arbitrary VLLMs and consists of two modules: 1) A Dynamic Downsampling (DD) module that adaptively removes redundant frames by analyzing frame-wise similarity. 2) A Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement (PAME) module that enriches each selected keyframe by aggregating the temporal context of its neighbors, ensuring that essential information is preserved even after aggressive frame reduction. Our approach substantially reduces the computation of long-context modeling, while enhancing the performance of the baseline model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PCA consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in both efficiency and accuracy, achieving a speedup of 1.8$\times$ to 2.5$\times$ compared to the baseline VLLM. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/Heisenberg10110/PCA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的视频大语言模型（VLLM）持久性感知压缩与聚合（PCA）方法，包含动态下采样（DD）和持久性感知运动增强（PAME）两个模块，在编码前保留高保真原始视觉信息。实验表明PCA在效率和准确率上优于现有方法，加速1.8-2.5倍，且可即插即用于任意VLLM。
Motivation: 长视频帧中存在大量冗余，阻碍VLLM的高效推理。现有方法需要训练或修改模型，本文旨在提出一种训练前的即插即用压缩方法。
Method: PCA由DD模块（自适应地移除冗余帧，基于帧间相似性）和PAME模块（通过聚合邻域时间上下文增强关键帧，保留关键信息）组成，无需训练，直接应用于编码阶段前。
Result: 在多个视频理解基准上，PCA一致优于现有最先进方法，实现1.8倍到2.5倍的加速，同时提升基线模型性能。
Conclusion: PCA是一种有效且高效的视频压缩方法，可直接应用于任意VLLM以提升推理速度和准确性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural Preservation Governs Data Augmentation in Deep Learning-Based Laser Speckle Material Classification
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation is routinely used to improve generalization in image classification, but the assumptions underlying standard policies are poorly matched to coherent imaging. Laser speckle patterns are not generic textures; they arise from coherent interference, and their discriminative content is carried by structured stochastic spatial and frequency statistics. This study examines how controlled augmentation perturbations influence speckle-based material classification on the SensiCut dataset. We train ResNet18 and EfficientNet-B0 under a parametric augmentation framework comprising rotation, Gaussian blur, independent Gaussian noise, spatially correlated speckle-aware noise, intensity jitter, and spatial masking, and evaluate test performance using macro F1-score averaged over three random seeds. Separate ordinary least squares models link augmentation parameters to performance for each architecture. Across both models, Gaussian blur exerts a strong negative effect (p < 0.001), indicating that low-pass filtering suppresses high-frequency structure that is informative for material discrimination. Independent pixel-wise noise is likewise harmful (p = 0.003 for EfficientNet-B0 and p = 0.001 for ResNet18), consistent with disruption of local spatial coherence. In contrast, spatially correlated perturbations yield significant positive coefficients (p = 0.004 for EfficientNet-B0 and p = 0.001 for ResNet18), showing that variability can improve robustness when it preserves speckle organization. The fitted models explain a substantial fraction of performance variation (R2 = 0.796 for EfficientNet-B0 and R2 = 0.879 for ResNet18). These results show that, in laser speckle imaging, augmentation effectiveness is determined primarily by structural preservation rather than perturbation magnitude. The findings motivate physics-aware augmentation design for coherent optical sensing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据增强对基于激光散斑（laser speckle）材料分类的影响，发现结构保持比扰动幅度更关键。在SensiCut数据集上使用ResNet18和EfficientNet-B0进行参数化增强实验，通过普通最小二乘回归分析各增强参数与性能的关系。
Motivation: 标准数据增强策略的假设不适用于相干成像，激光散斑的判别信息由结构化随机统计承载，需要物理感知的增强设计。
Method: 采用包含旋转、高斯模糊、独立高斯噪声、空间相关散斑噪声、强度抖动和空间掩蔽的参数化增强框架，训练ResNet18和EfficientNet-B0，并用普通最小二乘模型将增强参数与宏F1分数关联。
Result: 高斯模糊和独立像素噪声显著有害（p<0.001），空间相关扰动显著有益（p<0.01）；回归模型R²分别为0.796和0.879。
Conclusion: 在激光散斑成像中，增强效果由结构保持主导，而非扰动幅度，为相干光传感的物理感知增强设计提供依据。

papers.title: Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon tasks, this comparison can suffer from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy while useful state-changing actions remain under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where outcome rewards provide no direction for correcting the policy. Together, these effects can form a self-reinforcing credit trap: failure-dominated sampling yields no outcome-based correction, allowing repeated low-effect actions to persist. To break this loop, we propose Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (ProGPO), which uses first-visit observation coverage only when all samples in a group receive zero outcome reward. Specifically, within such groups, ProGPO assigns higher relative advantages to trajectories or steps that visit more new states since reaching new observations is a prerequisite for task success. Experiments on two challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5/7B-Instruct, show that ProGPO consistently improves over group-based baselines, with particularly large gains on hard tasks.

papers.title: Visual Information Extraction from Documents via Classification-Guided Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual information extraction (VIE) from visually rich documents remains challenging due to high layout variability and real-world impairments. Existing methods typically rely on sequential OCR pipelines or end-to-end models requiring extensive labeled data and layout-specific training, limiting their scalability.We propose a classification-guided large vision-language model (LVLM) framework for multi-type VIE that achieves high accuracy with minimal supervision. The approach decouples document-type classification from content extraction and employs in-context learning (ICL)-based dynamic prompt engineering to inject task-specific knowledge, enabling robust zero-shot inference across diverse layouts. From a theoretical perspective, the proposed method can be viewed as a form of conditional computation that reduces task uncertainty and improves information efficiency during prompt-based inference. Evaluated on a real-world bidding dataset with 16 certificate types, our zero-shot method (based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B) outperforms a strong supervised baseline by 18.35 percentage points in F1-score (86.43\% vs. 68.08\%) and 0.23 in normalized edit distance (0.90 vs. 0.67). Optional domain-specific fine-tuning further improves performance to 93.65\% F1 and 0.93 NED, demonstrating superior robustness against seals, watermarks, and low contrast. The framework offers an efficient, scalable solution for complex document understanding in office automation. Code is available at https://github.com/FairmeHIT/Multi-VIE, and fine-tuned models at https://huggingface.co/fairme/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-SFT.
papers.journal_ref: Scientific Reports 16, 14158 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分类引导的大视觉语言模型（LVLM）框架，用于从视觉丰富的文档中提取信息。该方法将文档类型分类与内容提取解耦，并通过基于上下文学习（ICL）的动态提示工程注入任务知识，实现零样本推理。在包含16种证书类型的真实投标数据集上，基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B的零样本方法在F1分数上比强监督基线高出18.35个百分点（86.43% vs 68.08%），归一化编辑距离提升0.23（0.90 vs 0.67）。领域微调后F1达到93.65%，NED达到0.93，对印章、水印和低对比度具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有文档视觉信息提取方法依赖顺序OCR流水线或需要大量标注数据和布局特定训练的端到端模型，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 提出分类引导的LVLM框架，解耦文档类型分类和内容提取，并采用基于ICL的动态提示工程设计，实现跨布局的鲁棒零样本推理。
Result: 在16种证书类型的真实投标数据集上，零样本方法（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）F1分数86.43%，超过监督基线68.08%；NED 0.90 vs 0.67。领域微调后F1达93.65%，NED 0.93。
Conclusion: 该框架为办公自动化中的复杂文档理解提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案，代码和模型已公开。

papers.title: A New Kind of Adversarial Example: Measuring the Human-Model Gap, and Its Relationship to OOD Detection
papers.abstract_en: Almost all adversarial attacks add an imperceptible perturbation to fool a model. We instead study the opposite: a large, clearly visible perturbation that causes the model to keep its original, correct prediction, even though a human would no longer recognize the image. Prior work showed such examples can be generated at scale but left three questions untested: whether humans really perform worse than the model, whether standard out-of-distribution (OOD) detection and calibration tools catch it, and whether existing defenses mitigate it. We answer all three on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. (i) An independent recognizer proxy drops to ~49% on CIFAR-10 while the model stays at 100% -- a gap a small human pilot (N=5) corroborates directly and that is not explained by signal loss (a matched-magnitude Gaussian control degrades recognizability faster); a CLIP zero-shot proxy confirms the gap at ImageNet scale too. (ii) Confidence- and energy-based OOD detectors and calibration are structurally blind (0% detection, ECE ~= 0), while a feature-space Mahalanobis detector flags 100% -- but is evaded by an adaptive attacker at no cost to success. (iii) No classical defense, including adversarial training (45% robust accuracy), reduces attack success (correlation with large-epsilon_l resistance r ~= 0). A mechanistic analysis further shows the attack destroys low-level texture far faster than edge/shape structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了一种新型对抗性样本：施加明显可见的大扰动，使模型保持正确预测，而人类无法识别图像。在MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet上验证了人类与模型之间存在巨大性能差距（CIFAR-10上人类代理约49%，模型100%），发现置信度和能量基OOD检测完全失效（0%检测），马氏距离检测可达100%但可被自适应攻击绕过，且经典对抗训练等防御无法降低攻击成功率。
Motivation: 已有工作可生成此类大规模可见扰动样本，但未回答三个关键问题：人类是否确实比模型表现更差？标准OOD检测和校准工具能否检测？现有防御能否缓解？
Method: 通过独立识别代理、小规模人类实验（N=5）和CLIP零样本代理量化人类-模型差距；测试了置信度、能量基、马氏距离三种OOD检测器及校准工具；评估了对抗训练等经典防御，并进行机理分析。
Result: CIFAR-10上模型保持100%正确率，人类代理降至约49%（人类实验直接证实）；高斯控制实验排除信号损失解释；CLIP在ImageNet上复现差距。OOD检测方面，置信度和能量基检测完全无效（0%检测，ECE≈0），马氏距离检测100%但可被自适应攻击绕过且攻击成功率不变。所有经典防御（包括对抗训练，稳健精度45%）均无法降低攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 该对抗性样本揭示了人类与模型在视觉识别上的显著差距，现有OOD检测和防御体系对此存在结构性盲点，需要新的检测与防御策略。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Symbolic Security Protocol Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Security protocol verification relies on formal tools such as ProVerif and OFMC. This study evaluates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform comparable analysis. We test GPT and DeepSeek in chat and reasoning modes over three runs on 130 obfuscated AnB/AnBx protocols covering 388 security goals, scored against ProVerif and OFMC. Chat models reach 69 to 81% recall at precision below 31%. Reasoning models reverse this trade-off, reaching 66.5% precision for GPT and 45.4% for DeepSeek, but detect just over half the attacks. DeepSeek's two modes share one underlying model, so the comparison isolates reasoning itself, which raises precision from 27.2% to 45.4%. The GPT contrast spans a model-version change and is only suggestive. All models perform worst on authentication goals: reasoning models detect well under half of injective and non-injective agreement attacks, whereas chat models over-flag them at low precision. Confidentiality is the exception, with F1 up to 95.7% in reasoning mode. Verdicts are unstable across runs, identical on 89.7% of goals for GPT but 74.0% for DeepSeek. Self-reported confidence is uniformly high yet shows no meaningful correlation with correctness. On this benchmark LLMs do not match formal verification, but may serve, at best, as pre-screening filters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估大型语言模型（LLM）在符号安全协议分析中的能力，测试了GPT和DeepSeek在聊天和推理模式下对130个混淆AnB/AnBx协议（涵盖388个安全目标）的性能，并与ProVerif和OFMC进行比较。结果显示，聊天模型召回率较高但精度低，推理模型精度提升但漏检较多攻击，且所有模型表现不稳定，无法匹配形式化验证，最多作为预筛选工具。
Motivation: 安全协议验证依赖ProVerif和OFMC等正式工具，本文探索LLM能否进行类似的分析。
Method: 在聊天和推理模式下测试GPT和DeepSeek，对130个混淆AnB/AnBx协议（388个安全目标）进行三次运行，以ProVerif和OFMC为基准。
Result: 聊天模型召回率69%-81%，精度低于31%；推理模型GPT精度66.5%，DeepSeek精度45.4%，但仅检测到一半多攻击。认证目标上表现最差，保密性例外（F1高达95.7%）。模型不一致且自信度与正确性无相关性。
Conclusion: LLM无法匹配形式化验证，最多可作预筛选过滤器。

papers.title: A Fixed-Effects Causal Forest for Staggered Adoption, with an Application to Medicaid Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Difference-in-differences with staggered adoption identifies group-time average treatment effects ATT(g,t) by comparing each cohort to units not yet treated, which avoids the "forbidden comparisons" that bias two-way fixed-effects estimators when effects are heterogeneous. This paper studies the covariate-conditional version of that object, tau_{g,t}(x), and estimates it with a fixed-effects causal forest. Within each (g,t) comparison block, the outcome and treatment are residualized on unit and period fixed effects inside each tree node, and honest causal trees split on treatment-effect heterogeneity in the covariates. The estimand is not new: Hatamyar, Kreif, Rocha and Huber (2023) introduced it using a doubly-robust R-learner, and Imai, Qin and Yanagi (2023) study it for a single continuous covariate. What we add is a different way to estimate it. Where those methods remove confounding by modeling nuisance functions, we remove it by differencing out unit and period effects within each tree node, following the fixed-effects residualization of Kattenberg, Scheer and Thiel (2023) and Gavrilova, Langorgen and Zoutman (2025) and carrying it into the Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time structure. In Monte Carlo experiments the estimator is the only forest-based method that stays unbiased and correctly covered for the overall effect under staggered timing with cohort-varying effects; two-way fixed effects and a pooled causal forest inherit large forbidden-comparison bias. We apply the method to the Callaway-Sant'Anna minimum-wage panel as a validation and to the staggered county-level rollout of the ACA Medicaid expansion, where it recovers an average 2.25 percentage-point fall in the uninsured rate and a conditional surface on which poorer and lower-income counties gained substantially more coverage -- heterogeneity measured along socioeconomic covariates that are not lags of the outcome.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. JEL: C14, C21, C23, I13, J38
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究交错采用处理下的条件平均处理效应，提出固定效应因果森林（fixed-effects causal forest）方法。该方法在Callaway-Sant'Anna分组-时间框架中，通过单元和时期固定效应残差化消除混淆，避免双向固定效应估计量在有异质性处理效应时的“禁止比较”偏误。蒙特卡洛实验表明该估计量在交错时序和群组异质性效应下保持无偏和正确覆盖，应用于ACA医疗补助扩展发现未参保率平均下降2.25个百分点，且较贫困县受益更大。
Motivation: 传统双向固定效应估计量在处理效应异质性时因“禁止比较”而有偏，而现有因果森林方法未充分利用交错采用结构。本文旨在提供一种无需估计 nuisance 函数、通过固定效应残差化消除混淆的估计方法。
Method: 提出固定效应因果森林，在每个(处理组, 时间)比较块内，在每个树节点对结果和处理变量进行单元和时期固定效应残差化，并使用诚实因果树（honest causal tree）基于协变量处理效应异质性进行分裂，从而估计条件平均处理效应 τ_{g,t}(x)。
Result: 蒙特卡洛实验中，该估计量是唯一在交错时序和群组效应异质性下保持无偏和正确覆盖的森林方法；双向固定效应和池化因果森林存在较大禁止比较偏误。实际应用中，ACA医疗补助扩展导致未参保率平均下降2.25个百分点，且较贫穷、收入较低的县覆盖增加更多。
Conclusion: 固定效应因果森林为交错采用设计下的异质性处理效应估计提供了一种有效工具，通过固定效应残差化消除了对 nuisance 函数建模的需求，且在模拟和实际数据中表现良好。

summary_sections.result: 蒙特卡洛实验中，该估计量是唯一在交错时序和群组效应异质性下保持无偏和正确覆盖的森林方法；双向固定效应和池化因果森林存在较大禁止比较偏误。实际应用中，ACA医疗补助扩展导致未参保率平均下降2.25个百分点，且较贫穷、收入较低的县覆盖增加更多。
summary_sections.conclusion: 固定效应因果森林为交错采用设计下的异质性处理效应估计提供了一种有效工具，通过固定效应残差化消除了对 nuisance 函数建模的需求，且在模拟和实际数据中表现良好。

papers.title: An Interactive Vision Language Platform for Cognitive Remediation in Schizophrenia
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive remediation tasks often require patients to perform structured actions involving object manipulation and sequential reasoning. For patients diagnosed with schizophrenia, these tasks are crucial for addressing severe cognitive deficits. However, evaluating the correctness of these physical actions generally relies on manual observation by clinicians, which introduces subjectivity and limits the scalability of therapeutic interventions. In this paper, we propose an automated framework based on Vision-Language Models for action verification in cognitive remediation tasks tailored for schizophrenia rehabilitation. The proposed system relies on a camera-monitored tabletop environment composed of structured miniature scenes including roads, a roundabout, a park, and toy vehicles. Patients receive audio instructions describing goal-oriented spatial actions to perform by manipulating a toy vehicle. These interactive physical activities are specifically designed to stimulate targeted cognitive functions, such as sustained attention, motor coordination, spatial navigation, and cognitive flexibility. To verify the correctness of the performed actions without requiring continuous clinical oversight, the system analyzes the video feed tracking the patient's hand and toy movements. A fine-tuned Vision-Language Model interprets the recorded video sequences and generates semantic descriptions of the observed activities, enabling high-level verification of the executed actions with respect to the initial textual instructions. A dedicated dataset of 4634 tabletop cognitive remediation video scenarios was collected to evaluate the proposed approach. Experimental results demonstrate that our specialized framework effectively bridges low-level physical telemetry with high-level clinical feedback, presenting a scalable and objective solution for advanced cognitive rehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对精神分裂症患者的认知修复任务，提出一个基于视觉语言模型的自动化动作验证框架。系统通过摄像头监控桌面环境，患者根据音频指令操作玩具车，模型分析视频流并生成语义描述以验证动作正确性。在4634个视频场景数据集上评估，结果表明该方法可桥接低层物理遥测与高层临床反馈，提供可扩展的客观康复方案。
Motivation: 当前认知修复任务中，评估患者动作正确性依赖临床医生手动观察，存在主观性且限制干预的可扩展性，需要自动化客观评估方法。
Method: 构建一个包含道路、环岛等微型场景的桌面环境，患者按音频指令操控玩具车；系统通过摄像头追踪手和玩具运动，微调视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model）解析视频序列并生成语义描述，与初始文本指令进行高层次验证。
Result: 摘要报告在自主收集的4634个桌面认知修复视频场景上，该框架能有效实现动作验证，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 本文展示了一种无需持续临床监督的自动化动作验证方法，可用于精神分裂症患者的认知康复，具有客观性和可扩展性。

papers.title: CausalGate: Causal Importance Distillation for Transformer Module Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Existing adaptive inference methods for Large Language Models rely on observational heuristics, such as hidden-state similarity or activation magnitudes, to drop redundant modules. However, these correlation-based metrics often fail to capture subtle, non-linear structural computations vital for semantic accuracy. We introduce CausalGate, an intervention-guided framework for compute-efficient transformer inference. During a calibration phase, CausalGate isolates individual Attention and MLP sub-layers, zeros out their respective outputs, and measures the exact semantic damage via the Kullback-Leibler divergence of the final logit distribution. To eliminate runtime routing overhead, this structural importance hierarchy is distilled into a global set of static, lightweight scalar gates using an Exponential Moving Average smoothing objective paired with a differentiable pairwise ranking loss. Evaluated on TinyLlama-1.1B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Llama-3.1-8B across language modeling and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, CausalGate consistently outperforms prominent dynamic routing and layer-skipping baselines, translating theoretical compute savings into concrete hardware latency reductions with zero operational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CausalGate，一种用于Transformer模块剪枝的因果重要性蒸馏框架。通过在校准阶段对每个Attention和MLP子层进行干预（输出置零）并测量最终logit分布的KL散度，CausalGate能精确量化各子层的结构重要性。随后将该重要性层次蒸馏为一组静态标量门，实现运行时零开销的模块剪枝。在多个LLM（TinyLlama-1.1B等）上的实验表明，CausalGate优于现有的动态路由和跳层基线，将理论计算节省转化为实际硬件延迟降低。
Motivation: 现有自适应推理方法基于观察启发式（如隐藏状态相似性）来丢弃冗余模块，但这些相关性指标未能捕捉对语义准确性至关重要的非线性结构计算，导致剪枝可能损伤模型性能。
Method: 提出干预引导框架CausalGate：校准阶段隔离并置零每个子层的输出，用KL散度衡量语义损伤；然后通过指数移动平均平滑和目标可微分成对排序损失，将重要性层次蒸馏为一组静态标量门，消除运行时路由开销。
Result: 在TinyLlama-1.1B、Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.1-8B上，CausalGate优于动态路由和跳层基线，将理论计算节省转化为零操作开销的硬件延迟降低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调CausalGate通过因果干预和蒸馏实现了高效的模块剪枝，在多种LLM上验证了其有效性，且运行时无额外开销。

papers.title: $γ$-Bridge: A Look-Parametric Diffusion Bridge
papers.abstract_en: Multiplicative Gamma noise is a signal-dependent degradation in coherent imaging; synthetic aperture radar (SAR) despeckling is its most prominent real-world instance. Existing diffusion denoisers parameterize their forward process by abstract signal-to-noise schedules rather than by the physical look number $L$, so different deployment scenarios typically require separately trained models, and transfer from synthetic Gamma training to real SAR remains challenging without clean ground truth. We introduce $γ$-Bridge, a look-parametric bridge whose schedule $L(t)$ connects the noisy observation at $L_{obs}$ to the clean limit through exact multiplicative Gamma marginals. Its closed-form Gamma--Lévy reverse posterior admits both stochastic and deterministic processes, while observation conditioning and a two-step consistency loss stabilize multi-step inference in the low-SNR single-look regime. Because bridge time directly represents $L$, one conditioned network can smart-start from any admissible input look and stop at a target look number. These two orthogonal controls enable zero-shot restoration over the full admissible grid after training only at $L_{obs} = 1$ on natural images with synthetic Gamma corruption. Combined with a homogeneous-patch look estimator, $γ$-Bridge processes data from six spaceborne and airborne SAR sensors without sensor-specific fine-tuning, achieving leading results on standard synthetic benchmarks while providing physically interpretable input and output controls absent from prior denoisers. Codes are released \href{https://github.com/Teriri1999/GammaBridge}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出γ-Bridge，一种面向乘性Gamma噪声的参量化扩散桥，其时间调度直接对应物理视数L，支持从任意输入视数到目标视数的零样本恢复，在SAR图像去斑中取得领先效果。
Motivation: 现有扩散去噪器使用抽象信噪比调度而非物理视数L，导致不同场景需单独训练，且从合成Gamma数据迁移到真实SAR困难。
Method: 提出γ-Bridge，其调度L(t)连接噪声观测到干净极限，具有闭式Gamma-Lévy逆后验，支持随机和确定性过程，通过观测条件和两步一致性损失稳定低SNR单视推断。网络可在L_obs=1训练后，对任意输入视数进行零样本恢复，并结合同质块视数估计器处理多传感器数据。
Result: 在六个星载和机载SAR传感器上无需传感器特定微调，在标准合成基准上达到领先结果，并提供物理可解释的输入输出控制。
Conclusion: γ-Bridge通过物理驱动的调度和零样本能力，改进了SAR去斑的泛化性和可解释性。

papers.title: DAMamba-UNet3D: A Parameter-Efficient Mamba State Space U-Net with Dynamic Adaptive Scan for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: We propose parameter-efficient SSM-based U-Net architectures for 3D medical image segmentation. Convolutional U-Nets afford O(n) local mixing per layer but lack explicit global context; transformers provide global reasoning at O(n^2) cost in sequence length $n$. State-space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, offer $O(n)$ global propagation per block. Yet, existing medical SSM segmenters rely on fixed scan patterns and large parameter budgets. Dynamic Adaptive Scan (DAS), which learns data-dependent reordering before selective scan, has not been applied to medical imaging or extended to 3D volumes. We propose DAMamba-UNet3D, a hybrid encoder-decoder that integrates tri-plane 3D-DAS blocks at encoder stages E2-E4 while retaining convolutions elsewhere (~5.3M parameters). On BraTS 2020 five-fold cross-validation, DAMamba-UNet3D achieves mean Dice 0.815+/-0.013 (full-volume per-case evaluation) at ~13x lower parameter cost than SegMamba (0.824+\-0.014, ~70M). At comparable scale, DAMamba-L (~70M), a wide DAS-native variant with encoder-only DAMamba and a convolutional bottleneck, reaches 0.829+\-0.012, surpassing retrained SegMamba by 0.5pt. Component ablations show that encoder-only DAS placement is critical as bottleneck and decoder SSM blocks lower Dice. Together, the results suggest that learned tri-plane DAS in a hybrid U-Net is competitive with, and under our large-scale design may improve upon, SegMamba's fixed Tri-orientated Mamba (ToM) scanning on BraTS 2020. Code: https://github.com/marafathussain/DAMamba-UNet3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于状态空间模型 (SSM) 的参数高效 U-Net 架构 DAMamba-UNet3D，用于 3D 医学图像分割。该方法在编码器阶段引入三元平面动态自适应扫描 (tri-plane 3D-DAS) 模块，其余部分保留卷积，总参数量约 5.3M。在 BraTS 2020 五折交叉验证中，模型全体积逐例评估的平均 Dice 为 0.815±0.013，参数量仅为 SegMamba (约 70M, Dice 0.824) 的约 1/13；扩大模型 DAMamba-L (约 70M) 达到 Dice 0.829±0.012，超越重新训练的 SegMamba 0.5 个百分点。消融实验表明，仅在编码器放置 DAS 至关重要，瓶颈和解码器中的 SSM 模块会降低 Dice。
Motivation: 现有医学图像分割中的 SSM 方法（如 Mamba）依赖固定扫描模式且参数量大，缺乏数据依赖的动态扫描机制。
Method: 提出混合编码器-解码器架构：编码器阶段 E2-E4 集成三元平面 3D-DAS 模块，其余部分保留卷积；总参数量约 5.3M。通过基于注意力的三轴排序实现动态扫描。
Result: 在 BraTS 2020 上，DAMamba-UNet3D (5.3M) 达到平均 Dice 0.815，参数量为 SegMamba (70M, Dice 0.824) 的 1/13；扩大模型 DAMamba-L (70M) 达到 Dice 0.829，超越 SegMamba。消融证实编码器 DAS 是关键。
Conclusion: 学习型三元平面 DAS 在混合 U-Net 中与 SegMamba 的固定 Tri-orientated Mamba (ToM) 扫描具有竞争力，且大尺度设计可取得更优结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TOM-GS: Editable Video Representation via Temporal Opacity Modulation of Static 3D Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: While Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) and dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieve impressive results in video processing, they often fall short of producing representations that are easily editable. Recent methods address this by introducing complex spatial deformations or folded distributions, which constrain optimization and reduce flexibility for downstream editing. In this paper, we introduce TOM-GS, an editable video representation that forgoes complex deformations in favor of regular 3D Gaussians equipped with a continuous temporal opacity formulation. By assigning a learnable temporal mean and scale to the opacity of each Gaussian, our model enables static 3D spatial components to fade smoothly in and out of the scene. Grounded by robust, off-the-shelf pose estimation, our approach maintains a static spatial geometry that naturally supports a wide range of manual and physics-based edits. TOM-GS outperforms prior editable video representations in visual fidelity, while its reliance on standard 3D Gaussians ensures seamless compatibility with established 3D editing tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TOM-GS，一种可编辑视频表示方法，通过为每个3D高斯的透明度分配可学习的时序均值和尺度，使静态空间组件能平滑淡入淡出，避免复杂形变。该方法基于现成的姿态估计，保持静态空间几何，支持手动和基于物理的编辑，在视觉保真度上优于此前可编辑视频表示。
Motivation: 现有隐式神经表示和动态3D高斯泼溅在视频处理中难以生成易于编辑的表示，近期方法引入复杂空间形变或折叠分布，限制了优化和编辑灵活性。
Method: TOM-GS使用带有连续时序透明度公式的规则3D高斯，每个高斯的透明度具有可学习的时序均值和尺度，从而实现静态3D空间分量的平滑淡入淡出，并依赖现成的姿态估计保持静态空间几何。
Result: 在视觉保真度上超越先前的可编辑视频表示方法，且与标准3D编辑工具无缝兼容。
Conclusion: TOM-GS通过简单的透明度时序调制替代复杂形变，实现了高效且灵活的视频编辑，但具体性能和局限性需进一步验证。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在视觉保真度上超越先前的可编辑视频表示方法，且与标准3D编辑工具无缝兼容。
summary_sections.conclusion: TOM-GS通过简单的透明度时序调制替代复杂形变，实现了高效且灵活的视频编辑，但具体性能和局限性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Visual Token Compression Enhances Robustness of MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we show for the first time that visual token pruning enhances the robustness of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), mitigating vulnerabilities such as jailbreak attacks and hallucinations. Given that vision and language modalities cannot be perfectly aligned, the misaligned visual tokens might act as out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, leading to unpredictable outputs and introducing potential vulnerabilities. Building on this insight, we aim to enhance model robustness against jailbreaks and hallucinations by reducing OOD visual tokens at robust-pruning layers, while also reducing inference cost as a side benefit. Specifically, we measure the distance between each visual token and the language feature space. Then, visual tokens with large distances are identified as OOD tokens, which can be iteratively pruned. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, we evaluate it on seven diverse popular benchmarks. Notably, our method yields an average improvement of 13.29\% in defending jailbreak attacks, consistently achieves competitive performance in mitigating hallucinations, and maintains strong results on general datasets like MME.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 16 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. Code: https://github.com/Eurek001/OOD-VTP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次证明视觉token剪枝（visual token pruning）能够增强多模态大模型（MLLMs）的鲁棒性，缓解越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）和幻觉（hallucinations）等脆弱性。通过测量视觉token与语言特征空间的分布外（OOD）距离，迭代剪除高距离的OOD token，在七个基准上平均提升13.29%的越狱防御性能，同时保持甚至提升通用多模态任务表现。
Motivation: 视觉与语言模态无法完美对齐，未对齐的视觉token可能作为分布外（OOD）输入引入模型脆弱性，导致越狱攻击和幻觉。现有方法未从该角度系统研究视觉token剪枝对鲁棒性的影响。
Method: 针对视觉token，计算每个token与语言特征空间的距离，将距离大的token识别为OOD token，并在鲁棒剪枝层（robust-pruning layers）中迭代剪除这些OOD token，同时降低推理成本。
Result: 在七个多样化基准上，平均防御越狱攻击性能提升13.29%，在缓解幻觉任务上达到有竞争力效果，并在MME等通用数据集上保持强结果。
Conclusion: 通过剪除OOD视觉token可以有效提升MLLMs对越狱攻击和幻觉的鲁棒性，同时降低推理开销。

papers.title: Child-Oriented AIGC Video Risk Reviewing: A Benchmark and Knowledge-Supported Iterative Reasoning Framework
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence-generated content (AIGC) is reshaping video production and circulation, exposing children to an increasing volume of AIGC videos. Unlike traditionally produced videos, AIGC videos often exhibit greater uncertainty in visual details, narrative coherence, and content expression, which may introduce developmentally inappropriate risks for children. However, existing video safety research is largely designed for general violation detection from an adult perspective and remains insufficient for identifying the fine-grained, implicit, and context-dependent risks that children may encounter when viewing AIGC videos. To address this gap, we study child-oriented AIGC video reviewing, making three contributions. First, we construct CAVSR, a benchmark of 605 real-world videos collected from multiple platforms, and develop a hierarchical risk taxonomy comprising 6 top-level categories and 26 fine-grained labels to support systematic evaluation of children's viewing risks. Second, we propose QVRS-E, a knowledge- and experience-augmented video reviewing framework that combines multi-agent collaboration with expert and experiential knowledge to support targeted evidence acquisition and fact-grounded reviewing decisions. Third, extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the reviewing of child-related risks integrated with vision-language models, and yields more robust review reports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AIGC视频对儿童可能带来的风险，构建了包含605个真实视频的基准CAVSR，并提出了一个基于知识和经验的多智能体协作审阅框架QVRS-E，显著提升了儿童相关风险的审查效果。
Motivation: 现有视频安全研究主要面向成人视角的通用违规检测，难以识别儿童观看AIGC视频时可能遇到的细粒度、隐含且依赖上下文的发育不适当风险。
Method: 构建了包含6个顶级类别和26个细粒度标签的分层风险分类体系，并提出QVRS-E框架，结合多智能体协作与专家及经验知识，支持目标性证据获取和基于事实的审阅决策。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在结合视觉语言模型进行儿童相关风险审查时显著提升了效果，并生成更稳健的审阅报告。
Conclusion: 本研究为儿童AIGC视频安全审阅提供了基准和方法，但可能仅限于儿童相关风险，且依赖于知识库的质量。

papers.title: Real-Time Semantic Segmentation with Optimized RetinaNet Architectures for Embedded Automotive Systems
papers.abstract_en: Real-time perception is a foundational requirement for advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous vehicles, yet embedded automotive platforms impose severe constraints on compute, memory, and power. This paper presents an optimized semantic segmentation architecture derived from the RetinaNet detection framework, adapted for dense pixel-wise prediction and tailored for deployment on resource-constrained embedded hardware. The proposed architecture, termed Opt-RetinaSeg, replaces the standard ResNet-50 backbone with a hybrid lightweight feature extractor, restructures the Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) to reduce redundant multi-scale computation, and introduces a compact segmentation head guided by focal-loss-inspired class balancing to address the severe foreground-background imbalance common in road scenes. We further apply a three-stage optimization pipeline consisting of structured channel pruning, post-training INT8 quantization, and knowledge distillation from a high-capacity teacher network. Evaluated on the Cityscapes and BDD100K datasets and deployed on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX and a Qualcomm QCS610 automotive SoC, the proposed model achieves 73.9% mIoU at 70.4 FPS, representing a 7.4x inference speedup and a 4x reduction in model size relative to the ResNet-50 baseline, with less than 3% accuracy degradation. These results indicate that RetinaNet-derived architectures, when systematically optimized, are viable candidates for real-time semantic segmentation in embedded automotive perception pipelines
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Opt-RetinaSeg，一种基于RetinaNet检测框架改造的实时语义分割架构，专为嵌入式汽车平台（如NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX和Qualcomm QCS610）优化。通过轻量级混合特征提取器、重构的特征金字塔网络（FPN）、聚焦损失类平衡的分割头，以及结构化剪枝、后训练INT8量化和知识蒸馏的三阶段优化流水线，在Cityscapes和BDD100K数据集上达到73.9% mIoU和70.4 FPS，相比ResNet-50基线加速7.4倍、模型缩小4倍且精度损失小于3%。
Motivation: 嵌入式汽车平台对计算、内存和功耗有严格限制，现有语义分割模型难以在满足实时性的同时保持高性能。
Method: 从RetinaNet检测框架出发，将骨干网络替换为轻量级混合特征提取器，重构FPN减少多尺度冗余计算，设计紧凑分割头并采用聚焦损失（focal loss）处理前景-背景不平衡；进一步应用结构化通道剪枝、INT8量化和知识蒸馏三阶段优化。
Result: 在Cityscapes和BDD100K上，Opt-RetinaSeg达到73.9% mIoU和70.4 FPS，模型大小和推理速度比ResNet-50基线分别减少4倍和提升7.4倍，精度损失低于3%。
Conclusion: 经过系统优化的RetinaNet衍生架构可作为嵌入式汽车感知流水线中实时语义分割的可行方案。

papers.title: SEGRA: Structured Experience-Guided Graph Reasoning Agent for Gremlin Based Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise IT support knowledge graphs capture rich relationships among cases, users, devices, symptoms, taxonomic categories, root causes, and historical resolutions. Yet querying them in Gremlin requires knowledge of graph schemas, traversal semantics, edge directionality, and property-graph-specific constraints, making them difficult for non-expert operators to use. We introduce SEGRA, an experience-guided agent for enterprise text-to-Gremlin question answering. SEGRA integrates intent routing, schema- and taxonomy-grounded query generation, multi-shot decomposition, execution-aware verification, and a curriculum-bootstrapped skill library that reuses verified query patterns. On an enterprise IT support benchmark, SEGRA achieves a $7.0\times$ higher mean judge score than backbone-only chain-of-thought prompting. Its skill library further reduces LLM calls by $20\%$ and dollar cost by $18\%$ relative to SEGRA without skills, while preserving answer quality. These results show that schema-grounded agent design and reusable execution experience improve both accuracy and efficiency for enterprise graph QA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEGRA，一种基于经验引导的智能体，用于将自然语言问题转换为Gremlin图查询，以支持企业IT支持知识图谱的问答。SEGRA整合了意图路由、模式与分类体系引导的查询生成、多步分解、执行感知验证以及课程引导的技能库（重用已验证的查询模式）。在企业IT支持基准上，SEGRA的平均评判分数比仅使用思维链提示的基线高7倍，技能库在保持答案质量的同时将LLM调用次数减少20%，成本降低18%。
Motivation: 现有企业IT支持知识图谱查询需要用户掌握图模式、遍历语义、边方向性等专业知识，非专家用户难以使用。因此需要一种能够自动将自然语言问题转换为Gremlin查询的系统。
Method: SEGRA采用结构化智能体设计，包括：意图路由模块、基于模式与分类体系的查询生成、多步分解策略、执行感知验证机制，以及课程引导的技能库（存储并重用已验证的查询模式）。
Result: 在企业IT支持基准上，SEGRA的平均评判分数比纯思维链提示基线高7.0倍；技能库进一步减少20%的LLM调用和18%的成本，同时保持答案质量。
Conclusion: 基于模式引导的智能体设计和可重用的执行经验可以显著提高企业图问答的准确性和效率。

papers.title: scMIR: a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation
authors: Renjie Zhou (1) ((1) Department of Biomedical Engineering
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
(2) College of Computer Science and Electronic Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell light microscopy images have become an important data source for characterizing cell phenotypes, but their complexity and heterogeneity pose challenges to high-throughput automated analysis. Existing representation learning methods mostly rely on task-oriented modeling, which is limited by specific datasets and predefined tasks, making them difficult to generalize across different cell types and microscopy modalities, and experimental conditions. Although general-purpose methods have improved the generalization ability of image representation in recent years, their limited utilization of experimental background and biological context information still poses challenges in complex phenotypic analysis. Here, we propose scMIR, a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation. By synergistically combining self-supervised image reconstruction with text-guided cross-modal alignment, scMIR can simultaneously encode morphological and biological semantic information in a unified representation space. scMIR is pre-trained on 207,957 image-text pairs, covering various cell types, microscopy modalities, and perturbation conditions. scMIR outperforms existing general models and task-oriented methods as systematically evaluated on various complex tasks using 16 benchmark datasets, including cell classification, clustering, phenotype inference, and batch effect correction tasks. Furthermore, scMIR shows a strong generalization ability across various tasks without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. With its unique advantages, we envision scMIR may promote the standardization and automation of high-throughput phenotyping workflows through supporting various downstream analysis tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 scMIR，一个面向单细胞光学显微镜图像的视觉-语言基础模型，通过自监督图像重建与文本引导的跨模态对齐，在统一表示空间中编码形态和生物学语义信息。模型在 207,957 个图像-文本对上预训练，覆盖多种细胞类型、显微镜模态和扰动条件，在 16 个基准数据集的分类、聚类、表型推断和批次效应校正任务上优于现有通用和任务导向方法，且无需微调即可泛化。
Motivation: 现有单细胞显微镜图像表示学习方法多依赖特定数据集和预定义任务，泛化能力差；通用方法对实验背景和生物学上下文信息利用有限，难以应对复杂表型分析。
Method: scMIR 采用视觉-语言架构，结合自监督图像重构（masked image modeling）和文本引导的跨模态对比学习，同时学习形态特征和生物学语义。
Result: 在 16 个基准数据集上，scMIR 在细胞分类、聚类、表型推断和批次效应校正等任务中均优于现有通用模型（如 ImageNet 预训练模型）和任务导向方法。
Conclusion: scMIR 作为一种通用基础模型，有望推动高通量表型分析流程的标准化和自动化，无需任务特定微调即可支持多种下游分析。

papers.title: CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM coding agents operate by constructing trajectories that accumulate reasoning, tool calls, and results to enable multi-step decision-making. However, the conventional append-only trajectory architecture found in practice tightly couples file-read actions with their observations, capturing snapshots that become permanently fixed in the chronological history. As files change through agent edits or concurrent human modifications, these snapshots become stale, causing reasoning errors and causing agents to redundantly re-read files, with each re-read appending yet another copy to the trajectory. To mitigate this, we propose CORVUS, a novel trajectory architecture that decouples file-read actions from their observations by maintaining a synchronized registry of relevant files and injecting only their current contents at each reasoning cycle. This structural change produces significantly lighter-weight trajectories that remain synchronized with the actual codebase state by construction, eliminating redundant file copies and stale snapshots that bloat conventional trajectories. We evaluated CORVUS on SWE- POLYBENCH_VERIFIED and SWE-BENCH PRO across four LLMs, achieving 9-50% reduction in average input tokens per task, 15-32% shorter final prompts, and up to 37% fewer reasoning cycles while maintaining comparable pass rates.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: CORVUS通过结构优化消除了冗余文件拷贝和过时快照，实现了更轻量且同步的轨迹，提升了LLM编码代理的效率。

papers.title: RMS@CC-MMD 2026: Multimodal Misogyny Detection via Geometric Interaction and Multi-View Consensus
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of internet memes has introduced new complexities to automated content moderation, particularly in detecting misogyny. Memes often rely on a semantic clash between visual and textual modalities, where hateful intent is implicit and culturally grounded. This paper presents GeoMVC (Geometric Interaction and Multi-View Consensus), developed for the CC-MMD Grand Challenge at ICMI 2026. To address the limitations of static feature concatenation, a Geometric Interaction Layer is proposed that models cross-modal alignment via Hadamard products and cosine similarity between frozen visual and textual embeddings. We further mitigate distribution shifts caused by noisy OCR and code-mixed transliteration through a Multi-View Consensus strategy, aggregating predictions across raw, length-filtered, and English-translated text views. The system achieved Rank 2 in the Malayalam partition (Macro F1: 0.892) and Rank 3 in the Chinese partition (Macro F1: 0.895) on Task A, while securing Rank 5 in the Tamil partition (Macro F1: 0.521). A detailed error analysis on the development partition highlights open challenges in modeling localized transliteration and code-mixed sarcasm across Dravidian and Chinese cultural contexts.
papers.comment: Accepted for the CC-MMD Grand Challenge at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了GeoMVC方法，用于ICMI 2026的CC-MMD多模态厌女检测挑战。该方法通过几何交互层（Hadamard积和余弦相似度）对齐视觉与文本嵌入，并采用多视角共识策略（聚合原始、长度过滤和英文翻译文本视图）来缓解OCR噪声和代码混合转写的分布偏移。在马来语、中文和泰米尔语分区上分别取得第2、第3和第5名。
Motivation: 互联网模因中的厌女检测因视觉与文本模态的语义冲突而困难，现有静态特征拼接方法不足以处理隐含的厌恶意图和文化背景。
Method: 提出GeoMVC：一是几何交互层，使用Hadamard积和余弦相似度对齐冻结的视觉和文本嵌入；二是多视角共识策略，聚合原始、长度过滤和英文翻译文本视图的预测以缓解分布偏移。
Result: 在CC-MMD挑战中，马来语分区Macro F1=0.892（第2名），中文分区Macro F1=0.895（第3名），泰米尔语分区Macro F1=0.521（第5名）。
Conclusion: 错误分析揭示了建模德拉维达语和中文文化语境中的本地化转写和代码混合讽刺仍是开放挑战。

papers.title: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
papers.abstract_en: Deploying a vision-language model with full UI understanding on end devices has long been trapped between accuracy and efficiency: on one side is the accuracy bar for OCR, screen understanding, visual question answering, and element grounding; on the other is the strict compute, memory, and power budget of mobile chips. Existing work either trades one for the other, or stops at simulation without real-device validation. We present StepX-Edge, a 0.9B-parameter on-device UI vision-language model that resolves this tension through three-layer co-design of architecture, training, and deployment. Architecturally, UI-aware Layered Visual Encoding (ULVE) and a Progressive Dimensionality Projection (PDP) connector target the extreme aspect ratios and fine-grained perception of screens, while standard full attention throughout ensures native compatibility with mainstream mobile NPU operators. For training, the five-stage StepX-Curriculum framework is designed around our observation of mutual-promotion effects among UI subtasks, so that all four capabilities grow synergistically under a tight parameter budget rather than interfering. For deployment, a module-wise differentiated two-stage PTQ-to-QAT quantization scheme keeps the post-quantization accuracy loss within 1%. StepX-Edge achieves the strongest overall UI understanding among <=1B models, surpassing all 2B-2.3B baselines on ScreenQA (88.76 F1) and Chinese OCRBench v2 (57.25), and matching 1.3B-2.3B general VLMs on RefCOCO (92.0%) and OCRBench v1 (831) with far fewer parameters. After W4A16+KV8 quantization, the model runs stably on Snapdragon 8 Gen5 devices with ~0.84 s TTFT, 98 tok/s decode, and 1.4 GB peak memory. We will open-source the training data, the full training recipe, and the quantization deployment pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StepX-Edge，一个 0.9B 参数的端上 UI 视觉语言模型，通过架构、训练和部署三层协同设计，解决了在移动设备上同时实现高精度 UI 理解和高效率的难题。在 ScreenQA、Chinese OCRBench v2 等基准上，该模型超越所有 <=1B 模型并匹配 2B-2.3B 模型，量化后可在骁龙 8 Gen5 上稳定运行。
Motivation: 现有端上 UI 视觉语言模型在精度与效率之间难以平衡，要么牺牲一方面，要么缺乏真实设备验证。
Method: 架构上提出 ULVE 和 PDP 处理屏幕极端长宽比与细粒度感知；训练上设计五阶段 StepX-Curriculum 框架利用 UI 子任务的相互促进；部署上采用模块化两阶段 PTQ-to-QAT 量化方案。
Result: 在 ScreenQA 上达 88.76 F1，Chinese OCRBench v2 上 57.25，RefCOCO 上 92.0%，OCRBench v1 上 831；量化后 TTFT 约 0.84s，解码速度 98 tok/s，峰值内存 1.4GB。
Conclusion: 论文将开源训练数据、完整训练配方和量化部署流水线。

papers.title: LowAux-RDNet: Low-Pass Residual Supervision with Scene-Balanced Real-World Training for Single-Image Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Single-image reflection removal aims to recover a clean transmission layer from one image captured through glass. We study an explicit decomposition pipeline built on RDNet and introduce LowAux, a training-only low-pass reflection auxiliary objective. The original residual target remains the main reflection supervision, while symmetrically filtered prediction and target provide a stable low-frequency constraint. We further incorporate scene-balanced real pairs from RRW to broaden real-scene coverage and improve cross-dataset generalization. To avoid evaluation discrepancies caused by model-specific resizing, padding, output quantization, and metric code, we build a unified public benchmark over CEILNet, Real20, Postcard, Objects, and Wild. Under the same evaluator, the proposed system obtains a five-dataset macro average of 27.546 dB PSNR, 0.9220 SSIM, 0.9751 NCC, and 0.004760 LMSE, achieving the highest macro-average PSNR, SSIM, and NCC and the lowest LMSE among the compared public checkpoints and internal variants. Per-dataset and qualitative analyses show that the main benefit is a more balanced performance across diverse reflection distributions, while clear semantic reflections in Postcard remain challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LowAux-RDNet，在 RDNet 分解框架上引入训练时使用的低通反射辅助损失（LowAux），通过对称滤波后的预测与目标提供低频约束，并结合 RRW 的场景平衡真实数据对提升跨数据集泛化。在包含 CEILNet、Real20、Postcard、Objects、Wild 的统一评测基准上，系统取得五数据集宏观平均 PSNR 27.546 dB、SSIM 0.9220、NCC 0.9751、LMSE 0.004760，在公开模型和内部变体中均为最高宏观平均 PSNR、SSIM、NCC 和最低 LMSE。定性分析显示主要收益是更平衡的反射分布表现，但 Postcard 中的清晰语义反射仍有挑战。
Motivation: 单图像反射去除中现有方法在多样反射分布下性能不均衡，且因模型特定的尺寸调整、填充、量化及评估代码差异导致比较不一致。
Method: 基于 RDNet 的显式分解流水线，加一个仅训练时使用的低通反射辅助目标（LowAux）：原始残差目标为反射主监督，对称滤波后的预测与目标提供低频约束；同时引入场景平衡的真实数据对（RRW）以扩展真实场景覆盖。
Result: 在统一基准上（CEILNet、Real20、Postcard、Objects、Wild），系统宏观平均 PSNR 27.546 dB、SSIM 0.9220、NCC 0.9751、LMSE 0.004760，均为五种比较变体中的最优值。
Conclusion: 所提方法能更平衡地处理不同反射分布，但处理清晰语义反射（如 Postcard）仍有困难。

papers.title: MPR-CiteG: Enhancing RAG with Multi-Portfolio Retrieval and Citation-Grounded Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the MPR-CiteG framework, which achieved second place in the ScienceON AI Challenge by addressing two fundamental challenges in generative AI: inefficient retrieval and the absence of source verification. We propose a dual-component system, termed MPR-CiteG, in which the Multi-Portfolio Retriever (MPR) efficiently retrieves diverse and relevant information, while the Citation-Grounded Generation (CiteG) module ensures that every generated output remains factually consistent and explicitly attributed to its source. MPR-CiteG represents a significant step toward building more trustworthy and accurate LLMs that are not only capable of generating information but also of grounding their responses in reliable evidence, thereby mitigating common issues like model hallucination. Extensive experiments on the challenge dataset validate the effectiveness and reliability of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/2noweyh/MPR-citeG.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. The 1st International Workshop on Retrieval-Driven Generative AI & ScienceON AI Challenge 2025@CIKM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MPR-CiteG框架，在ScienceON AI Challenge中取得第二名成绩，旨在解决生成式AI中检索效率低下和缺乏来源验证两大问题。该框架由多组合检索器（MPR）和引用生成模块（CiteG）组成，前者高效检索多样相关信息，后者确保生成内容的事实一致性和显式来源归属。在挑战数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有生成式AI模型在检索相关信息和提供可验证来源方面存在不足，导致模型幻觉问题。
Method: 提出双组件系统：Multi-Portfolio Retriever（MPR）负责高效检索多样相关信息，Citation-Grounded Generation（CiteG）模块确保生成输出事实一致且明确标注来源。
Result: 在ScienceON AI Challenge数据集上的实验验证了框架的有效性和可靠性。
Conclusion: MPR-CiteG是构建更可信、更准确的大语言模型的重要一步，能缓解幻觉问题，并支持基于可靠证据的生成。
