papers.title: EditCLEVR: A Paired-Scene Intervention Benchmark for Compositional Faithfulness of Object-Centric Representations
papers.abstract_en: Object-centric learning aims to represent scenes as objects whose properties can be reused in new combinations. Existing evaluations usually score segmentation, single-image factor prediction, or downstream accuracy, but these tests do not directly ask whether a per-object representation behaves correctly under a controlled semantic edit. We introduce EditCLEVR, a paired-scene intervention benchmark in which each example contains a before/after pair of CLEVR-style renders with the same object indices and scene layout, and either exactly one known attribute change on one known object or a no-edit re-render for drift measurement. The protocol includes probe-free diagnostics for representation-change localization and stability, together with probe-decoded semantic faithfulness metrics that test whether the predicted scene change matches the intended intervention across in-distribution and compositional out-of-distribution (OOD) suites, allowing code-space movement and decoded object-attribute correctness to be evaluated separately. We introduce the semantic metric Scene-Graph Intervention Accuracy (SGIA), which requires the full after-scene prediction to be correct and the only predicted before-to-after semantic change to be the intended object-factor edit. We also establish Delta-SGIA as a companion diagnostic that checks the single-site change pattern without requiring the full after-scene graph to be correct. Baseline evaluations on ground-truth-mask backbones, learned-slot models, SAM 2 + frozen-ViT models, and one mask-feature hybrid indicate that CoGenT-OOD-core degradation can persist under ground-truth instance masks, that mask source accounts for part but not all of native performance, and that locality or stability alone can overstate semantic faithfulness. Code is available at https://github.com/torux-bughunter/EditCLEVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EditCLEVR，一个成对场景干预基准，用于评估对象中心表征的组合忠实性。每个样本包含前后成对的CLEVR风格渲染图，通过已知属性变化或无编辑重渲染来测试表征变化定位、稳定性以及语义忠实性。引入了场景图干预准确率（SGIA）和Delta-SGIA指标。基线实验表明，在ground-truth掩码骨干、学习槽模型、SAM2+冻结ViT等设置下，CoGenT-OOD-core退化依然存在，且局部性或稳定性可能高估语义忠实性。
Motivation: 现有对象中心学习评估通常侧重于分割、单图像因子预测或下游准确率，未能直接检验对象表示在受控语义编辑下的行为正确性。
Method: 构建成对场景干预基准EditCLEVR，包含已知属性变化或重渲染的样本；提出SGIA和Delta-SGIA指标，分别测试完整后场景预测正确性和单站点变化模式。
Result: 基线实验显示，即使使用ground-truth实例掩码，CoGenT-OOD-core退化仍然存在；掩码来源部分解释原生性能差异；局部性或稳定性指标可能高估语义忠实性。
Conclusion: EditCLEVR提供了细粒度的语义忠实性评估，揭示了现有对象中心表征在组合泛化上的不足，并分离了表征变化定位、稳定性与语义正确性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有对象中心学习评估通常侧重于分割、单图像因子预测或下游准确率，未能直接检验对象表示在受控语义编辑下的行为正确性。
summary_sections.method: 构建成对场景干预基准EditCLEVR，包含已知属性变化或重渲染的样本；提出SGIA和Delta-SGIA指标，分别测试完整后场景预测正确性和单站点变化模式。
summary_sections.result: 基线实验显示，即使使用ground-truth实例掩码，CoGenT-OOD-core退化仍然存在；掩码来源部分解释原生性能差异；局部性或稳定性指标可能高估语义忠实性。
summary_sections.conclusion: EditCLEVR提供了细粒度的语义忠实性评估，揭示了现有对象中心表征在组合泛化上的不足，并分离了表征变化定位、稳定性与语义正确性。

papers.title: Visible-Light Imaging Diagnosis of Neutral Particle Emission Tomography in the Tokamak Divertor: An Efficient Transformer-based Surrogate Model
papers.abstract_en: Nuclear fusion has made significant progress in recent years and is expected to become one of the most important pathways to addressing global energy challenges. This paper focuses on observing plasma using visible-light cameras, analyzing its spatio-temporal motion cues, and predicting the two-dimensional spatial distribution of light intensity, aiming to provide a foundational basis for future scientific experiments using deep neural networks. Specifically, we propose Delta-InvFormer, a novel backbone network centered on a differential Transformer. The key insight is that by taking consecutive video frames as input, we can better capture the dynamics of the plasma. Moreover, spatial and temporal differential self-attention effectively mitigates interference from noisy signals, ensuring high-quality feature extraction. These features are then fused into a compact and informative representation, which is fed into a decoder network to predict the distribution. Based on real experimental data collected from the Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) large-scale scientific facility, our results demonstrate that the proposed model not only significantly accelerates traditional methods for distribution prediction but also achieves competitive reconstruction accuracy. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Delta-InvFormer，一种基于差分 Transformer 的代理模型，用于从托卡马克偏滤器的可见光视频帧中预测等离子体光强度的二维空间分布。该方法利用时空差分自注意力机制抑制噪声，并在 EAST 装置的真实实验数据上实现了比传统方法更快的分布预测和竞争性重建精度。
Motivation: 核聚变实验中需要快速准确地诊断等离子体行为，传统方法计算耗时，难以满足实时需求。
Method: 提出以连续视频帧为输入，通过差分 Transformer 提取时空特征，融合后输入解码器预测光强度分布。
Result: 在 EAST 实验数据上，模型显著加速分布预测，同时保持有竞争力的重建精度。
Conclusion: 基于 Transformer 的代理模型可以高效替代传统断层成像方法，为未来聚变实验提供快速诊断基础。

papers.title: Histopathological Spectrum-Guided Prostate Stratification via Segmentation-Assisted Diagnostic Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Prostate cancer diagnosis with multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) is commonly based on PI-RADS assessment or binary classification, which suffer from subjectivity and fail to capture clinically relevant pathological heterogeneity. To address this limitation, we construct a Prostate Cancer Histopathology Spectrum Dataset (PCa-HSD) and formulate a clinically meaningful four-class classification task, addressing the underrepresentation of benign lesions that are easily confounded with prostate cancer in existing datasets. We propose Language-guided Segmentation-assisted Diagnostic Transformer model (LSDT), which leverages zero-shot segmentation to provide anatomical priors and performs effective multi-modal slice fusion for classification. Our proposed method consistently improves accuracy across backbones, achieving the best average accuracy of 0.633 and JointRecall of 0.768 in five-fold cross-validation on a cohort of 344 patients. These results demonstrate that integrating pathology supervision and anatomical priors significantly enhances fine-grained prostate MRI classification and provides a more clinically relevant paradigm for risk stratification. Code will be made publicly available in a future revision.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, and 4 tables. Code will be made publicly available in a future revision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前列腺癌mpMRI诊断中PI-RADS评估和二元分类的局限性，构建了前列腺癌组织病理学谱数据集（PCa-HSD），并提出四分类任务。提出语言引导的分割辅助诊断Transformer（LSDT），利用零样本分割提供解剖先验，进行多模态切片融合分类。在344名患者队列上五折交叉验证，平均准确率0.633，联合召回率0.768。
Motivation: 现有前列腺癌MRI诊断依赖主观的PI-RADS或二元分类，无法捕捉临床相关的病理异质性，且现有数据集忽视易与癌症混淆的良性病变。
Method: 构建PCa-HSD数据集并定义四分类任务；提出LSDT模型，使用零样本分割（如SAM）获取解剖先验，通过多模态切片融合增强分类。
Result: 在344例患者五折交叉验证中，平均准确率0.633，联合召回率0.768，在不同骨干网络上均有一致提升。
Conclusion: 整合病理监督和解剖先验能显著提升细粒度前列腺MRI分类，为风险分层提供更临床相关的范式。

papers.title: MIME: Multimodal Interactive Motion Encoder
papers.abstract_en: Text-motion representation learning has advanced rapidly, with growing interest in multi person interactions for animation, AR/VR, and embodied AI. These settings require representations that align language with both individual actor dynamics and the relationships between actors. We introduce the Multimodal Interactive Motion Encoder (MIME), which, to our knowledge, represents the first dedicated multimodal encoder designed specifically for two person interactive motion. MIME captures individual and shared structure using stream based co-attention with explicit interaction features and curriculum based contrastive training. On Inter-X text-motion retrieval, MIME consistently outperforms early and late fusion baselines across gallery sizes, achieving a 12.8% relative improvement in text-to-motion R@1 at a 2,000-sample gallery. We further evaluate MIME as a frozen auxiliary prior within TIMotion and InterMask on the unseen InterHuman dataset. MIME improves semantic alignment metrics while maintaining comparable FID in TIMotion. These results show that interaction aware multimodal encoding improves multi person motion retrieval and transfers across datasets to support downstream motion generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MIME，首个专为两人交互运动设计的多模态编码器，采用基于流的共注意力、显式交互特征和课程对比训练。在Inter-X文本-运动检索任务上，MIME在2000样本库中实现文本到运动R@1相对提升12.8%，并优于早期和晚期融合基线。作为冻结先验使用时，MIME在TIMotion和InterMask上改善语义对齐指标，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 现有文本-运动表示学习方法主要针对个体运动，缺乏专门处理两人交互运动的多模态编码器，难以有效对齐语言与个体运动及交互关系。
Method: 提出多模态交互运动编码器（MIME），使用基于流的共注意力（stream-based co-attention）建模个体与共享结构，显式提取交互特征，并采用课程对比训练（curriculum-based contrastive training）进行优化。
Result: 在Inter-X文本-运动检索中，MIME在2000样本库上R@1相对提升12.8%；在TIMotion中作为冻结先验，改善语义对齐同时保持FID；跨数据集迁移至InterHuman数据集时保持有效性。
Conclusion: 交互感知的多模态编码方法能够有效提升多人交互运动的检索性能，并具备跨数据集迁移能力，支持下游运动生成任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoleMix: Unifying Sequential and Non-Sequential Features via Semantic Tokenization for Post-Click Conversion Rate Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Post-click conversion rate (PCVR) prediction is central to industrial recommendation, but remains challenged by the structural mismatch between sparse, unordered multi-field features and long, domain-specific behavior histories. Existing models often process these signals through separate pathways and fuse them late, weakening semantic roles and limiting cross-signal refinement. We propose RoleMix, a unified interaction architecture that represents sequential and non-sequential evidence through a shared, role-preserving token interface. Non-sequential fields are converted into explicit semantic tokens that preserve user, item, pairwise, dense, contextual, and cross-feature roles, while long behavior domains are compressed into item- and context-aware sequence-query tokens through two-stage hierarchical window attention. The resulting global, semantic, and sequence-query tokens are jointly refined by stacked UniMixing-Lite blocks for PCVR prediction. On the large-scale KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, RoleMix achieves 83.648% online AUC, outperforming the official industrial baseline by 1.953%. Ablation studies show that semantic tokenization yields the largest isolated gain, highlighting a key principle for large-scale PCVR modeling: preserving field semantics at the token-interface level is as important as scaling the interaction backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RoleMix，一种统一交互架构，通过语义分词（semantic tokenization）将非序列特征转化为显式语义 token，并用两级层级窗口注意力压缩长行为序列，最终用 UniMixing-Lite 块联合优化。在 KDD Cup 2026 腾讯 UniRec 挑战赛上达到 83.648% 在线 AUC，比工业基线高 1.953%。消融实验显示语义分词带来最大单独增益。
Motivation: PCVR 预测面临结构不匹配问题：稀疏无序的多特征域与长行为历史难以融合，现有模型通过分离通路处理并后期融合，削弱了语义角色。
Method: 提出 RoleMix，将非序列特征转换为保留角色语义的 token，用两级层次窗口注意力压缩行为序列，并通过 UniMixing-Lite 块联合优化。
Result: 在 KDD Cup 2026 数据集上 AUC 83.648%，比基线高 1.953%；语义分词贡献最大增益。
Conclusion: 保留字段语义在 token 接口层面与扩展交互骨干同样重要，是大规模 PCVR 建模的关键原则。

papers.title: Similarity All The Way Up: Multilingual Generalization in LLMs Relies on Language-Level Similarity Structures
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow more capable across diverse tasks, their (in)ability to generalize remains difficult to quantify and poorly understood beyond limited domains. In particular, LLMs are known to struggle generalizing multilingually, to languages outside of English, and that are poorly attested in their training data. To understand why this may be, and what enables some models to perform better than others, we turn to a long history of work across the cognitive sciences, arguing that successful generalization derives from appropriate representations in similarity space. We look at how well LLMs' representations capture the hierarchical similarity structure between distinct languages. Strikingly, we show LLMs' latent representations largely recover the hierarchical structure of the Indo-European language family tree -- grouping languages that are members of the same subfamily closely together in representation space. Furthermore, we show that the degree to which models reflect the similarity structure of languages correlates with their performance on XNLI, a multilingual natural language inference benchmark. This extends classic work on similarity-driven generalization at scale, showing how models that represent similar languages similarly generalize better from one language to another.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLMs）的多语言泛化能力，发现模型的潜在表征能够大致恢复印欧语系的层次结构，同一子族的语言在表征空间中更接近。进一步，模型对语言相似性结构的捕捉程度与XNLI多语言自然语言推理基准的性能正相关。该工作将认知科学中相似性驱动泛化的经典理论扩展到大规模语言模型。
Motivation: LLMs在非英语和训练数据稀少的语言上泛化能力不足，机制尚不明确；论文旨在从表征的相似性结构角度解释为何某些模型表现更好。
Method: 分析LLMs的潜在表征，计算语言间的相似性矩阵，并与印欧语系树对比；通过相关性分析考察表征层次结构与XNLI性能的关系。
Result: LLMs的潜在表征基本恢复了印欧语系树的结构；模型反映语言相似性结构的程度与其在XNLI上的准确率呈正相关。
Conclusion: 成功泛化依赖于表征空间中的适当相似性结构，该认知科学原理同样适用于大规模语言模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FogDrive: A Multi-Modal Synthetic Driving Dataset for Perception under Graded Fog
papers.abstract_en: Perception under adverse weather remains a critical bottleneck for reliable autonomous driving, yet existing benchmarks lack the systematic multi-modal alignments needed to evaluate robust sensor fusion. Real-world weather datasets suffer from uncontrolled collection and single-level, uncalibrated conditions, while synthetic alternatives either target camera-only restoration or lack the paired clean-and-foggy structure needed to benchmark "defog-then-detect" pipelines. We present FogDrive, a rigorously calibrated, multi-modal autonomous-driving dataset bridging data-centric engineering and robust machine learning. Built with the CARLA simulator, FogDrive contains 660 scenes (~133k fully annotated frames, 50:50 day/night) across four synchronized cameras (RGB, depth, semantic segmentation), a LiDAR and semantic-LiDAR pair, and front radar. Physically consistent fog is modeled independently on camera channels (Koschmieder model) and LiDAR channels (Beer-Lambert law) at three calibrated visibility densities (160m, 100m, 50m). Every scene ships in four matched variants (clean plus three graded fog levels) with cross-calibrated 2D and 3D bounding boxes. A semantic-segmentation-based quality audit over 8k images validates annotations at 95.1% precision and over 99% recall for vehicles within 40m. We establish baseline benchmarks with state-of-the-art architectures (TransFusion, BEVFusion, YOLOv8-m) across two paradigms: 3D multi-modal fusion and 2D image restoration. These yield critical data-centric insights: mixing multi-density fog during training tightens 3D bounding-box geometry without added data-scaling cost, while in 2D pipelines image-quality metrics (PSNR, SSIM) prove poor predictors of downstream detection performance. FogDrive will be fully open-sourced alongside our data-generation framework to accelerate robust, multi-modal research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FogDrive是一个多模态合成自动驾驶数据集，专注于在分级雾天条件下的感知。数据集基于CARLA模拟器，包含660个场景（约13.3万帧），同步四摄像头（RGB、深度、语义分割）、LiDAR和雷达。雾天建模物理一致，分为三个可见度级别（160m、100m、50m），并提供清洁版本作为对照。语义分割质量审核精度95.1%，车辆召回率>99%。基线实验表明，多密度雾混合训练可改善3D检测几何精度，而2D图像质量指标（PSNR、SSIM）与检测性能相关性差。数据集和生成框架将开源。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶在恶劣天气下的感知基准缺乏多模态对齐和系统性的雾度条件控制；真实天气数据集难以控制，合成数据集多限于单模态或缺失配对清洁-雾数据。
Method: 使用CARLA模拟器生成物理一致的雾（相机通道用Koschmieder模型，LiDAR通道用Beer-Lambert定律），三个可见度级别，四模态同步数据，并提供清洁对照。
Result: 语义分割质量审核精度95.1%，车辆召回率>99%。基线显示多密度雾混合训练可改善3D检测几何；2D图像质量指标与检测性能关联弱。
Conclusion: FogDrive为多模态雾天感知提供了标准化基准，并揭示数据工程（如混合密度训练）对鲁棒性的重要性。

summary_sections.tldr: FogDrive是一个多模态合成自动驾驶数据集，专注于在分级雾天条件下的感知。数据集基于CARLA模拟器，包含660个场景（约13.3万帧），同步四摄像头（RGB、深度、语义分割）、LiDAR和雷达。雾天建模物理一致，分为三个可见度级别（160m、100m、50m），并提供清洁版本作为对照。语义分割质量审核精度95.1%，车辆召回率>99%。基线实验表明，多密度雾混合训练可改善3D检测几何精度，而2D图像质量指标（PSNR、SSIM）与检测性能相关性差。数据集和生成框架将开源。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有自动驾驶在恶劣天气下的感知基准缺乏多模态对齐和系统性的雾度条件控制；真实天气数据集难以控制，合成数据集多限于单模态或缺失配对清洁-雾数据。
summary_sections.method: 使用CARLA模拟器生成物理一致的雾（相机通道用Koschmieder模型，LiDAR通道用Beer-Lambert定律），三个可见度级别，四模态同步数据，并提供清洁对照。

summary_sections.conclusion: FogDrive为多模态雾天感知提供了标准化基准，并揭示数据工程（如混合密度训练）对鲁棒性的重要性。

papers.title: Test-Time Coverage: Test-Conditioned Data Curation for Deployment-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deployed AI systems are often trained from broad candidate data pools, necessitating data curation towards the deployment test distribution. However, standard data curation methods score training-side criteria rather than directly optimizing deployment match. We introduce TTCov (Test-Time Coverage), a data-level test-conditioned curation method that uses test-side information before training instead of updating model weights at inference. TTCov decomposes deployment-conditioned curation into coverage and distribution. To represent coverage, it builds a task Atlas, a collection of LLM-based atomic propositions (APs) describing deployment-relevant concepts, seeded from open task knowledge and expanded with unmatched APs extracted from unlabeled deployment samples. To represent distribution, it instantiates the matched deployment APs with their frequencies, yielding a Knowledge Atlas (K-Atlas) that operationalizes the deployment distribution as a curation target. TTCov then selects a budgeted training set whose deployment APs distribution approximates this target. We apply TTCov towards autonomous driving (AD), keeping adaptation off the inference path while selecting data with greater deployment-relevant coverage, closer K-Atlas matching, and stronger downstream end-to-end driving performance than data-curation baselines, including seamless adaptability to novel domains via city-to-city expansion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TTCov（Test-Time Coverage），一种测试条件数据筛选方法，在训练前利用测试侧信息（而非推理时更新模型权重）来优化部署匹配。方法构建任务图集（Atlas）和知识图集（K-Atlas）表示部署覆盖和分布，并选择预算内的训练集以近似部署分布。在自动驾驶（AD）场景中，TTCov 无需推理时调整即可提升数据筛选的部署相关覆盖率和驾驶性能，并支持跨城市域适应。
Motivation: 现有数据筛选方法多基于训练侧标准，未能直接优化模型与部署测试分布的匹配，导致部署时性能不佳。
Method: TTCov 将部署条件数据筛选分解为覆盖度和分布两个部分：通过 LLM 构建原子命题（AP）形成任务图集表示覆盖，再结合部署样本中匹配 AP 的频率得到知识图集（K-Atlas），最后选择训练集使其 AP 分布逼近 K-Atlas 目标。
Result: 在自动驾驶场景下，TTCov 相比于数据筛选基线，在部署相关覆盖、K-Atlas 匹配度以及端到端驾驶性能上均更优，且能通过城市间扩展无缝适应新领域。
Conclusion: TTCov 提供了一种无需推理时调整的测试条件数据筛选框架，适用于部署感知学习，特别在自动驾驶领域展示了有效性。

papers.title: MegaSlide-DiT: Memory-Centric Adaptation and Deformable Local Attention for Efficient Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution video diffusion models built on Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver strong fidelity but quickly exhaust the memory budget of a single workstation. A 100 billion-plus parameter DiT easily requires over a terabyte of persistent state, while naive spatiotemporal self-attention grows quadratically in sequence length. These two walls -- parameter memory and activation memory -- prevent researchers from adapting massive generative models without large GPU clusters. We revisit this problem from a systems perspective and introduce MegaSlide-DiT, a prototype that demonstrates how a pre-trained 105B DiT can be adapted on a single H200 GPU with 1.5 TB of host RAM. Our key insight is that the GPU need not own the model state: all persistent weights, master weights and optimizer moments remain in host memory, while only transient shards are streamed to the GPU on demand. Simultaneously, we replace quadratic global attention with 3D Deformable Slide Attention (3D-DSA), a motion-adaptive local attention operator that reduces both memory and computational complexity to linear in the sequence length. We report detailed memory accounting, execution traces and evaluation results to substantiate our design. MegaSlide-DiT does not claim to train a 105B model from scratch on a single GPU, nor does it magically solve bandwidth limits; rather, it offers a pragmatic path for full-parameter adaptation of massive video diffusion models on high-end workstations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MegaSlide-DiT，一种在单GPU上适配超大规模视频扩散模型（105B参数）的原型系统。核心设计包括：将模型权重、优化器状态驻留于主机内存，仅按需流式传输临时分片到GPU；同时以3D可变形滑动注意力（3D-DSA）替代二次自注意力，实现线性内存与计算复杂度。实验在单块H200 GPU（1.5TB主机RAM）上成功适配105B DiT，并报告详细内存与执行分析。
Motivation: 现有高分辨率视频DiT模型面临参数内存与激活内存双重瓶颈：超100B参数需TB级持久状态，且朴素时空自注意力复杂度随序列长度二次增长，导致无法在单工作站上进行全参数适配。
Method: 将全部持久权重、主权重和优化器状态保留在主机内存，GPU仅按需流式加载临时分片；同时提出3D可变形滑动注意力（3D-DSA），一种运动自适应局部注意力算子，将内存与计算复杂度降为序列长度的线性。
Result: 在单块H200 GPU（配备1.5TB主机RAM）上成功适配105B参数的DiT模型，并提供了详细的内存记账、执行轨迹和评估结果。
Conclusion: MegaSlide-DiT不声称在单GPU上从头训练105B模型，也不解决带宽限制，而是为高端工作站上大规模视频扩散模型的全参数适配提供一条实用路径。

papers.title: PANOPTICON: A PII-Based Assemblage of Naturalistic Output Tokens for Investigating Privacy Leakage Within LLM Context Window
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are capable of generalizing human language for the completion of never-before-seen tasks, leading to widespread deployment. While this automation provides clear utility, completing these tasks often requires the insertion of Personally Identifiable Information (PII), strings of information that uniquely identify some individual, raising privacy concerns. However, ethics has prevented the curation of a public, authentic dataset of PII. Without an appropriate dataset, it is difficult to quantify privacy risks. Thus, we introduce the PANOPTICON pipeline and dataset. The dataset, generated by Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model, contains 67, 718 prompts, intended for the models context window, containing PII spans derived from 9,674 publicly available synthetic user profiles. We measure lexical diversity and S-BERT diversity of the created dataset to evaluate realism. Finally, we present a case study showcasing the utility of PANOPTICON data for understanding Prompt Inversion Attacks (PIAs). PANOPTICON thus emerges as the first benchmark dataset for studying PIAs over private corpora, providing a foundation for future LLM privacy research.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE CARS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PANOPTICON流水线和数据集，使用Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型根据9,674个公开合成用户档案生成了67,718个包含PII（个人身份信息）的提示，用于研究LLM上下文窗口中的隐私泄露。通过词汇多样性和S-BERT多样性评估数据集的真实性，并展示了该数据集在提示反转攻击研究中的实用性。PANOPTICON成为首个用于研究提示反转攻击的基准数据集。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在处理任务时常需插入PII，引发隐私担忧，但伦理限制阻碍了公开真实PII数据集的构建，从而难以量化隐私风险。
Method: 基于Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型，从9,674个公开可用的合成用户档案中生成67,718个包含PII的提示，构建PANOPTICON数据集。
Result: 数据集包含67,718个提示，通过词汇多样性和S-BERT多样性评估表明其具有真实性。案例研究验证了该数据集在提示反转攻击研究中的有效性。
Conclusion: PANOPTICON成为首个用于研究提示反转攻击的基准数据集，为未来LLM隐私研究提供了基础。

papers.title: Bayesian Repetition Penalty: A Principled Adjacent-Conditional Framework for Reversing Attention Collapse in Autoregressive Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Attention collapse in autoregressive language models -- manifested as repetitive token loops where the model becomes trapped in self-reinforcing attractors -- is a persistent pathology that existing decoding-time heuristics fail to address at its root cause. We present a principled framework that penalises or compensates anomalous confidence arising from collapsed generation patterns, by comparing a token's observed frequency against its corpus prior through an adjacent-conditional probability construction. The resulting self-normalising penalty ratio $R=f(m,n,p)/f(np,n,p)$ requires no ad hoc standardisation and admits a closed-form logit offset with zero approximation error. The correction is isolated from the loss gradient and accumulated into a frozen output-layer bias via exponential moving average, enabling deployment as a repair mechanism for models that have already collapsed without requiring intrusive modifications to standard training pipelines. Experimental validation on a 1.5B-parameter model demonstrates that the frozen-bias mechanism can rescue a model already trapped in a collapsed attractor, reducing 2-gram repetition from 0.073 to near 0 while preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯重复惩罚框架，通过相邻条件概率构造比较 token 观测频率与语料先验，以自归一化比率 R 校正自回归语言模型中的注意力崩溃（重复循环），无需特设标准化，且可导出零近似误差的闭式 logit 偏移。该校正与损失梯度隔离，通过指数移动平均累积到冻结的输出层偏置中，可作为已崩溃模型的修复机制，无需修改标准训练流程。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型中注意力崩溃表现为重复 token 循环，现有解码启发式方法无法从根源解决此问题。
Method: 基于相邻条件概率构造，比较 token 观测频率与语料先验，得到自归一化惩罚比率 R=f(m,n,p)/f(np,n,p)，导出闭式 logit 偏移，并通过指数移动平均累积到冻结的输出层偏置中。
Result: 在 1.5B 参数模型上验证，冻结偏置机制能挽救已陷入崩溃吸引子的模型，将 2-gram 重复率从 0.073 降至接近 0，同时保持生成质量。
Conclusion: 该框架无需特设标准化，无近似误差，可作为无需修改训练管道的修复机制。

papers.title: Risk Governance for Generative AI Mental Health Support: A Multi-Turn Safety Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support despite lacking mechanisms to safely govern evolving mental health risk. Existing safety approaches primarily detect risk but rarely shape how models respond as conversational risk unfolds. We developed a model-agnostic safety governance architecture that combines contextual risk detection, reasoning-based verification, and protocol-guided response generation for multi-turn mental health interactions. Synthetic conversations grounded in real-world mental health narratives were used to evaluate the architecture's performance, tested with GPT-5-chat and Qwen3.5-27B, achieving high risk detection performance (specificity: 0.85 (95\%CI: 0.78;0.91), sensitivity: 0.92 (95\%CI: 0.88;0.95)) and increasing clinician-preferred escalation responses by 25.6--59.2pp while preserving rapport and connection. Performance remained stable across conversation length and generalized across both proprietary and open-source models. These findings demonstrate that clinically-grounded safety governance can extend beyond risk detection to improve how LLMs manage evolving mental health risk, providing a scalable framework for safer deployment across models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种模型无关的安全治理架构，用于多轮心理健康对话中的风险检测、验证和协议引导的响应生成。在基于真实世界心理健康叙事合成的对话上，使用GPT-5-chat和Qwen3.5-27B评估，实现了高风险检测性能（特异性0.85，敏感性0.92），并将临床医生优先的升级响应提高了25.6-59.2个百分点，同时保持了融洽和连接。性能在对话长度上保持稳定，并泛化到专有和开源模型。
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型在情感支持中缺乏安全治理机制，现有方法主要检测风险，但很少在对话中塑造模型的响应方式。
Method: 开发了一种模型无关的安全治理架构，结合上下文风险检测、基于推理的验证和协议引导的响应生成，用于多轮心理健康互动。
Result: 在合成对话中，风险检测特异性0.85（95%CI: 0.78-0.91），敏感性0.92（95%CI: 0.88-0.95），临床医生优先的升级响应增加25.6-59.2个百分点，性能稳定且泛化良好。
Conclusion: 临床基础的安全治理可以超越风险检测，改善LLM管理演变中心理健康风险的方式，为跨模型的安全部署提供可扩展框架。

papers.title: HiLLTS: Zero-Shot Hierarchical LLM-Guided Traffic Signal Control for Sustainable Transportation
papers.abstract_en: Urban traffic congestion significantly increases fuel consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, and commuter delays, resulting in substantial economic losses and environmental harm in modern cities. Traditional traffic signal control strategies such as fixed-time scheduling, actuated control, and reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods, offer different degrees of adaptability; however, RL-based methods can require extensive retraining, careful reward design, and substantial simulation data when transferred across networks or demand regimes. To address these challenges, we propose HiLLTS, an LLM-guided traffic signal control framework that employs a hierarchical three-layer architecture consisting of a central coordination agent, a district layer and multiple cluster-level intersection agents. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in both congestion and environmental performance. Compared with the strongest non-LLM baseline in each scenario, HiLLTS reduces average waiting time by 36.73% under the low-congestion scenario and 14.71% under the high-congestion scenario, while reducing average CO2 emissions by 7.87% and 8.57%, respectively. Larger gains are observed against weaker baselines: under low congestion, HiLLTS achieves reductions of up to 18.00% in emissions and 62.07% in waiting time relative to Fixed-Time control; under high congestion, reductions of up to 28.89% in emissions and 40.36% in waiting time are observed relative to Max Pressure. The ablation study further validates the contribution of LLM-guided coordination over rule-based control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiLLTS，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的分层交通信号控制框架，采用三层架构（中央协调、区域层、集群交叉口）实现零样本迁移。实验表明，相比非LLM基线，HiLLTS在低拥堵和高拥堵场景下分别将平均等待时间降低36.73%和14.71%，CO2排放降低7.87%和8.57%。消融实验验证了LLM协调优于规则控制。
Motivation: 传统交通信号控制方法（如固定定时、强化学习）需要大量重新训练或仿真数据，难以在不同网络或需求模式下迁移，亟需一种无需重新训练的零样本方案。
Method: 提出HiLLTS，一种LLM引导的交通信号控制框架，采用分层三层架构：中央协调智能体、区域层以及多个集群级交叉口智能体，利用LLM进行协调决策。
Result: 在低拥堵场景下平均等待时间降低36.73%，高拥堵场景降低14.71%；CO2排放分别降低7.87%和8.57%。对比固定时间控制、最大压力等较弱基线，提升更显著。
Conclusion: LLM引导的分层架构在交通信号控制中优于传统规则控制，且无需重新训练，证明了零样本迁移的有效性。

papers.title: LazyMem: Retrieve Broadly, Construct Selectively for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory lets LLM agents reuse past interactions, but raw dialogue histories are verbose and information-sparse. Retrieving broadly improves evidence coverage yet overwhelms downstream reasoning with noise; compressing at write time reduces noise but irreversibly discards details the future query may need. We introduce LazyMem, which sidesteps this dilemma by deferring all memory construction to query time. A lightweight 4B model processes the retrieved candidate pool in overlapping parallel windows, selectively retaining and compressing only query-relevant content. The model is trained through supervised fine-tuning followed by group-based reinforcement learning with a format-gated composite reward that combines a rule-based action signal measuring selection accuracy with an LLM-judged quality signal measuring source faithfulness and query utility. On the LongMemEval benchmark, LazyMem-4B achieves an LLM-judge accuracy of 0.85 with only 213 memory tokens, 68.7$\times$ fewer than retrieval-only, and generalizes to LoCoMo (0.68) without target-domain training, while reducing mean latency over the prior query-time baseline. The 32B variant reaches 0.93, surpassing oracle-context references on aggregation-heavy question types. The code associated with this work is publicly available at https://github.com/allacnobug/LazyMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LazyMem 是一种针对 LLM 智能体长期记忆的延迟构建方法。它在查询时通过轻量级 4B 模型对检索到的候选池进行并行窗口处理，选择性保留和压缩与查询相关的内容，避免了写入时压缩导致信息丢失或检索时噪声过多的问题。在 LongMemEval 基准上，LazyMem-4B 以 213 个记忆 token 达到 0.85 的 LLM 评判准确率，比仅检索方法节省 68.7 倍 token；32B 变体达到 0.93，在聚合密集问题类型上超过 oracle 上下文参考。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆方法中，检索广泛但噪声大导致下游推理困难，写入时压缩又不可逆地丢弃细节。LazyMem 通过在查询时构建记忆来避免这一困境。
Method: LazyMem 将所有记忆构建推迟到查询时刻：使用轻量 4B 模型对检索候选池进行重叠并行窗口处理，选择性保留和压缩仅与查询相关的内容。模型通过监督微调后，采用基于组强化学习训练，奖励函数结合规则基的选择准确性信号和 LLM 评判的质量信号。
Result: LongMemEval 上 LazyMem-4B 的 LLM 评判准确率为 0.85，仅使用 213 个记忆 token（比仅检索少 68.7 倍）；32B 变体达 0.93，在聚合型问题上超越 oracle 上下文参考。零样本泛化到 LoCoMo 得到 0.68，延迟低于先前基线。
Conclusion: LazyMem 通过查询时选择性构造记忆，在 token 效率、准确率和延迟上优于现有方法，且具有较强的跨域泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Sequential Interaction: Benchmarking Parallel Execution and Coordination for GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are systems powered by large multimodal models (LMMs). They perceive screen state and execute user instructions through GUI actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling on desktops and mobile devices. However, current agents scale poorly to long-horizon tasks: actions incur costly LMM inferences, and performance degrades as context grows. Humans divide such workloads among collaborators who complete sub-tasks in parallel. Yet parallel coordination among GUI agents has received little attention. To close this gap, we introduce ParaGUIBench, to our knowledge, the first benchmark dedicated to parallel execution and coordination of multiple GUI agents on separate desktop instances. It consists of three components: a multi-device Docker infrastructure with a shared file system; a dataset of 233 tasks spanning six task categories; and an evaluation system with efficiency metrics, including step reduction ratio and token cost. We further introduce ParaGUI, a planner-worker agent that decomposes GUI tasks and dispatches sub-tasks to concurrent workers on separate desktop instances. On ParaGUIBench, ParaGUI reaches a 46.4% success rate, outperforming the strongest serial baseline (Claude Sonnet 4.6) by 12.9 points while using roughly half the steps and less than half the tokens. These results show that parallel execution can improve both success rate and efficiency on decomposable, long-horizon GUI tasks, pointing to a direction worth further study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ParaGUIBench，据作者所知是首个专注于多个GUI代理在独立桌面实例上并行执行与协调的基准。该基准包含多设备Docker基础设施、233个任务和效率评估指标。作者还提出ParaGUI，一种计划者-工作器（planner-worker）架构，将GUI任务分解并派发给并发工作器。实验显示ParaGUI在ParaGUIBench上达到46.4%成功率，超过最强串行基线（Claude Sonnet 4.6）12.9个百分点，同时步骤数和token消耗均减半。
Motivation: 当前GUI代理在长时任务上扩展性差：动作推理成本高，上下文增长导致性能下降。人类通过协作并行完成任务，但GUI代理的并行协调尚未被充分研究。
Method: 构建ParaGUIBench，包括多设备Docker基础设施（共享文件系统）、233个任务（覆盖六类）以及含步骤缩减比和token成本的评估系统。提出ParaGUI，一种计划者-工作器代理，将GUI任务分解并派发给并发工作器在独立桌面实例上执行。
Result: ParaGUI在ParaGUIBench上达到46.4%成功率，比最强串行基线Claude Sonnet 4.6高12.9个百分点，同时步骤数约减少一半，token成本降低超过一半。
Conclusion: 结果表明并行执行能在可分解的长时GUI任务上同时提升成功率和效率，是值得进一步研究的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Co-Harness: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Model Weights for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Post-training agents for automated AI research requires optimizing not only model parameters, but also the runtime harness that shapes how research trajectories are generated, evaluated, and learned from. Existing pipelines typically train models under a fixed harness, including prompts, tools, skills, middleware, and memory, while leaving the data-generating process outside the optimization objective. This creates a mismatch between model updates and the static scaffolding that determines trajectory quality. We introduce Co-Harness, a framework that jointly optimizes the agent harness and model parameters during post-training. Co-Harness alternates between harness optimization and model optimization. An LLM-based HarnessCritic analyzes failed trajectories, identifies harness-level failure modes, and proposes validated local updates. The model is then fine-tuned on high-quality trajectories generated by the improved harness, distilling effective scaffolding into model parameters. A 200+ hour autonomous case study further shows that Co-Harness can recover from system crashes, improve inference efficiency, and discover ensemble strategies without human intervention. These results suggest that joint harness and model optimization is an effective way to improve agents beyond fixed-harness post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Co-Harness框架，在LLM agent后训练阶段联合优化agent harness（包括提示、工具、技能、中间件、记忆）和模型权重。通过交替进行harness优化和模型优化，利用LLM-based HarnessCritic分析失败轨迹并提出harness改进，然后在新harness生成的优质轨迹上微调模型。200+小时自主案例研究表明该方法能从系统崩溃中恢复、提高推理效率、发现集成策略。
Motivation: 现有后训练管线在固定harness下优化模型，导致模型更新与决定轨迹质量的静态框架不匹配，限制了agent性能。
Method: 提出Co-Harness框架，采用交替优化：先由HarnessCritic（基于LLM）分析失败轨迹，识别harness级失败模式并提出局部更新；然后在改进的harness下生成高质量轨迹，用于微调模型，将有效框架蒸馏到模型参数中。
Result: 200+小时自主案例研究显示，Co-Harness能自主恢复系统崩溃、提升推理效率、发现集成策略，无需人工干预。
Conclusion: 联合优化harness和模型是超越固定harness后训练的有效方法，可提升agent能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mixing Configurations for Downstream Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Clustering-based features are widely used in machine learning, but most methods must choose a resolution -- a choice that is global, fixed, and ad hoc. Recent work shows that varying the resolution parameter produces only a finite set of structurally stable partitions, known as configurations. Based on this, we introduce Configuration-Mixed Prediction (CMP), a setting where models learn to adaptively weight these configurations per sample for downstream prediction. We propose MixConfig, a plug-and-play feature augmentation module that extracts configurations from any frozen embedding and learns energy-aware mixing weights via a novel selector that jointly reasons about sample context, cluster assignments, and stability statistics. Experiments across tabular, molecular, vision, and text domains demonstrate consistent improvements over single-resolution and static baselines across diverse predictor architectures, with gains particularly pronounced in low-data regimes.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026. Equal contribution: Juntang Wang, Hao Wu, Yihan Wang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Configuration-Mixed Prediction (CMP) 框架，利用固定分辨率聚类得到的有限个稳定划分（配置），通过可学习能量感知权重自适应混合这些配置，用于下游预测任务。提出的 MixConfig 模块作为即插即用的特征增强方法，在表格、分子、视觉和文本领域均优于单分辨率和静态基线，尤其在低数据场景下提升显著。
Motivation: 现有基于聚类的特征方法通常需要全局固定的分辨率选择，且这种选择是临时决定的。
Method: MixConfig 模块：从冻结的嵌入中提取配置，并通过新颖的选择器联合考虑样本上下文、聚类分配和稳定性统计，学习能量感知的混合权重。
Result: 在表格、分子、视觉和文本领域的实验中，MixConfig 一致优于单分辨率和静态基线，且在低数据场景下增益尤为突出。
Conclusion: 本文表明，自适应加权多个稳定聚类配置可以提升下游预测性能，MixConfig 是一种有效的即插即用特征增强模块。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: DINOv3-MIL: Per-Kidney Multi-Label Tumour and Cyst Detection from Foundation-Model Patch Tokens on KiTS23
papers.abstract_en: Foundation vision models trained on natural images transfer to medical tasks without domain pre-training, but volumetric classification requires aggregating tens of thousands of patch tokens per study, and the aggregator constrains how the resulting model can be interpreted. We compare three aggregators on identical frozen DINOv3 ViT-H/16+ features for renal tumour/cyst detection on KiTS23 (966 kidneys; n=97 test): a CLS-token linear probe, gated attention multiple instance learning (MIL) over 55,296 patch tokens, and a prototype head following ProtoViT. Attention MIL achieves the highest AUROC for tumour (0.74, 95% CI 0.64-0.83) and cyst (0.80, 0.70-0.88), with attention enriched 7.5-9.8x over chance within annotated lesions. The prototype head does not transfer to cyst detection (AUROC 0.51), exposing an interpretability-performance trade-off at this token scale.
papers.comment: Accepted at MIUA 2026 (poster). To appear in Frontiers in Medical Technology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较三种聚合器在固定DINOv3 ViT-H/16+特征上用于肾脏肿瘤/囊肿检测的效果。注意力多实例学习在肿瘤（AUROC 0.74）和囊肿（AUROC 0.80）检测上取得最佳性能，肿瘤病灶内注意力集中度是随机水平的7.5-9.8倍。原型头在囊肿检测上失效（AUROC 0.51），揭示了大规模token尺度下的可解释性-性能权衡。
Motivation: 基础视觉模型在无领域预训练下可迁移到医学任务，但体积分类需要聚合大量patch token，聚合器限制了模型的解释性，需要比较不同聚合器的效果。
Method: 在KiTS23数据集上，使用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-H/16+特征，比较CLS token线性探针、基于55,296个patch token的门控注意力多实例学习以及ProtoViT原型头三种聚合器。
Result: 注意力MIL在肿瘤检测上AUROC 0.74（95% CI 0.64-0.83），囊肿检测上AUROC 0.80（0.70-0.88），注意力在标注病灶内富集7.5-9.8倍；原型头在囊肿检测上AUROC仅为0.51。

papers.title: Towards Nexus-Score: Metadata Gaps Limit Scholarly AI Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly mediate how science is found and credited. We asked whether missing metadata prevents AI systems from crediting work. As a boundary test, an AI system citing without access to task-relevant paper lists often produced out-of-list identifiers, some fabricated. We then tested the mechanism in real scholarly infrastructure by using OpenAlex records to hide or restore author, institution, funder, reference, and text-access links while holding works and tasks fixed. Restoring the relevant link made the corresponding attribution possible; restoring the wrong kind did not, with 0 correct answers across 469 completed mismatched tests. Thus, in these tasks, one metadata facet did not substitute for another. Missing links led to invented answers, refusals, or tool-budget exhaustion, and web search did not recover hidden author links. In sum, AI systems credited work only when record connections were visible or recoverable. This motivates Nexus-Score, a record-level check for metadata gaps, to guide repair and help prepare the scholarly record for AI-mediated use.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables; includes supplementary methods and reproducibility information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究元数据缺失如何阻碍AI系统正确归因学术工作。通过两个实验发现，AI仅在记录连接可见或可恢复时才能正确归因，且一个元数据维度不能替代另一个。这提出了Nexus-Score，用于检查记录级元数据缺口以指导修复。
Motivation: AI系统越来越主导科学发现和引用，但缺失的元数据可能导致AI无法正确归因工作，甚至产生虚构答案。现有基础设施未能确保元数据完整性。
Method: 通过两个实验：边界测试中AI在无任务相关论文列表时产生虚构标识符；在真实基础设施中利用OpenAlex隐藏或恢复作者、机构、资助者、参考文献和文本访问链接。
Result: 恢复相关链接使相应归因成为可能，恢复错误类型链接导致0个正确答案（469个不匹配测试）。缺失链接导致虚构答案、拒绝或工具预算耗尽；网络搜索无法恢复隐藏的作者链接。
Conclusion: AI系统仅当记录连接可见或可恢复时才归因工作，因此需要Nexus-Score检查元数据缺口以指导修复。

papers.title: Imprompt: A Language Framework for Prompt Programming
papers.abstract_en: With the unprecedented success of Language Models (LMs), the science of Prompt Engineering has evolved the powerful idea of Prompt Programming, where prompts are treated as a programmable control surface for describing complex tasks and leveraging LM capabilities. However, existing prompt programming frameworks suffer from various complexities and inelegances, which make them hard to utilize in practice for effectively describing tasks. We propose Imprompt, a new language framework for the study and practice of prompt programming. We undertake a foundational investigation of prompt programming, and contend that prompt programs must contain only the task descriptions and must be decoupled from lower-level 'execution' details. We further develop this position by illustrating structured prompting as a combination of prompt programming and prompt program 'compilation'. We exemplify this view by formally defining two compilers for Imprompt programs. We then explore the idea of typing for prompt programs and draw a correspondence between type checking and constrained decoding. Finally, we implement our compilers and type checkers and evaluate them on a variety of case studies. We believe our work contributes programming-language foundations toward the emerging area of prompt programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Imprompt，一个用于提示编程（prompt programming）的语言框架，强调提示程序应仅包含任务描述，并与底层执行细节解耦。作者形式化定义了两种编译器，探讨了类型检查与约束解码的对应关系，并在多个案例上评估了实现。
Motivation: 现有提示编程框架复杂且不优雅，难以在实践中有效描述任务，缺乏语言层的基础设施支持。
Method: 设计 Imprompt 语言，将提示编程与提示程序编译分离；形式化定义两种编译器，并引入类型系统与约束解码的对应。
Result: 通过案例研究展示了编译器和类型检查器的可用性，但未提供定量基准结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为提示编程提供了编程语言基础，但尚需更多实际应用验证。

papers.title: A Vocabulary for Multi-Agent Automated Research Systems
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a vocabulary for automated research systems built from one or more agents to make their design choices easier to describe and compare. The vocabulary specifies 1) who the agents are, 2) what operations are available in the system, 3) who may invoke them, 4) how agents communicate, 5) what information is visible within and across runs, 6) how the next action is chosen, 7) how a run begins, and 8) how outputs are evaluated. A trajectory records one run from the input task to the returned artifact. Because agents, operations, and initialization may be stochastic, repeated runs on the same task induce a distribution over trajectories rather than a single behavior. Our vocabulary turns structural design questions, such as when agents should communicate, gain or lose a capability, or carry information across runs, into testable choices. It also makes the evaluator a component of the system, since reported gains depend on how closely the proxy score matches true quality. That separation also splits the vague complaint that these systems lack taste into two failures with different solutions. Generative taste is the rate at which a system proposes novel trajectories before any score is observed, and evaluative taste is the gap between the proxy score and the quality it should match. We instantiate the vocabulary on recent autoresearch systems to illustrate that it covers designs that differ widely in structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于描述和比较多智能体自动化研究系统设计的词汇表，涵盖代理身份、可用操作、调用权限、通信方式、信息可见性、动作选择、初始化及输出评估等八个方面。该词汇表将结构设计问题转化为可测试的选择，并将评估器视为系统组件，区分了生成品味和评估品味两类失败。论文通过实例化多个最近的自动化研究系统展示了其覆盖范围。
Motivation: 现有的自动化研究系统设计各异，缺乏统一的描述和比较框架，导致设计选择难以系统化分析。
Method: 提出一个包含八个维度的词汇表：代理身份、可用操作、调用权限、通信方式、信息可见性、动作选择、初始化及输出评估。轨迹记录一次运行过程，随机重复运行产生轨迹分布。
Result: 词汇表能够覆盖结构差异很大的近期自动化研究系统设计，并区分了生成品味和评估品味两类失败。
Conclusion: 该词汇表为多智能体自动化研究系统的设计提供了通用的描述语言，使设计选择可测试，并强调评估器在系统中的作用。

papers.title: DOSA: A Tree-Guided, Self-Regressive Framework for Long Document Structure Analysis
papers.abstract_en: In visually-rich documents, information is encoded not only in individual page objects such as tables, headers, and text blocks, but also in the structural relations among them, making document structure analysis fundamental to information retrieval and document understanding. However, accurately inferring such relations remains challenging in multi-page documents with long-range dependencies and heterogeneous layouts. To address this, we propose a tree-guided and self-regressive framework, termed DOcument Structure Analyzer (DOSA), for inferring relations among page objects and reconstructing document-level semantic trees. DOSA processes documents chunk-by-chunk, fusing visual, textual, and layout features for each page object and predicting hierarchical and ordering relations. The predicted relations are used to incrementally construct a semantic tree, which is then leveraged as structural context to guide inference on subsequent chunks. Experimental results on five benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DOSA, with improvements of up to 4 F1 points and 19 TEDS points on DocHieNet, the most challenging multi-page hierarchy benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DOSA（文档结构分析器），一种树引导的自回归框架，用于分析长文档中页面对象之间的层次和顺序关系。该方法逐块处理文档，融合视觉、文本和布局特征预测关系，并逐步构建语义树作为上下文指导后续推理。在五个基准上验证，在DocHieNet上提升最多4个F1点和19个TEDS点。
Motivation: 多页文档中存在长距离依赖和异构布局，准确推断页面对象间的结构关系具有挑战性。
Method: 提出树引导的自回归框架DOSA，逐块处理文档，融合视觉、文本和布局特征预测层次与顺序关系，增量构建语义树并作为结构上下文指导后续块的推理。
Result: 在五个基准测试上表现有效，尤其在DocHieNet上达到最多4个F1点和19个TEDS点的提升。
Conclusion: 树引导的自回归方式能够有效利用已构建的结构上下文，提升多页文档结构分析性能。

papers.title: SetGo: Metadata Readiness for Scientific AI Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Scientific datasets intended for AI use require both computational readiness for model training and metadata readiness for discovery, sharing, and reuse. The Readiness Engine for Data Integration (REDI) addresses computational readiness, but no corresponding tool evaluates whether a dataset's metadata are sufficiently complete, governed, and standards-compliant for publication and agent-based consumption. Existing FAIR assessors operate only on published repository records, and no single system covers FAIR compliance, licensing, provenance, governance, reproducibility, and catalog readiness together. We present SetGo, an open-source Python toolkit that assesses and repairs metadata readiness across these six dimensions before a dataset is published or archived. Applied to four scientific corpora, SetGo surfaces deficiencies that general-purpose tools do not detect: ERA5 climate metadata scores 4% on ACDD 1.3 compliance; materials datasets fail OPTIMADE species-definition requirements; and PDB-derived proteomics data carries licensing terms incompatible with standard SPDX identifiers. Guided enrichment raises overall FAIR scores from 52-57% to 81-91%, and a single setgo publish command pushes to Hugging Face Hub, CKAN, or OpenMetadata with ML Commons Croissant 1.0 metadata sidecars. To support interactive and automated workflows, SetGo integrates with coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) through a /setgo skill that enables natural-language execution of the full assess-enrich-publish loop, with user involvement limited to supplying missing metadata values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SetGo，一个开源 Python 工具包，用于在科学数据集发布或归档之前评估和修复其元数据就绪性，涵盖 FAIR 合规性、许可、溯源、治理、可复现性和目录就绪性六个维度。应用于四个科学语料库后，SetGo 发现了通用工具无法检测的缺陷，并通过引导式富集将整体 FAIR 分数从 52-57% 提升至 81-91%。
Motivation: 现有工具如 REDI 仅关注计算就绪性，而缺乏评估数据集元数据是否完整、符合标准且可用于发现、共享和复用的系统。FAIR 评估器只作用于已发布的存储库记录，且没有任何单个系统覆盖所有六个关键维度。
Method: SetGo 是一个开源 Python 工具包，提供对元数据就绪性的六维评估，并支持自动修复。它通过单一命令将数据集推送至 Hugging Face Hub、CKAN 或 OpenMetadata，并生成 ML Commons Croissant 1.0 元数据侧车。此外，SetGo 通过 /setgo 技能与基于大语言模型的编码代理集成，支持自然语言驱动的全流程。
Result: 在 ERA5 气候数据集上，ACDD 1.3 合规性得分仅为 4%；材料数据集未能通过 OPTIMADE 物种定义要求；PDB 衍生蛋白质组学数据的许可条款与 SPDX 标识符不兼容。引导式富集后，整体 FAIR 分数从 52-57% 提升至 81-91%。
Conclusion: SetGo 能够发现通用工具无法检测的元数据缺陷，并通过自动化修复显著提升 FAIR 合规性。该工具适用于交互式和自动化工作流，但用户仍需提供缺失的元数据值。

papers.title: How LLM Task-Adaptation Reshapes Alignment: A Multi-dimensional Study of Behavioral and Representational Drift
papers.abstract_en: Post-training is a key mechanism for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. While prior work suggests that task adaptation can alter a model's pre-existing alignment, especially its safety behavior, its broader effects across alignment domains remain poorly understood. We address this gap through a systematic evaluation of representative task-adaptation methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), KL-regularized SFT, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) across 15 alignment aspects spanning six key domains: safety, factuality, stance stability, social harm, controllability, and instructability. Our results reveal that post-training does not reshape alignment uniformly. RLVR improves task performance while inducing comparatively small, but non-zero, metric-specific shifts, while SFT leads to substantially larger alignment drift across domains. KL regularization mitigates this effect: stronger reference-model anchoring reduces alignment drift from the baseline, although KL-SFT still falls short of RLVR in preserving alignment. Representation-level analysis further supports this pattern, with shifts in alignment-relevant representations tracking behavioral drift. Together, these results show that task adaptation is not merely a capability-improving step, but an alignment intervention in its own right, motivating multi-dimensional alignment evaluation as a standard component of post-training pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了监督微调、KL正则化SFT和基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）等任务适应方法对LLM在六个对齐领域（安全性、事实性、立场稳定性、社会伤害、可控性、可指令性）共15个方面的行为影响。实验结果发现RLVR在提升任务性能的同时引起较小的对齐漂移，而SFT导致显著的对齐漂移；KL正则化可部分缓解但效果不如RLVR。
Motivation: 现有研究认为任务适应可能改变模型的预训练对齐（尤其是安全性），但其在多个对齐维度上的广泛影响尚不清楚。
Method: 对SFT、KL正则化SFT和RLVR三种任务适应方法在15个对齐方面进行系统性行为评估，并结合表征层面的分析。
Result: RLVR在保持任务性能的同时引起较小的、特定指标的偏移；SFT导致跨领域更大的对齐漂移；KL正则化能减少基线漂移但仍不如RLVR。
Conclusion: 任务适应本身是一种对齐干预，建议将多维对齐评估作为后训练标准流程的一部分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Text-based Tactile Graphics Generation for the Visually Impaired
papers.abstract_en: Tactile graphics are a primary medium for blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals to access non-textual information. However, they are difficult to scale or personalize. While recent generative models have revolutionized visual content creation, they are optimized for screen-based visual realism and fail to satisfy the haptic perceptual and physical fabrication constraints required for touch. We present the first integrated generative system that produces fabrication-ready 2.5D tactile graphics directly from natural language prompts, jointly generating global base geometry, fine-grained tactile surface textures, and standard-compliant braille within a unified 3D-printable representation. Our approach introduces fabrication-aware techniques, including template-guided relief generation, a fast diffusion-based text-to-texture module for high-resolution tileable normal maps, and strict base flattening to ensure tactile readability and printability, while supporting both automatic generation and interactive texture control. Extensive evaluations, together with in-person user studies with BLV participants and blindfolded sighted participants using physically 3D-printed outputs, show that participants consistently prefer our results over baselines. By extending generative graphics beyond screens to touchable reliefs, our work broadens access to generative AI for the BLV community and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个从自然语言提示直接生成可3D打印的2.5D触觉图形的生成系统，针对盲人和低视力群体。系统联合生成全局基底几何、精细触觉表面纹理和符合标准的盲文，采用模板引导浮雕生成、快速扩散文本到纹理模块等制造感知技术。用户研究显示，使用物理3D打印输出时，参与者一致偏好该结果。
Motivation: 触觉图形是盲人和低视力群体获取非文本信息的主要媒介，但难以规模化或个性化。现有生成模型优化屏幕视觉真实感，无法满足触觉感知和物理制造约束。
Method: 提出集成的生成系统，包含模板引导的浮雕生成、基于扩散的快速文本到纹理模块（生成高分辨率可平铺法线图）、严格基面平整，支持自动生成和交互纹理控制，输出统一的3D可打印表示。
Result: 摘要报告，通过盲人参与者及蒙眼视力正常参与者的实地用户研究，使用物理3D打印输出，参与者一致偏好该系统结果而非基线。
Conclusion: 该系统将生成图形扩展到屏幕之外的触摸浮雕，拓宽了盲人和低视力社区对生成式AI的可及性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: URHead: A Unified UV-Space Representation for Joint Mesh-3DGS Optimization in Head Avatars
papers.abstract_en: We present URHead, a unified representation for high-fidelity and animatable head avatars that fundamentally redefines mesh-Gaussian integration. While mesh-based methods offer precise geometric control but lack photorealistic detail, and Gaussian-based approaches achieve photorealism but suffer from poor structural consistency, existing hybrid solutions fail to fully leverage their complementary strengths. Our key contribution is a UV-space unification where both representations share a common UV parameterization. Through joint optimization with adaptive gaussian sampling, our method automatically learns to disentangle and allocate appropriate roles to each component. URHead maintains full parametric controllability while preserving subject-specific details, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality and animation consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出URHead，一种统一表示用于高保真可动画头部虚拟人，通过UV空间联合网格和3D高斯泼溅优化。该方法实现了网格的精确几何控制和高斯泼溅的逼真细节，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于网格的方法缺乏逼真细节，基于高斯的方法结构一致性差，而混合方案未能充分利用两者的互补优势。
Method: 关键贡献是UV空间统一，使网格和高斯共享同一UV参数化；通过自适应高斯采样的联合优化，自动学习分离并分配每个组件的角色。
Result: 在重建质量和动画一致性上优于现有最先进方法，保持完整参数可控性和主体特定细节。
Conclusion: URHead通过UV空间统一有效结合网格和高斯泼溅的优势，为头部虚拟人提供高保真可动画表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AIR-BENCH Live: An Evolving Safety Benchmark for Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model safety benchmarks capture the AI risks of their time of publication: as models improve and governments pass new AI-safety legislation, their risk taxonomies become incomprehensive and their attack prompts become ineffective. We present AIR-BENCH Live, a self-evolving successor to AIR-BENCH 2024. An automated update pipeline monitors government regulation and classifies new policies against the current four-tier risk taxonomy, either matching them to existing categories or proposing new granular categories. Then, a multi-agent, persona-driven prompt generation algorithm generates realistic, multilingual prompts with minimal human review, leaving room for improvement with modern jail breaking techniques. This algorithm is used to overhaul legacy prompts and generate prompts for new categories. In our current version, the pipeline has expanded the benchmark from 314 to 335 granular risks, with the 21 new categories drawing from 31 truly novel policy clauses across seven jurisdictions. Evaluating 14 recent models, we find a wide safety spread (from 0.17 to 0.89 among the models judged on their own behavior), that the modernized prompts are on average 0.06 points harder than the 2024 set, with the largest drops concentrated among the most compliant models, and that most models are modestly less safe on non-English prompts. By continuously absorbing new regulation and regenerating prompts, AIR-BENCH Live is designed to evolve alongside a fast-moving field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AIR-BENCH Live，一个自演进的基座模型安全基准，通过自动化管道持续吸收新法规并生成多语言攻击提示，将风险分类从314个扩展至335个，评估14个近期模型发现安全得分范围0.17-0.89，新版提示比2024版平均难0.06。
Motivation: 现有安全基准随模型进步和法规更新而变得不全面，攻击提示失效，需要持续演进的基准来覆盖新风险。
Method: 构建自动化更新管道：监控政府法规并分类到四层风险分类法，用多智能体、角色驱动的提示生成算法生成现实的多语言提示，替换旧提示并生成新类别提示。
Result: 基准风险类别从314增至335（21个新类别来自31个新法规条款），评估14个模型发现安全得分差距大（0.17-0.89），新版提示难度平均增加0.06，最合规模型下降最大，非英语提示安全性略低。
Conclusion: AIR-BENCH Live 通过持续吸收新法规和再生提示，旨在与快速发展的领域同步演进，但当前版本仍依赖有限的人工审查，且提示生成可能受现代越狱技术影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Sensor Selection in Maritime Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an information-gain-guided reinforcement-learning sensor-selection framework for single-vessel tracking in heterogeneous maritime sensor networks. The proposed approach is motivated by information-theoretic sensor management: instead of activating all sensors or repeatedly performing computationally expensive online expected-information-gain evaluation, a learned policy selects one tracking-relevant sensor at each decision epoch. A Bayesian sequential Monte Carlo tracker estimates the vessel state from noisy measurements and provides a belief representation for scheduling under nonlinear and non-Gaussian conditions. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent selects one of five sensors deployed in a georeferenced simulation of the CMMI Smart Marina testbed at Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus. The agent observes belief-state, detection-history, coverage, sensor-geometry, and realized-information-gain features. The reward is defined as a realized-information-gain term gated by an observability mask. Final-test simulations compare the proposed framework with random single-sensor selection, always-on sensing using all sensors simultaneously, and the expected-information-gain sensor-selection baseline proposed in our previous work. Results show that the learned policy achieves tracking performance close to always-on sensing while activating only one sensor per decision time step and avoiding the computationally expensive online entropy search required by expected-information-gain selection.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, submitted to the IEEE MetroSea 2026 Conference: Special Session 13: Object Detection, Tracking, and Sensor Fusion for Maritime Situational Awareness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个信息增益引导的强化学习传感器选择框架，用于异构海洋传感器网络中的单船跟踪。通过PPO智能体在每个决策时刻只激活一个传感器，在CMMI Smart Marina仿真中实现了接近全激活的跟踪性能，同时避免了在线熵搜索的计算开销。
Motivation: 传统传感器管理要么激活所有传感器导致能耗和计算开销大，要么进行昂贵的在线期望信息增益计算，缺乏高效且性能接近全激活的选择策略。
Method: 采用PPO（Proximal Policy Optimization）智能体，观察信念状态、检测历史、覆盖、传感器几何和实现信息增益特征，奖励由实现信息增益门控可观测性掩码定义。在包含五个传感器的CMMI Smart Marina仿真中训练和测试。
Result: 与随机单传感器选择、始终全激活以及先前工作的预期信息增益基线相比，学习策略在跟踪精度上接近始终全激活，但每次只激活一个传感器，且避免了在线熵搜索的计算负担。
Conclusion: 该框架验证了强化学习可有效平衡异构传感器网络中的跟踪性能与计算成本，适用于海洋监视等场景。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Obliviate: Efficient Unlearning in Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning is becoming increasingly critical in the context of data privacy regulations, particularly for recommendation systems that are directly trained on user interaction data. The goal of this work is to remove requested interaction data and their downstream influence from trained model while preserving recommendation quality, and to do so without incurring the substantial computational cost of full retraining. Existing approaches exhibit several limitations, including limited unlearning completeness and degradation in recommendation performance, while having substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose Obliviate, an efficient two-stage unlearning framework for recommender systems that achieves high unlearning completeness while maintaining good utility. In the first stage, we introduce a Low-Rank Unlearning Adapter (LUA), which employs a lightweight Hessian proxy to enable curvature-aware and efficient unlearning through localized low-rank adapters rather than full parameters. In the second stage, we propose Locality-Aware Calibration (LAC), a lightweight refinement stage that updates only the adapter parameters to improve the performance by enforcing unlearning via ranking-based objectives while preserving utility through knowledge distillation. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that Obliviate achieves high level of forgetting with minimal loss in recommendation quality and at significantly reduced computational cost, offering a practical and scalable solution for large-scale recommender systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Obliviate，一个面向推荐系统的两阶段高效遗忘框架。第一阶段使用低秩遗忘适配器（LUA）通过轻量Hessian代理实现曲率感知的局部遗忘；第二阶段提出局部感知校准（LAC），通过排序目标和知识蒸馏更新适配器参数以恢复性能。实验表明Obliviate在遗忘完整性和推荐质量之间取得良好平衡，计算成本显著低于完整重训练。
Motivation: 推荐系统直接基于用户交互数据训练，但现有遗忘方法存在遗忘不彻底、推荐性能下降和计算开销大的问题，亟需高效且实用的解决方案。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 低秩遗忘适配器（LUA）使用Hessian代理进行曲率感知的局部参数更新；2) 局部感知校准（LAC）通过排序目标强制执行遗忘，并通过知识蒸馏保持推荐效用，仅更新适配器参数。
Result: 广泛实验表明Obliviate实现了高度遗忘，推荐质量损失极小，且计算成本显著降低，适用于大规模推荐系统。
Conclusion: Obliviate为推荐系统提供了一种实用且可扩展的高效遗忘方案，在隐私法规日益严格的背景下具有重要应用价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Block Boundaries: Multi-Block Editing for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Block diffusion has emerged as the dominant paradigm for scaling discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), because decoding text in fixed-size blocks preserves parallel generation within each block while keeping the quadratic attention cost tractable. However, this efficiency comes with a structural limitation: tokens near the end of a block are generated without access to future cross-block context, and once a block is finalized, its uncertain predictions become irreversible context for all subsequent blocks. This creates a block boundary problem, in which uncertainty accumulates toward block boundaries and early mistakes propagate throughout later generation. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Block Editing (MBE), to mitigate this problem by editing decoded tokens based on cross-block context. Following this principle, MBE first proposes a training-free decoding algorithm to edit the decoded tokens in previous blocks, which is achieved by re-opening a full-attention window over selected blocks. Given the mismatched attention mechanism between block diffusion training and MBE inference, MBE further introduces a supervised Fine-tuning strategy, which equips the model with bidirectional attention masks that progressively expands the editing span. Furthermore, it also extends SGLang with a multi-shape CUDA Graph pool and fine-grained KV cache control to make these variable-length editing passes efficient in practice. Experiments on LLaDA2.1-Mini across 13 benchmarks show that training-free MBE outperforms all existing decoding baselines while maintaining comparable throughput, and MBE SFT further brings a performance gain of 2.7. The largest improvements appear on tasks requiring strong long-range consistency, including +13.3 on AIME 2025 and +5.9 on ZebraLogic, demonstrating the effectiveness of MBE.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在LLaDA2.1-Mini的13个基准上，训练自由MBE优于所有现有解码基线且吞吐量相当；MBE SFT额外提升2.7，其中长程一致性任务收益最大：AIME 2025提升13.3，ZebraLogic提升5.9。

papers.title: CuraWeb: Joint Optimization of Quality, Redundancy, and Diversity for Web-Scale Pretraining Data
papers.abstract_en: Open-web corpora curated via highly selective filters, such as FineWeb-Edu and DCLM, constitute the core of LLM pretraining data and have significantly advanced LLM performance. However, these pipelines typically rely on singular optimization objectives, which inevitably narrows distributional diversity and marginalizes long-tail knowledge, thereby restricting data coverage and underutilizing the vast potential of the open web. To address this limitation, we propose a novel curation paradigm that shifts from linear pruning to the joint optimization of quality, redundancy, and diversity. This framework synergizes dual-track cleaning (rule-based and model-driven) with hybrid deduplication (n-gram and semantic), while employing a multi-objective sampler to balance informational quality with distributional breadth. Applying this framework to Common Crawl, we construct CuraWeb, a 2T-token English corpus. Unlike existing resources, CuraWeb establishes an industrial-grade standard for data curation by recovering a more holistic data distribution with enhanced diversity and minimal redundancy, achieving broader coverage of long-tail knowledge across diverse domains. Experimental evaluations at the 3B scale demonstrate that CuraWeb significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding an average performance gain of 1.8\% across a wide range of benchmarks, particularly in knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CuraWeb，一种从线性筛选转向联合优化质量、冗余度和多样性的网络级预训练数据策展范式。通过结合规则与模型驱动的双轨清洗、n-gram与语义混合去重，以及多目标采样器，作者从Common Crawl构建了2T词元的英文语料。在3B参数规模的实验表明，CuraWeb在多个基准上平均提升1.8%，尤其在知识密集与推理任务上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有高选择性过滤器（如FineWeb-Edu、DCLM）虽提升LLM性能，但单一优化目标导致分布多样性丧失和长尾知识边缘化，限制了开放网络的数据覆盖潜力。
Method: 提出联合优化质量、冗余度和多样性的策展框架，包含双轨清洁（规则与模型驱动）、混合去重（n-gram与语义）以及多目标采样器，以平衡信息质量与分布广度。
Result: 在3B参数规模上，CuraWeb显著优于现有基线，平均基准性能提升1.8%，尤其在知识密集与推理任务上表现更佳。
Conclusion: CuraWeb建立了工业级数据策展标准，通过恢复更全面的数据分布、增强多样性并最小化冗余，实现了对长尾知识的更广覆盖。

papers.title: TRE: Training-Free Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have recently gained increasing attention, yet their reliability is significantly hindered by the hallucination problem. Existing hallucination detection approaches for D-LLMs mainly follow a training-based paradigm, relying on data-driven training to optimize the detector. Such reliance not only limits their generalizability across domains models but also incurs additional training cost and deployment overhead. To address these limitations, we propose TRE, a training-free hallucination detection metric for D-LLMs. TRE is a parameter-free and single-run metric that estimates hallucination risk directly from the entropy signals of a single generation, without requiring any detector training or repeated sampling. TRE extracts entropy signals within the D-LLM decoding process along both the spatial and temporal dimensions. From a token-level spatial perspective, we focus on revealing tokens as the most informative carriers of uncertainty, capturing where uncertainty is actively committed. From a diffusion step-level temporal perspective, we empirically identify the dominance of late-step entropy and hence aggregate these signals with a simple linear weighting scheme to obtain TRE. Extensive experiments on multiple D-LLMs and QA datasets demonstrate that TRE achieves competitive performance, while enjoying strong generalizability, efficiency, and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（D-LLMs）的幻觉检测问题，提出了一种无需训练的检测指标TRE。TRE直接从单次生成的熵信号中估计幻觉风险，无需检测器训练或重复采样。实验表明TRE在多个D-LLM和问答数据集上达到有竞争力的性能，并具有良好的泛化性、效率和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有D-LLM幻觉检测方法依赖训练，限制了跨领域模型的泛化性并带来额外的训练和部署成本。
Method: 提出TRE，一个参数免费、单次运行的指标，从解码过程中沿空间和时间两个维度提取熵信号：空间上关注揭示令牌（revealing tokens）作为最信息量的不确定性载体；时间上识别后期步骤熵的主导地位，并用简单线性加权聚合信号。
Result: 在多个D-LLM和问答数据集上的实验表明，TRE取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: TRE是第一个无需训练的D-LLM幻觉检测指标，具有强泛化性、高效性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StanceBench: A Benchmark for Audio LLM-Based Interpersonal Stance Evaluation from Speech
authors: Laureano Moro-Velázquez (1) ((1) Electrical and Computer Engineering Department
papers.abstract_en: Speech-to-speech dialogue models increasingly depend on prosody and interactional nuance to convey social intent, yet benchmarks for these cues remain limited. We introduce StanceBench, a benchmark for measuring interpersonal stance in conversational speech and evaluating audio-capable LLMs as automated judges. Using the Seamless Interaction corpus, StanceBench (1) specifies 9 stance dimensions via role-prompt poles, (2) standardizes single-speaker and interaction-based evaluations, and (3) reports LLM-as-a-judge robustness, bias, and stance inference. Across evaluated stances, empathy and politeness are the easiest. Warmth and assertiveness are moderately separable with positivity skew/asymmetry. Honesty is the hardest and shows high prompt order bias, consistent with needing cross-turn evidence. Attentiveness is separable but aligns weakly with humans. Interaction stances are more context-sensitive, with threshold gaps and high variance, especially conflict regulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StanceBench，一个用于衡量对话语音中人际立场（interpersonal stance）的基准，并评估音频大语言模型（LLM）作为自动评判者的能力。基于 Seamless Interaction 语料库，该基准定义了9个立场维度，标准化了单说话人和交互评估，并报告了LLM的鲁棒性、偏差和立场推断结果。实验表明，同理心和礼貌最容易，诚实最难且具有高提示顺序偏差，交互立场更依赖上下文且方差大。
Motivation: 现有语音对话模型日益依赖韵律和交互细微差别来传达社交意图，但针对这些线索的基准仍然有限。
Method: 提出 StanceBench 基准，包含9个立场维度（通过角色提示极指定），标准化单说话人和基于交互的评估，并使用音频LLM作为自动评判者，同时评估其鲁棒性、偏见和立场推断能力。
Result: 摘要显示，同理心和礼貌是最容易的立场；温暖和自信可分离但存在正向偏斜/不对称；诚实最难，且表现出高提示顺序偏差；注意力可分离但与人类对齐较弱；交互立场（特别是冲突调节）对上下文更敏感，具有阈值间隙和高方差。
Conclusion: StanceBench 提供了一个标准化基准，用于评估音频LLM在对话语音中推断人际立场的能力，揭示了不同立场维度的难度差异和偏差特性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Between Suppression and Collapse: Evaluating Narrative Unlearning with LENS
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce disinformation-aligned narrative frames as plausible explanations, raising the question of whether existing machine-unlearning algorithms can suppress this behavior. We introduce Level-based Evaluation of Narrative Suppression (LENS), a contextualization based evaluation protocol for testing target narrative reproduction across direct, attributed, contrastive, and abstract resistance levels. We evaluate two source-grounded narratives: one framing Russia's war against Ukraine as forced by NATO expansion, and one framing the United States as exploiting or abandoning Taiwan. The experiments cover four near-12B multilingual instruction models: Lapa LLM, Gemma-12B, Qwen-14B, and TAIDE-Gemma. We introduce the Suppression-Collapse Efficiency (SCE) score as a checkpoint selection summary that rewards target-narrative suppression while penalizing degraded outputs. Our results shows that selected checkpoints can reduce narrative reproduction and suppression may transfer beyond direct forget prompts. We also report entity recovery as a separate side effect: abstract A/B/C prompts can cause models to recover the real-world actors associated with the target frame after unlearning. These findings demonstrate that LENS is a successful diagnostic protocol for both reporting and guiding the further study of the deeper structure of narrative unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LENS (Level-based Evaluation of Narrative Suppression) 评估协议，用于测试大语言模型经过机器遗忘后是否仍能复现特定叙事框架。该协议覆盖直接、归因、对比和抽象抵抗四个层次，并引入 Suppression-Collapse Efficiency (SCE) 分数作为检查点选择依据。实验基于两个地缘政治叙事（俄乌战争中的北约扩张叙事、美国对台湾的利用或放弃叙事）在四个近12B参数的多语言指令模型上进行，发现选中的检查点能减少叙事复现，且抑制效果可能迁移到直接遗忘提示之外，同时观察到实体恢复的副作用。
Motivation: 大语言模型可能以看似合理的解释复现虚假信息叙事框架，现有机器遗忘算法能否有效抑制这种行为尚不明确，需要更系统的评估方法。
Method: 提出 LENS 评估协议，通过直接、归因、对比和抽象抵抗四个层次测试模型对目标叙事的复现能力；引入 SCE 分数平衡叙事抑制与输出质量损失，用于选择最优检查点。
Result: 选中的检查点能有效减少叙事复现，且抑制效果可能泛化到遗忘提示之外；同时发现抽象 A/B/C 提示可能导致模型在遗忘后恢复与目标叙事相关的真实世界实体。
Conclusion: LENS 是一种有效的诊断协议，可用于报告和指导叙事遗忘机制的进一步研究，揭示遗忘的深层结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EventOD: Event-Aware OD Flow Generation via LLM-Guided Semantic Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating origin-destination (OD) flows under disruptive events is important for disaster response and urban resilience. Existing deep OD models trained on routine mobility often degrade when extreme events abruptly alter regional functions and population activities, while retraining a new generator for each event is impractical under limited event-time supervision. We propose EventOD, an event-adaptive OD generation framework that steers a pretrained OD generator using structured event semantics. EventOD first uses a large language model to infer region-level functional and demographic control vectors from coarse event observations. It then learns two lightweight adaptation modules, AlphaNet and BetaNet, to calibrate the magnitude of these semantic shifts, and further introduces a retrieval-augmented fallback pathway for scenarios with sparse supervision. The resulting event-conditioned features are injected into a pretrained graph diffusion OD model through input-level modulation, enabling event-aware adaptation without updating generator parameters. Experiments on hurricane- and pandemic-induced mobility across U.S. counties show that EventOD consistently improves both reconstruction accuracy and distributional fidelity over strong baselines. Source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EventOD-5C11/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EventOD 提出一个事件自适应 OD 生成框架，利用大语言模型从粗略事件观测中推断区域功能及人口统计的控制向量，再通过轻量自适应模块 AlphaNet 和 BetaNet 校准语义偏移，并将事件条件特征注入预训练的图扩散 OD 模型中，实现在不更新生成器参数的情况下进行事件感知的 OD 流生成。在美国县的飓风和疫情引起的移动性实验中，该方法在重建准确性和分布保真度上均优于现有强基线。
Motivation: 现有深度 OD 模型在常规移动性下训练，当极端事件突然改变区域功能和人口活动时表现下降；而针对每个事件重新训练生成器在有限的事件时间监督下不切实际。
Method: 利用大语言模型从粗粒度事件观测推断区域功能及人口统计控制向量；学习轻量自适应模块 AlphaNet 和 BetaNet 以校准语义偏移；并引入检索增强的备选路径应对监督稀疏场景；将事件条件特征通过输入层调制注入预训练图扩散 OD 模型。
Result: 在飓风和疫情引起的美国县移动性数据上，EventOD 在重建准确性和分布保真度上持续优于强基线。
Conclusion: EventOD 通过结构化事件语义引导预训练 OD 生成器实现事件自适应，无需重新训练，验证了其在灾害响应和城市韧性中的应用潜力。

papers.title: MINT-V2X: A Mobility-Integrated Network Trajectory Dataset for Predictive Resource Management
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication systems are based on datasets that not only contain vehicle trajectory data but also wireless network parameters with a realistic level of fidelity, enabling the creation of prediction and optimization models. There is a very critical research infrastructure gap today, and publicly available datasets are likely to be limited to one of the two: mobility or network parameters, and rarely provide a single, integrated view that combines both. This paper introduces MINT-V2X, a comprehensive dataset generated by coupling SUMO traffic dynamics with OMNeT++/Simu5G network simulation. The validation framework is composed of 14 standardized tests based on 3GPP Release 14 (C-V2X), ETSI standards and Shannon capacity theory. The resulting dataset contains 9.87 million synchronized data points from 1,386 vehicles from 15 roadside units (RSUs) during 3 hours of urban traffic simulation. We demonstrate strict algorithmic consistency through network metric correlations (CQI-SINR: 0.993; SINR-PDR: 0.946). Finally, we demonstrate the value of the dataset by conducting an RSU load prediction case study, showing that using trajectory data yields better predictive performance than network-history-only baselines. The dataset, experiments, and complete SUMO configuration files are available in the GitHub repository to facilitate reproduction on alternative simulation stacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINT-V2X，一个结合车辆移动轨迹和无线网络参数的集成数据集，用于 V2X 通信中的预测资源管理。数据集通过 SUMO 和 OMNeT++/Simu5G 仿真生成，包含 987 万条同步数据点，经 3GPP/ETSI 标准验证，并展示轨迹数据可提升 RSU 负载预测性能。
Motivation: 现有公开数据集往往只包含移动性数据或网络参数中的一种，缺乏两者结合的集成视图，阻碍了 V2X 预测与优化模型的研究。
Method: 通过耦合 SUMO 交通仿真和 OMNeT++/Simu5G 网络仿真生成集成数据，并依据 3GPP Release 14、ETSI 标准和香农容量理论设计 14 项标准化验证测试。
Result: 数据集包含 1386 辆车、15 个 RSU 的 987 万条同步数据点；网络指标相关性高（CQI-SINR: 0.993, SINR-PDR: 0.946）；RSU 负载预测案例表明轨迹数据优于仅用网络历史数据的基线。
Conclusion: MINT-V2X 提供了高保真度的集成数据集，可支持 V2X 中的预测资源管理研究，并公开代码和配置以促进复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Language Models Converge to Themselves? Recursive Self-Refinement as Textual Relaxation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in recursive refinement workflows, where an initial draft is repeatedly revised by the same model. Despite their growing use, the long-term dynamics of such workflows remain poorly understood. Does repeated refinement continue to improve outputs indefinitely, or does it converge toward a stable textual form? We study recursive self-refinement as a dynamical process in which repeated LLM revision drives text toward a model-preferred soft fixed-point region. Using GPT-5.5, we generate 10-step refinement trajectories for 50 ICML 2025 abstracts under both default-temperature and deterministic decoding, and additionally evaluate 15 ICML 2020 abstracts. We analyze normalized edit distance, exact and approximate fixed points, word-count stability, exponential relaxation, and external LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Across all settings, refinement trajectories rapidly saturate. Most edits occur within the first few iterations, after which trajectories enter a soft fixed-point region with only minor surface-level changes. Deterministic decoding reaches exact fixed points earlier and exhibits smaller residual fluctuations than default-temperature decoding, while both achieve universal approximate convergence. The average edit magnitude follows a consistent exponential relaxation pattern, suggesting convergence toward a model-preferred textual equilibrium rather than open-ended optimization. External evaluation indicates that converged abstracts improve clarity, conciseness, and scientific style while preserving technical meaning. These findings support a dynamical-systems view of LLM self-refinement and motivate practical stopping criteria based on edit-magnitude saturation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在递归自精炼（recursive self-refinement）工作流中的长期动力学。通过GPT-5.5对ICML摘要进行多步精炼实验，发现精炼轨迹迅速饱和，进入模型偏好的软不动点区域，编辑幅度呈指数衰减，表明这是趋近于文本均衡而非无限优化。
Motivation: 递归自精炼工作流日益广泛，但其长期行为尚不明确：重复精炼是否持续改善输出，还是会收敛到稳定形式？
Method: 使用GPT-5.5对50篇ICML 2025摘要和15篇ICML 2020摘要进行10步精炼，分别在默认温度（default-temperature）和确定性解码（deterministic decoding）下进行，分析归一化编辑距离、精确与近似不动点、词数稳定性、指数松弛及外部LLM评判。
Result: 所有设置下精炼轨迹迅速饱和，大部分编辑在初始几步发生后进入软不动点区域。确定性解码比默认温度解码更早达到精确不动点且残差波动更小。平均编辑幅度呈一致指数衰减，表明收敛于模型偏好的文本均衡。外部评判显示精炼后的摘要清晰度、简洁性和科学风格提升，技术含义保持不变。
Conclusion: 该实验支持将LLM自精炼视为动力学系统，并可根据编辑幅度饱和设定实用停止标准。

papers.title: KG2Code: Bridging Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models via Executable Code for Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Recent research has explored the integration of knowledge graphs (KGs) with large language models (LLMs) to enhance their performance on downstream knowledge-intensive tasks, particularly knowledge graph question answering (KGQA). Existing approaches primarily combine LLMs with KGs through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based, agent-based, and SPARQL-based methods. Although these methods have achieved notable success, they still suffer from several limitations, including structural information loss, unfaithful reasoning, and limited flexibility and generalization. To address these challenges, this paper proposes KG2Code, a novel approach that transforms knowledge graphs into a code-based representation, preserving structural semantics while naturally aligning with the code-aware pretraining of modern LLMs. Based on KG2Code, KG2Code-QA is further introduced as a KGQA framework that formulates KGQA as a code generation task. This formulation enables the generation of verifiable reasoning traces and executable code, thereby substantially mitigating the impact of hallucinations. In addition, an automated pipeline is developed to construct a large-scale, high-quality code corpus for effectively training open-source LLMs on KG2Code-QA. After training, LLMs are able to perform KGQA in zero-shot scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly outperforms existing KG-enhanced LLM methods for KGQA, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen KGs. The code and data are available at Github.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KG2Code方法，将知识图谱转换为代码表示，保留结构语义并与现代LLM的代码预训练对齐。基于此构建KG2Code-QA框架，将知识图谱问答（KGQA）重构为代码生成任务，生成可验证推理轨迹和可执行代码，以缓解幻觉问题。实验表明该方法在KGQA上显著优于现有KG增强LLM方法，并展现出对未见知识图谱的强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有结合知识图谱与LLM的方法（如RAG、Agent、SPARQL）存在结构信息丢失、推理不忠实、灵活性和泛化性有限等问题，亟待改进。
Method: 提出KG2Code将知识图谱转化为代码表示，并设计KG2Code-QA框架将KGQA作为代码生成任务。同时开发自动流水线构建大规模高质量代码语料，用于训练开源LLM在零样本场景下执行KGQA。
Result: 广泛实验表明，所提方法在KGQA任务上显著优于现有KG增强LLM方法，且对未见知识图谱表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过代码表示和代码生成范式，有效缓解LLM幻觉，提升KGQA的推理忠实度、灵活性与泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARdena: Scenario-driven control of real-time LLM agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled increasingly capable conversational agents, but reliably controlling their behavior in real-time interactive environments remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches often rely on model fine-tuning or alignment procedures that are difficult to adapt to changing interaction requirements. This paper introduces layered scenario-driven LLM control, a framework that enables runtime behavior control through structured prompting. By combining persistent context with scenario-specific constraints, the approach allows agent behavior to be modified during interaction without changing the underlying model. The framework is implemented in ARDena, a real-time multimodal embodied agent that integrates speech interaction, visual perception, tool use, and avatar-based response generation. The proposed approach is evaluated with respect to control effectiveness, response latency, and operational stability. The results demonstrate that scenario definitions alone can produce substantially different interaction behaviors while maintaining stable real-time operation, highlighting the effectiveness of scenario-driven prompting for controlling LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种层次化场景驱动的LLM控制框架，通过结构化提示实现运行时行为控制，无需微调模型。该框架在实时多模态具身智能体ARDena中实现，支持语音、视觉、工具使用和虚拟形象响应。实验表明，仅通过场景定义即可产生显著不同的交互行为，同时保持稳定的实时运行。
Motivation: 现有LLM agent控制方法依赖微调或对齐，难以适应实时交互中不断变化的需求。需要一种运行时可控且无需修改底层模型的方法。
Method: 提出分层场景驱动控制：结合持久上下文（persistent context）和场景特定约束（scenario-specific constraints），通过结构化的提示在交互过程中动态调整agent行为，无需更改底层LLM。
Result: 实验评估了控制有效性、响应延迟和运行稳定性，结果表明仅通过场景定义即可产生显著不同的交互行为，同时保持稳定实时操作。
Conclusion: 场景驱动提示（scenario-driven prompting）是控制LLM agent的有效方法，能够在不修改模型的前提下实现运行时行为定制，具备较好的部署灵活性。
