papers.title: STAIF: A Stage-wise Optimization for Complex Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Following complex instructions with multiple explicit constraints remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing alignment methods, such as DPO, optimize holistic reward signals that often underemphasize strict satisfaction of individual constraints, particularly under out-of-distribution or multi-constraint settings. In this paper, we propose STAIF, a stage-wise optimization framework that decouples the alignment of subjective (soft) constraints from the optimization of objectively verifiable (hard) constraints. Stage 1 applies preference optimization with multiple negative samples to sharpen sensitivity to soft constraints, while Stage 2 applies Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enforce strict compliance with hard constraints. To support this method, we construct STAINSTRUCT, a high-quality bilingual (English, Chinese) dataset of approximately 31,000 complex multi-constraint instructions. Extensive analyses validate the design of STAIF and show state-of-the-art performance on representative benchmarks against strong baselines, as well as genuine generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAIF，一种针对大型语言模型（LLM）复杂指令遵循的分阶段优化框架。第一阶使用多重负样本偏好优化提升对软约束的敏感性；第二阶段使用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）强制执行硬约束。同时构建了约31,000条中英双语多约束指令数据集 STAINSTRUCT，在多个基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法（如 DPO）优化整体奖励信号，往往忽略对单个约束的严格满足，尤其在分布外或多约束场景下表现不佳。
Method: 两阶段优化：阶段1采用多重负样本偏好优化增强软约束敏感性；阶段2采用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）强制执行硬约束。
Result: 在代表性基准上优于强基线，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 分阶段优化软硬约束能有效提升复杂指令遵循性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PTStore (Prefix Tensor Store): Distributed Prefix Caching and Replication for High Throughput Inference Serving
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by the design of client caching in Content Delivery Networks (CDNs), PTStore distributes and replicates popular tensors that form reusable KV cache prefixes, which are the main technique used by state of art approaches to accelerate inferences. This reduces the latency of accessing the KV cache and alleviates load imbalance caused by a disproportionately large number of requests on servers containing popular tensors. Furthermore, thanks to decentralization, PTStore allows the expansion of the size of the KV cache for LLM inference by orders of magnitude. As a result, PTStore can execute inferences on long passage Q\&A datasets 5-6 times more efficiently than current baselines, which do not aggregate memory across different nodes and GPUs and therefore require regenerating the KV cache.
papers.journal_ref: Euro-Par 2026: 32nd International European Conference on Parallel and Distributed Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受CDN客户端缓存启发，PTStore分布并复制形成可复用KV缓存前缀的流行张量，以加速LLM推理。它通过去中心化缓解了负载不均，并将KV缓存规模扩大了数个数量级。在长段落问答数据集上，PTStore比当前基线（不聚合跨节点GPU内存）效率高5-6倍。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理中，KV缓存的访问延迟和负载不均限制了吞吐量，且单个节点内存有限导致需要频繁重新生成KV缓存。
Method: 提出PTStore，一种分布式前缀缓存和复制系统，基于CDN设计思想，将流行张量（形成KV缓存前缀）分布存储并复制到多个节点，实现去中心化缓存。
Result: 摘要表明，在长段落问答数据集上，PTStore实现5-6倍的效率提升（相比不聚合跨节点GPU内存的基线）。
Conclusion: 通过去中心化缓存复制，PTStore能够显著扩大KV缓存规模并提高推理吞吐量，是解决LLM推理中KV缓存瓶颈的有效方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Extracting Algorithms in Pre-trained LLMs: A Case on Hidden Markov Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) display a striking ability to predict next observations from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) via in-context learning (ICL), but the algorithm underlying this capability remains undetermined: prior work has proposed several candidates without consensus, and none has been grounded in the model's internal activations. We close this gap with a three-stage pipeline. First, we empirically compare LLM behavior against a suite of candidate algorithms and narrow the space to three classes -- though no single class explains LLM behavior across all HMM settings and sequence lengths. Second, we derive theoretical connections between the three classes and show how each can be implemented in-context by a Transformer, validating the construction in a small trained Transformer. Third, returning to pre-trained LLMs, we introduce the Principal Activations Probe (PAP), a layer-wise probing and intervention method that isolates algorithmic signals in model activations. PAP reveals low-dimensional linear representations that causally drive model predictions and track empirical ICL performance. PAP further reveals how these representations shift with properties of the underlying HMM regime; distinct computational stages are localized to different layers. Together, our results connect the in-context behavior of pre-trained LLMs to the underlying internal mechanisms and advance our understanding of how LLMs perform ICL on HMMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三阶段流水线，揭示预训练大语言模型（LLM）如何通过上下文学习（ICL）预测隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的下一观测值。首先通过经验比较缩小候选算法空间至三类，其次理论证明这三类可由Transformer在上下文中实现，最后提出主激活探针（PAP）方法从模型激活中提取低维线性表示，该表示因果驱动预测并随HMM特性变化分布于不同层。
Motivation: 已有研究提出多种候选算法解释LLM在HMM上的ICL能力，但未达成共识，且缺乏从模型内部激活出发的验证。
Method: 三阶段流水线：（1）经验比较LLM行为与候选算法，聚焦三类算法；（2）理论推导三类算法间的联系及Transformer上下文实现；（3）提出主激活探针（PAP），逐层探测并干预激活，提取算法信号。
Result: 发现低维线性表示因果驱动预测且跟踪ICL性能；这些表示随HMM特性变化，不同计算阶段定位于不同层。
Conclusion: 将预训练LLM的ICL行为与内部机制联系起来，增进了对LLM在HMM上执行ICL的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DocHRL: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cost-Optimised Document Classification
papers.abstract_en: Real-world document classification pipelines typically apply the same sequence of models to every incoming document, regardless of its complexity or type. This leads to inefficient use of compute and human resources: simple documents are over-processed while difficult ones may not receive enough scrutiny. We introduce DocHRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns to adaptively and dynamically select the most cost-effective classification policy on a per-document basis. DocHRL formulates document classification as a sequential decision problem with a two-level policy hierarchy: a top-level policy selects among broad options (vision classifiers, LLMs, OCR, and human-in-the-loop review), while option-specific sub-policies choose the concrete model or tool to invoke. The reward signal is the negative total expected cost, which captures inference cost, cost of misclassification, and cost of human labelling. Trained with Proximal Policy Optimisation on the RVL-CDIP benchmark, DocHRL achieves a macro F1 of 0.973 across 16 document classes while reducing average per-document cost to 2.74 normalised units compared to substantially higher costs incurred by fixed standalone classifiers. Our results demonstrate that cost-aware reinforcement learning can simultaneously improve classification performance and operational efficiency in document understanding systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocHRL 提出一种层次强化学习框架，用于自适应地为每个文档选择成本最优的分类策略。该方法在 RVL-CDIP 基准上实现 macro F1 0.973，并将平均每文档成本降至 2.74 标准化单位，显著低于固定分类器。
Motivation: 现实文档分类管道对所有文档应用相同模型序列，导致简单文档过度处理而复杂文档可能处理不足，造成计算和人力浪费。
Method: 采用两级策略层次的强化学习：顶层策略选择宽泛选项（如视觉分类器、LLM、OCR、人工审核），子策略选择具体模型或工具。奖励信号为负期望总成本（包含推理成本、误分类成本和人工标注成本），使用 PPO 训练。
Result: 在 RVL-CDIP 16 类文档上取得 macro F1 0.973，平均每文档成本 2.74 标准化单位，远低于固定分类器的成本。
Conclusion: 成本感知的强化学习能同时提升文档分类系统的分类性能与运营效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reason Before You Retrieve: Agentic Planning for Multi-modal RAG
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG) aims to answer image-text queries with external knowledge, but most existing systems still retrieve directly from raw multimodal input over a flat evidence space. This design often struggles with two key challenges: the retrieval target is under-specified because the question intent must be grounded to the correct visual referent, and the search space is weakly structured, forcing semantically distinct evidence to compete in a single global ranking step. We propose MM-R2, a multimodal agentic retrieval framework that reasons before retrieval by explicitly modeling both what to retrieve and where to search. MM-R2 first constructs an intent-grounded retrieval state from the image-question pair, capturing the information need, grounded referent, and retrieval constraints. It then performs retrieval over a structured KnowledgeMap, where the agent selects relevant retrieval units before issuing grounded queries within them. To enable this capability, we build MM-R2-Traj, a large-scale trajectory dataset of multi-step retrieval processes, and adopt a two-stage post-training strategy with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. Experiments on Infoseek and Encyclopedic VQA datasets show that MM-R2 substantially outperforms strong baselines on answer accuracy while also yielding more interpretable and verifiable retrieval trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-R2，一个多模态智能检索增强生成框架，通过先推理后检索的策略，显式建模检索目标和搜索空间。框架构建意图导向的检索状态，并在结构化知识图谱上执行检索，同时构建了大规模轨迹数据集 MM-R2-Traj，采用两阶段后训练（SFT + GRPO）。在 Infoseek 和 Encyclopedic VQA 数据集上，该方法显著提升了答案准确性，并生成了更可解释的检索轨迹。
Motivation: 现有 mRAG 系统直接从原始多模态输入在平坦证据空间检索，面临检索目标不明确（问题意图需对应正确视觉指代）和搜索空间结构弱（语义不同的证据在全局排序中竞争）两大挑战。
Method: MM-R2 框架包含两部分：1) 从图像-问题对构建意图导向的检索状态，包含信息需求、指代对象和检索约束；2) 在结构化知识图谱上，智能体选择相关检索单元并发出查询。训练采用 MM-R2-Traj 轨迹数据集，结合监督微调和 GRPO。
Result: 在 Infoseek 和 Encyclopedic VQA 上，MM-R2 在答案准确率上大幅超过强基线，并产出更可解释和可验证的检索轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调先推理后检索的策略能有效解决多模态检索中的目标指定和空间结构化问题，并展示了可解释性优势。

papers.title: CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving the consistency required for production-facing analytics. We present CRAFT, a two-stage post-training recipe for schema-grounded coding agents. First, schema-stripped PLAN supervised fine-tuning learns domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without exhaustive prompt-time schema injection. Second, execution-shaped reinforcement learning aligns the policy for tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency, and recovery from failed executions. Training trajectories are curated through a Tri-Gate filter combining execution validation, data-integrity checks, and LLM-judge reasoning audit. We evaluate CRAFT for planned rollout in advertising analytics, covering campaign performance analysis, metric drill-downs, entity-level performance analysis, and multi-turn analytical refinement. The enterprise evaluation environment incorporates beta APIs as the agent-facing tool surface and spans 25 schema-linked core entities and 30 agentic workflows. Relative to a schema-stuffed baseline, CRAFT improves composite Agent Score by +9.6 pp, consistency by +4.1 pp, and multi-turn coherence by +4.2 pp, while reducing input-token burden by approximately 9x and schema-discovery loops by up to 5x. We further report deployment tradeoffs, reward-shaping limitations, and training-infrastructure extensions required for multi-turn tool-use reinforcement learning in enterprise settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CRAFT，一种面向企业编码智能体的两阶段后训练方法，旨在无需耗尽性模式注入的情况下学习稳定的模式知识和工具使用行为。第一阶段通过模式剥离的PLAN监督微调从验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划和可执行行为；第二阶段通过执行形状的强化学习对齐工具选择、代码质量等。在广告分析环境的评估中，CRAFT相对于注入模式的基线提高了Agent Score 9.6个百分点，同时减少输入令牌负担约9倍。
Motivation: 现有注入完整模式文档的方法增加了推理开销，复杂化了模式演化，并削弱了多轮分析的可靠性。论文旨在通过后训练获取稳定的模式知识和工具使用行为，同时保持生产所需的一致性。
Method: 两阶段后训练：第一阶段是模式剥离的PLAN监督微调，从验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划和可执行行为；第二阶段是执行形状的强化学习，对齐工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性和失败恢复。训练轨迹通过三重门滤波器（执行验证、数据完整性检查、LLM评审）筛选。
Result: 在广告分析环境中，相对于注入模式的基线，CRAFT提高了复合Agent Score 9.6个百分点，一致性4.1个百分点，多轮连贯性4.2个百分点，同时减少输入令牌负担约9倍，模式发现循环减少最多5倍。
Conclusion: 论文报告了企业环境中的部署权衡、奖励塑造限制以及多轮工具使用强化学习所需的训练基础设施扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoCluster, AutoTopicModeling, AutoTrendAnalysis: A Complete AutoML Pipeline for Predicting Emerging Trends
papers.abstract_en: Predicting emerging trends is vital for businesses, researchers, and policymakers; yet traditional approaches often lack scalability and adaptability. This paper presents a trend prediction framework based on Automated Machine Learning (AutoML), designed to extract insights from textual datasets with temporal attributes. The system ingests subject-specific textual entries accompanied by a date field. The pipeline begins with preprocessing and embedding, followed by AutoClustering, which uses meta-learning to select the optimal clustering algorithm. AutoTopicModeling then applies successive halving to identify the best topic modeling method: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), Latent Semantic Analysis (LSA), BERTopic, or Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) based on the coherence score for each cluster. For trend forecasting, AutoTrendAnalysis evaluates multiple models: Facebook Prophet, AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Seasonal-Trend decomposition using Loess (STL), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) selecting the most accurate based on Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), either through successive halving or exhaustive comparison. Topics are classified as strong signals, weak signals, or noise based on forecasting outcomes, enabling the identification of emerging trends. By automating clustering, topic modeling, and time series forecasting, this research enhances trend prediction accuracy while reducing manual effort. The proposed system offers a scalable and user-friendly solution suitable for real-time applications and stakeholders with limited machine learning expertise. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system's best trial achieves a final RMSE of 7.099, indicating high predictive accuracy.
papers.comment: Conference: 2025 International Conference on Computer and Applications (ICCA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于AutoML的端到端趋势预测框架，包括自动聚类、自动主题建模和自动趋势分析三个模块。系统从带时间戳的文本数据中提取洞察，通过元学习选择最优聚类算法，基于连贯性分数选择LDA、LSA、BERTopic或NMF进行主题建模，并评估Prophet、ARIMA、STL或LSTM进行趋势预测。实验表明最佳试验的RMSE为7.099，具有高预测精度。
Motivation: 传统趋势预测方法缺乏可扩展性和适应性，需要大量人工干预，难以处理大规模文本数据。
Method: 采用AutoML流水线：预处理和嵌入后，AutoClustering使用元学习选择最优聚类算法；AutoTopicModeling基于连贯性分数通过逐次减半法选择LDA、LSA、BERTopic或NMF；AutoTrendAnalysis评估Prophet、ARIMA、STL和LSTM，基于RMSE通过逐次减半或穷举比较选择最优模型。趋势分类为强信号、弱信号或噪声。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Causal Inference and Mediation Analyses of Environmental and Psychosocial Determinants of Subjective Cognitive Difficulties in the All of Us Research Program
papers.abstract_en: Short-term environmental exposures have been linked to cognitive and behavioral outcomes, although many reported associations may reflect broader geographic and contextual differences. Using longitudinal data from the All of Us Research Program (2018--2024), we linked daily weather and air-pollution exposures to repeated attention-related and subjective cognitive outcomes. Associations were evaluated using pooled, fixed-effects, lagged, and event-study analyses. Additional machine-learning analyses were conducted to explore potential heterogeneity and latent psychosocial structure. Replication analyses were performed using the 2024 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS). Several environmental exposure measures showed small associations with cognitive outcomes in pooled analyses, but most attenuated substantially after accounting for within-location temporal variation. Mediation, sensitivity, and machine-learning analyses yielded similar conclusions. In contrast, mental-health burden, loneliness, and social functioning were consistently associated with subjective cognitive difficulty and exhibited substantially larger effect sizes than environmental exposures. Similar patterns were observed in BRFSS. Exploratory AI-assisted analyses yielded findings broadly consistent with the primary longitudinal analyses. These findings suggest that short-term environmental perturbations may have limited associations with cognitive outcomes after accounting for within-location variation, whereas psychosocial factors appear to be more consistently associated with subjective cognitive burden.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 利用 All of Us 研究计划（2018-2024）纵向数据，结合日常天气和空气污染暴露与主观认知困难指标，采用多种统计和机器学习方法进行因果推断和中介分析。结果显示，在控制地点内时间变化后，短期环境暴露与认知结局的关联很弱，而心理健康、孤独感和社会功能等因素与认知困难关联更强且效应量更大。AI辅助探索性分析结果与主要纵向分析一致。
Motivation: 现有研究将短期环境暴露与认知行为结果关联，但许多报告关联可能反映更广泛的地理和背景差异，需要更严谨的因果推断方法剥离混杂因素。
Method: 使用 All of Us 纵向数据，链接每日天气和空气污染暴露与重复测量的注意力相关和主观认知结局；采用合并、固定效应、滞后和事件研究分析，以及机器学习探索异质性和潜在心理社会结构；并在 BRFSS 中复制。
Result: 合并分析中环境暴露与认知结局有微小关联，但在控制地点内时间变化后大多显著减弱；中介、敏感性和机器学习分析得出一致结论。心理社会因素（心理健康负担、孤独感、社会功能）与主观认知困难关联一致且效应量显著更大。
Conclusion: 短期环境扰动对认知结局的独立关联有限，而心理社会因素与主观认知负担关联更稳健。

papers.title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search. Toolsense shows that this regime has two critical drawbacks: it destroys parametric tool knowledge during training, and its beam-search decoding is too slow for real-time deployment. We introduce TRACE (Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules), a two-stage curriculum that resolves this dissociation. Stage 1 reuses the multi-format memorization SFT from ToolSense to seed tool knowledge with LoRA. Stage 2 is our core contribution: the model is trained to emit a thinking trace before producing a JSON list of tool tokens, using two data sources -- RRB pairs from ToolSense and queries synthesized to target business rules curated by domain experts -- both augmented with reasoning traces. This training objective preserves Stage 1 MCQ and QA probing accuracy while enabling single-beam greedy decoding at production latency. Evaluated on a combined enterprise catalog of 8,300+ tools across two enterprise product lines, TRACE training for Stage 2 not only preserves but improves tool understanding: MCQ accuracy gains +3.2 pp and QA probing gains +9 pp over Stage 1. On retrieval, TRACE achieves ~86% recall on Domain A and ~60% on Domain B -- compared to embedding baseline performance of ~27% & ~52% -- both with single-beam greedy decoding, making it directly deployable at production latency.

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE，一个两阶段课程学习方法，解决参数化工具检索中工具知识丢失和推理速度慢的问题。通过思维链训练和业务规则约束，在保留工具理解的同时实现高效解码。
Motivation: 现有的参数化工具检索方法（如ToolSense）存在两个关键缺陷：训练过程中破坏参数化工具知识，以及束搜索解码速度慢，无法用于实时部署。
Method: 提出两阶段课程：阶段一复用ToolSense的多格式记忆SFT用LoRA注入工具知识；阶段二是核心贡献，训练模型在输出工具token的JSON列表前生成思考轨迹，使用来自ToolSense的RRB对和领域专家策划的业务规则查询，两者都增强推理轨迹。训练目标保留阶段一的MCQ和QA探测准确率，同时支持单束贪婪解码实现生产级延迟。
Result: 在总计8300+工具的两位企业产品线上评估，阶段二训练不仅保留还提升了工具理解：MCQ准确率提升3.2个百分点，QA探测提升9个百分点。检索方面，域A召回率约86%，域B约60%，而嵌入基线分别约27%和52%，且使用单束贪婪解码，可直接部署。
Conclusion: TRACE通过业务规则驱动的思维链课程，在保持工具知识的同时实现了快速、高召回的工具检索，适用于企业LLM的实时部署。

papers.title: Fast Cross-Scenario Adaptation of CSI Models via Channel Conditional Parameter Generation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has shown strong potential for massive multiple-input multiple-output (Massive MIMO) physical-layer tasks, including channel state information (CSI) feedback and channel estimation. However, environmental heterogeneity can severely degrade CSI models in unseen scenarios, while conventional adaptation requires target-domain data and substantial computation. This paper proposes Channel Conditional Parameter Generation (CCPG), an end-to-end pipeline for rapid deployment of CSI models in dynamic wireless environments. CCPG identifies scene-sensitive adaptation bottlenecks through component-freezing experiments and generates only lightweight LoRA weights instead of full model parameters. It compresses high-dimensional channel features into compact latent conditions using cascaded SVD and a Perceiver Resampler. An energy-based canonicalization mechanism mitigates permutation and sign ambiguities in LoRA weights, while a diffusion-based generator incorporates structural information and an asymmetric size-aware loss for topology-aware parameter generation. Experiments on DeepMIMO and WAIR-D for CSI feedback and channel estimation show that CCPG adapts to new scenarios in about 3 seconds with a single forward pass, without target-scenario training or fine-tuning, and achieves cross-domain recovery performance comparable to costly online adaptation. These results demonstrate that CCPG enables efficient deployment of CSI models in large-scale dynamic wireless scenarios for intelligent 6G communications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Channel Conditional Parameter Generation (CCPG)方法，用于在动态无线环境中快速部署CSI模型。CCPG通过冻结模型组件识别场景敏感瓶颈，仅生成轻量LoRA权重，利用级联SVD和Perceiver Resampler压缩信道特征，并用能量规范化解决LoRA歧义，扩散生成器结合结构信息。在DeepMIMO和WAIR-D数据集上，CCPG可在约3秒内单次前向适应新场景，无需目标场景训练或微调，跨域恢复性能接近昂贵的在线适应。
Motivation: 深度学习在Massive MIMO物理层任务中表现优异，但环境异质会导致CSI模型在未见场景中性能严重下降，传统适应需要目标域数据和大量计算。
Method: 提出端到端CCPG管线，包括组件冻结实验识别适应瓶颈、仅生成轻量LoRA权重、级联SVD和Perceiver Resampler压缩信道特征、能量规范化机制消除LoRA权重歧义、扩散生成器利用结构信息和非对称尺寸感知损失进行拓扑感知参数生成。
Result: 在DeepMIMO和WAIR-D上针对CSI反馈和信道估计的实验表明，CCPG能在约3秒内通过单次前向适应新场景，无需目标场景训练或微调，跨域恢复性能接近昂贵的在线适应。
Conclusion: CCPG能够在大规模动态无线场景中高效部署CSI模型，支持智能6G通信。

papers.title: Answering Path Queries under Linear and Guarded Existential Rules
papers.abstract_en: Ontology-mediated query answering is concerned with the problem of answering queries over knowledge bases consisting of a database instance and an ontology. While most work in the area focuses on conjunctive queries (CQs), navigational queries have gained increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate the complexity of answering two-way (conjunctive) regular path queries ((C)RPQs) over knowledge bases whose ontology is given by a set of guarded existential rules. We first consider the subclass of linear existential rules and show that (C)RPQ answering is NL-complete in data complexity, which matches the data complexity of answering RPQs over plain graph databases (i.e., without an ontology). In combined complexity, both tasks are ExpTime-complete in the general case, but RPQ and CRPQ answering drop to PTime-complete and PSpace-complete respectively if there is a bound on predicate arity. For guarded rules, we provide a non-trivial reduction to the linear case, which allows us to show that the complexity of (C)RPQ answering is the same as for CQs, namely 2ExpTime-complete in combined complexity (ExpTime-complete in the bounded-arity case) and PTime-complete in data complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在由守卫存在规则（guarded existential rules）构成的本体下，回答双向（合取）正则路径查询（(C)RPQs）的复杂度。对于线性存在规则，(C)RPQ回答在数据复杂度上为NL-完全，与无本体时的RPQ相当；在组合复杂度上，一般情况为ExpTime-完全，有界谓词元数时RPQ降为PTime-完全，CRPQ为PSpace-完全。对于守卫规则，通过非平凡归约到线性情况，得到与合取查询相同的复杂度：组合复杂度2ExpTime-完全（有界元数时ExpTime-完全），数据复杂度PTime-完全。
Motivation: 现有本体中介查询回答主要关注合取查询，而对导航查询（如正则路径查询）的关注不足。本文旨在填补对线性与守卫存在规则下路径查询回答复杂度的理论空白。
Method: 通过复杂度归约证明：将守卫规则下的(C)RPQ回答归约到线性规则的情形，并分别分析数据复杂度和组合复杂度。
Result: 线性存在规则下，(C)RPQ回答的数据复杂度为NL-完全（与无本体相同），组合复杂度为ExpTime-完全（有界元数时RPQ为PTime-完全，CRPQ为PSpace-完全）；守卫规则下，复杂度与合取查询一致：组合复杂度2ExpTime-完全（有界元数ExpTime-完全），数据复杂度PTime-完全。
Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了线性与守卫存在规则下路径查询回答的复杂度边界，表明在线性规则下导航查询并未增加数据复杂度，而在守卫规则下与合取查询复杂度相同。

papers.title: CallBench: A Benchmark for Dual-Goal Coordination in Phone Call Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Target-oriented dialogue systems have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing user goals through interactive conversations. However, existing studies are primarily designed for single, explicit goal completion, while phone call assistants face a proxy setting that requires coordinating the device owner's explicit preset goal with the caller's implicit and dynamic goal. We introduce \textsc{CallBench}, a Chinese benchmark for evaluating dual-goal coordination in phone call assistants. \textsc{CallBench} contains 50,000 complete multi-turn phone call dialogues across six scenarios: takeout, delivery, taxi, work, life, and harassment. It covers regular presets, emergent presets, and no-preset cases, and includes diverse relations between owner-side and caller-side goals, such as alignment, complementarity, irrelevance, and conflict. We further design a preset-aware turn-level evaluation protocol covering semantic understanding, context use, active guidance, response quality, preset compliance, dialogue rhythm, and safety. Experiments on representative dialogue methods show that existing approaches still struggle with this task, highlighting the need for phone call assistants that can make reliable turn-level decisions between two independent goals under proxy constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CallBench，一个用于评估电话助手双目标协调能力的中文基准。该基准包含 50,000 个多轮电话对话，覆盖六类场景，包括规则预设、紧急预设和无预设情况，并涉及所有者与呼叫者目标之间的对齐、互补、无关和冲突关系。实验表明现有对话方法在此任务上表现不佳，凸显了电话助手在代理约束下协调双目标的挑战。
Motivation: 现有目标导向对话系统主要针对单一明确目标，而电话助手需协调设备所有者的预设目标与呼叫者的动态目标，缺乏相应的评估基准。
Method: 构建包含 50,000 个中文多轮电话对话的数据集，覆盖六类场景及多种目标关系，并设计预设感知的逐轮评估协议，涵盖语义理解、上下文使用、主动引导、响应质量、预设合规、对话节奏和安全性七个维度。
Result: 评估多种代表性对话方法，发现现有方法在双目标协调上表现欠佳，难以做出可靠的逐轮决策。
Conclusion: 工作强调了电话助手中双目标协调的难度，并提出了一套评估协议，期望推动该方向的研究。

papers.title: PRESTO: Prefix-Aligned Tree Drafting for Diffusion Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, generating tokens in parallel. This makes them effective draft models for speculative decoding (SD), producing an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass. Yet existing diffusion-based drafting methods rely on linear drafting, even though dLLMs emit multiple candidate tokens across positions, inducing a large combinatorial space of decoding paths. Consequently, they limit acceptance length and decoding efficiency. To exploit this multi-candidate structure, we apply tree-based drafting to diffusion drafters, enabling exploration of diverse candidate paths. However, we find that naive tree drafting is suboptimal: diffusion marginals are prefix-blind, mismatching the prefix-based AR verification and yielding unreliable path ranking. We propose PRESTO, a principled framework that extends tree-based drafting to diffusion drafters while resolving the fundamental mismatch between diffusion draft confidence and prefix-based AR verification through PREfix-aligned Scoring and priority-based Tree search for diffusion speculative decOding. The key principles behind PRESTO are that (1) candidate ranking should align with the prefix-based nature of AR verification, and (2) tree construction should prioritize candidate paths with high verification potential to maximize acceptance length. Extensive experiments show that PRESTO achieves up to an average of $1.5\times$ end-to-end throughput speedup on the state-of-the-art dedicated diffusion drafter SD and an average of $1.12\times$ on self-speculative diffusion LLMs across diverse benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRESTO 框架，用于扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的投机解码。现有扩散草稿方法采用线性草稿，未能利用 dLLM 生成的多个候选 token，导致解码效率受限。PRESTO 通过前缀对齐评分和优先级树搜索，将树草稿思想扩展到扩散草稿器，解决扩散草稿置信度与前缀自回归验证之间的不匹配。实验表明，在专用扩散草稿模型 SD 上平均端到端吞吐量提升 1.5 倍，在自投机扩散 LLM 上提升 1.12 倍。
Motivation: 现有扩散草稿方法（线性草稿）未能利用 dLLM 生成的多候选 token 结构，限制了接受长度和解码效率。
Method: 提出 PRESTO，核心是前缀对齐评分（Prefifix-aligned Scoring）和优先级树搜索（Priority-based Tree Search），以匹配自回归验证的前缀性质。
Result: 在 state-of-the-art 专用扩散草稿模型 SD 上平均端到端吞吐量加速 1.5 倍，在自投机扩散 LLM 上平均加速 1.12 倍。
Conclusion: 通过将树草稿思想扩展到扩散草稿器并解决前缀对齐问题，显著提升扩散投机解码的效率。

papers.title: Evolving from Lessons: Skill-Augmented Table Graph Reasoning for Operation-wise Table Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Table Question Answering (TableQA) aims to reason over tables to answer user queries. Existing research treats all questions uniformly and evaluates solely through overall accuracy, obscuring a critical reality that LLMs excel at simple lookups yet struggle with complex operations like aggregation and arithmetic. To reveal this disparity, we introduce a novel \emph{Operation-wise TableQA} task with a fine-grained question taxonomy and release two datasets named WikiTQ-ow and TabFact-ow for evaluation. As for modeling bottlenecks, existing methods flatten tables into linearized texts, disrupting inherent structures and inducing the ``lost-in-the-middle'' issue, which poses a primary barrier to complex cross-row reasoning. Moreover, they typically reason from scratch, neglecting reusable patterns shared across similar operations. To address these limitations, we propose a Skill-augmented Table Graph Reasoning (SkillTGR) framework for self-evolving structured reasoning. Specifically, SkillTGR represents tables as attributed graphs with explicit row-column-cell structures, where LLMs plan and execute dynamic chains to retrieve evidence subgraphs for graph traversal reasoning. Based on this, SkillTGR builds a hierarchical SkillBank to distill reason trajectories into abstract skills under cognitive heuristics, then hybrid retrieves both successful and failed skills for contrastive augmented table graph reasoning, thereby enabling the continual self-evolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillTGR achieves superior performance with an average of 5.91\% overall and 6.03\% operation-wise improvement, also reducing 19.76\% token consumption and 27.64\% inference latency. Our codes and data will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Operation-wise TableQA任务，揭示LLM在简单查询和复杂操作（如聚合、算术）上的表现差异，并构建两个细粒度数据集WikiTQ-ow和TabFact-ow。针对现有方法将表格线性化导致结构破坏和“中间丢失”问题，以及从零推理缺乏复用模式，提出Skill-augmented Table Graph Reasoning (SkillTGR)框架，将表格表示为属性图，通过动态链规划提取证据子图，并构建层级技能库蒸馏推理路径，混合检索成功和失败技能进行对比增强推理。实验表明SkillTGR平均提升5.91%整体准确率和6.03%操作级准确率，同时减少19.76%令牌消耗和27.64%推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有TableQA研究对所有问题统一评估，掩盖了LLM在简单查找与复杂操作上的能力差异。同时，现有方法将表格线性化破坏结构，且从零推理缺乏对可复用模式的利用。
Method: 提出SkillTGR框架：将表格建模为带属性的图结构，LLM规划并执行动态链检索证据子图；构建层级SkillBank蒸馏推理轨迹为抽象技能，混合检索成功与失败技能进行对比增强推理。
Result: 在WikiTQ-ow和TabFact-ow上，SkillTGR平均提升5.91%整体准确率和6.03%操作级准确率，并降低19.76%令牌消耗和27.64%推理延迟。
Conclusion: 本文通过细粒度操作级评估和结构化图推理，验证了复用技能模式能有效提升TableQA复杂操作性能，并降低资源消耗。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VlogReward: Learning Multi-Dimensional Evaluation for Vlog Editing
papers.abstract_en: The rapid rise of vlogs as a personalized storytelling medium has created a demand for automated systems to evaluate and refine vlog editing plans. However, vlog assessment is highly subjective and remains challenging due to a lack of standardized criteria, dataset and benchmark, and effective reward models. To address these challenges, we define a comprehensive vlog evaluation framework guided by professional vlog creators and product managers, establishing a taxonomy of six key dimensions, i.e., Creativity, Consistency, Concept Design, Cinematography, Narration, and Pacing. Subsequently, we curate a large-scale dataset of 100k vlog edits and a dedicated benchmark, VRMBench, to evaluate the vlog rewarding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Finally, we present VlogReward, a robust vlog reward model that can provide both fine-grained multi-dimensional scores and actionable feedback for iterative refinement. Technically, we enhance the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework by introducing an adjustable inter-group comparison reward, which mitigates the "direction blindness" issue of standard GRPO and enables the model to better distinguish varied-quality edits. VlogReward achieves state-of-the-art results that significantly outperform existing MLLMs, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro. We hope that our study can help vlog creators and foster automated vlog evaluation and refinement systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对vlog编辑评估缺乏标准化标准、数据集和奖励模型的问题，定义了包含创造力、一致性、概念设计、电影摄影、叙事和节奏六个维度的评估框架，并构建了10万条vlog编辑的大规模数据集和基准VRMBench。提出的VlogReward奖励模型通过引入可调节组间比较奖励来改进GRPO，在多个维度上提供细粒度评分和可操作反馈，超越GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro等现有MLLM。
Motivation: vlog评估高度主观，缺乏标准化标准、数据集和基准，以及有效的奖励模型。
Method: 定义六维度评估框架，构建100k vlog编辑数据集和VRMBench基准；提出VlogReward模型，通过引入可调节组间比较奖励改进GRPO，缓解标准GRPO的“方向盲目性”。
Result: VlogReward在VRMBench等基准上达到SOTA，显著超越GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro。
Conclusion: 本文工作有望帮助vlog创作者并推动自动vlog评估与改进系统的发展。

papers.title: Masked Distillation: Internalizing the Chain-of-Thought in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) produce long, explicit chains of intermediate steps before generating a final answer at inference time. These intermediate traces dominate latency, memory usage, and serving cost, even though the final answer correctness is not causally related to the trace correctness and the trace length is not a reliable indicator of the problem complexity. This raises a natural question: can the computation expressed in these intermediate tokens be internalized into the parameters of a language model, enabling it to produce answers directly (or with much shorter intermediate traces)? We introduce \textit{masked distillation}, a knowledge-distillation framework in which a student LLM is trained to predict only the solution tokens conditioned on the question, while a reasoning teacher provides feedback on the student's responses after conditioning on the question and its own CoT trace. We instantiate this framework in two settings: (i) a \textit{self-distillation} setting, in which the same model serves as the teacher in thinking mode and as the student in non-thinking mode, and (ii) a \textit{dual-model} setting, in which a larger reasoning teacher supervises a separate smaller non-thinking student over the solution tokens. By treating intermediate tokens as a scaffold which reasoning models use to fit over the solution tokens, We additionally vary the length of intermediate-token scaffolding the student is supervised on, interpolating between full internalization (the student emits only the solution) and no internalization (the student emits the full trace before the answer). We evaluate the framework through controlled experiments on two reasoning domains: GSM8K (grade-school arithmetic) and Countdown (a number-puzzle search task).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出遮蔽蒸馏框架，使学生LLM直接预测答案而无需完整思维链，通过教师对条件预测的反馈实现内部化。在GSM8K和Countdown任务上进行了实验。
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）产生冗长的中间步骤，导致高延迟和计算成本，而答案正确性与中间步骤的正确性并不因果相关。因此希望将中间步骤的计算内部化到模型参数中。
Method: 引入遮蔽蒸馏，学生模型仅基于问题预测答案，教师模型在问题+自身思维链条件下提供反馈。包括自蒸馏和双模型两种设置，并变化中间步骤监督长度。
Result: 在GSM8K和Countdown两个推理领域进行了受控实验，展示了内部化中间步骤的效果。
Conclusion: 遮蔽蒸馏框架能够使模型在保持答案质量的同时减少中间步骤长度，从而降低推理成本。

papers.title: TokenMem: Faithful Knowledge Injection for Frozen LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but suffers from knowledge conflicts: when retrieved information contradicts parametric memory, the shared self-attention pathway produces unpredictable outputs. We present TokenMem, a lightweight memory system that injects knowledge into frozen LLMs through a dedicated cross-attention channel, bypassing competition with parametric memory in the residual stream. TokenMem trains only a thin gating adapter ($\sim$3-7M parameters) via a two-phase curriculum: first learning general knowledge utilization, then strengthening faithful compliance under counterfactual knowledge. In controlled experiments on five models spanning three families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, OLMo-3-7B), TokenMem achieves 69-70% Knowledge Compliance (KC) on counterfactual benchmarks, compared to 20-52% for vanilla RAG, a gap of up to 49 percentage points. Ablation studies show that the two-phase curriculum is critical: removing Phase 2 collapses KC to near-zero. Mechanistic analysis reveals that the gate adapter learns a conflict-aware, layer-specific injection strategy without explicit supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TokenMem 是一种轻量级记忆系统，通过专用交叉注意力通道将知识注入冻结的大语言模型，避免与参数记忆的竞争。采用两阶段课程训练一个薄门控适配器（约3-7M参数），在五个模型上实现69-70%的知识合规率，相比普通RAG提升最多49个百分点。消融实验表明两阶段课程至关重要。
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）面临知识冲突问题：当检索信息与参数记忆矛盾时，共享自注意力路径会产生不可预测的输出。现有方法缺乏对冻结LLM的忠实知识注入机制。
Method: 提出TokenMem，包含一个专用交叉注意力通道和一个两阶段课程训练的门控适配器。第一阶段学习通用知识利用，第二阶段在反事实知识下加强忠实合规。
Result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B五个模型上，TokenMem在反事实基准上达到69-70%知识合规率，而普通RAG仅20-52%，差距高达49个百分点。消融实验显示移除第二阶段后合规率降至接近零。
Conclusion: TokenMem通过分离知识注入通道和两阶段训练有效解决了RAG中的知识冲突问题，提升了冻结LLM的知识忠实度。

summary_sections.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）面临知识冲突问题：当检索信息与参数记忆矛盾时，共享自注意力路径会产生不可预测的输出。现有方法缺乏对冻结LLM的忠实知识注入机制。
summary_sections.method: 提出TokenMem，包含一个专用交叉注意力通道和一个两阶段课程训练的门控适配器。第一阶段学习通用知识利用，第二阶段在反事实知识下加强忠实合规。
summary_sections.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B五个模型上，TokenMem在反事实基准上达到69-70%知识合规率，而普通RAG仅20-52%，差距高达49个百分点。消融实验显示移除第二阶段后合规率降至接近零。
summary_sections.conclusion: TokenMem通过分离知识注入通道和两阶段训练有效解决了RAG中的知识冲突问题，提升了冻结LLM的知识忠实度。

papers.title: CHS-SQL: A Text-to-SQL approach based on Confidence-Guided Heuristic Search Schema Linking process
papers.abstract_en: Recently, there have been several works in the Text-to-SQL domain that utilize Small Language Models (SLMs) for training. These approaches achieve performance close to that of large models in generating SQL, using only the computational power of a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, while also ensuring data security. Most existing methods filter out redundant tables and columns during Schema Linking to improve Text-to-SQL accuracy. However, they do not consider the precision-recall trade-off when selecting the candidate schema subset. Our research found that both the precision and recall of Schema Linking directly affect the final SQL accuracy. Therefore, we propose a novel framework for efficiently fine-tuning SLMs on Text-to-SQL tasks, CHS-SQL, that not only balances precision and recall but also improves overall performance on Text-to-SQL tasks. Its main innovation lies in the Schema Linking phase, where a heuristic search combined with model internal confidence is employed to achieve an optimal precision-recall trade-off. This elaborated mechanism maximizes the precision of relevant schema candidates for the generated SQL queries while suppressing irrelevant noise. The same strategy is further applied during SQL generation to refine candidate queries while helping the SLM to avoid trapping in a local optimum. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on Text-to-SQL tasks via SLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHS-SQL，一种针对小语言模型（SLM）的 Text-to-SQL 框架。核心创新在于模式链接阶段使用启发式搜索结合模型内部置信度，以优化精确率和召回率的权衡，并进一步将类似策略应用于 SQL 生成阶段以避免局部最优。摘要报告该方法在 SLM 上达到了 SOTA 结果。
Motivation: 现有模式链接方法未考虑精确率-召回率权衡，而这两者直接影响最终 SQL 的准确性。
Method: 提出 CHS-SQL，在模式链接阶段使用启发式搜索和模型内部置信度来优化候选模式的精确率和召回率，并在 SQL 生成阶段应用相同策略以避免局部最优。
Result: 摘要声称在 SLM 的 Text-to-SQL 任务上达到了 SOTA。
Conclusion: 强调平衡精确率和召回率可以提升小语言模型在 Text-to-SQL 上的性能。

papers.title: Learning When to Reason for Text-to-SQL via SFT and DPO
papers.abstract_en: Recent Text-to-SQL methods rely heavily on reasoning-centric paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), achieving substantial gains on complex benchmarks at the cost of high inference-time overhead. However, a large fraction of real-world queries are simple lookups or aggregations that can be resolved without multi-step deduction, making forced reasoning wasteful. Thus, we propose AutoThinkSQL, a framework that integrates an auto-thinking mechanism into both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on Text-to-SQL. Our approach enables the model to dynamically bypass reasoning for simple queries while invoking deep CoT for complex queries. On Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, our method achieves consistent gains compared to the best counterpart baseline on both Spider and BIRD benchmarks while simultaneously reducing average output tokens by 24.6% and 18.3%, and average latency by 17.1% and 11.5% compared to CoT-only generation. Further analysis indicates that the model learns to align its reasoning decisions with query difficulty.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/autothinksql
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoThinkSQL框架，将自动思考机制整合到SFT和DPO中，使模型能够为简单查询动态绕过推理，为复杂查询启用深度CoT，从而在Text-to-SQL任务上提高性能并减少输出token和延迟。
Motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法强制对所有查询进行链式推理，导致简单查询上的推理开销浪费，且增加了延迟。
Method: 提出AutoThinkSQL，通过在SFT和DPO中引入自动思考机制，让模型根据查询难度动态决定是否进行推理。
Result: 在Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B上，相比CoT-only方法，在Spider和BIRD基准上取得一致提升，同时平均输出token减少24.6%和18.3%，平均延迟降低17.1%和11.5%。
Conclusion: 模型学会将推理决策与查询难度对齐，实现了效率与效果的平衡。

papers.title: Opti-Q: A Constraint-Based Optimization Framework for Multi-LLM Question Planning
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) enable strong question answering (QA), budgeted deployment is complicated by nondeterminism and heterogeneous resource profiles (cost, latency, and energy). We present OPTI-Q, a database-inspired, cost-based optimizer that implements a plan-before-execute paradigm for multi-LLM orchestration. OPTI-Q models LLM invocations as physical operators in an execution DAG and, for each question, searches for plans that optimize answer quality (QoA) while trading off financial cost, latency, and energy under user-specified resource constraints. Plans can include sequential operators that pass intermediate answers as context and parallel/blend operators that run models concurrently and merge their outputs. To search this space without executing each candidate plan, OPTI-Q uses PERFDB, a statistics catalog populated and refreshed from benchmarks and execution traces, to estimate the QoA and resource costs of both individual operators and composed subplans. Using these estimates, OPTI-Q performs Pareto-frontier search and selects a final plan based on user preferences. On MMLU-Pro and SimpleQA under user-specified budgets, OPTI-Q improves average QoA by ~58% and ~41% over baselines at comparable cost, demonstrating that database-style planning yields better quality-resource trade-offs for multi-LLM QA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OPTI-Q，一个受数据库启发的基于成本的优化器，用于多LLM编排。它实现了一种先规划后执行的范式，通过执行DAG建模LLM调用，并为每个问题搜索优化回答质量同时权衡成本、延迟和能耗的计划。使用PERFDB统计目录进行估计，并通过帕累托前沿搜索选择最终计划。在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA上，在用户指定预算下，平均回答质量相比基线提升约58%和41%。
Motivation: 预算受限的多LLM问答部署面临非确定性和异构资源剖面的复杂性，缺乏系统化的质量-资源权衡规划方法。
Method: OPTI-Q将LLM调用建模为执行DAG中的物理算子，使用PERFDB统计目录估计质量和资源成本，通过帕累托前沿搜索在约束下选择最优计划。
Result: 在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA上，OPTI-Q在可比成本下将平均回答质量分别提升约58%和41%。
Conclusion: 数据库风格的规划方法能够为多LLM问答实现更好的质量-资源权衡。

papers.title: A Resolution of the SS--RS--GD Inequalities
papers.abstract_en: Yun, Sra, and Jadbabaie (COLT 2021, open question) conjectured the SS--RS--GD inequalities: for well-conditioned symmetric matrices $A_1,\dots,A_n$, the operators $W_{ss}$, $W_{rs}$, and $W_{gd}$ that encode the expected iterate of single-shuffle SGD, random-reshuffle SGD, and gradient descent on a quadratic finite sum should satisfy \[ \|W_{ss}\|\le \| W_{rs}\|\le \|W_{gd}\|. \] The conjecture is resolved, $\bullet$ SS-RS inequality fails. Already for $n=3$, $K=2$, and $d=4$, we exhibit explicit PSD matrices whose condition number is arbitrarily close to $1$, yet $\|W_{ss}\|>\|W_{rs}\|$. $\bullet$ RS-GD inequality holds. For every symmetric $A_i$ with $\bigl(1-\frac1{4n^2+1}\bigr)I\preceq A_i\preceq I$, one has $\|W_{rs}\|\le\|W_{gd}\|$. The proof was found via GPT-5.5 Pro extended prompted by the author.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文解决了Yun, Sra, Jadbabaie提出的SS-RS-GD不等式猜想。通过构造反例，证明SS-RS不等式不成立（对于n=3, K=2, d=4，存在条件数任意接近1的PSD矩阵使得||W_ss|| > ||W_rs||），并证明RS-GD不等式在特定条件下成立（对于所有对称矩阵A_i满足(1-1/(4n^2+1))I ≤ A_i ≤ I，有||W_rs|| ≤ ||W_gd||）。证明过程借助了GPT-5.5 Pro的扩展提示。
Motivation: 针对单次洗牌SGD、随机重洗SGD和梯度下降在二次有限和上的期望迭代算子范数大小关系，验证一个已被提出的猜想是否成立。
Method: 通过构造具体反例（n=3, K=2, d=4，矩阵条件数任意接近1）证明SS-RS不等式失败；利用矩阵分析和数值计算工具（GPT-5.5 Pro辅助）证明RS-GD不等式在给定条件下成立。
Result: SS-RS不等式不成立，存在反例；RS-GD不等式在条件(1-1/(4n^2+1))I ≤ A_i ≤ I下成立。
Conclusion: 完全解决了SS-RS-GD不等式猜想，揭示了不同SGD变体与梯度下降之间算子范数的确切关系，并展示了AI辅助证明的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Masked Autoencoders Learn Perception-Relevant Representations from Resting State Neural Data
papers.abstract_en: Clinical neuroprosthetics face a data bottleneck: labeled perception trials are scarce while hours of spontaneous neural activity are largely underutilized. Here, we test whether self-supervised learning can use these unlabeled datasets to improve perception decoding. We pretrained a masked autoencoder on 14.6 hours of spontaneous multiunit activity from an intracortical array in a blind participant's V1. The model captured interpretable brain structure without supervision: V1's spatial organization and perceptual state separation both emerged purely from its latent representations. To test these features, we used linear probing (logistic regression on the frozen latents) to measure performance on the data with stimulation. Perception decoding accuracy reached 84.1% on a general psychometric task. On the more difficult threshold-level task, accuracy reached 64.0%. This work shows that spontaneous cortical activity is not noise; it contains rich, task-relevant structure. Unsupervised pretraining on this data is a promising strategy to improve neural decoding.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the First Workshop on NeuroAI Multimodal Intelligence @ AAAI 2026, PMLR 308:93-98, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了自监督学习在临床神经假体中的应用，利用掩码自编码器对一名盲人参与者V1区的14.6小时自发多单元活动进行预训练。预训练后的模型能够从无监督的潜在表示中捕捉V1的空间组织和感知状态分离，通过线性探测在一般心理测量任务上达到84.1%的感知解码准确率，在阈值水平任务上达到64.0%。结果表明自发皮层活动包含丰富的任务相关结构，无监督预训练有望改善神经解码。
Motivation: 临床神经假体面临数据瓶颈：标注的感知试验数据稀缺，而大量未标注的自发神经活动未被充分利用。
Method: 使用掩码自编码器（Masked Autoencoder）对14.6小时的静息态多单元活动进行预训练，然后通过线性探测（冻结潜在特征的逻辑回归）评估感知解码性能。
Result: 在一般心理测量任务上解码准确率达84.1%，在更困难的阈值水平任务上达64.0%。
Conclusion: 自发皮层活动不是噪声，其中包含丰富的任务相关结构；对此类数据进行无监督预训练是改善神经解码的有效策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DynaResize: Runtime GPU Reallocation for Disaggregated LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: RL-based LLM post-training increasingly disaggregates Rollout and Training across separate GPU resources, but static GPU partitioning suffers from severe pipeline bubbles under long-tail rollout latency. We present DynaResize, a runtime GPU reallocation system that dynamically switches GPUs between Rollout and Training to balance stage execution times without changing RL semantics. DynaResize decomposes resizing into fine-grained operations and removes non-startup-critical work from the critical path through communicator reuse, bounded state staging, and hysteresis-based resizing. Experimental results show that DynaResize can improve end-to-end throughput by 66.5% and reduce total execution time by 33% over the optimal static configuration, while hiding 27% of role-switching overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出DynaResize系统，用于大规模LLM后训练中Rollout与Training阶段的运行时GPU动态重分配，通过细粒度操作、通信器复用、有界状态暂存和滞后重分配策略，在不改变RL语义的前提下平衡阶段执行时间，消除静态分区导致的流水线气泡。
Motivation: 基于RL的LLM后训练将Rollout和Training分散在不同GPU上，但静态GPU分区在长尾Rollout延迟下会产生严重流水线气泡，导致资源浪费和吞吐下降。
Method: 设计运行时GPU重分配系统DynaResize，将重分配分解为细粒度操作；通过通信器复用、有界状态暂存和基于滞后的重分配技术，将非启动关键工作移出关键路径，实现GPU在Rollout和Training角色间动态切换。
Result: 实验表明，相比最优静态配置，DynaResize提升端到端吞吐66.5%，减少总执行时间33%，并隐藏27%的角色切换开销。
Conclusion: 动态GPU重分配可以有效缓解LLM后训练中的流水线气泡问题，且对RL语义无影响。

papers.title: Revitalizing Public Urban Places through Cultural and Political Memory: A Technological Approach with LLMs and Augmented Reality
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the intersection of memory, place, and identity, examining how new technologies, particularly Apple Vision Pro, can illuminate this nexus. Leveraging digital twins and virtual reality, it investigates how memory is woven into landscapes and urban environments of cultural and historical significance, identifying visual elements that evoke memory and heritage. Applications such as Apple Vision Pro can facilitate image extension to define place identity, informing viewers about cultural and political entities across timelines. Visual storytelling can showcase the evolution of landscapes and the preservation of cultural heritage, while Virtual Reality (VR) enables the recreation of historical landscapes and urban-scapes. This immersive approach invites users to transcend temporal boundaries and experience the past dynamically. Semantic Image Search can support research by uncovering images related to monuments, tradition, or cultural identity. This research introduces a methodology to connect digital twins and virtual environments with urban and non-urban landscapes to illustrate cultural, historical, and environmental sustainability. Central to this approach is defining the resilience of the current state, its future evolution, and the significance of the past. These technologies facilitate a historical and cultural embrace while evoking the feeling of returning to a specific place years later. The methodology outlines the integration of technologies needed to revitalize public urban places through cultural and political memory. Through these applications, this paper contributes to research on digital twins of spaces, urban transformation, and cultural heritage preservation. By offering insights into the relationship between memory, place, and identity in the digital age, it supports a deeper understanding of our collective past and its impact on the present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和增强现实技术（如Apple Vision Pro）来通过文化和政治记忆复兴公共城市空间。提出一种连接数字孪生与虚拟环境的方法，以展示文化遗产、历史演进和环境可持续性。
Motivation: 城市公共空间往往丢失了文化和历史记忆，现有技术未能充分整合这些记忆以增强地方认同感。
Method: 结合数字孪生、虚拟现实和语义图像搜索，利用LLMs和增强现实技术，定义当前状态、未来演变及过去意义，以复兴城市空间。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或量化指标，主要描述了方法框架和应用潜力。
Conclusion: 该技术方法有助于加深对记忆、场所与身份在数字时代关系的理解，支持城市转型和文化遗产保护。

papers.title: Quotient Tree Arithmetic: Deferred-Division Computation with Bounded Symbolic Depth and Cross-Subtree Cancellation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Quotient Tree Arithmetic (QTA), a computational substrate in which values are represented as deferred quotient pairs (N, D) whose ratio is evaluated lazily at a designated materialization boundary. The framework applies to any domain: IEEE 754 doubles used as exact integer containers give exact rational arithmetic within the 2^53 exactness window; arbitrary IEEE doubles extend coverage to transcendental values including machine learning activations such as exp(x) and sqrt(x). Three structural theorems underpin QTA. (1) Bounded Depth Growth: each arithmetic operation increases tree depth by at most 1, giving O(m) tree size after m operations with no combinatorial explosion. (2) Cross-Subtree Cancellation: subtrees appearing in both numerator and denominator positions cancel via reference identity without arithmetic, including transcendental values computed once and shared. (3) Deferred Stability: a single IEEE division at the materialization boundary introduces at most one-half ULP of rounding error, versus O(m) ULP for eager evaluation. For machine learning training, QTA provides: structural prevention of gradient underflow to zero; O(1)-cost gradient computation via chain-rule tape collapse when intermediate activations are reference-identical; shared-weight batch compression reducing DAG storage from O(BLd) to O(L+Bd) for a batch of B examples through L layers; and tracked factor cancellation replacing O(log n) GCD with O(1) trial division when denominators are known. We propose a vectorized hardware normalization instruction (RatCleanup) for SIMD-parallel rational pair reduction. The algebraic foundation is the localization of a ring at its multiplicative set, connecting QTA to algebraic structure theory while grounding it in hardware-native IEEE arithmetic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出商树算术（Quotient Tree Arithmetic, QTA），一种将值表示为延迟商对（N, D）的计算基底，在指定物化边界时才惰性求值。该框架适用于任何域：IEEE 754双精度作为精确整数容器可在2^53精度窗口内提供精确有理算术；任意IEEE双精度扩展可覆盖包括机器学习激活函数如exp(x)和sqrt(x)在内的超越数。三个结构性定理支撑QTA：（1）有界深度增长：每个算术操作最多使树深度增加1，m次操作后树大小为O(m)，无组合爆炸；（2）跨子树消去：出现在分子和分母位置的子树通过引用标识消去，无需算术运算，包括一次性计算并共享的超越数；（3）延迟稳定性：物化边界处的单次IEEE除法最多引入半ULP舍入误差，而急切求值引入O(m) ULP。对于机器学习训练，QTA提供：梯度下溢的结构性预防；当中间激活引用相同时通过链式法则磁带折叠实现O(1)成本梯度计算；共享权重批压缩将B个样本L层的DAG存储从O(BLd)降至O(L+Bd)；已知分母时跟踪因子消去代替O(log n) GCD的O(1)试除。提出一种向量化硬件归一化指令（RatCleanup）用于SIMD并行有理对化简。代数基础是环对其乘法集的局部化，将QTA与代数结构理论联系，同时基于硬件原生IEEE算术。
Motivation: 现有浮点算术在机器学习训练中面临梯度下溢、舍入误差累积、存储和计算开销大等问题，需要一种兼具精确性、稳定性和高效性的计算表示。
Method: 提出商树算术（QTA），将值表示为延迟商对（N, D），通过有界深度增长、跨子树消去和延迟稳定性三个定理保证计算效率与精度，并设计向量化硬件指令RatCleanup。
Result: 理论分析表明：m次操作后树大小为O(m)；物化边界处单次除法最多引入半ULP误差；训练中梯度无下溢，梯度计算代价O(1)（当激活引用相同时），DAG存储从O(BLd)降至O(L+Bd)，消去操作从O(log n) GCD降至O(1)试除。
Conclusion: QTA提供了一种基于环局部化理论的硬件友好计算框架，有望在机器学习及其他领域实现高效、精确且稳定的数值计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decentralized Granular Access Control for Agentic AI Systems in Critical Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of autonomous AI agents in production infrastructure introduces fundamental security challenges that traditional role-based access control (RBAC) models cannot address. Unlike deterministic automation, AI agents exhibit stochastic behavior, making conventional trust models insufficient for governing their access to critical systems. This paper presents a decentralized, multi-layered access control architecture designed specifically for agentic AI systems operating in critical cloud infrastructure. Our framework introduces four key innovations: (1) a compound identity model that binds agent actions to delegated human authority, (2) a hierarchical permission system spanning five granularity levels from global platform access to per-parameter constraints, (3) a decentralized policy ownership model where tool teams independently govern their authorization boundaries, and (4) progressive trust escalation with safety interlocks that prevent autonomous agents from executing high-risk operations. We ground our design in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) threat taxonomy and demonstrate how each architectural decision mitigates specific attack vectors. Deployed in production at a major cloud provider managing network infrastructure across hundreds of datacenters, the system enforces granular access control for 20+ specialized AI agents and 60+ deterministic playbooks processing thousands of operations daily while maintaining zero unauthorized write operations over eight months of production deployment. We present empirical data on access pattern distributions, denial rates, and the effectiveness of layered authorization in preventing privilege escalation by non-deterministic actors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对关键基础设施中自主AI代理的分布式细粒度访问控制架构，解决了传统RBAC模型无法应对AI代理随机行为的安全挑战。框架包含复合身份模型、五级权限层次、去中心化策略所有权和渐进信任升级与安全联锁。在生产环境中部署于大型云服务商，管理数百数据中心的网络基础设施，运行20多个AI代理和60多个确定性剧本，八个月内未发生未授权写操作。
Motivation: 传统RBAC模型无法应对AI代理的随机行为，导致关键基础设施中AI代理的访问控制存在安全漏洞。
Method: 提出分布式多层访问控制架构，包括复合身份模型（绑定代理行为与人类授权）、五级权限（从全局平台访问到每参数约束）、去中心化策略所有权（工具团队自主定义边界）、渐进信任升级与安全联锁。
Result: 在生产部署中，系统管理20+ AI代理和60+ 确定性剧本，每天处理数千操作，八个月内零未授权写操作。提供了访问模式分布、拒绝率和分层授权防止特权提升的实证数据。
Conclusion: 该架构有效性基于OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025)威胁分类学，并在实际生产中验证了防止非确定性实体特权提升的能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tokengeist: Multi-Turn Attribution Tracing in Agentic Conversations
papers.abstract_en: When a language model produces a response in a multi-turn conversation, which tokens from prior turns shaped that answer, and how did those dependencies propagate across prior turns? Existing context attribution methods process the full context in a single pass, recovering surface-level dependencies but missing the layered, non-linear structure of real-world dialogues and multi-step reasoning tasks. We introduce multi-turn context attribution (MTCA): given a target span in a model response, the task of tracing attribution backward across turns to identify not only which prior turns were directly relevant, but also how those turns themselves depended on earlier context. We propose Tokengeist, an attribution-method-agnostic and scalable framework that recovers full dependency paths by casting attribution as a recursive traversal of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) over conversation turns. We will release MTCABench, a benchmark of 3,845 target spans across 665 multi-turn conversations, annotated with gold provenance graphs reaching depths of up to 14, across four dependency types. Across four open-weight models, flat attribution methods fail to recover multi-hop dependencies, achieving under 20% source recall, while Tokengeist reaches 90%. Our results reveal systematic failure modes of single-pass attribution -- which we term provenance collapse -- and motivate attribution methods that reason recursively across turns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多轮上下文归因（MTCA）任务，旨在追踪多轮对话中模型响应所依赖的先前轮次及其依赖链。作者提出Tokengeist框架，通过将有向无环图上的递归遍历实现归因，并发布MTCABench基准。实验表明，简单单次归因方法在多跳依赖上源召回率低于20%，而Tokengeist达到90%，揭示了单次归因的系统性失败模式。
Motivation: 现有上下文归因方法仅进行单次全上下文处理，无法捕捉多轮对话中非线性的依赖结构，因此需要能跨轮次追踪完整依赖路径的方法。
Method: 提出Tokengeist，一种与归因方法无关的可扩展框架，通过将归因建模为对话轮次上的有向无环图递归遍历来恢复完整依赖路径。
Result: 在665个多轮对话的MTCABench基准上，Tokengeist在四个开源模型上达到90%的源召回率，而单次归因方法低于20%。
Conclusion: 单次归因方法存在“归因崩溃”（provenance collapse）的系统性缺陷，而递归跨轮次推理的归因方法更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs as Interpretable Controllers for Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision-making and reasoning tasks, yet their potential as controllers for physical systems remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether LLMs can function as interpretable controllers for a dynamic thermal environment, examining their ability to follow setpoints, interpret natural-language commands, reason about actuator effects, and incorporate prior model-based knowledge. Five LLMs of varying scales are evaluated under multiple scenarios, including settings with penalties on heater or fan usage and cases where the models have access to a physics-based prediction tool. The results show that control performance depends on model complexity: while low- and mid-scale models frequently misinterpret actuator dynamics or generate inconsistent reasoning, high-complexity models such as Qwen-3~14B and GPT-4o achieve accurate temperature tracking, stable actuator usage, and coherent explanations aligned with physical principles. Incorporating a physics-based model significantly improves control smoothness and energy efficiency by enabling anticipatory decision-making. A detailed reasoning taxonomy further reveals a clear progression from causal misinterpretation in smaller models to cohesive and temporally aware reasoning in larger ones. The findings demonstrate that LLMs can act as interpretable controllers when sufficiently capable and appropriately grounded in domain knowledge, highlighting promising opportunities for hybrid model-based and language-driven control strategies that can provide plausible explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了多种规模的大语言模型（LLMs）作为动态热环境可解释控制器的性能，包括遵循设定点、解释自然语言命令、推理执行器效应及整合基于模型的先验知识。研究发现，控制性能依赖于模型复杂度：低/中规模模型常误解执行器动态或生成不一致推理，而高复杂度模型（如Qwen-3 14B、GPT-4o）实现了准确温度跟踪、稳定执行器使用以及与物理原理一致的连贯解释。结合基于物理的模型显著改善了控制平滑性和能效。
Motivation: 尽管LLMs在决策和推理任务中广泛应用，但它们作为物理系统控制器的潜力尚未充分探索。本文旨在研究LLMs是否能够作为动态热环境的可解释控制器，并评估其在不同场景下的能力。
Method: 使用五种不同规模的LLMs在多个场景中评估，包括对加热器或风扇使用施加惩罚的情况，以及模型可以使用基于物理的预测工具的情况。通过分析模型遵循设定点、解释自然语言命令、推理执行器效应和整合先验知识的能力，并建立详细推理分类法。
Result: 高复杂度模型（Qwen-3 14B、GPT-4o）实现了准确的温度跟踪和稳定的执行器使用，而低/中规模模型表现较差。引入基于物理的模型显著提高了控制平滑性和能源效率。推理分类显示从较小模型的因果误解到较大模型的一致和时间感知推理的明显进展。
Conclusion: LLMs在足够强大并适当基于领域知识时，可以作为可解释控制器，为混合基于模型和语言驱动的控制策略提供前景，这些策略能提供合理解释。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.method: 使用五种不同规模的LLMs在多个场景中评估，包括对加热器或风扇使用施加惩罚的情况，以及模型可以使用基于物理的预测工具的情况。通过分析模型遵循设定点、解释自然语言命令、推理执行器效应和整合先验知识的能力，并建立详细推理分类法。
summary_sections.result: 高复杂度模型（Qwen-3 14B、GPT-4o）实现了准确的温度跟踪和稳定的执行器使用，而低/中规模模型表现较差。引入基于物理的模型显著提高了控制平滑性和能源效率。推理分类显示从较小模型的因果误解到较大模型的一致和时间感知推理的明显进展。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLMs在足够强大并适当基于领域知识时，可以作为可解释控制器，为混合基于模型和语言驱动的控制策略提供前景，这些策略能提供合理解释。

papers.title: Group Preference Collapse in Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Personalized multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aim to generate user-specific responses, but existing methods mainly rely on profile-level information and overlook diverse user preferences. We identify group preference collapse, where multi-user personalized MLLMs become insensitive to individual preferences and drift toward dominant population-level choices due to suppressed preference signals and unreliable preference use during generation. We propose PrefMoE, a preference-centric framework that separates stable profile information from preference-related representations. PrefMoE decomposes preferences into shared prototypes and personalized residuals, preserves individualized residuals with imbalance-aware learning, counterfactual pseudo-user augmentation, and residual decorrelation, and routes profile and preference factors through separate LoRA adaptation paths. Experiments across multiple MLLM backbones show that PrefMoE improves preference-sensitive personalization while substantially reducing preference collapse. Project page: https://prefmoe.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现个性化多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）存在“群体偏好塌陷”现象，即模型对个体偏好不敏感，偏向人口层面的主导选择。为此提出PrefMoE框架，将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差，通过不平衡学习、反事实伪用户增强和残差解耦保留个体化残差，并通过分离的LoRA路径路由配置文件和偏好因素。实验表明PrefMoE在多个MLLM主干上提升偏好敏感个性化，显著减少偏好塌陷。
Motivation: 现有个性化MLLM主要依赖档案级信息，忽略用户偏好的多样性，导致多用户场景下模型对个体偏好不敏感，向群体主导选择漂移。
Method: 提出PrefMoE框架，包括：将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差；通过不平衡学习、反事实伪用户增强和残差解耦保留个体化残差；通过分离的LoRA路径路由配置文件和偏好因素。
Result: 实验表明PrefMoE在多个MLLM主干上提升偏好敏感个性化，显著减少偏好塌陷。
Conclusion: PrefMoE通过显式分离和保留个体偏好表示，有效缓解了群体偏好塌陷，提升了个性化质量。

papers.title: DeepLook: Deeper Thinking with Lookahead
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model reasoning, often delivering larger gains on difficult reasoning tasks than parameter scaling alone. However, existing approaches remain inefficient in how compute is allocated within a reasoning trace. Motivated by the observation that reasoning failures often exhibit an early onset of uncertainty before a wrong answer become explicit, we introduce DeepLook, a training-free monitor-and-intervene decoding framework that concentrates lookahead compute at uncertainty bottlenecks. DeepLook aggregates token-level confidence into segment-level signals, triggers when confidence drops relative to recent history, and explores candidate continuations with fixed-horizon lookahead. Branches are ranked by Average Lookahead Confidence (ALC), the average segment-level confidence over rollout continuations, then pruned and aggregated through voting. On four competition-style mathematics benchmarks across DeepSeek-R1-8B, Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B, DeepLook shifts the accuracy--token-cost Pareto frontier: it improves accuracy over DeepConf-low in 11 of 16 settings while reducing dataset-level token generation by 87.3% on average, including gains of +3.1 on AIME25 with Qwen3-32B and +8.8 on BRUMO25 with GPT-OSS-20B. These results show that selective, future-aware intervention yields substantially stronger accuracy--cost trade-offs than uniformly scaling complete reasoning trajectories. Code is available here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeepLook，一种无需训练的监控-干预解码框架，通过在不确定性瓶颈处集中分配计算资源来提升大语言模型的推理效率。该方法将token级置信度聚合成片段级信号，在置信度下降时触发固定视野的向前探索，使用平均向前置信度（ALC）对分支排序，并通过投票进行剪枝与聚合。在四个竞赛级数学基准上，DeepLook在11/16的设置中提升了准确率，同时平均减少87.3%的token生成，例如在AIME25上使用Qwen3-32B提升+3.1，在BRUMO25上使用GPT-OSS-20B提升+8.8。
Motivation: 现有推理时计算扩展方法在推理轨迹内的计算分配效率低下，推理失败往往在错误答案明确之前就表现出不确定性早期出现，需要更智能的计算分配策略。
Method: 提出无训练的监控-干预解码框架：聚合token级置信度为片段级信号，在置信度相对历史下降时触发；执行固定视野向前探索；使用平均向前置信度（ALC）对候选分支排序；通过投票进行剪枝和聚合。
Result: 在DeepSeek-R1-8B、Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-20B和GPT-OSS-120B上评估四个竞赛级数学基准：在11/16的设置中提升准确率，数据集级token生成平均减少87.3%，包括AIME25上+3.1和BRUMO25上+8.8的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 选择性、未来感知的干预相比统一扩展完整推理轨迹，能够实现显著更强的准确率-成本权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chart Deception in Vision-Language Models: From Vulnerability to Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Information visualizations are widely used to communicate patterns, trends, and outliers, yet deceptive design choices-such as truncated or inverted axes, distorted aspect ratios, inappropriate encodings, and misleading color mappings-can systematically alter interpretation while preserving the underlying data. As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for chart understanding and analytical reasoning, assessing their robustness to such deceptive visualizations has become critical for trustworthy data analysis. We introduce VisDeception, the first controlled paired benchmark for evaluating the robustness of VLMs to misleading chart designs. The benchmark contains 1,600 paired faithful and misleading charts spanning eight major categories of deceptive visualization tactics, where each misleading chart is paired with a faithful counterpart generated from the same underlying data. To isolate deception-induced reasoning errors from baseline chart-understanding errors, we introduce the Deception Score, a paired evaluation metric that quantifies how misleading visualizations shift model responses away from the faithful interpretation of the data. Across 32,000 responses from 10 state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that even advanced models remain highly vulnerable to deceptive visual manipulations. To improve robustness, we further propose an inference-time multi-agent mitigation framework that grounds reasoning in structured chart metadata extracted from the visualization before answer generation, enabling models to reduce the influence of deceptive visual cues without requiring explicit user instructions. Together, our findings reveal important reliability gaps in current chart-understanding systems and establish benchmark-driven evaluation, deception-aware metrics, and structured reasoning as promising directions for developing more trustworthy VLMs for visual analytics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisDeception，首个用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在欺骗性图表设计下鲁棒性的受控配对基准，包含 1,600 对忠实与误导性图表，涵盖八类欺骗策略。通过引入 Deception Score 量化误导造成的推理偏差，测试 10 个先进 VLM 后发现模型仍易受欺骗。作者进一步提出推理时多智能体缓解框架，利用图表结构化元数据引导推理，减少欺骗性视觉线索的影响。
Motivation: 当前 VLM 在图表理解中广泛应用，但针对有意误导的图表设计（如截断坐标轴、扭曲比例）的鲁棒性缺乏系统评估，这对可靠的数据分析至关重要。
Method: 构建 VisDeception 基准：1,600 对图表（每对包含忠实与欺骗版本，源自相同数据）；提出 Deception Score 作为配对评估指标，隔离欺骗导致的推理错误；提出多智能体缓解框架，在推理时提取图表元数据并引导推理。
Result: 10 个 SOTA VLM 的 32,000 次响应显示，即使先进模型仍高度易受欺骗性视觉操纵，而所提缓解框架能减少欺骗影响。
Conclusion: 当前图表理解系统存在可靠性缺口，基准驱动的评估、欺骗感知指标和结构化推理是开发更可信 VLM 进行可视化分析的有前景方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differencing the Diffusion Trajectory toward Uncertain Components for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become a widely used framework for probabilistic time series forecasting, modeling the distribution of future values given an observed history. In time series forecasting, however, the future continues the observed history, creating an asymmetry the standard diffusion process leaves unaddressed, with slowly-varying content largely determined by the observed continuity while higher-frequency dynamics carry most of the residual uncertainty. Existing diffusion-based forecasters decouple this asymmetry through an external rule before generation, leaving the corruption trajectory blind to which parts of the target the history can already anchor. We propose DiffDiff, a diffusion framework that embeds this predictability asymmetry into the diffusion trajectory itself, so that a single end-to-end diffusion process becomes aware of which parts of the target the history can already anchor. DiffDiff makes the forward operator step-dependent so that the noisy intermediate state progressively shifts from the target itself toward its second-order differenced structure, while a conditioning pathway supplies the denoiser with both value-domain and differential history information balanced by a stage-adaptive gate at each diffusion step. The terminal distribution approaches a standard Gaussian, preserving compatibility with existing samplers. On seven benchmarks across four prediction horizons, DiffDiff outperforms six diffusion baselines, and our analysis confirms that DiffDiff concentrates the diffusion's generative effort on the most uncertain components of the target while relieving it from rebuilding the history-anchored content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列预测中未来与历史的不对称性问题，提出DiffDiff，将预测的不对称性嵌入扩散轨迹本身。DiffDiff使前向算子依赖于步骤，让噪声中间状态逐步从目标本身向其二阶差分结构偏移，并通过阶段自适应门控平衡值域和差分历史信息。在七个基准上，DiffDiff优于六个扩散基线，并集中生成努力于最不确定的成分。
Motivation: 现有扩散预测器在生成前通过外部规则解耦历史可锚定部分与不确定部分，使加噪轨迹对历史已确定内容不敏感，导致效率低下。
Method: 提出DiffDiff框架，使扩散前向算子步骤依赖，噪声中间状态逐步从目标转向其二阶差分结构，同时通过阶段自适应门控为去噪器提供值域和差分历史信息。
Result: 在七个基准四个预测范围上，DiffDiff优于六个扩散基线，并集中生成努力于最不确定成分，减少重建历史锚定内容的负担。
Conclusion: DiffDiff将历史与未来之间的不对称性嵌入扩散过程本身，实现端到端的不确定性感知生成，与现有采样器兼容。

papers.title: A didactical-driven teacher assistant for a dimensional modeling course
papers.abstract_en: Educational chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) show promising effects on learning outcomes, yet most systems delegate pedagogical decisions such as content selection and didactic structuring implicitly to the LLM, making tutoring strategies difficult to trace, evaluate, and reproduce. This paper presents a didactical-driven teacher assistant for a French-language university course on dimensional modelling, operating without commercial LLM budget or GPU infrastructure. The architecture formalises the instructor's pedagogical reasoning into deterministic modules that handle intent detection, concept linking, and didactic approach selection before any text is generated; the LLM acts solely as a linguistic executor. Evaluation on 195 authentic student questions addresses two research questions. First, we show that standard semantic retrieval alone does not reliably recover the pedagogically required content, thereby justifying the upstream orchestration strategy adopted in our architecture (RQ1). Second, compared to free-tier LLMs whose detection performance varies widely across models and which produce errors silently, the deterministic pipeline achieves high pair precision (73%) with full traceability and explicit abstention, though its limited coverage confirms that the detection strategy requires further refinement (RQ2).
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Computer Supported Education, May 2026, Benidorm/Spain, France. pp.177-189
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于教学驱动的教师助手，用于法语大学的维度建模课程。系统将教师的教学推理形式化为确定性模块，包括意图检测、概念连接和教学方法选择，LLM仅作为语言执行器。在195个真实学生问题上评估，标准语义检索不能可靠恢复所需教学内容（RQ1），确定性流水线达到73%的配对精度，但覆盖有限（RQ2）。
Motivation: 现有教育聊天机器人将教学决策隐式委托给LLM，导致教学策略难以追踪、评估和复现。
Method: 构建确定性模块进行意图检测、概念连接和教学方法选择，LLM仅用于文本生成。
Result: 确定性流水线达到73%的配对精度，具有完全可追溯性和明确弃权，但覆盖率有限。

papers.title: HyCE-RAG: Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop question answering requires systems to retrieve evidence from multiple documents and connect scattered facts into a coherent reasoning process. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mainly relies on semantic similarity between a query and text chunks, and therefore often fails to model structural relations among entities, facts, and evidence units. Graph-based RAG improves this by introducing graph-structured knowledge, but pairwise edges are still limited in representing higher-order associations involving multiple entities and contexts. We propose HyCE-RAG, a Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework for explainable multi-hop question answering. HyCE-RAG organizes entities, relations, and contextual evidence into hyperedges, builds a query-aware evidence hypergraph, and performs confidence propagation over entity--hyperedge incidence structures. It then uses confidence-guided evidence assembly to select, connect, and rank evidence paths before answer generation. The scoring process jointly considers semantic relevance, entity connectivity, evidence coverage, relation reliability, extraction confidence, and propagated confidence. By providing the language model with structured evidence chains rather than flat retrieved passages, HyCE-RAG supports more faithful and interpretable reasoning. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and two GraphRAG-Bench subsets show that HyCE-RAG consistently outperforms standard RAG and graph-based RAG baselines in answer accuracy, context relevance, and faithfulness. These results suggest that hypergraph-based evidence organization is a promising direction for post-retrieval reasoning in complex question answering.

Result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue 以及两个 GraphRAG-Bench 子集上，HyCE-RAG 在答案准确率、上下文相关性和忠实性方面均超越标准 RAG 和图 RAG 基线。
Conclusion: 超图组织的证据链能提升后检索推理的效果和可解释性，是复杂问答中一个有前景的方向。

papers.title: An Agentic Orchestration of Atomistic Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Atomistic simulations are central to materials design, but their execution involves complex, multi-step workflows that require significant human expertise. Here, we present an agent-based system embedded within the URSA (Universal Research and Scientific Agent) framework that automates the design, execution, and validation of atomistic simulations, demonstrated using the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS) tool. Our system autonomously selects interatomic potentials, constructs and runs simulations, and performs iterative error recovery within a closed-loop workflow. We evaluate the scientific reliability of the agent by benchmarking its outputs against LAVA, a high-throughput toolkit for LAMMPS and the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) calculations. Our framework reduces manual intervention and trial-and-error, thereby improving the rigor, reproducibility, and scalability of atomistic modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个基于URSA框架的智能体系统，用于自动化原子尺度模拟（如LAMMPS）的设计、执行和验证，包括自主选择势函数、构建运行模拟以及迭代错误恢复，并与高吞吐量工具LAVA基准对比，旨在减少人工干预、提高可重复性和可扩展性。
Motivation: 原子尺度模拟的手工操作流程复杂且依赖专家经验，缺乏自动化和可重复性，限制了材料设计的效率和规模。
Method: 在URSA框架内构建智能体系统，将LAMMPS模拟工作流封装为闭环自动化流程，包含势函数选择、模拟构建、运行和错误恢复等步骤。
Result: 通过将智能体输出与LAVA工具对比，验证了其科学可靠性；框架减少了手动试错，提升了模拟的严谨性、可重复性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 智能体编排能够有效自动化原子尺度模拟，提升材料建模的效率和可靠性。

papers.title: xMIx: High-Performance Serving-Time Platform for Mechanistic Interpretability Apps
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) has emerged as a powerful approach for analyzing and intervening in inference computations, with a growing number of applications such as jailbreak attempt detection, truthfulness evaluation, and hallucination detection. Unfortunately, MI deployment in production model-serving systems is currently not practical, as most existing MI frameworks introduce prohibitively high runtime overheads. The fundamental problem is that MI functions do not compose cleanly with served models: they fragment deployment, often force draining requests and rebuilding serving state, and conflict with critical performance optimizations such as continuous batching and CUDA-graph execution, essential for production deployments. We present xMIx, a serving-native framework for deploying MI applications in production inference serving environments. xMIx enables attaching MI functions to a predefined set of locations in the model runtime, interposing on activations within the layers and residual streams. xMIx supports conditional invocation of MI functions depending on the outputs in preceding model layers. Multiple MI applications can be deployed in a single model instance. xMIx compiles them all into the serving path but activates them dynamically at runtime only when necessary, with negligible performance cost, and without requiring a separate model instance or alternative execution stack. We integrate xMIx with the vLLM serving system and evaluate it across three major models and seven diverse MI applications. xMIx achieves performance comparable to native vLLM execution, incurring a slowdown of 1.3% mean inter-token latency (ITL), 1.2% for tail P99 ITL, 2.6% for mean time to first token (TTFT), and 1.6% for mean total token throughput (TTT).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 xMIx，一个面向生产推理服务的机械可解释性（MI）部署框架，解决现有 MI 框架高运行时开销和与模型服务不兼容的问题。xMIx 允许在模型层内插激活值，支持条件调用和多个 MI 应用共存，通过编译到服务路径但动态激活实现接近原生的性能。在 vLLM 上集成测试三个模型和七个应用，平均 token 间延迟仅增加 1.3%。
Motivation: 机械可解释性应用（如越狱检测、真实性评估）在生产模型服务系统中部署不实用，现有框架引入过高运行时开销，且与连续批处理、CUDA-graph 执行等优化冲突。
Method: xMIx 是一个服务原生框架，将 MI 函数附加到模型运行时的预定义位置（层内激活和残差流），支持条件调用（根据前层输出决定是否执行），多个 MI 应用可编译到同一服务路径，仅在运行时动态激活，无需独立模型实例或替换执行栈。
Result: 与原生 vLLM 执行相比，xMIx 的平均 token 间延迟 slowdown 1.3%，P99 延迟 slowdown 1.2%，平均首 token 时间 slowdown 2.6%，总吞吐量 slowdown 1.6%。
Conclusion: xMIx 使得生产环境中高效部署多种 MI 应用成为可能，性能损失可忽略，无需额外模型实例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Creative Integration: A Decidable Criterion of Creativity
papers.abstract_en: "Integrative" solutions are widely praised but rarely defined: we lack an operational way to tell a genuine integration -- one that makes the world cheaper to describe -- from a tidy re-description. Building on the lineage that treats creativity and intelligence as compression, we give such a criterion for creative integration (CI): the resolution of a real conflict between A and B is CI if and only if, under a fixed description language, the description length strictly shrinks (C = L_pre/L_post > 1), with the reduction located in the conflict itself. We make the judgment decidable through four binary, conjunctive gates, and we fix its extension through a taxonomy of pseudo-integration that names and rejects the look-alikes. We back the criterion with a curated, multi-domain corpus and -- crucially -- validate it not by human inter-rater agreement but by four falsifiable tests it could fail: an independent computational check, discrimination against hard negatives, out-of-sample prediction, and description-language robustness; all pass with margin. The contribution is not "creativity is compression" but its decidability, discrimination, and corpus: on this account, what makes a move genuinely creative -- rather than merely novel -- is that it compresses a conflict, with novelty and value as downstream symptoms; whether all creativity is so constituted we state as an explicit conjecture. We claim only the sign of C-1; we judge, not generate. The result is a citable primitive for a broader program.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可判定的创造性整合（creative integration）标准，基于描述长度压缩，通过四个二进制门判断，并用多领域语料库和四个可证伪测试验证，均通过。
Motivation: 当前缺乏操作化方式区分真正的整合与简单的再描述，论文旨在给出可判定的创造力标准。
Method: 基于压缩视角，定义条件：在固定描述语言下，描述长度严格缩小（C=L_pre/L_post>1），且缩减位于冲突本身，则为创造性整合；通过四个二进制门和伪整合分类法实现可判定。
Result: 独立计算检查、硬负例鉴别、样本外预测和描述语言鲁棒性四个可证伪测试均通过。
Conclusion: 贡献在于可判定性、鉴别力和语料库，而非‘创造力即压缩’本身；该标准区分真正创造性与仅新颖性。

papers.title: Structure Over Scale: Schema-Constrained Causal Graphs for RAG
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) grounds answers in structured knowledge, but current systems extract entities and relationships exhaustively, producing graphs whose size and construction cost scale with corpus length rather than with the reasoning a query requires. We introduce HCG-RAG (Hierarchical Causal Graph RAG), which replaces open-ended extraction with schema-constrained causal graphs: an automated pipeline distills a corpus into a fixed, typed vocabulary of causal variables and materializes a compact two-tier graph over it. Our schema-constrained graphs match entity-relation baselines on answer quality at a fraction of the cost: 3-20x fewer nodes, 8x-135x fewer build-time LLM calls than the most LLM-intensive baseline (MS-GraphRAG), and graphs compact enough for a domain expert to audit, correct, and extend. On medical and clinical benchmarks, including a neurologist-validated epilepsy dataset, HCG-RAG matches or exceeds the best entity-relation systems. An ablation isolates the causal graph as a structured retrieval filter, contributing +6 percentage points (pp) over embedding-only retrieval. Across all domains with discoverable hierarchical causal structure, only methods imposing higher-level organization outperform flat entity-relation retrieval, indicating that what is placed in the graph matters more than how many nodes it contains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HCG-RAG (Hierarchical Causal Graph RAG)，用模式约束的因果图替代开箱即用的实体关系抽取，显著减少图规模和构建成本，同时保持回答质量。在医疗和临床基准上，HCG-RAG匹配或超越最佳实体关系系统。
Motivation: 当前GraphRAG系统过度抽取实体关系，图规模与语料长度成正比而非查询所需推理，导致构建成本高且难以审计。
Method: 自动化流水线将语料蒸馏为固定类型化因果变量词汇表，并生成紧凑的两层因果图，用作结构化检索过滤器。
Result: 相比实体关系基线，节点数减少3-20倍，构建时LLM调用减少8-135倍；在医疗和临床基准上匹配或超越最佳实体关系系统；因果图作为检索过滤器贡献+6个百分点。
Conclusion: 在具有可发现层次因果结构的领域中，施加高层组织的图方法优于平面实体关系检索；图中放置的内容比节点数量更重要。
