papers.title: Lexical discovery in unknown environments orchestrated by Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Populations of autonomous agents deployed in unknown environments (e.g. planetary or deep-sea exploration) must develop shared vocabularies to refer to entities that have no name in any human language. We propose the Neuro-Symbolic Lexical Discovery (NSLD) framework, in which a population of LLM-based agents plays a referential game over out-of-distribution visual referents, autonomously self-organising a shared alien lexicon. Each agent combines a frozen CLIP vision encoder with a private FAISS vector index and a text-only LLM. Crucially, discovered alien words are anchored to natural language via semantic proximity in the embedding space, enlarging the human vocabulary with new perceptually grounded words. Consensus is reached in simulations with populations of up to twenty agents and ten visual referents. Convergence dynamics are characterised through three analytical models achieving R^2 > 0.95, representing a first step towards pre-deployment planning in autonomous exploration missions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经符号词汇发现（NSLD）框架，使基于LLM的智能体群体在未知环境中通过指代游戏自主组织共享的外星词汇。每个智能体结合冻结的CLIP视觉编码器、私有FAISS向量索引和纯文本LLM，将发现的词汇通过嵌入空间的语义相似性锚定到自然语言。在最多20个智能体和10个视觉指代物的模拟中达成共识，并通过三个分析模型刻画收敛动力学（R²>0.95），为自主探索任务的事前部署规划提供初步步骤。
Motivation: 在未知环境（如行星或深海探索）中部署的自主智能体群体需要发展共享词汇来指代任何人类语言中不存在名称的实体，现有方法缺乏此类词汇发现机制。
Method: 提出NSLD框架：智能体群体进行指代游戏，每个智能体使用CLIP视觉编码器、FAISS向量索引和文本LLM，通过嵌入空间的语义相似性将发现的外星词汇锚定到自然语言，实现自主词汇自组织。
Result: 在最多20个智能体和10个视觉指代物的模拟中达成共识，收敛动态通过三个分析模型以R²>0.95的精度刻画。
Conclusion: 该工作为自主探索任务中的事前部署规划提供了第一步，但论文未提及实际环境部署或与人类语言词汇的显式对比。

summary_sections.method: 提出NSLD框架：智能体群体进行指代游戏，每个智能体使用CLIP视觉编码器、FAISS向量索引和文本LLM，通过嵌入空间的语义相似性将发现的外星词汇锚定到自然语言，实现自主词汇自组织。
summary_sections.result: 在最多20个智能体和10个视觉指代物的模拟中达成共识，收敛动态通过三个分析模型以R²>0.95的精度刻画。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为自主探索任务中的事前部署规划提供了第一步，但论文未提及实际环境部署或与人类语言词汇的显式对比。

papers.title: DRP-FLR: Data-Driven Assessment of Demand Response Potential for Flexible Load Regulation in Smart Grids
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of AI workloads and renewable energy resources exacerbates supply-demand imbalance in power systems, making traditional load regulation designed for efficient allocation inadequate and motivating demand response (DR) mechanisms to enable load controllability in smart grids. However, existing DR-oriented approaches either focus on optimizing electricity cost or occupant comfort with limited benefit to system-level balance. Others overlook the diverse and dynamic consumption patterns of heterogeneous energy entities, leading to significant over- or under-regulation. Therefore, we propose DRP-FLR. First, DRP-FLR achieves accurate short-term load forecasting by embedding exogenous knowledge (e.g., entity information, prediction time) into historical load representations. Next, it constructs entity-specific load-pattern profiles by clustering historical load curves, and estimates DR potential by matching forecasted loads with pattern profiles. Finally, DRP-FLR formulates flexible load regulation as a mixed-integer optimization problem and solves it with an MILP solver to jointly optimize DR utilization, participant economic benefit, and renewable accommodation, while enforcing supply-demand balance and economic feasibility. Experiments on a regional grid and a campus microgrid show that DRP-FLR reduces regulation deviation by 36.63%-91.87% and improves participant benefit by 44.66% on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRP-FLR，一种数据驱动的需求响应潜力评估方法，用于智能电网中的灵活负荷调节。该方法通过嵌入外部知识实现短期负荷预测，构建负荷模式轮廓并匹配预测负荷以估算需求响应潜力，最后将负荷调节建模为混合整数优化问题，使用 MILP 求解器优化需求响应利用、参与者经济效益和可再生能源消纳。实验表明，DRP-FLR 在区域电网和校园微电网中将调节偏差降低 36.63%-91.87%，参与者平均收益提升 44.66%。
Motivation: 现有需求响应方法要么侧重于优化用电成本或用户舒适度，对系统级平衡帮助有限，要么忽视异质能源实体的多样动态消费模式，导致过度或不足调节。需要一种能精准评估需求响应潜力并优化调节的方法。
Method: DRP-FLR 包含三步：1) 将外部知识（实体信息、预测时间）嵌入历史负荷表示，实现精准短期负荷预测；2) 聚类历史负荷曲线构建实体特定负荷模式轮廓，通过匹配预测负荷与轮廓估算需求响应潜力；3) 将灵活负荷调节表述为混合整数优化问题，用 MILP 求解器联合优化需求响应利用率、参与者经济效益和可再生能源消纳，同时保证供需平衡和经济可行性。
Result: 在区域电网和校园微电网实验中，DRP-FLR 将调节偏差降低 36.63%-91.87%，参与者平均收益提升 44.66%。
Conclusion: DRP-FLR 通过数据驱动方法有效提升需求响应调节精度和参与者收益，但摘要未说明其可扩展性、实时性限制或对异常事件的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ParBench: A Benchmark for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Parallel Code Translation
papers.abstract_en: Modern compute-intensive software must migrate across a changing ecosystem of accelerators, programming APIs, compiler stacks, and portability layers, including CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. Large language models and autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed for such migration, but the field lacks reliable ways to measure whether they preserve the low-level parallel semantics that make translations behaviorally valid, including thread indexing, synchronization, memory management, host-device coordination, and API-specific execution structure. We present ParBench, a kernel-centric benchmark framework for evaluating LLM-based parallel API translation under executable, reproducible conditions. ParBench fixes the surrounding build, run, and verification infrastructure through declarative benchmark specifications and asks models to translate only the computational kernels. It draws on multiple open-source HPC suites and covers representative cross-API translation directions among CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. To test whether success reflects robust translation rather than surface-form memorization, ParBench includes AST-driven, intended behavior-preserving, baseline-validated source augmentation. Evaluations on state-of-the-art open and proprietary LLMs show persistent barriers to reliable parallel code translation, including direction asymmetry, multi-file coordination, incomplete API adaptation, and uneven robustness to source-level perturbations. Code is available at https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/ParBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParBench 是一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在并行代码翻译任务中可靠性的基准框架。该框架专注于 CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL 和 OpenMP target offload 之间的翻译，通过声明式规范固定构建、运行和验证基础设施，要求模型仅翻译计算核心，并引入 AST 驱动的源增强来测试翻译的鲁棒性。评估表明，现有开源和闭源 LLM 在并行代码翻译中仍存在方向不对称、多文件协调、API 适配不完全以及对源级扰动鲁棒性不足等问题。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 被越来越多地用于跨加速器、编程 API 和编译器栈的代码迁移，但缺乏可靠的方法来评估翻译是否保留了底层并行语义（如线程索引、同步、内存管理、主机-设备协调等），导致翻译的行为有效性无法保证。
Method: 提出 ParBench，一个以核心（kernel）为中心的基准框架，使用声明式规范固定构建、运行和验证基础设施，让模型仅翻译计算核心。包括多源 HPC 套件，覆盖 CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL 和 OpenMP target offload 间的翻译方向，并通过 AST 驱动的、保留预期行为的源增强来区分鲁棒翻译与表面形式记忆。
Result: 对多个领先的开源和专有 LLM 评估显示，并行代码翻译仍面临持续障碍：方向不对称（不同翻译对性能差异大）、多文件协调困难、API 适配不完全以及翻译对源级扰动的鲁棒性不均。
Conclusion: ParBench 提供了一个可重复、可执行的基准，揭示了当前 LLM 在并行代码翻译中的局限性，强调了需要更可靠的方法来确保并行语义的正确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TriSP: Tri-Signal Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks but their deployment is constrained by the memory and compute cost of their parameters. Structured pruning addresses this by removing entire structures such as attention heads and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neurons to produce smaller dense models that run efficiently on standard hardware. However, existing methods rely on either gradient-based importance estimation, which is memory-prohibitive, or activation-based statistical proxies, which do not directly measure the effect of removal on the loss. Furthermore, the interaction between the importance criterion and the post-pruning recovery strategy has not been systematically studied. We propose TriSP (Tri-Signal Structured Pruning), an importance metric that combines weight magnitude scaled by activation norm with first-order gradient sensitivity via a geometric mean, producing a channel-level score that captures both structural and loss-sensitivity signals. Combined with adaptive per-layer budget allocation and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) recovery, TriSP achieves the lowest perplexity and highest zero-shot accuracy across all tested configurations, reaching 6.80 WikiText-2 perplexity at 20% pruning on LLaMA-7B. Inference throughput improves by 82% at 50% pruning, while still maintaining competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出TriSP（三信号结构化剪枝）方法，用于大语言模型的结构化剪枝，结合权重幅值、激活范数和一阶梯度的几何均值作为重要性度量，并辅以自适应逐层预算分配和低秩适应（LoRA）恢复。在LLaMA-7B上20%剪枝时WikiText-2困惑度达6.80，50%剪枝时推理吞吐量提升82%。
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法要么基于内存昂贵的梯度估计，要么基于激活统计代理，无法直接衡量剪枝对损失的影响；且重要性准则与剪枝后恢复策略之间的交互未被系统研究。
Method: 提出TriSP重要性度量，通过几何均值融合权重幅值、激活范数和一阶梯度敏感性，生成通道级分数；结合自适应逐层预算分配和LoRA恢复。
Result: 在LLaMA-7B上20%剪枝达到6.80 WikiText-2困惑度，50%剪枝时推理吞吐量提升82%，同时保持竞争性能。
Conclusion: TriSP结合多信号重要性度量与自适应恢复策略，实现高效结构化剪枝，降低部署成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inference, where decoding-time queries exhibit substantially larger variance than prefilling-stage representations, leading to unstable KV importance estimation under tight cache budgets. As a result, small ranking errors can disproportionately discard semantically critical visual tokens and degrade grounding and reasoning performance. We propose MM-ShiftKV, a training-free, decode-aware and strictly prefill-only KV selection method. MM-ShiftKV approximates decoding-time query behavior during prefilling by constructing variance-expanded query proxies and estimates prompt KV importance based on their aggregated attention mass. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MM-ShiftKV consistently outperforms existing methods under strict KV-cache budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/MM-ShiftKV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-ShiftKV，一种无需训练、解码感知且仅预填充阶段的 KV 选择方法，用于多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs)。该方法通过在预填充阶段构造方差扩展的查询代理来模拟解码时的查询行为，从而更稳定地估计 KV 重要性。实验表明，在严格 KV 缓存预算下，MM-ShiftKV 在多个多模态基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有预填充阶段 KV 重要性估计方法假设预填充查询能代表解码查询，但在多模态推理中解码查询方差更大，导致紧凑缓存下视觉 token 被错误丢弃，影响 grounding 和推理性能。
Method: 提出 MM-ShiftKV，在预填充阶段构造方差扩展的查询代理 (variance-expanded query proxies) 来近似解码时的查询行为，然后基于聚合注意力质量估计 prompt KV 重要性。
Result: 在多模态基准测试上，MM-ShiftKV 在严格 KV 缓存预算下持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需训练、严格预填充阶段执行，并开源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Scaffold Effect in Coding Agents: Harness Choice as a Hidden Variable in Coding-Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Public leaderboards for coding agents typically rank systems by model name and pass rate, while the surrounding harness (the scaffold that issues tools, manages context, and decides when to stop) is often under-specified. Model-to-model comparison is valid when the harness is fixed; when it varies, performance and efficiency conflate model and scaffold effects. We evaluate Qwen 3.6 Plus and MiniMax M2.5 across three open-source harnesses (Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK) on a stratified 50-task subset of Terminal-Bench Pro. Harness choice induces up to a 40x difference in tokens per solved task, while paired within-model pass-rate differences remain 0-8 percentage points (95% paired-task bootstrap CIs include zero except for the largest gap). Failure fingerprints replicate across models (REASON for Goose, VERIFY/MAX_TURNS for OpenHands-SDK, idle-loop/TIME for OpenCode), indicating harness-level biases that are largely model-independent. For human-centered coding-agent evaluation, model name alone is an incomplete comparison unit: harness-model pairs determine real-world cost, latency, and oversight burden; no-action turns are a per-task wait tax, not just a token tax. We therefore recommend selecting harness-model pairs by pass rate under token/latency budgets, and reporting token usage, latency, and full harness specifications alongside any model comparison. We release anonymized configs, raw trial logs, aggregated snapshots, and analysis scripts.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Preliminary work; under review at the 5th DL4C Workshop @ ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究编程助手（coding agents）的评估中，scaffold（提供工具、管理上下文、决定停止的框架）选择对性能指标的影响。实验发现，不同scaffold（Goose、OpenCode、OpenHands-SDK）导致每个解决任务的token消耗差异高达40倍，而同一模型在不同scaffold上的通过率差异通常在0-8个百分点内。失败模式在不同模型间复现，表明scaffold级偏差。作者建议在比较模型时，应同时报告scaffold规范、token使用和延迟。
Motivation: 当前编程助手排行榜通常仅按模型名称和通过率排名，而scaffold常被忽略，导致模型间比较混淆了模型与scaffold的影响。
Method: 在Terminal-Bench Pro的50任务子集上，使用三个开源scaffold（Goose、OpenCode、OpenHands-SDK）评估Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5，分析通过率、token消耗和失败模式。
Result: Scaffold选择导致每个解决任务的token消耗差异达40倍；同一模型在不同scaffold上的通过率差异在0-8个百分点内（95% bootstrap置信区间多数包含零）。失败模式（如Goose的REASON、OpenHands-SDK的VERIFY/MAX_TURNS、OpenCode的idle-loop/TIME）在不同模型间一致，表明scaffold级偏差。
Conclusion: 对于以人为中心的编程助手评估，模型名称单独不足以作为比较单位；应选择scaffold-模型对，并报告token使用、延迟和scaffold规格。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究编程助手（coding agents）的评估中，scaffold（提供工具、管理上下文、决定停止的框架）选择对性能指标的影响。实验发现，不同scaffold（Goose、OpenCode、OpenHands-SDK）导致每个解决任务的token消耗差异高达40倍，而同一模型在不同scaffold上的通过率差异通常在0-8个百分点内。失败模式在不同模型间复现，表明scaffold级偏差。作者建议在比较模型时，应同时报告scaffold规范、token使用和延迟。
summary_sections.motivation: 当前编程助手排行榜通常仅按模型名称和通过率排名，而scaffold常被忽略，导致模型间比较混淆了模型与scaffold的影响。
summary_sections.method: 在Terminal-Bench Pro的50任务子集上，使用三个开源scaffold（Goose、OpenCode、OpenHands-SDK）评估Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5，分析通过率、token消耗和失败模式。
summary_sections.result: Scaffold选择导致每个解决任务的token消耗差异达40倍；同一模型在不同scaffold上的通过率差异在0-8个百分点内（95% bootstrap置信区间多数包含零）。失败模式（如Goose的REASON、OpenHands-SDK的VERIFY/MAX_TURNS、OpenCode的idle-loop/TIME）在不同模型间一致，表明scaffold级偏差。

papers.title: Source-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Reliability Prior Approach
papers.abstract_en: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines rank retrieved documents by semantic similarity alone, without accounting for source provenance or credibility. This work evaluates a simple and interpretable modification to RAG retrieval ranking that incorporates domain-informed source reliability priors. Each document is assigned a prior lambda(s) based on its source type, and retrieval scores are reweighted using score(q, d) = sim(q, d) * lambda(s). The framework is evaluated against a similarity-only baseline on a 120-document health-domain corpus. In this controlled setting, source-aware reranking improves Precision@5 from 0.48 to 0.72 and reduces average adversarial document retrieval under the evaluated threat model, where low-credibility sources are identifiable via metadata. All experiments were executed on Rosie, the high-performance computing cluster at the Milwaukee School of Engineering, which provided the GPU-accelerated infrastructure necessary to run the full experimental pipeline reliably and reproducibly. These results suggest a potential mitigation strategy for source quality degradation in RAG pipelines, within the limits of the experimental setup described.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标准检索增强生成（RAG）管线仅依赖语义相似度排序、忽略文档来源可信度的问题，提出一种简单可解释的修改：引入基于来源类型的可靠性先验，将检索分数重加权为 sim(q,d) * lambda(s)。在120篇文档的健康领域语料库上，该源感知重排序方法将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并降低了平均对抗文档检索成功率。
Motivation: 标准RAG排序仅考虑语义相似度，未利用文档来源的可信度信息，导致低质量或对抗性文档可能被优先检索，影响生成可靠性。
Method: 为每个文档根据其来源类型分配先验可靠性权重 lambda(s)，然后按重加权分数 score(q,d)=sim(q,d)*lambda(s) 对检索结果重新排序。
Result: 在健康领域120文档语料库上，源感知重排序相比纯相似度基线将Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并在所评估的威胁模型下降低了平均对抗文档检索成功率。
Conclusion: 该可解释的源感知重排序策略在受控实验条件下显示能缓解RAG管线中来源质量下降的问题，但结论局限于特定的实验设置。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架，用于在边缘设备上部署大型语言模型（LLM）。框架包含粗粒度阶段（移除整个注意力/MLP块）和细粒度阶段（使用并行贝叶斯优化优化层间剪枝率，并基于重要性策略剪枝具体组件）。实验表明在37.5%和50%剪枝率下，该方法在常识推理任务上优于现有方法，同时显著降低推理成本。
Motivation: LLM在嵌入式/边缘设备上部署受限于严格的延迟、内存和能量约束。现有剪枝方法难以联合优化层、注意力头和MLP维度，穷举搜索计算昂贵且易陷入局部最优。
Method: 提出两阶段结构化剪枝框架。粗粒度阶段通过多目标深度剪枝移除整个注意力/MLP块；细粒度阶段采用并行贝叶斯优化（PBO）在延迟约束下搜索最优层剪枝率，并使用基于重要性的策略在每层预算内选择具体组件进行剪枝。
Result: 在37.5%和50%剪枝率下，该方法在多个LLM上的常识推理任务性能优于现有剪枝方法，同时显著降低推理成本。
Conclusion: 该方法在精度、延迟和模型大小之间实现了有利的权衡，适合边缘部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HeraSys: Collaborative Serving of Multiple LLM Workflows via Fine-Grained End-to-End Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted serving systems from processing isolated requests to orchestrating high-concurrency, multi-tenant agentic workflows. However, existing solutions typically prioritize intra-workflow optimization, largely neglecting the significant potential for inter-workflow optimization. In this paper, we propose HeraSys, an LLM serving system designed to optimize the end-to-end performance of concurrent workflows. Through fine-grained orchestration, HeraSys eliminates cross-workflow computational redundancy via structural node merging and reuse. Furthermore, HeraSys introduces a load-aware joint scheduling policy that dynamically manages execution order by evaluating both inter- and intra-query priorities. By integrating a resource skewing mechanism with adaptive batching and pipeline decomposition, HeraSys effectively mitigates tail latency while maintaining low average latency, thereby substantially improving system throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HeraSys reduces P99 latency by up to 2.17$\times$ and increases serving throughput by up to 1.85$\times$ under strict latency guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HeraSys，一个为多个 LLM 工作流（workflow）提供协作服务的系统，通过细粒度端到端优化消除跨工作流的计算冗余、引入负载感知联合调度策略以及资源倾斜机制，在严格延迟保证下显著提升吞吐量并降低尾延迟。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统主要针对单工作流内部优化，忽视了多工作流之间的协作优化潜力，导致资源利用不足和延迟问题。
Method: 采用结构化节点合并与重用以消除跨工作流冗余计算；提出负载感知联合调度策略，动态管理执行顺序；集成资源倾斜机制与自适应批处理及流水线分解。
Result: 在实验中，P99 延迟降低最多 2.17 倍，在严格延迟保证下服务吞吐量提升最多 1.85 倍。
Conclusion: HeraSys 通过细粒度端到端优化有效提升了并发 LLM 工作流的服务性能，适用于多租户场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel streams but incurs substantial overhead and suffers from homogenized routing and gradient collapse, and AltUp, which uses an auxiliary prediction branch but offers limited adaptivity and slow convergence. We establish that MoE-style mixture layers can be reformulated as variable-kernel dynamic convolutions, where each expert corresponds to a $1{\times}1$ convolutional kernel and routing implements input-conditioned kernel aggregation. Building on this equivalence, we introduce cMoLLM: a convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs that routes over end-to-end streams through fully differentiable dynamic convolution. In GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, cMoLLM improves language modeling perplexity and downstream GLUE and SQuAD accuracy under matched compute, with better stream utilization, more stable optimization, and favorable scaling compared to ParaScale- and AltUp-style baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出cMoLLM，一种卷积门控的混合LLM（Mixture-of-LLMs），将MoE风格混合层重新表述为可变核动态卷积，每个专家对应1×1卷积核，路由实现输入条件核聚合。在GPT-2风格模型上，cMoLLM在匹配计算下改进语言建模困惑度和下游GLUE、SQuAD准确率，相比ParaScale和AltUp基线具有更好的流利用率、更稳定的优化和更有利的缩放特性。
Motivation: 密集Transformer将容量和计算耦合，每个token激活所有参数，导致训练和推理成本随模型大小线性增长，成为万亿参数模型的瓶颈。现有流水线级方法如ParaScale和AltUp存在开销大、路由同质化、梯度崩溃或适应性有限等问题。
Method: 提出cMoLLM，基于MoE风格混合层与可变核动态卷积的等价性，通过全可微动态卷积在端到端流上进行路由。每个专家对应1×1卷积核，路由实现输入条件核聚合。
Result: 在GPT-2风格模型上，cMoLLM在匹配计算下改进语言建模困惑度和下游GLUE、SQuAD准确率，具有更好的流利用率、更稳定的优化和有利的缩放特性。
Conclusion: cMoLLM通过卷积门控的混合LLM设计，有效扩展容量而不显著增加计算成本，优于ParaScale和AltUp基线。

papers.title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal order memory task. Using a new dataset of human behavior based on memory of a full-length novel, we show that models exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on this task. We next apply long-context mechanistic interpretability analyses to uncover how models solve this task, and find that model performance relies on a one-dimensional temporal code that is reinstated during retrieval by a single time-reinstatement attention head. These findings support temporal context reinstatement as an important mechanism for episodic-like temporal-order memory in LLMs, offering new insights into how temporal aspects of long-term episodic memory may be instantiated in both artificial and biological systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过长上下文语言模型模拟人类情景记忆中的时序记忆行为，发现模型能复现人类在完整小说记忆任务中的距离效应，并揭示其依赖一个单一的时间重现注意力头所恢复的一维时间编码。该结果支持时间上下文重现作为情景式时序记忆的关键机制。
Motivation: 人类情景记忆的长时间跨度的计算机制因实验可解释性有限而难以研究，长上下文语言模型可能提供新的视角来揭示这种检索的计算原理。
Method: 基于人类对完整新书记忆的行为数据集，构建时序记忆任务；对长上下文语言模型进行行为测试，并应用可解释性分析（mechanistic interpretability）定位模型内部的注意力头活动。
Result: 模型在时序记忆任务中表现出与人类相同的距离效应，且该表现由单个时间重现注意力头恢复的一维时间编码驱动。
Conclusion: 时间上下文重现是语言模型中实现情景式时序记忆的重要机制，为理解人工和生物系统中长时情景记忆的时间方面提供了新见解。

papers.title: Too much evidence, too little time: From text to actionable recommendations through multi-objective evidence reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Evidence-based clinical decision making requires specialists to identify, evaluate and synthesize relevant scientific literature. However, PubMed searches for complex clinical cases often return hundreds of publications that cannot be reviewed manually under time constraints. This study proposes SCEPTER (Single-Case Evidence-driven PubMed-To-rEcommendation Reasoner), a framework for transforming clinical case descriptions into evidence-based recommendations. SCEPTER combines PubMed retrieval, PubMedBERT semantic ranking, large language model (LLM)-based claim extraction, evidence-level weighting, contradiction detection, consensus analysis and multi-objective Pareto claim selection. The framework generates structured evidence syntheses and grounded actionable recommendations. A Paper Q&A module further enables interactive exploration of selected publications. The proposed framework introduces multi-objective reasoning model that integrates literature support, contradiction analysis and interactive literature interrogation into a unified clinical decision-support pipeline. Evaluation on 150 case studies demonstrated that the framework reduced an average search space of 576 papers to 53 retained papers, 7 Pareto-optimal claims and 3 final recommendations, corresponding to an overall compression ratio of 192:1. Despite this reduction, the retained evidence maintained high diversity (entropy=0.901). The ablation study showed that Pareto-based selection increased evidence diversity and recommendation utility compared with conventional ranking approaches.

papers.title: PhononBench-MP40: a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset for phonon stability
papers.abstract_en: Imaginary phonon modes remain a practical bottleneck in computational materials screening because otherwise plausible structures can be locally dynamically unstable under a chosen workflow. Here we present PhononBench-MP40, a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset of Materials Project-derived crystals for workflow-defined phonon stability. The dataset starts from 47,969 MP40 workflow tasks and provides 46,899 completed records with paired stability labels and local phonopy YAML spectra, including 16,683 Stable records and 30,216 completed-phonon unstable records. A further 1,067 relaxation failures are reported separately rather than merged into the completed phonon denominator. The release centers on the local YAML spectrum: the stability label, the lowest sampled frequency and any threshold-dependent relabeling are derived from that spectrum. The dataset is openly available through Science Data Bank at https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.38735. A companion GitHub repository provides the calculation code and lightweight access utilities. PhononBench-MP40 provides an auditable reference for workflow-defined stability classification, minimum-frequency analysis, threshold studies and failure-aware triage, while keeping the reference workflow, data schema and interpretation boundaries explicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了 PhononBench-MP40 数据集，包含从 Materials Project 中提取的 46,899 个声子稳定性记录，每个记录带有工作流定义的稳定性标签和局部声子谱（YAML 格式）。数据集区分了稳定、不稳定和弛豫失败的记录，并提供了最低采样频率等逐谱信息，旨在为声子稳定性分类、阈值研究和失败感知筛选提供可审计的基准。
Motivation: 虚构声子模（imaginary phonon modes）在计算材料筛选中是实际瓶颈，因为即使结构在所选工作流下局部动态不稳定，也可能被误认为合理。需要一个带有完整谱信息和工作流定义明确的数据集来支持稳定性分类和阈值研究。
Method: 从 Materials Project 的 MP40 工作流出发，收集 47,969 个任务，经过筛选得到 46,899 个完成记录（16,683 稳定、30,216 不稳定），同时单独报告 1,067 个弛豫失败案例。每个记录关联其本地 phonopy YAML 谱，稳定性标签和最低频率等均从该谱导出。数据集通过 Science Data Bank 公开，并附带计算代码和访问工具。
Result: 数据集包含 46,899 个完成记录，其中稳定 16,683 个、不稳定 30,216 个，另有 1,067 个弛豫失败案例。提供了每个记录的 YAML 格式局部声子谱及最低频率等信息。

papers.title: Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL): Live Schema Grounding and Hallucination Validation for Oracle NL2SQL
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate fluent SQL from natural language, but on real enterprise Oracle databases they frequently fail at execution time: columns and aliases are hallucinated and dialect-specific syntax is missed, leading to ORA-00904 invalid-identifier errors. In this setting, failures are primarily due to missing schema grounding: the model cannot know which tables and columns actually exist. This paper introduces Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL), a lightweight middleware layer for Oracle NL2SQL that requires no model retraining. SAL queries Oracle's USER_TAB_COLUMNS catalog to build a live schema map, selects a relevant table subset for each question (falling back to the full schema for multi-table queries), and injects this ground-truth context into the LLM prompt. Generated SQL is then checked by the Hallucination Index (Hidx), which validates every alias.column reference against the live catalog, automatically rewrites predictable prefix errors, and otherwise triggers a structured retry with itemised corrections. We evaluate SAL on 500 TPC-H natural language questions executed against a live Oracle Autonomous Database 23c instance using GPT-4o-mini. Without any schema grounding, execution-grounded truth (EGT; executes and matches the reference result set) is 2.2% (12/500). A hand-written static schema hint brings EGT to 62.0%. SAL, with no manual schema curation, achieves 62.6% EGT (96% simple, 95% medium, 40.7% complex) while reducing execution failures from 97.6% to 2.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL)，一个轻量级中间件层，用于Oracle数据库的自然语言转SQL (NL2SQL) 任务。SAL通过查询Oracle的系统目录实时构建模式映射，选择相关表注入提示，并利用幻觉索引验证生成的SQL。在500个TPC-H问题上，SAL实现了62.6%的执行接地准确率，相比无模式接地时的2.2%有显著提升。
Motivation: LLM在真实企业Oracle数据库上生成SQL时，经常因缺乏模式接地（schema grounding）而失败，导致无效标识符错误。现有方法需要手动静态模式提示或模型重训练，不适用于动态生产环境。
Method: SAL通过查询Oracle的USER_TAB_COLUMNS目录构建实时模式映射，为每个问题选择相关表子集，注入真实上下文到LLM提示中。生成SQL后由幻觉索引验证每个列引用，自动重写常见前缀错误，并触发结构化重试。
Result: 在500个TPC-H问题上的评估显示，无模式接地时执行接地准确率（EGT）为2.2%，手动静态模式提示达到62.0%，而SAL无需手动策展达到62.6%，并将执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。
Conclusion: SAL作为一种无需模型重训练的轻量级中间件，能有效解决Oracle NL2SQL中的模式接地问题，显著提升SQL执行成功率。

papers.title: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) enables natural language interaction with structured enterprise knowledge, yet existing agentic approaches that perform well on public benchmarks often fail to generalize to real-world enterprise Knowledge Graphs (KGs), which are dense, schema-driven, and operationally constrained. To address these limitations, we propose SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning), a training-free framework that integrates structured planning with controlled iterative reasoning by injecting schema-conditioned structural priors and enforcing schema-aware traversal during multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on an enterprise-oriented benchmark constructed from a real-world Configuration Management DataBase (CMDB) demonstrate that SCAIR substantially improves performance over existing KG-RAG methods. Crucially, our study highlights that reliable enterprise graph reasoning cannot rely on generic agentic designs; instead, it must explicitly incorporate the target domain's structural and operational constraints into the reasoning process. We demonstrate that by aligning agent design with business logic, substantial performance gains can be achieved without the need for costly model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCAIR 是一种无需训练的框架，通过注入模式条件结构先验并强制模式感知遍历，用于企业知识图谱（KG）的多跳推理。在从真实配置管理数据库构建的企业基准上，SCAIR 显著优于现有 KG-RAG 方法。研究表明，可靠的企业图推理必须显式融入目标领域的结构和操作约束，而非依赖通用智能体设计。
Motivation: 现有基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（KG-RAG）方法在公共基准上表现良好，但难以泛化到现实企业知识图谱——这些图谱密集、以模式驱动且受操作约束。
Method: 提出 SCAIR，一种无需训练的框架，通过注入模式条件结构先验并强制执行模式感知遍历，实现结构化规划与受控迭代推理的结合。
Result: 在基于真实配置管理数据库（CMDB）构建的企业基准上，SCAIR 显著提升了性能，优于现有 KG-RAG 方法。
Conclusion: 可靠的企业图推理必须显式融入目标领域的结构和操作约束，通过将智能体设计与业务逻辑对齐，可在无需昂贵模型重训练的情况下实现显著性能提升。

papers.title: Reference Feature Atlases for Mechanistic Auditing of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Auditing a new language model usually means relearning and reinterpreting its internal features from scratch. We propose a reference feature atlas: a sparse feature library trained once on a reference panel and reused for new targets, which attach by fitting only a linear decoder. This yields two complementary views. The atlas channel reads the target on already interpreted panel features, providing a stable coordinate system across models. The residual channel learns features only from what the atlas fails to reconstruct, making "outside the reference panel" an explicit audit signal. We train leave-one-out atlases over five 7-9B instruction-tuned models and audit held-out Mistral and Qwen targets. On three controlled LoRA hidden objectives injected into both targets, the residual channel makes the planted mechanism perfectly controllable at runtime while matched controls stay unaffected and recovers the planted objective as the top-ranked latent across both targets; on Mistral, where the per-target SAE and pairwise crosscoder baselines are retrained for a head-to-head benchmark, both baselines fail to do so. On Qwen-2.5, the same channel additionally reveals a panel-relative political-framing cluster; steering it shifts the audited framing metrics while out-of-domain controls remain unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参考特征图集（reference feature atlas）方法，用于语言模型的机制审计。该方法先在参考模型面板上训练稀疏特征库，新模型只需拟合线性解码器即可复用该图集，产生图谱通道（反映已知特征）和残差通道（捕获未重建的特征）。实验表明，残差通道能有效检测注入的隐藏目标，并发现模型间相对的政治倾向聚类。
Motivation: 现有审计新语言模型时需从头学习其内部特征，耗时且难以跨模型比较。本文旨在构建一个可复用的特征库，减少重复工作并提供稳定的跨模型坐标系统。
Method: 在参考模型面板上训练稀疏特征库（参考特征图集），新模型通过仅训练线性解码器附加到该图集上。图集提供两个视图：图谱通道复用已解读的特征，残差通道学习图集未能重建的部分，成为显式的审计信号。
Result: 在五个7-9B指令微调模型上训练留一法图集，并在Mistral和Qwen目标上审计。残差通道使注入的LoRA隐藏目标完全可控，且不被匹配的对照组影响，而每目标SAE和跨编码器基线均失败。在Qwen-2.5上，残差通道还揭示了与面板相对的政治倾向聚类，干预该通道可改变框架度量。
Conclusion: 参考特征图集提供了一种高效、可复用的跨模型审计框架，残差通道作为关键审计信号，能检测新颖特征或违规行为。该方法有望降低审计成本并提升可解释性。

papers.title: Execution-Grounded Security Testing for Coding Agents in Software Engineering Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into system operations, where their tool use can directly modify project artifacts, execution environments, and the underlying system. For example, if a coding agent inserts a hook into a system startup or configuration script, that change can persist after the interaction, be triggered later, and abuse delegated user or system privileges to modify the system. This makes security testing a system problem: the key question is not only what the agent says, but what it actually does to the surrounding environment. We present an execution-grounded red-team testing framework for probing this execution-layer security boundary using observable sandbox evidence, including tool invocations, runtime traces, and file-system diffs. Our framework embeds target unsafe operations into routine software engineering workloads, including unit testing, regression testing, crash reproduction, and validation, and uses an execution oracle to guide refinement when an initial probe is rejected or fails. Across multiple agent frameworks and model backbones, our red-team workload reformulation substantially increases verified unsafe execution, reaching 73.61% on code carriers and 53.93% on text carriers. These results show that coding agents in system operations remain insecure under task disguise: once risky intent is hidden inside plausible engineering tasks, the agent can be induced to carry out unsafe actions on the surrounding system. More broadly, coding agents in system operations still demand stronger security testing and safeguards.

papers.title: Keyword Matters: Unveiling the Energy Sensitivity of On-Device LLM Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on mobile and embedded devices to improve privacy and reduce network latency. Yet on-device inference faces a fundamental constraint: high energy consumption on battery-powered, resource-limited hardware. While model compression and runtime acceleration have been widely studied, the effect of \emph{prompt design} on energy efficiency remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical study of the relationship between prompt wording and energy consumption for on-device LLMs. Using real power measurements collected on a smartphone, we quantify how linguistic features, particularly imperative keywords and instruction structure, affect decoding length and total energy. Our results show consistent energy differences across verbs and tasks, indicating that prompt engineering is a lightweight lever for improving energy efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过智能手机上的真实功耗测量，实证研究提示词设计对端侧大语言模型能量消耗的影响。结果表明，不同动词和任务指令结构一致地导致解码长度和总能耗的差异，提示词工程可作为提升能量效率的轻量级手段。
Motivation: 端侧LLM面临高能耗瓶颈，现有研究多关注模型压缩和运行时加速，但提示词设计对能耗的影响尚缺乏系统研究。
Method: 在智能手机上采用实际功率测量，量化语言特征（尤其是关键动词和指令结构）对解码长度和总能耗的影响。
Result: 不同动词和任务类型之间观察到一致的能耗差异，表明提示词工程能作为轻量级的能耗优化手段。
Conclusion: 提示词设计是影响端侧LLM能耗的重要因素，值得在部署中加以利用。

papers.title: A Formal Kinetic Theory for Zeroth-Order Newton Dynamics:Stein-Corrected Hessian Estimation and Curvature--Variance Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order Newton-type methods are useful when gradients and Hessians are unavailable, but they behave quite differently from first-order gradient-free methods. We develop a kinetic framework for algorithms that estimate both gradient and Hessian from black-box function values. The naive random-direction Hessian estimator turns out to be biased even on quadratics; a Gaussian--Stein correction is needed to estimate the Hessian of the Gaussian-smoothed objective. Linearizing the inverse Hessian exposes two noise channels: gradient noise preconditioned by the inverse Hessian, and Hessian noise transmitted through an inverse-Hessian sandwich. Under a noisy oracle the second channel carries the second-difference factor $μ_H^{-4}$. A small-mass kinetic lift links the finite-step Newton update to an underdamped phase-space model; the overdamped spatial limit yields a Lyapunov bound that exposes the curvature--variance trade-off between step size, batch sizes, smoothing radii, and regularization. Numerical experiments confirm estimator identities, the gradient and Hessian variance laws, dimension scaling, inverse-perturbation accuracy, and optimization behavior under query-budget and regularization ablations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为无梯度黑箱优化中的零阶牛顿型方法建立了形式化的动力学理论。发现朴素随机方向Hessian估计即使在二次函数上也有偏，需要高斯-斯坦因（Gaussian-Stein）修正来估计高斯平滑目标的Hessian。线性化逆Hessian揭示了两种噪声通道：梯度噪声（经逆Hessian预处理）和Hessian噪声（通过逆Hessian三明治传输），后者携带二次差分因子μ_H^{-4}。小质量动力学提升将有限步牛顿更新与欠阻尼相空间模型联系起来；过阻尼空间极限给出Lyapunov界，暴露了步长、批量大小、平滑半径与正则化之间的曲率-方差权衡。数值实验验证了估计量恒等式、梯度和Hessian方差律、维度缩放、逆扰动精度以及查询预算和正则化消融下的优化行为。
Motivation: 零阶牛顿方法在梯度与Hessian不可用时有用，但其行为与一阶无梯度方法截然不同，缺乏系统的动力学理解。现有Hessian估计存在偏差，且噪声机制不明确。
Method: 发展了一个动力学框架来估计黑箱函数值的梯度与Hessian：提出高斯-斯坦因修正来消除Hessian估计偏差；通过线性化逆Hessian分析两种噪声通道；利用小质量动力学提升将牛顿步与欠阻尼相空间模型关联。
Result: 揭示了Hessian噪声通道携带因子μ_H^{-4}；导出了曲率-方差权衡的Lyapunov界；数值实验验证了估计量恒等式、方差律、维度缩放和优化性能。
Conclusion: 该理论为零阶牛顿方法提供了严格的动力学基础，阐明了偏差-方差权衡和噪声结构，有助于设计更优的算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedLoCoMo: A Long-Context Multi-Session Medical Dialogue Benchmark for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: MedLoCoMo is a Medical Long-Context Memory benchmark for patient-specific clinical reasoning over multi-admission medical dialogue. Existing medical QA benchmarks largely test short context knowledge or single document grounding, leaving open whether LLMs can use, connect, and abstain over longitudinal patient histories. We build MedLoCoMo from deidentified MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note records by constructing admission-level clinical packets, synthesizing grounded doctor-patient conversations, and generating evidence linked QA items over single-admission, cross-admission, and adversarial unanswerable settings. The benchmark contains 100 patient timelines averaging 1,669.8 turns, 29.7 sessions, and 74,512.2 tokens per conversation. Across the evaluated baselines, cross-admission reasoning is consistently harder than localized evidence use, even when models have long context windows or use external memory or retrieval methods. The code and MedLoCoMo benchmark release is available at https://github.com/leozzy13/MedLoCoMo for use and reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedLoCoMo是一个针对大型语言模型在多轮医疗对话中长上下文推理能力的基准测试。该基准基于MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note数据构建，包含100个患者时间线，平均每个对话有1669.8轮、29.7次就诊和74512.2个令牌。基准涵盖单次就诊、跨次就诊和对抗性不可回答三种问题设置，评估发现跨次就诊推理比局部证据使用更难。
Motivation: 现有医疗问答基准主要测试短上下文知识或单文档推理，缺乏评估LLM在长期患者病史中进行连接、利用和拒答能力的基准。
Method: 从MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note记录中构建就诊级临床包，合成医患对话，并生成基于证据的问答项，覆盖单次就诊、跨次就诊和对抗性不可回答三种场景。
Result: 基准包含100个患者时间线，平均长度高；跨次就诊推理一致比局部证据使用更难，即使模型拥有长上下文窗口或使用外部记忆/检索方法。
Conclusion: MedLoCoMo填补了医疗领域长上下文多会话对话基准的空白，并揭示了当前LLM在跨就诊推理上的局限性。

papers.title: DSTFView: Multi-View Cloud-Edge Workload Forecasting with Dual-Input Spatio-Temporal-Frequency Modeling
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread deployment of edge-side AI inference, edge platforms are increasingly required to support latency-sensitive, highly concurrent, and reliability-critical applications. However, existing methods often struggle to balance multidimensional feature modeling and forecasting efficiency in collaborative cloud-edge environments. To address this issue, we propose DSTFView, a dual-input spatio-temporal-frequency multi-view workload forecasting framework for collaborative cloud-edge environments. It jointly models closeness and period dependencies and extracts spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain dependencies. Besides, it designs an adaptive fusion mechanism and adjusts the contribution of each view to capture abrupt changes. Experimental results on the CPU and TP datasets demonstrate that DSTFView consistently outperforms representative baselines across multiple forecasting horizons and evaluation metrics.

TL;DR: 本文提出DSTFView，一种面向云边协同环境的双输入时空频多视图工作负载预测框架。该框架联合建模临近性和周期依赖性，提取空间、时间和频域依赖，并设计自适应融合机制捕捉突变。在CPU和TP数据集上，DSTFView在多个预测时域和评估指标上持续优于代表性基线。

papers.title: Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. Each candidate feature map is treated as an arm. At each play time, one map is temporarily masked and evaluated on a sampled mini-batch; the map is then restored and the observed loss change is converted into a safe-removal reward. After a fixed play budget, candidate maps are ranked by learned scores and the top-k maps are permanently removed with their filters, biases and corresponding next-layer input-channel kernels. The study evaluates UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, compares them with direct/oracle-style evaluation on LeNet/MNIST, and extends the evaluation to MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011 and Oxford Flowers 102. Results show that UCB1 and Thompson Sampling preserve accuracy close to unpruned models while removing feature maps and reducing convolutional computation. Friedman and Nemenyi tests show that UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank, followed by Thompson Sampling; both significantly outperform greedy and magnitude-based pruning while remaining statistically comparable to the original unpruned model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多臂赌博机（multi-armed bandits）的损失感知特征图剪枝框架，用于卷积神经网络。将每个候选特征图视为一个臂，通过临时屏蔽并评估损失变化，在固定预算后移除评分最高的特征图及其相关滤波器。在多个数据集上评估了UCB1和汤普森采样，并与贪心、幅度剪枝等方法比较，结果表明UCB1和汤普森采样能在保持精度的同时减少计算量。
Motivation: 卷积神经网络中存在冗余特征图，增加存储和推理成本。现有剪枝方法可能不够高效或需要大量评估。
Method: 提出基于多臂赌博机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架。每个特征图作为一个臂，每次选择一张图临时屏蔽，用采样小批量评估损失变化，转换为安全移除奖励。固定预算后根据得分移除top-k特征图及其滤波器、偏置和下一层输入通道核。
Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10等数据集上，UCB1和汤普森采样在保持接近未剪枝模型精度的同时移除特征图并减少卷积计算。Friedman和Nemenyi检验显示UCB1平均秩最高，两者显著优于贪心和幅度剪枝，且与原模型统计上可比。
Conclusion: 基于多臂赌博机的剪枝方法能有效识别冗余特征图，减少计算成本而不显著损失精度。

summary_sections.method: 提出基于多臂赌博机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架。每个特征图作为一个臂，每次选择一张图临时屏蔽，用采样小批量评估损失变化，转换为安全移除奖励。固定预算后根据得分移除top-k特征图及其滤波器、偏置和下一层输入通道核。
summary_sections.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10等数据集上，UCB1和汤普森采样在保持接近未剪枝模型精度的同时移除特征图并减少卷积计算。Friedman和Nemenyi检验显示UCB1平均秩最高，两者显著优于贪心和幅度剪枝，且与原模型统计上可比。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基于多臂赌博机的剪枝方法能有效识别冗余特征图，减少计算成本而不显著损失精度。

papers.title: Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents
papers.abstract_en: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了AssetOpsBench基准，增加了智能电网变压器资产类别和四个IEC诊断工具，并提出了ScenarioGeneratorAgent管道，用于合成工业智能体评估场景。该管道通过混合验证-修复循环生成符合标准、物理合理、工具可达的场景，并采用多种优化将端到端运行时间降低8倍，同时保持场景质量。
Motivation: 现有工业智能体基准如AssetOpsBench依赖手动编写场景，覆盖资产类别有限，且缺乏可扩展的合成场景生成方法以支持多样化评估需求。
Method: 提出了ScenarioGeneratorAgent管道，包括构建证据资产画像、在运营域间分配感知预算的场景分配、以及通过混合验证-修复循环生成候选场景，确保模式有效性、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准对齐和去重。优化方面包括两级缓存、并行焦点组生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤。
Result: 在智能电网变压器场景生成上，优化使50个场景的端到端运行时间降低8倍，复合质量分数达到74.2±1.9，与未优化基线73.8±3.0相当。
Conclusion: 基于标准的合成场景生成可以有效扩展工业智能体基准，而不牺牲场景质量。

papers.title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SF-AMS框架，通过模拟记忆单元的长时重要性来压缩LLM智能体的长期记忆，用效用驱动的存活机制替代静态检索和启发式衰减，形成分层记忆结构。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s基准上，多跳推理任务（Qwen2.5-7B）F1提升9.65，时间推理（GPT-4o-mini）F1提升6.91，开放域任务F1提升6.53。
Motivation: LLM智能体处理长上下文时，冗余和无关信息会降低多步推理能力，现有静态检索和启发式衰减方法无法有效维持高效用记忆。
Method: 提出基于效用驱动的记忆存活机制，通过使用冗余和时间信号更新记忆重要性，并设计复合重要性评分融合语义和实体级别信号以增强检索鲁棒性。
Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s上超越LightMem、MemO、A-Mem等强基线：多跳推理F1提升9.65，时间推理提升6.91，开放域任务提升6.53，且跨主干模型泛化能力强。
Conclusion: 建模记忆重要性为动态效用信号对可靠的长上下文推理至关重要。

papers.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM-as-a-judge评估范式的高成本、高延迟和不透明问题，提出程序化蒸馏（program distillation）方法，将LLM的决策逻辑蒸馏为评分程序委员会。系统PAJAMA合成程序评委并聚合决策，同时设置回退机制将低置信度案例交给LLM。实验表明程序化评委可媲美13B参数LLM评委的性能，在RewardBench上蒸馏出的奖励模型以极低成本超越专有LLM标签训练的模型。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge评估虽然广泛使用，但存在每次评估调用LLM的高成本、高延迟以及决策不透明等问题，限制了其可扩展性和可靠性。
Method: 提出程序蒸馏（program distillation），将LLM的决策逻辑蒸馏为一组可直接评分候选样本的程序化评委。系统PAJAMA合成程序评委、聚合其裁决，并包含基于置信度的回退机制（低置信度时调用LLM）。
Result: 在五个数据集和四种模型家族上，程序化评委可匹配13B规模LLM评委的性能。使用程序输出作为路由信号时，PAJAMA提升了准确率和吞吐量，推进了Pareto前沿。在RewardBench上，从程序裁决蒸馏出的奖励模型性能优于专有LLM标签训练的模型，且API成本低两个数量级。
Conclusion: 程序化评委作为LLM评委的替代方案，兼具透明、可编辑、低成本和可扩展的优点，并可作为有效的奖励信号。

papers.title: Efficient multidisciplinary design via Bayesian optimization
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces SEGOMOE, a Bayesian optimization tool for optimizing complex, computationally expensive systems, especially in aeronautics. It efficiently handles mixed design variables (continuous, discrete, categorical, hierarchical) using adaptive Gaussian process models. SEGOMOE combines expert models to address nonlinearities in objectives and constraints, leveraging the open-source Surrogate Modeling Toolbox (SMT). The tool supports multi-fidelity data and solves both single- and multi-objective problems, including hidden constraints and high-dimensional decomposition. Validated through benchmarks and real-world aeronautical applications, SEGOMOE proves to be robust and versatile for tackling multidisciplinary challenges.
papers.comment: SEGOMOE. In Proceedings of the 17ème Colloque National en Calcul des Structures (CSMA 2026), Giens, France, May 2026
papers.journal_ref: Bartoli, N., Lefebvre, T., Lafage, R., Saves, P., Diouane, Y., & Morlier, J. (2026). Efficient multidisciplinary design via Bayesian optimization. CSMA 17, Giens, France, May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍SEGOMOE，一个基于贝叶斯优化的工具，用于优化复杂且计算昂贵的系统，特别是航空领域。它通过自适应高斯过程模型处理混合设计变量（连续、离散、分类、层次），融合专家模型处理非线性的目标和约束，并支持多保真度数据、单目标和多目标问题，包括隐藏约束和高维分解。通过基准测试和真实航空应用验证了其鲁棒性和通用性。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理具有混合变量、非线性约束和多保真度数据的复杂多学科设计问题时效率较低，需要更高效的优化工具。
Method: SEGOMOE采用贝叶斯优化框架，使用自适应高斯过程模型处理混合变量，通过组合专家模型来应对非线性的目标和约束，并支持多保真度数据。工具基于开源替代模型工具箱（SMT）构建。
Result: 摘要通过基准测试和真实航空应用验证了SEGOMOE的鲁棒性和通用性，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: SEGOMOE被证明是一个鲁棒且通用的工具，能够有效解决多学科挑战问题，尤其适用于航空领域的复杂设计优化。

papers.title: MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出MIITA框架，一种针对小语言模型在资源受限持续学习中的内存诱导推理时适应方法。通过存储修正方向原型和语义锚点，在推理时以语义和不确定性线索检索，并用门控临时隐藏状态适应实现无破坏性重用，无需更新主干或扩展提示。实验表明在固定内存预算下持续提升性能并缓解遗忘。
Motivation: 小语言模型在持续学习中因参数空间有限直接更新导致灾难性遗忘，而现有为大语言模型设计的记忆方法依赖大存储和强上下文推理，小模型难以适用。
Method: 存储监督经验为紧凑的修正方向原型和语义锚点，推理时基于语义和不确定性检索，通过门控临时隐藏状态适应应用检索到的方向，避免骨干更新、提示扩展或测试时反向传播。
Result: 在多种监督持续学习设置下，MIITA在固定内存预算下持续提升最终性能并缓解遗忘。
Conclusion: 该设计通过将记忆与参数分离，实现小语言模型在受限条件下的非破坏性知识复用，理论分析联系到一阶损失降低、不确定性引导检索和方向覆盖。

papers.title: DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

papers.title: Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across four benchmarks and 13 models, we find that model outputs frequently depend on the exact wording of the prompt. While overall accuracy typically changes only modestly across paraphrases, instance-level behavior is far less stable: for many questions, models alternate between correct and incorrect answers depending on phrasing, with mismatch rates reaching more than 23%. Conditioning on questions that are answered correctly in their original form reveals even larger failures measured by answer flip rates, showing that single-prompt correctness is often a poor indicator of reliability. At the same time, we find that models often produce a correct answer for at least one paraphrase of a question, suggesting that the underlying knowledge is present but inconsistently retrieved. Building on this observation, we show that a simple self-paraphrasing strategy can partially recover this latent knowledge and improve performance at inference time. Together, these findings suggest that standard accuracy metrics can mask substantial instability, and that evaluating consistency across equivalent inputs provides a clearer picture of LLM reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在面对语义等价的释义（paraphrase）时，回答是否一致。在事实问答和数学推理任务上，发现模型输出常依赖于具体措辞，单次正确性不可靠，但通过自释义策略可部分恢复潜在知识。
Motivation: 现有基准测试主要报告总体准确率，但很难反映模型在等价问题表述下的可靠性。本文旨在揭示准确率背后的不稳定性，并探索利用释义一致性来评估LLM的真实可靠性。
Method: 系统性地对同一问题的多种意义不变的释义进行测试，比较模型输出的一致性。提出一种简单的自释义（self-paraphrasing）推理策略，在测试时通过多次释义投票提升性能。
Result: 在4个基准和13个模型上，总体准确率变化不大，但实例级不一致率超过23%；正确问题在原措辞下回答正确时，翻转率更高。自释义策略可部分恢复潜在知识，提升推理性能。
Conclusion: 标准准确率指标会掩盖LLM的严重不稳定性；评估等价输入下的一致性更能反映模型的真实可靠性。

papers.title: Evaluating the Impact of Reviewer Guideline Design on LLM-Based Automated Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: Peer review is an essential process in scientific research, yet the growing workload has made its automation increasingly necessary. In this study, we analyze how different types of reviewer guidelines, such as official conference guidelines and reviewer-imitating ones generated from high-quality human reviews using LLMs, affect automated peer review. Our experiments show that official conference guidelines produce review results most consistent with human judgments, suggesting that evaluation criteria refined through conference practice serve as effective guidance for automated reviewing as well. In contrast, reviewer-imitating guidelines were generally less effective than official conference guidelines. Furthermore, enforcing strict rubric-style scoring consistently degraded performance, highlighting the importance of allowing subjective and holistic scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不同类型审稿指南（官方会议指南 vs. 模仿人类审稿者的指南）对基于LLM的自动化同行评审的影响。实验发现官方会议指南产生的评审结果与人类判断最一致，而模仿审稿者的指南效果较差，且强制使用严格的评分标准会降低评审质量。
Motivation: 同行评审工作量日益增长，自动化评审需求迫切，但如何设计有效的审稿指南以提升LLM评审质量尚不明确。
Method: 对比分析官方会议指南和由高质量人类评审生成的模仿审稿者指南，在LLM自动评审中的效果，并测试严格评分标准的影响。
Result: 官方会议指南与人类判断一致性最高；模仿审稿者指南效果较差；强制执行严格评分标准持续降低性能。
Conclusion: 经过会议实践验证的评估标准对自动评审有效，而模仿人类审稿者的指南并非更优；允许主观和整体评分比严格标准更重要。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MioFFAn: an Annotation Software for Formula Formalization with LLM Automation Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: The automatic translation of mathematical expressions in scientific literature into executable symbolic code (a process we refer to as Formula Formalization) is hindered by a severe scarcity of high-quality, ground-truth datasets specialized for technical scientific domains. In this paper, we present MioFFAn, an open-source, document-centric, and customizable framework designed to facilitate rapid annotation for this task. Building upon the MioGatto architecture, we extend existing features to overcome structural limitations and pivot its scope by introducing specific functionalities for Formula Formalization, such as selection of equations of interest and aided symbolic code specification. By allowing users to configure custom taxonomies and properties for identified symbols, and compatible symbolic operators, we ensure the framework is adaptable to diverse specialized scientific fields. Furthermore, MioFFAn is designed to incorporate partial automation via Large Language Models. By defining a modular set of automated sub-tasks with strict output formats, we enable researchers to iteratively refine automation capabilities and evaluate competing strategies using standard NLP metrics. We specify the current automation methodology and perform a preliminary evaluation that demonstrates to efficacy of this human-in-the-loop approach.
papers.comment: Presented in the 3rd International Workshop on Natural Scientific Language Processing (NSLP 2026), co-located at LREC2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 3rd Int. Workshop on Natural Scientific Language Processing (NSLP 2026) at LREC 2026, pages 206-217
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MioFFAn，一个开源、文档中心、可定制的注释框架，用于将科学文献中的数学表达式自动翻译成可执行符号代码（公式形式化）。该框架基于MioGatto架构，扩展了公式选择、符号代码指定等功能，并支持通过大语言模型（LLM）实现部分自动化。初步评估验证了这种人在回路（human-in-the-loop）方法的有效性。
Motivation: 科学文献中数学表达式到符号代码的自动翻译（公式形式化）因缺乏高质量、领域特化的真实标注数据集而受阻。
Method: 基于MioGatto架构，MioFFAn允许用户配置自定义分类和符号属性，并定义了模块化的LLM自动化子任务，支持严格输出格式，以便迭代优化自动化能力和评估竞争策略。
Result: 初步评估显示该方法有效，但摘要未提供具体数值指标。
Conclusion: MioFFAn通过可定制框架和LLM辅助的自动化，为公式形式化注释提供了一种灵活的人机协作方案，适用于多种专业科学领域。

papers.title: Learning to Optimize at Scale: A Benders Decomposition-TransfORmers Framework for Stochastic Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose a learning-augmented Benders decomposition framework to solve large-scale two-stage stochastic mixed-integer programs. We focus on the two-stage stochastic capacitated lot-sizing problem (TSSCLSP) under demand uncertainty. Our method accelerates the convergence of the decomposition by using a pre-trained TransfORmer model to rapidly generate high-quality approximate solutions for the scenario subproblems. This hybrid strategy uses the TransfORmer predictions to generate strong optimality and feasibility cuts, effectively guiding the Benders master problem. Our framework includes a novel expandable generation mechanism, allowing a model trained on a fixed horizon to solve instances of arbitrary length. For the test set considered, our method solves instances up to T = 270, a scale previously intractable for this approach, while maintaining zero infeasibility in the generated subproblem solutions. This demonstrates the potential of TransfORmers as powerful surrogate solvers embedded within classical decomposition algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习增强的Benders分解框架，用于求解大规模两阶段随机混合整数规划问题，特别针对需求不确定下的随机能力受限批量问题（TSSCLSP）。方法利用预训练的Transformer模型快速生成场景子问题的高质量近似解，进而产生强最优性和可行性割，加速Benders主问题的收敛。框架包含可扩展生成机制，使得在固定时间范围上训练的模型能够求解任意长度的实例，在测试中成功求解了T=270的实例（此前对该方法不可行），且生成的子问题解零不可行。
Motivation: 传统Benders分解在大规模随机组合优化问题中收敛缓慢，子问题求解计算成本高，限制了其实际应用规模。
Method: 采用预训练的Transformer模型作为快速近似求解器，为每个场景子问题生成近似解，并用这些解构造Benders分解中的最优性割和可行性割，从而指导主问题的迭代。同时设计可扩展生成机制，使训练好的模型能泛化到不同时间范围的实例。
Result: 在TSSCLSP测试集上，所提方法成功求解了时间范围T=270的实例，该规模此前对Benders分解方法不可行，且所有子问题解均满足可行性（零不可行）。
Conclusion: Transformer可作为强大的代理求解器嵌入经典分解算法，有效扩展Benders分解的可解规模，为大规模随机组合优化提供新路径。

papers.title: QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation. We present QFoldAgent, a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding in which a design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the resulting Hamiltonian under Qiskit Aer noise, and a feedback agent uses energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation signals to refine penalties across cycles. Ground-truth metrics such as RMSD are never exposed to the agents and are used only for evaluation. We study the framework on two complementary datasets: 55 QDockBank-derived fragments with known structures and 100 coverage-optimized unseen sequences. On the QDockBank benchmark, QFoldAgent reduces median RMSD from 3.64 Å to 3.20 Å, with the largest gains on the hardest targets. On unseen sequences, the closed loop raises structural validity from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovers 87% of initially invalid cases, and the strongest controller improves cycle-3 energy on 87% of sequences while maintaining 96% Ramachandran-favored geometry. These results show that iterative agent control can systematically improve optimization behavior and reduce failure cases in a 5-residue quantum setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QFoldAgent，一个闭环多智能体框架，用于5残基四面体晶格折叠的量子-经典混合蛋白质结构预测。框架包含设计智能体、VQE量子-经典流水线和反馈智能体，通过能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号迭代优化哈密顿量惩罚权重。在55个QDockBank片段上，中位RMSD从3.64 Å降至3.20 Å；在100个未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%。结果表明迭代智能体控制能系统性改善量子场景下的优化行为并减少失败案例。
Motivation: 现有混合量子-经典蛋白质结构预测工作通常手工固定哈密顿量惩罚权重，且仅评估短片段，缺乏自动优化机制。
Method: 提出闭环多智能体框架，包含设计智能体（提出序列条件惩罚）、VQE量子-经典流水线（在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量）和反馈智能体（利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号细化惩罚）。
Result: 在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64 Å降至3.20 Å，最难目标上增益最大；在未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%升至98.7%，恢复87%初始无效案例，最佳控制器在87%序列上改善第三轮能量并维持96% Ramachandran偏好几何。
Conclusion: 迭代智能体控制可系统性改善5残基量子设置中的优化行为并减少失败案例，但当前框架限于短片段和四面体晶格模型。

summary_sections.result: 在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64 Å降至3.20 Å，最难目标上增益最大；在未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%升至98.7%，恢复87%初始无效案例，最佳控制器在87%序列上改善第三轮能量并维持96% Ramachandran偏好几何。
summary_sections.conclusion: 迭代智能体控制可系统性改善5残基量子设置中的优化行为并减少失败案例，但当前框架限于短片段和四面体晶格模型。

papers.title: SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series
papers.abstract_en: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeT-Diff，首个面向高性能计算（HPC）节点遥测和时间序列的基础模型。该模型利用扩散过程，以传感器的语义描述为条件，实现与数据集结构解耦的生成。在真实超算数据集上，重建任务的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.0470，并展现出零样本排列稳定性。单个预训练模型可有效执行数据插补、预测和虚拟传感，在热推断任务上MAE达0.033。
Motivation: 当前HPC遥测的机器学习模型通常依赖静态的固定位置传感器变量子集，当目标任务或传感器指标变化时模型失效。
Method: 提出扩散基础的模型 SeT-Diff，以每个传感器的语义描述为条件进行生成，从而解耦系统动态与数据集结构。
Result: 在真实超算数据集上，重建MAE为0.0470；零样本排列稳定性下准确率几乎无损失；一个预训练模型可实现数据插补、预测和虚拟传感，热推断MAE为0.033。
Conclusion: SeT-Diff作为数据驱动的数字孪生，可有效建模HPC节点遥测，并具有适应不同任务和传感器配置的灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semalith v1.4: A Calibrated 184M Safety Classifier Achieving State-of-the-Art Prompt-Injection Detection at 44x Fewer Parameters than Llama-Guard-3-8B
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models in financial-services and agentic settings requires safety classifiers that simultaneously handle prompt injection, regulatory compliance, and general harm, a combination no existing open guardrail addresses in a single inference pass. Semalith v1.4 is a 184M-parameter DeBERTa-v3-base classifier performing simultaneous three-axis safety classification including prompt injection, general harm, and financial-services regulatory compliance, in a single forward pass. Its 22-class head (BENIGN, nine prompt-injection sub-types, general-harm, eleven BFSI labels) is trained with a 4-class auxiliary super-category head under jointly weighted loss, on a 76,204-row corpus mined from 49 public sources with SHA-1 deduplication against every held-out evaluation set, with 21 of 22 benchmarks at zero contamination (max 0.22%). Against Llama-Guard-3-8B on 22 held-out benchmarks, Semalith v1.4 wins every prompt-injection evaluation (7/7) and 11 of 18 benchmarks overall at 44x fewer parameters, with FPR = 0.000 on 208 benign agentic prompts vs 0.063 for Llama-Guard-3-8B. On general-harm benchmarks (WildGuardMix, HEx-PHI, HarmBench), Llama-Guard-3 leads; this complementary split is documented in Section 4. Six measured weak spots are disclosed in Section 6. Deployment guidance: v1.3 is recommended for conversational moderation deployments (ToxicChat F1 0.624); v1.4 is recommended when BFSI label coverage or zero-FPR on benign agentic prompts is the priority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Semalith v1.4，一个 184M 参数的 DeBERTa-v3-base 分类器，用于同时检测提示注入、一般危害和金融服务监管合规。在 22 个 held-out 基准测试中，以 44x 更少的参数在提示注入评估上全部击败 Llama-Guard-3-8B，但在一般危害基准上落后。训练语料来自 49 个公开来源，经 SHA-1 去重确保零污染。
Motivation: 在金融服务和代理场景中部署大语言模型需要同时处理提示注入、监管合规和一般危害的安全分类器，现有开源防护栏无法一次推理同时满足三者。
Method: 使用 184M 参数的 DeBERTa-v3-base，22 类输出头（BENIGN、9 种提示注入子类型、一般危害、11 个 BFSI 标签）与 4 类辅助超类别头联合加权损失训练，训练数据为 76,204 行从 49 个公开来源挖掘的语料。
Result: 在 22 个 held-out 基准上，Semalith v1.4 在 7/7 提示注入评估中获胜，整体 18 个基准中胜出 11 个，参数数仅为 Llama-Guard-3-8B 的 1/44；对 208 个良性代理提示 FPR=0.000，而 Llama-Guard 为 0.063。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 v1.4 适用于需要 BFSI 标签或零假阳性率的场景，v1.3 更适合对话审核；论文披露了六个已知弱点。

papers.title: Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-VCE，一种将分类器直接集成到扩散模型中的概念瓶颈层的新框架，用于生成视觉反事实解释。通过让用户控制语义概念、使用概率正则化器和梯度掩码，C-VCE 在 CelebA 基准上匹配或提高了翻转率，同时生成更接近原始图像、畸变更小的反事实。该方法避免依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器，增强了可解释性和实用性。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的反事实解释依赖外部分类器，这些分类器需要在噪声图像上可靠工作，导致脆弱且难以部署。
Method: 引入概念瓶颈层，将分类器内置于生成模型中，通过采样时开关语义概念、概率正则化器平衡预测改变与原始相似度，以及梯度掩码限制修改区域。
Result: 在 CelebA 基准上，C-VCE 的翻转率与现有方法相当或更高，且生成的反事实图像在视觉上更接近输入、变形更少。
Conclusion: 暴露和控制内部概念层是使生成模型更易于理解和安全使用的有前景方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comparing Optimization Models for Radiotherapy Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: The Radiotherapy Scheduling Problem (RTSP) involves determining an optimal schedule for patients undergoing radiation treatments, a task that has a massive impact on clinical outcomes given the central role of radiotherapy in cancer care. The daily batch approach--which consists of scheduling all the newly arrived patients together at the end of each day--modelled with Integer Linear Programming, is currently one of the most effective methods for the RTSP. However, this kind of formulation requires substantial computational resources in terms of time and memory. Here, we address these limitations by developing two novel greedy heuristics (named RTSP First Fit and RTSP Best Fit) and use them as constructive heuristics for a Simulated Annealing (SA) approach to optimize the scheduling. The proposed methods--the heuristics alone and their combination with SA--are evaluated on a publicly available dataset against an integer linear program formulation solved with two different state-of-the-art exact solvers. Evaluation metrics include six scheduling objectives capturing patient waiting times, preference satisfaction, and changes in linear accelerator assignment (aggregated in four different weight configurations), solving time, and memory consumption. The results show that the novel heuristics achieve solutions close to those of exact methods, while dramatically reducing runtime and memory usage; furthermore, when combined with SA, they further improve the solution quality while maintaining low runtime and memory usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对放射治疗调度问题（RTSP），提出两种新的贪婪启发式算法（RTSP First Fit和RTSP Best Fit），并将其作为模拟退火（SA）的构造式启发方法。在公开数据集上，与整数线性规划求解器对比，新方法在接近最优解质量的同时，大幅降低了运行时间和内存消耗。
Motivation: 现有的整数线性规划方法求解RTSP需要大量计算资源和内存，限制其在临床中的实际应用。
Method: 开发两种贪婪启发式算法（First Fit和Best Fit）用于初始调度，再结合模拟退火进行优化。
Result: 在四个不同权重配置下，新启发式方法产生的解质量接近精确方法，而运行时间和内存使用显著减少；结合SA后进一步提升了解质量，同时仍保持低资源消耗。
Conclusion: 提出的贪婪启发式与模拟退火组合为RTSP提供了高效且实用的近似求解方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Face Recognition with Machine Learning in OpenCV_ Fusion of the results with the Localization Data of an Acoustic Camera for Speaker Identification
papers.abstract_en: This contribution gives an overview of face recogni-tion algorithms, their implementation and practical uses. First, a training set of different persons' faces has to be collected and used to train a face recognizer. The resulting face model can be utilized to classify people in specific individuals or unknowns. After tracking the recognized face and estimating the acoustic sound source's position, both can be combined to give detailed information about possible speakers and if they are talking or not. This leads to a precise real-time description of the situation, which can be used for further applications, e.g. for multi-channel speech enhancement by adaptive beamformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文概述了人脸识别算法及其在OpenCV中的实现，通过训练人脸模型进行身份分类，并结合声学相机的声源定位数据，实现说话人识别与说话状态判断。该方法适用于实时场景描述，并可进一步用于多通道语音增强。
Motivation: 现有系统难以在复杂声学环境中准确识别说话人并判断其是否正在说话，融合视觉与声学信息可提供更精确的情景描述。
Method: 收集并训练人脸数据集生成人脸模型，利用OpenCV进行人脸识别与跟踪；同时使用声学相机估计声源位置；将两者融合，根据人脸位置与声源位置匹配判断说话人身份及说话状态。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称能给出精确的实时情景描述，并可用于自适应波束形成的多通道语音增强。
Conclusion: 该融合方法有望提升说话人识别与语音增强的性能，但缺少量化评估。
Relevance: 0
